verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל לֵ/אמֹר֒ נֶ֗פֶשׁ כִּֽי תֶחֱטָ֤א בִ/שְׁגָגָה֙ מִ/כֹּל֙ מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֣א תֵעָשֶׂ֑ינָה וְ/עָשָׂ֕ה מֵ/אַחַ֖ת מֵ/הֵֽנָּה
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l l'mr npsh khy tcht' bshggh mkhl mtsvt yhvh 'shr l' t'shynh v'shh m'cht mhnh
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:

verses.original: אִ֣ם הַ/כֹּהֵ֧ן הַ/מָּשִׁ֛יחַ יֶחֱטָ֖א לְ/אַשְׁמַ֣ת הָ/עָ֑ם וְ/הִקְרִ֡יב עַ֣ל חַטָּאת/וֹ֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָטָ֜א פַּ֣ר בֶּן בָּקָ֥ר תָּמִ֛ים לַ/יהוָ֖ה לְ/חַטָּֽאת
verses.translit: 'm hkhhn hmshych ycht' l'shmt h'm vhqryb 'l cht'tv 'shr cht' pr bn bqr tmym lyhvh lcht't
verses.translation: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the LORD for a sin offering.

verses.original: וְ/הֵבִ֣יא אֶת הַ/פָּ֗ר אֶל פֶּ֛תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/סָמַ֤ךְ אֶת יָד/וֹ֙ עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/פָּ֔ר וְ/שָׁחַ֥ט אֶת הַ/פָּ֖ר לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhby' 't hpr 'l ptch 'hl mv'd lpny yhvh vsmkh 't ydv 'l r'sh hpr vshcht 't hpr lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the LORD ; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock’s head, and kill the bullock before the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֛ח הַ/כֹּהֵ֥ן הַ/מָּשִׁ֖יחַ מִ/דַּ֣ם הַ/פָּ֑ר וְ/הֵבִ֥יא אֹת֖/וֹ אֶל אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn hmshych mdm hpr vhby' 'tv 'l 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock’s blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:

verses.original: וְ/טָבַ֧ל הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת אֶצְבָּע֖/וֹ בַּ/דָּ֑ם וְ/הִזָּ֨ה מִן הַ/דָּ֜ם שֶׁ֤בַע פְּעָמִים֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֶת פְּנֵ֖י פָּרֹ֥כֶת הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: vtbl hkhhn 't 'tsb'v bdm vhzh mn hdm shb' p'mym lpny yhvh 't pny prkht hqdsh
verses.translation: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the LORD , before the vail of the sanctuary.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַן֩ הַ/כֹּהֵ֨ן מִן הַ/דָּ֜ם עַל קַ֠רְנוֹת מִזְבַּ֨ח קְטֹ֤רֶת הַ/סַּמִּים֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְ/אֵ֣ת כָּל דַּ֣ם הַ/פָּ֗ר יִשְׁפֹּךְ֙ אֶל יְסוֹד֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָ/עֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vntn hkhhn mn hdm 'l qrnvt mzbch qtrt hsmym lpny yhvh 'shr b'hl mv'd v't khl dm hpr yshpkh 'l ysvd mzbch h'lh 'shr ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD , which is in the tabernacle of the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת כָּל חֵ֛לֶב פַּ֥ר הַֽ/חַטָּ֖את יָרִ֣ים מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ אֶת הַ/חֵ֨לֶב֙ הַֽ/מְכַסֶּ֣ה עַל הַ/קֶּ֔רֶב וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל הַ/חֵ֔לֶב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַ/קֶּֽרֶב
verses.translit: v't khl chlb pr hcht't yrym mmnv 't hchlb hmkhsh 'l hqrb v't khl hchlb 'shr 'l hqrb
verses.translation: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַ/כְּלָיֹ֔ת וְ/אֶת הַ/חֵ֨לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַ/כְּסָלִ֑ים וְ/אֶת הַ/יֹּתֶ֨רֶת֙ עַל הַ/כָּבֵ֔ד עַל הַ/כְּלָי֖וֹת יְסִירֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: v't shty hkhlyt v't hchlb 'shr 'lyhn 'shr 'l hkhslym v't hytrt 'l hkhbd 'l hkhlyvt ysyrnh
verses.translation: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away,

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר יוּרַ֔ם מִ/שּׁ֖וֹר זֶ֣בַח הַ/שְּׁלָמִ֑ים וְ/הִקְטִירָ/ם֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן עַ֖ל מִזְבַּ֥ח הָ/עֹלָֽה
verses.translit: kh'shr yvrm mshvr zbch hshlmym vhqtyrm hkhhn 'l mzbch h'lh
verses.translation: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת ע֤וֹר הַ/פָּר֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל בְּשָׂר֔/וֹ עַל רֹאשׁ֖/וֹ וְ/עַל כְּרָעָ֑י/ו וְ/קִרְבּ֖/וֹ וּ/פִרְשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: v't 'vr hpr v't khl bshrv 'l r'shv v'l khr'yv vqrbv vprshv
verses.translation: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,

verses.original: וְ/הוֹצִ֣יא אֶת כָּל הַ֠/פָּר אֶל מִ/ח֨וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֜ה אֶל מָק֤וֹם טָהוֹר֙ אֶל שֶׁ֣פֶךְ הַ/דֶּ֔שֶׁן וְ/שָׂרַ֥ף אֹת֛/וֹ עַל עֵצִ֖ים בָּ/אֵ֑שׁ עַל שֶׁ֥פֶךְ הַ/דֶּ֖שֶׁן יִשָּׂרֵֽף
verses.translit: vhvtsy' 't khl hpr 'l mchvts lmchnh 'l mqvm thvr 'l shpkh hdshn vshrf 'tv 'l 'tsym b'sh 'l shpkh hdshn yshrf
verses.translation: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֨ם כָּל עֲדַ֤ת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יִשְׁגּ֔וּ וְ/נֶעְלַ֣ם דָּבָ֔ר מֵ/עֵינֵ֖י הַ/קָּהָ֑ל וְ֠/עָשׂוּ אַחַ֨ת מִ/כָּל מִצְוֺ֧ת יְהוָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂ֖ינָה וְ/אָשֵֽׁמוּ
verses.translit: v'm khl 'dt yshr'l yshgv vn'lm dbr m'yny hqhl v'shv 'cht mkhl mtsvt yhvh 'shr l' t'shynh v'shmv
verses.translation: And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which should not be done, and are guilty;

verses.original: וְ/נֽוֹדְעָה֙ הַֽ/חַטָּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטְא֖וּ עָלֶ֑י/הָ וְ/הִקְרִ֨יבוּ הַ/קָּהָ֜ל פַּ֤ר בֶּן בָּקָר֙ לְ/חַטָּ֔את וְ/הֵבִ֣יאוּ אֹת֔/וֹ לִ/פְנֵ֖י אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vnvd'h hcht't 'shr cht'v 'lyh vhqrybv hqhl pr bn bqr lcht't vhby'v 'tv lpny 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: וְ֠/סָמְכוּ זִקְנֵ֨י הָ/עֵדָ֧ה אֶת יְדֵי/הֶ֛ם עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הַ/פָּ֖ר לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/שָׁחַ֥ט אֶת הַ/פָּ֖ר לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vsmkhv zqny h'dh 't ydyhm 'l r'sh hpr lpny yhvh vshcht 't hpr lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the LORD : and the bullock shall be killed before the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הֵבִ֛יא הַ/כֹּהֵ֥ן הַ/מָּשִׁ֖יחַ מִ/דַּ֣ם הַ/פָּ֑ר אֶל אֹ֖הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vhby' hkhhn hmshych mdm hpr 'l 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock’s blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:

verses.original: וְ/טָבַ֧ל הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן אֶצְבָּע֖/וֹ מִן הַ/דָּ֑ם וְ/הִזָּ֞ה שֶׁ֤בַע פְּעָמִים֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֖ת פְּנֵ֥י הַ/פָּרֹֽכֶת
verses.translit: vtbl hkhhn 'tsb'v mn hdm vhzh shb' p'mym lpny yhvh 't pny hprkht
verses.translation: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD , even before the vail.

verses.original: וּ/מִן הַ/דָּ֞ם יִתֵּ֣ן עַל קַרְנֹ֣ת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֗חַ אֲשֶׁר֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְ/אֵ֣ת כָּל הַ/דָּ֗ם יִשְׁפֹּךְ֙ אֶל יְסוֹד֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָ/עֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vmn hdm ytn 'l qrnt hmzbch 'shr lpny yhvh 'shr b'hl mv'd v't khl hdm yshpkh 'l ysvd mzbch h'lh 'shr ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And he shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before the LORD , that is in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֥ת כָּל חֶלְבּ֖/וֹ יָרִ֣ים מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ וְ/הִקְטִ֖יר הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחָ/ה
verses.translit: v't khl chlbv yrym mmnv vhqtyr hmzbchh
verses.translation: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn it upon the altar.

verses.original: וְ/עָשָׂ֣ה לַ/פָּ֔ר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לְ/פַ֣ר הַֽ/חַטָּ֔את כֵּ֖ן יַעֲשֶׂה לּ֑/וֹ וְ/כִפֶּ֧ר עֲלֵ/הֶ֛ם הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן וְ/נִסְלַ֥ח לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'shh lpr kh'shr 'shh lpr hcht't khn y'shh lv vkhpr 'lhm hkhhn vnslch lhm
verses.translation: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.

verses.original: וְ/הוֹצִ֣יא אֶת הַ/פָּ֗ר אֶל מִ/חוּץ֙ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְ/שָׂרַ֣ף אֹת֔/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂרַ֔ף אֵ֖ת הַ/פָּ֣ר הָ/רִאשׁ֑וֹן חַטַּ֥את הַ/קָּהָ֖ל הֽוּא
verses.translit: vhvtsy' 't hpr 'l mchvts lmchnh vshrf 'tv kh'shr shrf 't hpr hr'shvn cht't hqhl hv'
verses.translation: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it is a sin offering for the congregation.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָשִׂ֖יא יֶֽחֱטָ֑א וְ/עָשָׂ֡ה אַחַ֣ת מִ/כָּל מִצְוֺת֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהָ֜י/ו אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂ֛ינָה בִּ/שְׁגָגָ֖ה וְ/אָשֵֽׁם
verses.translit: 'shr nshy' ycht' v'shh 'cht mkhl mtsvt yhvh 'lhyv 'shr l' t'shynh bshggh v'shm
verses.translation: When a ruler hath sinned, and done somewhat through ignorance against any of the commandments of the LORD his God concerning things which should not be done, and is guilty;

verses.original: אֽוֹ הוֹדַ֤ע אֵלָי/ו֙ חַטָּאת֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖א בָּ֑/הּ וְ/הֵבִ֧יא אֶת קָרְבָּנ֛/וֹ שְׂעִ֥יר עִזִּ֖ים זָכָ֥ר תָּמִֽים
verses.translit: 'v hvd' 'lyv cht'tv 'shr cht' bh vhby' 't qrbnv sh'yr 'zym zkhr tmym
verses.translation: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:

verses.original: וְ/סָמַ֤ךְ יָד/וֹ֙ עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/שָּׂעִ֔יר וְ/שָׁחַ֣ט אֹת֔/וֹ בִּ/מְק֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁחַ֥ט אֶת הָ/עֹלָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה חַטָּ֖את הֽוּא
verses.translit: vsmkh ydv 'l r'sh hsh'yr vshcht 'tv bmqvm 'shr yshcht 't h'lh lpny yhvh cht't hv'
verses.translation: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD : it is a sin offering.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֨ח הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן מִ/דַּ֤ם הַֽ/חַטָּאת֙ בְּ/אֶצְבָּע֔/וֹ וְ/נָתַ֕ן עַל קַרְנֹ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָ/עֹלָ֑ה וְ/אֶת דָּמ֣/וֹ יִשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל יְס֖וֹד מִזְבַּ֥ח הָ/עֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn mdm hcht't b'tsb'v vntn 'l qrnt mzbch h'lh v't dmv yshpkh 'l ysvd mzbch h'lh
verses.translation: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת כָּל חֶלְבּ/וֹ֙ יַקְטִ֣יר הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חָ/ה כְּ/חֵ֖לֶב זֶ֣בַח הַ/שְּׁלָמִ֑ים וְ/כִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧י/ו הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן מֵ/חַטָּאת֖/וֹ וְ/נִסְלַ֥ח לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v't khl chlbv yqtyr hmzbchh khchlb zbch hshlmym vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn mcht'tv vnslch lv
verses.translation: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.

verses.original: וְ/אִם נֶ֧פֶשׁ אַחַ֛ת תֶּחֱטָ֥א בִ/שְׁגָגָ֖ה מֵ/עַ֣ם הָ/אָ֑רֶץ בַּ֠/עֲשֹׂתָ/הּ אַחַ֨ת מִ/מִּצְוֺ֧ת יְהוָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא תֵעָשֶׂ֖ינָה וְ/אָשֵֽׁם
verses.translit: v'm npsh 'cht tcht' bshggh m'm h'rts b'shth 'cht mmtsvt yhvh 'shr l' t'shynh v'shm
verses.translation: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the LORD concerning things which ought not to be done, and be guilty;

verses.original: א֚וֹ הוֹדַ֣ע אֵלָ֔י/ו חַטָּאת֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֑א וְ/הֵבִ֨יא קָרְבָּנ֜/וֹ שְׂעִירַ֤ת עִזִּים֙ תְּמִימָ֣ה נְקֵבָ֔ה עַל חַטָּאת֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָֽא
verses.translit: 'v hvd' 'lyv cht'tv 'shr cht' vhby' qrbnv sh'yrt 'zym tmymh nqbh 'l cht'tv 'shr cht'
verses.translation: Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.

verses.original: וְ/סָמַךְ֙ אֶת יָד֔/וֹ עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַֽ/חַטָּ֑את וְ/שָׁחַט֙ אֶת הַ֣/חַטָּ֔את בִּ/מְק֖וֹם הָ/עֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vsmkh 't ydv 'l r'sh hcht't vshcht 't hcht't bmqvm h'lh
verses.translation: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֨ח הַ/כֹּהֵ֤ן מִ/דָּמָ/הּ֙ בְּ/אֶצְבָּע֔/וֹ וְ/נָתַ֕ן עַל קַרְנֹ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָ/עֹלָ֑ה וְ/אֶת כָּל דָּמָ֣/הּ יִשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל יְס֖וֹד הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn mdmh b'tsb'v vntn 'l qrnt mzbch h'lh v't khl dmh yshpkh 'l ysvd hmzbch
verses.translation: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת כָּל חֶלְבָּ֣/הּ יָסִ֗יר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוּסַ֣ר חֵלֶב֮ מֵ/עַ֣ל זֶ֣בַח הַ/שְּׁלָמִים֒ וְ/הִקְטִ֤יר הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חָ/ה לְ/רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/כִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛י/ו הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן וְ/נִסְלַ֥ח לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v't khl chlbh ysyr kh'shr hvsr chlb m'l zbch hshlmym vhqtyr hkhhn hmzbchh lrych nychch lyhvh vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn vnslch lv
verses.translation: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the LORD ; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.

verses.original: וְ/אִם כֶּ֛בֶשׂ יָבִ֥יא קָרְבָּנ֖/וֹ לְ/חַטָּ֑את נְקֵבָ֥ה תְמִימָ֖ה יְבִיאֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: v'm khbsh yby' qrbnv lcht't nqbh tmymh yby'nh
verses.translation: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.

verses.original: וְ/סָמַךְ֙ אֶת יָד֔/וֹ עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַֽ/חַטָּ֑את וְ/שָׁחַ֤ט אֹתָ/הּ֙ לְ/חַטָּ֔את בִּ/מְק֕וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשְׁחַ֖ט אֶת הָ/עֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vsmkh 't ydv 'l r'sh hcht't vshcht 'th lcht't bmqvm 'shr yshcht 't h'lh
verses.translation: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֨ח הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן מִ/דַּ֤ם הַֽ/חַטָּאת֙ בְּ/אֶצְבָּע֔/וֹ וְ/נָתַ֕ן עַל קַרְנֹ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָ/עֹלָ֑ה וְ/אֶת כָּל דָּמָ֣/הּ יִשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל יְס֖וֹד הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn mdm hcht't b'tsb'v vntn 'l qrnt mzbch h'lh v't khl dmh yshpkh 'l ysvd hmzbch
verses.translation: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar:

verses.original: וְ/אֶת כָּל חֶלְבָּ֣/ה יָסִ֗יר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר יוּסַ֥ר חֵֽלֶב הַ/כֶּשֶׂב֮ מִ/זֶּ֣בַח הַ/שְּׁלָמִים֒ וְ/הִקְטִ֨יר הַ/כֹּהֵ֤ן אֹתָ/ם֙ הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חָ/ה עַ֖ל אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/כִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧י/ו הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן עַל חַטָּאת֥/וֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָ֖א וְ/נִסְלַ֥ח לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v't khl chlbh ysyr kh'shr yvsr chlb hkhshb mzbch hshlmym vhqtyr hkhhn 'tm hmzbchh 'l 'shy yhvh vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn 'l cht'tv 'shr cht' vnslch lv
verses.translation: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD : and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.

verses.original: וְ/נֶ֣פֶשׁ כִּֽי תֶחֱטָ֗א וְ/שָֽׁמְעָה֙ ק֣וֹל אָלָ֔ה וְ/ה֣וּא עֵ֔ד א֥וֹ רָאָ֖ה א֣וֹ יָדָ֑ע אִם ל֥וֹא יַגִּ֖יד וְ/נָשָׂ֥א עֲוֺנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vnpsh khy tcht' vshm'h qvl 'lh vhv' 'd 'v r'h 'v yd' 'm lv' ygyd vnsh' 'vnv
verses.translation: And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, whether he hath seen or known of it; if he do not utter it , then he shall bear his iniquity.

verses.original: א֣וֹ נֶ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּגַּע֮ בְּ/כָל דָּבָ֣ר טָמֵא֒ אוֹ֩ בְ/נִבְלַ֨ת חַיָּ֜ה טְמֵאָ֗ה א֤וֹ בְּ/נִבְלַת֙ בְּהֵמָ֣ה טְמֵאָ֔ה א֕וֹ בְּ/נִבְלַ֖ת שֶׁ֣רֶץ טָמֵ֑א וְ/נֶעְלַ֣ם מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ וְ/ה֥וּא טָמֵ֖א וְ/אָשֵֽׁם
verses.translit: 'v npsh 'shr tg' bkhl dbr tm' 'v bnblt chyh tm'h 'v bnblt bhmh tm'h 'v bnblt shrts tm' vn'lm mmnv vhv' tm' v'shm
verses.translation: Or if a soul touch any unclean thing, whether it be a carcase of an unclean beast, or a carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of unclean creeping things, and if it be hidden from him; he also shall be unclean, and guilty.

verses.original: א֣וֹ כִ֤י יִגַּע֙ בְּ/טֻמְאַ֣ת אָדָ֔ם לְ/כֹל֙ טֻמְאָת֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִטְמָ֖א בָּ֑/הּ וְ/נֶעְלַ֣ם מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ וְ/ה֥וּא יָדַ֖ע וְ/אָשֵֽׁם
verses.translit: 'v khy yg' btm't 'dm lkhl tm'tv 'shr ytm' bh vn'lm mmnv vhv' yd' v'shm
verses.translation: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever uncleanness it be that a man shall be defiled withal, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it , then he shall be guilty.

verses.original: א֣וֹ נֶ֡פֶשׁ כִּ֣י תִשָּׁבַע֩ לְ/בַטֵּ֨א בִ/שְׂפָתַ֜יִם לְ/הָרַ֣ע א֣וֹ לְ/הֵיטִ֗יב לְ֠/כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְבַטֵּ֧א הָ/אָדָ֛ם בִּ/שְׁבֻעָ֖ה וְ/נֶעְלַ֣ם מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ וְ/הוּא יָדַ֥ע וְ/אָשֵׁ֖ם לְ/אַחַ֥ת מֵ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: 'v npsh khy tshb' lbt' bshptym lhr' 'v lhytyb lkhl 'shr ybt' h'dm bshb'h vn'lm mmnv vhv' yd' v'shm l'cht m'lh
verses.translation: Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it , then he shall be guilty in one of these.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֥ה כִֽי יֶאְשַׁ֖ם לְ/אַחַ֣ת מֵ/אֵ֑לֶּה וְ/הִ֨תְוַדָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖א עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vhyh khy y'shm l'cht m'lh vhtvdh 'shr cht' 'lyh
verses.translation: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these things , that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that thing:

verses.original: וְ/הֵבִ֣יא אֶת אֲשָׁמ֣/וֹ לַ/יהוָ֡ה עַ֣ל חַטָּאת/וֹ֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָטָ֜א נְקֵבָ֨ה מִן הַ/צֹּ֥אן כִּשְׂבָּ֛ה אֽוֹ שְׂעִירַ֥ת עִזִּ֖ים לְ/חַטָּ֑את וְ/כִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛י/ו הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן מֵ/חַטָּאתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhby' 't 'shmv lyhvh 'l cht'tv 'shr cht' nqbh mn hts'n khshbh 'v sh'yrt 'zym lcht't vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn mcht'tv
verses.translation: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin.

verses.original: וְ/אִם לֹ֨א תַגִּ֣יע יָד/וֹ֮ דֵּ֣י שֶׂה֒ וְ/הֵבִ֨יא אֶת אֲשָׁמ֜/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֗א שְׁתֵּ֥י תֹרִ֛ים אֽוֹ שְׁנֵ֥י בְנֵֽי יוֹנָ֖ה לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה אֶחָ֥ד לְ/חַטָּ֖את וְ/אֶחָ֥ד לְ/עֹלָֽה
verses.translit: v'm l' tgy' ydv dy shh vhby' 't 'shmv 'shr cht' shty trym 'v shny bny yvnh lyhvh 'chd lcht't v'chd l'lh
verses.translation: And if he be not able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring for his trespass, which he hath committed, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, unto the LORD ; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.

verses.original: וְ/הֵבִ֤יא אֹתָ/ם֙ אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/הִקְרִ֛יב אֶת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַ/חַטָּ֖את רִאשׁוֹנָ֑ה וּ/מָלַ֧ק אֶת רֹאשׁ֛/וֹ מִ/מּ֥וּל עָרְפּ֖/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א יַבְדִּֽיל
verses.translit: vhby' 'tm 'l hkhhn vhqryb 't 'shr lcht't r'shvnh vmlq 't r'shv mmvl 'rpv vl' ybdyl
verses.translation: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first, and wring off his head from his neck, but shall not divide it asunder:

verses.original: וְ/הִזָּ֞ה מִ/דַּ֤ם הַ/חַטָּאת֙ עַל קִ֣יר הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְ/הַ/נִּשְׁאָ֣ר בַּ/דָּ֔ם יִמָּצֵ֖ה אֶל יְס֣וֹד הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ חַטָּ֖את הֽוּא
verses.translit: vhzh mdm hcht't 'l qyr hmzbch vhnsh'r bdm ymtsh 'l ysvd hmzbch cht't hv'
verses.translation: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar: it is a sin offering.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/שֵּׁנִ֛י יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה עֹלָ֖ה כַּ/מִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְ/כִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧י/ו הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן מֵ/חַטָּאת֥/וֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָ֖א וְ/נִסְלַ֥ח לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v't hshny y'shh 'lh khmshpt vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn mcht'tv 'shr cht' vnslch lv
verses.translation: And he shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the manner: and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he hath sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.

verses.original: וְ/אִם לֹא֩ תַשִּׂ֨יג יָד֜/וֹ לִ/שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֗ים אוֹ֮ לִ/שְׁנֵ֣י בְנֵי יוֹנָה֒ וְ/הֵבִ֨יא אֶת קָרְבָּנ֜/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֗א עֲשִׂירִ֧ת הָ/אֵפָ֛ה סֹ֖לֶת לְ/חַטָּ֑את לֹא יָשִׂ֨ים עָלֶ֜י/הָ שֶׁ֗מֶן וְ/לֹא יִתֵּ֤ן עָלֶ֨י/הָ֙ לְבֹנָ֔ה כִּ֥י חַטָּ֖את הִֽיא
verses.translit: v'm l' tshyg ydv lshty trym 'v lshny bny yvnh vhby' 't qrbnv 'shr cht' 'shyrt h'ph slt lcht't l' yshym 'lyh shmn vl' ytn 'lyh lbnh khy cht't hy'
verses.translation: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon: for it is a sin offering.

verses.original: וֶ/הֱבִיאָ/הּ֮ אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵן֒ וְ/קָמַ֣ץ הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן מִ֠מֶּ/נָּה מְל֨וֹא קֻמְצ֜/וֹ אֶת אַזְכָּרָתָ/ה֙ וְ/הִקְטִ֣יר הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חָ/ה עַ֖ל אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהוָ֑ה חַטָּ֖את הִֽוא
verses.translit: vhby'h 'l hkhhn vqmts hkhhn mmnh mlv' qmtsv 't 'zkhrth vhqtyr hmzbchh 'l 'shy yhvh cht't hv'
verses.translation: Then shall he bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, even a memorial thereof, and burn it on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the LORD : it is a sin offering.

verses.original: וְ/כִפֶּר֩ עָלָ֨י/ו הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן עַל חַטָּאת֧/וֹ אֲשֶׁר חָטָ֛א מֵֽ/אַחַ֥ת מֵ/אֵ֖לֶּה וְ/נִסְלַ֣ח ל֑/וֹ וְ/הָיְתָ֥ה לַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן כַּ/מִּנְחָֽה
verses.translit: vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn 'l cht'tv 'shr cht' m'cht m'lh vnslch lv vhyth lkhhn khmnchh
verses.translation: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him: and the remnant shall be the priest’s, as a meat offering.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: נֶ֚פֶשׁ כִּֽי תִמְעֹ֣ל מַ֔עַל וְ/חָֽטְאָה֙ בִּ/שְׁגָגָ֔ה מִ/קָּדְשֵׁ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/הֵבִיא֩ אֶת אֲשָׁמ֨/וֹ לַֽ/יהוָ֜ה אַ֧יִל תָּמִ֣ים מִן הַ/צֹּ֗אן בְּ/עֶרְכְּ/ךָ֛ כֶּֽסֶף שְׁקָלִ֥ים בְּ/שֶֽׁקֶל הַ/קֹּ֖דֶשׁ לְ/אָשָֽׁם
verses.translit: npsh khy tm'l m'l vcht'h bshggh mqdshy yhvh vhby' 't 'shmv lyhvh 'yl tmym mn hts'n b'rkhkh khsf shqlym bshql hqdsh l'shm
verses.translation: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the LORD ; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the LORD a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering:

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר֩ חָטָ֨א מִן הַ/קֹּ֜דֶשׁ יְשַׁלֵּ֗ם וְ/אֶת חֲמִֽישִׁת/וֹ֙ יוֹסֵ֣ף עָלָ֔י/ו וְ/נָתַ֥ן אֹת֖/וֹ לַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן וְ/הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן יְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָ֛י/ו בְּ/אֵ֥יל הָ/אָשָׁ֖ם וְ/נִסְלַ֥ח לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v't 'shr cht' mn hqdsh yshlm v't chmyshtv yvsf 'lyv vntn 'tv lkhhn vhkhhn ykhpr 'lyv b'yl h'shm vnslch lv
verses.translation: And he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.

verses.original: וְ/אִם נֶ֨פֶשׁ֙ כִּ֣י תֶֽחֱטָ֔א וְ/עָֽשְׂתָ֗ה אַחַת֙ מִ/כָּל מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֣א תֵעָשֶׂ֑ינָה וְ/לֹֽא יָדַ֥ע וְ/אָשֵׁ֖ם וְ/נָשָׂ֥א עֲוֺנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'm npsh khy tcht' v'shth 'cht mkhl mtsvt yhvh 'shr l' t'shynh vl' yd' v'shm vnsh' 'vnv
verses.translation: And if a soul sin, and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the LORD ; though he wist it not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.

verses.original: וְ֠/הֵבִיא אַ֣יִל תָּמִ֧ים מִן הַ/צֹּ֛אן בְּ/עֶרְכְּ/ךָ֥ לְ/אָשָׁ֖ם אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן וְ/כִפֶּר֩ עָלָ֨י/ו הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן עַ֣ל שִׁגְגָת֧/וֹ אֲשֶׁר שָׁגָ֛ג וְ/ה֥וּא לֹֽא יָדַ֖ע וְ/נִסְלַ֥ח לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhby' 'yl tmym mn hts'n b'rkhkh l'shm 'l hkhhn vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn 'l shggtv 'shr shgg vhv' l' yd' vnslch lv
verses.translation: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not, and it shall be forgiven him.

verses.original: אָשָׁ֖ם ה֑וּא אָשֹׁ֥ם אָשַׁ֖ם לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'shm hv' 'shm 'shm lyhvh
verses.translation: It is a trespass offering: he hath certainly trespassed against the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: צַ֤ו אֶֽת אַהֲרֹן֙ וְ/אֶת בָּנָ֣י/ו לֵ/אמֹ֔ר זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הָ/עֹלָ֑ה הִ֣וא הָ/עֹלָ֡ה עַל֩ מוֹקְדָ֨ה עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֤חַ כָּל הַ/לַּ֨יְלָה֙ עַד הַ/בֹּ֔קֶר וְ/אֵ֥שׁ הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ תּ֥וּקַד בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: tsv 't 'hrn v't bnyv l'mr z't tvrt h'lh hv' h'lh 'l mvqdh 'l hmzbch khl hlylh 'd hbqr v'sh hmzbch tvqd bv
verses.translation: If a soul sin, and commit a trespass against the LORD , and lie unto his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep, or in fellowship, or in a thing taken away by violence, or hath deceived his neighbour;

verses.original: וְ/לָבַ֨שׁ הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן מִדּ֣/וֹ בַ֗ד וּ/מִֽכְנְסֵי בַד֮ יִלְבַּ֣שׁ עַל בְּשָׂר/וֹ֒ וְ/הֵרִ֣ים אֶת הַ/דֶּ֗שֶׁן אֲשֶׁ֨ר תֹּאכַ֥ל הָ/אֵ֛שׁ אֶת הָ/עֹלָ֖ה עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְ/שָׂמ֕/וֹ אֵ֖צֶל הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vlbsh hkhhn mdv bd vmkhnsy bd ylbsh 'l bshrv vhrym 't hdshn 'shr t'khl h'sh 't h'lh 'l hmzbch vshmv 'tsl hmzbch
verses.translation: Or have found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein:

verses.original: וּ/פָשַׁט֙ אֶת בְּגָדָ֔י/ו וְ/לָבַ֖שׁ בְּגָדִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וְ/הוֹצִ֤יא אֶת הַ/דֶּ֨שֶׁן֙ אֶל מִ/ח֣וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה אֶל מָק֖וֹם טָהֽוֹר
verses.translit: vpsht 't bgdyv vlbsh bgdym 'chrym vhvtsy' 't hdshn 'l mchvts lmchnh 'l mqvm thvr
verses.translation: Then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away, or the thing which he hath deceitfully gotten, or that which was delivered him to keep, or the lost thing which he found,

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אֵ֨שׁ עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֤חַ תּֽוּקַד בּ/וֹ֙ לֹ֣א תִכְבֶּ֔ה וּ/בִעֵ֨ר עָלֶ֧י/הָ הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן עֵצִ֖ים בַּ/בֹּ֣קֶר בַּ/בֹּ֑קֶר וְ/עָרַ֤ךְ עָלֶ֨י/הָ֙ הָֽ/עֹלָ֔ה וְ/הִקְטִ֥יר עָלֶ֖י/הָ חֶלְבֵ֥י הַ/שְּׁלָמִֽים
verses.translit: vh'sh 'l hmzbch tvqd bv l' tkhbh vb'r 'lyh hkhhn 'tsym bbqr bbqr v'rkh 'lyh h'lh vhqtyr 'lyh chlby hshlmym
verses.translation: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering.

verses.original: אֵ֗שׁ תָּמִ֛יד תּוּקַ֥ד עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לֹ֥א תִכְבֶֽה
verses.translit: 'sh tmyd tvqd 'l hmzbch l' tkhbh
verses.translation: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD , a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:

verses.original: וְ/זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַ/מִּנְחָ֑ה הַקְרֵ֨ב אֹתָ֤/הּ בְּנֵֽי אַהֲרֹן֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֶל פְּנֵ֖י הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vz't tvrt hmnchh hqrb 'th bny 'hrn lpny yhvh 'l pny hmzbch
verses.translation: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD : and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he hath done in trespassing therein.

verses.original: וְ/הֵרִ֨ים מִמֶּ֜/נּוּ בְּ/קֻמְצ֗/וֹ מִ/סֹּ֤לֶת הַ/מִּנְחָה֙ וּ/מִ/שַּׁמְנָ֔/הּ וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל הַ/לְּבֹנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַ/מִּנְחָ֑ה וְ/הִקְטִ֣יר הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֗חַ רֵ֧יחַ נִיחֹ֛חַ אַזְכָּרָתָ֖/הּ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhrym mmnv bqmtsv mslt hmnchh vmshmnh v't khl hlbnh 'shr 'l hmnchh vhqtyr hmzbch rych nychch 'zkhrth lyhvh
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נּוֹתֶ֣רֶת מִמֶּ֔/נָּה יֹאכְל֖וּ אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּ/בָנָ֑י/ו מַצּ֤וֹת תֵּֽאָכֵל֙ בְּ/מָק֣וֹם קָדֹ֔שׁ בַּ/חֲצַ֥ר אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד יֹאכְלֽוּ/הָ
verses.translit: vhnvtrt mmnh y'khlv 'hrn vbnyv mtsvt t'khl bmqvm qdsh bchtsr 'hl mv'd y'khlvh
verses.translation: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt offering: It is the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.

verses.original: לֹ֤א תֵאָפֶה֙ חָמֵ֔ץ חֶלְקָ֛/ם נָתַ֥תִּי אֹתָ֖/הּ מֵ/אִשָּׁ֑/י קֹ֤דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁים֙ הִ֔וא כַּ/חַטָּ֖את וְ/כָ/אָשָֽׁם
verses.translit: l' t'ph chmts chlqm ntty 'th m'shy qdsh qdshym hv' khcht't vkh'shm
verses.translation: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh, and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.

verses.original: כָּל זָכָ֞ר בִּ/בְנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ יֹֽאכֲלֶ֔/נָּה חָק עוֹלָם֙ לְ/דֹרֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם מֵ/אִשֵּׁ֖י יְהוָ֑ה כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּ֥ע בָּ/הֶ֖ם יִקְדָּֽשׁ
verses.translit: khl zkhr bbny 'hrn y'khlnh chq 'vlm ldrtykhm m'shy yhvh khl 'shr yg' bhm yqdsh
verses.translation: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings.

verses.original: זֶ֡ה קָרְבַּן֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן וּ/בָנָ֜י/ו אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִ֣יבוּ לַֽ/יהוָ֗ה בְּ/יוֹם֙ הִמָּשַׁ֣ח אֹת֔/וֹ עֲשִׂירִ֨ת הָ/אֵפָ֥ה סֹ֛לֶת מִנְחָ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד מַחֲצִיתָ֣/הּ בַּ/בֹּ֔קֶר וּ/מַחֲצִיתָ֖/הּ בָּ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: zh qrbn 'hrn vbnyv 'shr yqrybv lyhvh byvm hmshch 'tv 'shyrt h'ph slt mnchh tmyd mchtsyth bbqr vmchtsyth b'rb
verses.translation: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.

verses.original: עַֽל מַחֲבַ֗ת בַּ/שֶּׁ֛מֶן תֵּעָשֶׂ֖ה מֻרְבֶּ֣כֶת תְּבִיאֶ֑/נָּה תֻּפִינֵי֙ מִנְחַ֣ת פִּתִּ֔ים תַּקְרִ֥יב רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'l mchbt bshmn t'shh mrbkht tby'nh tpyny mncht ptym tqryb rych nychch lyhvh
verses.translation: And this is the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the LORD , before the altar.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/כֹּהֵ֨ן הַ/מָּשִׁ֧יחַ תַּחְתָּ֛י/ו מִ/בָּנָ֖י/ו יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑/הּ חָק עוֹלָ֕ם לַ/יהוָ֖ה כָּלִ֥יל תָּקְטָֽר
verses.translit: vhkhhn hmshych tchtyv mbnyv y'shh 'th chq 'vlm lyhvh khlyl tqtr
verses.translation: And he shall take of it his handful, of the flour of the meat offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering, and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour, even the memorial of it, unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/כָל מִנְחַ֥ת כֹּהֵ֛ן כָּלִ֥יל תִּהְיֶ֖ה לֹ֥א תֵאָכֵֽל
verses.translit: vkhl mncht khhn khlyl thyh l' t'khl
verses.translation: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it unto them for their portion of my offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as is the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֤ר אֶֽל אַהֲרֹן֙ וְ/אֶל בָּנָ֣י/ו לֵ/אמֹ֔ר זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַֽ/חַטָּ֑את בִּ/מְק֡וֹם אֲשֶׁר֩ תִּשָּׁחֵ֨ט הָ/עֹלָ֜ה תִּשָּׁחֵ֤ט הַֽ/חַטָּאת֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הִֽוא
verses.translit: dbr 'l 'hrn v'l bnyv l'mr z't tvrt hcht't bmqvm 'shr tshcht h'lh tshcht hcht't lpny yhvh qdsh qdshym hv'
verses.translation: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the LORD made by fire: every one that toucheth them shall be holy.

verses.original: הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן הַֽ/מְחַטֵּ֥א אֹתָ֖/הּ יֹאכֲלֶ֑/נָּה בְּ/מָק֤וֹם קָדֹשׁ֙ תֵּֽאָכֵ֔ל בַּ/חֲצַ֖ר אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: hkhhn hmcht' 'th y'khlnh bmqvm qdsh t'khl bchtsr 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּ֥ע בִּ/בְשָׂרָ֖/הּ יִקְדָּ֑שׁ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִזֶּ֤ה מִ/דָּמָ/הּ֙ עַל הַ/בֶּ֔גֶד אֲשֶׁר֙ יִזֶּ֣ה עָלֶ֔י/הָ תְּכַבֵּ֖ס בְּ/מָק֥וֹם קָדֹֽשׁ
verses.translit: khl 'shr yg' bbshrh yqdsh v'shr yzh mdmh 'l hbgd 'shr yzh 'lyh tkhbs bmqvm qdsh
verses.translation: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the LORD in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.

verses.original: וּ/כְלִי חֶ֛רֶשׂ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּבֻשַּׁל בּ֖/וֹ יִשָּׁבֵ֑ר וְ/אִם בִּ/כְלִ֤י נְחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ בֻּשָּׁ֔לָה וּ/מֹרַ֥ק וְ/שֻׁטַּ֖ף בַּ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: vkhly chrsh 'shr tbshl bv yshbr v'm bkhly nchsht bshlh vmrq vshtf bmym
verses.translation: In a pan it shall be made with oil; and when it is baken, thou shalt bring it in: and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the LORD .

verses.original: כָּל זָכָ֥ר בַּ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים יֹאכַ֣ל אֹתָ֑/הּ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הִֽוא
verses.translit: khl zkhr bkhhnym y'khl 'th qdsh qdshym hv'
verses.translation: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it: it is a statute for ever unto the LORD ; it shall be wholly burnt.

verses.original: וְ/כָל חַטָּ֡את אֲשֶׁר֩ יוּבָ֨א מִ/דָּמָ֜/הּ אֶל אֹ֧הֶל מוֹעֵ֛ד לְ/כַפֵּ֥ר בַּ/קֹּ֖דֶשׁ לֹ֣א תֵאָכֵ֑ל בָּ/אֵ֖שׁ תִּשָּׂרֵֽף
verses.translit: vkhl cht't 'shr yvb' mdmh 'l 'hl mv'd lkhpr bqdsh l' t'khl b'sh tshrf
verses.translation: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.
And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the LORD : it is most holy.
The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.
Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.
But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in water.
All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.
And no sin offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place , shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.

verses.original: וְ/זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הָ/אָשָׁ֑ם קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הֽוּא
verses.translit: vz't tvrt h'shm qdsh qdshym hv'
verses.translation: Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering: it is most holy.

verses.original: בִּ/מְק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁחֲטוּ֙ אֶת הָ֣/עֹלָ֔ה יִשְׁחֲט֖וּ אֶת הָ/אָשָׁ֑ם וְ/אֶת דָּמ֛/וֹ יִזְרֹ֥ק עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: bmqvm 'shr yshchtv 't h'lh yshchtv 't h'shm v't dmv yzrq 'l hmzbch sbyb
verses.translation: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֥ת כָּל חֶלְבּ֖/וֹ יַקְרִ֣יב מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ אֵ֚ת הָֽ/אַלְיָ֔ה וְ/אֶת הַ/חֵ֖לֶב הַֽ/מְכַסֶּ֥ה אֶת הַ/קֶּֽרֶב
verses.translit: v't khl chlbv yqryb mmnv 't h'lyh v't hchlb hmkhsh 't hqrb
verses.translation: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַ/כְּלָיֹ֔ת וְ/אֶת הַ/חֵ֨לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵי/הֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל הַ/כְּסָלִ֑ים וְ/אֶת הַ/יֹּתֶ֨רֶת֙ עַל הַ/כָּבֵ֔ד עַל הַ/כְּלָיֹ֖ת יְסִירֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: v't shty hkhlyt v't hchlb 'shr 'lyhn 'shr 'l hkhslym v't hytrt 'l hkhbd 'l hkhlyt ysyrnh
verses.translation: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:

verses.original: וְ/הִקְטִ֨יר אֹתָ֤/ם הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חָ/ה אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַ/יהוָ֑ה אָשָׁ֖ם הֽוּא
verses.translit: vhqtyr 'tm hkhhn hmzbchh 'shh lyhvh 'shm hv'
verses.translation: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the LORD : it is a trespass offering.

verses.original: כָּל זָכָ֥ר בַּ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים יֹאכְלֶ֑/נּוּ בְּ/מָק֤וֹם קָדוֹשׁ֙ יֵאָכֵ֔ל קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הֽוּא
verses.translit: khl zkhr bkhhnym y'khlnv bmqvm qdvsh y'khl qdsh qdshym hv'
verses.translation: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it is most holy.

verses.original: כַּֽ/חַטָּאת֙ כָּֽ/אָשָׁ֔ם תּוֹרָ֥ה אַחַ֖ת לָ/הֶ֑ם הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְכַפֶּר בּ֖/וֹ ל֥/וֹ יִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: khcht't kh'shm tvrh 'cht lhm hkhhn 'shr ykhpr bv lv yhyh
verses.translation: As the sin offering is , so is the trespass offering: there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it .

verses.original: וְ/הַ֨/כֹּהֵ֔ן הַ/מַּקְרִ֖יב אֶת עֹ֣לַת אִ֑ישׁ ע֤וֹר הָֽ/עֹלָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְרִ֔יב לַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן ל֥/וֹ יִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vhkhhn hmqryb 't 'lt 'ysh 'vr h'lh 'shr hqryb lkhhn lv yhyh
verses.translation: And the priest that offereth any man’s burnt offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.

verses.original: וְ/כָל מִנְחָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר תֵּֽאָפֶה֙ בַּ/תַּנּ֔וּר וְ/כָל נַעֲשָׂ֥ה בַ/מַּרְחֶ֖שֶׁת וְ/עַֽל מַחֲבַ֑ת לַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן הַ/מַּקְרִ֥יב אֹתָ֖/הּ ל֥/וֹ תִֽהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vkhl mnchh 'shr t'ph btnvr vkhl n'shh bmrchsht v'l mchbt lkhhn hmqryb 'th lv thyh
verses.translation: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest’s that offereth it.

verses.original: וְ/כָל מִנְחָ֥ה בְלוּלָֽה בַ/שֶּׁ֖מֶן וַ/חֲרֵבָ֑ה לְ/כָל בְּנֵ֧י אַהֲרֹ֛ן תִּהְיֶ֖ה אִ֥ישׁ כְּ/אָחִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vkhl mnchh blvlh bshmn vchrbh lkhl bny 'hrn thyh 'ysh kh'chyv
verses.translation: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as much as another.

verses.original: וְ/זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת זֶ֣בַח הַ/שְּׁלָמִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַקְרִ֖יב לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vz't tvrt zbch hshlmym 'shr yqryb lyhvh
verses.translation: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto the LORD .

verses.original: אִ֣ם עַל תּוֹדָה֮ יַקְרִיבֶ/נּוּ֒ וְ/הִקְרִ֣יב עַל זֶ֣בַח הַ/תּוֹדָ֗ה חַלּ֤וֹת מַצּוֹת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּ/שֶּׁ֔מֶן וּ/רְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֣ים בַּ/שָּׁ֑מֶן וְ/סֹ֣לֶת מֻרְבֶּ֔כֶת חַלֹּ֖ת בְּלוּלֹ֥ת בַּ/שָּֽׁמֶן
verses.translit: 'm 'l tvdh yqrybnv vhqryb 'l zbch htvdh chlvt mtsvt blvlt bshmn vrqyqy mtsvt mshchym bshmn vslt mrbkht chlt blvlt bshmn
verses.translation: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.

verses.original: עַל חַלֹּת֙ לֶ֣חֶם חָמֵ֔ץ יַקְרִ֖יב קָרְבָּנ֑/וֹ עַל זֶ֖בַח תּוֹדַ֥ת שְׁלָמָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'l chlt lchm chmts yqryb qrbnv 'l zbch tvdt shlmyv
verses.translation: Besides the cakes, he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרִ֨יב מִמֶּ֤/נּוּ אֶחָד֙ מִ/כָּל קָרְבָּ֔ן תְּרוּמָ֖ה לַ/יהוָ֑ה לַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן הַ/זֹּרֵ֛ק אֶת דַּ֥ם הַ/שְּׁלָמִ֖ים ל֥/וֹ יִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vhqryb mmnv 'chd mkhl qrbn trvmh lyhvh lkhhn hzrq 't dm hshlmym lv yhyh
verses.translation: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave offering unto the LORD , and it shall be the priest’s that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.

verses.original: וּ/בְשַׂ֗ר זֶ֚בַח תּוֹדַ֣ת שְׁלָמָ֔י/ו בְּ/י֥וֹם קָרְבָּנ֖/וֹ יֵאָכֵ֑ל לֹֽא יַנִּ֥יחַ מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ עַד בֹּֽקֶר
verses.translit: vbshr zbch tvdt shlmyv byvm qrbnv y'khl l' ynych mmnv 'd bqr
verses.translation: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.

verses.original: וְ/אִם נֶ֣דֶר א֣וֹ נְדָבָ֗ה זֶ֚בַח קָרְבָּנ֔/וֹ בְּ/י֛וֹם הַקְרִיב֥/וֹ אֶת זִבְח֖/וֹ יֵאָכֵ֑ל וּ/מִֽ/מָּחֳרָ֔ת וְ/הַ/נּוֹתָ֥ר מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ יֵאָכֵֽל
verses.translit: v'm ndr 'v ndbh zbch qrbnv byvm hqrybv 't zbchv y'khl vmmchrt vhnvtr mmnv y'khl
verses.translation: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:

verses.translit: vhnvtr mbshr hzbch byvm hshlyshy b'sh yshrf
verses.translation: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֣ם הֵאָכֹ֣ל יֵ֠אָכֵל מִ/בְּשַׂר זֶ֨בַח שְׁלָמָ֜י/ו בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁי֮ לֹ֣א יֵרָצֶה֒ הַ/מַּקְרִ֣יב אֹת֗/וֹ לֹ֧א יֵחָשֵׁ֛ב ל֖/וֹ פִּגּ֣וּל יִהְיֶ֑ה וְ/הַ/נֶּ֛פֶשׁ הָ/אֹכֶ֥לֶת מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ עֲוֺנָ֥/הּ תִּשָּֽׂא
verses.translit: v'm h'khl y'khl mbshr zbch shlmyv byvm hshlyshy l' yrtsh hmqryb 'tv l' ychshb lv pgvl yhyh vhnpsh h'khlt mmnv 'vnh tsh'
verses.translation: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/בָּשָׂ֞ר אֲשֶׁר יִגַּ֤ע בְּ/כָל טָמֵא֙ לֹ֣א יֵֽאָכֵ֔ל בָּ/אֵ֖שׁ יִשָּׂרֵ֑ף וְ/הַ֨/בָּשָׂ֔ר כָּל טָה֖וֹר יֹאכַ֥ל בָּשָֽׂר
verses.translit: vhbshr 'shr yg' bkhl tm' l' y'khl b'sh yshrf vhbshr khl thvr y'khl bshr
verses.translation: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נֶּ֜פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַ֣ל בָּשָׂ֗ר מִ/זֶּ֤בַח הַ/שְּׁלָמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַ/יהוָ֔ה וְ/טֻמְאָת֖/וֹ עָלָ֑י/ו וְ/נִכְרְתָ֛ה הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/הִ֖וא מֵ/עַמֶּֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vhnpsh 'shr t'khl bshr mzbch hshlmym 'shr lyhvh vtm'tv 'lyv vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' m'myh
verses.translation: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that pertain unto the LORD , having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

verses.original: וְ/נֶ֜פֶשׁ כִּֽי תִגַּ֣ע בְּ/כָל טָמֵ֗א בְּ/טֻמְאַ֤ת אָדָם֙ א֣וֹ בִּ/בְהֵמָ֣ה טְמֵאָ֗ה א֚וֹ בְּ/כָל שֶׁ֣קֶץ טָמֵ֔א וְ/אָכַ֛ל מִ/בְּשַׂר זֶ֥בַח הַ/שְּׁלָמִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/נִכְרְתָ֛ה הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/הִ֖וא מֵ/עַמֶּֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vnpsh khy tg' bkhl tm' btm't 'dm 'v bbhmh tm'h 'v bkhl shqts tm' v'khl mbshr zbch hshlmym 'shr lyhvh vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' m'myh
verses.translation: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing, as the uncleanness of man, or any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean thing , and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which pertain unto the LORD , even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כָּל חֵ֜לֶב שׁ֥וֹר וְ/כֶ֛שֶׂב וָ/עֵ֖ז לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l l'mr khl chlb shvr vkhshb v'z l' t'khlv
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.

verses.original: וְ/חֵ֤לֶב נְבֵלָה֙ וְ/חֵ֣לֶב טְרֵפָ֔ה יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה לְ/כָל מְלָאכָ֑ה וְ/אָכֹ֖ל לֹ֥א תֹאכְלֻֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vchlb nblh vchlb trph y'shh lkhl ml'khh v'khl l' t'khlhv
verses.translation: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.

verses.original: כִּ֚י כָּל אֹכֵ֣ל חֵ֔לֶב מִן הַ֨/בְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְרִ֥יב מִמֶּ֛/נָּה אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/נִכְרְתָ֛ה הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הָ/אֹכֶ֖לֶת מֵֽ/עַמֶּֽי/הָ
verses.translit: khy khl 'khl chlb mn hbhmh 'shr yqryb mmnh 'shh lyhvh vnkhrth hnpsh h'khlt m'myh
verses.translation: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD , even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.

verses.original: וְ/כָל דָּם֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכְל֔וּ בְּ/כֹ֖ל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם לָ/ע֖וֹף וְ/לַ/בְּהֵמָֽה
verses.translit: vkhl dm l' t'khlv bkhl mvshbtykhm l'vf vlbhmh
verses.translation: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.

verses.original: כָּל נֶ֖פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תֹּאכַ֣ל כָּל דָּ֑ם וְ/נִכְרְתָ֛ה הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/הִ֖וא מֵֽ/עַמֶּֽי/הָ
verses.translit: khl npsh 'shr t'khl khl dm vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' m'myh
verses.translation: Whatsoever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הַ/מַּקְרִ֞יב אֶת זֶ֤בַח שְׁלָמָי/ו֙ לַ/יהוָ֔ה יָבִ֧יא אֶת קָרְבָּנ֛/וֹ לַ/יהוָ֖ה מִ/זֶּ֥בַח שְׁלָמָֽי/ו
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l l'mr hmqryb 't zbch shlmyv lyhvh yby' 't qrbnv lyhvh mzbch shlmyv
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the LORD shall bring his oblation unto the LORD of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.

verses.original: יָדָ֣י/ו תְּבִיאֶ֔ינָה אֵ֖ת אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֶת הַ/חֵ֤לֶב עַל הֶֽ/חָזֶה֙ יְבִיאֶ֔/נּוּ אֵ֣ת הֶ/חָזֶ֗ה לְ/הָנִ֥יף אֹת֛/וֹ תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: ydyv tby'ynh 't 'shy yhvh 't hchlb 'l hchzh yby'nv 't hchzh lhnyf 'tv tnvph lpny yhvh
verses.translation: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הִקְטִ֧יר הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת הַ/חֵ֖לֶב הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חָ/ה וְ/הָיָה֙ הֶֽ/חָזֶ֔ה לְ/אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּ/לְ/בָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vhqtyr hkhhn 't hchlb hmzbchh vhyh hchzh l'hrn vlbnyv
verses.translation: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron’s and his sons’.

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ שׁ֣וֹק הַ/יָּמִ֔ין תִּתְּנ֥וּ תְרוּמָ֖ה לַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן מִ/זִּבְחֵ֖י שַׁלְמֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v't shvq hymyn ttnv trvmh lkhhn mzbchy shlmykhm
verses.translation: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest for an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.

verses.original: הַ/מַּקְרִ֞יב אֶת דַּ֧ם הַ/שְּׁלָמִ֛ים וְ/אֶת הַ/חֵ֖לֶב מִ/בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן ל֧/וֹ תִהְיֶ֛ה שׁ֥וֹק הַ/יָּמִ֖ין לְ/מָנָֽה
verses.translit: hmqryb 't dm hshlmym v't hchlb mbny 'hrn lv thyh shvq hymyn lmnh
verses.translation: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for his part.

verses.original: כִּי֩ אֶת חֲזֵ֨ה הַ/תְּנוּפָ֜ה וְ/אֵ֣ת שׁ֣וֹק הַ/תְּרוּמָ֗ה לָקַ֨חְתִּי֙ מֵ/אֵ֣ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ/זִּבְחֵ֖י שַׁלְמֵי/הֶ֑ם וָ/אֶתֵּ֣ן אֹ֠תָ/ם לְ/אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֤ן וּ/לְ/בָנָי/ו֙ לְ/חָק עוֹלָ֔ם מֵ/אֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: khy 't chzh htnvph v't shvq htrvmh lqchty m't bny yshr'l mzbchy shlmyhm v'tn 'tm l'hrn hkhhn vlbnyv lchq 'vlm m't bny yshr'l
verses.translation: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.

verses.original: זֹ֣את מִשְׁחַ֤ת אַהֲרֹן֙ וּ/מִשְׁחַ֣ת בָּנָ֔י/ו מֵ/אִשֵּׁ֖י יְהוָ֑ה בְּ/יוֹם֙ הִקְרִ֣יב אֹתָ֔/ם לְ/כַהֵ֖ן לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: z't mshcht 'hrn vmshcht bnyv m'shy yhvh byvm hqryb 'tm lkhhn lyhvh
verses.translation: This is the portion of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister unto the LORD in the priest’s office;

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה לָ/תֵ֣ת לָ/הֶ֗ם בְּ/יוֹם֙ מָשְׁח֣/וֹ אֹתָ֔/ם מֵ/אֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְ/דֹרֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'shr tsvh yhvh ltt lhm byvm mshchv 'tm m't bny yshr'l chqt 'vlm ldrtm
verses.translation: Which the LORD commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, by a statute for ever throughout their generations.

verses.original: זֹ֣את הַ/תּוֹרָ֗ה לָֽ/עֹלָה֙ לַ/מִּנְחָ֔ה וְ/לַֽ/חַטָּ֖את וְ/לָ/אָשָׁ֑ם וְ/לַ֨/מִּלּוּאִ֔ים וּ/לְ/זֶ֖בַח הַ/שְּׁלָמִֽים
verses.translit: z't htvrh l'lh lmnchh vlcht't vl'shm vlmlv'ym vlzbch hshlmym
verses.translation: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּ/הַ֣ר סִינָ֑י בְּ/י֨וֹם צַוֺּת֜/וֹ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לְ/הַקְרִ֧יב אֶת קָרְבְּנֵי/הֶ֛ם לַ/יהוָ֖ה בְּ/מִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי
verses.translit: 'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh bhr syny byvm tsvtv 't bny yshr'l lhqryb 't qrbnyhm lyhvh bmdbr syny
verses.translation: Which the LORD commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the LORD , in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: קַ֤ח אֶֽת אַהֲרֹן֙ וְ/אֶת בָּנָ֣י/ו אִתּ֔/וֹ וְ/אֵת֙ הַ/בְּגָדִ֔ים וְ/אֵ֖ת שֶׁ֣מֶן הַ/מִּשְׁחָ֑ה וְ/אֵ֣ת פַּ֣ר הַֽ/חַטָּ֗את וְ/אֵת֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הָֽ/אֵילִ֔ים וְ/אֵ֖ת סַ֥ל הַ/מַּצּֽוֹת
verses.translit: qch 't 'hrn v't bnyv 'tv v't hbgdym v't shmn hmshchh v't pr hcht't v't shny h'ylym v't sl hmtsvt
verses.translation: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֥ת כָּל הָ/עֵדָ֖ה הַקְהֵ֑ל אֶל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: v't khl h'dh hqhl 'l ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֑/וֹ וַ/תִּקָּהֵל֙ הָֽ/עֵדָ֔ה אֶל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vy'sh mshh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tv vtqhl h'dh 'l ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל הָ/עֵדָ֑ה זֶ֣ה הַ/דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לַ/עֲשֽׂוֹת
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l h'dh zh hdbr 'shr tsvh yhvh l'shvt
verses.translation: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which the LORD commanded to be done.

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְרֵ֣ב מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶֽת אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְ/אֶת בָּנָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּרְחַ֥ץ אֹתָ֖/ם בַּ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: vyqrb mshh 't 'hrn v't bnyv vyrchts 'tm bmym
verses.translation: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן עָלָ֜י/ו אֶת הַ/כֻּתֹּ֗נֶת וַ/יַּחְגֹּ֤ר אֹת/וֹ֙ בָּֽ/אַבְנֵ֔ט וַ/יַּלְבֵּ֤שׁ אֹת/וֹ֙ אֶֽת הַ/מְּעִ֔יל וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן עָלָ֖י/ו אֶת הָ/אֵפֹ֑ד וַ/יַּחְגֹּ֣ר אֹת֗/וֹ בְּ/חֵ֨שֶׁב֙ הָֽ/אֵפֹ֔ד וַ/יֶּאְפֹּ֥ד ל֖/וֹ בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vytn 'lyv 't hkhtnt vychgr 'tv b'bnt vylbsh 'tv 't hm'yl vytn 'lyv 't h'pd vychgr 'tv bchshb h'pd vy'pd lv bv
verses.translation: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥שֶׂם עָלָ֖י/ו אֶת הַ/חֹ֑שֶׁן וַ/יִּתֵּן֙ אֶל הַ/חֹ֔שֶׁן אֶת הָ/אוּרִ֖ים וְ/אֶת הַ/תֻּמִּֽים
verses.translit: vyshm 'lyv 't hchshn vytn 'l hchshn 't h'vrym v't htmym
verses.translation: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת הַ/מִּצְנֶ֖פֶת עַל רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ וַ/יָּ֨שֶׂם עַֽל הַ/מִּצְנֶ֜פֶת אֶל מ֣וּל פָּנָ֗י/ו אֵ֣ת צִ֤יץ הַ/זָּהָב֙ נֵ֣זֶר הַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vyshm 't hmtsnpt 'l r'shv vyshm 'l hmtsnpt 'l mvl pnyv 't tsyts hzhb nzr hqdsh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת שֶׁ֣מֶן הַ/מִּשְׁחָ֔ה וַ/יִּמְשַׁ֥ח אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְ/אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר בּ֑/וֹ וַ/יְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyqch mshh 't shmn hmshchh vymshch 't hmshkhn v't khl 'shr bv vyqdsh 'tm
verses.translation: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥ז מִמֶּ֛/נּוּ עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וַ/יִּמְשַׁ֨ח אֶת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֜חַ וְ/אֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֗י/ו וְ/אֶת הַ/כִּיֹּ֛ר וְ/אֶת כַּנּ֖/וֹ לְ/קַדְּשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: vyz mmnv 'l hmzbch shb' p'mym vymshch 't hmzbch v't khl khlyv v't hkhyr v't khnv lqdshm
verses.translation: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּצֹק֙ מִ/שֶּׁ֣מֶן הַ/מִּשְׁחָ֔ה עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ אַהֲרֹ֑ן וַ/יִּמְשַׁ֥ח אֹת֖/וֹ לְ/קַדְּשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: vytsq mshmn hmshchh 'l r'sh 'hrn vymshch 'tv lqdshv
verses.translation: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְרֵ֨ב מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַ/יַּלְבִּשֵׁ֤/ם כֻּתֳּנֹת֙ וַ/יַּחְגֹּ֤ר אֹתָ/ם֙ אַבְנֵ֔ט וַ/יַּחֲבֹ֥שׁ לָ/הֶ֖ם מִגְבָּע֑וֹת כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vyqrb mshh 't bny 'hrn vylbshm khtnt vychgr 'tm 'bnt vychbsh lhm mgb'vt kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגֵּ֕שׁ אֵ֖ת פַּ֣ר הַֽ/חַטָּ֑את וַ/יִּסְמֹ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּ/בָנָי/ו֙ אֶת יְדֵי/הֶ֔ם עַל רֹ֖אשׁ פַּ֥ר הַֽ/חַטָּֽאת
verses.translit: vygsh 't pr hcht't vysmkh 'hrn vbnyv 't ydyhm 'l r'sh pr hcht't
verses.translation: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁחָ֗ט וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת הַ/דָּם֙ וַ֠/יִּתֵּן עַל קַרְנ֨וֹת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֤חַ סָבִיב֙ בְּ/אֶצְבָּע֔/וֹ וַ/יְחַטֵּ֖א אֶת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְ/אֶת הַ/דָּ֗ם יָצַק֙ אֶל יְס֣וֹד הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וַֽ/יְקַדְּשֵׁ֖/הוּ לְ/כַפֵּ֥ר עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshcht vyqch mshh 't hdm vytn 'l qrnvt hmzbch sbyb b'tsb'v vycht' 't hmzbch v't hdm ytsq 'l ysvd hmzbch vyqdshhv lkhpr 'lyv
verses.translation: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֗ח אֶֽת כָּל הַ/חֵלֶב֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הַ/קֶּרֶב֒ וְ/אֵת֙ יֹתֶ֣רֶת הַ/כָּבֵ֔ד וְ/אֶת שְׁתֵּ֥י הַ/כְּלָיֹ֖ת וְ/אֶֽת חֶלְבְּ/הֶ֑ן וַ/יַּקְטֵ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֖ה הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחָ/ה
verses.translit: vyqch 't khl hchlb 'shr 'l hqrb v't ytrt hkhbd v't shty hkhlyt v't chlbhn vyqtr mshh hmzbchh
verses.translation: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned it upon the altar.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/פָּ֤ר וְ/אֶת עֹר/וֹ֙ וְ/אֶת בְּשָׂר֣/וֹ וְ/אֶת פִּרְשׁ֔/וֹ שָׂרַ֣ף בָּ/אֵ֔שׁ מִ/ח֖וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: v't hpr v't 'rv v't bshrv v't prshv shrf b'sh mchvts lmchnh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְרֵ֕ב אֵ֖ת אֵ֣יל הָ/עֹלָ֑ה וַֽ/יִּסְמְכ֞וּ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּ/בָנָ֛י/ו אֶת יְדֵי/הֶ֖ם עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הָ/אָֽיִל
verses.translit: vyqrb 't 'yl h'lh vysmkhv 'hrn vbnyv 't ydyhm 'l r'sh h'yl
verses.translation: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁחָ֑ט וַ/יִּזְרֹ֨ק מֹשֶׁ֧ה אֶת הַ/דָּ֛ם עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vyshcht vyzrq mshh 't hdm 'l hmzbch sbyb
verses.translation: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הָ/אַ֔יִל נִתַּ֖ח לִ/נְתָחָ֑י/ו וַ/יַּקְטֵ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת הָ/רֹ֔אשׁ וְ/אֶת הַ/נְּתָחִ֖ים וְ/אֶת הַ/פָּֽדֶר
verses.translit: v't h'yl ntch lntchyv vyqtr mshh 't hr'sh v't hntchym v't hpdr
verses.translation: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/קֶּ֥רֶב וְ/אֶת הַ/כְּרָעַ֖יִם רָחַ֣ץ בַּ/מָּ֑יִם וַ/יַּקְטֵר֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה אֶת כָּל הָ/אַ֜יִל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֗חָ/ה עֹלָ֨ה ה֤וּא לְ/רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ אִשֶּׁ֥ה הוּא֙ לַ/יהוָ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: v't hqrb v't hkhr'ym rchts bmym vyqtr mshh 't khl h'yl hmzbchh 'lh hv' lrych nychch 'shh hv' lyhvh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, and an offering made by fire unto the LORD ; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְרֵב֙ אֶת הָ/אַ֣יִל הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י אֵ֖יל הַ/מִּלֻּאִ֑ים וַֽ/יִּסְמְכ֞וּ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּ/בָנָ֛י/ו אֶת יְדֵי/הֶ֖ם עַל רֹ֥אשׁ הָ/אָֽיִל
verses.translit: vyqrb 't h'yl hshny 'yl hml'ym vysmkhv 'hrn vbnyv 't ydyhm 'l r'sh h'yl
verses.translation: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁחָ֓ט וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ מִ/דָּמ֔/וֹ וַ/יִּתֵּ֛ן עַל תְּנ֥וּךְ אֹֽזֶן אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַ/יְמָנִ֑ית וְ/עַל בֹּ֤הֶן יָד/וֹ֙ הַ/יְמָנִ֔ית וְ/עַל בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖/וֹ הַ/יְמָנִֽית
verses.translit: vyshcht vyqch mshh mdmv vytn 'l tnvkh 'zn 'hrn hymnyt v'l bhn ydv hymnyt v'l bhn rglv hymnyt
verses.translation: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְרֵ֞ב אֶת בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן מֹשֶׁ֤ה מִן הַ/דָּם֙ עַל תְּנ֤וּךְ אָזְנָ/ם֙ הַ/יְמָנִ֔ית וְ/עַל בֹּ֤הֶן יָדָ/ם֙ הַ/יְמָנִ֔ית וְ/עַל בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְלָ֖/ם הַ/יְמָנִ֑ית וַ/יִּזְרֹ֨ק מֹשֶׁ֧ה אֶת הַ/דָּ֛ם עַל הַֽ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vyqrb 't bny 'hrn vytn mshh mn hdm 'l tnvkh 'znm hymnyt v'l bhn ydm hymnyt v'l bhn rglm hymnyt vyzrq mshh 't hdm 'l hmzbch sbyb
verses.translation: And he brought Aaron’s sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֞ח אֶת הַ/חֵ֣לֶב וְ/אֶת הָֽ/אַלְיָ֗ה וְ/אֶֽת כָּל הַ/חֵלֶב֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הַ/קֶּרֶב֒ וְ/אֵת֙ יֹתֶ֣רֶת הַ/כָּבֵ֔ד וְ/אֶת שְׁתֵּ֥י הַ/כְּלָיֹ֖ת וְ/אֶֽת חֶלְבְּ/הֶ֑ן וְ/אֵ֖ת שׁ֥וֹק הַ/יָּמִֽין
verses.translit: vyqch 't hchlb v't h'lyh v't khl hchlb 'shr 'l hqrb v't ytrt hkhbd v't shty hkhlyt v't chlbhn v't shvq hymyn
verses.translation: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:

verses.original: וּ/מִ/סַּ֨ל הַ/מַּצּ֜וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה לָ֠קַח חַלַּ֨ת מַצָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ וְֽ/חַלַּ֨ת לֶ֥חֶם שֶׁ֛מֶן אַחַ֖ת וְ/רָקִ֣יק אֶחָ֑ד וַ/יָּ֨שֶׂם֙ עַל הַ֣/חֲלָבִ֔ים וְ/עַ֖ל שׁ֥וֹק הַ/יָּמִֽין
verses.translit: vmsl hmtsvt 'shr lpny yhvh lqch chlt mtsh 'cht vchlt lchm shmn 'cht vrqyq 'chd vyshm 'l hchlbym v'l shvq hymyn
verses.translation: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before the LORD , he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן אֶת הַ/כֹּ֔ל עַ֚ל כַּפֵּ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְ/עַ֖ל כַּפֵּ֣י בָנָ֑י/ו וַ/יָּ֧נֶף אֹתָ֛/ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vytn 't hkhl 'l khpy 'hrn v'l khpy bnyv vynf 'tm tnvph lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And he put all upon Aaron’s hands, and upon his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֹתָ/ם֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל כַּפֵּי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יַּקְטֵ֥ר הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חָ/ה עַל הָ/עֹלָ֑ה מִלֻּאִ֥ים הֵם֙ לְ/רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֥ה ה֖וּא לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqch mshh 'tm m'l khpyhm vyqtr hmzbchh 'l h'lh ml'ym hm lrych nychch 'shh hv' lyhvh
verses.translation: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering: they were consecrations for a sweet savour: it is an offering made by fire unto the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת הֶ֣/חָזֶ֔ה וַ/יְנִיפֵ֥/הוּ תְנוּפָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מֵ/אֵ֣יל הַ/מִּלֻּאִ֗ים לְ/מֹשֶׁ֤ה הָיָה֙ לְ/מָנָ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vyqch mshh 't hchzh vynyphv tnvph lpny yhvh m'yl hml'ym lmshh hyh lmnh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the LORD : for of the ram of consecration it was Moses’ part; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה מִ/שֶּׁ֣מֶן הַ/מִּשְׁחָ֗ה וּ/מִן הַ/דָּם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּחַ֒ וַ/יַּ֤ז עַֽל אַהֲרֹן֙ עַל בְּגָדָ֔י/ו וְ/עַל בָּנָ֛י/ו וְ/עַל בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖י/ו אִתּ֑/וֹ וַ/יְקַדֵּ֤שׁ אֶֽת אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת בְּגָדָ֔י/ו וְ/אֶת בָּנָ֛י/ו וְ/אֶת בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖י/ו אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqch mshh mshmn hmshchh vmn hdm 'shr 'l hmzbch vyz 'l 'hrn 'l bgdyv v'l bnyv v'l bgdy bnyv 'tv vyqdsh 't 'hrn 't bgdyv v't bnyv v't bgdy bnyv 'tv
verses.translation: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons’ garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל אַהֲרֹ֣ן וְ/אֶל בָּנָ֗י/ו בַּשְּׁל֣וּ אֶת הַ/בָּשָׂר֮ פֶּ֣תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֒ וְ/שָׁם֙ תֹּאכְל֣וּ אֹת֔/וֹ וְ/אֶ֨ת הַ/לֶּ֔חֶם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/סַ֣ל הַ/מִּלֻּאִ֑ים כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר צִוֵּ֨יתִי֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּ/בָנָ֖י/ו יֹאכְלֻֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l 'hrn v'l bnyv bshlv 't hbshr ptch 'hl mv'd vshm t'khlv 'tv v't hlchm 'shr bsl hml'ym kh'shr tsvyty l'mr 'hrn vbnyv y'khlhv
verses.translation: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that is in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.

verses.translit: vhnvtr bbshr vblchm b'sh tshrpv
verses.translation: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/פֶּתַח֩ אֹ֨הֶל מוֹעֵ֜ד לֹ֤א תֵֽצְאוּ֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים עַ֚ד י֣וֹם מְלֹ֔את יְמֵ֖י מִלֻּאֵי/כֶ֑ם כִּ֚י שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים יְמַלֵּ֖א אֶת יֶדְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vmptch 'hl mv'd l' tts'v shb't ymym 'd yvm ml't ymy ml'ykhm khy shb't ymym yml' 't ydkhm
verses.translation: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לַ/עֲשֹׂ֖ת לְ/כַפֵּ֥ר עֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: kh'shr 'shh byvm hzh tsvh yhvh l'sht lkhpr 'lykhm
verses.translation: As he hath done this day, so the LORD hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.

verses.original: וּ/פֶתַח֩ אֹ֨הֶל מוֹעֵ֜ד תֵּשְׁב֨וּ יוֹמָ֤ם וָ/לַ֨יְלָה֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּ֛ם אֶת מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת יְהוָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֣א תָמ֑וּתוּ כִּי כֵ֖ן צֻוֵּֽיתִי
verses.translit: vptch 'hl mv'd tshbv yvmm vlylh shb't ymym vshmrtm 't mshmrt yhvh vl' tmvtv khy khn tsvyty
verses.translation: Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the LORD , that ye die not: for so I am commanded.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥עַשׂ אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּ/בָנָ֑י/ו אֵ֚ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יַד מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'sh 'hrn vbnyv 't khl hdbrym 'shr tsvh yhvh byd mshh
verses.translation: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֔י קָרָ֣א מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְ/אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּ/לְ/בָנָ֑י/ו וּ/לְ/זִקְנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhy byvm hshmyny qr' mshh l'hrn vlbnyv vlzqny yshr'l
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֗ן קַח לְ֠/ךָ עֵ֣גֶל בֶּן בָּקָ֧ר לְ/חַטָּ֛את וְ/אַ֥יִל לְ/עֹלָ֖ה תְּמִימִ֑ם וְ/הַקְרֵ֖ב לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l 'hrn qch lkh 'gl bn bqr lcht't v'yl l'lh tmymm vhqrb lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵ/אמֹ֑ר קְח֤וּ שְׂעִיר עִזִּים֙ לְ/חַטָּ֔את וְ/עֵ֨גֶל וָ/כֶ֧בֶשׂ בְּנֵי שָׁנָ֛ה תְּמִימִ֖ם לְ/עֹלָֽה
verses.translit: v'l bny yshr'l tdbr l'mr qchv sh'yr 'zym lcht't v'gl vkhbsh bny shnh tmymm l'lh
verses.translation: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;

verses.original: וְ/שׁ֨וֹר וָ/אַ֜יִל לִ/שְׁלָמִ֗ים לִ/זְבֹּ֨חַ֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּ/מִנְחָ֖ה בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַ/שָּׁ֑מֶן כִּ֣י הַ/יּ֔וֹם יְהוָ֖ה נִרְאָ֥ה אֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vshvr v'yl lshlmym lzbch lpny yhvh vmnchh blvlh bshmn khy hyvm yhvh nr'h 'lykhm
verses.translation: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the LORD ; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the LORD will appear unto you.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְח֗וּ אֵ֚ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל פְּנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַֽ/יִּקְרְבוּ֙ כָּל הָ֣/עֵדָ֔ה וַ/יַּֽעַמְד֖וּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqchv 't 'shr tsvh mshh 'l pny 'hl mv'd vyqrbv khl h'dh vy'mdv lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה זֶ֧ה הַ/דָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ וְ/יֵרָ֥א אֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם כְּב֥וֹד יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh zh hdbr 'shr tsvh yhvh t'shv vyr' 'lykhm khbvd yhvh
verses.translation: And Moses said, This is the thing which the LORD commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the LORD shall appear unto you.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֗ן קְרַ֤ב אֶל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ וַ/עֲשֵׂ֞ה אֶת חַטָּֽאתְ/ךָ֙ וְ/אֶת עֹ֣לָתֶ֔/ךָ וְ/כַפֵּ֥ר בַּֽעַדְ/ךָ֖ וּ/בְעַ֣ד הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/עֲשֵׂ֞ה אֶת קָרְבַּ֤ן הָ/עָם֙ וְ/כַפֵּ֣ר בַּֽעֲדָ֔/ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l 'hrn qrb 'l hmzbch v'shh 't cht'tkh v't 'ltkh vkhpr b'dkh vb'd h'm v'shh 't qrbn h'm vkhpr b'dm kh'shr tsvh yhvh
verses.translation: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as the LORD commanded.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרַ֥ב אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֶל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וַ/יִּשְׁחַ֛ט אֶת עֵ֥גֶל הַ/חַטָּ֖את אֲשֶׁר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqrb 'hrn 'l hmzbch vyshcht 't 'gl hcht't 'shr lv
verses.translation: Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.

verses.original: וַ֠/יַּקְרִבוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֣ן אֶת הַ/דָּם֮ אֵלָי/ו֒ וַ/יִּטְבֹּ֤ל אֶצְבָּע/וֹ֙ בַּ/דָּ֔ם וַ/יִּתֵּ֖ן עַל קַרְנ֣וֹת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְ/אֶת הַ/דָּ֣ם יָצַ֔ק אֶל יְס֖וֹד הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vyqrbv bny 'hrn 't hdm 'lyv vytbl 'tsb'v bdm vytn 'l qrnvt hmzbch v't hdm ytsq 'l ysvd hmzbch
verses.translation: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/חֵ֨לֶב וְ/אֶת הַ/כְּלָיֹ֜ת וְ/אֶת הַ/יֹּתֶ֤רֶת מִן הַ/כָּבֵד֙ מִן הַ֣/חַטָּ֔את הִקְטִ֖יר הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חָ/ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: v't hchlb v't hkhlyt v't hytrt mn hkhbd mn hcht't hqtyr hmzbchh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/בָּשָׂ֖ר וְ/אֶת הָ/ע֑וֹר שָׂרַ֣ף בָּ/אֵ֔שׁ מִ/ח֖וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: v't hbshr v't h'vr shrf b'sh mchvts lmchnh
verses.translation: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁחַ֖ט אֶת הָ/עֹלָ֑ה וַ֠/יַּמְצִאוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֤ן אֵלָי/ו֙ אֶת הַ/דָּ֔ם וַ/יִּזְרְקֵ֥/הוּ עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vyshcht 't h'lh vymts'v bny 'hrn 'lyv 't hdm vyzrqhv 'l hmzbch sbyb
verses.translation: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron’s sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled round about upon the altar.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הָ/עֹלָ֗ה הִמְצִ֧יאוּ אֵלָ֛י/ו לִ/נְתָחֶ֖י/הָ וְ/אֶת הָ/רֹ֑אשׁ וַ/יַּקְטֵ֖ר עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: v't h'lh hmtsy'v 'lyv lntchyh v't hr'sh vyqtr 'l hmzbch
verses.translation: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְחַ֥ץ אֶת הַ/קֶּ֖רֶב וְ/אֶת הַ/כְּרָעָ֑יִם וַ/יַּקְטֵ֥ר עַל הָ/עֹלָ֖ה הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחָ/ה
verses.translit: vyrchts 't hqrb v't hkhr'ym vyqtr 'l h'lh hmzbchh
verses.translation: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar.

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְרֵ֕ב אֵ֖ת קָרְבַּ֣ן הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יִּקַּ֞ח אֶת שְׂעִ֤יר הַֽ/חַטָּאת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ/עָ֔ם וַ/יִּשְׁחָטֵ֥/הוּ וַֽ/יְחַטְּאֵ֖/הוּ כָּ/רִאשֽׁוֹן
verses.translit: vyqrb 't qrbn h'm vyqch 't sh'yr hcht't 'shr l'm vyshchthv vycht'hv khr'shvn
verses.translation: And he brought the people’s offering, and took the goat, which was the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.

verses.translit: vyqrb 't h'lh vy'shh khmshpt
verses.translation: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְרֵב֮ אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָה֒ וַ/יְמַלֵּ֤א כַפּ/וֹ֙ מִמֶּ֔/נָּה וַ/יַּקְטֵ֖ר עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ מִ/לְּ/בַ֖ד עֹלַ֥ת הַ/בֹּֽקֶר
verses.translit: vyqrb 't hmnchh vyml' khpv mmnh vyqtr 'l hmzbch mlbd 'lt hbqr
verses.translation: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁחַ֤ט אֶת הַ/שּׁוֹר֙ וְ/אֶת הָ/אַ֔יִל זֶ֥בַח הַ/שְּׁלָמִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ/עָ֑ם וַ֠/יַּמְצִאוּ בְּנֵ֨י אַהֲרֹ֤ן אֶת הַ/דָּם֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּזְרְקֵ֥/הוּ עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vyshcht 't hshvr v't h'yl zbch hshlmym 'shr l'm vymts'v bny 'hrn 't hdm 'lyv vyzrqhv 'l hmzbch sbyb
verses.translation: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron’s sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/חֲלָבִ֖ים מִן הַ/שּׁ֑וֹר וּ/מִן הָ/אַ֔יִל הָֽ/אַלְיָ֤ה וְ/הַֽ/מְכַסֶּה֙ וְ/הַ/כְּלָיֹ֔ת וְ/יֹתֶ֖רֶת הַ/כָּבֵֽד
verses.translit: v't hchlbym mn hshvr vmn h'yl h'lyh vhmkhsh vhkhlyt vytrt hkhbd
verses.translation: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth the inwards , and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver:

verses.original: וַ/יָּשִׂ֥ימוּ אֶת הַ/חֲלָבִ֖ים עַל הֶ/חָז֑וֹת וַ/יַּקְטֵ֥ר הַ/חֲלָבִ֖ים הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחָ/ה
verses.translit: vyshymv 't hchlbym 'l hchzvt vyqtr hchlbym hmzbchh
verses.translation: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣ת הֶ/חָז֗וֹת וְ/אֵת֙ שׁ֣וֹק הַ/יָּמִ֔ין הֵנִ֧יף אַהֲרֹ֛ן תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֥ה מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: v't hchzvt v't shvq hymyn hnyf 'hrn tnvph lpny yhvh kh'shr tsvh mshh
verses.translation: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before the LORD ; as Moses commanded.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֨א אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת יד/ו יָדָ֛י/ו אֶל הָ/עָ֖ם וַֽ/יְבָרְכֵ֑/ם וַ/יֵּ֗רֶד מֵ/עֲשֹׂ֧ת הַֽ/חַטָּ֛את וְ/הָ/עֹלָ֖ה וְ/הַ/שְּׁלָמִֽים
verses.translit: vysh' 'hrn 't ydv ydyv 'l h'm vybrkhm vyrd m'sht hcht't vh'lh vhshlmym
verses.translation: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְ/אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וַ/יֵּ֣צְא֔וּ וַֽ/יְבָרֲכ֖וּ אֶת הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יֵּרָ֥א כְבוֹד יְהוָ֖ה אֶל כָּל הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyb' mshh v'hrn 'l 'hl mv'd vyts'v vybrkhv 't h'm vyr' khbvd yhvh 'l khl h'm
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the people.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֤צֵא אֵשׁ֙ מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַ/תֹּ֨אכַל֙ עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ אֶת הָ/עֹלָ֖ה וְ/אֶת הַ/חֲלָבִ֑ים וַ/יַּ֤רְא כָּל הָ/עָם֙ וַ/יָּרֹ֔נּוּ וַֽ/יִּפְּל֖וּ עַל פְּנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vtts' 'sh mlpny yhvh vt'khl 'l hmzbch 't h'lh v't hchlbym vyr' khl h'm vyrnv vyplv 'l pnyhm
verses.translation: And there came a fire out from before the LORD , and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְח֣וּ בְנֵֽי אַ֠הֲרֹן נָדָ֨ב וַ/אֲבִיה֜וּא אִ֣ישׁ מַחְתָּת֗/וֹ וַ/יִּתְּנ֤וּ בָ/הֵן֙ אֵ֔שׁ וַ/יָּשִׂ֥ימוּ עָלֶ֖י/הָ קְטֹ֑רֶת וַ/יַּקְרִ֜בוּ לִ/פְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֵ֣שׁ זָרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹ֦א צִוָּ֖ה אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyqchv bny 'hrn ndb v'byhv' 'ysh mchttv vytnv bhn 'sh vyshymv 'lyh qtrt vyqrbv lpny yhvh 'sh zrh 'shr l' tsvh 'tm
verses.translation: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the LORD , which he commanded them not.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֥צֵא אֵ֛שׁ מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וַ/תֹּ֣אכַל אוֹתָ֑/ם וַ/יָּמֻ֖תוּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vtts' 'sh mlpny yhvh vt'khl 'vtm vymtv lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And there went out fire from the LORD , and devoured them, and they died before the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֗ן הוּא֩ אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה לֵ/אמֹר֙ בִּ/קְרֹבַ֣/י אֶקָּדֵ֔שׁ וְ/עַל פְּנֵ֥י כָל הָ/עָ֖ם אֶכָּבֵ֑ד וַ/יִּדֹּ֖ם אַהֲרֹֽן
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l 'hrn hv' 'shr dbr yhvh l'mr bqrby 'qdsh v'l pny khl h'm 'khbd vydm 'hrn
verses.translation: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that the LORD spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶל מִֽישָׁאֵל֙ וְ/אֶ֣ל אֶלְצָפָ֔ן בְּנֵ֥י עֻזִּיאֵ֖ל דֹּ֣ד אַהֲרֹ֑ן וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם קִ֠רְב֞וּ שְׂא֤וּ אֶת אֲחֵי/כֶם֙ מֵ/אֵ֣ת פְּנֵי הַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ אֶל מִ/ח֖וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vyqr' mshh 'l mysh'l v'l 'ltspn bny 'zy'l dd 'hrn vy'mr 'lhm qrbv sh'v 't 'chykhm m't pny hqdsh 'l mchvts lmchnh
verses.translation: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.

verses.translit: vyqrbv vysh'm bkhtntm 'l mchvts lmchnh kh'shr dbr mshh
verses.translation: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֣ה אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֡ן וּ/לְ/אֶלְעָזָר֩ וּ/לְ/אִֽיתָמָ֨ר בָּנָ֜י/ו רָֽאשֵׁי/כֶ֥ם אַל תִּפְרָ֣עוּ וּ/בִגְדֵי/כֶ֤ם לֹֽא תִפְרֹ֨מוּ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א תָמֻ֔תוּ וְ/עַ֥ל כָּל הָ/עֵדָ֖ה יִקְצֹ֑ף וַ/אֲחֵי/כֶם֙ כָּל בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יִבְכּוּ֙ אֶת הַ/שְּׂרֵפָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר שָׂרַ֥ף יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l 'hrn vl'l'zr vl'ytmr bnyv r'shykhm 'l tpr'v vbgdykhm l' tprmv vl' tmtv v'l khl h'dh yqtsf v'chykhm khl byt yshr'l ybkhv 't hshrph 'shr shrf yhvh
verses.translation: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the LORD hath kindled.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/פֶּתַח֩ אֹ֨הֶל מוֹעֵ֜ד לֹ֤א תֵֽצְאוּ֙ פֶּן תָּמֻ֔תוּ כִּי שֶׁ֛מֶן מִשְׁחַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה עֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֖וּ כִּ/דְבַ֥ר מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vmptch 'hl mv'd l' tts'v pn tmtv khy shmn mshcht yhvh 'lykhm vy'shv khdbr mshh
verses.translation: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the LORD is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l 'hrn l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, saying,

verses.original: יַ֣יִן וְ/שֵׁכָ֞ר אַל תֵּ֣שְׁתְּ אַתָּ֣ה וּ/בָנֶ֣י/ךָ אִתָּ֗/ךְ בְּ/בֹאֲ/כֶ֛ם אֶל אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וְ/לֹ֣א תָמֻ֑תוּ חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְ/דֹרֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: yyn vshkhr 'l tsht 'th vbnykh 'tkh bb'khm 'l 'hl mv'd vl' tmtv chqt 'vlm ldrtykhm
verses.translation: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:

verses.original: וּֽ/לֲ/הַבְדִּ֔יל בֵּ֥ין הַ/קֹּ֖דֶשׁ וּ/בֵ֣ין הַ/חֹ֑ל וּ/בֵ֥ין הַ/טָּמֵ֖א וּ/בֵ֥ין הַ/טָּהֽוֹר
verses.translit: vlhbdyl byn hqdsh vbyn hchl vbyn htm' vbyn hthvr
verses.translation: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;

verses.original: וּ/לְ/הוֹרֹ֖ת אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֵ֚ת כָּל הַ֣/חֻקִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם בְּ/יַד מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vlhvrt 't bny yshr'l 't khl hchqym 'shr dbr yhvh 'lyhm byd mshh
verses.translation: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the LORD hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֨ר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֗ן וְ/אֶ֣ל אֶ֠לְעָזָר וְ/אֶל אִ֨יתָמָ֥ר בָּנָי/ו֮ הַ/נּֽוֹתָרִים֒ קְח֣וּ אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָ֗ה הַ/נּוֹתֶ֨רֶת֙ מֵ/אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְ/אִכְל֥וּ/הָ מַצּ֖וֹת אֵ֣צֶל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ כִּ֛י קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הִֽוא
verses.translit: vydbr mshh 'l 'hrn v'l 'l'zr v'l 'ytmr bnyv hnvtrym qchv 't hmnchh hnvtrt m'shy yhvh v'khlvh mtsvt 'tsl hmzbch khy qdsh qdshym hv'
verses.translation: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it is most holy:
