verses.original: וַ/אֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם אֹתָ/הּ֙ בְּ/מָק֣וֹם קָדֹ֔שׁ כִּ֣י חָקְ/ךָ֤ וְ/חָק בָּנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ הִ֔וא מֵ/אִשֵּׁ֖י יְהוָ֑ה כִּי כֵ֖ן צֻוֵּֽיתִי
verses.translit: v'khltm 'th bmqvm qdsh khy chqkh vchq bnykh hv' m'shy yhvh khy khn tsvyty
verses.translation: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it is thy due, and thy sons’ due, of the sacrifices of the LORD made by fire: for so I am commanded.

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֩ חֲזֵ֨ה הַ/תְּנוּפָ֜ה וְ/אֵ֣ת שׁ֣וֹק הַ/תְּרוּמָ֗ה תֹּֽאכְלוּ֙ בְּ/מָק֣וֹם טָה֔וֹר אַתָּ֕ה וּ/בָנֶ֥י/ךָ וּ/בְנֹתֶ֖י/ךָ אִתָּ֑/ךְ כִּֽי חָקְ/ךָ֤ וְ/חָק בָּנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ נִתְּנ֔וּ מִ/זִּבְחֵ֥י שַׁלְמֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v't chzh htnvph v't shvq htrvmh t'khlv bmqvm thvr 'th vbnykh vbntykh 'tkh khy chqkh vchq bnykh ntnv mzbchy shlmy bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for they be thy due, and thy sons’ due, which are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.

verses.original: שׁ֣וֹק הַ/תְּרוּמָ֞ה וַ/חֲזֵ֣ה הַ/תְּנוּפָ֗ה עַ֣ל אִשֵּׁ֤י הַ/חֲלָבִים֙ יָבִ֔יאוּ לְ/הָנִ֥יף תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/הָיָ֨ה לְ/ךָ֜ וּ/לְ/בָנֶ֤י/ךָ אִתְּ/ךָ֙ לְ/חָק עוֹלָ֔ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: shvq htrvmh vchzh htnvph 'l 'shy hchlbym yby'v lhnyf tnvph lpny yhvh vhyh lkh vlbnykh 'tkh lchq 'vlm kh'shr tsvh yhvh
verses.translation: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the LORD ; and it shall be thine, and thy sons’ with thee, by a statute for ever; as the LORD hath commanded.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣ת שְׂעִ֣יר הַֽ/חַטָּ֗את דָּרֹ֥שׁ דָּרַ֛שׁ מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה שֹׂרָ֑ף וַ֠/יִּקְצֹף עַל אֶלְעָזָ֤ר וְ/עַל אִֽיתָמָר֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן הַ/נּוֹתָרִ֖ם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: v't sh'yr hcht't drsh drsh mshh vhnh shrf vyqtsf 'l 'l'zr v'l 'ytmr bny 'hrn hnvtrm l'mr
verses.translation: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron which were left alive , saying,

verses.original: מַדּ֗וּעַ לֹֽא אֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם אֶת הַֽ/חַטָּאת֙ בִּ/מְק֣וֹם הַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ כִּ֛י קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הִ֑וא וְ/אֹתָ֣/הּ נָתַ֣ן לָ/כֶ֗ם לָ/שֵׂאת֙ אֶת עֲוֺ֣ן הָ/עֵדָ֔ה לְ/כַפֵּ֥ר עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: mdv' l' 'khltm 't hcht't bmqvm hqdsh khy qdsh qdshym hv' v'th ntn lkhm lsh't 't 'vn h'dh lkhpr 'lyhm lpny yhvh
verses.translation: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it is most holy, and God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the LORD ?

verses.original: הֵ֚ן לֹא הוּבָ֣א אֶת דָּמָ֔/הּ אֶל הַ/קֹּ֖דֶשׁ פְּנִ֑ימָה אָכ֨וֹל תֹּאכְל֥וּ אֹתָ֛/הּ בַּ/קֹּ֖דֶשׁ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוֵּֽיתִי
verses.translit: hn l' hvb' 't dmh 'l hqdsh pnymh 'khvl t'khlv 'th bqdsh kh'shr tsvyty
verses.translation: Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place: ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place , as I commanded.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֨ר אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה הֵ֣ן הַ֠/יּוֹם הִקְרִ֨יבוּ אֶת חַטָּאתָ֤/ם וְ/אֶת עֹֽלָתָ/ם֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַ/תִּקְרֶ֥אנָה אֹתִ֖/י כָּ/אֵ֑לֶּה וְ/אָכַ֤לְתִּי חַטָּאת֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם הַ/יִּיטַ֖ב בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vydbr 'hrn 'l mshh hn hyvm hqrybv 't cht'tm v't 'ltm lpny yhvh vtqr'nh 'ty kh'lh v'khlty cht't hyvm hyytb b'yny yhvh
verses.translation: And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the LORD ; and such things have befallen me: and if I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of the LORD ?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַ/יִּיטַ֖ב בְּ/עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshm' mshh vyytb b'ynyv
verses.translation: And when Moses heard that , he was content.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְ/אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵ/אמֹ֥ר אֲלֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh v'l 'hrn l'mr 'lhm
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,

verses.original: דַּבְּר֛וּ אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר זֹ֤את הַֽ/חַיָּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֹּאכְל֔וּ מִ/כָּל הַ/בְּהֵמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: dbrv 'l bny yshr'l l'mr z't hchyh 'shr t'khlv mkhl hbhmh 'shr 'l h'rts
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ל מַפְרֶ֣סֶת פַּרְסָ֗ה וְ/שֹׁסַ֤עַת שֶׁ֨סַע֙ פְּרָסֹ֔ת מַעֲלַ֥ת גֵּרָ֖ה בַּ/בְּהֵמָ֑ה אֹתָ֖/הּ תֹּאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: khl mprst prsh vshs't shs' prst m'lt grh bbhmh 'th t'khlv
verses.translation: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.

verses.original: אַ֤ךְ אֶת זֶה֙ לֹ֣א תֹֽאכְל֔וּ מִֽ/מַּעֲלֵי֙ הַ/גֵּרָ֔ה וּ/מִ/מַּפְרִיסֵ֖י הַ/פַּרְסָ֑ה אֶֽת הַ֠/גָּמָל כִּֽי מַעֲלֵ֨ה גֵרָ֜ה ה֗וּא וּ/פַרְסָה֙ אֵינֶ֣/נּוּ מַפְרִ֔יס טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'kh 't zh l' t'khlv mm'ly hgrh vmmprysy hprsh 't hgml khy m'lh grh hv' vprsh 'ynnv mprys tm' hv' lkhm
verses.translation: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/שָּׁפָ֗ן כִּֽי מַעֲלֵ֤ה גֵרָה֙ ה֔וּא וּ/פַרְסָ֖ה לֹ֣א יַפְרִ֑יס טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v't hshpn khy m'lh grh hv' vprsh l' yprys tm' hv' lkhm
verses.translation: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הָ/אַרְנֶ֗בֶת כִּֽי מַעֲלַ֤ת גֵּרָה֙ הִ֔וא וּ/פַרְסָ֖ה לֹ֣א הִפְרִ֑יסָה טְמֵאָ֥ה הִ֖וא לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v't h'rnbt khy m'lt grh hv' vprsh l' hprysh tm'h hv' lkhm
verses.translation: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ֠/חֲזִיר כִּֽי מַפְרִ֨יס פַּרְסָ֜ה ה֗וּא וְ/שֹׁסַ֥ע שֶׁ֨סַע֙ פַּרְסָ֔ה וְ/ה֖וּא גֵּרָ֣ה לֹֽא יִגָּ֑ר טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v't hchzyr khy mprys prsh hv' vshs' shs' prsh vhv' grh l' ygr tm' hv' lkhm
verses.translation: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean to you.

verses.original: מִ/בְּשָׂרָ/ם֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֔לוּ וּ/בְ/נִבְלָתָ֖/ם לֹ֣א תִגָּ֑עוּ טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: mbshrm l' t'khlv vbnbltm l' tg'v tm'ym hm lkhm
verses.translation: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they are unclean to you.

verses.original: אֶת זֶה֙ תֹּֽאכְל֔וּ מִ/כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/מָּ֑יִם כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר ל/וֹ֩ סְנַפִּ֨יר וְ/קַשְׂקֶ֜שֶׂת בַּ/מַּ֗יִם בַּ/יַּמִּ֛ים וּ/בַ/נְּחָלִ֖ים אֹתָ֥/ם תֹּאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: 't zh t'khlv mkhl 'shr bmym khl 'shr lv snpyr vqshqsht bmym bymym vbnchlym 'tm t'khlv
verses.translation: These shall ye eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.

verses.original: וְ/כֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֵֽין ל֜/וֹ סְנַפִּ֣יר וְ/קַשְׂקֶ֗שֶׂת בַּ/יַּמִּים֙ וּ/בַ/נְּחָלִ֔ים מִ/כֹּל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הַ/מַּ֔יִם וּ/מִ/כֹּ֛ל נֶ֥פֶשׁ הַ/חַיָּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/מָּ֑יִם שֶׁ֥קֶץ הֵ֖ם לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vkhl 'shr 'yn lv snpyr vqshqsht bymym vbnchlym mkhl shrts hmym vmkhl npsh hchyh 'shr bmym shqts hm lkhm
verses.translation: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which is in the waters, they shall be an abomination unto you:

verses.original: וְ/שֶׁ֖קֶץ יִהְי֣וּ לָ/כֶ֑ם מִ/בְּשָׂרָ/ם֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֔לוּ וְ/אֶת נִבְלָתָ֖/ם תְּשַׁקֵּֽצוּ
verses.translit: vshqts yhyv lkhm mbshrm l' t'khlv v't nbltm tshqtsv
verses.translation: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵֽין ל֛/וֹ סְנַפִּ֥יר וְ/קַשְׂקֶ֖שֶׂת בַּ/מָּ֑יִם שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khl 'shr 'yn lv snpyr vqshqsht bmym shqts hv' lkhm
verses.translation: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that shall be an abomination unto you.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת אֵ֨לֶּה֙ תְּשַׁקְּצ֣וּ מִן הָ/ע֔וֹף לֹ֥א יֵאָכְל֖וּ שֶׁ֣קֶץ הֵ֑ם אֶת הַ/נֶּ֨שֶׁר֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/פֶּ֔רֶס וְ/אֵ֖ת הָ/עָזְנִיָּֽה
verses.translit: v't 'lh tshqtsv mn h'vf l' y'khlv shqts hm 't hnshr v't hprs v't h'znyh
verses.translation: And these are they which ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ֨/דָּאָ֔ה וְ/אֶת הָ/אַיָּ֖ה לְ/מִינָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v't hd'h v't h'yh lmynh
verses.translation: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;

verses.original: אֵ֥ת כָּל עֹרֵ֖ב לְ/מִינֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 't khl 'rb lmynv
verses.translation: Every raven after his kind;

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ בַּ֣ת הַֽ/יַּעֲנָ֔ה וְ/אֶת הַ/תַּחְמָ֖ס וְ/אֶת הַ/שָּׁ֑חַף וְ/אֶת הַ/נֵּ֖ץ לְ/מִינֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: v't bt hy'nh v't htchms v't hshchf v't hnts lmynhv
verses.translation: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/כּ֥וֹס וְ/אֶת הַ/שָּׁלָ֖ךְ וְ/אֶת הַ/יַּנְשֽׁוּף
verses.translit: v't hkhvs v't hshlkh v't hynshvf
verses.translation: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/תִּנְשֶׁ֥מֶת וְ/אֶת הַ/קָּאָ֖ת וְ/אֶת הָ/רָחָֽם
verses.translit: v't htnshmt v't hq't v't hrchm
verses.translation: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ הַ/חֲסִידָ֔ה הָ/אֲנָפָ֖ה לְ/מִינָ֑/הּ וְ/אֶת הַ/דּוּכִיפַ֖ת וְ/אֶת הָ/עֲטַלֵּֽף
verses.translit: v't hchsydh h'nph lmynh v't hdvkhypt v't h'tlf
verses.translation: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ל שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָ/ע֔וֹף הַ/הֹלֵ֖ךְ עַל אַרְבַּ֑ע שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khl shrts h'vf hhlkh 'l 'rb' shqts hv' lkhm
verses.translation: All fowls that creep, going upon all four, shall be an abomination unto you.

verses.original: אַ֤ךְ אֶת זֶה֙ תֹּֽאכְל֔וּ מִ/כֹּל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָ/ע֔וֹף הַ/הֹלֵ֖ךְ עַל אַרְבַּ֑ע אֲשֶׁר לא ל֤/וֹ כְרָעַ֨יִם֙ מִ/מַּ֣עַל לְ/רַגְלָ֔י/ו לְ/נַתֵּ֥ר בָּ/הֵ֖ן עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 'kh 't zh t'khlv mkhl shrts h'vf hhlkh 'l 'rb' 'shr l' lv khr'ym mm'l lrglyv lntr bhn 'l h'rts
verses.translation: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon all four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;

verses.original: אֶת אֵ֤לֶּה מֵ/הֶם֙ תֹּאכֵ֔לוּ אֶת הָֽ/אַרְבֶּ֣ה לְ/מִינ֔/וֹ וְ/אֶת הַ/סָּלְעָ֖ם לְ/מִינֵ֑/הוּ וְ/אֶת הַ/חַרְגֹּ֣ל לְ/מִינֵ֔/הוּ וְ/אֶת הֶ/חָגָ֖ב לְ/מִינֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: 't 'lh mhm t'khlv 't h'rbh lmynv v't hsl'm lmynhv v't hchrgl lmynhv v't hchgb lmynhv
verses.translation: Even these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.

verses.original: וְ/כֹל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָ/ע֔וֹף אֲשֶׁר ל֖/וֹ אַרְבַּ֣ע רַגְלָ֑יִם שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vkhl shrts h'vf 'shr lv 'rb' rglym shqts hv' lkhm
verses.translation: But all other flying creeping things, which have four feet, shall be an abomination unto you.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/אֵ֖לֶּה תִּטַּמָּ֑אוּ כָּל הַ/נֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּ/נִבְלָתָ֖/ם יִטְמָ֥א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vl'lh ttm'v khl hng' bnbltm ytm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הַ/נֹּשֵׂ֖א מִ/נִּבְלָתָ֑/ם יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖י/ו וְ/טָמֵ֥א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vkhl hnsh' mnbltm ykhbs bgdyv vtm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And whosoever beareth ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

verses.original: לְֽ/כָל הַ/בְּהֵמָ֡ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִוא֩ מַפְרֶ֨סֶת פַּרְסָ֜ה וְ/שֶׁ֣סַע אֵינֶ֣/נָּה שֹׁסַ֗עַת וְ/גֵרָה֙ אֵינֶ֣/נָּה מַעֲלָ֔ה טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָ/כֶ֑ם כָּל הַ/נֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּ/הֶ֖ם יִטְמָֽא
verses.translit: lkhl hbhmh 'shr hv' mprst prsh vshs' 'ynnh shs't vgrh 'ynnh m'lh tm'ym hm lkhm khl hng' bhm ytm'
verses.translation: The carcases of every beast which divideth the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, are unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.

verses.original: וְ/כֹ֣ל הוֹלֵ֣ךְ עַל כַּפָּ֗י/ו בְּ/כָל הַֽ/חַיָּה֙ הַ/הֹלֶ֣כֶת עַל אַרְבַּ֔ע טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָ/כֶ֑ם כָּל הַ/נֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּ/נִבְלָתָ֖/ם יִטְמָ֥א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vkhl hvlkh 'l khpyv bkhl hchyh hhlkht 'l 'rb' tm'ym hm lkhm khl hng' bnbltm ytm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נֹּשֵׂא֙ אֶת נִבְלָתָ֔/ם יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖י/ו וְ/טָמֵ֣א עַד הָ/עָ֑רֶב טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖מָּה לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhnsh' 't nbltm ykhbs bgdyv vtm' 'd h'rb tm'ym hmh lkhm
verses.translation: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.

verses.original: וְ/זֶ֤ה לָ/כֶם֙ הַ/טָּמֵ֔א בַּ/שֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַ/שֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ הַ/חֹ֥לֶד וְ/הָ/עַכְבָּ֖ר וְ/הַ/צָּ֥ב לְ/מִינֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vzh lkhm htm' bshrts hshrts 'l h'rts hchld vh'khbr vhtsb lmynhv
verses.translation: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,

verses.translit: vh'nqh vhkhch vhlt'h vhchmt vhtnshmt
verses.translation: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה הַ/טְּמֵאִ֥ים לָ/כֶ֖ם בְּ/כָל הַ/שָּׁ֑רֶץ כָּל הַ/נֹּגֵ֧עַ בָּ/הֶ֛ם בְּ/מֹתָ֖/ם יִטְמָ֥א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: 'lh htm'ym lkhm bkhl hshrts khl hng' bhm bmtm ytm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: These are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וְ/כֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר יִפֹּל עָלָי/ו֩ מֵ/הֶ֨ם בְּ/מֹתָ֜/ם יִטְמָ֗א מִ/כָּל כְּלִי עֵץ֙ א֣וֹ בֶ֤גֶד אוֹ עוֹר֙ א֣וֹ שָׂ֔ק כָּל כְּלִ֕י אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂ֥ה מְלָאכָ֖ה בָּ/הֶ֑ם בַּ/מַּ֧יִם יוּבָ֛א וְ/טָמֵ֥א עַד הָ/עֶ֖רֶב וְ/טָהֵֽר
verses.translit: vkhl 'shr ypl 'lyv mhm bmtm ytm' mkhl khly 'ts 'v bgd 'v 'vr 'v shq khl khly 'shr y'shh ml'khh bhm bmym yvb' vtm' 'd h'rb vthr
verses.translation: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be , wherein any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.

verses.original: וְ/כָל כְּלִי חֶ֔רֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר יִפֹּ֥ל מֵ/הֶ֖ם אֶל תּוֹכ֑/וֹ כֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּ/תוֹכ֛/וֹ יִטְמָ֖א וְ/אֹת֥/וֹ תִשְׁבֹּֽרוּ
verses.translit: vkhl khly chrsh 'shr ypl mhm 'l tvkhv khl 'shr btvkhv ytm' v'tv tshbrv
verses.translation: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.

verses.original: מִ/כָּל הָ/אֹ֜כֶל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵאָכֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָב֥וֹא עָלָ֛י/ו מַ֖יִם יִטְמָ֑א וְ/כָל מַשְׁקֶה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשָּׁתֶ֔ה בְּ/כָל כְּלִ֖י יִטְמָֽא
verses.translit: mkhl h'khl 'shr y'khl 'shr ybv' 'lyv mym ytm' vkhl mshqh 'shr yshth bkhl khly ytm'
verses.translation: Of all meat which may be eaten, that on which such water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.

verses.original: וְ֠/כֹל אֲשֶׁר יִפֹּ֨ל מִ/נִּבְלָתָ֥/ם עָלָי/ו֮ יִטְמָא֒ תַּנּ֧וּר וְ/כִירַ֛יִם יֻתָּ֖ץ טְמֵאִ֣ים הֵ֑ם וּ/טְמֵאִ֖ים יִהְי֥וּ לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vkhl 'shr ypl mnbltm 'lyv ytm' tnvr vkhyrym ytts tm'ym hm vtm'ym yhyv lkhm
verses.translation: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: for they are unclean, and shall be unclean unto you.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ מַעְיָ֥ן וּ/ב֛וֹר מִקְוֵה מַ֖יִם יִהְיֶ֣ה טָה֑וֹר וְ/נֹגֵ֥עַ בְּ/נִבְלָתָ֖/ם יִטְמָֽא
verses.translit: 'kh m'yn vbvr mqvh mym yhyh thvr vng' bnbltm ytm'
verses.translation: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, wherein there is plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.

verses.original: וְ/כִ֤י יִפֹּל֙ מִ/נִּבְלָתָ֔/ם עַל כָּל זֶ֥רַע זֵר֖וּעַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִזָּרֵ֑עַ טָה֖וֹר הֽוּא
verses.translit: vkhy ypl mnbltm 'l khl zr' zrv' 'shr yzr' thvr hv'
verses.translation: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean.

verses.original: וְ/כִ֤י יֻתַּן מַ֨יִם֙ עַל זֶ֔רַע וְ/נָפַ֥ל מִ/נִּבְלָתָ֖/ם עָלָ֑י/ו טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vkhy ytn mym 'l zr' vnpl mnbltm 'lyv tm' hv' lkhm
verses.translation: But if any water be put upon the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.

verses.original: וְ/כִ֤י יָמוּת֙ מִן הַ/בְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר הִ֥יא לָ/כֶ֖ם לְ/אָכְלָ֑ה הַ/נֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּ/נִבְלָתָ֖/הּ יִטְמָ֥א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vkhy ymvt mn hbhmh 'shr hy' lkhm l'khlh hng' bnblth ytm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וְ/הָֽ/אֹכֵל֙ מִ/נִּבְלָתָ֔/הּ יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖י/ו וְ/טָמֵ֣א עַד הָ/עָ֑רֶב וְ/הַ/נֹּשֵׂא֙ אֶת נִבְלָתָ֔/הּ יְכַבֵּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖י/ו וְ/טָמֵ֥א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vh'khl mnblth ykhbs bgdyv vtm' 'd h'rb vhnsh' 't nblth ykhbs bgdyv vtm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הַ/שֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַ/שֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ שֶׁ֥קֶץ ה֖וּא לֹ֥א יֵאָכֵֽל
verses.translit: vkhl hshrts hshrts 'l h'rts shqts hv' l' y'khl
verses.translation: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.

verses.original: כֹּל֩ הוֹלֵ֨ךְ עַל גָּח֜וֹן וְ/כֹ֣ל הוֹלֵ֣ךְ עַל אַרְבַּ֗ע עַ֚ד כָּל מַרְבֵּ֣ה רַגְלַ֔יִם לְ/כָל הַ/שֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַ/שֹּׁרֵ֣ץ עַל הָ/אָ֑רֶץ לֹ֥א תֹאכְל֖וּ/ם כִּי שֶׁ֥קֶץ הֵֽם
verses.translit: khl hvlkh 'l gchvn vkhl hvlkh 'l 'rb' 'd khl mrbh rglym lkhl hshrts hshrts 'l h'rts l' t'khlvm khy shqts hm
verses.translation: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.

verses.original: אַל תְּשַׁקְּצוּ֙ אֶת נַפְשֹׁ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם בְּ/כָל הַ/שֶּׁ֖רֶץ הַ/שֹּׁרֵ֑ץ וְ/לֹ֤א תִֽטַּמְּאוּ֙ בָּ/הֶ֔ם וְ/נִטְמֵתֶ֖ם בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'l tshqtsv 't npshtykhm bkhl hshrts hshrts vl' ttm'v bhm vntmtm bm
verses.translation: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָה֮ אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶם֒ וְ/הִתְקַדִּשְׁתֶּם֙ וִ/הְיִיתֶ֣ם קְדֹשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י קָד֖וֹשׁ אָ֑נִי וְ/לֹ֤א תְטַמְּאוּ֙ אֶת נַפְשֹׁ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם בְּ/כָל הַ/שֶּׁ֖רֶץ הָ/רֹמֵ֥שׂ עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khy 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm vhtqdshtm vhyytm qdshym khy qdvsh 'ny vl' ttm'v 't npshtykhm bkhl hshrts hrmsh 'l h'rts
verses.translation: For I am the LORD your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה הַֽ/מַּעֲלֶ֤ה אֶתְ/כֶם֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִ/הְיֹ֥ת לָ/כֶ֖ם לֵ/אלֹהִ֑ים וִ/הְיִיתֶ֣ם קְדֹשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י קָד֖וֹשׁ אָֽנִי
verses.translit: khy 'ny yhvh hm'lh 'tkhm m'rts mtsrym lhyt lkhm l'lhym vhyytm qdshym khy qdvsh 'ny
verses.translation: For I am the LORD that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.

verses.original: זֹ֣את תּוֹרַ֤ת הַ/בְּהֵמָה֙ וְ/הָ/ע֔וֹף וְ/כֹל֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ הַֽ/חַיָּ֔ה הָ/רֹמֶ֖שֶׂת בַּ/מָּ֑יִם וּ/לְ/כָל נֶ֖פֶשׁ הַ/שֹּׁרֶ֥צֶת עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: z't tvrt hbhmh vh'vf vkhl npsh hchyh hrmsht bmym vlkhl npsh hshrtst 'l h'rts
verses.translation: This is the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:

verses.original: לְ/הַבְדִּ֕יל בֵּ֥ין הַ/טָּמֵ֖א וּ/בֵ֣ין הַ/טָּהֹ֑ר וּ/בֵ֤ין הַֽ/חַיָּה֙ הַֽ/נֶּאֱכֶ֔לֶת וּ/בֵין֙ הַֽ/חַיָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א תֵאָכֵֽל
verses.translit: lhbdyl byn htm' vbyn hthr vbyn hchyh hn'khlt vbyn hchyh 'shr l' t'khl
verses.translation: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר אִשָּׁה֙ כִּ֣י תַזְרִ֔יעַ וְ/יָלְדָ֖ה זָכָ֑ר וְ/טָֽמְאָה֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים כִּ/ימֵ֛י נִדַּ֥ת דְּוֺתָ֖/הּ תִּטְמָֽא
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l l'mr 'shh khy tzry' vyldh zkhr vtm'h shb't ymym khymy ndt dvth ttm'
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/יּ֖וֹם הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֑י יִמּ֖וֹל בְּשַׂ֥ר עָרְלָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vbyvm hshmyny ymvl bshr 'rltv
verses.translation: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים יוֹם֙ וּ/שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים תֵּשֵׁ֖ב בִּ/דְמֵ֣י טָהֳרָ֑ה בְּ/כָל קֹ֣דֶשׁ לֹֽא תִגָּ֗ע וְ/אֶל הַ/מִּקְדָּשׁ֙ לֹ֣א תָבֹ֔א עַד מְלֹ֖את יְמֵ֥י טָהֳרָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vshlshym yvm vshlsht ymym tshb bdmy thrh bkhl qdsh l' tg' v'l hmqdsh l' tb' 'd ml't ymy thrh
verses.translation: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.

verses.original: וְ/אִם נְקֵבָ֣ה תֵלֵ֔ד וְ/טָמְאָ֥ה שְׁבֻעַ֖יִם כְּ/נִדָּתָ֑/הּ וְ/שִׁשִּׁ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְ/שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים תֵּשֵׁ֖ב עַל דְּמֵ֥י טָהֳרָֽה
verses.translit: v'm nqbh tld vtm'h shb'ym khndth vshshym yvm vshsht ymym tshb 'l dmy thrh
verses.translation: But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/מְלֹ֣את יְמֵ֣י טָהֳרָ֗/הּ לְ/בֵן֮ א֣וֹ לְ/בַת֒ תָּבִ֞יא כֶּ֤בֶשׂ בֶּן שְׁנָת/וֹ֙ לְ/עֹלָ֔ה וּ/בֶן יוֹנָ֥ה אוֹ תֹ֖ר לְ/חַטָּ֑את אֶל פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: vbml't ymy thrh lbn 'v lbt tby' khbsh bn shntv l'lh vbn yvnh 'v tr lcht't 'l ptch 'hl mv'd 'l hkhhn
verses.translation: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרִיב֞/וֹ לִ/פְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְ/כִפֶּ֣ר עָלֶ֔י/הָ וְ/טָהֲרָ֖ה מִ/מְּקֹ֣ר דָּמֶ֑י/הָ זֹ֤את תּוֹרַת֙ הַ/יֹּלֶ֔דֶת לַ/זָּכָ֖ר א֥וֹ לַ/נְּקֵבָֽה
verses.translit: vhqrybv lpny yhvh vkhpr 'lyh vthrh mmqr dmyh z't tvrt hyldt lzkhr 'v lnqbh
verses.translation: Who shall offer it before the LORD , and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female.

verses.original: וְ/אִם לֹ֨א תִמְצָ֣א יָדָ/הּ֮ דֵּ֣י שֶׂה֒ וְ/לָקְחָ֣ה שְׁתֵּֽי תֹרִ֗ים א֤וֹ שְׁנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֔ה אֶחָ֥ד לְ/עֹלָ֖ה וְ/אֶחָ֣ד לְ/חַטָּ֑את וְ/כִפֶּ֥ר עָלֶ֛י/הָ הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן וְ/טָהֵֽרָה
verses.translit: v'm l' tmts' ydh dy shh vlqchh shty trym 'v shny bny yvnh 'chd l'lh v'chd lcht't vkhpr 'lyh hkhhn vthrh
verses.translation: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְ/אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh v'l 'hrn l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,

verses.original: אָדָ֗ם כִּֽי יִהְיֶ֤ה בְ/עוֹר בְּשָׂר/וֹ֙ שְׂאֵ֤ת אֽוֹ סַפַּ֨חַת֙ א֣וֹ בַהֶ֔רֶת וְ/הָיָ֥ה בְ/עוֹר בְּשָׂר֖/וֹ לְ/נֶ֣גַע צָרָ֑עַת וְ/הוּבָא֙ אֶל אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן א֛וֹ אֶל אַחַ֥ד מִ/בָּנָ֖י/ו הַ/כֹּהֲנִֽים
verses.translit: 'dm khy yhyh b'vr bshrv sh't 'v spcht 'v bhrt vhyh b'vr bshrv lng' tsr't vhvb' 'l 'hrn hkhhn 'v 'l 'chd mbnyv hkhhnym
verses.translation: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:

verses.original: וְ/רָאָ֣ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן אֶת הַ/נֶּ֣גַע בְּ/עֽוֹר הַ֠/בָּשָׂר וְ/שֵׂעָ֨ר בַּ/נֶּ֜גַע הָפַ֣ךְ לָבָ֗ן וּ/מַרְאֵ֤ה הַ/נֶּ֨גַע֙ עָמֹק֙ מֵ/ע֣וֹר בְּשָׂר֔/וֹ נֶ֥גַע צָרַ֖עַת ה֑וּא וְ/רָאָ֥/הוּ הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן וְ/טִמֵּ֥א אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vr'h hkhhn 't hng' b'vr hbshr vsh'r bng' hpkh lbn vmr'h hng' 'mq m'vr bshrv ng' tsr't hv' vr'hv hkhhn vtm' 'tv
verses.translation: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and when the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.

verses.original: וְ/אִם בַּהֶרֶת֩ לְבָנָ֨ה הִ֜וא בְּ/ע֣וֹר בְּשָׂר֗/וֹ וְ/עָמֹק֙ אֵין מַרְאֶ֣/הָ מִן הָ/ע֔וֹר וּ/שְׂעָרָ֖/ה לֹא הָפַ֣ךְ לָבָ֑ן וְ/הִסְגִּ֧יר הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת הַ/נֶּ֖גַע שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: v'm bhrt lbnh hv' b'vr bshrv v'mq 'yn mr'h mn h'vr vsh'rh l' hpkh lbn vhsgyr hkhhn 't hng' shb't ymym
verses.translation: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days:

verses.original: וְ/רָאָ֣/הוּ הַ/כֹּהֵן֮ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִי֒ וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה הַ/נֶּ֨גַע֙ עָמַ֣ד בְּ/עֵינָ֔י/ו לֹֽא פָשָׂ֥ה הַ/נֶּ֖גַע בָּ/ע֑וֹר וְ/הִסְגִּיר֧/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים שֵׁנִֽית
verses.translit: vr'hv hkhhn byvm hshby'y vhnh hng' 'md b'ynyv l' pshh hng' b'vr vhsgyrv hkhhn shb't ymym shnyt
verses.translation: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague in his sight be at a stay, and the plague spread not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:

verses.original: וְ/רָאָה֩ הַ/כֹּהֵ֨ן אֹת֜/וֹ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִי֮ שֵׁנִית֒ וְ/הִנֵּה֙ כֵּהָ֣ה הַ/נֶּ֔גַע וְ/לֹא פָשָׂ֥ה הַ/נֶּ֖גַע בָּ/ע֑וֹר וְ/טִהֲר֤/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ מִסְפַּ֣חַת הִ֔יא וְ/כִבֶּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖י/ו וְ/טָהֵֽר
verses.translit: vr'h hkhhn 'tv byvm hshby'y shnyt vhnh khhh hng' vl' pshh hng' b'vr vthrv hkhhn mspcht hy' vkhbs bgdyv vthr
verses.translation: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague be somewhat dark, and the plague spread not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is but a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

verses.original: וְ/אִם פָּשֹׂ֨ה תִפְשֶׂ֤ה הַ/מִּסְפַּ֨חַת֙ בָּ/ע֔וֹר אַחֲרֵ֧י הֵרָאֹת֛/וֹ אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן לְ/טָהֳרָת֑/וֹ וְ/נִרְאָ֥ה שֵׁנִ֖ית אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: v'm pshh tpshh hmspcht b'vr 'chry hr'tv 'l hkhhn lthrtv vnr'h shnyt 'l hkhhn
verses.translation: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen of the priest again:

verses.original: וְ/רָאָה֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה פָּשְׂתָ֥ה הַ/מִּסְפַּ֖חַת בָּ/ע֑וֹר וְ/טִמְּא֥/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן צָרַ֥עַת הִֽוא
verses.translit: vr'h hkhhn vhnh pshth hmspcht b'vr vtm'v hkhhn tsr't hv'
verses.translation: And if the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a leprosy.

verses.original: נֶ֣גַע צָרַ֔עַת כִּ֥י תִהְיֶ֖ה בְּ/אָדָ֑ם וְ/הוּבָ֖א אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: ng' tsr't khy thyh b'dm vhvb' 'l hkhhn
verses.translation: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;

verses.original: וְ/רָאָ֣ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה שְׂאֵת לְבָנָה֙ בָּ/ע֔וֹר וְ/הִ֕יא הָפְכָ֖ה שֵׂעָ֣ר לָבָ֑ן וּ/מִֽחְיַ֛ת בָּשָׂ֥ר חַ֖י בַּ/שְׂאֵֽת
verses.translit: vr'h hkhhn vhnh sh't lbnh b'vr vhy' hpkhh sh'r lbn vmchyt bshr chy bsh't
verses.translation: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the rising be white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising;

verses.original: צָרַ֨עַת נוֹשֶׁ֤נֶת הִוא֙ בְּ/ע֣וֹר בְּשָׂר֔/וֹ וְ/טִמְּא֖/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן לֹ֣א יַסְגִּרֶ֔/נּוּ כִּ֥י טָמֵ֖א הֽוּא
verses.translit: tsr't nvshnt hv' b'vr bshrv vtm'v hkhhn l' ysgrnv khy tm' hv'
verses.translation: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he is unclean.

verses.original: וְ/אִם פָּר֨וֹחַ תִּפְרַ֤ח הַ/צָּרַ֨עַת֙ בָּ/ע֔וֹר וְ/כִסְּתָ֣ה הַ/צָּרַ֗עַת אֵ֚ת כָּל ע֣וֹר הַ/נֶּ֔גַע מֵ/רֹאשׁ֖/וֹ וְ/עַד רַגְלָ֑י/ו לְ/כָל מַרְאֵ֖ה עֵינֵ֥י הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: v'm prvch tprch htsr't b'vr vkhsth htsr't 't khl 'vr hng' mr'shv v'd rglyv lkhl mr'h 'yny hkhhn
verses.translation: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his foot, wheresoever the priest looketh;

verses.original: וְ/רָאָ֣ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן וְ/הִנֵּ֨ה כִסְּתָ֤ה הַ/צָּרַ֨עַת֙ אֶת כָּל בְּשָׂר֔/וֹ וְ/טִהַ֖ר אֶת הַ/נָּ֑גַע כֻּלּ֛/וֹ הָפַ֥ךְ לָבָ֖ן טָה֥וֹר הֽוּא
verses.translit: vr'h hkhhn vhnh khsth htsr't 't khl bshrv vthr 't hng' khlv hpkh lbn thvr hv'
verses.translation: Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/י֨וֹם הֵרָא֥וֹת בּ֛/וֹ בָּשָׂ֥ר חַ֖י יִטְמָֽא
verses.translit: vbyvm hr'vt bv bshr chy ytm'
verses.translation: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.

verses.original: וְ/רָאָ֧ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת הַ/בָּשָׂ֥ר הַ/חַ֖י וְ/טִמְּא֑/וֹ הַ/בָּשָׂ֥ר הַ/חַ֛י טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא צָרַ֥עַת הֽוּא
verses.translit: vr'h hkhhn 't hbshr hchy vtm'v hbshr hchy tm' hv' tsr't hv'
verses.translation: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: for the raw flesh is unclean: it is a leprosy.

verses.original: א֣וֹ כִ֥י יָשׁ֛וּב הַ/בָּשָׂ֥ר הַ/חַ֖י וְ/נֶהְפַּ֣ךְ לְ/לָבָ֑ן וּ/בָ֖א אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: 'v khy yshvb hbshr hchy vnhpkh llbn vb' 'l hkhhn
verses.translation: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;

verses.original: וְ/רָאָ֨/הוּ֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ הַ/נֶּ֖גַע לְ/לָבָ֑ן וְ/טִהַ֧ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת הַ/נֶּ֖גַע טָה֥וֹר הֽוּא
verses.translit: vr'hv hkhhn vhnh nhpkh hng' llbn vthr hkhhn 't hng' thvr hv'
verses.translation: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the plague be turned into white; then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: he is clean.

verses.original: וּ/בָשָׂ֕ר כִּֽי יִהְיֶ֥ה בֽ/וֹ בְ/עֹר֖/וֹ שְׁחִ֑ין וְ/נִרְפָּֽא
verses.translit: vbshr khy yhyh bv b'rv shchyn vnrp'
verses.translation: The flesh also, in which, even in the skin thereof, was a boil, and is healed,

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֞ה בִּ/מְק֤וֹם הַ/שְּׁחִין֙ שְׂאֵ֣ת לְבָנָ֔ה א֥וֹ בַהֶ֖רֶת לְבָנָ֣ה אֲדַמְדָּ֑מֶת וְ/נִרְאָ֖ה אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: vhyh bmqvm hshchyn sh't lbnh 'v bhrt lbnh 'dmdmt vnr'h 'l hkhhn
verses.translation: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;

verses.original: וְ/רָאָ֣ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה מַרְאֶ֨/הָ֙ שָׁפָ֣ל מִן הָ/ע֔וֹר וּ/שְׂעָרָ֖/הּ הָפַ֣ךְ לָבָ֑ן וְ/טִמְּא֧/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן נֶֽגַע צָרַ֥עַת הִ֖וא בַּ/שְּׁחִ֥ין פָּרָֽחָה
verses.translit: vr'h hkhhn vhnh mr'h shpl mn h'vr vsh'rh hpkh lbn vtm'v hkhhn ng' tsr't hv' bshchyn prchh
verses.translation: And if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it be in sight lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white; the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֣ם יִרְאֶ֣/נָּה הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה אֵֽין בָּ/הּ֙ שֵׂעָ֣ר לָבָ֔ן וּ/שְׁפָלָ֥ה אֵינֶ֛/נָּה מִן הָ/ע֖וֹר וְ/הִ֣יא כֵהָ֑ה וְ/הִסְגִּיר֥/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: v'm yr'nh hkhhn vhnh 'yn bh sh'r lbn vshplh 'ynnh mn h'vr vhy' khhh vhsgyrv hkhhn shb't ymym
verses.translation: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs therein, and if it be not lower than the skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:

verses.original: וְ/אִם פָּשֹׂ֥ה תִפְשֶׂ֖ה בָּ/ע֑וֹר וְ/טִמֵּ֧א הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן אֹת֖/וֹ נֶ֥גַע הִֽוא
verses.translit: v'm pshh tpshh b'vr vtm' hkhhn 'tv ng' hv'
verses.translation: And if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.

verses.original: וְ/אִם תַּחְתֶּ֜י/הָ תַּעֲמֹ֤ד הַ/בַּהֶ֨רֶת֙ לֹ֣א פָשָׂ֔תָה צָרֶ֥בֶת הַ/שְּׁחִ֖ין הִ֑וא וְ/טִהֲר֖/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: v'm tchtyh t'md hbhrt l' pshth tsrbt hshchyn hv' vthrv hkhhn
verses.translation: But if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not, it is a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

verses.original: א֣וֹ בָשָׂ֔ר כִּֽי יִהְיֶ֥ה בְ/עֹר֖/וֹ מִכְוַת אֵ֑שׁ וְֽ/הָיְתָ֞ה מִֽחְיַ֣ת הַ/מִּכְוָ֗ה בַּהֶ֛רֶת לְבָנָ֥ה אֲדַמְדֶּ֖מֶת א֥וֹ לְבָנָֽה
verses.translit: 'v bshr khy yhyh b'rv mkhvt 'sh vhyth mchyt hmkhvh bhrt lbnh 'dmdmt 'v lbnh
verses.translation: Or if there be any flesh, in the skin whereof there is a hot burning, and the quick flesh that burneth have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;

verses.original: וְ/רָאָ֣ה אֹתָ֣/הּ הַ/כֹּהֵ֡ן וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה נֶהְפַּךְ֩ שֵׂעָ֨ר לָבָ֜ן בַּ/בַּהֶ֗רֶת וּ/מַרְאֶ֨/הָ֙ עָמֹ֣ק מִן הָ/ע֔וֹר צָרַ֣עַת הִ֔וא בַּ/מִּכְוָ֖ה פָּרָ֑חָה וְ/טִמֵּ֤א אֹת/וֹ֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן נֶ֥גַע צָרַ֖עַת הִֽוא
verses.translit: vr'h 'th hkhhn vhnh nhpkh sh'r lbn bbhrt vmr'h 'mq mn h'vr tsr't hv' bmkhvh prchh vtm' 'tv hkhhn ng' tsr't hv'
verses.translation: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and it be in sight deeper than the skin; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning: wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֣ם יִרְאֶ֣/נָּה הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה אֵֽין בַּ/בֶּהֶ֨רֶת֙ שֵׂעָ֣ר לָבָ֔ן וּ/שְׁפָלָ֥ה אֵינֶ֛/נָּה מִן הָ/ע֖וֹר וְ/הִ֣וא כֵהָ֑ה וְ/הִסְגִּיר֥/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: v'm yr'nh hkhhn vhnh 'yn bbhrt sh'r lbn vshplh 'ynnh mn h'vr vhv' khhh vhsgyrv hkhhn shb't ymym
verses.translation: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the other skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:

verses.original: וְ/רָאָ֥/הוּ הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֑י אִם פָּשֹׂ֤ה תִפְשֶׂה֙ בָּ/ע֔וֹר וְ/טִמֵּ֤א הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ אֹת֔/וֹ נֶ֥גַע צָרַ֖עַת הִֽוא
verses.translit: vr'hv hkhhn byvm hshby'y 'm pshh tpshh b'vr vtm' hkhhn 'tv ng' tsr't hv'
verses.translation: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: and if it be spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.

verses.original: וְ/אִם תַּחְתֶּי/הָ֩ תַעֲמֹ֨ד הַ/בַּהֶ֜רֶת לֹא פָשְׂתָ֤ה בָ/עוֹר֙ וְ/הִ֣וא כֵהָ֔ה שְׂאֵ֥ת הַ/מִּכְוָ֖ה הִ֑וא וְ/טִֽהֲר/וֹ֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן כִּֽי צָרֶ֥בֶת הַ/מִּכְוָ֖ה הִֽוא
verses.translit: v'm tchtyh t'md hbhrt l' pshth b'vr vhv' khhh sh't hmkhvh hv' vthrv hkhhn khy tsrbt hmkhvh hv'
verses.translation: And if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not in the skin, but it be somewhat dark; it is a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is an inflammation of the burning.

verses.original: וְ/אִישׁ֙ א֣וֹ אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּֽי יִהְיֶ֥ה ב֖/וֹ נָ֑גַע בְּ/רֹ֖אשׁ א֥וֹ בְ/זָקָֽן
verses.translit: v'ysh 'v 'shh khy yhyh bv ng' br'sh 'v bzqn
verses.translation: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;

verses.original: וְ/רָאָ֨ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת הַ/נֶּ֗גַע וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה מַרְאֵ֨/הוּ֙ עָמֹ֣ק מִן הָ/ע֔וֹר וּ/ב֛/וֹ שֵׂעָ֥ר צָהֹ֖ב דָּ֑ק וְ/טִמֵּ֨א אֹת֤/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ נֶ֣תֶק ה֔וּא צָרַ֧עַת הָ/רֹ֛אשׁ א֥וֹ הַ/זָּקָ֖ן הֽוּא
verses.translit: vr'h hkhhn 't hng' vhnh mr'hv 'mq mn h'vr vbv sh'r tshb dq vtm' 'tv hkhhn ntq hv' tsr't hr'sh 'v hzqn hv'
verses.translation: Then the priest shall see the plague: and, behold, if it be in sight deeper than the skin; and there be in it a yellow thin hair; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a dry scall, even a leprosy upon the head or beard.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יִרְאֶ֨ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת נֶ֣גַע הַ/נֶּ֗תֶק וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה אֵין מַרְאֵ֨/הוּ֙ עָמֹ֣ק מִן הָ/ע֔וֹר וְ/שֵׂעָ֥ר שָׁחֹ֖ר אֵ֣ין בּ֑/וֹ וְ/הִסְגִּ֧יר הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת נֶ֥גַע הַ/נֶּ֖תֶק שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vkhy yr'h hkhhn 't ng' hntq vhnh 'yn mr'hv 'mq mn h'vr vsh'r shchr 'yn bv vhsgyr hkhhn 't ng' hntq shb't ymym
verses.translation: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it be not in sight deeper than the skin, and that there is no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague of the scall seven days:

verses.original: וְ/רָאָ֨ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן אֶת הַ/נֶּגַע֮ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִי֒ וְ/הִנֵּה֙ לֹא פָשָׂ֣ה הַ/נֶּ֔תֶק וְ/לֹא הָ֥יָה ב֖/וֹ שֵׂעָ֣ר צָהֹ֑ב וּ/מַרְאֵ֣ה הַ/נֶּ֔תֶק אֵ֥ין עָמֹ֖ק מִן הָ/עֽוֹר
verses.translit: vr'h hkhhn 't hng' byvm hshby'y vhnh l' pshh hntq vl' hyh bv sh'r tshb vmr'h hntq 'yn 'mq mn h'vr
verses.translation: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague: and, behold, if the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin;

verses.original: וְ/הִ֨תְגַּלָּ֔ח וְ/אֶת הַ/נֶּ֖תֶק לֹ֣א יְגַלֵּ֑חַ וְ/הִסְגִּ֨יר הַ/כֹּהֵ֧ן אֶת הַ/נֶּ֛תֶק שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים שֵׁנִֽית
verses.translit: vhtglch v't hntq l' yglch vhsgyr hkhhn 't hntq shb't ymym shnyt
verses.translation: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more:

verses.original: וְ/רָאָה֩ הַ/כֹּהֵ֨ן אֶת הַ/נֶּ֜תֶק בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֗י וְ֠/הִנֵּה לֹא פָשָׂ֤ה הַ/נֶּ֨תֶק֙ בָּ/ע֔וֹר וּ/מַרְאֵ֕/הוּ אֵינֶ֥/נּוּ עָמֹ֖ק מִן הָ/ע֑וֹר וְ/טִהַ֤ר אֹת/וֹ֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/כִבֶּ֥ס בְּגָדָ֖י/ו וְ/טָהֵֽר
verses.translit: vr'h hkhhn 't hntq byvm hshby'y vhnh l' pshh hntq b'vr vmr'hv 'ynnv 'mq mn h'vr vthr 'tv hkhhn vkhbs bgdyv vthr
verses.translation: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, nor be in sight deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.

verses.original: וְ/אִם פָּשֹׂ֥ה יִפְשֶׂ֛ה הַ/נֶּ֖תֶק בָּ/ע֑וֹר אַחֲרֵ֖י טָהֳרָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'm pshh ypshh hntq b'vr 'chry thrtv
verses.translation: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;

verses.original: וְ/רָאָ֨/הוּ֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה פָּשָׂ֥ה הַ/נֶּ֖תֶק בָּ/ע֑וֹר לֹֽא יְבַקֵּ֧ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן לַ/שֵּׂעָ֥ר הַ/צָּהֹ֖ב טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא
verses.translit: vr'hv hkhhn vhnh pshh hntq b'vr l' ybqr hkhhn lsh'r htshb tm' hv'
verses.translation: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he is unclean.

verses.original: וְ/אִם בְּ/עֵינָי/ו֩ עָמַ֨ד הַ/נֶּ֜תֶק וְ/שֵׂעָ֨ר שָׁחֹ֧ר צָֽמַח בּ֛/וֹ נִרְפָּ֥א הַ/נֶּ֖תֶק טָה֣וֹר ה֑וּא וְ/טִהֲר֖/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: v'm b'ynyv 'md hntq vsh'r shchr tsmch bv nrp' hntq thvr hv' vthrv hkhhn
verses.translation: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay, and that there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.

verses.original: וְ/אִישׁ֙ אֽוֹ אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּֽי יִהְיֶ֥ה בְ/עוֹר בְּשָׂרָ֖/ם בֶּהָרֹ֑ת בֶּהָרֹ֖ת לְבָנֹֽת
verses.translit: v'ysh 'v 'shh khy yhyh b'vr bshrm bhrt bhrt lbnt
verses.translation: If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;

verses.original: וְ/רָאָ֣ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן וְ/הִנֵּ֧ה בְ/עוֹר בְּשָׂרָ֛/ם בֶּהָרֹ֖ת כֵּה֣וֹת לְבָנֹ֑ת בֹּ֥הַק ה֛וּא פָּרַ֥ח בָּ/ע֖וֹר טָה֥וֹר הֽוּא
verses.translit: vr'h hkhhn vhnh b'vr bshrm bhrt khhvt lbnt bhq hv' prch b'vr thvr hv'
verses.translation: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin; he is clean.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֕ישׁ כִּ֥י יִמָּרֵ֖ט רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ קֵרֵ֥חַ ה֖וּא טָה֥וֹר הֽוּא
verses.translit: v'ysh khy ymrt r'shv qrch hv' thvr hv'
verses.translation: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.

verses.original: וְ/אִם֙ מִ/פְּאַ֣ת פָּנָ֔י/ו יִמָּרֵ֖ט רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ גִּבֵּ֥חַ ה֖וּא טָה֥וֹר הֽוּא
verses.translit: v'm mp't pnyv ymrt r'shv gbch hv' thvr hv'
verses.translation: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he is forehead bald: yet is he clean.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יִהְיֶ֤ה בַ/קָּרַ֨חַת֙ א֣וֹ בַ/גַּבַּ֔חַת נֶ֖גַע לָבָ֣ן אֲדַמְדָּ֑ם צָרַ֤עַת פֹּרַ֨חַת֙ הִ֔וא בְּ/קָרַחְתּ֖/וֹ א֥וֹ בְ/גַבַּחְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vkhy yhyh bqrcht 'v bgbcht ng' lbn 'dmdm tsr't prcht hv' bqrchtv 'v bgbchtv
verses.translation: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.

verses.original: וְ/רָאָ֨ה אֹת֜/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה שְׂאֵת הַ/נֶּ֨גַע֙ לְבָנָ֣ה אֲדַמְדֶּ֔מֶת בְּ/קָרַחְתּ֖/וֹ א֣וֹ בְ/גַבַּחְתּ֑/וֹ כְּ/מַרְאֵ֥ה צָרַ֖עַת ע֥וֹר בָּשָֽׂר
verses.translit: vr'h 'tv hkhhn vhnh sh't hng' lbnh 'dmdmt bqrchtv 'v bgbchtv khmr'h tsr't 'vr bshr
verses.translation: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;

verses.original: אִישׁ צָר֥וּעַ ה֖וּא טָמֵ֣א ה֑וּא טַמֵּ֧א יְטַמְּאֶ֛/נּוּ הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן בְּ/רֹאשׁ֥/וֹ נִגְעֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'ysh tsrv' hv' tm' hv' tm' ytm'nv hkhhn br'shv ng'v
verses.translation: He is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague is in his head.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/צָּר֜וּעַ אֲשֶׁר בּ֣/וֹ הַ/נֶּ֗גַע בְּגָדָ֞י/ו יִהְי֤וּ פְרֻמִים֙ וְ/רֹאשׁ/וֹ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה פָר֔וּעַ וְ/עַל שָׂפָ֖ם יַעְטֶ֑ה וְ/טָמֵ֥א טָמֵ֖א יִקְרָֽא
verses.translit: vhtsrv' 'shr bv hng' bgdyv yhyv prmym vr'shv yhyh prv' v'l shpm y'th vtm' tm' yqr'
verses.translation: And the leper in whom the plague is , his clothes shall be rent, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.

verses.original: כָּל יְמֵ֞י אֲשֶׁ֨ר הַ/נֶּ֥גַע בּ֛/וֹ יִטְמָ֖א טָמֵ֣א ה֑וּא בָּדָ֣ד יֵשֵׁ֔ב מִ/ח֥וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה מוֹשָׁבֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khl ymy 'shr hng' bv ytm' tm' hv' bdd yshb mchvts lmchnh mvshbv
verses.translation: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled; he is unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his habitation be .

verses.original: וְ/הַ/בֶּ֕גֶד כִּֽי יִהְיֶ֥ה ב֖/וֹ נֶ֣גַע צָרָ֑עַת בְּ/בֶ֣גֶד צֶ֔מֶר א֖וֹ בְּ/בֶ֥גֶד פִּשְׁתִּֽים
verses.translit: vhbgd khy yhyh bv ng' tsr't bbgd tsmr 'v bbgd pshtym
verses.translation: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a woollen garment, or a linen garment;

verses.original: א֤וֹ בִֽ/שְׁתִי֙ א֣וֹ בְ/עֵ֔רֶב לַ/פִּשְׁתִּ֖ים וְ/לַ/צָּ֑מֶר א֣וֹ בְ/ע֔וֹר א֖וֹ בְּ/כָל מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֽוֹר
verses.translit: 'v bshty 'v b'rb lpshtym vltsmr 'v b'vr 'v bkhl ml'kht 'vr
verses.translation: Whether it be in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֨ה הַ/נֶּ֜גַע יְרַקְרַ֣ק א֣וֹ אֲדַמְדָּ֗ם בַּ/בֶּגֶד֩ א֨וֹ בָ/ע֜וֹר אֽוֹ בַ/שְּׁתִ֤י אוֹ בָ/עֵ֨רֶב֙ א֣וֹ בְ/כָל כְּלִי ע֔וֹר נֶ֥גַע צָרַ֖עַת ה֑וּא וְ/הָרְאָ֖ה אֶת הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: vhyh hng' yrqrq 'v 'dmdm bbgd 'v b'vr 'v bshty 'v b'rb 'v bkhl khly 'vr ng' tsr't hv' vhr'h 't hkhhn
verses.translation: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest:

verses.original: וְ/רָאָ֥ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת הַ/נָּ֑גַע וְ/הִסְגִּ֥יר אֶת הַ/נֶּ֖גַע שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vr'h hkhhn 't hng' vhsgyr 't hng' shb't ymym
verses.translation: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up it that hath the plague seven days:

verses.original: וְ/רָאָ֨ה אֶת הַ/נֶּ֜גַע בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֗י כִּֽי פָשָׂ֤ה הַ/נֶּ֨גַע֙ בַּ֠/בֶּגֶד אֽוֹ בַ/שְּׁתִ֤י אֽוֹ בָ/עֵ֨רֶב֙ א֣וֹ בָ/ע֔וֹר לְ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר יֵעָשֶׂ֥ה הָ/ע֖וֹר לִ/מְלָאכָ֑ה צָרַ֧עַת מַמְאֶ֛רֶת הַ/נֶּ֖גַע טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא
verses.translit: vr'h 't hng' byvm hshby'y khy pshh hng' bbgd 'v bshty 'v b'rb 'v b'vr lkhl 'shr y'shh h'vr lml'khh tsr't mm'rt hng' tm' hv'
verses.translation: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, or in any work that is made of skin; the plague is a fretting leprosy; it is unclean.

verses.original: וְ/שָׂרַ֨ף אֶת הַ/בֶּ֜גֶד א֥וֹ אֶֽת הַ/שְּׁתִ֣י א֣וֹ אֶת הָ/עֵ֗רֶב בַּ/צֶּ֨מֶר֙ א֣וֹ בַ/פִּשְׁתִּ֔ים א֚וֹ אֶת כָּל כְּלִ֣י הָ/ע֔וֹר אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶ֥ה ב֖/וֹ הַ/נָּ֑גַע כִּֽי צָרַ֤עַת מַמְאֶ֨רֶת֙ הִ֔וא בָּ/אֵ֖שׁ תִּשָּׂרֵֽף
verses.translit: vshrf 't hbgd 'v 't hshty 'v 't h'rb btsmr 'v bpshtym 'v 't khl khly h'vr 'shr yhyh bv hng' khy tsr't mm'rt hv' b'sh tshrf
verses.translation: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.

verses.original: וְ/אִם֮ יִרְאֶ֣ה הַ/כֹּהֵן֒ וְ/הִנֵּה֙ לֹא פָשָׂ֣ה הַ/נֶּ֔גַע בַּ/בֶּ֕גֶד א֥וֹ בַ/שְּׁתִ֖י א֣וֹ בָ/עֵ֑רֶב א֖וֹ בְּ/כָל כְּלִי עֽוֹר
verses.translit: v'm yr'h hkhhn vhnh l' pshh hng' bbgd 'v bshty 'v b'rb 'v bkhl khly 'vr
verses.translation: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;

verses.original: וְ/צִוָּה֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/כִ֨בְּס֔וּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר בּ֖/וֹ הַ/נָּ֑גַע וְ/הִסְגִּיר֥/וֹ שִׁבְעַת יָמִ֖ים שֵׁנִֽית
verses.translit: vtsvh hkhhn vkhbsv 't 'shr bv hng' vhsgyrv shb't ymym shnyt
verses.translation: Then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is , and he shall shut it up seven days more:

verses.original: וְ/רָאָ֨ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן אַחֲרֵ֣י הֻכַּבֵּ֣ס אֶת הַ/נֶּ֗גַע וְ֠/הִנֵּה לֹֽא הָפַ֨ךְ הַ/נֶּ֤גַע אֶת עֵינ/וֹ֙ וְ/הַ/נֶּ֣גַע לֹֽא פָשָׂ֔ה טָמֵ֣א ה֔וּא בָּ/אֵ֖שׁ תִּשְׂרְפֶ֑/נּוּ פְּחֶ֣תֶת הִ֔וא בְּ/קָרַחְתּ֖/וֹ א֥וֹ בְ/גַבַּחְתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vr'h hkhhn 'chry hkhbs 't hng' vhnh l' hpkh hng' 't 'ynv vhng' l' pshh tm' hv' b'sh tshrpnv pchtt hv' bqrchtv 'v bgbchtv
verses.translation: And the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed: and, behold, if the plague have not changed his colour, and the plague be not spread; it is unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it is fret inward, whether it be bare within or without.

verses.original: וְ/אִם֮ רָאָ֣ה הַ/כֹּהֵן֒ וְ/הִנֵּה֙ כֵּהָ֣ה הַ/נֶּ֔גַע אַחֲרֵ֖י הֻכַּבֵּ֣ס אֹת֑/וֹ וְ/קָרַ֣ע אֹת֗/וֹ מִן הַ/בֶּ֨גֶד֙ א֣וֹ מִן הָ/ע֔וֹר א֥וֹ מִן הַ/שְּׁתִ֖י א֥וֹ מִן הָ/עֵֽרֶב
verses.translit: v'm r'h hkhhn vhnh khhh hng' 'chry hkhbs 'tv vqr' 'tv mn hbgd 'v mn h'vr 'v mn hshty 'v mn h'rb
verses.translation: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:

verses.original: וְ/אִם תֵּרָאֶ֨ה ע֜וֹד בַּ֠/בֶּגֶד אֽוֹ בַ/שְּׁתִ֤י אֽוֹ בָ/עֵ֨רֶב֙ א֣וֹ בְ/כָל כְּלִי ע֔וֹר פֹּרַ֖חַת הִ֑וא בָּ/אֵ֣שׁ תִּשְׂרְפֶ֔/נּוּ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר בּ֖/וֹ הַ/נָּֽגַע
verses.translit: v'm tr'h 'vd bbgd 'v bshty 'v b'rb 'v bkhl khly 'vr prcht hv' b'sh tshrpnv 't 'shr bv hng'
verses.translation: And if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a spreading plague: thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/בֶּ֡גֶד אֽוֹ הַ/שְּׁתִ֨י אוֹ הָ/עֵ֜רֶב אֽוֹ כָל כְּלִ֤י הָ/עוֹר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תְּכַבֵּ֔ס וְ/סָ֥ר מֵ/הֶ֖ם הַ/נָּ֑גַע וְ/כֻבַּ֥ס שֵׁנִ֖ית וְ/טָהֵֽר
verses.translit: vhbgd 'v hshty 'v h'rb 'v khl khly h'vr 'shr tkhbs vsr mhm hng' vkhbs shnyt vthr
verses.translation: And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing of skin it be , which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.

verses.original: זֹ֠את תּוֹרַ֨ת נֶֽגַע צָרַ֜עַת בֶּ֥גֶד הַ/צֶּ֣מֶר א֣וֹ הַ/פִּשְׁתִּ֗ים א֤וֹ הַ/שְּׁתִי֙ א֣וֹ הָ/עֵ֔רֶב א֖וֹ כָּל כְּלִי ע֑וֹר לְ/טַהֲר֖/וֹ א֥וֹ לְ/טַמְּאֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: z't tvrt ng' tsr't bgd htsmr 'v hpshtym 'v hshty 'v h'rb 'v khl khly 'vr lthrv 'v ltm'v
verses.translation: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: זֹ֤את תִּֽהְיֶה֙ תּוֹרַ֣ת הַ/מְּצֹרָ֔ע בְּ/י֖וֹם טָהֳרָת֑/וֹ וְ/הוּבָ֖א אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: z't thyh tvrt hmtsr' byvm thrtv vhvb' 'l hkhhn
verses.translation: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:

verses.original: וְ/יָצָא֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל מִ/ח֖וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְ/רָאָה֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה נִרְפָּ֥א נֶֽגַע הַ/צָּרַ֖עַת מִן הַ/צָּרֽוּעַ
verses.translit: vyts' hkhhn 'l mchvts lmchnh vr'h hkhhn vhnh nrp' ng' htsr't mn htsrv'
verses.translation: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;

verses.original: וְ/צִוָּה֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/לָקַ֧ח לַ/מִּטַּהֵ֛ר שְׁתֵּֽי צִפֳּרִ֥ים חַיּ֖וֹת טְהֹר֑וֹת וְ/עֵ֣ץ אֶ֔רֶז וּ/שְׁנִ֥י תוֹלַ֖עַת וְ/אֵזֹֽב
verses.translit: vtsvh hkhhn vlqch lmthr shty tsprym chyvt thrvt v'ts 'rz vshny tvl't v'zb
verses.translation: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

verses.original: וְ/צִוָּה֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/שָׁחַ֖ט אֶת הַ/צִּפּ֣וֹר הָ/אֶחָ֑ת אֶל כְּלִי חֶ֖רֶשׂ עַל מַ֥יִם חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: vtsvh hkhhn vshcht 't htspvr h'cht 'l khly chrsh 'l mym chyym
verses.translation: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:

verses.original: אֶת הַ/צִּפֹּ֤ר הַֽ/חַיָּה֙ יִקַּ֣ח אֹתָ֔/הּ וְ/אֶת עֵ֥ץ הָ/אֶ֛רֶז וְ/אֶת שְׁנִ֥י הַ/תּוֹלַ֖עַת וְ/אֶת הָ/אֵזֹ֑ב וְ/טָבַ֨ל אוֹתָ֜/ם וְ/אֵ֣ת הַ/צִּפֹּ֣ר הַֽ/חַיָּ֗ה בְּ/דַם֙ הַ/צִּפֹּ֣ר הַ/שְּׁחֻטָ֔ה עַ֖ל הַ/מַּ֥יִם הַֽ/חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: 't htspr hchyh yqch 'th v't 'ts h'rz v't shny htvl't v't h'zb vtbl 'vtm v't htspr hchyh bdm htspr hshchth 'l hmym hchyym
verses.translation: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:

verses.original: וְ/הִזָּ֗ה עַ֧ל הַ/מִּטַּהֵ֛ר מִן הַ/צָּרַ֖עַת שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְ/טִ֣הֲר֔/וֹ וְ/שִׁלַּ֛ח אֶת הַ/צִּפֹּ֥ר הַֽ/חַיָּ֖ה עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: vhzh 'l hmthr mn htsr't shb' p'mym vthrv vshlch 't htspr hchyh 'l pny hshdh
verses.translation: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.

verses.original: וְ/כִבֶּס֩ הַ/מִּטַּהֵ֨ר אֶת בְּגָדָ֜י/ו וְ/גִלַּ֣ח אֶת כָּל שְׂעָר֗/וֹ וְ/רָחַ֤ץ בַּ/מַּ֨יִם֙ וְ/טָהֵ֔ר וְ/אַחַ֖ר יָב֣וֹא אֶל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְ/יָשַׁ֛ב מִ/ח֥וּץ לְ/אָהֳל֖/וֹ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vkhbs hmthr 't bgdyv vglch 't khl sh'rv vrchts bmym vthr v'chr ybv' 'l hmchnh vyshb mchvts l'hlv shb't ymym
verses.translation: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֩ בַ/יּ֨וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֜י יְגַלַּ֣ח אֶת כָּל שְׂעָר֗/וֹ אֶת רֹאשׁ֤/וֹ וְ/אֶת זְקָנ/וֹ֙ וְ/אֵת֙ גַּבֹּ֣ת עֵינָ֔י/ו וְ/אֶת כָּל שְׂעָר֖/וֹ יְגַלֵּ֑חַ וְ/כִבֶּ֣ס אֶת בְּגָדָ֗י/ו וְ/רָחַ֧ץ אֶת בְּשָׂר֛/וֹ בַּ/מַּ֖יִם וְ/טָהֵֽר
verses.translit: vhyh byvm hshby'y yglch 't khl sh'rv 't r'shv v't zqnv v't gbt 'ynyv v't khl sh'rv yglch vkhbs 't bgdyv vrchts 't bshrv bmym vthr
verses.translation: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֗י יִקַּ֤ח שְׁנֵֽי כְבָשִׂים֙ תְּמִימִ֔ים וְ/כַבְשָׂ֥ה אַחַ֛ת בַּת שְׁנָתָ֖/הּ תְּמִימָ֑ה וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶן וְ/לֹ֥ג אֶחָ֖ד שָֽׁמֶן
verses.translit: vbyvm hshmyny yqch shny khbshym tmymym vkhbshh 'cht bt shnth tmymh vshlshh 'shrnym slt mnchh blvlh bshmn vlg 'chd shmn
verses.translation: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.

verses.original: וְ/הֶעֱמִ֞יד הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן הַֽ/מְטַהֵ֗ר אֵ֛ת הָ/אִ֥ישׁ הַ/מִּטַּהֵ֖ר וְ/אֹתָ֑/ם לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vh'myd hkhhn hmthr 't h'ysh hmthr v'tm lpny yhvh ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And the priest that maketh him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the LORD , at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֨ח הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת הַ/כֶּ֣בֶשׂ הָ/אֶחָ֗ד וְ/הִקְרִ֥יב אֹת֛/וֹ לְ/אָשָׁ֖ם וְ/אֶת לֹ֣ג הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶן וְ/הֵנִ֥יף אֹתָ֛/ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn 't hkhbsh h'chd vhqryb 'tv l'shm v't lg hshmn vhnyf 'tm tnvph lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the LORD :

verses.original: וְ/שָׁחַ֣ט אֶת הַ/כֶּ֗בֶשׂ בִּ֠/מְקוֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁחַ֧ט אֶת הַֽ/חַטָּ֛את וְ/אֶת הָ/עֹלָ֖ה בִּ/מְק֣וֹם הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ כִּ֡י כַּ֠/חַטָּאת הָ/אָשָׁ֥ם הוּא֙ לַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים הֽוּא
verses.translit: vshcht 't hkhbsh bmqvm 'shr yshcht 't hcht't v't h'lh bmqvm hqdsh khy khcht't h'shm hv' lkhhn qdsh qdshym hv'
verses.translation: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering is the priest’s, so is the trespass offering: it is most holy:

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֣ח הַ/כֹּהֵן֮ מִ/דַּ֣ם הָ/אָשָׁם֒ וְ/נָתַן֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן עַל תְּנ֛וּךְ אֹ֥זֶן הַ/מִּטַּהֵ֖ר הַ/יְמָנִ֑ית וְ/עַל בֹּ֤הֶן יָד/וֹ֙ הַ/יְמָנִ֔ית וְ/עַל בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖/וֹ הַ/יְמָנִֽית
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn mdm h'shm vntn hkhhn 'l tnvkh 'zn hmthr hymnyt v'l bhn ydv hymnyt v'l bhn rglv hymnyt
verses.translation: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֥ח הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן מִ/לֹּ֣ג הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶן וְ/יָצַ֛ק עַל כַּ֥ף הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן הַ/שְּׂמָאלִֽית
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn mlg hshmn vytsq 'l khf hkhhn hshm'lyt
verses.translation: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand:

verses.original: וְ/טָבַ֤ל הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ אֶת אֶצְבָּע֣/וֹ הַ/יְמָנִ֔ית מִן הַ/שֶּׁ֕מֶן אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל כַּפּ֖/וֹ הַ/שְּׂמָאלִ֑ית וְ/הִזָּ֨ה מִן הַ/שֶּׁ֧מֶן בְּ/אֶצְבָּע֛/וֹ שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִ֖ים לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vtbl hkhhn 't 'tsb'v hymnyt mn hshmn 'shr 'l khpv hshm'lyt vhzh mn hshmn b'tsb'v shb' p'mym lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the LORD :

verses.original: וּ/מִ/יֶּ֨תֶר הַ/שֶּׁ֜מֶן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל כַּפּ֗/וֹ יִתֵּ֤ן הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ עַל תְּנ֞וּךְ אֹ֤זֶן הַ/מִּטַּהֵר֙ הַ/יְמָנִ֔ית וְ/עַל בֹּ֤הֶן יָד/וֹ֙ הַ/יְמָנִ֔ית וְ/עַל בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖/וֹ הַ/יְמָנִ֑ית עַ֖ל דַּ֥ם הָ/אָשָֽׁם
verses.translit: vmytr hshmn 'shr 'l khpv ytn hkhhn 'l tnvkh 'zn hmthr hymnyt v'l bhn ydv hymnyt v'l bhn rglv hymnyt 'l dm h'shm
verses.translation: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נּוֹתָ֗ר בַּ/שֶּׁ֨מֶן֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל כַּ֣ף הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן יִתֵּ֖ן עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/מִּטַּהֵ֑ר וְ/כִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛י/ו הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhnvtr bshmn 'shr 'l khf hkhhn ytn 'l r'sh hmthr vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/עָשָׂ֤ה הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ אֶת הַ֣/חַטָּ֔את וְ/כִפֶּ֕ר עַל הַ/מִּטַּהֵ֖ר מִ/טֻּמְאָת֑/וֹ וְ/אַחַ֖ר יִשְׁחַ֥ט אֶת הָ/עֹלָֽה
verses.translit: v'shh hkhhn 't hcht't vkhpr 'l hmthr mtm'tv v'chr yshcht 't h'lh
verses.translation: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:

verses.original: וְ/הֶעֱלָ֧ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת הָ/עֹלָ֥ה וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָ֖ה הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חָ/ה וְ/כִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛י/ו הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן וְ/טָהֵֽר
verses.translit: vh'lh hkhhn 't h'lh v't hmnchh hmzbchh vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn vthr
verses.translation: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.

verses.original: וְ/אִם דַּ֣ל ה֗וּא וְ/אֵ֣ין יָד/וֹ֮ מַשֶּׂגֶת֒ וְ֠/לָקַח כֶּ֣בֶשׂ אֶחָ֥ד אָשָׁ֛ם לִ/תְנוּפָ֖ה לְ/כַפֵּ֣ר עָלָ֑י/ו וְ/עִשָּׂר֨וֹן סֹ֜לֶת אֶחָ֨ד בָּל֥וּל בַּ/שֶּׁ֛מֶן לְ/מִנְחָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥ג שָֽׁמֶן
verses.translit: v'm dl hv' v'yn ydv mshgt vlqch khbsh 'chd 'shm ltnvph lkhpr 'lyv v'shrvn slt 'chd blvl bshmn lmnchh vlg shmn
verses.translation: And if he be poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil;

verses.original: וּ/שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֗ים א֤וֹ שְׁנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּשִּׂ֖יג יָד֑/וֹ וְ/הָיָ֤ה אֶחָד֙ חַטָּ֔את וְ/הָ/אֶחָ֖ד עֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vshty trym 'v shny bny yvnh 'shr tshyg ydv vhyh 'chd cht't vh'chd 'lh
verses.translation: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.

verses.original: וְ/הֵבִ֨יא אֹתָ֜/ם בַּ/יּ֧וֹם הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֛י לְ/טָהֳרָת֖/וֹ אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן אֶל פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhby' 'tm byvm hshmyny lthrtv 'l hkhhn 'l ptch 'hl mv'd lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֧ח הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת כֶּ֥בֶשׂ הָ/אָשָׁ֖ם וְ/אֶת לֹ֣ג הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶן וְ/הֵנִ֨יף אֹתָ֧/ם הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn 't khbsh h'shm v't lg hshmn vhnyf 'tm hkhhn tnvph lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD :

verses.original: וְ/שָׁחַט֮ אֶת כֶּ֣בֶשׂ הָֽ/אָשָׁם֒ וְ/לָקַ֤ח הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ מִ/דַּ֣ם הָֽ/אָשָׁ֔ם וְ/נָתַ֛ן עַל תְּנ֥וּךְ אֹֽזֶן הַ/מִּטַּהֵ֖ר הַ/יְמָנִ֑ית וְ/עַל בֹּ֤הֶן יָד/וֹ֙ הַ/יְמָנִ֔ית וְ/עַל בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖/וֹ הַ/יְמָנִֽית
verses.translit: vshcht 't khbsh h'shm vlqch hkhhn mdm h'shm vntn 'l tnvkh 'zn hmthr hymnyt v'l bhn ydv hymnyt v'l bhn rglv hymnyt
verses.translation: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:

verses.original: וּ/מִן הַ/שֶּׁ֖מֶן יִצֹ֣ק הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן עַל כַּ֥ף הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן הַ/שְּׂמָאלִֽית
verses.translit: vmn hshmn ytsq hkhhn 'l khf hkhhn hshm'lyt
verses.translation: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand:

verses.original: וְ/הִזָּ֤ה הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ בְּ/אֶצְבָּע֣/וֹ הַ/יְמָנִ֔ית מִן הַ/שֶּׁ֕מֶן אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל כַּפּ֖/וֹ הַ/שְּׂמָאלִ֑ית שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִ֖ים לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhzh hkhhn b'tsb'v hymnyt mn hshmn 'shr 'l khpv hshm'lyt shb' p'mym lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the LORD :

verses.original: וְ/נָתַ֨ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן מִן הַ/שֶּׁ֣מֶן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל כַּפּ֗/וֹ עַל תְּנ֞וּךְ אֹ֤זֶן הַ/מִּטַּהֵר֙ הַ/יְמָנִ֔ית וְ/עַל בֹּ֤הֶן יָד/וֹ֙ הַ/יְמָנִ֔ית וְ/עַל בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖/וֹ הַ/יְמָנִ֑ית עַל מְק֖וֹם דַּ֥ם הָ/אָשָֽׁם
verses.translit: vntn hkhhn mn hshmn 'shr 'l khpv 'l tnvkh 'zn hmthr hymnyt v'l bhn ydv hymnyt v'l bhn rglv hymnyt 'l mqvm dm h'shm
verses.translation: And the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering:

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נּוֹתָ֗ר מִן הַ/שֶּׁ֨מֶן֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל כַּ֣ף הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן יִתֵּ֖ן עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/מִּטַּהֵ֑ר לְ/כַפֵּ֥ר עָלָ֖י/ו לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhnvtr mn hshmn 'shr 'l khf hkhhn ytn 'l r'sh hmthr lkhpr 'lyv lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest’s hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for him before the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/עָשָׂ֤ה אֶת הָֽ/אֶחָד֙ מִן הַ/תֹּרִ֔ים א֖וֹ מִן בְּנֵ֣י הַ/יּוֹנָ֑ה מֵ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּשִּׂ֖יג יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'shh 't h'chd mn htrym 'v mn bny hyvnh m'shr tshyg ydv
verses.translation: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;

verses.original: אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר תַּשִּׂ֞יג יָד֗/וֹ אֶת הָ/אֶחָ֥ד חַטָּ֛את וְ/אֶת הָ/אֶחָ֥ד עֹלָ֖ה עַל הַ/מִּנְחָ֑ה וְ/כִפֶּ֧ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן עַ֥ל הַ/מִּטַּהֵ֖ר לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 't 'shr tshyg ydv 't h'chd cht't v't h'chd 'lh 'l hmnchh vkhpr hkhhn 'l hmthr lpny yhvh
verses.translation: Even such as he is able to get, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the LORD .

verses.original: זֹ֣את תּוֹרַ֔ת אֲשֶׁר בּ֖/וֹ נֶ֣גַע צָרָ֑עַת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא תַשִּׂ֥יג יָד֖/וֹ בְּ/טָהֳרָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: z't tvrt 'shr bv ng' tsr't 'shr l' tshyg ydv bthrtv
verses.translation: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְ/אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh v'l 'hrn l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

verses.original: כִּ֤י תָבֹ֨אוּ֙ אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לָ/כֶ֖ם לַ/אֲחֻזָּ֑ה וְ/נָתַתִּי֙ נֶ֣גַע צָרַ֔עַת בְּ/בֵ֖ית אֶ֥רֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khy tb'v 'l 'rts khn'n 'shr 'ny ntn lkhm l'chzh vntty ng' tsr't bbyt 'rts 'chztkhm
verses.translation: When ye be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;

verses.original: וּ/בָא֙ אֲשֶׁר ל֣/וֹ הַ/בַּ֔יִת וְ/הִגִּ֥יד לַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כְּ/נֶ֕גַע נִרְאָ֥ה לִ֖/י בַּ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vb' 'shr lv hbyt vhgyd lkhhn l'mr khng' nr'h ly bbyt
verses.translation: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house:

verses.original: וְ/צִוָּ֨ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן וּ/פִנּ֣וּ אֶת הַ/בַּ֗יִת בְּ/טֶ֨רֶם יָבֹ֤א הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ לִ/רְא֣וֹת אֶת הַ/נֶּ֔גַע וְ/לֹ֥א יִטְמָ֖א כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/בָּ֑יִת וְ/אַ֥חַר כֵּ֛ן יָבֹ֥א הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן לִ/רְא֥וֹת אֶת הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vtsvh hkhhn vpnv 't hbyt btrm yb' hkhhn lr'vt 't hng' vl' ytm' khl 'shr bbyt v'chr khn yb' hkhhn lr'vt 't hbyt
verses.translation: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go into it to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:

verses.original: וְ/רָאָ֣ה אֶת הַ/נֶּ֗גַע וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה הַ/נֶּ֨גַע֙ בְּ/קִירֹ֣ת הַ/בַּ֔יִת שְׁקַֽעֲרוּרֹת֙ יְרַקְרַקֹּ֔ת א֖וֹ אֲדַמְדַּמֹּ֑ת וּ/מַרְאֵי/הֶ֥ן שָׁפָ֖ל מִן הַ/קִּֽיר
verses.translit: vr'h 't hng' vhnh hng' bqyrt hbyt shq'rvrt yrqrqt 'v 'dmdmt vmr'yhn shpl mn hqyr
verses.translation: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight are lower than the wall;

verses.original: וְ/יָצָ֧א הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן מִן הַ/בַּ֖יִת אֶל פֶּ֣תַח הַ/בָּ֑יִת וְ/הִסְגִּ֥יר אֶת הַ/בַּ֖יִת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vyts' hkhhn mn hbyt 'l ptch hbyt vhsgyr 't hbyt shb't ymym
verses.translation: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:

verses.original: וְ/שָׁ֥ב הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֑י וְ/רָאָ֕ה וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה פָּשָׂ֥ה הַ/נֶּ֖גַע בְּ/קִירֹ֥ת הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vshb hkhhn byvm hshby'y vr'h vhnh pshh hng' bqyrt hbyt
verses.translation: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold, if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;

verses.original: וְ/צִוָּה֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/חִלְּצוּ֙ אֶת הָ֣/אֲבָנִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּ/הֵ֖ן הַ/נָּ֑גַע וְ/הִשְׁלִ֤יכוּ אֶתְ/הֶן֙ אֶל מִ/ח֣וּץ לָ/עִ֔יר אֶל מָק֖וֹם טָמֵֽא
verses.translit: vtsvh hkhhn vchltsv 't h'bnym 'shr bhn hng' vhshlykhv 'thn 'l mchvts l'yr 'l mqvm tm'
verses.translation: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is , and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city:

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ/בַּ֛יִת יַקְצִ֥עַ מִ/בַּ֖יִת סָבִ֑יב וְ/שָׁפְכ֗וּ אֶת הֶֽ/עָפָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְצ֔וּ אֶל מִ/ח֣וּץ לָ/עִ֔יר אֶל מָק֖וֹם טָמֵֽא
verses.translit: v't hbyt yqts' mbyt sbyb vshpkhv 't h'pr 'shr hqtsv 'l mchvts l'yr 'l mqvm tm'
verses.translation: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:

verses.original: וְ/לָקְחוּ֙ אֲבָנִ֣ים אֲחֵר֔וֹת וְ/הֵבִ֖יאוּ אֶל תַּ֣חַת הָ/אֲבָנִ֑ים וְ/עָפָ֥ר אַחֵ֛ר יִקַּ֖ח וְ/טָ֥ח אֶת הַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vlqchv 'bnym 'chrvt vhby'v 'l tcht h'bnym v'pr 'chr yqch vtch 't hbyt
verses.translation: And they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other morter, and shall plaister the house.

verses.original: וְ/אִם יָשׁ֤וּב הַ/נֶּ֨גַע֙ וּ/פָרַ֣ח בַּ/בַּ֔יִת אַחַ֖ר חִלֵּ֣ץ אֶת הָ/אֲבָנִ֑ים וְ/אַחֲרֵ֛י הִקְצ֥וֹת אֶת הַ/בַּ֖יִת וְ/אַחֲרֵ֥י הִטּֽוֹחַ
verses.translit: v'm yshvb hng' vprch bbyt 'chr chlts 't h'bnym v'chry hqtsvt 't hbyt v'chry htvch
verses.translation: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plaistered;

verses.original: וּ/בָא֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/רָאָ֕ה וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה פָּשָׂ֥ה הַ/נֶּ֖גַע בַּ/בָּ֑יִת צָרַ֨עַת מַמְאֶ֥רֶת הִ֛וא בַּ/בַּ֖יִת טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא
verses.translit: vb' hkhhn vr'h vhnh pshh hng' bbyt tsr't mm'rt hv' bbyt tm' hv'
verses.translation: Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold, if the plague be spread in the house, it is a fretting leprosy in the house: it is unclean.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַ֣ץ אֶת הַ/בַּ֗יִת אֶת אֲבָנָי/ו֙ וְ/אֶת עֵצָ֔י/ו וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל עֲפַ֣ר הַ/בָּ֑יִת וְ/הוֹצִיא֙ אֶל מִ/ח֣וּץ לָ/עִ֔יר אֶל מָק֖וֹם טָמֵֽא
verses.translit: vntts 't hbyt 't 'bnyv v't 'tsyv v't khl 'pr hbyt vhvtsy' 'l mchvts l'yr 'l mqvm tm'
verses.translation: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the morter of the house; and he shall carry them forth out of the city into an unclean place.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/בָּא֙ אֶל הַ/בַּ֔יִת כָּל יְמֵ֖י הִסְגִּ֣יר אֹת֑/וֹ יִטְמָ֖א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vhb' 'l hbyt khl ymy hsgyr 'tv ytm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/שֹּׁכֵ֣ב בַּ/בַּ֔יִת יְכַבֵּ֖ס אֶת בְּגָדָ֑י/ו וְ/הָ/אֹכֵ֣ל בַּ/בַּ֔יִת יְכַבֵּ֖ס אֶת בְּגָדָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vhshkhb bbyt ykhbs 't bgdyv vh'khl bbyt ykhbs 't bgdyv
verses.translation: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.

verses.original: וְ/אִם בֹּ֨א יָבֹ֜א הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן וְ/רָאָה֙ וְ֠/הִנֵּה לֹא פָשָׂ֤ה הַ/נֶּ֨גַע֙ בַּ/בַּ֔יִת אַחֲרֵ֖י הִטֹּ֣חַ אֶת הַ/בָּ֑יִת וְ/טִהַ֤ר הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ אֶת הַ/בַּ֔יִת כִּ֥י נִרְפָּ֖א הַ/נָּֽגַע
verses.translit: v'm b' yb' hkhhn vr'h vhnh l' pshh hng' bbyt 'chry htch 't hbyt vthr hkhhn 't hbyt khy nrp' hng'
verses.translation: And if the priest shall come in, and look upon it , and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plaistered: then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֛ח לְ/חַטֵּ֥א אֶת הַ/בַּ֖יִת שְׁתֵּ֣י צִפֳּרִ֑ים וְ/עֵ֣ץ אֶ֔רֶז וּ/שְׁנִ֥י תוֹלַ֖עַת וְ/אֵזֹֽב
verses.translit: vlqch lcht' 't hbyt shty tsprym v'ts 'rz vshny tvl't v'zb
verses.translation: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:

verses.original: וְ/שָׁחַ֖ט אֶת הַ/צִּפֹּ֣ר הָ/אֶחָ֑ת אֶל כְּלִי חֶ֖רֶשׂ עַל מַ֥יִם חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: vshcht 't htspr h'cht 'l khly chrsh 'l mym chyym
verses.translation: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֣ח אֶת עֵֽץ הָ֠/אֶרֶז וְ/אֶת הָ֨/אֵזֹ֜ב וְ/אֵ֣ת שְׁנִ֣י הַ/תּוֹלַ֗עַת וְ/אֵת֮ הַ/צִּפֹּ֣ר הַֽ/חַיָּה֒ וְ/טָבַ֣ל אֹתָ֗/ם בְּ/דַם֙ הַ/צִּפֹּ֣ר הַ/שְּׁחוּטָ֔ה וּ/בַ/מַּ֖יִם הַֽ/חַיִּ֑ים וְ/הִזָּ֥ה אֶל הַ/בַּ֖יִת שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִֽים
verses.translit: vlqch 't 'ts h'rz v't h'zb v't shny htvl't v't htspr hchyh vtbl 'tm bdm htspr hshchvth vbmym hchyym vhzh 'l hbyt shb' p'mym
verses.translation: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:

verses.original: וְ/חִטֵּ֣א אֶת הַ/בַּ֔יִת בְּ/דַם֙ הַ/צִּפּ֔וֹר וּ/בַ/מַּ֖יִם הַֽ/חַיִּ֑ים וּ/בַ/צִּפֹּ֣ר הַ/חַיָּ֗ה וּ/בְ/עֵ֥ץ הָ/אֶ֛רֶז וּ/בָ/אֵזֹ֖ב וּ/בִ/שְׁנִ֥י הַ/תּוֹלָֽעַת
verses.translit: vcht' 't hbyt bdm htspvr vbmym hchyym vbtspr hchyh vb'ts h'rz vb'zb vbshny htvl't
verses.translation: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:

verses.original: וְ/שִׁלַּ֞ח אֶת הַ/צִּפֹּ֧ר הַֽ/חַיָּ֛ה אֶל מִ/ח֥וּץ לָ/עִ֖יר אֶל פְּנֵ֣י הַ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה וְ/כִפֶּ֥ר עַל הַ/בַּ֖יִת וְ/טָהֵֽר
verses.translit: vshlch 't htspr hchyh 'l mchvts l'yr 'l pny hshdh vkhpr 'l hbyt vthr
verses.translation: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.

verses.original: זֹ֖את הַ/תּוֹרָ֑ה לְ/כָל נֶ֥גַע הַ/צָּרַ֖עַת וְ/לַ/נָּֽתֶק
verses.translit: z't htvrh lkhl ng' htsr't vlntq
verses.translation: This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,

verses.original: וּ/לְ/צָרַ֥עַת הַ/בֶּ֖גֶד וְ/לַ/בָּֽיִת
verses.translit: vltsr't hbgd vlbyt
verses.translation: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,

verses.translit: vlsh't vlspcht vlbhrt
verses.translation: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:

verses.original: לְ/הוֹרֹ֕ת בְּ/י֥וֹם הַ/טָּמֵ֖א וּ/בְ/י֣וֹם הַ/טָּהֹ֑ר זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַ/צָּרָֽעַת
verses.translit: lhvrt byvm htm' vbyvm hthr z't tvrt htsr't
verses.translation: To teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean: this is the law of leprosy.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְ/אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh v'l 'hrn l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,

verses.original: דַּבְּרוּ֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם אִ֣ישׁ אִ֗ישׁ כִּ֤י יִהְיֶה֙ זָ֣ב מִ/בְּשָׂר֔/וֹ זוֹב֖/וֹ טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא
verses.translit: dbrv 'l bny yshr'l v'mrtm 'lhm 'ysh 'ysh khy yhyh zb mbshrv zvbv tm' hv'
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.

verses.original: וְ/זֹ֛את תִּהְיֶ֥ה טֻמְאָת֖/וֹ בְּ/זוֹב֑/וֹ רָ֣ר בְּשָׂר֞/וֹ אֶת זוֹב֗/וֹ אֽוֹ הֶחְתִּ֤ים בְּשָׂר/וֹ֙ מִ/זּוֹב֔/וֹ טֻמְאָת֖/וֹ הִֽוא
verses.translit: vz't thyh tm'tv bzvbv rr bshrv 't zvbv 'v hchtym bshrv mzvbv tm'tv hv'
verses.translation: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.

verses.original: כָּל הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛י/ו הַ/זָּ֖ב יִטְמָ֑א וְ/כָֽל הַ/כְּלִ֛י אֲשֶׁר יֵשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖י/ו יִטְמָֽא
verses.translit: khl hmshkhb 'shr yshkhb 'lyv hzb ytm' vkhl hkhly 'shr yshb 'lyv ytm'
verses.translation: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִגַּ֖ע בְּ/מִשְׁכָּב֑/וֹ יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛י/ו וְ/רָחַ֥ץ בַּ/מַּ֖יִם וְ/טָמֵ֥א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr yg' bmshkhbv ykhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vtm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/יֹּשֵׁב֙ עַֽל הַ/כְּלִ֔י אֲשֶׁר יֵשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖י/ו הַ/זָּ֑ב יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛י/ו וְ/רָחַ֥ץ בַּ/מַּ֖יִם וְ/טָמֵ֥א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vhyshb 'l hkhly 'shr yshb 'lyv hzb ykhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vtm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And he that sitteth on any thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נֹּגֵ֖עַ בִּ/בְשַׂ֣ר הַ/זָּ֑ב יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛י/ו וְ/רָחַ֥ץ בַּ/מַּ֖יִם וְ/טָמֵ֥א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vhng' bbshr hzb ykhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vtm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יָרֹ֛ק הַ/זָּ֖ב בַּ/טָּה֑וֹר וְ/כִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛י/ו וְ/רָחַ֥ץ בַּ/מַּ֖יִם וְ/טָמֵ֥א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vkhy yrq hzb bthvr vkhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vtm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הַ/מֶּרְכָּ֗ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛י/ו הַ/זָּ֖ב יִטְמָֽא
verses.translit: vkhl hmrkhb 'shr yrkhb 'lyv hzb ytm'
verses.translation: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הַ/נֹּגֵ֗עַ בְּ/כֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִהְיֶ֣ה תַחְתָּ֔י/ו יִטְמָ֖א עַד הָ/עָ֑רֶב וְ/הַ/נּוֹשֵׂ֣א אוֹתָ֔/ם יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛י/ו וְ/רָחַ֥ץ בַּ/מַּ֖יִם וְ/טָמֵ֥א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vkhl hng' bkhl 'shr yhyh tchtyv ytm' 'd h'rb vhnvsh' 'vtm ykhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vtm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth any of those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וְ/כֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִגַּע בּ/וֹ֙ הַ/זָּ֔ב וְ/יָדָ֖י/ו לֹא שָׁטַ֣ף בַּ/מָּ֑יִם וְ/כִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛י/ו וְ/רָחַ֥ץ בַּ/מַּ֖יִם וְ/טָמֵ֥א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vkhl 'shr yg' bv hzb vydyv l' shtf bmym vkhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vtm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וּ/כְלִי חֶ֛רֶשׂ אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בּ֥/וֹ הַ/זָּ֖ב יִשָּׁבֵ֑ר וְ/כָל כְּלִי עֵ֔ץ יִשָּׁטֵ֖ף בַּ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: vkhly chrsh 'shr yg' bv hzb yshbr vkhl khly 'ts yshtf bmym
verses.translation: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יִטְהַ֤ר הַ/זָּב֙ מִ/זּוֹב֔/וֹ וְ/סָ֨פַר ל֜/וֹ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֛ים לְ/טָהֳרָת֖/וֹ וְ/כִבֶּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֑י/ו וְ/רָחַ֧ץ בְּשָׂר֛/וֹ בְּ/מַ֥יִם חַיִּ֖ים וְ/טָהֵֽר
verses.translit: vkhy ythr hzb mzvbv vspr lv shb't ymym lthrtv vkhbs bgdyv vrchts bshrv bmym chyym vthr
verses.translation: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֗י יִֽקַּֽח ל/וֹ֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה וּ/בָ֣א לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֶל פֶּ֨תַח֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וּ/נְתָנָ֖/ם אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: vbyvm hshmyny yqch lv shty trym 'v shny bny yvnh vb' lpny yhvh 'l ptch 'hl mv'd vntnm 'l hkhhn
verses.translation: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the LORD unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:

verses.original: וְ/עָשָׂ֤ה אֹתָ/ם֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן אֶחָ֣ד חַטָּ֔את וְ/הָ/אֶחָ֖ד עֹלָ֑ה וְ/כִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧י/ו הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מִ/זּוֹבֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'shh 'tm hkhhn 'chd cht't vh'chd 'lh vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn lpny yhvh mzvbv
verses.translation: And the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the LORD for his issue.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֕ישׁ כִּֽי תֵצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ שִׁכְבַת זָ֑רַע וְ/רָחַ֥ץ בַּ/מַּ֛יִם אֶת כָּל בְּשָׂר֖/וֹ וְ/טָמֵ֥א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: v'ysh khy tts' mmnv shkhbt zr' vrchts bmym 't khl bshrv vtm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And if any man’s seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וְ/כָל בֶּ֣גֶד וְ/כָל ע֔וֹר אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶ֥ה עָלָ֖י/ו שִׁכְבַת זָ֑רַע וְ/כֻבַּ֥ס בַּ/מַּ֖יִם וְ/טָמֵ֥א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vkhl bgd vkhl 'vr 'shr yhyh 'lyv shkhbt zr' vkhbs bmym vtm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וְ/אִשָּׁ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֥ב אִ֛ישׁ אֹתָ֖/הּ שִׁכְבַת זָ֑רַע וְ/רָחֲצ֣וּ בַ/מַּ֔יִם וְ/טָמְא֖וּ עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: v'shh 'shr yshkhb 'ysh 'th shkhbt zr' vrchtsv bmym vtm'v 'd h'rb
verses.translation: The woman also with whom man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.
