verses.original: וְ/אִשָּׁה֙ כִּֽי תִהְיֶ֣ה זָבָ֔ה דָּ֛ם יִהְיֶ֥ה זֹבָ֖/הּ בִּ/בְשָׂרָ֑/הּ שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה בְ/נִדָּתָ֔/הּ וְ/כָל הַ/נֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּ֖/הּ יִטְמָ֥א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: v'shh khy thyh zbh dm yhyh zbh bbshrh shb't ymym thyh bndth vkhl hng' bh ytm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וְ/כֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֛י/ו בְּ/נִדָּתָ֖/הּ יִטְמָ֑א וְ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר תֵּשֵׁ֥ב עָלָ֖י/ו יִטְמָֽא
verses.translit: vkhl 'shr tshkhb 'lyv bndth ytm' vkhl 'shr tshb 'lyv ytm'
verses.translation: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הַ/נֹּגֵ֖עַ בְּ/מִשְׁכָּבָ֑/הּ יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛י/ו וְ/רָחַ֥ץ בַּ/מַּ֖יִם וְ/טָמֵ֥א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vkhl hng' bmshkhbh ykhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vtm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הַ/נֹּגֵ֔עַ בְּ/כָל כְּלִ֖י אֲשֶׁר תֵּשֵׁ֣ב עָלָ֑י/ו יְכַבֵּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛י/ו וְ/רָחַ֥ץ בַּ/מַּ֖יִם וְ/טָמֵ֥א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vkhl hng' bkhl khly 'shr tshb 'lyv ykhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vtm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֨ם עַֽל הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֜ב ה֗וּא א֧וֹ עַֽל הַ/כְּלִ֛י אֲשֶׁר הִ֥וא יֹשֶֽׁבֶת עָלָ֖י/ו בְּ/נָגְע/וֹ ב֑/וֹ יִטְמָ֖א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: v'm 'l hmshkhb hv' 'v 'l hkhly 'shr hv' yshbt 'lyv bng'v bv ytm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And if it be on her bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֡ם שָׁכֹב֩ יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אִ֜ישׁ אֹתָ֗/הּ וּ/תְהִ֤י נִדָּתָ/הּ֙ עָלָ֔י/ו וְ/טָמֵ֖א שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְ/כָל הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֛ב אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּ֥ב עָלָ֖י/ו יִטְמָֽא
verses.translit: v'm shkhb yshkhb 'ysh 'th vthy ndth 'lyv vtm' shb't ymym vkhl hmshkhb 'shr yshkhb 'lyv ytm'
verses.translation: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.

verses.original: וְ/אִשָּׁ֡ה כִּֽי יָזוּב֩ ז֨וֹב דָּמָ֜/הּ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים בְּ/לֹא֙ עֶת נִדָּתָ֔/הּ א֥וֹ כִֽי תָז֖וּב עַל נִדָּתָ֑/הּ כָּל יְמֵ֞י ז֣וֹב טֻמְאָתָ֗/הּ כִּ/ימֵ֧י נִדָּתָ֛/הּ תִּהְיֶ֖ה טְמֵאָ֥ה הִֽוא
verses.translit: v'shh khy yzvb zvb dmh ymym rbym bl' 't ndth 'v khy tzvb 'l ndth khl ymy zvb tm'th khymy ndth thyh tm'h hv'
verses.translation: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she shall be unclean.

verses.original: כָּל הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֞ב אֲשֶׁר תִּשְׁכַּ֤ב עָלָי/ו֙ כָּל יְמֵ֣י זוֹבָ֔/הּ כְּ/מִשְׁכַּ֥ב נִדָּתָ֖/הּ יִֽהְיֶה לָּ֑/הּ וְ/כָֽל הַ/כְּלִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּשֵׁ֣ב עָלָ֔י/ו טָמֵ֣א יִהְיֶ֔ה כְּ/טֻמְאַ֖ת נִדָּתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khl hmshkhb 'shr tshkhb 'lyv khl ymy zvbh khmshkhb ndth yhyh lh vkhl hkhly 'shr tshb 'lyv tm' yhyh khtm't ndth
verses.translation: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הַ/נּוֹגֵ֥עַ בָּ֖/ם יִטְמָ֑א וְ/כִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛י/ו וְ/רָחַ֥ץ בַּ/מַּ֖יִם וְ/טָמֵ֥א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vkhl hnvg' bm ytm' vkhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vtm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וְ/אִֽם טָהֲרָ֖ה מִ/זּוֹבָ֑/הּ וְ/סָ֥פְרָה לָּ֛/הּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים וְ/אַחַ֥ר תִּטְהָֽר
verses.translit: v'm thrh mzvbh vsprh lh shb't ymym v'chr tthr
verses.translation: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֗י תִּֽקַּֽח לָ/הּ֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה וְ/הֵבִיאָ֤ה אוֹתָ/ם֙ אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vbyvm hshmyny tqch lh shty trym 'v shny bny yvnh vhby'h 'vtm 'l hkhhn 'l ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: וְ/עָשָׂ֤ה הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ אֶת הָ/אֶחָ֣ד חַטָּ֔את וְ/אֶת הָ/אֶחָ֖ד עֹלָ֑ה וְ/כִפֶּ֨ר עָלֶ֤י/הָ הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מִ/זּ֖וֹב טֻמְאָתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'shh hkhhn 't h'chd cht't v't h'chd 'lh vkhpr 'lyh hkhhn lpny yhvh mzvb tm'th
verses.translation: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the LORD for the issue of her uncleanness.

verses.original: וְ/הִזַּרְתֶּ֥ם אֶת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מִ/טֻּמְאָתָ֑/ם וְ/לֹ֤א יָמֻ֨תוּ֙ בְּ/טֻמְאָתָ֔/ם בְּ/טַמְּאָ֥/ם אֶת מִשְׁכָּנִ֖/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhzrtm 't bny yshr'l mtm'tm vl' ymtv btm'tm btm'm 't mshkhny 'shr btvkhm
verses.translation: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.

verses.original: זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַ/זָּ֑ב וַ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר תֵּצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֛/נּוּ שִׁכְבַת זֶ֖רַע לְ/טָמְאָה בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: z't tvrt hzb v'shr tts' mmnv shkhbt zr' ltm'h bh
verses.translation: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled therewith;

verses.original: וְ/הַ/דָּוָה֙ בְּ/נִדָּתָ֔/הּ וְ/הַ/זָּב֙ אֶת זוֹב֔/וֹ לַ/זָּכָ֖ר וְ/לַ/נְּקֵבָ֑ה וּ/לְ/אִ֕ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשְׁכַּ֖ב עִם טְמֵאָֽה
verses.translit: vhdvh bndth vhzb 't zvbv lzkhr vlnqbh vl'ysh 'shr yshkhb 'm tm'h
verses.translation: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה אַחֲרֵ֣י מ֔וֹת שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן בְּ/קָרְבָתָ֥/ם לִ/פְנֵי יְהוָ֖ה וַ/יָּמֻֽתוּ
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh 'chry mvt shny bny 'hrn bqrbtm lpny yhvh vymtv
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD , and died;

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה דַּבֵּר֮ אֶל אַהֲרֹ֣ן אָחִי/ךָ֒ וְ/אַל יָבֹ֤א בְ/כָל עֵת֙ אֶל הַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ מִ/בֵּ֖ית לַ/פָּרֹ֑כֶת אֶל פְּנֵ֨י הַ/כַּפֹּ֜רֶת אֲשֶׁ֤ר עַל הָ/אָרֹן֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יָמ֔וּת כִּ֚י בֶּֽ/עָנָ֔ן אֵרָאֶ֖ה עַל הַ/כַּפֹּֽרֶת
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh dbr 'l 'hrn 'chykh v'l yb' bkhl 't 'l hqdsh mbyt lprkht 'l pny hkhprt 'shr 'l h'rn vl' ymvt khy b'nn 'r'h 'l hkhprt
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat, which is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.

verses.original: בְּ/זֹ֛את יָבֹ֥א אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֶל הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ בְּ/פַ֧ר בֶּן בָּקָ֛ר לְ/חַטָּ֖את וְ/אַ֥יִל לְ/עֹלָֽה
verses.translit: bz't yb' 'hrn 'l hqdsh bpr bn bqr lcht't v'yl l'lh
verses.translation: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

verses.original: כְּתֹֽנֶת בַּ֨ד קֹ֜דֶשׁ יִלְבָּ֗שׁ וּ/מִֽכְנְסֵי בַד֮ יִהְי֣וּ עַל בְּשָׂר/וֹ֒ וּ/בְ/אַבְנֵ֥ט בַּד֙ יַחְגֹּ֔ר וּ/בְ/מִצְנֶ֥פֶת בַּ֖ד יִצְנֹ֑ף בִּגְדֵי קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֔ם וְ/רָחַ֥ץ בַּ/מַּ֛יִם אֶת בְּשָׂר֖/וֹ וּ/לְבֵשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: khtnt bd qdsh ylbsh vmkhnsy bd yhyv 'l bshrv vb'bnt bd ychgr vbmtsnpt bd ytsnf bgdy qdsh hm vrchts bmym 't bshrv vlbshm
verses.translation: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these are holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and so put them on.

verses.original: וּ/מֵ/אֵ֗ת עֲדַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יִקַּ֛ח שְׁנֵֽי שְׂעִירֵ֥י עִזִּ֖ים לְ/חַטָּ֑את וְ/אַ֥יִל אֶחָ֖ד לְ/עֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vm't 'dt bny yshr'l yqch shny sh'yry 'zym lcht't v'yl 'chd l'lh
verses.translation: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרִ֧יב אַהֲרֹ֛ן אֶת פַּ֥ר הַ/חַטָּ֖את אֲשֶׁר ל֑/וֹ וְ/כִפֶּ֥ר בַּעֲד֖/וֹ וּ/בְעַ֥ד בֵּיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhqryb 'hrn 't pr hcht't 'shr lv vkhpr b'dv vb'd bytv
verses.translation: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֖ח אֶת שְׁנֵ֣י הַ/שְּׂעִירִ֑ם וְ/הֶעֱמִ֤יד אֹתָ/ם֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vlqch 't shny hsh'yrm vh'myd 'tm lpny yhvh ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַ֧ן אַהֲרֹ֛ן עַל שְׁנֵ֥י הַ/שְּׂעִירִ֖ם גּוֹרָל֑וֹת גּוֹרָ֤ל אֶחָד֙ לַ/יהוָ֔ה וְ/גוֹרָ֥ל אֶחָ֖ד לַ/עֲזָאזֵֽל
verses.translit: vntn 'hrn 'l shny hsh'yrm gvrlvt gvrl 'chd lyhvh vgvrl 'chd l'z'zl
verses.translation: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD , and the other lot for the scapegoat.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרִ֤יב אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת הַ/שָּׂעִ֔יר אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָלָ֥ה עָלָ֛י/ו הַ/גּוֹרָ֖ל לַ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/עָשָׂ֖/הוּ חַטָּֽאת
verses.translit: vhqryb 'hrn 't hsh'yr 'shr 'lh 'lyv hgvrl lyhvh v'shhv cht't
verses.translation: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD’s lot fell, and offer him for a sin offering.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/שָּׂעִ֗יר אֲשֶׁר֩ עָלָ֨ה עָלָ֤י/ו הַ/גּוֹרָל֙ לַ/עֲזָאזֵ֔ל יָֽעֳמַד חַ֛י לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְ/כַפֵּ֣ר עָלָ֑י/ו לְ/שַׁלַּ֥ח אֹת֛/וֹ לַ/עֲזָאזֵ֖ל הַ/מִּדְבָּֽרָ/ה
verses.translit: vhsh'yr 'shr 'lh 'lyv hgvrl l'z'zl y'md chy lpny yhvh lkhpr 'lyv lshlch 'tv l'z'zl hmdbrh
verses.translation: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the LORD , to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרִ֨יב אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת פַּ֤ר הַֽ/חַטָּאת֙ אֲשֶׁר ל֔/וֹ וְ/כִפֶּ֥ר בַּֽעֲד֖/וֹ וּ/בְעַ֣ד בֵּית֑/וֹ וְ/שָׁחַ֛ט אֶת פַּ֥ר הַֽ/חַטָּ֖את אֲשֶׁר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhqryb 'hrn 't pr hcht't 'shr lv vkhpr b'dv vb'd bytv vshcht 't pr hcht't 'shr lv
verses.translation: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself:

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֣ח מְלֹֽא הַ֠/מַּחְתָּה גַּֽחֲלֵי אֵ֞שׁ מֵ/עַ֤ל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּ/מְלֹ֣א חָפְנָ֔י/ו קְטֹ֥רֶת סַמִּ֖ים דַּקָּ֑ה וְ/הֵבִ֖יא מִ/בֵּ֥ית לַ/פָּרֹֽכֶת
verses.translit: vlqch ml' hmchth gchly 'sh m'l hmzbch mlpny yhvh vml' chpnyv qtrt smym dqh vhby' mbyt lprkht
verses.translation: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD , and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the vail:

verses.original: וְ/נָתַ֧ן אֶֽת הַ/קְּטֹ֛רֶת עַל הָ/אֵ֖שׁ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/כִסָּ֣ה עֲנַ֣ן הַ/קְּטֹ֗רֶת אֶת הַ/כַּפֹּ֛רֶת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל הָ/עֵד֖וּת וְ/לֹ֥א יָמֽוּת
verses.translit: vntn 't hqtrt 'l h'sh lpny yhvh vkhsh 'nn hqtrt 't hkhprt 'shr 'l h'dvt vl' ymvt
verses.translation: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the LORD , that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:

verses.original: וְ/לָקַח֙ מִ/דַּ֣ם הַ/פָּ֔ר וְ/הִזָּ֧ה בְ/אֶצְבָּע֛/וֹ עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַ/כַּפֹּ֖רֶת קֵ֑דְמָ/ה וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/כַּפֹּ֗רֶת יַזֶּ֧ה שֶֽׁבַע פְּעָמִ֛ים מִן הַ/דָּ֖ם בְּ/אֶצְבָּעֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vlqch mdm hpr vhzh b'tsb'v 'l pny hkhprt qdmh vlpny hkhprt yzh shb' p'mym mn hdm b'tsb'v
verses.translation: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁחַ֞ט אֶת שְׂעִ֤יר הַֽ/חַטָּאת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ/עָ֔ם וְ/הֵבִיא֙ אֶת דָּמ֔/וֹ אֶל מִ/בֵּ֖ית לַ/פָּרֹ֑כֶת וְ/עָשָׂ֣ה אֶת דָּמ֗/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לְ/דַ֣ם הַ/פָּ֔ר וְ/הִזָּ֥ה אֹת֛/וֹ עַל הַ/כַּפֹּ֖רֶת וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/כַּפֹּֽרֶת
verses.translit: vshcht 't sh'yr hcht't 'shr l'm vhby' 't dmv 'l mbyt lprkht v'shh 't dmv kh'shr 'shh ldm hpr vhzh 'tv 'l hkhprt vlpny hkhprt
verses.translation: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:

verses.original: וְ/כִפֶּ֣ר עַל הַ/קֹּ֗דֶשׁ מִ/טֻּמְאֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּ/מִ/פִּשְׁעֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/כָל חַטֹּאתָ֑/ם וְ/כֵ֤ן יַעֲשֶׂה֙ לְ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד הַ/שֹּׁכֵ֣ן אִתָּ֔/ם בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ טֻמְאֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vkhpr 'l hqdsh mtm't bny yshr'l vmpsh'yhm lkhl cht'tm vkhn y'shh l'hl mv'd hshkhn 'tm btvkh tm'tm
verses.translation: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place , because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.

verses.original: וְ/כָל אָדָ֞ם לֹא יִהְיֶ֣ה בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד בְּ/בֹא֛/וֹ לְ/כַפֵּ֥ר בַּ/קֹּ֖דֶשׁ עַד צֵאת֑/וֹ וְ/כִפֶּ֤ר בַּעֲד/וֹ֙ וּ/בְעַ֣ד בֵּית֔/וֹ וּ/בְעַ֖ד כָּל קְהַ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vkhl 'dm l' yhyh b'hl mv'd bb'v lkhpr bqdsh 'd ts'tv vkhpr b'dv vb'd bytv vb'd khl qhl yshr'l
verses.translation: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy place , until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/יָצָ֗א אֶל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֛חַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִ/פְנֵֽי יְהוָ֖ה וְ/כִפֶּ֣ר עָלָ֑י/ו וְ/לָקַ֞ח מִ/דַּ֤ם הַ/פָּר֙ וּ/מִ/דַּ֣ם הַ/שָּׂעִ֔יר וְ/נָתַ֛ן עַל קַרְנ֥וֹת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vyts' 'l hmzbch 'shr lpny yhvh vkhpr 'lyv vlqch mdm hpr vmdm hsh'yr vntn 'l qrnvt hmzbch sbyb
verses.translation: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the LORD , and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.

verses.original: וְ/הִזָּ֨ה עָלָ֧י/ו מִן הַ/דָּ֛ם בְּ/אֶצְבָּע֖/וֹ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְ/טִהֲר֣/וֹ וְ/קִדְּשׁ֔/וֹ מִ/טֻּמְאֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhzh 'lyv mn hdm b'tsb'v shb' p'mym vthrv vqdshv mtm't bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/כִלָּה֙ מִ/כַּפֵּ֣ר אֶת הַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְ/אֶת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְ/הִקְרִ֖יב אֶת הַ/שָּׂעִ֥יר הֶ/חָֽי
verses.translit: vkhlh mkhpr 't hqdsh v't 'hl mv'd v't hmzbch vhqryb 't hsh'yr hchy
verses.translation: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy place , and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:

verses.original: וְ/סָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת שְׁתֵּ֣י יד/ו יָדָ֗י/ו עַ֨ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/שָּׂעִיר֮ הַ/חַי֒ וְ/הִתְוַדָּ֣ה עָלָ֗י/ו אֶת כָּל עֲוֺנֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אֶת כָּל פִּשְׁעֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/כָל חַטֹּאתָ֑/ם וְ/נָתַ֤ן אֹתָ/ם֙ עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/שָּׂעִ֔יר וְ/שִׁלַּ֛ח בְּ/יַד אִ֥ישׁ עִתִּ֖י הַ/מִּדְבָּֽרָ/ה
verses.translit: vsmkh 'hrn 't shty ydv ydyv 'l r'sh hsh'yr hchy vhtvdh 'lyv 't khl 'vnt bny yshr'l v't khl psh'yhm lkhl cht'tm vntn 'tm 'l r'sh hsh'yr vshlch byd 'ysh 'ty hmdbrh
verses.translation: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:

verses.original: וְ/נָשָׂ֨א הַ/שָּׂעִ֥יר עָלָ֛י/ו אֶת כָּל עֲוֺנֹתָ֖/ם אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ גְּזֵרָ֑ה וְ/שִׁלַּ֥ח אֶת הַ/שָּׂעִ֖יר בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: vnsh' hsh'yr 'lyv 't khl 'vntm 'l 'rts gzrh vshlch 't hsh'yr bmdbr
verses.translation: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.

verses.original: וּ/בָ֤א אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וּ/פָשַׁט֙ אֶת בִּגְדֵ֣י הַ/בָּ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָבַ֖שׁ בְּ/בֹא֣/וֹ אֶל הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְ/הִנִּיחָ֖/ם שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vb' 'hrn 'l 'hl mv'd vpsht 't bgdy hbd 'shr lbsh bb'v 'l hqdsh vhnychm shm
verses.translation: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place , and shall leave them there:

verses.original: וְ/רָחַ֨ץ אֶת בְּשָׂר֤/וֹ בַ/מַּ֨יִם֙ בְּ/מָק֣וֹם קָד֔וֹשׁ וְ/לָבַ֖שׁ אֶת בְּגָדָ֑י/ו וְ/יָצָ֗א וְ/עָשָׂ֤ה אֶת עֹֽלָת/וֹ֙ וְ/אֶת עֹלַ֣ת הָ/עָ֔ם וְ/כִפֶּ֥ר בַּעֲד֖/וֹ וּ/בְעַ֥ד הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vrchts 't bshrv bmym bmqvm qdvsh vlbsh 't bgdyv vyts' v'shh 't 'ltv v't 'lt h'm vkhpr b'dv vb'd h'm
verses.translation: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֛ת חֵ֥לֶב הַֽ/חַטָּ֖את יַקְטִ֥יר הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחָ/ה
verses.translit: v't chlb hcht't yqtyr hmzbchh
verses.translation: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.

verses.original: וְ/הַֽ/מְשַׁלֵּ֤חַ אֶת הַ/שָּׂעִיר֙ לַֽ/עֲזָאזֵ֔ל יְכַבֵּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֔י/ו וְ/רָחַ֥ץ אֶת בְּשָׂר֖/וֹ בַּ/מָּ֑יִם וְ/אַחֲרֵי כֵ֖ן יָב֥וֹא אֶל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vhmshlch 't hsh'yr l'z'zl ykhbs bgdyv vrchts 't bshrv bmym v'chry khn ybv' 'l hmchnh
verses.translation: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֩ פַּ֨ר הַֽ/חַטָּ֜את וְ/אֵ֣ת שְׂעִ֣יר הַֽ/חַטָּ֗את אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוּבָ֤א אֶת דָּמָ/ם֙ לְ/כַפֵּ֣ר בַּ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ יוֹצִ֖יא אֶל מִ/ח֣וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְ/שָׂרְפ֣וּ בָ/אֵ֔שׁ אֶת עֹרֹתָ֥/ם וְ/אֶת בְּשָׂרָ֖/ם וְ/אֶת פִּרְשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: v't pr hcht't v't sh'yr hcht't 'shr hvb' 't dmm lkhpr bqdsh yvtsy' 'l mchvts lmchnh vshrpv b'sh 't 'rtm v't bshrm v't prshm
verses.translation: And the bullock for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place , shall one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/שֹּׂרֵ֣ף אֹתָ֔/ם יְכַבֵּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֔י/ו וְ/רָחַ֥ץ אֶת בְּשָׂר֖/וֹ בַּ/מָּ֑יִם וְ/אַחֲרֵי כֵ֖ן יָב֥וֹא אֶל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vhshrf 'tm ykhbs bgdyv vrchts 't bshrv bmym v'chry khn ybv' 'l hmchnh
verses.translation: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.

verses.original: וְ/הָיְתָ֥ה לָ/כֶ֖ם לְ/חֻקַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ֠/שְּׁבִיעִי בֶּֽ/עָשׂ֨וֹר לַ/חֹ֜דֶשׁ תְּעַנּ֣וּ אֶת נַפְשֹֽׁתֵי/כֶ֗ם וְ/כָל מְלָאכָה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ הָֽ/אֶזְרָ֔ח וְ/הַ/גֵּ֖ר הַ/גָּ֥ר בְּ/תוֹכְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhyth lkhm lchqt 'vlm bchdsh hshby'y b'shvr lchdsh t'nv 't npshtykhm vkhl ml'khh l' t'shv h'zrch vhgr hgr btvkhkhm
verses.translation: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you: that in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:

verses.original: כִּֽי בַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּ֛ה יְכַפֵּ֥ר עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם לְ/טַהֵ֣ר אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם מִ/כֹּל֙ חַטֹּ֣אתֵי/כֶ֔ם לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תִּטְהָֽרוּ
verses.translit: khy byvm hzh ykhpr 'lykhm lthr 'tkhm mkhl cht'tykhm lpny yhvh tthrv
verses.translation: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that ye may be clean from all your sins before the LORD .

verses.original: שַׁבַּ֨ת שַׁבָּת֥וֹן הִיא֙ לָ/כֶ֔ם וְ/עִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵי/כֶ֑ם חֻקַּ֖ת עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: shbt shbtvn hy' lkhm v'nytm 't npshtykhm chqt 'vlm
verses.translation: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.

verses.original: וְ/כִפֶּ֨ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן אֲשֶׁר יִמְשַׁ֣ח אֹת֗/וֹ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר יְמַלֵּא֙ אֶת יָד֔/וֹ לְ/כַהֵ֖ן תַּ֣חַת אָבִ֑י/ו וְ/לָבַ֛שׁ אֶת בִּגְדֵ֥י הַ/בָּ֖ד בִּגְדֵ֥י הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: vkhpr hkhhn 'shr ymshch 'tv v'shr yml' 't ydv lkhhn tcht 'byv vlbsh 't bgdy hbd bgdy hqdsh
verses.translation: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest’s office in his father’s stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, even the holy garments:

verses.original: וְ/כִפֶּר֙ אֶת מִקְדַּ֣שׁ הַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְ/אֶת אֹ֧הֶל מוֹעֵ֛ד וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ יְכַפֵּ֑ר וְ/עַ֧ל הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֛ים וְ/עַל כָּל עַ֥ם הַ/קָּהָ֖ל יְכַפֵּֽר
verses.translit: vkhpr 't mqdsh hqdsh v't 'hl mv'd v't hmzbch ykhpr v'l hkhhnym v'l khl 'm hqhl ykhpr
verses.translation: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.

verses.original: וְ/הָֽיְתָה זֹּ֨את לָ/כֶ֜ם לְ/חֻקַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֗ם לְ/כַפֵּ֞ר עַל בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִ/כָּל חַטֹּאתָ֔/ם אַחַ֖ת בַּ/שָּׁנָ֑ה וַ/יַּ֕עַשׂ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vhyth z't lkhm lchqt 'vlm lkhpr 'l bny yshr'l mkhl cht'tm 'cht bshnh vy'sh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְ/אֶל בָּנָ֗י/ו וְ/אֶל֙ כָּל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם זֶ֣ה הַ/דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: dbr 'l 'hrn v'l bnyv v'l khl bny yshr'l v'mrt 'lyhm zh hdbr 'shr tsvh yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, saying,

verses.original: אִ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ מִ/בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁחַ֜ט שׁ֥וֹר אוֹ כֶ֛שֶׂב אוֹ עֵ֖ז בַּֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה א֚וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁחַ֔ט מִ/ח֖וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: 'ysh 'ysh mbyt yshr'l 'shr yshcht shvr 'v khshb 'v 'z bmchnh 'v 'shr yshcht mchvts lmchnh
verses.translation: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it out of the camp,

verses.original: וְ/אֶל פֶּ֜תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֮ לֹ֣א הֱבִיא/וֹ֒ לְ/הַקְרִ֤יב קָרְבָּן֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה לִ/פְנֵ֖י מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֑ה דָּ֣ם יֵחָשֵׁ֞ב לָ/אִ֤ישׁ הַ/הוּא֙ דָּ֣ם שָׁפָ֔ךְ וְ/נִכְרַ֛ת הָ/אִ֥ישׁ הַ/ה֖וּא מִ/קֶּ֥רֶב עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'l ptch 'hl mv'd l' hby'v lhqryb qrbn lyhvh lpny mshkhn yhvh dm ychshb l'ysh hhv' dm shpkh vnkhrt h'ysh hhv' mqrb 'mv
verses.translation: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto the LORD before the tabernacle of the LORD ; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:

verses.original: לְמַעַן֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָבִ֜יאוּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶֽת זִבְחֵי/הֶם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֵ֣ם זֹבְחִים֮ עַל פְּנֵ֣י הַ/שָּׂדֶה֒ וֶֽ/הֱבִיאֻ֣/ם לַֽ/יהוָ֗ה אֶל פֶּ֛תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן וְ/זָ֨בְח֜וּ זִבְחֵ֧י שְׁלָמִ֛ים לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה אוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: lm'n 'shr yby'v bny yshr'l 't zbchyhm 'shr hm zbchym 'l pny hshdh vhby'm lyhvh 'l ptch 'hl mv'd 'l hkhhn vzbchv zbchy shlmym lyhvh 'vtm
verses.translation: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the LORD , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them for peace offerings unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/זָרַ֨ק הַ/כֹּהֵ֤ן אֶת הַ/דָּם֙ עַל מִזְבַּ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְ/הִקְטִ֣יר הַ/חֵ֔לֶב לְ/רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vzrq hkhhn 't hdm 'l mzbch yhvh ptch 'hl mv'd vhqtyr hchlb lrych nychch lyhvh
verses.translation: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/לֹא יִזְבְּח֥וּ עוֹד֙ אֶת זִבְחֵי/הֶ֔ם לַ/שְּׂעִירִ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥ם זֹנִ֖ים אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֑ם חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֛ם תִּֽהְיֶה זֹּ֥את לָ/הֶ֖ם לְ/דֹרֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vl' yzbchv 'vd 't zbchyhm lsh'yrm 'shr hm znym 'chryhm chqt 'vlm thyh z't lhm ldrtm
verses.translation: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.

verses.original: וַ/אֲלֵ/הֶ֣ם תֹּאמַ֔ר אִ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ מִ/בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּ/מִן הַ/גֵּ֖ר אֲשֶׁר יָג֣וּר בְּ/תוֹכָ֑/ם אֲשֶׁר יַעֲלֶ֥ה עֹלָ֖ה אוֹ זָֽבַח
verses.translit: v'lhm t'mr 'ysh 'ysh mbyt yshr'l vmn hgr 'shr ygvr btvkhm 'shr y'lh 'lh 'v zbch
verses.translation: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering or sacrifice,

verses.original: וְ/אֶל פֶּ֜תַח אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ לֹ֣א יְבִיאֶ֔/נּוּ לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת אֹת֖/וֹ לַ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/נִכְרַ֛ת הָ/אִ֥ישׁ הַ/ה֖וּא מֵ/עַמָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'l ptch 'hl mv'd l' yby'nv l'shvt 'tv lyhvh vnkhrt h'ysh hhv' m'myv
verses.translation: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the LORD ; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֨ישׁ אִ֜ישׁ מִ/בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּ/מִן הַ/גֵּר֙ הַ/גָּ֣ר בְּ/תוֹכָ֔/ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֹאכַ֖ל כָּל דָּ֑ם וְ/נָתַתִּ֣י פָנַ֗/י בַּ/נֶּ֨פֶשׁ֙ הָ/אֹכֶ֣לֶת אֶת הַ/דָּ֔ם וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֥י אֹתָ֖/הּ מִ/קֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'ysh 'ysh mbyt yshr'l vmn hgr hgr btvkhm 'shr y'khl khl dm vntty pny bnpsh h'khlt 't hdm vhkhrty 'th mqrb 'mh
verses.translation: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.

verses.original: כִּ֣י נֶ֣פֶשׁ הַ/בָּשָׂר֮ בַּ/דָּ֣ם הִוא֒ וַ/אֲנִ֞י נְתַתִּ֤י/ו לָ/כֶם֙ עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ לְ/כַפֵּ֖ר עַל נַפְשֹׁתֵי/כֶ֑ם כִּֽי הַ/דָּ֥ם ה֖וּא בַּ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ יְכַפֵּֽר
verses.translit: khy npsh hbshr bdm hv' v'ny nttyv lkhm 'l hmzbch lkhpr 'l npshtykhm khy hdm hv' bnpsh ykhpr
verses.translation: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֤ן אָמַ֨רְתִּי֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כָּל נֶ֥פֶשׁ מִ/כֶּ֖ם לֹא תֹ֣אכַל דָּ֑ם וְ/הַ/גֵּ֛ר הַ/גָּ֥ר בְּ/תוֹכְ/כֶ֖ם לֹא יֹ֥אכַל דָּֽם
verses.translit: 'l khn 'mrty lbny yshr'l khl npsh mkhm l' t'khl dm vhgr hgr btvkhkhm l' y'khl dm
verses.translation: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֨ישׁ אִ֜ישׁ מִ/בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּ/מִן הַ/גֵּר֙ הַ/גָּ֣ר בְּ/תוֹכָ֔/ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצ֜וּד צֵ֥יד חַיָּ֛ה אוֹ ע֖וֹף אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֵאָכֵ֑ל וְ/שָׁפַךְ֙ אֶת דָּמ֔/וֹ וְ/כִסָּ֖/הוּ בֶּ/עָפָֽר
verses.translit: v'ysh 'ysh mbny yshr'l vmn hgr hgr btvkhm 'shr ytsvd tsyd chyh 'v 'vf 'shr y'khl vshpkh 't dmv vkhshv b'pr
verses.translation: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.

verses.original: כִּֽי נֶ֣פֶשׁ כָּל בָּשָׂ֗ר דָּמ֣/וֹ בְ/נַפְשׁ/וֹ֮ הוּא֒ וָֽ/אֹמַר֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל דַּ֥ם כָּל בָּשָׂ֖ר לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֑לוּ כִּ֣י נֶ֤פֶשׁ כָּל בָּשָׂר֙ דָּמ֣/וֹ הִ֔וא כָּל אֹכְלָ֖י/ו יִכָּרֵֽת
verses.translit: khy npsh khl bshr dmv bnpshv hv' v'mr lbny yshr'l dm khl bshr l' t'khlv khy npsh khl bshr dmv hv' khl 'khlyv ykhrt
verses.translation: For it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it is for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.

verses.original: וְ/כָל נֶ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תֹּאכַ֤ל נְבֵלָה֙ וּ/טְרֵפָ֔ה בָּ/אֶזְרָ֖ח וּ/בַ/גֵּ֑ר וְ/כִבֶּ֨ס בְּגָדָ֜י/ו וְ/רָחַ֥ץ בַּ/מַּ֛יִם וְ/טָמֵ֥א עַד הָ/עֶ֖רֶב וְ/טָהֵֽר
verses.translit: vkhl npsh 'shr t'khl nblh vtrph b'zrch vbgr vkhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vtm' 'd h'rb vthr
verses.translation: And every soul that eateth that which died of itself , or that which was torn with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.

verses.original: וְ/אִם֙ לֹ֣א יְכַבֵּ֔ס וּ/בְשָׂר֖/וֹ לֹ֣א יִרְחָ֑ץ וְ/נָשָׂ֖א עֲוֺנֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'm l' ykhbs vbshrv l' yrchts vnsh' 'vnv
verses.translation: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: כְּ/מַעֲשֵׂ֧ה אֶֽרֶץ מִצְרַ֛יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשַׁבְתֶּם בָּ֖/הּ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ וּ/כְ/מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֶֽרֶץ כְּנַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲנִי֩ מֵבִ֨יא אֶתְ/כֶ֥ם שָׁ֨מָּ/ה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ וּ/בְ/חֻקֹּתֵי/הֶ֖ם לֹ֥א תֵלֵֽכוּ
verses.translit: khm'shh 'rts mtsrym 'shr yshbtm bh l' t'shv vkhm'shh 'rts khn'n 'shr 'ny mby' 'tkhm shmh l' t'shv vbchqtyhm l' tlkhv
verses.translation: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.

verses.original: אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַ֧/י תַּעֲשׂ֛וּ וְ/אֶת חֻקֹּתַ֥/י תִּשְׁמְר֖וּ לָ/לֶ֣כֶת בָּ/הֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 't mshpty t'shv v't chqty tshmrv llkht bhm 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֶת חֻקֹּתַ/י֙ וְ/אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֛/ם הָ/אָדָ֖ם וָ/חַ֣י בָּ/הֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vshmrtm 't chqty v't mshpty 'shr y'shh 'tm h'dm vchy bhm 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am the LORD .

verses.original: אִ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ אֶל כָּל שְׁאֵ֣ר בְּשָׂר֔/וֹ לֹ֥א תִקְרְב֖וּ לְ/גַלּ֣וֹת עֶרְוָ֑ה אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'ysh 'ysh 'l khl sh'r bshrv l' tqrbv lglvt 'rvh 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD .

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אָבִ֛י/ךָ וְ/עֶרְוַ֥ת אִמְּ/ךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אִמְּ/ךָ֣ הִ֔וא לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'rvt 'bykh v'rvt 'mkh l' tglh 'mkh hv' l' tglh 'rvth
verses.translation: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֵֽשֶׁת אָבִ֖י/ךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה עֶרְוַ֥ת אָבִ֖י/ךָ הִֽוא
verses.translit: 'rvt 'sht 'bykh l' tglh 'rvt 'bykh hv'
verses.translation: The nakedness of thy father’s wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father’s nakedness.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֨ת אֲחֽוֹתְ/ךָ֤ בַת אָבִ֨י/ךָ֙ א֣וֹ בַת אִמֶּ֔/ךָ מוֹלֶ֣דֶת בַּ֔יִת א֖וֹ מוֹלֶ֣דֶת ח֑וּץ לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽ/ן
verses.translit: 'rvt 'chvtkh bt 'bykh 'v bt 'mkh mvldt byt 'v mvldt chvts l' tglh 'rvtn
verses.translation: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֤ת בַּת בִּנְ/ךָ֙ א֣וֹ בַֽת בִּתְּ/ךָ֔ לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָ֑/ן כִּ֥י עֶרְוָתְ/ךָ֖ הֵֽנָּה
verses.translit: 'rvt bt bnkh 'v bt btkh l' tglh 'rvtn khy 'rvtkh hnh
verses.translation: The nakedness of thy son’s daughter, or of thy daughter’s daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֨ת בַּת אֵ֤שֶׁת אָבִ֨י/ךָ֙ מוֹלֶ֣דֶת אָבִ֔י/ךָ אֲחוֹתְ/ךָ֖ הִ֑וא לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'rvt bt 'sht 'bykh mvldt 'bykh 'chvtkh hv' l' tglh 'rvth
verses.translation: The nakedness of thy father’s wife’s daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֲחוֹת אָבִ֖י/ךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה שְׁאֵ֥ר אָבִ֖י/ךָ הִֽוא
verses.translit: 'rvt 'chvt 'bykh l' tglh sh'r 'bykh hv'
verses.translation: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s sister: she is thy father’s near kinswoman.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֲחֽוֹת אִמְּ/ךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה כִּֽי שְׁאֵ֥ר אִמְּ/ךָ֖ הִֽוא
verses.translit: 'rvt 'chvt 'mkh l' tglh khy sh'r 'mkh hv'
verses.translation: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister: for she is thy mother’s near kinswoman.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֲחִֽי אָבִ֖י/ךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אֶל אִשְׁתּ/וֹ֙ לֹ֣א תִקְרָ֔ב דֹּדָֽתְ/ךָ֖ הִֽוא
verses.translit: 'rvt 'chy 'bykh l' tglh 'l 'shtv l' tqrb ddtkh hv'
verses.translation: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father’s brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת כַּלָּֽתְ/ךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אֵ֤שֶׁת בִּנְ/ךָ֙ הִ֔וא לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'rvt khltkh l' tglh 'sht bnkh hv' l' tglh 'rvth
verses.translation: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she is thy son’s wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֵֽשֶׁת אָחִ֖י/ךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה עֶרְוַ֥ת אָחִ֖י/ךָ הִֽוא
verses.translit: 'rvt 'sht 'chykh l' tglh 'rvt 'chykh hv'
verses.translation: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother’s wife: it is thy brother’s nakedness.

verses.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אִשָּׁ֛ה וּ/בִתָּ֖/הּ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אֶֽת בַּת בְּנָ֞/הּ וְ/אֶת בַּת בִּתָּ֗/הּ לֹ֤א תִקַּח֙ לְ/גַלּ֣וֹת עֶרְוָתָ֔/הּ שַׁאֲרָ֥ה הֵ֖נָּה זִמָּ֥ה הִֽוא
verses.translit: 'rvt 'shh vbth l' tglh 't bt bnh v't bt bth l' tqch lglvt 'rvth sh'rh hnh zmh hv'
verses.translation: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son’s daughter, or her daughter’s daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.

verses.original: וְ/אִשָּׁ֥ה אֶל אֲחֹתָ֖/הּ לֹ֣א תִקָּ֑ח לִ/צְרֹ֗ר לְ/גַלּ֧וֹת עֶרְוָתָ֛/הּ עָלֶ֖י/הָ בְּ/חַיֶּֽי/הָ
verses.translit: v'shh 'l 'chth l' tqch ltsrr lglvt 'rvth 'lyh bchyyh
verses.translation: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex her , to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time .

verses.original: וְ/אֶל אִשָּׁ֖ה בְּ/נִדַּ֣ת טֻמְאָתָ֑/הּ לֹ֣א תִקְרַ֔ב לְ/גַלּ֖וֹת עֶרְוָתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'l 'shh bndt tm'th l' tqrb lglvt 'rvth
verses.translation: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל אֵ֨שֶׁת֙ עֲמִֽיתְ/ךָ֔ לֹא תִתֵּ֥ן שְׁכָבְתְּ/ךָ֖ לְ/זָ֑רַע לְ/טָמְאָה בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'l 'sht 'mytkh l' ttn shkhbtkh lzr' ltm'h bh
verses.translation: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour’s wife, to defile thyself with her.

verses.original: וּ/מִֽ/זַּרְעֲ/ךָ֥ לֹא תִתֵּ֖ן לְ/הַעֲבִ֣יר לַ/מֹּ֑לֶךְ וְ/לֹ֧א תְחַלֵּ֛ל אֶת שֵׁ֥ם אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vmzr'kh l' ttn lh'byr lmlkh vl' tchll 't shm 'lhykh 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אֶ֨ת זָכָ֔ר לֹ֥א תִשְׁכַּ֖ב מִשְׁכְּבֵ֣י אִשָּׁ֑ה תּוֹעֵבָ֖ה הִֽוא
verses.translit: v't zkhr l' tshkhb mshkhby 'shh tv'bh hv'
verses.translation: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/כָל בְּהֵמָ֛ה לֹא תִתֵּ֥ן שְׁכָבְתְּ/ךָ֖ לְ/טָמְאָה בָ֑/הּ וְ/אִשָּׁ֗ה לֹֽא תַעֲמֹ֞ד לִ/פְנֵ֧י בְהֵמָ֛ה לְ/רִבְעָ֖/הּ תֶּ֥בֶל הֽוּא
verses.translit: vbkhl bhmh l' ttn shkhbtkh ltm'h bh v'shh l' t'md lpny bhmh lrb'h tbl hv'
verses.translation: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.

verses.original: אַל תִּֽטַּמְּא֖וּ בְּ/כָל אֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֤י בְ/כָל אֵ֨לֶּה֙ נִטְמְא֣וּ הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר אֲנִ֥י מְשַׁלֵּ֖חַ מִ/פְּנֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'l ttm'v bkhl 'lh khy bkhl 'lh ntm'v hgvym 'shr 'ny mshlch mpnykhm
verses.translation: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:

verses.original: וַ/תִּטְמָ֣א הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וָ/אֶפְקֹ֥ד עֲוֺנָ֖/הּ עָלֶ֑י/הָ וַ/תָּקִ֥א הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אֶת יֹשְׁבֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vttm' h'rts v'pqd 'vnh 'lyh vtq' h'rts 't yshbyh
verses.translation: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם אַתֶּ֗ם אֶת חֻקֹּתַ/י֙ וְ/אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַ֔/י וְ/לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ מִ/כֹּ֥ל הַ/תּוֹעֵבֹ֖ת הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה הָֽ/אֶזְרָ֔ח וְ/הַ/גֵּ֖ר הַ/גָּ֥ר בְּ/תוֹכְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vshmrtm 'tm 't chqty v't mshpty vl' t'shv mkhl htv'bt h'lh h'zrch vhgr hgr btvkhkhm
verses.translation: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations; neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:

verses.original: כִּ֚י אֶת כָּל הַ/תּוֹעֵבֹ֣ת הָ/אֵ֔ל עָשׂ֥וּ אַנְשֵֽׁי הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֑ם וַ/תִּטְמָ֖א הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khy 't khl htv'bt h'l 'shv 'nshy h'rts 'shr lpnykhm vttm' h'rts
verses.translation: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which were before you, and the land is defiled;)

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא תָקִ֤יא הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם בְּ/טַֽמַּאֲ/כֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑/הּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר קָאָ֛ה אֶת הַ/גּ֖וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִ/פְנֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vl' tqy' h'rts 'tkhm btm'khm 'th kh'shr q'h 't hgvy 'shr lpnykhm
verses.translation: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before you.

verses.original: כִּ֚י כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַעֲשֶׂ֔ה מִ/כֹּ֥ל הַ/תּוֹעֵב֖וֹת הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וְ/נִכְרְת֛וּ הַ/נְּפָשׁ֥וֹת הָ/עֹשֹׂ֖ת מִ/קֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy khl 'shr y'shh mkhl htv'bvt h'lh vnkhrtv hnpshvt h'sht mqrb 'mm
verses.translation: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם אֶת מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֗/י לְ/בִלְתִּ֨י עֲשׂ֜וֹת מֵ/חֻקּ֤וֹת הַ/תּֽוֹעֵבֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נַעֲשׂ֣וּ לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/לֹ֥א תִֽטַּמְּא֖וּ בָּ/הֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vshmrtm 't mshmrty lblty 'shvt mchqvt htv'bt 'shr n'shv lpnykhm vl' ttm'v bhm 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל כָּל עֲדַ֧ת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֥ אֲלֵ/הֶ֖ם קְדֹשִׁ֣ים תִּהְי֑וּ כִּ֣י קָד֔וֹשׁ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: dbr 'l khl 'dt bny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm qdshym thyv khy qdvsh 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the LORD your God am holy.

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ אִמּ֤/וֹ וְ/אָבִי/ו֙ תִּירָ֔אוּ וְ/אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖/י תִּשְׁמֹ֑רוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'ysh 'mv v'byv tyr'v v't shbtty tshmrv 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: אַל תִּפְנוּ֙ אֶל הָ֣/אֱלִילִ֔ים וֵֽ/אלֹהֵי֙ מַסֵּכָ֔ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ לָ/כֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'l tpnv 'l h'lylym v'lhy mskhh l' t'shv lkhm 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: וְ/כִ֧י תִזְבְּח֛וּ זֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִ֖ים לַ/יהוָ֑ה לִֽ/רְצֹנְ/כֶ֖ם תִּזְבָּחֻֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vkhy tzbchv zbch shlmym lyhvh lrtsnkhm tzbchhv
verses.translation: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD , ye shall offer it at your own will.

verses.original: בְּ/י֧וֹם זִבְחֲ/כֶ֛ם יֵאָכֵ֖ל וּ/מִֽ/מָּחֳרָ֑ת וְ/הַ/נּוֹתָר֙ עַד י֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֔י בָּ/אֵ֖שׁ יִשָּׂרֵֽף
verses.translit: byvm zbchkhm y'khl vmmchrt vhnvtr 'd yvm hshlyshy b'sh yshrf
verses.translation: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֛ם הֵאָכֹ֥ל יֵאָכֵ֖ל בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֑י פִּגּ֥וּל ה֖וּא לֹ֥א יֵרָצֶֽה
verses.translit: v'm h'khl y'khl byvm hshlyshy pgvl hv' l' yrtsh
verses.translation: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.

verses.original: וְ/אֹֽכְלָי/ו֙ עֲוֺנ֣/וֹ יִשָּׂ֔א כִּֽי אֶת קֹ֥דֶשׁ יְהוָ֖ה חִלֵּ֑ל וְ/נִכְרְתָ֛ה הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/הִ֖וא מֵ/עַמֶּֽי/הָ
verses.translit: v'khlyv 'vnv ysh' khy 't qdsh yhvh chll vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' m'myh
verses.translation: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the LORD : and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.original: וּֽ/בְ/קֻצְרְ/כֶם֙ אֶת קְצִ֣יר אַרְצְ/כֶ֔ם לֹ֧א תְכַלֶּ֛ה פְּאַ֥ת שָׂדְ/ךָ֖ לִ/קְצֹ֑ר וְ/לֶ֥קֶט קְצִֽירְ/ךָ֖ לֹ֥א תְלַקֵּֽט
verses.translit: vbqtsrkhm 't qtsyr 'rtskhm l' tkhlh p't shdkh lqtsr vlqt qtsyrkh l' tlqt
verses.translation: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.

verses.original: וְ/כַרְמְ/ךָ֙ לֹ֣א תְעוֹלֵ֔ל וּ/פֶ֥רֶט כַּרְמְ/ךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְלַקֵּ֑ט לֶֽ/עָנִ֤י וְ/לַ/גֵּר֙ תַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֹתָ֔/ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vkhrmkh l' t'vll vprt khrmkh l' tlqt l'ny vlgr t'zb 'tm 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: לֹ֖א תִּגְנֹ֑בוּ וְ/לֹא תְכַחֲשׁ֥וּ וְ/לֹֽא תְשַׁקְּר֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ בַּ/עֲמִיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l' tgnbv vl' tkhchshv vl' tshqrv 'ysh b'mytv
verses.translation: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא תִשָּׁבְע֥וּ בִ/שְׁמִ֖/י לַ/שָּׁ֑קֶר וְ/חִלַּלְתָּ֛ אֶת שֵׁ֥ם אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vl' tshb'v bshmy lshqr vchllt 't shm 'lhykh 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD .

verses.original: לֹֽא תַעֲשֹׁ֥ק אֶת רֵֽעֲ/ךָ֖ וְ/לֹ֣א תִגְזֹ֑ל לֹֽא תָלִ֞ין פְּעֻלַּ֥ת שָׂכִ֛יר אִתְּ/ךָ֖ עַד בֹּֽקֶר
verses.translit: l' t'shq 't r'kh vl' tgzl l' tlyn p'lt shkhyr 'tkh 'd bqr
verses.translation: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.

verses.original: לֹא תְקַלֵּ֣ל חֵרֵ֔שׁ וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֣י עִוֵּ֔ר לֹ֥א תִתֵּ֖ן מִכְשֹׁ֑ל וְ/יָרֵ֥אתָ מֵּ/אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: l' tqll chrsh vlpny 'vr l' ttn mkhshl vyr't m'lhykh 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the LORD .

verses.original: לֹא תַעֲשׂ֥וּ עָ֨וֶל֙ בַּ/מִּשְׁפָּ֔ט לֹא תִשָּׂ֣א פְנֵי דָ֔ל וְ/לֹ֥א תֶהְדַּ֖ר פְּנֵ֣י גָד֑וֹל בְּ/צֶ֖דֶק תִּשְׁפֹּ֥ט עֲמִיתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: l' t'shv 'vl bmshpt l' tsh' pny dl vl' thdr pny gdvl btsdq tshpt 'mytkh
verses.translation: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honour the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.

verses.original: לֹא תֵלֵ֤ךְ רָכִיל֙ בְּ/עַמֶּ֔י/ךָ לֹ֥א תַעֲמֹ֖ד עַל דַּ֣ם רֵעֶ֑/ךָ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: l' tlkh rkhyl b'mykh l' t'md 'l dm r'kh 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the LORD .

verses.original: לֹֽא תִשְׂנָ֥א אֶת אָחִ֖י/ךָ בִּ/לְבָבֶ֑/ךָ הוֹכֵ֤חַ תּוֹכִ֨יחַ֙ אֶת עֲמִיתֶ֔/ךָ וְ/לֹא תִשָּׂ֥א עָלָ֖י/ו חֵֽטְא
verses.translit: l' tshn' 't 'chykh blbbkh hvkhch tvkhych 't 'mytkh vl' tsh' 'lyv cht'
verses.translation: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.

verses.original: לֹֽא תִקֹּ֤ם וְ/לֹֽא תִטֹּר֙ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י עַמֶּ֔/ךָ וְ/אָֽהַבְתָּ֥ לְ/רֵעֲ/ךָ֖ כָּמ֑וֹ/ךָ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: l' tqm vl' ttr 't bny 'mkh v'hbt lr'kh khmvkh 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the LORD .

verses.original: אֶֽת חֻקֹּתַ/י֮ תִּשְׁמֹרוּ֒ בְּהֶמְתְּ/ךָ֙ לֹא תַרְבִּ֣יעַ כִּלְאַ֔יִם שָׂדְ/ךָ֖ לֹא תִזְרַ֣ע כִּלְאָ֑יִם וּ/בֶ֤גֶד כִּלְאַ֨יִם֙ שַֽׁעַטְנֵ֔ז לֹ֥א יַעֲלֶ֖ה עָלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 't chqty tshmrv bhmtkh l' trby' khl'ym shdkh l' tzr' khl'ym vbgd khl'ym sh'tnz l' y'lh 'lykh
verses.translation: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.

verses.original: וְ֠/אִישׁ כִּֽי יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אֶת אִשָּׁ֜ה שִׁכְבַת זֶ֗רַע וְ/הִ֤וא שִׁפְחָה֙ נֶחֱרֶ֣פֶת לְ/אִ֔ישׁ וְ/הָפְדֵּה֙ לֹ֣א נִפְדָּ֔תָה א֥וֹ חֻפְשָׁ֖ה לֹ֣א נִתַּן לָ֑/הּ בִּקֹּ֧רֶת תִּהְיֶ֛ה לֹ֥א יוּמְת֖וּ כִּי לֹ֥א חֻפָּֽשָׁה
verses.translit: v'ysh khy yshkhb 't 'shh shkhbt zr' vhv' shpchh nchrpt l'ysh vhpdh l' npdth 'v chpshh l' ntn lh bqrt thyh l' yvmtv khy l' chpshh
verses.translation: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.

verses.original: וְ/הֵבִ֤יא אֶת אֲשָׁמ/וֹ֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה אֶל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד אֵ֖יל אָשָֽׁם
verses.translit: vhby' 't 'shmv lyhvh 'l ptch 'hl mv'd 'yl 'shm
verses.translation: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the LORD , unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.

verses.original: וְ/כִפֶּר֩ עָלָ֨י/ו הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן בְּ/אֵ֤יל הָֽ/אָשָׁם֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עַל חַטָּאת֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֑א וְ/נִסְלַ֣ח ל֔/וֹ מֵ/חַטָּאת֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָֽא
verses.translit: vkhpr 'lyv hkhhn b'yl h'shm lpny yhvh 'l cht'tv 'shr cht' vnslch lv mcht'tv 'shr cht'
verses.translation: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the LORD for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.

verses.original: וְ/כִי תָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל הָ/אָ֗רֶץ וּ/נְטַעְתֶּם֙ כָּל עֵ֣ץ מַאֲכָ֔ל וַ/עֲרַלְתֶּ֥ם עָרְלָת֖/וֹ אֶת פִּרְי֑/וֹ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֗ים יִהְיֶ֥ה לָ/כֶ֛ם עֲרֵלִ֖ים לֹ֥א יֵאָכֵֽל
verses.translit: vkhy tb'v 'l h'rts vnt'tm khl 'ts m'khl v'rltm 'rltv 't pryv shlsh shnym yhyh lkhm 'rlym l' y'khl
verses.translation: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/שָּׁנָה֙ הָ/רְבִיעִ֔ת יִהְיֶ֖ה כָּל פִּרְי֑/וֹ קֹ֥דֶשׁ הִלּוּלִ֖ים לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vbshnh hrby't yhyh khl pryv qdsh hlvlym lyhvh
verses.translation: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the LORD withal .

verses.original: וּ/בַ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ/חֲמִישִׁ֗ת תֹּֽאכְלוּ֙ אֶת פִּרְי֔/וֹ לְ/הוֹסִ֥יף לָ/כֶ֖ם תְּבוּאָת֑/וֹ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vbshnh hchmysht t'khlv 't pryv lhvsyf lkhm tbv'tv 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: לֹ֥א תֹאכְל֖וּ עַל הַ/דָּ֑ם לֹ֥א תְנַחֲשׁ֖וּ וְ/לֹ֥א תְעוֹנֵֽנוּ
verses.translit: l' t'khlv 'l hdm l' tnchshv vl' t'vnnv
verses.translation: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.

verses.original: לֹ֣א תַקִּ֔פוּ פְּאַ֖ת רֹאשְׁ/כֶ֑ם וְ/לֹ֣א תַשְׁחִ֔ית אֵ֖ת פְּאַ֥ת זְקָנֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: l' tqpv p't r'shkhm vl' tshchyt 't p't zqnkh
verses.translation: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.

verses.original: וְ/שֶׂ֣רֶט לָ/נֶ֗פֶשׁ לֹ֤א תִתְּנוּ֙ בִּ/בְשַׂרְ/כֶ֔ם וּ/כְתֹ֣בֶת קַֽעֲקַ֔ע לֹ֥א תִתְּנ֖וּ בָּ/כֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vshrt lnpsh l' ttnv bbshrkhm vkhtbt q'q' l' ttnv bkhm 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the LORD .

verses.original: אַל תְּחַלֵּ֥ל אֶֽת בִּתְּ/ךָ֖ לְ/הַזְנוֹתָ֑/הּ וְ/לֹא תִזְנֶ֣ה הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וּ/מָלְאָ֥ה הָ/אָ֖רֶץ זִמָּֽה
verses.translit: 'l tchll 't btkh lhznvth vl' tznh h'rts vml'h h'rts zmh
verses.translation: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.

verses.original: אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַ֣/י תִּשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וּ/מִקְדָּשִׁ֖/י תִּירָ֑אוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 't shbtty tshmrv vmqdshy tyr'v 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD .

verses.original: אַל תִּפְנ֤וּ אֶל הָ/אֹבֹת֙ וְ/אֶל הַ/יִּדְּעֹנִ֔ים אַל תְּבַקְשׁ֖וּ לְ/טָמְאָ֣ה בָ/הֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'l tpnv 'l h'bt v'l hyd'nym 'l tbqshv ltm'h bhm 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: מִ/פְּנֵ֤י שֵׂיבָה֙ תָּק֔וּם וְ/הָדַרְתָּ֖ פְּנֵ֣י זָקֵ֑ן וְ/יָרֵ֥אתָ מֵּ/אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: mpny shybh tqvm vhdrt pny zqn vyr't m'lhykh 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יָג֧וּר אִתְּ/ךָ֛ גֵּ֖ר בְּ/אַרְצְ/כֶ֑ם לֹ֥א תוֹנ֖וּ אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vkhy ygvr 'tkh gr b'rtskhm l' tvnv 'tv
verses.translation: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.

verses.original: כְּ/אֶזְרָ֣ח מִ/כֶּם֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה לָ/כֶ֜ם הַ/גֵּ֣ר הַ/גָּ֣ר אִתְּ/כֶ֗ם וְ/אָהַבְתָּ֥ ל/וֹ֙ כָּמ֔וֹ/ךָ כִּֽי גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: kh'zrch mkhm yhyh lkhm hgr hgr 'tkhm v'hbt lv khmvkh khy grym hyytm b'rts mtsrym 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.

verses.translit: l' t'shv 'vl bmshpt bmdh bmshql vbmshvrh
verses.translation: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.

verses.original: מֹ֧אזְנֵי צֶ֣דֶק אַבְנֵי צֶ֗דֶק אֵ֥יפַת צֶ֛דֶק וְ/הִ֥ין צֶ֖דֶק יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֑ם אֲנִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: m'zny tsdq 'bny tsdq 'ypt tsdq vhyn tsdq yhyh lkhm 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm 'shr hvts'ty 'tkhm m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֶת כָּל חֻקֹּתַ/י֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל מִשְׁפָּטַ֔/י וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑/ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vshmrtm 't khl chqty v't khl mshpty v'shytm 'tm 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: וְ/אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל תֹּאמַר֒ אִ֣ישׁ אִישׁ֩ מִ/בְּנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּ/מִן הַ/גֵּ֣ר הַ/גָּ֣ר בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֧ן מִ/זַּרְע֛/וֹ לַ/מֹּ֖לֶךְ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑ת עַ֥ם הָ/אָ֖רֶץ יִרְגְּמֻ֥/הוּ בָ/אָֽבֶן
verses.translit: v'l bny yshr'l t'mr 'ysh 'ysh mbny yshr'l vmn hgr hgr byshr'l 'shr ytn mzr'v lmlkh mvt yvmt 'm h'rts yrgmhv b'bn
verses.translation: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֞י אֶתֵּ֤ן אֶת פָּנַ/י֙ בָּ/אִ֣ישׁ הַ/ה֔וּא וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֥י אֹת֖/וֹ מִ/קֶּ֣רֶב עַמּ֑/וֹ כִּ֤י מִ/זַּרְע/וֹ֙ נָתַ֣ן לַ/מֹּ֔לֶךְ לְמַ֗עַן טַמֵּא֙ אֶת מִקְדָּשִׁ֔/י וּ/לְ/חַלֵּ֖ל אֶת שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשִֽׁ/י
verses.translit: v'ny 'tn 't pny b'ysh hhv' vhkhrty 'tv mqrb 'mv khy mzr'v ntn lmlkh lm'n tm' 't mqdshy vlchll 't shm qdshy
verses.translation: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֡ם הַעְלֵ֣ם יַעְלִימֽוּ֩ עַ֨ם הָ/אָ֜רֶץ אֶת עֵֽינֵי/הֶם֙ מִן הָ/אִ֣ישׁ הַ/ה֔וּא בְּ/תִתּ֥/וֹ מִ/זַּרְע֖/וֹ לַ/מֹּ֑לֶךְ לְ/בִלְתִּ֖י הָמִ֥ית אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'm h'lm y'lymv 'm h'rts 't 'ynyhm mn h'ysh hhv' bttv mzr'v lmlkh lblty hmyt 'tv
verses.translation: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֨י אֲנִ֧י אֶת פָּנַ֛/י בָּ/אִ֥ישׁ הַ/ה֖וּא וּ/בְ/מִשְׁפַּחְתּ֑/וֹ וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֨י אֹת֜/וֹ וְ/אֵ֣ת כָּל הַ/זֹּנִ֣ים אַחֲרָ֗י/ו לִ/זְנ֛וֹת אַחֲרֵ֥י הַ/מֹּ֖לֶךְ מִ/קֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vshmty 'ny 't pny b'ysh hhv' vbmshpchtv vhkhrty 'tv v't khl hznym 'chryv lznvt 'chry hmlkh mqrb 'mm
verses.translation: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נֶּ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּפְנֶ֤ה אֶל הָֽ/אֹבֹת֙ וְ/אֶל הַ/יִּדְּעֹנִ֔ים לִ/זְנ֖וֹת אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י אֶת פָּנַ/י֙ בַּ/נֶּ֣פֶשׁ הַ/הִ֔וא וְ/הִכְרַתִּ֥י אֹת֖/וֹ מִ/קֶּ֥רֶב עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhnpsh 'shr tpnh 'l h'bt v'l hyd'nym lznvt 'chryhm vntty 't pny bnpsh hhv' vhkhrty 'tv mqrb 'mv
verses.translation: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.

verses.original: וְ/הִ֨תְקַדִּשְׁתֶּ֔ם וִ/הְיִיתֶ֖ם קְדֹשִׁ֑ים כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhtqdshtm vhyytm qdshym khy 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת חֻקֹּתַ֔/י וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑/ם אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vshmrtm 't chqty v'shytm 'tm 'ny yhvh mqdshkhm
verses.translation: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am the LORD which sanctify you.

verses.original: כִּֽי אִ֣ישׁ אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְקַלֵּ֧ל אֶת אָבִ֛י/ו וְ/אֶת אִמּ֖/וֹ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑ת אָבִ֧י/ו וְ/אִמּ֛/וֹ קִלֵּ֖ל דָּמָ֥י/ו בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy 'ysh 'ysh 'shr yqll 't 'byv v't 'mv mvt yvmt 'byv v'mv qll dmyv bv
verses.translation: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִנְאַף֙ אֶת אֵ֣שֶׁת אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִנְאַ֖ף אֶת אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֑/הוּ מֽוֹת יוּמַ֥ת הַ/נֹּאֵ֖ף וְ/הַ/נֹּאָֽפֶת
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr yn'f 't 'sht 'ysh 'shr yn'f 't 'sht r'hv mvt yvmt hn'f vhn'pt
verses.translation: And the man that committeth adultery with another man’s wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour’s wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת אֵ֣שֶׁת אָבִ֔י/ו עֶרְוַ֥ת אָבִ֖י/ו גִּלָּ֑ה מֽוֹת יוּמְת֥וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶ֖ם דְּמֵי/הֶ֥ם בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr yshkhb 't 'sht 'byv 'rvt 'byv glh mvt yvmtv shnyhm dmyhm bm
verses.translation: And the man that lieth with his father’s wife hath uncovered his father’s nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת כַּלָּת֔/וֹ מ֥וֹת יוּמְת֖וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶ֑ם תֶּ֥בֶל עָשׂ֖וּ דְּמֵי/הֶ֥ם בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr yshkhb 't khltv mvt yvmtv shnyhm tbl 'shv dmyhm bm
verses.translation: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכַּ֤ב אֶת זָכָר֙ מִשְׁכְּבֵ֣י אִשָּׁ֔ה תּוֹעֵבָ֥ה עָשׂ֖וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶ֑ם מ֥וֹת יוּמָ֖תוּ דְּמֵי/הֶ֥ם בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr yshkhb 't zkhr mshkhby 'shh tv'bh 'shv shnyhm mvt yvmtv dmyhm bm
verses.translation: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִקַּ֧ח אֶת אִשָּׁ֛ה וְ/אֶת אִמָּ֖/הּ זִמָּ֣ה הִ֑וא בָּ/אֵ֞שׁ יִשְׂרְפ֤וּ אֹת/וֹ֙ וְ/אֶתְ/הֶ֔ן וְ/לֹא תִהְיֶ֥ה זִמָּ֖ה בְּ/תוֹכְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr yqch 't 'shh v't 'mh zmh hv' b'sh yshrpv 'tv v'thn vl' thyh zmh btvkhkhm
verses.translation: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֧ן שְׁכָבְתּ֛/וֹ בִּ/בְהֵמָ֖ה מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑ת וְ/אֶת הַ/בְּהֵמָ֖ה תַּהֲרֹֽגוּ
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr ytn shkhbtv bbhmh mvt yvmt v't hbhmh thrgv
verses.translation: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.

verses.original: וְ/אִשָּׁ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּקְרַ֤ב אֶל כָּל בְּהֵמָה֙ לְ/רִבְעָ֣ה אֹתָ֔/הּ וְ/הָרַגְתָּ֥ אֶת הָ/אִשָּׁ֖ה וְ/אֶת הַ/בְּהֵמָ֑ה מ֥וֹת יוּמָ֖תוּ דְּמֵי/הֶ֥ם בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'shh 'shr tqrb 'l khl bhmh lrb'h 'th vhrgt 't h'shh v't hbhmh mvt yvmtv dmyhm bm
verses.translation: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֣ישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקַּ֣ח אֶת אֲחֹת֡/וֹ בַּת אָבִ֣י/ו א֣וֹ בַת אִ֠מּ/וֹ וְ/רָאָ֨ה אֶת עֶרְוָתָ֜/הּ וְ/הִֽיא תִרְאֶ֤ה אֶת עֶרְוָת/וֹ֙ חֶ֣סֶד ה֔וּא וְ/נִ֨כְרְת֔וּ לְ/עֵינֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י עַמָּ֑/ם עֶרְוַ֧ת אֲחֹת֛/וֹ גִּלָּ֖ה עֲוֺנ֥/וֹ יִשָּֽׂא
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr yqch 't 'chtv bt 'byv 'v bt 'mv vr'h 't 'rvth vhy' tr'h 't 'rvtv chsd hv' vnkhrtv l'yny bny 'mm 'rvt 'chtv glh 'vnv ysh'
verses.translation: And if a man shall take his sister, his father’s daughter, or his mother’s daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister’s nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.

verses.original: וְ֠/אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִשְׁכַּ֨ב אֶת אִשָּׁ֜ה דָּוָ֗ה וְ/גִלָּ֤ה אֶת עֶרְוָתָ/הּ֙ אֶת מְקֹרָ֣/הּ הֶֽעֱרָ֔ה וְ/הִ֕יא גִּלְּתָ֖ה אֶת מְק֣וֹר דָּמֶ֑י/הָ וְ/נִכְרְת֥וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶ֖ם מִ/קֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr yshkhb 't 'shh dvh vglh 't 'rvth 't mqrh h'rh vhy' glth 't mqvr dmyh vnkhrtv shnyhm mqrb 'mm
verses.translation: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.

verses.original: וְ/עֶרְוַ֨ת אֲח֧וֹת אִמְּ/ךָ֛ וַ/אֲח֥וֹת אָבִ֖י/ךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה כִּ֧י אֶת שְׁאֵר֛/וֹ הֶעֱרָ֖ה עֲוֺנָ֥/ם יִשָּֽׂאוּ
verses.translit: v'rvt 'chvt 'mkh v'chvt 'bykh l' tglh khy 't sh'rv h'rh 'vnm ysh'v
verses.translation: And thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother’s sister, nor of thy father’s sister: for he uncovereth his near kin: they shall bear their iniquity.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁכַּב֙ אֶת דֹּ֣דָת֔/וֹ עֶרְוַ֥ת דֹּד֖/וֹ גִּלָּ֑ה חֶטְאָ֥/ם יִשָּׂ֖אוּ עֲרִירִ֥ים יָמֻֽתוּ
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr yshkhb 't ddtv 'rvt ddv glh cht'm ysh'v 'ryrym ymtv
verses.translation: And if a man shall lie with his uncle’s wife, he hath uncovered his uncle’s nakedness: they shall bear their sin; they shall die childless.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִקַּ֛ח אֶת אֵ֥שֶׁת אָחִ֖י/ו נִדָּ֣ה הִ֑וא עֶרְוַ֥ת אָחִ֛י/ו גִּלָּ֖ה עֲרִירִ֥ים יִהְיֽוּ
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr yqch 't 'sht 'chyv ndh hv' 'rvt 'chyv glh 'ryrym yhyv
verses.translation: And if a man shall take his brother’s wife, it is an unclean thing: he hath uncovered his brother’s nakedness; they shall be childless.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֶת כָּל חֻקֹּתַ/י֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל מִשְׁפָּטַ֔/י וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑/ם וְ/לֹא תָקִ֤יא אֶתְ/כֶם֙ הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנִ֜י מֵבִ֥יא אֶתְ/כֶ֛ם שָׁ֖מָּ/ה לָ/שֶׁ֥בֶת בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vshmrtm 't khl chqty v't khl mshpty v'shytm 'tm vl' tqy' 'tkhm h'rts 'shr 'ny mby' 'tkhm shmh lshbt bh
verses.translation: Ye shall therefore keep all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: that the land, whither I bring you to dwell therein, spue you not out.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֤א תֵֽלְכוּ֙ בְּ/חֻקֹּ֣ת הַ/גּ֔וֹי אֲשֶׁר אֲנִ֥י מְשַׁלֵּ֖חַ מִ/פְּנֵי/כֶ֑ם כִּ֤י אֶת כָּל אֵ֨לֶּה֙ עָשׂ֔וּ וָ/אָקֻ֖ץ בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vl' tlkhv bchqt hgvy 'shr 'ny mshlch mpnykhm khy 't khl 'lh 'shv v'qts bm
verses.translation: And ye shall not walk in the manners of the nation, which I cast out before you: for they committed all these things, and therefore I abhorred them.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֣ר לָ/כֶ֗ם אַתֶּם֮ תִּֽירְשׁ֣וּ אֶת אַדְמָתָ/ם֒ וַ/אֲנִ֞י אֶתְּנֶ֤/נָּה לָ/כֶם֙ לָ/רֶ֣שֶׁת אֹתָ֔/הּ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּ/דְבָ֑שׁ אֲנִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר הִבְדַּ֥לְתִּי אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מִן הָֽ/עַמִּֽים
verses.translit: v'mr lkhm 'tm tyrshv 't 'dmtm v'ny 'tnnh lkhm lrsht 'th 'rts zbt chlb vdbsh 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm 'shr hbdlty 'tkhm mn h'mym
verses.translation: But I have said unto you, Ye shall inherit their land, and I will give it unto you to possess it, a land that floweth with milk and honey: I am the LORD your God, which have separated you from other people.

verses.original: וְ/הִבְדַּלְתֶּ֞ם בֵּֽין הַ/בְּהֵמָ֤ה הַ/טְּהֹרָה֙ לַ/טְּמֵאָ֔ה וּ/בֵין הָ/ע֥וֹף הַ/טָּמֵ֖א לַ/טָּהֹ֑ר וְ/לֹֽא תְשַׁקְּצ֨וּ אֶת נַפְשֹֽׁתֵי/כֶ֜ם בַּ/בְּהֵמָ֣ה וּ/בָ/ע֗וֹף וּ/בְ/כֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּרְמֹ֣שׂ הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר הִבְדַּ֥לְתִּי לָ/כֶ֖ם לְ/טַמֵּֽא
verses.translit: vhbdltm byn hbhmh hthrh ltm'h vbyn h'vf htm' lthr vl' tshqtsv 't npshtykhm bbhmh vb'vf vbkhl 'shr trmsh h'dmh 'shr hbdlty lkhm ltm'
verses.translation: Ye shall therefore put difference between clean beasts and unclean, and between unclean fowls and clean: and ye shall not make your souls abominable by beast, or by fowl, or by any manner of living thing that creepeth on the ground, which I have separated from you as unclean.

verses.original: וִ/הְיִ֤יתֶם לִ/י֙ קְדֹשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י קָד֖וֹשׁ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וָ/אַבְדִּ֥ל אֶתְ/כֶ֛ם מִן הָֽ/עַמִּ֖ים לִ/הְי֥וֹת לִֽ/י
verses.translit: vhyytm ly qdshym khy qdvsh 'ny yhvh v'bdl 'tkhm mn h'mym lhyvt ly
verses.translation: And ye shall be holy unto me: for I the LORD am holy, and have severed you from other people, that ye should be mine.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֣ישׁ אֽוֹ אִשָּׁ֗ה כִּֽי יִהְיֶ֨ה בָ/הֶ֥ם א֛וֹב א֥וֹ יִדְּעֹנִ֖י מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֑תוּ בָּ/אֶ֛בֶן יִרְגְּמ֥וּ אֹתָ֖/ם דְּמֵי/הֶ֥ם בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'ysh 'v 'shh khy yhyh bhm 'vb 'v yd'ny mvt yvmtv b'bn yrgmv 'tm dmyhm bm
verses.translation: A man also or woman that hath a familiar spirit, or that is a wizard, shall surely be put to death: they shall stone them with stones: their blood shall be upon them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֱמֹ֥ר אֶל הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם לְ/נֶ֥פֶשׁ לֹֽא יִטַּמָּ֖א בְּ/עַמָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh 'mr 'l hkhhnym bny 'hrn v'mrt 'lhm lnpsh l' ytm' b'myv
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto the priests the sons of Aaron, and say unto them, There shall none be defiled for the dead among his people:

verses.original: כִּ֚י אִם לִ/שְׁאֵר֔/וֹ הַ/קָּרֹ֖ב אֵלָ֑י/ו לְ/אִמּ֣/וֹ וּ/לְ/אָבִ֔י/ו וְ/לִ/בְנ֥/וֹ וּ/לְ/בִתּ֖/וֹ וּ/לְ/אָחִֽי/ו
verses.translit: khy 'm lsh'rv hqrb 'lyv l'mv vl'byv vlbnv vlbtv vl'chyv
verses.translation: But for his kin, that is near unto him, that is , for his mother, and for his father, and for his son, and for his daughter, and for his brother,

verses.original: וְ/לַ/אֲחֹת֤/וֹ הַ/בְּתוּלָה֙ הַ/קְּרוֹבָ֣ה אֵלָ֔י/ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא הָיְתָ֖ה לְ/אִ֑ישׁ לָ֖/הּ יִטַּמָּֽא
verses.translit: vl'chtv hbtvlh hqrvbh 'lyv 'shr l' hyth l'ysh lh ytm'
verses.translation: And for his sister a virgin, that is nigh unto him, which hath had no husband; for her may he be defiled.

verses.translit: l' ytm' b'l b'myv lhchlv
verses.translation: But he shall not defile himself, being a chief man among his people, to profane himself.

verses.original: לֹֽא יקרחה יִקְרְח֤וּ קָרְחָה֙ בְּ/רֹאשָׁ֔/ם וּ/פְאַ֥ת זְקָנָ֖/ם לֹ֣א יְגַלֵּ֑חוּ וּ/בִ֨/בְשָׂרָ֔/ם לֹ֥א יִשְׂרְט֖וּ שָׂרָֽטֶת
verses.translit: l' yqrchh yqrchv qrchh br'shm vp't zqnm l' yglchv vbbshrm l' yshrtv shrtt
verses.translation: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.

verses.original: קְדֹשִׁ֤ים יִהְיוּ֙ לֵ/אלֹ֣הֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/לֹ֣א יְחַלְּל֔וּ שֵׁ֖ם אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֑ם כִּי֩ אֶת אִשֵּׁ֨י יְהוָ֜ה לֶ֧חֶם אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֛ם הֵ֥ם מַקְרִיבִ֖ם וְ/הָ֥יוּ קֹֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: qdshym yhyv l'lhyhm vl' ychllv shm 'lhyhm khy 't 'shy yhvh lchm 'lhyhm hm mqrybm vhyv qdsh
verses.translation: They shall be holy unto their God, and not profane the name of their God: for the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and the bread of their God, they do offer: therefore they shall be holy.

verses.original: אִשָּׁ֨ה זֹנָ֤ה וַ/חֲלָלָה֙ לֹ֣א יִקָּ֔חוּ וְ/אִשָּׁ֛ה גְּרוּשָׁ֥ה מֵ/אִישָׁ֖/הּ לֹ֣א יִקָּ֑חוּ כִּֽי קָדֹ֥שׁ ה֖וּא לֵ/אלֹהָֽי/ו
verses.translit: 'shh znh vchllh l' yqchv v'shh grvshh m'yshh l' yqchv khy qdsh hv' l'lhyv
verses.translation: They shall not take a wife that is a whore, or profane; neither shall they take a woman put away from her husband: for he is holy unto his God.

verses.original: וְ/קִדַּשְׁתּ֔/וֹ כִּֽי אֶת לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ ה֣וּא מַקְרִ֑יב קָדֹשׁ֙ יִֽהְיֶה לָּ֔/ךְ כִּ֣י קָד֔וֹשׁ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vqdshtv khy 't lchm 'lhykh hv' mqryb qdsh yhyh lkh khy qdvsh 'ny yhvh mqdshkhm
verses.translation: Thou shalt sanctify him therefore; for he offereth the bread of thy God: he shall be holy unto thee: for I the LORD , which sanctify you, am holy.

verses.original: וּ/בַת֙ אִ֣ישׁ כֹּהֵ֔ן כִּ֥י תֵחֵ֖ל לִ/זְנ֑וֹת אֶת אָבִ֨י/הָ֙ הִ֣יא מְחַלֶּ֔לֶת בָּ/אֵ֖שׁ תִּשָּׂרֵֽף
verses.translit: vbt 'ysh khhn khy tchl lznvt 't 'byh hy' mchllt b'sh tshrf
verses.translation: And the daughter of any priest, if she profane herself by playing the whore, she profaneth her father: she shall be burnt with fire.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/כֹּהֵן֩ הַ/גָּד֨וֹל מֵ/אֶחָ֜י/ו אֲֽשֶׁר יוּצַ֥ק עַל רֹאשׁ֣/וֹ שֶׁ֤מֶן הַ/מִּשְׁחָה֙ וּ/מִלֵּ֣א אֶת יָד֔/וֹ לִ/לְבֹּ֖שׁ אֶת הַ/בְּגָדִ֑ים אֶת רֹאשׁ/וֹ֙ לֹ֣א יִפְרָ֔ע וּ/בְגָדָ֖י/ו לֹ֥א יִפְרֹֽם
verses.translit: vhkhhn hgdvl m'chyv 'shr yvtsq 'l r'shv shmn hmshchh vml' 't ydv llbsh 't hbgdym 't r'shv l' ypr' vbgdyv l' yprm
verses.translation: And he that is the high priest among his brethren, upon whose head the anointing oil was poured, and that is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not uncover his head, nor rend his clothes;

verses.original: וְ/עַ֛ל כָּל נַפְשֹׁ֥ת מֵ֖ת לֹ֣א יָבֹ֑א לְ/אָבִ֥י/ו וּ/לְ/אִמּ֖/וֹ לֹ֥א יִטַּמָּֽא
verses.translit: v'l khl npsht mt l' yb' l'byv vl'mv l' ytm'
verses.translation: Neither shall he go in to any dead body, nor defile himself for his father, or for his mother;

verses.original: וּ/מִן הַ/מִּקְדָּשׁ֙ לֹ֣א יֵצֵ֔א וְ/לֹ֣א יְחַלֵּ֔ל אֵ֖ת מִקְדַּ֣שׁ אֱלֹהָ֑י/ו כִּ֡י נֵ֠זֶר שֶׁ֣מֶן מִשְׁחַ֧ת אֱלֹהָ֛י/ו עָלָ֖י/ו אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vmn hmqdsh l' yts' vl' ychll 't mqdsh 'lhyv khy nzr shmn mshcht 'lhyv 'lyv 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Neither shall he go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him: I am the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/ה֕וּא אִשָּׁ֥ה בִ/בְתוּלֶ֖י/הָ יִקָּֽח
verses.translit: vhv' 'shh bbtvlyh yqch
verses.translation: And he shall take a wife in her virginity.

verses.original: אַלְמָנָ֤ה וּ/גְרוּשָׁה֙ וַ/חֲלָלָ֣ה זֹנָ֔ה אֶת אֵ֖לֶּה לֹ֣א יִקָּ֑ח כִּ֛י אִם בְּתוּלָ֥ה מֵ/עַמָּ֖י/ו יִקַּ֥ח אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: 'lmnh vgrvshh vchllh znh 't 'lh l' yqch khy 'm btvlh m'myv yqch 'shh
verses.translation: A widow, or a divorced woman, or profane, or an harlot, these shall he not take: but he shall take a virgin of his own people to wife.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא יְחַלֵּ֥ל זַרְע֖/וֹ בְּ/עַמָּ֑י/ו כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: vl' ychll zr'v b'myv khy 'ny yhvh mqdshv
verses.translation: Neither shall he profane his seed among his people: for I the LORD do sanctify him.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֥ר אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אִ֣ישׁ מִֽ/זַּרְעֲ/ךָ֞ לְ/דֹרֹתָ֗/ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה ב/וֹ֙ מ֔וּם לֹ֣א יִקְרַ֔ב לְ/הַקְרִ֖יב לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהָֽי/ו
verses.translit: dbr 'l 'hrn l'mr 'ysh mzr'kh ldrtm 'shr yhyh bv mvm l' yqrb lhqryb lchm 'lhyv
verses.translation: Speak unto Aaron, saying, Whosoever he be of thy seed in their generations that hath any blemish, let him not approach to offer the bread of his God.

verses.original: כִּ֥י כָל אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר בּ֥/וֹ מ֖וּם לֹ֣א יִקְרָ֑ב אִ֤ישׁ עִוֵּר֙ א֣וֹ פִסֵּ֔חַ א֥וֹ חָרֻ֖ם א֥וֹ שָׂרֽוּעַ
verses.translit: khy khl 'ysh 'shr bv mvm l' yqrb 'ysh 'vr 'v psch 'v chrm 'v shrv'
verses.translation: For whatsoever man he be that hath a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or a lame, or he that hath a flat nose, or any thing superfluous,

verses.original: א֣וֹ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶ֥ה ב֖/וֹ שֶׁ֣בֶר רָ֑גֶל א֖וֹ שֶׁ֥בֶר יָֽד
verses.translit: 'v 'ysh 'shr yhyh bv shbr rgl 'v shbr yd
verses.translation: Or a man that is brokenfooted, or brokenhanded,

verses.original: אֽוֹ גִבֵּ֣ן אוֹ דַ֔ק א֖וֹ תְּבַלֻּ֣ל בְּ/עֵינ֑/וֹ א֤וֹ גָרָב֙ א֣וֹ יַלֶּ֔פֶת א֖וֹ מְר֥וֹחַ אָֽשֶׁךְ
verses.translit: 'v gbn 'v dq 'v tbll b'ynv 'v grb 'v ylpt 'v mrvch 'shkh
verses.translation: Or crookbackt, or a dwarf, or that hath a blemish in his eye, or be scurvy, or scabbed, or hath his stones broken;

verses.original: כָּל אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר בּ֣/וֹ מ֗וּם מִ/זֶּ֨רַע֙ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן לֹ֣א יִגַּ֔שׁ לְ/הַקְרִ֖יב אֶת אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מ֣וּם בּ֔/וֹ אֵ֚ת לֶ֣חֶם אֱלֹהָ֔י/ו לֹ֥א יִגַּ֖שׁ לְ/הַקְרִֽיב
verses.translit: khl 'ysh 'shr bv mvm mzr' 'hrn hkhhn l' ygsh lhqryb 't 'shy yhvh mvm bv 't lchm 'lhyv l' ygsh lhqryb
verses.translation: No man that hath a blemish of the seed of Aaron the priest shall come nigh to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire: he hath a blemish; he shall not come nigh to offer the bread of his God.

verses.original: לֶ֣חֶם אֱלֹהָ֔י/ו מִ/קָּדְשֵׁ֖י הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֑ים וּ/מִן הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֖ים יֹאכֵֽל
verses.translit: lchm 'lhyv mqdshy hqdshym vmn hqdshym y'khl
verses.translation: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ אֶל הַ/פָּרֹ֜כֶת לֹ֣א יָבֹ֗א וְ/אֶל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֛חַ לֹ֥א יִגַּ֖שׁ כִּֽי מ֣וּם בּ֑/וֹ וְ/לֹ֤א יְחַלֵּל֙ אֶת מִקְדָּשַׁ֔/י כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: 'kh 'l hprkht l' yb' v'l hmzbch l' ygsh khy mvm bv vl' ychll 't mqdshy khy 'ny yhvh mqdshm
verses.translation: Only he shall not go in unto the vail, nor come nigh unto the altar, because he hath a blemish; that he profane not my sanctuaries: for I the LORD do sanctify them.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְ/אֶל בָּנָ֑י/ו וְ/אֶֽל כָּל בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vydbr mshh 'l 'hrn v'l bnyv v'l khl bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And Moses told it unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְ/אֶל בָּנָ֗י/ו וְ/יִנָּֽזְרוּ֙ מִ/קָּדְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/לֹ֥א יְחַלְּל֖וּ אֶת שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֑/י אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵ֧ם מַקְדִּשִׁ֛ים לִ֖/י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: dbr 'l 'hrn v'l bnyv vynzrv mqdshy bny yshr'l vl' ychllv 't shm qdshy 'shr hm mqdshym ly 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, and that they profane not my holy name in those things which they hallow unto me: I am the LORD .

verses.original: אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם לְ/דֹרֹ֨תֵי/כֶ֜ם כָּל אִ֣ישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִקְרַ֣ב מִ/כָּל זַרְעֲ/כֶ֗ם אֶל הַ/קֳּדָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְדִּ֤ישׁוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה וְ/טֻמְאָת֖/וֹ עָלָ֑י/ו וְ/נִכְרְתָ֞ה הַ/נֶּ֧פֶשׁ הַ/הִ֛וא מִ/לְּ/פָנַ֖/י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'mr 'lhm ldrtykhm khl 'ysh 'shr yqrb mkhl zr'khm 'l hqdshym 'shr yqdyshv bny yshr'l lyhvh vtm'tv 'lyv vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' mlpny 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed among your generations, that goeth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto the LORD , having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from my presence: I am the LORD .

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ אִ֞ישׁ מִ/זֶּ֣רַע אַהֲרֹ֗ן וְ/ה֤וּא צָר֨וּעַ֙ א֣וֹ זָ֔ב בַּ/קֳּדָשִׁים֙ לֹ֣א יֹאכַ֔ל עַ֖ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִטְהָ֑ר וְ/הַ/נֹּגֵ֨עַ֙ בְּ/כָל טְמֵא נֶ֔פֶשׁ א֣וֹ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁר תֵּצֵ֥א מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ שִׁכְבַת זָֽרַע
verses.translit: 'ysh 'ysh mzr' 'hrn vhv' tsrv' 'v zb bqdshym l' y'khl 'd 'shr ythr vhng' bkhl tm' npsh 'v 'ysh 'shr tts' mmnv shkhbt zr'
verses.translation: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath a running issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth any thing that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;

verses.original: אוֹ אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִגַּ֔ע בְּ/כָל שֶׁ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִטְמָא ל֑/וֹ א֤וֹ בְ/אָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִטְמָא ל֔/וֹ לְ/כֹ֖ל טֻמְאָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'v 'ysh 'shr yg' bkhl shrts 'shr ytm' lv 'v b'dm 'shr ytm' lv lkhl tm'tv
verses.translation: Or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;

verses.original: נֶ֚פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּגַּע בּ֔/וֹ וְ/טָמְאָ֖ה עַד הָ/עָ֑רֶב וְ/לֹ֤א יֹאכַל֙ מִן הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֔ים כִּ֛י אִם רָחַ֥ץ בְּשָׂר֖/וֹ בַּ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: npsh 'shr tg' bv vtm'h 'd h'rb vl' y'khl mn hqdshym khy 'm rchts bshrv bmym
verses.translation: The soul which hath touched any such shall be unclean until even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he wash his flesh with water.

verses.original: וּ/בָ֥א הַ/שֶּׁ֖מֶשׁ וְ/טָהֵ֑ר וְ/אַחַר֙ יֹאכַ֣ל מִן הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֔ים כִּ֥י לַחְמ֖/וֹ הֽוּא
verses.translit: vb' hshmsh vthr v'chr y'khl mn hqdshym khy lchmv hv'
verses.translation: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean, and shall afterward eat of the holy things; because it is his food.

verses.original: נְבֵלָ֧ה וּ/טְרֵפָ֛ה לֹ֥א יֹאכַ֖ל לְ/טָמְאָה בָ֑/הּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: nblh vtrph l' y'khl ltm'h bh 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: That which dieth of itself, or is torn with beasts , he shall not eat to defile himself therewith: I am the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמְר֣וּ אֶת מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֗/י וְ/לֹֽא יִשְׂא֤וּ עָלָי/ו֙ חֵ֔טְא וּ/מֵ֥תוּ ב֖/וֹ כִּ֣י יְחַלְּלֻ֑/הוּ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: vshmrv 't mshmrty vl' ysh'v 'lyv cht' vmtv bv khy ychllhv 'ny yhvh mqdshm
verses.translation: They shall therefore keep mine ordinance, lest they bear sin for it, and die therefore, if they profane it: I the LORD do sanctify them.

verses.original: וְ/כָל זָ֖ר לֹא יֹ֣אכַל קֹ֑דֶשׁ תּוֹשַׁ֥ב כֹּהֵ֛ן וְ/שָׂכִ֖יר לֹא יֹ֥אכַל קֹֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: vkhl zr l' y'khl qdsh tvshb khhn vshkhyr l' y'khl qdsh
verses.translation: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest, or an hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

verses.original: וְ/כֹהֵ֗ן כִּֽי יִקְנֶ֥ה נֶ֨פֶשׁ֙ קִנְיַ֣ן כַּסְפּ֔/וֹ ה֖וּא יֹ֣אכַל בּ֑/וֹ וִ/ילִ֣יד בֵּית֔/וֹ הֵ֖ם יֹאכְל֥וּ בְ/לַחְמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vkhhn khy yqnh npsh qnyn khspv hv' y'khl bv vylyd bytv hm y'khlv blchmv
verses.translation: But if the priest buy any soul with his money, he shall eat of it, and he that is born in his house: they shall eat of his meat.

verses.original: וּ/בַת כֹּהֵ֔ן כִּ֥י תִהְיֶ֖ה לְ/אִ֣ישׁ זָ֑ר הִ֕וא בִּ/תְרוּמַ֥ת הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֖ים לֹ֥א תֹאכֵֽל
verses.translit: vbt khhn khy thyh l'ysh zr hv' btrvmt hqdshym l' t'khl
verses.translation: If the priest’s daughter also be married unto a stranger, she may not eat of an offering of the holy things.

verses.original: וּ/בַת כֹּהֵן֩ כִּ֨י תִהְיֶ֜ה אַלְמָנָ֣ה וּ/גְרוּשָׁ֗ה וְ/זֶרַע֮ אֵ֣ין לָ/הּ֒ וְ/שָׁבָ֞ה אֶל בֵּ֤ית אָבִ֨י/הָ֙ כִּ/נְעוּרֶ֔י/הָ מִ/לֶּ֥חֶם אָבִ֖י/הָ תֹּאכֵ֑ל וְ/כָל זָ֖ר לֹא יֹ֥אכַל בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vbt khhn khy thyh 'lmnh vgrvshh vzr' 'yn lh vshbh 'l byt 'byh khn'vryh mlchm 'byh t'khl vkhl zr l' y'khl bv
verses.translation: But if the priest’s daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and is returned unto her father’s house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father’s meat: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֕ישׁ כִּֽי יֹאכַ֥ל קֹ֖דֶשׁ בִּ/שְׁגָגָ֑ה וְ/יָסַ֤ף חֲמִֽשִׁית/וֹ֙ עָלָ֔י/ו וְ/נָתַ֥ן לַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן אֶת הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: v'ysh khy y'khl qdsh bshggh vysf chmshytv 'lyv vntn lkhhn 't hqdsh
verses.translation: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give it unto the priest with the holy thing.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֣א יְחַלְּל֔וּ אֶת קָדְשֵׁ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר יָרִ֖ימוּ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vl' ychllv 't qdshy bny yshr'l 't 'shr yrymv lyhvh
verses.translation: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto the LORD ;

verses.original: וְ/הִשִּׂ֤יאוּ אוֹתָ/ם֙ עֲוֺ֣ן אַשְׁמָ֔ה בְּ/אָכְלָ֖/ם אֶת קָדְשֵׁי/הֶ֑ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדְּשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: vhshy'v 'vtm 'vn 'shmh b'khlm 't qdshyhm khy 'ny yhvh mqdshm
verses.translation: Or suffer them to bear the iniquity of trespass, when they eat their holy things: for I the LORD do sanctify them.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
