verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְ/אֶל בָּנָ֗י/ו וְ/אֶל֙ כָּל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם אִ֣ישׁ אִישׁ֩ מִ/בֵּ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּ/מִן הַ/גֵּ֣ר בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְרִ֤יב קָרְבָּנ/וֹ֙ לְ/כָל נִדְרֵי/הֶם֙ וּ/לְ/כָל נִדְבוֹתָ֔/ם אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִ֥יבוּ לַ/יהוָ֖ה לְ/עֹלָֽה
verses.translit: dbr 'l 'hrn v'l bnyv v'l khl bny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm 'ysh 'ysh mbyt yshr'l vmn hgr byshr'l 'shr yqryb qrbnv lkhl ndryhm vlkhl ndbvtm 'shr yqrybv lyhvh l'lh
verses.translation: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whatsoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers in Israel, that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto the LORD for a burnt offering;

verses.original: לִֽ/רְצֹנְ/כֶ֑ם תָּמִ֣ים זָכָ֔ר בַּ/בָּקָ֕ר בַּ/כְּשָׂבִ֖ים וּ/בָֽ/עִזִּֽים
verses.translit: lrtsnkhm tmym zkhr bbqr bkhshbym vb'zym
verses.translation: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats.

verses.original: כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר בּ֥/וֹ מ֖וּם לֹ֣א תַקְרִ֑יבוּ כִּי לֹ֥א לְ/רָצ֖וֹן יִהְיֶ֥ה לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khl 'shr bv mvm l' tqrybv khy l' lrtsvn yhyh lkhm
verses.translation: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֗ישׁ כִּֽי יַקְרִ֤יב זֶֽבַח שְׁלָמִים֙ לַ/יהוָ֔ה לְ/פַלֵּא נֶ֨דֶר֙ א֣וֹ לִ/נְדָבָ֔ה בַּ/בָּקָ֖ר א֣וֹ בַ/צֹּ֑אן תָּמִ֤ים יִֽהְיֶה֙ לְ/רָצ֔וֹן כָּל מ֖וּם לֹ֥א יִהְיֶה בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'ysh khy yqryb zbch shlmym lyhvh lpl' ndr 'v lndbh bbqr 'v bts'n tmym yhyh lrtsvn khl mvm l' yhyh bv
verses.translation: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD to accomplish his vow, or a freewill offering in beeves or sheep, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.

verses.original: עַוֶּרֶת֩ א֨וֹ שָׁב֜וּר אוֹ חָר֣וּץ אֽוֹ יַבֶּ֗לֶת א֤וֹ גָרָב֙ א֣וֹ יַלֶּ֔פֶת לֹא תַקְרִ֥יבוּ אֵ֖לֶּה לַ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/אִשֶּׁ֗ה לֹא תִתְּנ֥וּ מֵ/הֶ֛ם עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'vrt 'v shbvr 'v chrvts 'v yblt 'v grb 'v ylpt l' tqrybv 'lh lyhvh v'shh l' ttnv mhm 'l hmzbch lyhvh
verses.translation: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto the LORD , nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/שׁ֥וֹר וָ/שֶׂ֖ה שָׂר֣וּעַ וְ/קָל֑וּט נְדָבָה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹת֔/וֹ וּ/לְ/נֵ֖דֶר לֹ֥א יֵרָצֶֽה
verses.translit: vshvr vshh shrv' vqlvt ndbh t'shh 'tv vlndr l' yrtsh
verses.translation: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath any thing superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

verses.original: וּ/מָע֤וּךְ וְ/כָתוּת֙ וְ/נָת֣וּק וְ/כָר֔וּת לֹ֥א תַקְרִ֖יבוּ לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה וּֽ/בְ/אַרְצְ/כֶ֖ם לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: vm'vkh vkhtvt vntvq vkhrvt l' tqrybv lyhvh vb'rtskhm l' t'shv
verses.translation: Ye shall not offer unto the LORD that which is bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut; neither shall ye make any offering thereof in your land.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/יַּ֣ד בֶּן נֵכָ֗ר לֹ֥א תַקְרִ֛יבוּ אֶת לֶ֥חֶם אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֖ם מִ/כָּל אֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֣י מָשְׁחָתָ֤/ם בָּ/הֶם֙ מ֣וּם בָּ֔/ם לֹ֥א יֵרָצ֖וּ לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vmyd bn nkhr l' tqrybv 't lchm 'lhykhm mkhl 'lh khy mshchtm bhm mvm bm l' yrtsv lkhm
verses.translation: Neither from a stranger’s hand shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, and blemishes be in them: they shall not be accepted for you.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: שׁ֣וֹר אוֹ כֶ֤שֶׂב אוֹ עֵז֙ כִּ֣י יִוָּלֵ֔ד וְ/הָיָ֛ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים תַּ֣חַת אִמּ֑/וֹ וּ/מִ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/שְּׁמִינִי֙ וָ/הָ֔לְאָה יֵרָצֶ֕ה לְ/קָרְבַּ֥ן אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: shvr 'v khshb 'v 'z khy yvld vhyh shb't ymym tcht 'mv vmyvm hshmyny vhl'h yrtsh lqrbn 'shh lyhvh
verses.translation: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for an offering made by fire unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/שׁ֖וֹר אוֹ שֶׂ֑ה אֹת֣/וֹ וְ/אֶת בְּנ֔/וֹ לֹ֥א תִשְׁחֲט֖וּ בְּ/י֥וֹם אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vshvr 'v shh 'tv v't bnv l' tshchtv byvm 'chd
verses.translation: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and her young both in one day.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי תִזְבְּח֥וּ זֶֽבַח תּוֹדָ֖ה לַ/יהוָ֑ה לִֽ/רְצֹנְ/כֶ֖ם תִּזְבָּֽחוּ
verses.translit: vkhy tzbchv zbch tvdh lyhvh lrtsnkhm tzbchv
verses.translation: And when ye will offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto the LORD , offer it at your own will.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/הוּא֙ יֵאָכֵ֔ל לֹֽא תוֹתִ֥ירוּ מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ עַד בֹּ֑קֶר אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: byvm hhv' y'khl l' tvtyrv mmnv 'd bqr 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am the LORD .

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ מִצְוֺתַ֔/י וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑/ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vshmrtm mtsvty v'shytm 'tm 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֤א תְחַלְּלוּ֙ אֶת שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֔/י וְ/נִ֨קְדַּשְׁתִּ֔י בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vl' tchllv 't shm qdshy vnqdshty btvkh bny yshr'l 'ny yhvh mqdshkhm
verses.translation: Neither shall ye profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am the LORD which hallow you,

verses.original: הַ/מּוֹצִ֤יא אֶתְ/כֶם֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִ/הְי֥וֹת לָ/כֶ֖ם לֵ/אלֹהִ֑ים אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hmvtsy' 'tkhm m'rts mtsrym lhyvt lkhm l'lhym 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: That brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם מוֹעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרְא֥וּ אֹתָ֖/ם מִקְרָאֵ֣י קֹ֑דֶשׁ אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מוֹעֲדָֽ/י
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm mv'dy yhvh 'shr tqr'v 'tm mqr'y qdsh 'lh hm mv'dy
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of the LORD , which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.

verses.original: שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִים֮ תֵּעָשֶׂ֣ה מְלָאכָה֒ וּ/בַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֗י שַׁבַּ֤ת שַׁבָּתוֹן֙ מִקְרָא קֹ֔דֶשׁ כָּל מְלָאכָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ שַׁבָּ֥ת הִוא֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה בְּ/כֹ֖ל מֽוֹשְׁבֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: shsht ymym t'shh ml'khh vbyvm hshby'y shbt shbtvn mqr' qdsh khl ml'khh l' t'shv shbt hv' lyhvh bkhl mvshbtykhm
verses.translation: Six days shall work be done: but the seventh day is the sabbath of rest, an holy convocation; ye shall do no work therein: it is the sabbath of the LORD in all your dwellings.

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה מוֹעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מִקְרָאֵ֖י קֹ֑דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרְא֥וּ אֹתָ֖/ם בְּ/מוֹעֲדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'lh mv'dy yhvh mqr'y qdsh 'shr tqr'v 'tm bmv'dm
verses.translation: These are the feasts of the LORD , even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.

verses.original: בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשׁ֗וֹן בְּ/אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר לַ/חֹ֖דֶשׁ בֵּ֣ין הָ/עַרְבָּ֑יִם פֶּ֖סַח לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: bchdsh hr'shvn b'rb'h 'shr lchdsh byn h'rbym psch lyhvh
verses.translation: In the fourteenth day of the first month at even is the LORD’s passover.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/זֶּ֔ה חַ֥ג הַ/מַּצּ֖וֹת לַ/יהוָ֑ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים מַצּ֥וֹת תֹּאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: vbchmshh 'shr yvm lchdsh hzh chg hmtsvt lyhvh shb't ymym mtsvt t'khlv
verses.translation: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread unto the LORD : seven days ye must eat unleavened bread.

verses.original: בַּ/יּוֹם֙ הָֽ/רִאשׁ֔וֹן מִקְרָא קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֑ם כָּל מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: byvm hr'shvn mqr' qdsh yhyh lkhm khl ml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv
verses.translation: In the first day ye shall have an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם אִשֶּׁ֛ה לַ/יהוָ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים בַּ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִי֙ מִקְרָא קֹ֔דֶשׁ כָּל מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: vhqrbtm 'shh lyhvh shb't ymym byvm hshby'y mqr' qdsh khl ml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv
verses.translation: But ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD seven days: in the seventh day is an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein .

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם כִּֽי תָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ/כֶ֔ם וּ/קְצַרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת קְצִירָ֑/הּ וַ/הֲבֵאתֶ֥ם אֶת עֹ֛מֶר רֵאשִׁ֥ית קְצִירְ/כֶ֖ם אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm khy tb'v 'l h'rts 'shr 'ny ntn lkhm vqtsrtm 't qtsyrh vhb'tm 't 'mr r'shyt qtsyrkhm 'l hkhhn
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land which I give unto you, and shall reap the harvest thereof, then ye shall bring a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest unto the priest:

verses.original: וְ/הֵנִ֧יף אֶת הָ/עֹ֛מֶר לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לִֽ/רְצֹנְ/כֶ֑ם מִֽ/מָּחֳרַת֙ הַ/שַּׁבָּ֔ת יְנִיפֶ֖/נּוּ הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: vhnyf 't h'mr lpny yhvh lrtsnkhm mmchrt hshbt ynypnv hkhhn
verses.translation: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD , to be accepted for you: on the morrow after the sabbath the priest shall wave it.

verses.original: וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֕ם בְּ/י֥וֹם הֲנִֽיפְ/כֶ֖ם אֶת הָ/עֹ֑מֶר כֶּ֣בֶשׂ תָּמִ֧ים בֶּן שְׁנָת֛/וֹ לְ/עֹלָ֖ה לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'shytm byvm hnypkhm 't h'mr khbsh tmym bn shntv l'lh lyhvh
verses.translation: And ye shall offer that day when ye wave the sheaf an he lamb without blemish of the first year for a burnt offering unto the LORD .

verses.original: וּ/מִנְחָת/וֹ֩ שְׁנֵ֨י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים סֹ֣לֶת בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַ/שֶּׁ֛מֶן אִשֶּׁ֥ה לַ/יהוָ֖ה רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֑חַ וְ/נִסְכֹּ֥/ה יַ֖יִן רְבִיעִ֥ת הַ/הִֽין
verses.translit: vmnchtv shny 'shrnym slt blvlh bshmn 'shh lyhvh rych nychch vnskhh yyn rby't hhyn
verses.translation: And the meat offering thereof shall be two tenth deals of fine flour mingled with oil, an offering made by fire unto the LORD for a sweet savour: and the drink offering thereof shall be of wine, the fourth part of an hin.

verses.original: וְ/לֶחֶם֩ וְ/קָלִ֨י וְ/כַרְמֶ֜ל לֹ֣א תֹֽאכְל֗וּ עַד עֶ֨צֶם֙ הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה עַ֚ד הֲבִ֣יאֲ/כֶ֔ם אֶת קָרְבַּ֖ן אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֑ם חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְ/דֹרֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם בְּ/כֹ֖ל מֹשְׁבֹֽתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vlchm vqly vkhrml l' t'khlv 'd 'tsm hyvm hzh 'd hby'khm 't qrbn 'lhykhm chqt 'vlm ldrtykhm bkhl mshbtykhm
verses.translation: And ye shall eat neither bread, nor parched corn, nor green ears, until the selfsame day that ye have brought an offering unto your God: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

verses.original: וּ/סְפַרְתֶּ֤ם לָ/כֶם֙ מִ/מָּחֳרַ֣ת הַ/שַּׁבָּ֔ת מִ/יּוֹם֙ הֲבִ֣יאֲ/כֶ֔ם אֶת עֹ֖מֶר הַ/תְּנוּפָ֑ה שֶׁ֥בַע שַׁבָּת֖וֹת תְּמִימֹ֥ת תִּהְיֶֽינָה
verses.translit: vsprtm lkhm mmchrt hshbt myvm hby'khm 't 'mr htnvph shb' shbtvt tmymt thyynh
verses.translation: And ye shall count unto you from the morrow after the sabbath, from the day that ye brought the sheaf of the wave offering; seven sabbaths shall be complete:

verses.original: עַ֣ד מִֽ/מָּחֳרַ֤ת הַ/שַּׁבָּת֙ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔ת תִּסְפְּר֖וּ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים י֑וֹם וְ/הִקְרַבְתֶּ֛ם מִנְחָ֥ה חֲדָשָׁ֖ה לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'd mmchrt hshbt hshby't tsprv chmshym yvm vhqrbtm mnchh chdshh lyhvh
verses.translation: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto the LORD .

verses.original: מִ/מּוֹשְׁבֹ֨תֵי/כֶ֜ם תָּבִ֣יאּוּ לֶ֣חֶם תְּנוּפָ֗ה שְׁ֚תַּיִם שְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים סֹ֣לֶת תִּהְיֶ֔ינָה חָמֵ֖ץ תֵּאָפֶ֑ינָה בִּכּוּרִ֖ים לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: mmvshbtykhm tby'v lchm tnvph shtym shny 'shrnym slt thyynh chmts t'pynh bkhvrym lyhvh
verses.translation: Ye shall bring out of your habitations two wave loaves of two tenth deals: they shall be of fine flour; they shall be baken with leaven; they are the firstfruits unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרַבְתֶּ֣ם עַל הַ/לֶּ֗חֶם שִׁבְעַ֨ת כְּבָשִׂ֤ים תְּמִימִם֙ בְּנֵ֣י שָׁנָ֔ה וּ/פַ֧ר בֶּן בָּקָ֛ר אֶחָ֖ד וְ/אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם יִהְי֤וּ עֹלָה֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה וּ/מִנְחָתָ/ם֙ וְ/נִסְכֵּי/הֶ֔ם אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhqrbtm 'l hlchm shb't khbshym tmymm bny shnh vpr bn bqr 'chd v'ylm shnym yhyv 'lh lyhvh vmnchtm vnskhyhm 'shh rych nychch lyhvh
verses.translation: And ye shall offer with the bread seven lambs without blemish of the first year, and one young bullock, and two rams: they shall be for a burnt offering unto the LORD , with their meat offering, and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of sweet savour unto the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֛ם שְׂעִיר עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד לְ/חַטָּ֑את וּ/שְׁנֵ֧י כְבָשִׂ֛ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָ֖ה לְ/זֶ֥בַח שְׁלָמִֽים
verses.translit: v'shytm sh'yr 'zym 'chd lcht't vshny khbshym bny shnh lzbch shlmym
verses.translation: Then ye shall sacrifice one kid of the goats for a sin offering, and two lambs of the first year for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

verses.original: וְ/הֵנִ֣יף הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן אֹתָ֡/ם עַל֩ לֶ֨חֶם הַ/בִּכּוּרִ֤ים תְּנוּפָה֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה עַל שְׁנֵ֖י כְּבָשִׂ֑ים קֹ֛דֶשׁ יִהְי֥וּ לַ/יהוָ֖ה לַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: vhnyf hkhhn 'tm 'l lchm hbkhvrym tnvph lpny yhvh 'l shny khbshym qdsh yhyv lyhvh lkhhn
verses.translation: And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the firstfruits for a wave offering before the LORD , with the two lambs: they shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.

verses.original: וּ/קְרָאתֶ֞ם בְּ/עֶ֣צֶם הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֗ה מִֽקְרָא קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֔ם כָּל מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֛ם בְּ/כָל מוֹשְׁבֹ֥תֵי/כֶ֖ם לְ/דֹרֹֽתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vqr'tm b'tsm hyvm hzh mqr' qdsh yhyh lkhm khl ml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv chqt 'vlm bkhl mvshbtykhm ldrtykhm
verses.translation: And ye shall proclaim on the selfsame day, that it may be an holy convocation unto you: ye shall do no servile work therein: it shall be a statute for ever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

verses.original: וּֽ/בְ/קֻצְרְ/כֶ֞ם אֶת קְצִ֣יר אַרְצְ/כֶ֗ם לֹֽא תְכַלֶּ֞ה פְּאַ֤ת שָֽׂדְ/ךָ֙ בְּ/קֻצְרֶ֔/ךָ וְ/לֶ֥קֶט קְצִירְ/ךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְלַקֵּ֑ט לֶֽ/עָנִ֤י וְ/לַ/גֵּר֙ תַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֹתָ֔/ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vbqtsrkhm 't qtsyr 'rtskhm l' tkhlh p't shdkh bqtsrkh vlqt qtsyrkh l' tlqt l'ny vlgr t'zb 'tm 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not make clean riddance of the corners of thy field when thou reapest, neither shalt thou gather any gleaning of thy harvest: thou shalt leave them unto the poor, and to the stranger: I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר בַּ/חֹ֨דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֜י בְּ/אֶחָ֣ד לַ/חֹ֗דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֤ה לָ/כֶם֙ שַׁבָּת֔וֹן זִכְר֥וֹן תְּרוּעָ֖ה מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l l'mr bchdsh hshby'y b'chd lchdsh yhyh lkhm shbtvn zkhrvn trv'h mqr' qdsh
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, In the seventh month, in the first day of the month, shall ye have a sabbath, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, an holy convocation.

verses.original: כָּל מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ וְ/הִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: khl ml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv vhqrbtm 'shh lyhvh
verses.translation: Ye shall do no servile work therein: but ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: אַ֡ךְ בֶּ/עָשׂ֣וֹר לַ/חֹדֶשׁ֩ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֨י הַ/זֶּ֜ה י֧וֹם הַ/כִּפֻּרִ֣ים ה֗וּא מִֽקְרָא קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֔ם וְ/עִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/הִקְרַבְתֶּ֥ם אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'kh b'shvr lchdsh hshby'y hzh yvm hkhprym hv' mqr' qdsh yhyh lkhm v'nytm 't npshtykhm vhqrbtm 'shh lyhvh
verses.translation: Also on the tenth day of this seventh month there shall be a day of atonement: it shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall afflict your souls, and offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/כָל מְלָאכָה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ בְּ/עֶ֖צֶם הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה כִּ֣י י֤וֹם כִּפֻּרִים֙ ה֔וּא לְ/כַפֵּ֣ר עֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם לִ/פְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vkhl ml'khh l' t'shv b'tsm hyvm hzh khy yvm khprym hv' lkhpr 'lykhm lpny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: And ye shall do no work in that same day: for it is a day of atonement, to make an atonement for you before the LORD your God.

verses.original: כִּ֤י כָל הַ/נֶּ֨פֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא תְעֻנֶּ֔ה בְּ/עֶ֖צֶם הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/נִכְרְתָ֖ה מֵֽ/עַמֶּֽי/הָ
verses.translit: khy khl hnpsh 'shr l' t'nh b'tsm hyvm hzh vnkhrth m'myh
verses.translation: For whatsoever soul it be that shall not be afflicted in that same day, he shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הַ/נֶּ֗פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ כָּל מְלָאכָ֔ה בְּ/עֶ֖צֶם הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/הַֽאֲבַדְתִּ֛י אֶת הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/הִ֖וא מִ/קֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vkhl hnpsh 'shr t'shh khl ml'khh b'tsm hyvm hzh vh'bdty 't hnpsh hhv' mqrb 'mh
verses.translation: And whatsoever soul it be that doeth any work in that same day, the same soul will I destroy from among his people.

verses.original: כָּל מְלָאכָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְ/דֹרֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם בְּ/כֹ֖ל מֹֽשְׁבֹֽתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khl ml'khh l' t'shv chqt 'vlm ldrtykhm bkhl mshbtykhm
verses.translation: Ye shall do no manner of work: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

verses.original: שַׁבַּ֨ת שַׁבָּת֥וֹן הוּא֙ לָ/כֶ֔ם וְ/עִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵי/כֶ֑ם בְּ/תִשְׁעָ֤ה לַ/חֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ בָּ/עֶ֔רֶב מֵ/עֶ֣רֶב עַד עֶ֔רֶב תִּשְׁבְּת֖וּ שַׁבַּתְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: shbt shbtvn hv' lkhm v'nytm 't npshtykhm btsh'h lchdsh b'rb m'rb 'd 'rb tshbtv shbtkhm
verses.translation: It shall be unto you a sabbath of rest, and ye shall afflict your souls: in the ninth day of the month at even, from even unto even, shall ye celebrate your sabbath.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר בַּ/חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֜ר י֗וֹם לַ/חֹ֤דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִי֙ הַ/זֶּ֔ה חַ֧ג הַ/סֻּכּ֛וֹת שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים לַ/יהֹוָֽה
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l l'mr bchmshh 'shr yvm lchdsh hshby'y hzh chg hskhvt shb't ymym lyhvh
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, The fifteenth day of this seventh month shall be the feast of tabernacles for seven days unto the LORD .

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הָ/רִאשׁ֖וֹן מִקְרָא קֹ֑דֶשׁ כָּל מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: byvm hr'shvn mqr' qdsh khl ml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv
verses.translation: On the first day shall be an holy convocation: ye shall do no servile work therein .

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים תַּקְרִ֥יבוּ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַ/יהוָ֑ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֡י מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה לָ/כֶ֜ם וְ/הִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם אִשֶּׁ֤ה לַֽ/יהוָה֙ עֲצֶ֣רֶת הִ֔וא כָּל מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: shb't ymym tqrybv 'shh lyhvh byvm hshmyny mqr' qdsh yhyh lkhm vhqrbtm 'shh lyhvh 'tsrt hv' khl ml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv
verses.translation: Seven days ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD : on the eighth day shall be an holy convocation unto you; and ye shall offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD : it is a solemn assembly; and ye shall do no servile work therein .

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה מוֹעֲדֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר תִּקְרְא֥וּ אֹתָ֖/ם מִקְרָאֵ֣י קֹ֑דֶשׁ לְ/הַקְרִ֨יב אִשֶּׁ֜ה לַ/יהוָ֗ה עֹלָ֧ה וּ/מִנְחָ֛ה זֶ֥בַח וּ/נְסָכִ֖ים דְּבַר י֥וֹם בְּ/יוֹמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'lh mv'dy yhvh 'shr tqr'v 'tm mqr'y qdsh lhqryb 'shh lyhvh 'lh vmnchh zbch vnskhym dbr yvm byvmv
verses.translation: These are the feasts of the LORD , which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire unto the LORD , a burnt offering, and a meat offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, every thing upon his day:

verses.original: מִ/לְּ/בַ֖ד שַׁבְּתֹ֣ת יְּהוָ֑ה וּ/מִ/לְּ/בַ֣ד מַתְּנֽוֹתֵי/כֶ֗ם וּ/מִ/לְּ/בַ֤ד כָּל נִדְרֵי/כֶם֙ וּ/מִ/לְּ/בַד֙ כָּל נִדְב֣וֹתֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּתְּנ֖וּ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: mlbd shbtt yhvh vmlbd mtnvtykhm vmlbd khl ndrykhm vmlbd khl ndbvtykhm 'shr ttnv lyhvh
verses.translation: Beside the sabbaths of the LORD , and beside your gifts, and beside all your vows, and beside all your freewill offerings, which ye give unto the LORD .

verses.original: אַ֡ךְ בַּ/חֲמִשָּׁה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֜וֹם לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֗י בְּ/אָסְפְּ/כֶם֙ אֶת תְּבוּאַ֣ת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ תָּחֹ֥גּוּ אֶת חַג יְהוָ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים בַּ/יּ֤וֹם הָֽ/רִאשׁוֹן֙ שַׁבָּת֔וֹן וּ/בַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֖י שַׁבָּתֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'kh bchmshh 'shr yvm lchdsh hshby'y b'spkhm 't tbv't h'rts tchgv 't chg yhvh shb't ymym byvm hr'shvn shbtvn vbyvm hshmyny shbtvn
verses.translation: Also in the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when ye have gathered in the fruit of the land, ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days: on the first day shall be a sabbath, and on the eighth day shall be a sabbath.

verses.original: וּ/לְקַחְתֶּ֨ם לָ/כֶ֜ם בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הָ/רִאשׁ֗וֹן פְּרִ֨י עֵ֤ץ הָדָר֙ כַּפֹּ֣ת תְּמָרִ֔ים וַ/עֲנַ֥ף עֵץ עָבֹ֖ת וְ/עַרְבֵי נָ֑חַל וּ/שְׂמַחְתֶּ֗ם לִ/פְנֵ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֖ם שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vlqchtm lkhm byvm hr'shvn pry 'ts hdr khpt tmrym v'nf 'ts 'bt v'rby nchl vshmchtm lpny yhvh 'lhykhm shb't ymym
verses.translation: And ye shall take you on the first day the boughs of goodly trees, branches of palm trees, and the boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.

verses.original: וְ/חַגֹּתֶ֤ם אֹת/וֹ֙ חַ֣ג לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים בַּ/שָּׁנָ֑ה חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְ/דֹרֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם בַּ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֖י תָּחֹ֥גּוּ אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vchgtm 'tv chg lyhvh shb't ymym bshnh chqt 'vlm ldrtykhm bchdsh hshby'y tchgv 'tv
verses.translation: And ye shall keep it a feast unto the LORD seven days in the year. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations: ye shall celebrate it in the seventh month.

verses.original: בַּ/סֻּכֹּ֥ת תֵּשְׁב֖וּ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים כָּל הָֽ/אֶזְרָח֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יֵשְׁב֖וּ בַּ/סֻּכֹּֽת
verses.translit: bskht tshbv shb't ymym khl h'zrch byshr'l yshbv bskht
verses.translation: Ye shall dwell in booths seven days; all that are Israelites born shall dwell in booths:

verses.original: לְמַעַן֮ יֵדְע֣וּ דֹרֹֽתֵי/כֶם֒ כִּ֣י בַ/סֻּכּ֗וֹת הוֹשַׁ֨בְתִּי֙ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּ/הוֹצִיאִ֥/י אוֹתָ֖/ם מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: lm'n yd'v drtykhm khy bskhvt hvshbty 't bny yshr'l bhvtsy'y 'vtm m'rts mtsrym 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: That your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in booths, when I brought them out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת מֹעֲדֵ֖י יְהוָ֑ה אֶל בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vydbr mshh 't m'dy yhvh 'l bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And Moses declared unto the children of Israel the feasts of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: צַ֞ו אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְ/יִקְח֨וּ אֵלֶ֜י/ךָ שֶׁ֣מֶן זַ֥יִת זָ֛ךְ כָּתִ֖ית לַ/מָּא֑וֹר לְ/הַעֲלֹ֥ת נֵ֖ר תָּמִֽיד
verses.translit: tsv 't bny yshr'l vyqchv 'lykh shmn zyt zkh khtyt lm'vr lh'lt nr tmyd
verses.translation: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure oil olive beaten for the light, to cause the lamps to burn continually.

verses.original: מִ/חוּץ֩ לְ/פָרֹ֨כֶת הָ/עֵדֻ֜ת בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד יַעֲרֹךְ֩ אֹת֨/וֹ אַהֲרֹ֜ן מֵ/עֶ֧רֶב עַד בֹּ֛קֶר לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְ/דֹרֹֽתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: mchvts lprkht h'dt b'hl mv'd y'rkh 'tv 'hrn m'rb 'd bqr lpny yhvh tmyd chqt 'vlm ldrtykhm
verses.translation: Without the vail of the testimony, in the tabernacle of the congregation, shall Aaron order it from the evening unto the morning before the LORD continually: it shall be a statute for ever in your generations.

verses.original: עַ֚ל הַ/מְּנֹרָ֣ה הַ/טְּהֹרָ֔ה יַעֲרֹ֖ךְ אֶת הַ/נֵּר֑וֹת לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִֽיד
verses.translit: 'l hmnrh hthrh y'rkh 't hnrvt lpny yhvh tmyd
verses.translation: He shall order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before the LORD continually.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֣ סֹ֔לֶת וְ/אָפִיתָ֣ אֹתָ֔/הּ שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה חַלּ֑וֹת שְׁנֵי֙ עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים יִהְיֶ֖ה הַֽ/חַלָּ֥ה הָ/אֶחָֽת
verses.translit: vlqcht slt v'pyt 'th shtym 'shrh chlvt shny 'shrnym yhyh hchlh h'cht
verses.translation: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth deals shall be in one cake.

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתָּ֥ אוֹתָ֛/ם שְׁתַּ֥יִם מַֽעֲרָכ֖וֹת שֵׁ֣שׁ הַֽ/מַּעֲרָ֑כֶת עַ֛ל הַ/שֻּׁלְחָ֥ן הַ/טָּהֹ֖ר לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vshmt 'vtm shtym m'rkhvt shsh hm'rkht 'l hshlchn hthr lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּ֥ עַל הַֽ/מַּעֲרֶ֖כֶת לְבֹנָ֣ה זַכָּ֑ה וְ/הָיְתָ֤ה לַ/לֶּ֨חֶם֙ לְ/אַזְכָּרָ֔ה אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vntt 'l hm'rkht lbnh zkhh vhyth llchm l'zkhrh 'shh lyhvh
verses.translation: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be on the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto the LORD .

verses.original: בְּ/י֨וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּ֜ת בְּ/י֣וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּ֗ת יַֽעַרְכֶ֛/נּוּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִ֑יד מֵ/אֵ֥ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: byvm hshbt byvm hshbt y'rkhnv lpny yhvh tmyd m't bny yshr'l bryt 'vlm
verses.translation: Every sabbath he shall set it in order before the LORD continually, being taken from the children of Israel by an everlasting covenant.

verses.original: וְ/הָֽיְתָה֙ לְ/אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּ/לְ/בָנָ֔י/ו וַ/אֲכָלֻ֖/הוּ בְּ/מָק֣וֹם קָדֹ֑שׁ כִּ֡י קֹדֶשׁ֩ קָֽדָשִׁ֨ים ה֥וּא ל֛/וֹ מֵ/אִשֵּׁ֥י יְהוָ֖ה חָק עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vhyth l'hrn vlbnyv v'khlhv bmqvm qdsh khy qdsh qdshym hv' lv m'shy yhvh chq 'vlm
verses.translation: And it shall be Aaron’s and his sons’; and they shall eat it in the holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵא֙ בֶּן אִשָּׁ֣ה יִשְׂרְאֵלִ֔ית וְ/הוּא֙ בֶּן אִ֣ישׁ מִצְרִ֔י בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּנָּצוּ֙ בַּֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה בֶּ֚ן הַ/יִּשְׂרְאֵלִ֔ית וְ/אִ֖ישׁ הַ/יִּשְׂרְאֵלִֽי
verses.translit: vyts' bn 'shh yshr'lyt vhv' bn 'ysh mtsry btvkh bny yshr'l vyntsv bmchnh bn hyshr'lyt v'ysh hyshr'ly
verses.translation: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel: and this son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp;

verses.original: וַ֠/יִּקֹּב בֶּן הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֨ה הַ/יִּשְׂרְאֵלִ֤ית אֶת הַ/שֵּׁם֙ וַ/יְקַלֵּ֔ל וַ/יָּבִ֥יאוּ אֹת֖/וֹ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְ/שֵׁ֥ם אִמּ֛/וֹ שְׁלֹמִ֥ית בַּת דִּבְרִ֖י לְ/מַטֵּה דָֽן
verses.translit: vyqb bn h'shh hyshr'lyt 't hshm vyqll vyby'v 'tv 'l mshh vshm 'mv shlmyt bt dbry lmth dn
verses.translation: And the Israelitish woman’s son blasphemed the name of the LORD , and cursed. And they brought him unto Moses: (and his mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan:)

verses.original: וַ/יַּנִּיחֻ֖/הוּ בַּ/מִּשְׁמָ֑ר לִ/פְרֹ֥שׁ לָ/הֶ֖ם עַל פִּ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vynychhv bmshmr lprsh lhm 'l py yhvh
verses.translation: And they put him in ward, that the mind of the LORD might be shewed them.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: הוֹצֵ֣א אֶת הַֽ/מְקַלֵּ֗ל אֶל מִ/חוּץ֙ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְ/סָמְכ֧וּ כָֽל הַ/שֹּׁמְעִ֛ים אֶת יְדֵי/הֶ֖ם עַל רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ וְ/רָגְמ֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ כָּל הָ/עֵדָֽה
verses.translit: hvts' 't hmqll 'l mchvts lmchnh vsmkhv khl hshm'ym 't ydyhm 'l r'shv vrgmv 'tv khl h'dh
verses.translation: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אִ֥ישׁ אִ֛ישׁ כִּֽי יְקַלֵּ֥ל אֱלֹהָ֖י/ו וְ/נָשָׂ֥א חֶטְאֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'l bny yshr'l tdbr l'mr 'ysh 'ysh khy yqll 'lhyv vnsh' cht'v
verses.translation: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.

verses.original: וְ/נֹקֵ֤ב שֵׁם יְהוָה֙ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֔ת רָג֥וֹם יִרְגְּמוּ ב֖/וֹ כָּל הָ/עֵדָ֑ה כַּ/גֵּר֙ כָּֽ/אֶזְרָ֔ח בְּ/נָקְב/וֹ שֵׁ֖ם יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: vnqb shm yhvh mvt yvmt rgvm yrgmv bv khl h'dh khgr kh'zrch bnqbv shm yvmt
verses.translation: And he that blasphemeth the name of the LORD , he shall surely be put to death, and all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the stranger, as he that is born in the land, when he blasphemeth the name of the LORD , shall be put to death.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֕ישׁ כִּ֥י יַכֶּ֖ה כָּל נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֑ם מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: v'ysh khy ykhh khl npsh 'dm mvt yvmt
verses.translation: And he that killeth any man shall surely be put to death.

verses.original: וּ/מַכֵּ֥ה נֶֽפֶשׁ בְּהֵמָ֖ה יְשַׁלְּמֶ֑/נָּה נֶ֖פֶשׁ תַּ֥חַת נָֽפֶשׁ
verses.translit: vmkhh npsh bhmh yshlmnh npsh tcht npsh
verses.translation: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good; beast for beast.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֕ישׁ כִּֽי יִתֵּ֥ן מ֖וּם בַּ/עֲמִית֑/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה כֵּ֖ן יֵעָ֥שֶׂה לּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'ysh khy ytn mvm b'mytv kh'shr 'shh khn y'shh lv
verses.translation: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbour; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him;

verses.original: שֶׁ֚בֶר תַּ֣חַת שֶׁ֔בֶר עַ֚יִן תַּ֣חַת עַ֔יִן שֵׁ֖ן תַּ֣חַת שֵׁ֑ן כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֥ן מוּם֙ בָּֽ/אָדָ֔ם כֵּ֖ן יִנָּ֥תֶן בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: shbr tcht shbr 'yn tcht 'yn shn tcht shn kh'shr ytn mvm b'dm khn yntn bv
verses.translation: Breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth: as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be done to him again .

verses.original: וּ/מַכֵּ֥ה בְהֵמָ֖ה יְשַׁלְּמֶ֑/נָּה וּ/מַכֵּ֥ה אָדָ֖ם יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: vmkhh bhmh yshlmnh vmkhh 'dm yvmt
verses.translation: And he that killeth a beast, he shall restore it: and he that killeth a man, he shall be put to death.

verses.original: מִשְׁפַּ֤ט אֶחָד֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֔ם כַּ/גֵּ֥ר כָּ/אֶזְרָ֖ח יִהְיֶ֑ה כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: mshpt 'chd yhyh lkhm khgr kh'zrch yhyh khy 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the stranger, as for one of your own country: for I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁה֮ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַ/יּוֹצִ֣יאוּ אֶת הַֽ/מְקַלֵּ֗ל אֶל מִ/חוּץ֙ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַ/יִּרְגְּמ֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ אָ֑בֶן וּ/בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עָשׂ֔וּ כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vydbr mshh 'l bny yshr'l vyvtsy'v 't hmqll 'l mchvts lmchnh vyrgmv 'tv 'bn vbny yshr'l 'shv kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And Moses spake to the children of Israel, that they should bring forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stone him with stones. And the children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּ/הַ֥ר סִינַ֖י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh bhr syny l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses in mount Sinai, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם כִּ֤י תָבֹ֨אוּ֙ אֶל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י נֹתֵ֣ן לָ/כֶ֑ם וְ/שָׁבְתָ֣ה הָ/אָ֔רֶץ שַׁבָּ֖ת לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm khy tb'v 'l h'rts 'shr 'ny ntn lkhm vshbth h'rts shbt lyhvh
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land which I give you, then shall the land keep a sabbath unto the LORD .

verses.original: שֵׁ֤שׁ שָׁנִים֙ תִּזְרַ֣ע שָׂדֶ֔/ךָ וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ שָׁנִ֖ים תִּזְמֹ֣ר כַּרְמֶ֑/ךָ וְ/אָסַפְתָּ֖ אֶת תְּבוּאָתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: shsh shnym tzr' shdkh vshsh shnym tzmr khrmkh v'spt 't tbv'th
verses.translation: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit thereof;

verses.original: וּ/בַ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֗ת שַׁבַּ֤ת שַׁבָּתוֹן֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/אָ֔רֶץ שַׁבָּ֖ת לַ/יהוָ֑ה שָֽׂדְ/ךָ֙ לֹ֣א תִזְרָ֔ע וְ/כַרְמְ/ךָ֖ לֹ֥א תִזְמֹֽר
verses.translit: vbshnh hshby't shbt shbtvn yhyh l'rts shbt lyhvh shdkh l' tzr' vkhrmkh l' tzmr
verses.translation: But in the seventh year shall be a sabbath of rest unto the land, a sabbath for the LORD : thou shalt neither sow thy field, nor prune thy vineyard.

verses.original: אֵ֣ת סְפִ֤יחַ קְצִֽירְ/ךָ֙ לֹ֣א תִקְצ֔וֹר וְ/אֶת עִנְּבֵ֥י נְזִירֶ֖/ךָ לֹ֣א תִבְצֹ֑ר שְׁנַ֥ת שַׁבָּת֖וֹן יִהְיֶ֥ה לָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: 't spych qtsyrkh l' tqtsvr v't 'nby nzyrkh l' tbtsr shnt shbtvn yhyh l'rts
verses.translation: That which groweth of its own accord of thy harvest thou shalt not reap, neither gather the grapes of thy vine undressed: for it is a year of rest unto the land.

verses.translit: vhyth shbt h'rts lkhm l'khlh lkh vl'bdkh vl'mtkh vlshkhyrkh vltvshbkh hgrym 'mkh
verses.translation: And the sabbath of the land shall be meat for you; for thee, and for thy servant, and for thy maid, and for thy hired servant, and for thy stranger that sojourneth with thee,

verses.original: וְ/לִ֨/בְהֶמְתְּ/ךָ֔ וְ/לַֽ/חַיָּ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/אַרְצֶ֑/ךָ תִּהְיֶ֥ה כָל תְּבוּאָתָ֖/הּ לֶ/אֱכֹֽל
verses.translit: vlbhmtkh vlchyh 'shr b'rtskh thyh khl tbv'th l'khl
verses.translation: And for thy cattle, and for the beast that are in thy land, shall all the increase thereof be meat.

verses.original: וְ/סָפַרְתָּ֣ לְ/ךָ֗ שֶׁ֚בַע שַׁבְּתֹ֣ת שָׁנִ֔ים שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְ/הָי֣וּ לְ/ךָ֗ יְמֵי֙ שֶׁ֚בַע שַׁבְּתֹ֣ת הַ/שָּׁנִ֔ים תֵּ֥שַׁע וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vsprt lkh shb' shbtt shnym shb' shnym shb' p'mym vhyv lkh ymy shb' shbtt hshnym tsh' v'rb'ym shnh
verses.translation: And thou shalt number seven sabbaths of years unto thee, seven times seven years; and the space of the seven sabbaths of years shall be unto thee forty and nine years.

verses.original: וְ/הַֽעֲבַרְתָּ֞ שׁוֹפַ֤ר תְּרוּעָה֙ בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִעִ֔י בֶּ/עָשׂ֖וֹר לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ בְּ/יוֹם֙ הַ/כִּפֻּרִ֔ים תַּעֲבִ֥ירוּ שׁוֹפָ֖ר בְּ/כָל אַרְצְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vh'brt shvpr trv'h bchdsh hshb'y b'shvr lchdsh byvm hkhprym t'byrv shvpr bkhl 'rtskhm
verses.translation: Then shalt thou cause the trumpet of the jubile to sound on the tenth day of the seventh month, in the day of atonement shall ye make the trumpet sound throughout all your land.

verses.original: וְ/קִדַּשְׁתֶּ֗ם אֵ֣ת שְׁנַ֤ת הַ/חֲמִשִּׁים֙ שָׁנָ֔ה וּ/קְרָאתֶ֥ם דְּר֛וֹר בָּ/אָ֖רֶץ לְ/כָל יֹשְׁבֶ֑י/הָ יוֹבֵ֥ל הִוא֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֔ם וְ/שַׁבְתֶּ֗ם אִ֚ישׁ אֶל אֲחֻזָּת֔/וֹ וְ/אִ֥ישׁ אֶל מִשְׁפַּחְתּ֖/וֹ תָּשֻֽׁבוּ
verses.translit: vqdshtm 't shnt hchmshym shnh vqr'tm drvr b'rts lkhl yshbyh yvbl hv' thyh lkhm vshbtm 'ysh 'l 'chztv v'ysh 'l mshpchtv tshbv
verses.translation: And ye shall hallow the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty throughout all the land unto all the inhabitants thereof: it shall be a jubile unto you; and ye shall return every man unto his possession, and ye shall return every man unto his family.

verses.original: יוֹבֵ֣ל הִ֗וא שְׁנַ֛ת הַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה תִּהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֑ם לֹ֣א תִזְרָ֔עוּ וְ/לֹ֤א תִקְצְרוּ֙ אֶת סְפִיחֶ֔י/הָ וְ/לֹ֥א תִבְצְר֖וּ אֶת נְזִרֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: yvbl hv' shnt hchmshym shnh thyh lkhm l' tzr'v vl' tqtsrv 't spychyh vl' tbtsrv 't nzryh
verses.translation: A jubile shall that fiftieth year be unto you: ye shall not sow, neither reap that which groweth of itself in it, nor gather the grapes in it of thy vine undressed.

verses.original: כִּ֚י יוֹבֵ֣ל הִ֔וא קֹ֖דֶשׁ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֑ם מִן הַ֨/שָּׂדֶ֔ה תֹּאכְל֖וּ אֶת תְּבוּאָתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy yvbl hv' qdsh thyh lkhm mn hshdh t'khlv 't tbv'th
verses.translation: For it is the jubile; it shall be holy unto you: ye shall eat the increase thereof out of the field.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֥ת הַ/יּוֹבֵ֖ל הַ/זֹּ֑את תָּשֻׁ֕בוּ אִ֖ישׁ אֶל אֲחֻזָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: bshnt hyvbl hz't tshbv 'ysh 'l 'chztv
verses.translation: In the year of this jubile ye shall return every man unto his possession.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי תִמְכְּר֤וּ מִמְכָּר֙ לַ/עֲמִיתֶ֔/ךָ א֥וֹ קָנֹ֖ה מִ/יַּ֣ד עֲמִיתֶ֑/ךָ אַל תּוֹנ֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ אֶת אָחִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vkhy tmkhrv mmkhr l'mytkh 'v qnh myd 'mytkh 'l tvnv 'ysh 't 'chyv
verses.translation: And if thou sell ought unto thy neighbour, or buyest ought of thy neighbour’s hand, ye shall not oppress one another:

verses.original: בְּ/מִסְפַּ֤ר שָׁנִים֙ אַחַ֣ר הַ/יּוֹבֵ֔ל תִּקְנֶ֖ה מֵ/אֵ֣ת עֲמִיתֶ֑/ךָ בְּ/מִסְפַּ֥ר שְׁנֵֽי תְבוּאֹ֖ת יִמְכָּר לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: bmspr shnym 'chr hyvbl tqnh m't 'mytkh bmspr shny tbv't ymkhr lkh
verses.translation: According to the number of years after the jubile thou shalt buy of thy neighbour, and according unto the number of years of the fruits he shall sell unto thee:

verses.original: לְ/פִ֣י רֹ֣ב הַ/שָּׁנִ֗ים תַּרְבֶּה֙ מִקְנָת֔/וֹ וּ/לְ/פִי֙ מְעֹ֣ט הַ/שָּׁנִ֔ים תַּמְעִ֖יט מִקְנָת֑/וֹ כִּ֚י מִסְפַּ֣ר תְּבוּאֹ֔ת ה֥וּא מֹכֵ֖ר לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: lpy rb hshnym trbh mqntv vlpy m't hshnym tm'yt mqntv khy mspr tbv't hv' mkhr lkh
verses.translation: According to the multitude of years thou shalt increase the price thereof, and according to the fewness of years thou shalt diminish the price of it: for according to the number of the years of the fruits doth he sell unto thee.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֤א תוֹנוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶת עֲמִית֔/וֹ וְ/יָרֵ֖אתָ מֵֽ/אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהֹוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vl' tvnv 'ysh 't 'mytv vyr't m'lhykh khy 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Ye shall not therefore oppress one another; but thou shalt fear thy God: for I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶם֙ אֶת חֻקֹּתַ֔/י וְ/אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַ֥/י תִּשְׁמְר֖וּ וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם אֹתָ֑/ם וִֽ/ישַׁבְתֶּ֥ם עַל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לָ/בֶֽטַח
verses.translit: v'shytm 't chqty v't mshpty tshmrv v'shytm 'tm vyshbtm 'l h'rts lbtch
verses.translation: Wherefore ye shall do my statutes, and keep my judgments, and do them; and ye shall dwell in the land in safety.

verses.original: וְ/נָתְנָ֤ה הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ פִּרְיָ֔/הּ וַ/אֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם לָ/שֹׂ֑בַע וִֽ/ישַׁבְתֶּ֥ם לָ/בֶ֖טַח עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vntnh h'rts pryh v'khltm lshb' vyshbtm lbtch 'lyh
verses.translation: And the land shall yield her fruit, and ye shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

verses.original: וְ/כִ֣י תֹאמְר֔וּ מַה נֹּאכַ֤֖ל בַּ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֑ת הֵ֚ן לֹ֣א נִזְרָ֔ע וְ/לֹ֥א נֶאֱסֹ֖ף אֶת תְּבוּאָתֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vkhy t'mrv mh n'khl bshnh hshby't hn l' nzr' vl' n'sf 't tbv'tnv
verses.translation: And if ye shall say, What shall we eat the seventh year? behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase:

verses.original: וְ/צִוִּ֤יתִי אֶת בִּרְכָתִ/י֙ לָ/כֶ֔ם בַּ/שָּׁנָ֖ה הַ/שִּׁשִּׁ֑ית וְ/עָשָׂת֙ אֶת הַ/תְּבוּאָ֔ה לִ/שְׁלֹ֖שׁ הַ/שָּׁנִֽים
verses.translit: vtsvyty 't brkhty lkhm bshnh hshshyt v'sht 't htbv'h lshlsh hshnym
verses.translation: Then I will command my blessing upon you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for three years.

verses.original: וּ/זְרַעְתֶּ֗ם אֵ֚ת הַ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֔ת וַ/אֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם מִן הַ/תְּבוּאָ֣ה יָשָׁ֑ן עַ֣ד הַ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ/תְּשִׁיעִ֗ת עַד בּוֹא֙ תְּב֣וּאָתָ֔/הּ תֹּאכְל֖וּ יָשָֽׁן
verses.translit: vzr'tm 't hshnh hshmynt v'khltm mn htbv'h yshn 'd hshnh htshy't 'd bv' tbv'th t'khlv yshn
verses.translation: And ye shall sow the eighth year, and eat yet of old fruit until the ninth year; until her fruits come in ye shall eat of the old store .

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אָ֗רֶץ לֹ֤א תִמָּכֵר֙ לִ/צְמִתֻ֔ת כִּי לִ֖/י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי גֵרִ֧ים וְ/תוֹשָׁבִ֛ים אַתֶּ֖ם עִמָּדִֽ/י
verses.translit: vh'rts l' tmkhr ltsmtt khy ly h'rts khy grym vtvshbym 'tm 'mdy
verses.translation: The land shall not be sold for ever: for the land is mine; for ye are strangers and sojourners with me.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/כֹ֖ל אֶ֣רֶץ אֲחֻזַּתְ/כֶ֑ם גְּאֻלָּ֖ה תִּתְּנ֥וּ לָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vbkhl 'rts 'chztkhm g'lh ttnv l'rts
verses.translation: And in all the land of your possession ye shall grant a redemption for the land.

verses.original: כִּֽי יָמ֣וּךְ אָחִ֔י/ךָ וּ/מָכַ֖ר מֵ/אֲחֻזָּת֑/וֹ וּ/בָ֤א גֹֽאֲל/וֹ֙ הַ/קָּרֹ֣ב אֵלָ֔י/ו וְ/גָאַ֕ל אֵ֖ת מִמְכַּ֥ר אָחִֽי/ו
verses.translit: khy ymvkh 'chykh vmkhr m'chztv vb' g'lv hqrb 'lyv vg'l 't mmkhr 'chyv
verses.translation: If thy brother be waxen poor, and hath sold away some of his possession, and if any of his kin come to redeem it, then shall he redeem that which his brother sold.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֕ישׁ כִּ֛י לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה לּ֖/וֹ גֹּאֵ֑ל וְ/הִשִּׂ֣יגָה יָד֔/וֹ וּ/מָצָ֖א כְּ/דֵ֥י גְאֻלָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'ysh khy l' yhyh lv g'l vhshygh ydv vmts' khdy g'ltv
verses.translation: And if the man have none to redeem it, and himself be able to redeem it;

verses.original: וְ/חִשַּׁב֙ אֶת שְׁנֵ֣י מִמְכָּר֔/וֹ וְ/הֵשִׁיב֙ אֶת הָ֣/עֹדֵ֔ף לָ/אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָֽכַר ל֑/וֹ וְ/שָׁ֖ב לַ/אֲחֻזָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vchshb 't shny mmkhrv vhshyb 't h'df l'ysh 'shr mkhr lv vshb l'chztv
verses.translation: Then let him count the years of the sale thereof, and restore the overplus unto the man to whom he sold it; that he may return unto his possession.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֨ם לֹֽא מָֽצְאָ֜ה יָד֗/וֹ דֵּי֮ הָשִׁ֣יב ל/וֹ֒ וְ/הָיָ֣ה מִמְכָּר֗/וֹ בְּ/יַד֙ הַ/קֹּנֶ֣ה אֹת֔/וֹ עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַ/יּוֹבֵ֑ל וְ/יָצָא֙ בַּ/יֹּבֵ֔ל וְ/שָׁ֖ב לַ/אֲחֻזָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'm l' mts'h ydv dy hshyb lv vhyh mmkhrv byd hqnh 'tv 'd shnt hyvbl vyts' bybl vshb l'chztv
verses.translation: But if he be not able to restore it to him, then that which is sold shall remain in the hand of him that hath bought it until the year of jubile: and in the jubile it shall go out, and he shall return unto his possession.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֗ישׁ כִּֽי יִמְכֹּ֤ר בֵּית מוֹשַׁב֙ עִ֣יר חוֹמָ֔ה וְ/הָיְתָה֙ גְּאֻלָּת֔/וֹ עַד תֹּ֖ם שְׁנַ֣ת מִמְכָּר֑/וֹ יָמִ֖ים תִּהְיֶ֥ה גְאֻלָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'ysh khy ymkhr byt mvshb 'yr chvmh vhyth g'ltv 'd tm shnt mmkhrv ymym thyh g'ltv
verses.translation: And if a man sell a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it is sold; within a full year may he redeem it.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֣ם לֹֽא יִגָּאֵ֗ל עַד מְלֹ֣את ל/וֹ֮ שָׁנָ֣ה תְמִימָה֒ וְ֠/קָם הַ/בַּ֨יִת אֲשֶׁר בָּ/עִ֜יר אֲשֶׁר לא ל֣/וֹ חֹמָ֗ה לַ/צְּמִיתֻ֛ת לַ/קֹּנֶ֥ה אֹת֖/וֹ לְ/דֹרֹתָ֑י/ו לֹ֥א יֵצֵ֖א בַּ/יֹּבֵֽל
verses.translit: v'm l' yg'l 'd ml't lv shnh tmymh vqm hbyt 'shr b'yr 'shr l' lv chmh ltsmytt lqnh 'tv ldrtyv l' yts' bybl
verses.translation: And if it be not redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be established for ever to him that bought it throughout his generations: it shall not go out in the jubile.

verses.original: וּ/בָתֵּ֣י הַ/חֲצֵרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֵין לָ/הֶ֤ם חֹמָה֙ סָבִ֔יב עַל שְׂדֵ֥ה הָ/אָ֖רֶץ יֵחָשֵׁ֑ב גְּאֻלָּה֙ תִּהְיֶה לּ֔/וֹ וּ/בַ/יֹּבֵ֖ל יֵצֵֽא
verses.translit: vbty hchtsrym 'shr 'yn lhm chmh sbyb 'l shdh h'rts ychshb g'lh thyh lv vbybl yts'
verses.translation: But the houses of the villages which have no wall round about them shall be counted as the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall go out in the jubile.

verses.original: וְ/עָרֵי֙ הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם בָּתֵּ֖י עָרֵ֣י אֲחֻזָּתָ֑/ם גְּאֻלַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם תִּהְיֶ֥ה לַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: v'ry hlvym bty 'ry 'chztm g'lt 'vlm thyh llvym
verses.translation: Notwithstanding the cities of the Levites, and the houses of the cities of their possession, may the Levites redeem at any time.

verses.original: וַ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִגְאַל֙ מִן הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם וְ/יָצָ֧א מִמְכַּר בַּ֛יִת וְ/עִ֥יר אֲחֻזָּת֖/וֹ בַּ/יֹּבֵ֑ל כִּ֣י בָתֵּ֞י עָרֵ֣י הַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם הִ֚וא אֲחֻזָּתָ֔/ם בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'shr yg'l mn hlvym vyts' mmkhr byt v'yr 'chztv bybl khy bty 'ry hlvym hv' 'chztm btvkh bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And if a man purchase of the Levites, then the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, shall go out in the year of jubile: for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

verses.original: וּֽ/שְׂדֵ֛ה מִגְרַ֥שׁ עָרֵי/הֶ֖ם לֹ֣א יִמָּכֵ֑ר כִּֽי אֲחֻזַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֛ם ה֖וּא לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vshdh mgrsh 'ryhm l' ymkhr khy 'chzt 'vlm hv' lhm
verses.translation: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יָמ֣וּךְ אָחִ֔י/ךָ וּ/מָ֥טָה יָד֖/וֹ עִמָּ֑/ךְ וְ/הֶֽחֱזַ֣קְתָּ בּ֔/וֹ גֵּ֧ר וְ/תוֹשָׁ֛ב וָ/חַ֖י עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vkhy ymvkh 'chykh vmth ydv 'mkh vhchzqt bv gr vtvshb vchy 'mkh
verses.translation: And if thy brother be waxen poor, and fallen in decay with thee; then thou shalt relieve him: yea, though he be a stranger, or a sojourner; that he may live with thee.

verses.original: אַל תִּקַּ֤ח מֵֽ/אִתּ/וֹ֙ נֶ֣שֶׁךְ וְ/תַרְבִּ֔ית וְ/יָרֵ֖אתָ מֵֽ/אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/חֵ֥י אָחִ֖י/ךָ עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'l tqch m'tv nshkh vtrbyt vyr't m'lhykh vchy 'chykh 'mkh
verses.translation: Take thou no usury of him, or increase: but fear thy God; that thy brother may live with thee.

verses.original: אֶ֨ת כַּסְפְּ/ךָ֔ לֹֽא תִתֵּ֥ן ל֖/וֹ בְּ/נֶ֑שֶׁךְ וּ/בְ/מַרְבִּ֖ית לֹא תִתֵּ֥ן אָכְלֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 't khspkh l' ttn lv bnshkh vbmrbyt l' ttn 'khlkh
verses.translation: Thou shalt not give him thy money upon usury, nor lend him thy victuals for increase.

verses.original: אֲנִ֗י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לָ/תֵ֤ת לָ/כֶם֙ אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן לִ/הְי֥וֹת לָ/כֶ֖ם לֵ/אלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm 'shr hvts'ty 'tkhm m'rts mtsrym ltt lkhm 't 'rts khn'n lhyvt lkhm l'lhym
verses.translation: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יָמ֥וּךְ אָחִ֛י/ךָ עִמָּ֖/ךְ וְ/נִמְכַּר לָ֑/ךְ לֹא תַעֲבֹ֥ד בּ֖/וֹ עֲבֹ֥דַת עָֽבֶד
verses.translit: vkhy ymvkh 'chykh 'mkh vnmkhr lkh l' t'bd bv 'bdt 'bd
verses.translation: And if thy brother that dwelleth by thee be waxen poor, and be sold unto thee; thou shalt not compel him to serve as a bondservant:

verses.original: כְּ/שָׂכִ֥יר כְּ/תוֹשָׁ֖ב יִהְיֶ֣ה עִמָּ֑/ךְ עַד שְׁנַ֥ת הַ/יֹּבֵ֖ל יַעֲבֹ֥ד עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khshkhyr khtvshb yhyh 'mkh 'd shnt hybl y'bd 'mkh
verses.translation: But as an hired servant, and as a sojourner, he shall be with thee, and shall serve thee unto the year of jubile:

verses.original: וְ/יָצָא֙ מֵֽ/עִמָּ֔/ךְ ה֖וּא וּ/בָנָ֣י/ו עִמּ֑/וֹ וְ/שָׁב֙ אֶל מִשְׁפַּחְתּ֔/וֹ וְ/אֶל אֲחֻזַּ֥ת אֲבֹתָ֖י/ו יָשֽׁוּב
verses.translit: vyts' m'mkh hv' vbnyv 'mv vshb 'l mshpchtv v'l 'chzt 'btyv yshvb
verses.translation: And then shall he depart from thee, both he and his children with him, and shall return unto his own family, and unto the possession of his fathers shall he return.

verses.original: כִּֽי עֲבָדַ֣/י הֵ֔ם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֹתָ֖/ם מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לֹ֥א יִמָּכְר֖וּ מִמְכֶּ֥רֶת עָֽבֶד
verses.translit: khy 'bdy hm 'shr hvts'ty 'tm m'rts mtsrym l' ymkhrv mmkhrt 'bd
verses.translation: For they are my servants, which I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: they shall not be sold as bondmen.

verses.original: לֹא תִרְדֶּ֥ה ב֖/וֹ בְּ/פָ֑רֶךְ וְ/יָרֵ֖אתָ מֵ/אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: l' trdh bv bprkh vyr't m'lhykh
verses.translation: Thou shalt not rule over him with rigour; but shalt fear thy God.

verses.original: וְ/עַבְדְּ/ךָ֥ וַ/אֲמָתְ/ךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִהְיוּ לָ֑/ךְ מֵ/אֵ֣ת הַ/גּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁר֙ סְבִיבֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם מֵ/הֶ֥ם תִּקְנ֖וּ עֶ֥בֶד וְ/אָמָֽה
verses.translit: v'bdkh v'mtkh 'shr yhyv lkh m't hgvym 'shr sbybtykhm mhm tqnv 'bd v'mh
verses.translation: Both thy bondmen, and thy bondmaids, which thou shalt have, shall be of the heathen that are round about you; of them shall ye buy bondmen and bondmaids.

verses.original: וְ֠/גַם מִ/בְּנֵ֨י הַ/תּוֹשָׁבִ֜ים הַ/גָּרִ֤ים עִמָּ/כֶם֙ מֵ/הֶ֣ם תִּקְנ֔וּ וּ/מִ/מִּשְׁפַּחְתָּ/ם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִמָּ/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹלִ֖ידוּ בְּ/אַרְצְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/הָי֥וּ לָ/כֶ֖ם לַֽ/אֲחֻזָּֽה
verses.translit: vgm mbny htvshbym hgrym 'mkhm mhm tqnv vmmshpchtm 'shr 'mkhm 'shr hvlydv b'rtskhm vhyv lkhm l'chzh
verses.translation: Moreover of the children of the strangers that do sojourn among you, of them shall ye buy, and of their families that are with you, which they begat in your land: and they shall be your possession.

verses.original: וְ/הִתְנַחֲלְתֶּ֨ם אֹתָ֜/ם לִ/בְנֵי/כֶ֤ם אַחֲרֵי/כֶם֙ לָ/רֶ֣שֶׁת אֲחֻזָּ֔ה לְ/עֹלָ֖ם בָּ/הֶ֣ם תַּעֲבֹ֑דוּ וּ/בְ/אַ֨חֵי/כֶ֤ם בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אִ֣ישׁ בְּ/אָחִ֔י/ו לֹא תִרְדֶּ֥ה ב֖/וֹ בְּ/פָֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: vhtnchltm 'tm lbnykhm 'chrykhm lrsht 'chzh l'lm bhm t'bdv vb'chykhm bny yshr'l 'ysh b'chyv l' trdh bv bprkh
verses.translation: And ye shall take them as an inheritance for your children after you, to inherit them for a possession; they shall be your bondmen for ever: but over your brethren the children of Israel, ye shall not rule one over another with rigour.

verses.original: וְ/כִ֣י תַשִּׂ֗יג יַ֣ד גֵּ֤ר וְ/תוֹשָׁב֙ עִמָּ֔/ךְ וּ/מָ֥ךְ אָחִ֖י/ךָ עִמּ֑/וֹ וְ/נִמְכַּ֗ר לְ/גֵ֤ר תּוֹשָׁב֙ עִמָּ֔/ךְ א֥וֹ לְ/עֵ֖קֶר מִשְׁפַּ֥חַת גֵּֽר
verses.translit: vkhy tshyg yd gr vtvshb 'mkh vmkh 'chykh 'mv vnmkhr lgr tvshb 'mkh 'v l'qr mshpcht gr
verses.translation: And if a sojourner or stranger wax rich by thee, and thy brother that dwelleth by him wax poor, and sell himself unto the stranger or sojourner by thee, or to the stock of the stranger’s family:

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֣י נִמְכַּ֔ר גְּאֻלָּ֖ה תִּהְיֶה לּ֑/וֹ אֶחָ֥ד מֵ/אֶחָ֖י/ו יִגְאָלֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 'chry nmkhr g'lh thyh lv 'chd m'chyv yg'lnv
verses.translation: After that he is sold he may be redeemed again; one of his brethren may redeem him:

verses.original: אוֹ דֹד֞/וֹ א֤וֹ בֶן דֹּד/וֹ֙ יִגְאָלֶ֔/נּוּ אֽוֹ מִ/שְּׁאֵ֧ר בְּשָׂר֛/וֹ מִ/מִּשְׁפַּחְתּ֖/וֹ יִגְאָלֶ֑/נּוּ אֽוֹ הִשִּׂ֥יגָה יָד֖/וֹ וְ/נִגְאָֽל
verses.translit: 'v ddv 'v bn ddv yg'lnv 'v msh'r bshrv mmshpchtv yg'lnv 'v hshygh ydv vng'l
verses.translation: Either his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any that is nigh of kin unto him of his family may redeem him; or if he be able, he may redeem himself.

verses.original: וְ/חִשַּׁב֙ עִם קֹנֵ֔/הוּ מִ/שְּׁנַת֙ הִמָּ֣כְר/וֹ ל֔/וֹ עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַ/יֹּבֵ֑ל וְ/הָיָ֞ה כֶּ֤סֶף מִמְכָּר/וֹ֙ בְּ/מִסְפַּ֣ר שָׁנִ֔ים כִּ/ימֵ֥י שָׂכִ֖יר יִהְיֶ֥ה עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vchshb 'm qnhv mshnt hmkhrv lv 'd shnt hybl vhyh khsf mmkhrv bmspr shnym khymy shkhyr yhyh 'mv
verses.translation: And he shall reckon with him that bought him from the year that he was sold to him unto the year of jubile: and the price of his sale shall be according unto the number of years, according to the time of an hired servant shall it be with him.

verses.original: אִם ע֥וֹד רַבּ֖וֹת בַּ/שָּׁנִ֑ים לְ/פִי/הֶן֙ יָשִׁ֣יב גְּאֻלָּת֔/וֹ מִ/כֶּ֖סֶף מִקְנָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'm 'vd rbvt bshnym lpyhn yshyb g'ltv mkhsf mqntv
verses.translation: If there be yet many years behind , according unto them he shall give again the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

verses.original: וְ/אִם מְעַ֞ט נִשְׁאַ֧ר בַּ/שָּׁנִ֛ים עַד שְׁנַ֥ת הַ/יֹּבֵ֖ל וְ/חִשַּׁב ל֑/וֹ כְּ/פִ֣י שָׁנָ֔י/ו יָשִׁ֖יב אֶת גְּאֻלָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'm m't nsh'r bshnym 'd shnt hybl vchshb lv khpy shnyv yshyb 't g'ltv
verses.translation: And if there remain but few years unto the year of jubile, then he shall count with him, and according unto his years shall he give him again the price of his redemption.

verses.original: כִּ/שְׂכִ֥יר שָׁנָ֛ה בְּ/שָׁנָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֣ה עִמּ֑/וֹ לֹֽא יִרְדֶּ֥/נּֽוּ בְּ/פֶ֖רֶךְ לְ/עֵינֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khshkhyr shnh bshnh yhyh 'mv l' yrdnv bprkh l'ynykh
verses.translation: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.

verses.original: וְ/אִם לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵ֖ל בְּ/אֵ֑לֶּה וְ/יָצָא֙ בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת הַ/יֹּבֵ֔ל ה֖וּא וּ/בָנָ֥י/ו עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'm l' yg'l b'lh vyts' bshnt hybl hv' vbnyv 'mv
verses.translation: And if he be not redeemed in these years , then he shall go out in the year of jubile, both he, and his children with him.

verses.original: כִּֽי לִ֤/י בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עֲבָדִ֔ים עֲבָדַ֣/י הֵ֔ם אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אוֹתָ֖/ם מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khy ly bny yshr'l 'bdym 'bdy hm 'shr hvts'ty 'vtm m'rts mtsrym 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: For unto me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt: I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: לֹֽא תַעֲשׂ֨וּ לָ/כֶ֜ם אֱלִילִ֗ם וּ/פֶ֤סֶל וּ/מַצֵּבָה֙ לֹֽא תָקִ֣ימוּ לָ/כֶ֔ם וְ/אֶ֣בֶן מַשְׂכִּ֗ית לֹ֤א תִתְּנוּ֙ בְּ/אַרְצְ/כֶ֔ם לְ/הִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֖ת עָלֶ֑י/הָ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: l' t'shv lkhm 'lylm vpsl vmtsbh l' tqymv lkhm v'bn mshkhyt l' ttnv b'rtskhm lhshtchvt 'lyh khy 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Ye shall make you no idols nor graven image, neither rear you up a standing image, neither shall ye set up any image of stone in your land, to bow down unto it: for I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתַ֣/י תִּשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וּ/מִקְדָּשִׁ֖/י תִּירָ֑אוּ אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 't shbtty tshmrv vmqdshy tyr'v 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the LORD .

verses.original: אִם בְּ/חֻקֹּתַ֖/י תֵּלֵ֑כוּ וְ/אֶת מִצְוֺתַ֣/י תִּשְׁמְר֔וּ וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'm bchqty tlkhv v't mtsvty tshmrv v'shytm 'tm
verses.translation: If ye walk in my statutes, and keep my commandments, and do them;

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י גִשְׁמֵי/כֶ֖ם בְּ/עִתָּ֑/ם וְ/נָתְנָ֤ה הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ יְבוּלָ֔/הּ וְ/עֵ֥ץ הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה יִתֵּ֥ן פִּרְיֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vntty gshmykhm b'tm vntnh h'rts ybvlh v'ts hshdh ytn pryv
verses.translation: Then I will give you rain in due season, and the land shall yield her increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

verses.original: וְ/הִשִּׂ֨יג לָ/כֶ֥ם דַּ֨יִשׁ֙ אֶת בָּצִ֔יר וּ/בָצִ֖יר יַשִּׂ֣יג אֶת זָ֑רַע וַ/אֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם לַחְמְ/כֶם֙ לָ/שֹׂ֔בַע וִֽ/ישַׁבְתֶּ֥ם לָ/בֶ֖טַח בְּ/אַרְצְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhshyg lkhm dysh 't btsyr vbtsyr yshyg 't zr' v'khltm lchmkhm lshb' vyshbtm lbtch b'rtskhm
verses.translation: And your threshing shall reach unto the vintage, and the vintage shall reach unto the sowing time: and ye shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י שָׁלוֹם֙ בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ וּ/שְׁכַבְתֶּ֖ם וְ/אֵ֣ין מַחֲרִ֑יד וְ/הִשְׁבַּתִּ֞י חַיָּ֤ה רָעָה֙ מִן הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/חֶ֖רֶב לֹא תַעֲבֹ֥ר בְּ/אַרְצְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vntty shlvm b'rts vshkhbtm v'yn mchryd vhshbty chyh r'h mn h'rts vchrb l' t'br b'rtskhm
verses.translation: And I will give peace in the land, and ye shall lie down, and none shall make you afraid: and I will rid evil beasts out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

verses.original: וּ/רְדַפְתֶּ֖ם אֶת אֹיְבֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/נָפְל֥וּ לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֖ם לֶ/חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vrdptm 't 'ybykhm vnplv lpnykhm lchrb
verses.translation: And ye shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

verses.original: וְ/רָדְפ֨וּ מִ/כֶּ֤ם חֲמִשָּׁה֙ מֵאָ֔ה וּ/מֵאָ֥ה מִ/כֶּ֖ם רְבָבָ֣ה יִרְדֹּ֑פוּ וְ/נָפְל֧וּ אֹיְבֵי/כֶ֛ם לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֖ם לֶ/חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vrdpv mkhm chmshh m'h vm'h mkhm rbbh yrdpv vnplv 'ybykhm lpnykhm lchrb
verses.translation: And five of you shall chase an hundred, and an hundred of you shall put ten thousand to flight: and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

verses.original: וּ/פָנִ֣יתִי אֲלֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/הִפְרֵיתִ֣י אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/הִרְבֵּיתִ֖י אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם וַ/הֲקִימֹתִ֥י אֶת בְּרִיתִ֖/י אִתְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vpnyty 'lykhm vhpryty 'tkhm vhrbyty 'tkhm vhqymty 't bryty 'tkhm
verses.translation: For I will have respect unto you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, and establish my covenant with you.

verses.original: וַ/אֲכַלְתֶּ֥ם יָשָׁ֖ן נוֹשָׁ֑ן וְ/יָשָׁ֕ן מִ/פְּנֵ֥י חָדָ֖שׁ תּוֹצִֽיאוּ
verses.translit: v'khltm yshn nvshn vyshn mpny chdsh tvtsy'v
verses.translation: And ye shall eat old store, and bring forth the old because of the new.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֥י מִשְׁכָּנִ֖/י בְּ/תוֹכְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/לֹֽא תִגְעַ֥ל נַפְשִׁ֖/י אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vntty mshkhny btvkhkhm vl' tg'l npshy 'tkhm
verses.translation: And I will set my tabernacle among you: and my soul shall not abhor you.

verses.original: וְ/הִתְהַלַּכְתִּי֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹכְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/הָיִ֥יתִי לָ/כֶ֖ם לֵֽ/אלֹהִ֑ים וְ/אַתֶּ֖ם תִּהְיוּ לִ֥/י לְ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vhthlkhty btvkhkhm vhyyty lkhm l'lhym v'tm thyv ly l'm
verses.translation: And I will walk among you, and will be your God, and ye shall be my people.

verses.original: אֲנִ֞י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֤אתִי אֶתְ/כֶם֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם מִֽ/הְיֹ֥ת לָ/הֶ֖ם עֲבָדִ֑ים וָ/אֶשְׁבֹּר֙ מֹטֹ֣ת עֻלְּ/כֶ֔ם וָ/אוֹלֵ֥ךְ אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם קֽוֹמְמִיּֽוּת
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm 'shr hvts'ty 'tkhm m'rts mtsrym mhyt lhm 'bdym v'shbr mtt 'lkhm v'vlkh 'tkhm qvmmyvt
verses.translation: I am the LORD your God, which brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, that ye should not be their bondmen; and I have broken the bands of your yoke, and made you go upright.

verses.original: וְ/אִם לֹ֥א תִשְׁמְע֖וּ לִ֑/י וְ/לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/מִּצְוֺ֖ת הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: v'm l' tshm'v ly vl' t'shv 't khl hmtsvt h'lh
verses.translation: But if ye will not hearken unto me, and will not do all these commandments;

verses.original: וְ/אִם בְּ/חֻקֹּתַ֣/י תִּמְאָ֔סוּ וְ/אִ֥ם אֶת מִשְׁפָּטַ֖/י תִּגְעַ֣ל נַפְשְׁ/כֶ֑ם לְ/בִלְתִּ֤י עֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת כָּל מִצְוֺתַ֔/י לְ/הַפְרְ/כֶ֖ם אֶת בְּרִיתִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'm bchqty tm'sv v'm 't mshpty tg'l npshkhm lblty 'shvt 't khl mtsvty lhprkhm 't bryty
verses.translation: And if ye shall despise my statutes, or if your soul abhor my judgments, so that ye will not do all my commandments, but that ye break my covenant:

verses.original: אַף אֲנִ֞י אֶֽעֱשֶׂה זֹּ֣את לָ/כֶ֗ם וְ/הִפְקַדְתִּ֨י עֲלֵי/כֶ֤ם בֶּֽהָלָה֙ אֶת הַ/שַּׁחֶ֣פֶת וְ/אֶת הַ/קַּדַּ֔חַת מְכַלּ֥וֹת עֵינַ֖יִם וּ/מְדִיבֹ֣ת נָ֑פֶשׁ וּ/זְרַעְתֶּ֤ם לָ/רִיק֙ זַרְעֲ/כֶ֔ם וַ/אֲכָלֻ֖/הוּ אֹיְבֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'f 'ny ''shh z't lkhm vhpqdty 'lykhm bhlh 't hshchpt v't hqdcht mkhlvt 'ynym vmdybt npsh vzr'tm lryq zr'khm v'khlhv 'ybykhm
verses.translation: I also will do this unto you; I will even appoint over you terror, consumption, and the burning ague, that shall consume the eyes, and cause sorrow of heart: and ye shall sow your seed in vain, for your enemies shall eat it.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י פָנַ/י֙ בָּ/כֶ֔ם וְ/נִגַּפְתֶּ֖ם לִ/פְנֵ֣י אֹיְבֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/רָד֤וּ בָ/כֶם֙ שֹֽׂנְאֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/נַסְתֶּ֖ם וְ/אֵין רֹדֵ֥ף אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vntty pny bkhm vngptm lpny 'ybykhm vrdv bkhm shn'ykhm vnstm v'yn rdf 'tkhm
verses.translation: And I will set my face against you, and ye shall be slain before your enemies: they that hate you shall reign over you; and ye shall flee when none pursueth you.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֨ם עַד אֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א תִשְׁמְע֖וּ לִ֑/י וְ/יָסַפְתִּי֙ לְ/יַסְּרָ֣ה אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם שֶׁ֖בַע עַל חַטֹּאתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'm 'd 'lh l' tshm'v ly vyspty lysrh 'tkhm shb' 'l cht'tykhm
verses.translation: And if ye will not yet for all this hearken unto me, then I will punish you seven times more for your sins.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁבַרְתִּ֖י אֶת גְּא֣וֹן עֻזְּ/כֶ֑ם וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י אֶת שְׁמֵי/כֶם֙ כַּ/בַּרְזֶ֔ל וְ/אֶֽת אַרְצְ/כֶ֖ם כַּ/נְּחֻשָֽׁה
verses.translit: vshbrty 't g'vn 'zkhm vntty 't shmykhm khbrzl v't 'rtskhm khnchshh
verses.translation: And I will break the pride of your power; and I will make your heaven as iron, and your earth as brass:

verses.original: וְ/תַ֥ם לָ/רִ֖יק כֹּחֲ/כֶ֑ם וְ/לֹֽא תִתֵּ֤ן אַרְצְ/כֶם֙ אֶת יְבוּלָ֔/הּ וְ/עֵ֣ץ הָ/אָ֔רֶץ לֹ֥א יִתֵּ֖ן פִּרְיֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vtm lryq khchkhm vl' ttn 'rtskhm 't ybvlh v'ts h'rts l' ytn pryv
verses.translation: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.

verses.original: וְ/אִם תֵּֽלְכ֤וּ עִמִּ/י֙ קֶ֔רִי וְ/לֹ֥א תֹאב֖וּ לִ/שְׁמֹ֣עַֽ לִ֑/י וְ/יָסַפְתִּ֤י עֲלֵי/כֶם֙ מַכָּ֔ה שֶׁ֖בַע כְּ/חַטֹּאתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'm tlkhv 'my qry vl' t'bv lshm' ly vyspty 'lykhm mkhh shb' khcht'tykhm
verses.translation: And if ye walk contrary unto me, and will not hearken unto me; I will bring seven times more plagues upon you according to your sins.

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁלַחְתִּ֨י בָ/כֶ֜ם אֶת חַיַּ֤ת הַ/שָּׂדֶה֙ וְ/שִׁכְּלָ֣ה אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/הִכְרִ֨יתָה֙ אֶת בְּהֶמְתְּ/כֶ֔ם וְ/הִמְעִ֖יטָה אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/נָשַׁ֖מּוּ דַּרְכֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhshlchty bkhm 't chyt hshdh vshkhlh 'tkhm vhkhryth 't bhmtkhm vhm'yth 'tkhm vnshmv drkhykhm
verses.translation: I will also send wild beasts among you, which shall rob you of your children, and destroy your cattle, and make you few in number; and your high ways shall be desolate.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֨ם בְּ/אֵ֔לֶּה לֹ֥א תִוָּסְר֖וּ לִ֑/י וַ/הֲלַכְתֶּ֥ם עִמִּ֖/י קֶֽרִי
verses.translit: v'm b'lh l' tvsrv ly vhlkhtm 'my qry
verses.translation: And if ye will not be reformed by me by these things, but will walk contrary unto me;

verses.original: וְ/הָלַכְתִּ֧י אַף אֲנִ֛י עִמָּ/כֶ֖ם בְּ/קֶ֑רִי וְ/הִכֵּיתִ֤י אֶתְ/כֶם֙ גַּם אָ֔נִי שֶׁ֖בַע עַל חַטֹּאתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhlkhty 'f 'ny 'mkhm bqry vhkhyty 'tkhm gm 'ny shb' 'l cht'tykhm
verses.translation: Then will I also walk contrary unto you, and will punish you yet seven times for your sins.

verses.original: וְ/הֵבֵאתִ֨י עֲלֵי/כֶ֜ם חֶ֗רֶב נֹקֶ֨מֶת֙ נְקַם בְּרִ֔ית וְ/נֶאֱסַפְתֶּ֖ם אֶל עָרֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/שִׁלַּ֤חְתִּי דֶ֨בֶר֙ בְּ/ת֣וֹכְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/נִתַּתֶּ֖ם בְּ/יַד אוֹיֵֽב
verses.translit: vhb'ty 'lykhm chrb nqmt nqm bryt vn'sptm 'l 'rykhm vshlchty dbr btvkhkhm vnttm byd 'vyb
verses.translation: And I will bring a sword upon you, that shall avenge the quarrel of my covenant: and when ye are gathered together within your cities, I will send the pestilence among you; and ye shall be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

verses.original: בְּ/שִׁבְרִ֣/י לָ/כֶם֮ מַטֵּה לֶחֶם֒ וְ֠/אָפוּ עֶ֣שֶׂר נָשִׁ֤ים לַחְמְ/כֶם֙ בְּ/תַנּ֣וּר אֶחָ֔ד וְ/הֵשִׁ֥יבוּ לַחְמְ/כֶ֖ם בַּ/מִּשְׁקָ֑ל וַ/אֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם וְ/לֹ֥א תִשְׂבָּֽעוּ
verses.translit: bshbry lkhm mth lchm v'pv 'shr nshym lchmkhm btnvr 'chd vhshybv lchmkhm bmshql v'khltm vl' tshb'v
verses.translation: And when I have broken the staff of your bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver you your bread again by weight: and ye shall eat, and not be satisfied.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֨ם בְּ/זֹ֔את לֹ֥א תִשְׁמְע֖וּ לִ֑/י וַ/הֲלַכְתֶּ֥ם עִמִּ֖/י בְּ/קֶֽרִי
verses.translit: v'm bz't l' tshm'v ly vhlkhtm 'my bqry
verses.translation: And if ye will not for all this hearken unto me, but walk contrary unto me;

verses.original: וְ/הָלַכְתִּ֥י עִמָּ/כֶ֖ם בַּ/חֲמַת קֶ֑רִי וְ/יִסַּרְתִּ֤י אֶתְ/כֶם֙ אַף אָ֔נִי שֶׁ֖בַע עַל חַטֹּאתֵי/כֶם
verses.translit: vhlkhty 'mkhm bchmt qry vysrty 'tkhm 'f 'ny shb' 'l cht'tykhm
verses.translation: Then I will walk contrary unto you also in fury; and I, even I, will chastise you seven times for your sins.

verses.original: וַ/אֲכַלְתֶּ֖ם בְּשַׂ֣ר בְּנֵי/כֶ֑ם וּ/בְשַׂ֥ר בְּנֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם תֹּאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: v'khltm bshr bnykhm vbshr bntykhm t'khlv
verses.translation: And ye shall eat the flesh of your sons, and the flesh of your daughters shall ye eat.

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁמַדְתִּ֞י אֶת בָּמֹֽתֵי/כֶ֗ם וְ/הִכְרַתִּי֙ אֶת חַמָּ֣נֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/נָֽתַתִּי֙ אֶת פִּגְרֵי/כֶ֔ם עַל פִּגְרֵ֖י גִּלּוּלֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/גָעֲלָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖/י אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhshmdty 't bmtykhm vhkhrty 't chmnykhm vntty 't pgrykhm 'l pgry glvlykhm vg'lh npshy 'tkhm
verses.translation: And I will destroy your high places, and cut down your images, and cast your carcases upon the carcases of your idols, and my soul shall abhor you.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י אֶת עָֽרֵי/כֶם֙ חָרְבָּ֔ה וַ/הֲשִׁמּוֹתִ֖י אֶת מִקְדְּשֵׁי/כֶ֑ם וְ/לֹ֣א אָרִ֔יחַ בְּ/רֵ֖יחַ נִיחֹֽחֲ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vntty 't 'rykhm chrbh vhshmvty 't mqdshykhm vl' 'rych brych nychchkhm
verses.translation: And I will make your cities waste, and bring your sanctuaries unto desolation, and I will not smell the savour of your sweet odours.

verses.original: וַ/הֲשִׁמֹּתִ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/שָֽׁמְמ֤וּ עָלֶ֨י/הָ֙ אֹֽיְבֵי/כֶ֔ם הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vhshmty 'ny 't h'rts vshmmv 'lyh 'ybykhm hyshbym bh
verses.translation: And I will bring the land into desolation: and your enemies which dwell therein shall be astonished at it.

verses.original: וְ/אֶתְ/כֶם֙ אֱזָרֶ֣ה בַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם וַ/הֲרִיקֹתִ֥י אַחֲרֵי/כֶ֖ם חָ֑רֶב וְ/הָיְתָ֤ה אַרְצְ/כֶם֙ שְׁמָמָ֔ה וְ/עָרֵי/כֶ֖ם יִהְי֥וּ חָרְבָּֽה
verses.translit: v'tkhm 'zrh bgvym vhryqty 'chrykhm chrb vhyth 'rtskhm shmmh v'rykhm yhyv chrbh
verses.translation: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.

verses.original: אָז֩ תִּרְצֶ֨ה הָ/אָ֜רֶץ אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתֶ֗י/הָ כֹּ֚ל יְמֵ֣י הֳשַׁמָּ֔/ה וְ/אַתֶּ֖ם בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ אֹיְבֵי/כֶ֑ם אָ֚ז תִּשְׁבַּ֣ת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/הִרְצָ֖ת אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: 'z trtsh h'rts 't shbttyh khl ymy hshmh v'tm b'rts 'ybykhm 'z tshbt h'rts vhrtst 't shbttyh
verses.translation: Then shall the land enjoy her sabbaths, as long as it lieth desolate, and ye be in your enemies’ land; even then shall the land rest, and enjoy her sabbaths.

verses.original: כָּל יְמֵ֥י הָשַּׁמָּ֖/ה תִּשְׁבֹּ֑ת אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא שָׁבְתָ֛ה בְּ/שַׁבְּתֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם בְּ/שִׁבְתְּ/כֶ֥ם עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: khl ymy hshmh tshbt 't 'shr l' shbth bshbttykhm bshbtkhm 'lyh
verses.translation: As long as it lieth desolate it shall rest; because it did not rest in your sabbaths, when ye dwelt upon it.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּ/כֶ֔ם וְ/הֵבֵ֤אתִי מֹ֨רֶךְ֙ בִּ/לְבָבָ֔/ם בְּ/אַרְצֹ֖ת אֹיְבֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/רָדַ֣ף אֹתָ֗/ם ק֚וֹל עָלֶ֣ה נִדָּ֔ף וְ/נָס֧וּ מְנֻֽסַת חֶ֛רֶב וְ/נָפְל֖וּ וְ/אֵ֥ין רֹדֵֽף
verses.translit: vhnsh'rym bkhm vhb'ty mrkh blbbm b'rtst 'ybyhm vrdf 'tm qvl 'lh ndf vnsv mnst chrb vnplv v'yn rdf
verses.translation: And upon them that are left alive of you I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies; and the sound of a shaken leaf shall chase them; and they shall flee, as fleeing from a sword; and they shall fall when none pursueth.

verses.original: וְ/כָשְׁל֧וּ אִישׁ בְּ/אָחִ֛י/ו כְּ/מִ/פְּנֵי חֶ֖רֶב וְ/רֹדֵ֣ף אָ֑יִן וְ/לֹא תִֽהְיֶ֤ה לָ/כֶם֙ תְּקוּמָ֔ה לִ/פְנֵ֖י אֹֽיְבֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vkhshlv 'ysh b'chyv khmpny chrb vrdf 'yn vl' thyh lkhm tqvmh lpny 'ybykhm
verses.translation: And they shall fall one upon another, as it were before a sword, when none pursueth: and ye shall have no power to stand before your enemies.

verses.original: וַ/אֲבַדְתֶּ֖ם בַּ/גּוֹיִ֑ם וְ/אָכְלָ֣ה אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם אֶ֖רֶץ אֹיְבֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'bdtm bgvym v'khlh 'tkhm 'rts 'ybykhm
verses.translation: And ye shall perish among the heathen, and the land of your enemies shall eat you up.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּ/כֶ֗ם יִמַּ֨קּוּ֙ בַּֽ/עֲוֺנָ֔/ם בְּ/אַרְצֹ֖ת אֹיְבֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/אַ֛ף בַּ/עֲוֺנֹ֥ת אֲבֹתָ֖/ם אִתָּ֥/ם יִמָּֽקּוּ
verses.translit: vhnsh'rym bkhm ymqv b'vnm b'rtst 'ybykhm v'f b'vnt 'btm 'tm ymqv
verses.translation: And they that are left of you shall pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers shall they pine away with them.

verses.original: וְ/הִתְוַדּ֤וּ אֶת עֲוֺנָ/ם֙ וְ/אֶת עֲוֺ֣ן אֲבֹתָ֔/ם בְּ/מַעֲלָ֖/ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר מָֽעֲלוּ בִ֑/י וְ/אַ֕ף אֲשֶׁר הָֽלְכ֥וּ עִמִּ֖/י בְּ/קֶֽרִי
verses.translit: vhtvdv 't 'vnm v't 'vn 'btm bm'lm 'shr m'lv by v'f 'shr hlkhv 'my bqry
verses.translation: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;

verses.original: אַף אֲנִ֗י אֵלֵ֤ךְ עִמָּ/ם֙ בְּ/קֶ֔רִי וְ/הֵבֵאתִ֣י אֹתָ֔/ם בְּ/אֶ֖רֶץ אֹיְבֵי/הֶ֑ם אוֹ אָ֣ז יִכָּנַ֗ע לְבָבָ/ם֙ הֶֽ/עָרֵ֔ל וְ/אָ֖ז יִרְצ֥וּ אֶת עֲוֺנָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'f 'ny 'lkh 'mm bqry vhb'ty 'tm b'rts 'ybyhm 'v 'z ykhn' lbbm h'rl v'z yrtsv 't 'vnm
verses.translation: And that I also have walked contrary unto them, and have brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised hearts be humbled, and they then accept of the punishment of their iniquity:

verses.original: וְ/זָכַרְתִּ֖י אֶת בְּרִיתִ֣/י יַעֲק֑וֹב וְ/אַף֩ אֶת בְּרִיתִ֨/י יִצְחָ֜ק וְ/אַ֨ף אֶת בְּרִיתִ֧/י אַבְרָהָ֛ם אֶזְכֹּ֖ר וְ/הָ/אָ֥רֶץ אֶזְכֹּֽר
verses.translit: vzkhrty 't bryty y'qvb v'f 't bryty ytschq v'f 't bryty 'brhm 'zkhr vh'rts 'zkhr
verses.translation: Then will I remember my covenant with Jacob, and also my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham will I remember; and I will remember the land.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אָרֶץ֩ תֵּעָזֵ֨ב מֵ/הֶ֜ם וְ/תִ֣רֶץ אֶת שַׁבְּתֹתֶ֗י/הָ בָּ/הְשַׁמָּ/ה֙ מֵ/הֶ֔ם וְ/הֵ֖ם יִרְצ֣וּ אֶת עֲוֺנָ֑/ם יַ֣עַן וּ/בְ/יַ֔עַן בְּ/מִשְׁפָּטַ֣/י מָאָ֔סוּ וְ/אֶת חֻקֹּתַ֖/י גָּעֲלָ֥ה נַפְשָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: vh'rts t'zb mhm vtrts 't shbttyh bhshmh mhm vhm yrtsv 't 'vnm y'n vby'n bmshpty m'sv v't chqty g'lh npshm
verses.translation: The land also shall be left of them, and shall enjoy her sabbaths, while she lieth desolate without them: and they shall accept of the punishment of their iniquity: because, even because they despised my judgments, and because their soul abhorred my statutes.

verses.original: וְ/אַף גַּם זֹ֠את בִּֽ/הְיוֹתָ֞/ם בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ אֹֽיְבֵי/הֶ֗ם לֹֽא מְאַסְתִּ֤י/ם וְ/לֹֽא גְעַלְתִּי/ם֙ לְ/כַלֹּתָ֔/ם לְ/הָפֵ֥ר בְּרִיתִ֖/י אִתָּ֑/ם כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'f gm z't bhyvtm b'rts 'ybyhm l' m'stym vl' g'ltym lkhltm lhpr bryty 'tm khy 'ny yhvh 'lhyhm
verses.translation: And yet for all that, when they be in the land of their enemies, I will not cast them away, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly, and to break my covenant with them: for I am the LORD their God.

verses.original: וְ/זָכַרְתִּ֥י לָ/הֶ֖ם בְּרִ֣ית רִאשֹׁנִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹצֵֽאתִי אֹתָ/ם֩ מֵ/אֶ֨רֶץ מִצְרַ֜יִם לְ/עֵינֵ֣י הַ/גּוֹיִ֗ם לִ/הְיֹ֥ת לָ/הֶ֛ם לֵ/אלֹהִ֖ים אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vzkhrty lhm bryt r'shnym 'shr hvts'ty 'tm m'rts mtsrym l'yny hgvym lhyt lhm l'lhym 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: But I will for their sakes remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought forth out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the heathen, that I might be their God: I am the LORD .

verses.original: אֵ֠לֶּה הַֽ/חֻקִּ֣ים וְ/הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִים֮ וְ/הַ/תּוֹרֹת֒ אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן יְהוָ֔ה בֵּינ֕/וֹ וּ/בֵ֖ין בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּ/הַ֥ר סִינַ֖י בְּ/יַד מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: 'lh hchqym vhmshptym vhtvrt 'shr ntn yhvh bynv vbyn bny yshr'l bhr syny byd mshh
verses.translation: These are the statutes and judgments and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in mount Sinai by the hand of Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם אִ֕ישׁ כִּ֥י יַפְלִ֖א נֶ֑דֶר בְּ/עֶרְכְּ/ךָ֥ נְפָשֹׁ֖ת לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm 'ysh khy ypl' ndr b'rkhkh npsht lyhvh
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When a man shall make a singular vow, the persons shall be for the LORD by thy estimation.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֤ה עֶרְכְּ/ךָ֙ הַ/זָּכָ֔ר מִ/בֶּן֙ עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְ/עַ֖ד בֶּן שִׁשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וְ/הָיָ֣ה עֶרְכְּ/ךָ֗ חֲמִשִּׁ֛ים שֶׁ֥קֶל כֶּ֖סֶף בְּ/שֶׁ֥קֶל הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: vhyh 'rkhkh hzkhr mbn 'shrym shnh v'd bn shshym shnh vhyh 'rkhkh chmshym shql khsf bshql hqdsh
verses.translation: And thy estimation shall be of the male from twenty years old even unto sixty years old, even thy estimation shall be fifty shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

verses.original: וְ/אִם נְקֵבָ֖ה הִ֑וא וְ/הָיָ֥ה עֶרְכְּ/ךָ֖ שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים שָֽׁקֶל
verses.translit: v'm nqbh hv' vhyh 'rkhkh shlshym shql
verses.translation: And if it be a female, then thy estimation shall be thirty shekels.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֨ם מִ/בֶּן חָמֵ֜שׁ שָׁנִ֗ים וְ/עַד֙ בֶּן עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְ/הָיָ֧ה עֶרְכְּ/ךָ֛ הַ/זָּכָ֖ר עֶשְׂרִ֣ים שְׁקָלִ֑ים וְ/לַ/נְּקֵבָ֖ה עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת שְׁקָלִֽים
verses.translit: v'm mbn chmsh shnym v'd bn 'shrym shnh vhyh 'rkhkh hzkhr 'shrym shqlym vlnqbh 'shrt shqlym
verses.translation: And if it be from five years old even unto twenty years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֣ם מִ/בֶּן חֹ֗דֶשׁ וְ/עַד֙ בֶּן חָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֔ים וְ/הָיָ֤ה עֶרְכְּ/ךָ֙ הַ/זָּכָ֔ר חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה שְׁקָלִ֖ים כָּ֑סֶף וְ/לַ/נְּקֵבָ֣ה עֶרְכְּ/ךָ֔ שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: v'm mbn chdsh v'd bn chmsh shnym vhyh 'rkhkh hzkhr chmshh shqlym khsf vlnqbh 'rkhkh shlsht shqlym khsf
verses.translation: And if it be from a month old even unto five years old, then thy estimation shall be of the male five shekels of silver, and for the female thy estimation shall be three shekels of silver.

verses.original: וְ֠/אִם מִ/בֶּן שִׁשִּׁ֨ים שָׁנָ֤ה וָ/מַ֨עְלָ/ה֙ אִם זָכָ֔ר וְ/הָיָ֣ה עֶרְכְּ/ךָ֔ חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר שָׁ֑קֶל וְ/לַ/נְּקֵבָ֖ה עֲשָׂרָ֥ה שְׁקָלִֽים
verses.translit: v'm mbn shshym shnh vm'lh 'm zkhr vhyh 'rkhkh chmshh 'shr shql vlnqbh 'shrh shqlym
verses.translation: And if it be from sixty years old and above; if it be a male, then thy estimation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.

verses.original: וְ/אִם מָ֥ךְ הוּא֙ מֵֽ/עֶרְכֶּ֔/ךָ וְ/הֶֽעֱמִיד/וֹ֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/הֶעֱרִ֥יךְ אֹת֖/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן עַל פִּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר תַּשִּׂיג֙ יַ֣ד הַ/נֹּדֵ֔ר יַעֲרִיכֶ֖/נּוּ הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: v'm mkh hv' m'rkhkh vh'mydv lpny hkhhn vh'rykh 'tv hkhhn 'l py 'shr tshyg yd hndr y'rykhnv hkhhn
verses.translation: But if he be poorer than thy estimation, then he shall present himself before the priest, and the priest shall value him; according to his ability that vowed shall the priest value him.

verses.original: וְ/אִם בְּהֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַקְרִ֧יבוּ מִמֶּ֛/נָּה קָרְבָּ֖ן לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִתֵּ֥ן מִמֶּ֛/נּוּ לַ/יהוָ֖ה יִֽהְיֶה קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: v'm bhmh 'shr yqrybv mmnh qrbn lyhvh khl 'shr ytn mmnv lyhvh yhyh qdsh
verses.translation: And if it be a beast, whereof men bring an offering unto the LORD , all that any man giveth of such unto the LORD shall be holy.

verses.original: לֹ֣א יַחֲלִיפֶ֗/נּוּ וְ/לֹֽא יָמִ֥יר אֹת֛/וֹ ט֥וֹב בְּ/רָ֖ע אוֹ רַ֣ע בְּ/ט֑וֹב וְ/אִם הָמֵ֨ר יָמִ֤יר בְּהֵמָה֙ בִּ/בְהֵמָ֔ה וְ/הָֽיָה ה֥וּא וּ/תְמוּרָת֖/וֹ יִֽהְיֶה קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: l' ychlypnv vl' ymyr 'tv tvb br' 'v r' btvb v'm hmr ymyr bhmh bbhmh vhyh hv' vtmvrtv yhyh qdsh
verses.translation: He shall not alter it, nor change it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good: and if he shall at all change beast for beast, then it and the exchange thereof shall be holy.

verses.original: וְ/אִם֙ כָּל בְּהֵמָ֣ה טְמֵאָ֔ה אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹא יַקְרִ֧יבוּ מִמֶּ֛/נָּה קָרְבָּ֖ן לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/הֶֽעֱמִ֥יד אֶת הַ/בְּהֵמָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: v'm khl bhmh tm'h 'shr l' yqrybv mmnh qrbn lyhvh vh'myd 't hbhmh lpny hkhhn
verses.translation: And if it be any unclean beast, of which they do not offer a sacrifice unto the LORD , then he shall present the beast before the priest:

verses.original: וְ/הֶעֱרִ֤יךְ הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ אֹתָ֔/הּ בֵּ֥ין ט֖וֹב וּ/בֵ֣ין רָ֑ע כְּ/עֶרְכְּ/ךָ֥ הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן כֵּ֥ן יִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vh'rykh hkhhn 'th byn tvb vbyn r' kh'rkhkh hkhhn khn yhyh
verses.translation: And the priest shall value it, whether it be good or bad: as thou valuest it, who art the priest, so shall it be.

verses.original: וְ/אִם גָּאֹ֖ל יִגְאָלֶ֑/נָּה וְ/יָסַ֥ף חֲמִישִׁת֖/וֹ עַל עֶרְכֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'm g'l yg'lnh vysf chmyshtv 'l 'rkhkh
verses.translation: But if he will at all redeem it, then he shall add a fifth part thereof unto thy estimation.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֗ישׁ כִּֽי יַקְדִּ֨שׁ אֶת בֵּית֥/וֹ קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה וְ/הֶעֱרִיכ/וֹ֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן בֵּ֥ין ט֖וֹב וּ/בֵ֣ין רָ֑ע כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲרִ֥יךְ אֹת֛/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן כֵּ֥ן יָקֽוּם
verses.translit: v'ysh khy yqdsh 't bytv qdsh lyhvh vh'rykhv hkhhn byn tvb vbyn r' kh'shr y'rykh 'tv hkhhn khn yqvm
verses.translation: And when a man shall sanctify his house to be holy unto the LORD , then the priest shall estimate it, whether it be good or bad: as the priest shall estimate it, so shall it stand.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֨ם הַ/מַּקְדִּ֔ישׁ יִגְאַ֖ל אֶת בֵּית֑/וֹ וְ֠/יָסַף חֲמִישִׁ֧ית כֶּֽסֶף עֶרְכְּ/ךָ֛ עָלָ֖י/ו וְ/הָ֥יָה לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'm hmqdysh yg'l 't bytv vysf chmyshyt khsf 'rkhkh 'lyv vhyh lv
verses.translation: And if he that sanctified it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be his.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֣ם מִ/שְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֗/וֹ יַקְדִּ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה וְ/הָיָ֥ה עֶרְכְּ/ךָ֖ לְ/פִ֣י זַרְע֑/וֹ זֶ֚רַע חֹ֣מֶר שְׂעֹרִ֔ים בַּ/חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים שֶׁ֥קֶל כָּֽסֶף
verses.translit: v'm mshdh 'chztv yqdysh 'ysh lyhvh vhyh 'rkhkh lpy zr'v zr' chmr sh'rym bchmshym shql khsf
verses.translation: And if a man shall sanctify unto the LORD some part of a field of his possession, then thy estimation shall be according to the seed thereof: an homer of barley seed shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

verses.original: אִם מִ/שְּׁנַ֥ת הַ/יֹּבֵ֖ל יַקְדִּ֣ישׁ שָׂדֵ֑/הוּ כְּ/עֶרְכְּ/ךָ֖ יָקֽוּם
verses.translit: 'm mshnt hybl yqdysh shdhv kh'rkhkh yqvm
verses.translation: If he sanctify his field from the year of jubile, according to thy estimation it shall stand.

verses.original: וְ/אִם אַחַ֣ר הַ/יֹּבֵל֮ יַקְדִּ֣ישׁ שָׂדֵ/הוּ֒ וְ/חִשַּׁב ל֨/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת הַ/כֶּ֗סֶף עַל פִּ֤י הַ/שָּׁנִים֙ הַ/נּ֣וֹתָרֹ֔ת עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַ/יֹּבֵ֑ל וְ/נִגְרַ֖ע מֵֽ/עֶרְכֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'm 'chr hybl yqdysh shdhv vchshb lv hkhhn 't hkhsf 'l py hshnym hnvtrt 'd shnt hybl vngr' m'rkhkh
verses.translation: But if he sanctify his field after the jubile, then the priest shall reckon unto him the money according to the years that remain, even unto the year of the jubile, and it shall be abated from thy estimation.

verses.original: וְ/אִם גָּאֹ֤ל יִגְאַל֙ אֶת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה הַ/מַּקְדִּ֖ישׁ אֹת֑/וֹ וְ֠/יָסַף חֲמִשִׁ֧ית כֶּֽסֶף עֶרְכְּ/ךָ֛ עָלָ֖י/ו וְ/קָ֥ם לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'm g'l yg'l 't hshdh hmqdysh 'tv vysf chmshyt khsf 'rkhkh 'lyv vqm lv
verses.translation: And if he that sanctified the field will in any wise redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of thy estimation unto it, and it shall be assured to him.

verses.original: וְ/אִם לֹ֤א יִגְאַל֙ אֶת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה וְ/אִם מָכַ֥ר אֶת הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה לְ/אִ֣ישׁ אַחֵ֑ר לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵ֖ל עֽוֹד
verses.translit: v'm l' yg'l 't hshdh v'm mkhr 't hshdh l'ysh 'chr l' yg'l 'vd
verses.translation: And if he will not redeem the field, or if he have sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more.
