verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֨ה הַ/שָּׂדֶ֜ה בְּ/צֵאת֣/וֹ בַ/יֹּבֵ֗ל קֹ֛דֶשׁ לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה כִּ/שְׂדֵ֣ה הַ/חֵ֑רֶם לַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן תִּהְיֶ֥ה אֲחֻזָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhyh hshdh bts'tv bybl qdsh lyhvh khshdh hchrm lkhhn thyh 'chztv
verses.translation: But the field, when it goeth out in the jubile, shall be holy unto the LORD , as a field devoted; the possession thereof shall be the priest’s.

verses.original: וְ/אִם֙ אֶת שְׂדֵ֣ה מִקְנָת֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֕ר לֹ֖א מִ/שְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֑/וֹ יַקְדִּ֖ישׁ לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'm 't shdh mqntv 'shr l' mshdh 'chztv yqdysh lyhvh
verses.translation: And if a man sanctify unto the LORD a field which he hath bought, which is not of the fields of his possession;

verses.original: וְ/חִשַּׁב ל֣/וֹ הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן אֵ֚ת מִכְסַ֣ת הָֽ/עֶרְכְּ/ךָ֔ עַ֖ד שְׁנַ֣ת הַ/יֹּבֵ֑ל וְ/נָתַ֤ן אֶת הָ/עֶרְכְּ/ךָ֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vchshb lv hkhhn 't mkhst h'rkhkh 'd shnt hybl vntn 't h'rkhkh byvm hhv' qdsh lyhvh
verses.translation: Then the priest shall reckon unto him the worth of thy estimation, even unto the year of the jubile: and he shall give thine estimation in that day, as a holy thing unto the LORD .

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁנַ֤ת הַ/יּוֹבֵל֙ יָשׁ֣וּב הַ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה לַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר קָנָ֖/הוּ מֵ/אִתּ֑/וֹ לַ/אֲשֶׁר ל֖/וֹ אֲחֻזַּ֥ת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: bshnt hyvbl yshvb hshdh l'shr qnhv m'tv l'shr lv 'chzt h'rts
verses.translation: In the year of the jubile the field shall return unto him of whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land did belong .

verses.original: וְ/כָל עֶרְכְּ/ךָ֔ יִהְיֶ֖ה בְּ/שֶׁ֣קֶל הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֥ה הַ/שָּֽׁקֶל
verses.translit: vkhl 'rkhkh yhyh bshql hqdsh 'shrym grh yhyh hshql
verses.translation: And all thy estimations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs shall be the shekel.

verses.original: אַךְ בְּכ֞וֹר אֲשֶׁר יְבֻכַּ֤ר לַֽ/יהוָה֙ בִּ/בְהֵמָ֔ה לֹֽא יַקְדִּ֥ישׁ אִ֖ישׁ אֹת֑/וֹ אִם שׁ֣וֹר אִם שֶׂ֔ה לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה הֽוּא
verses.translit: 'kh bkhvr 'shr ybkhr lyhvh bbhmh l' yqdysh 'ysh 'tv 'm shvr 'm shh lyhvh hv'
verses.translation: Only the firstling of the beasts, which should be the LORD’s firstling, no man shall sanctify it; whether it be ox, or sheep: it is the LORD’s .

verses.original: וְ/אִ֨ם בַּ/בְּהֵמָ֤ה הַ/טְּמֵאָה֙ וּ/פָדָ֣ה בְ/עֶרְכֶּ֔/ךָ וְ/יָסַ֥ף חֲמִשִׁת֖/וֹ עָלָ֑י/ו וְ/אִם לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵ֖ל וְ/נִמְכַּ֥ר בְּ/עֶרְכֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'm bbhmh htm'h vpdh b'rkhkh vysf chmshtv 'lyv v'm l' yg'l vnmkhr b'rkhkh
verses.translation: And if it be of an unclean beast, then he shall redeem it according to thine estimation, and shall add a fifth part of it thereto: or if it be not redeemed, then it shall be sold according to thy estimation.

verses.original: אַךְ כָּל חֵ֡רֶם אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַחֲרִם֩ אִ֨ישׁ לַֽ/יהוָ֜ה מִ/כָּל אֲשֶׁר ל֗/וֹ מֵ/אָדָ֤ם וּ/בְהֵמָה֙ וּ/מִ/שְּׂדֵ֣ה אֲחֻזָּת֔/וֹ לֹ֥א יִמָּכֵ֖ר וְ/לֹ֣א יִגָּאֵ֑ל כָּל חֵ֕רֶם קֹֽדֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֥ים ה֖וּא לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'kh khl chrm 'shr ychrm 'ysh lyhvh mkhl 'shr lv m'dm vbhmh vmshdh 'chztv l' ymkhr vl' yg'l khl chrm qdsh qdshym hv' lyhvh
verses.translation: Notwithstanding no devoted thing, that a man shall devote unto the LORD of all that he hath, both of man and beast, and of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed: every devoted thing is most holy unto the LORD .

verses.original: כָּל חֵ֗רֶם אֲשֶׁ֧ר יָחֳרַ֛ם מִן הָ/אָדָ֖ם לֹ֣א יִפָּדֶ֑ה מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: khl chrm 'shr ychrm mn h'dm l' ypdh mvt yvmt
verses.translation: None devoted, which shall be devoted of men, shall be redeemed; but shall surely be put to death.

verses.original: וְ/כָל מַעְשַׂ֨ר הָ/אָ֜רֶץ מִ/זֶּ֤רַע הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ מִ/פְּרִ֣י הָ/עֵ֔ץ לַ/יהוָ֖ה ה֑וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vkhl m'shr h'rts mzr' h'rts mpry h'ts lyhvh hv' qdsh lyhvh
verses.translation: And all the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land, or of the fruit of the tree, is the LORD’s : it is holy unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אִם גָּאֹ֥ל יִגְאַ֛ל אִ֖ישׁ מִ/מַּֽעַשְׂר֑/וֹ חֲמִשִׁית֖/וֹ יֹסֵ֥ף עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'm g'l yg'l 'ysh mm'shrv chmshytv ysf 'lyv
verses.translation: And if a man will at all redeem ought of his tithes, he shall add thereto the fifth part thereof.

verses.original: וְ/כָל מַעְשַׂ֤ר בָּקָר֙ וָ/צֹ֔אן כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר יַעֲבֹ֖ר תַּ֣חַת הַ/שָּׁ֑בֶט הָֽ/עֲשִׂירִ֕י יִֽהְיֶה קֹּ֖דֶשׁ לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vkhl m'shr bqr vts'n khl 'shr y'br tcht hshbt h'shyry yhyh qdsh lyhvh
verses.translation: And concerning the tithe of the herd, or of the flock, even of whatsoever passeth under the rod, the tenth shall be holy unto the LORD .

verses.original: לֹ֧א יְבַקֵּ֛ר בֵּֽין ט֥וֹב לָ/רַ֖ע וְ/לֹ֣א יְמִירֶ֑/נּוּ וְ/אִם הָמֵ֣ר יְמִירֶ֔/נּוּ וְ/הָֽיָה ה֧וּא וּ/תְמוּרָת֛/וֹ יִֽהְיֶה קֹ֖דֶשׁ לֹ֥א יִגָּאֵֽל
verses.translit: l' ybqr byn tvb lr' vl' ymyrnv v'm hmr ymyrnv vhyh hv' vtmvrtv yhyh qdsh l' yg'l
verses.translation: He shall not search whether it be good or bad, neither shall he change it: and if he change it at all, then both it and the change thereof shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַ/מִּצְוֺ֗ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּ/הַ֖ר סִינָֽי
verses.translit: 'lh hmtsvt 'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh 'l bny yshr'l bhr syny
verses.translation: These are the commandments, which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel in mount Sinai.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֛ה בְּ/מִדְבַּ֥ר סִינַ֖י בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד בְּ/אֶחָד֩ לַ/חֹ֨דֶשׁ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֜י בַּ/שָּׁנָ֣ה הַ/שֵּׁנִ֗ית לְ/צֵאתָ֛/ם מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh bmdbr syny b'hl mv'd b'chd lchdsh hshny bshnh hshnyt lts'tm m'rts mtsrym l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

verses.original: שְׂא֗וּ אֶת רֹאשׁ֙ כָּל עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם בְּ/מִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמ֔וֹת כָּל זָכָ֖ר לְ/גֻלְגְּלֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: sh'v 't r'sh khl 'dt bny yshr'l lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmvt khl zkhr lglgltm
verses.translation: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their polls;

verses.original: מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה כָּל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָ֖א בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל תִּפְקְד֥וּ אֹתָ֛/ם לְ/צִבְאֹתָ֖/ם אַתָּ֥ה וְ/אַהֲרֹֽן
verses.translit: mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb' byshr'l tpqdv 'tm ltsb'tm 'th v'hrn
verses.translation: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.

verses.original: וְ/אִתְּ/כֶ֣ם יִהְי֔וּ אִ֥ישׁ אִ֖ישׁ לַ/מַּטֶּ֑ה אִ֛ישׁ רֹ֥אשׁ לְ/בֵית אֲבֹתָ֖י/ו הֽוּא
verses.translit: v'tkhm yhyv 'ysh 'ysh lmth 'ysh r'sh lbyt 'btyv hv'
verses.translation: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַֽעַמְד֖וּ אִתְּ/כֶ֑ם לִ/רְאוּבֵ֕ן אֱלִיצ֖וּר בֶּן שְׁדֵיאֽוּר
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt h'nshym 'shr y'mdv 'tkhm lr'vbn 'lytsvr bn shdy'vr
verses.translation: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.

verses.original: לְ/שִׁמְע֕וֹן שְׁלֻמִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן צוּרִֽישַׁדָּֽי
verses.translit: lshm'vn shlmy'l bn tsvryshdy
verses.translation: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

verses.original: לִֽ/יהוּדָ֕ה נַחְשׁ֖וֹן בֶּן עַמִּינָדָֽב
verses.translit: lyhvdh nchshvn bn 'myndb
verses.translation: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

verses.original: לְ/יִ֨שָּׂשכָ֔ר נְתַנְאֵ֖ל בֶּן צוּעָֽר
verses.translit: lyshshkhr ntn'l bn tsv'r
verses.translation: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

verses.original: לִ/זְבוּלֻ֕ן אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן חֵלֹֽן
verses.translit: lzbvln 'ly'b bn chln
verses.translation: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף לְ/אֶפְרַ֕יִם אֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע בֶּן עַמִּיה֑וּד לִ/מְנַשֶּׁ֕ה גַּמְלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן פְּדָהצֽוּר
verses.translit: lbny yvsf l'prym 'lyshm' bn 'myhvd lmnshh gmly'l bn pdhtsvr
verses.translation: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

verses.original: לְ/בִ֨נְיָמִ֔ן אֲבִידָ֖ן בֶּן גִּדְעֹנִֽי
verses.translit: lbnymn 'bydn bn gd'ny
verses.translation: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.

verses.original: לְ/דָ֕ן אֲחִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן עַמִּֽישַׁדָּֽי
verses.translit: ldn 'chy'zr bn 'myshdy
verses.translation: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

verses.original: לְ/אָשֵׁ֕ר פַּגְעִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן עָכְרָֽן
verses.translit: l'shr pg'y'l bn 'khrn
verses.translation: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.

verses.original: לְ/גָ֕ד אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן דְּעוּאֵֽל
verses.translit: lgd 'lysf bn d'v'l
verses.translation: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

verses.original: לְ/נַ֨פְתָּלִ֔י אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן עֵינָֽן
verses.translit: lnptly 'chyr' bn 'ynn
verses.translation: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה קריאי קְרוּאֵ֣י הָ/עֵדָ֔ה נְשִׂיאֵ֖י מַטּ֣וֹת אֲבוֹתָ֑/ם רָאשֵׁ֛י אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽם
verses.translit: 'lh qry'y qrv'y h'dh nshy'y mtvt 'bvtm r'shy 'lpy yshr'l hm
verses.translation: These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֑ן אֵ֚ת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִקְּב֖וּ בְּ/שֵׁמֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyqch mshh v'hrn 't h'nshym h'lh 'shr nqbv bshmvt
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by their names:

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל הָ/עֵדָ֜ה הִקְהִ֗ילוּ בְּ/אֶחָד֙ לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י וַ/יִּתְיַֽלְד֥וּ עַל מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם בְּ/מִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמ֗וֹת מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֛ה וָ/מַ֖עְלָ/ה לְ/גֻלְגְּלֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v't khl h'dh hqhylv b'chd lchdsh hshny vytyldv 'l mshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmvt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh lglgltm
verses.translation: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַֽ/יִּפְקְדֵ֖/ם בְּ/מִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי
verses.translit: kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh vypqdm bmdbr syny
verses.translation: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֤וּ בְנֵֽי רְאוּבֵן֙ בְּכֹ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥/ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם בְּ/מִסְפַּ֤ר שֵׁמוֹת֙ לְ/גֻלְגְּלֹתָ֔/ם כָּל זָכָ֗ר מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא
verses.translit: vyhyv bny r'vbn bkhr yshr'l tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmvt lglgltm khl zkhr mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: And the children of Reuben, Israel’s eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֑ן שִׁשָּׁ֧ה וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth r'vbn shshh v'rb'ym 'lf vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Reuben, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֔וֹן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥/ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם פְּקֻדָ֗י/ו בְּ/מִסְפַּ֤ר שֵׁמוֹת֙ לְ/גֻלְגְּלֹתָ֔/ם כָּל זָכָ֗ר מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא
verses.translit: lbny shm'vn tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm pqdyv bmspr shmvt lglgltm khl zkhr mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה שִׁמְע֑וֹן תִּשְׁעָ֧ה וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּ/שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth shm'vn tsh'h vchmshym 'lf vshlsh m'vt
verses.translation: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֣י גָ֔ד תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥/ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם בְּ/מִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמ֗וֹת מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא
verses.translit: lbny gd tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmvt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Gad, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה גָ֑ד חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְ/אַרְבָּעִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַ/חֲמִשִּֽׁים
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth gd chmshh v'rb'ym 'lf vshsh m'vt vchmshym
verses.translation: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Gad, were forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥/ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם בְּ/מִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא
verses.translit: lbny yhvdh tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Judah, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה יְהוּדָ֑ה אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וְ/שִׁבְעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth yhvdh 'rb'h vshb'ym 'lf vshsh m'vt
verses.translation: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Judah, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥/ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם בְּ/מִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא
verses.translit: lbny yshshkhr tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Issachar, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה יִשָּׂשכָ֑ר אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth yshshkhr 'rb'h vchmshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt
verses.translation: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֣י זְבוּלֻ֔ן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥/ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם בְּ/מִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא
verses.translit: lbny zbvln tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֑ן שִׁבְעָ֧ה וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth zbvln shb'h vchmshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt
verses.translation: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֤י יוֹסֵף֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥/ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם בְּ/מִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא
verses.translit: lbny yvsf lbny 'prym tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Joseph, namely , of the children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה אֶפְרָ֑יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth 'prym 'rb'ym 'lf vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand and five hundred.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥/ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם בְּ/מִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמ֗וֹת מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא
verses.translit: lbny mnshh tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmvt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה שְׁנַ֧יִם וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּ/מָאתָֽיִם
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth mnshh shnym vshlshym 'lf vm'tym
verses.translation: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥/ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם בְּ/מִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא
verses.translit: lbny bnymn tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֑ן חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth bnymn chmshh vshlshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt
verses.translation: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֣י דָ֔ן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥/ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם בְּ/מִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא
verses.translit: lbny dn tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה דָ֑ן שְׁנַ֧יִם וְ/שִׁשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּ/שְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth dn shnym vshshym 'lf vshb' m'vt
verses.translation: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֔ר תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥/ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם בְּ/מִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא
verses.translit: lbny 'shr tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֑ר אֶחָ֧ד וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth 'shr 'chd v'rb'ym 'lf vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֔י תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥/ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם בְּ/מִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא
verses.translit: bny nptly tvldtm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm bmspr shmt mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb'
verses.translation: Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֑י שְׁלֹשָׁ֧ה וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: pqdyhm lmth nptly shlshh vchmshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt
verses.translation: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַ/פְּקֻדִ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ פָּקַ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְ/אַהֲרֹן֙ וּ/נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר אִ֑ישׁ אִישׁ אֶחָ֥ד לְ/בֵית אֲבֹתָ֖י/ו הָיֽוּ
verses.translit: 'lh hpqdym 'shr pqd mshh v'hrn vnshy'y yshr'l shnym 'shr 'ysh 'ysh 'chd lbyt 'btyv hyv
verses.translation: These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְי֛וּ כָּל פְּקוּדֵ֥י בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה כָּל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָ֖א בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhyv khl pqvdy bny yshr'l lbyt 'btm mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh khl yts' tsb' byshr'l
verses.translation: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל הַ/פְּקֻדִ֔ים שֵׁשׁ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף וּ/שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים וַ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַ/חֲמִשִּֽׁים
verses.translit: vyhyv khl hpqdym shsh m'vt 'lf vshlsht 'lpym vchmsh m'vt vchmshym
verses.translation: Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה אֲבֹתָ֑/ם לֹ֥א הָתְפָּקְד֖וּ בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhlvym lmth 'btm l' htpqdv btvkhm
verses.translation: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: For the LORD had spoken unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ אֶת מַטֵּ֤ה לֵוִי֙ לֹ֣א תִפְקֹ֔ד וְ/אֶת רֹאשָׁ֖/ם לֹ֣א תִשָּׂ֑א בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 'kh 't mth lvy l' tpqd v't r'shm l' tsh' btvkh bny yshr'l
verses.translation: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֡ה הַפְקֵ֣ד אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּם֩ עַל מִשְׁכַּ֨ן הָ/עֵדֻ֜ת וְ/עַ֣ל כָּל כֵּלָי/ו֮ וְ/עַ֣ל כָּל אֲשֶׁר ל/וֹ֒ הֵ֜מָּה יִשְׂא֤וּ אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּן֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֔י/ו וְ/הֵ֖ם יְשָׁרְתֻ֑/הוּ וְ/סָבִ֥יב לַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יַחֲנֽוּ
verses.translit: v'th hpqd 't hlvym 'l mshkhn h'dt v'l khl khlyv v'l khl 'shr lv hmh ysh'v 't hmshkhn v't khl khlyv vhm yshrthv vsbyb lmshkhn ychnv
verses.translation: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/נְסֹ֣עַ הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֗ן יוֹרִ֤ידוּ אֹת/וֹ֙ הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם וּ/בַ/חֲנֹת֙ הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יָקִ֥ימוּ אֹת֖/וֹ הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם וְ/הַ/זָּ֥ר הַ/קָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: vbns' hmshkhn yvrydv 'tv hlvym vbchnt hmshkhn yqymv 'tv hlvym vhzr hqrb yvmt
verses.translation: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

verses.original: וְ/חָנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִ֧ישׁ עַֽל מַחֲנֵ֛/הוּ וְ/אִ֥ישׁ עַל דִּגְל֖/וֹ לְ/צִבְאֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vchnv bny yshr'l 'ysh 'l mchnhv v'ysh 'l dglv ltsb'tm
verses.translation: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּ֞ם יַחֲנ֤וּ סָבִיב֙ לְ/מִשְׁכַּ֣ן הָ/עֵדֻ֔ת וְ/לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֣ה קֶ֔צֶף עַל עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/שָׁמְרוּ֙ הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם אֶת מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת מִשְׁכַּ֥ן הָ/עֵדֽוּת
verses.translit: vhlvym ychnv sbyb lmshkhn h'dt vl' yhyh qtsf 'l 'dt bny yshr'l vshmrv hlvym 't mshmrt mshkhn h'dvt
verses.translation: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּ֠/כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֖ה כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: vy'shv bny yshr'l khkhl 'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh khn 'shv
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְ/אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh v'l 'hrn l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ עַל דִּגְל֤/וֹ בְ/אֹתֹת֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֔/ם יַחֲנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ/נֶּ֕גֶד סָבִ֥יב לְ/אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד יַחֲנֽוּ
verses.translit: 'ysh 'l dglv b'tt lbyt 'btm ychnv bny yshr'l mngd sbyb l'hl mv'd ychnv
verses.translation: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father’s house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/חֹנִים֙ קֵ֣דְמָ/ה מִזְרָ֔חָ/ה דֶּ֛גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה יְהוּדָ֖ה לְ/צִבְאֹתָ֑/ם וְ/נָשִׂיא֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה נַחְשׁ֖וֹן בֶּן עַמִּינָדָֽב
verses.translit: vhchnym qdmh mzrchh dgl mchnh yhvdh ltsb'tm vnshy' lbny yhvdh nchshvn bn 'myndb
verses.translation: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah.

verses.original: וּ/צְבָא֖/וֹ וּ/פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וְ/שִׁבְעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyhm 'rb'h vshb'ym 'lf vshsh m'vt
verses.translation: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/חֹנִ֥ים עָלָ֖י/ו מַטֵּ֣ה יִשָּׂשכָ֑ר וְ/נָשִׂיא֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר נְתַנְאֵ֖ל בֶּן צוּעָֽר
verses.translit: vhchnym 'lyv mth yshshkhr vnshy' lbny yshshkhr ntn'l bn tsv'r
verses.translation: And those that do pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar.

verses.original: וּ/צְבָא֖/וֹ וּ/פְקֻדָ֑י/ו אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyv 'rb'h vchmshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt
verses.translation: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.

verses.original: מַטֵּ֖ה זְבוּלֻ֑ן וְ/נָשִׂיא֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י זְבוּלֻ֔ן אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן חֵלֹֽן
verses.translit: mth zbvln vnshy' lbny zbvln 'ly'b bn chln
verses.translation: Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun.

verses.original: וּ/צְבָא֖/וֹ וּ/פְקֻדָ֑י/ו שִׁבְעָ֧ה וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyv shb'h vchmshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt
verses.translation: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.

verses.original: כָּֽל הַ/פְּקֻדִ֞ים לְ/מַחֲנֵ֣ה יְהוּדָ֗ה מְאַ֨ת אֶ֜לֶף וּ/שְׁמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף וְ/שֵֽׁשֶׁת אֲלָפִ֥ים וְ/אַרְבַּע מֵא֖וֹת לְ/צִבְאֹתָ֑/ם רִאשֹׁנָ֖ה יִסָּֽעוּ
verses.translit: khl hpqdym lmchnh yhvdh m't 'lf vshmnym 'lf vshsht 'lpym v'rb' m'vt ltsb'tm r'shnh ys'v
verses.translation: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah were an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.

verses.original: דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֧ה רְאוּבֵ֛ן תֵּימָ֖נָ/ה לְ/צִבְאֹתָ֑/ם וְ/נָשִׂיא֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֱלִיצ֖וּר בֶּן שְׁדֵיאֽוּר
verses.translit: dgl mchnh r'vbn tymnh ltsb'tm vnshy' lbny r'vbn 'lytsvr bn shdy'vr
verses.translation: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

verses.original: וּ/צְבָא֖/וֹ וּ/פְקֻדָ֑י/ו שִׁשָּׁ֧ה וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyv shshh v'rb'ym 'lf vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/חוֹנִ֥ם עָלָ֖י/ו מַטֵּ֣ה שִׁמְע֑וֹן וְ/נָשִׂיא֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֔וֹן שְׁלֻמִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן צוּרִֽי שַׁדָּֽי
verses.translit: vhchvnm 'lyv mth shm'vn vnshy' lbny shm'vn shlmy'l bn tsvry shdy
verses.translation: And those which pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

verses.original: וּ/צְבָא֖/וֹ וּ/פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֑ם תִּשְׁעָ֧ה וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּ/שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyhm tsh'h vchmshym 'lf vshlsh m'vt
verses.translation: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.

verses.original: וְ/מַטֵּ֖ה גָּ֑ד וְ/נָשִׂיא֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י גָ֔ד אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן רְעוּאֵֽל
verses.translit: vmth gd vnshy' lbny gd 'lysf bn r'v'l
verses.translation: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

verses.original: וּ/צְבָא֖/וֹ וּ/פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֑ם חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְ/אַרְבָּעִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַ/חֲמִשִּֽׁים
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyhm chmshh v'rb'ym 'lf vshsh m'vt vchmshym
verses.translation: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.

verses.original: כָּֽל הַ/פְּקֻדִ֞ים לְ/מַחֲנֵ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֗ן מְאַ֨ת אֶ֜לֶף וְ/אֶחָ֨ד וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף וְ/אַרְבַּע מֵא֥וֹת וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים לְ/צִבְאֹתָ֑/ם וּ/שְׁנִיִּ֖ם יִסָּֽעוּ
verses.translit: khl hpqdym lmchnh r'vbn m't 'lf v'chd vchmshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt vchmshym ltsb'tm vshnym ys'v
verses.translation: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.

verses.original: וְ/נָסַ֧ע אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵ֛ד מַחֲנֵ֥ה הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הַֽ/מַּחֲנֹ֑ת כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַחֲנוּ֙ כֵּ֣ן יִסָּ֔עוּ אִ֥ישׁ עַל יָד֖/וֹ לְ/דִגְלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vns' 'hl mv'd mchnh hlvym btvkh hmchnt kh'shr ychnv khn ys'v 'ysh 'l ydv ldglyhm
verses.translation: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.

verses.original: דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה אֶפְרַ֛יִם לְ/צִבְאֹתָ֖/ם יָ֑מָּ/ה וְ/נָשִׂיא֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם אֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע בֶּן עַמִּיהֽוּד
verses.translit: dgl mchnh 'prym ltsb'tm ymh vnshy' lbny 'prym 'lyshm' bn 'myhvd
verses.translation: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

verses.original: וּ/צְבָא֖/וֹ וּ/פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyhm 'rb'ym 'lf vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.

verses.original: וְ/עָלָ֖י/ו מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וְ/נָשִׂיא֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה גַּמְלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן פְּדָהצֽוּר
verses.translit: v'lyv mth mnshh vnshy' lbny mnshh gmly'l bn pdhtsvr
verses.translation: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

verses.original: וּ/צְבָא֖/וֹ וּ/פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֑ם שְׁנַ֧יִם וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּ/מָאתָֽיִם
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyhm shnym vshlshym 'lf vm'tym
verses.translation: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.

verses.original: וּ/מַטֵּ֖ה בִּנְיָמִ֑ן וְ/נָשִׂיא֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן אֲבִידָ֖ן בֶּן גִּדְעֹנִֽי
verses.translit: vmth bnymn vnshy' lbny bnymn 'bydn bn gd'ny
verses.translation: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

verses.original: וּ/צְבָא֖/וֹ וּ/פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֑ם חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyhm chmshh vshlshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt
verses.translation: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.

verses.original: כָּֽל הַ/פְּקֻדִ֞ים לְ/מַחֲנֵ֣ה אֶפְרַ֗יִם מְאַ֥ת אֶ֛לֶף וּ/שְׁמֹֽנַת אֲלָפִ֥ים וּ/מֵאָ֖ה לְ/צִבְאֹתָ֑/ם וּ/שְׁלִשִׁ֖ים יִסָּֽעוּ
verses.translit: khl hpqdym lmchnh 'prym m't 'lf vshmnt 'lpym vm'h ltsb'tm vshlshym ys'v
verses.translation: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.

verses.original: דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה דָ֛ן צָפֹ֖נָ/ה לְ/צִבְאֹתָ֑/ם וְ/נָשִׂיא֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י דָ֔ן אֲחִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן עַמִּֽישַׁדָּֽי
verses.translit: dgl mchnh dn tspnh ltsb'tm vnshy' lbny dn 'chy'zr bn 'myshdy
verses.translation: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

verses.original: וּ/צְבָא֖/וֹ וּ/פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֑ם שְׁנַ֧יִם וְ/שִׁשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּ/שְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyhm shnym vshshym 'lf vshb' m'vt
verses.translation: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/חֹנִ֥ים עָלָ֖י/ו מַטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֑ר וְ/נָשִׂיא֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֔ר פַּגְעִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן עָכְרָֽן
verses.translit: vhchnym 'lyv mth 'shr vnshy' lbny 'shr pg'y'l bn 'khrn
verses.translation: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.

verses.original: וּ/צְבָא֖/וֹ וּ/פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֑ם אֶחָ֧ד וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyhm 'chd v'rb'ym 'lf vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.

verses.original: וּ/מַטֵּ֖ה נַפְתָּלִ֑י וְ/נָשִׂיא֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֔י אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן עֵינָֽן
verses.translit: vmth nptly vnshy' lbny nptly 'chyr' bn 'ynn
verses.translation: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

verses.original: וּ/צְבָא֖/וֹ וּ/פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֑ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֧ה וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vtsb'v vpqdyhm shlshh vchmshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt
verses.translation: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

verses.original: כָּל הַ/פְּקֻדִים֙ לְ/מַ֣חֲנֵה דָ֔ן מְאַ֣ת אֶ֗לֶף וְ/שִׁבְעָ֧ה וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְ/שֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת לָ/אַחֲרֹנָ֥ה יִסְע֖וּ לְ/דִגְלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khl hpqdym lmchnh dn m't 'lf vshb'h vchmshym 'lf vshsh m'vt l'chrnh ys'v ldglyhm
verses.translation: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה פְּקוּדֵ֥י בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם כָּל פְּקוּדֵ֤י הַֽ/מַּחֲנֹת֙ לְ/צִבְאֹתָ֔/ם שֵׁשׁ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֨לֶף֙ וּ/שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים וַ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַ/חֲמִשִּֽׁים
verses.translit: 'lh pqvdy bny yshr'l lbyt 'btm khl pqvdy hmchnt ltsb'tm shsh m'vt 'lf vshlsht 'lpym vchmsh m'vt vchmshym
verses.translation: These are those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.

verses.original: וְ/הַ֨/לְוִיִּ֔ם לֹ֣א הָתְפָּקְד֔וּ בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vhlvym l' htpqdv btvkh bny yshr'l kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּ֠/כֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֗ה כֵּֽן חָנ֤וּ לְ/דִגְלֵי/הֶם֙ וְ/כֵ֣ן נָסָ֔עוּ אִ֥ישׁ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖י/ו עַל בֵּ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'shv bny yshr'l khkhl 'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh khn chnv ldglyhm vkhn ns'v 'ysh lmshpchtyv 'l byt 'btyv
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֛לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֥ת אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּ/מֹשֶׁ֑ה בְּ/י֗וֹם דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּ/הַ֥ר סִינָֽי
verses.translit: v'lh tvldt 'hrn vmshh byvm dbr yhvh 't mshh bhr syny
verses.translation: These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spake with Moses in mount Sinai.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַ/בְּכ֣וֹר נָדָ֑ב וַ/אֲבִיה֕וּא אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְ/אִיתָמָֽר
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt bny 'hrn hbkhvr ndb v'byhv' 'l'zr v'ytmr
verses.translation: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.original: אֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים הַ/מְּשֻׁחִ֑ים אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּ֥א יָדָ֖/ם לְ/כַהֵֽן
verses.translit: 'lh shmvt bny 'hrn hkhhnym hmshchym 'shr ml' ydm lkhhn
verses.translation: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣מָת נָדָ֣ב וַ/אֲבִיה֣וּא לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֡ה בְּֽ/הַקְרִבָ/ם֩ אֵ֨שׁ זָרָ֜ה לִ/פְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ בְּ/מִדְבַּ֣ר סִינַ֔י וּ/בָנִ֖ים לֹא הָי֣וּ לָ/הֶ֑ם וַ/יְכַהֵ֤ן אֶלְעָזָר֙ וְ/אִ֣יתָמָ֔ר עַל פְּנֵ֖י אַהֲרֹ֥ן אֲבִי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vymt ndb v'byhv' lpny yhvh bhqrbm 'sh zrh lpny yhvh bmdbr syny vbnym l' hyv lhm vykhhn 'l'zr v'ytmr 'l pny 'hrn 'byhm
verses.translation: And Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD , when they offered strange fire before the LORD , in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the sight of Aaron their father.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: הַקְרֵב֙ אֶת מַטֵּ֣ה לֵוִ֔י וְֽ/הַעֲמַדְתָּ֣ אֹת֔/וֹ לִ/פְנֵ֖י אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן וְ/שֵׁרְת֖וּ אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: hqrb 't mth lvy vh'mdt 'tv lpny 'hrn hkhhn vshrtv 'tv
verses.translation: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמְר֣וּ אֶת מִשְׁמַרְתּ֗/וֹ וְ/אֶת מִשְׁמֶ֨רֶת֙ כָּל הָ֣/עֵדָ֔ה לִ/פְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לַ/עֲבֹ֖ד אֶת עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּֽן
verses.translit: vshmrv 't mshmrtv v't mshmrt khl h'dh lpny 'hl mv'd l'bd 't 'bdt hmshkhn
verses.translation: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמְר֗וּ אֶֽת כָּל כְּלֵי֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְ/אֶת מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לַ/עֲבֹ֖ד אֶת עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּֽן
verses.translit: vshmrv 't khl khly 'hl mv'd v't mshmrt bny yshr'l l'bd 't 'bdt hmshkhn
verses.translation: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּה֙ אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם לְ/אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּ/לְ/בָנָ֑י/ו נְתוּנִ֨ם נְתוּנִ֥ם הֵ֨מָּה֙ ל֔/וֹ מֵ/אֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vntth 't hlvym l'hrn vlbnyv ntvnm ntvnm hmh lv m't bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת אַהֲרֹ֤ן וְ/אֶת בָּנָי/ו֙ תִּפְקֹ֔ד וְ/שָׁמְר֖וּ אֶת כְּהֻנָּתָ֑/ם וְ/הַ/זָּ֥ר הַ/קָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: v't 'hrn v't bnyv tpqd vshmrv 't khhntm vhzr hqrb yvmt
verses.translation: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest’s office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֞י הִנֵּ֧ה לָקַ֣חְתִּי אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם מִ/תּוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תַּ֧חַת כָּל בְּכ֛וֹר פֶּ֥טֶר רֶ֖חֶם מִ/בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/הָ֥יוּ לִ֖/י הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: v'ny hnh lqchty 't hlvym mtvkh bny yshr'l tcht khl bkhvr ptr rchm mbny yshr'l vhyv ly hlvym
verses.translation: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;

verses.original: כִּ֣י לִ/י֮ כָּל בְּכוֹר֒ בְּ/יוֹם֩ הַכֹּתִ֨/י כָל בְּכ֜וֹר בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם הִקְדַּ֨שְׁתִּי לִ֤/י כָל בְּכוֹר֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵ/אָדָ֖ם עַד בְּהֵמָ֑ה לִ֥/י יִהְי֖וּ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: khy ly khl bkhvr byvm hkhty khl bkhvr b'rts mtsrym hqdshty ly khl bkhvr byshr'l m'dm 'd bhmh ly yhyv 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּ/מִדְבַּ֥ר סִינַ֖י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh bmdbr syny l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

verses.original: פְּקֹד֙ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י לְ/בֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָ֖/ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם כָּל זָכָ֛ר מִ/בֶּן חֹ֥דֶשׁ וָ/מַ֖עְלָ/ה תִּפְקְדֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: pqd 't bny lvy lbyt 'btm lmshpchtm khl zkhr mbn chdsh vm'lh tpqdm
verses.translation: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְקֹ֥ד אֹתָ֛/ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עַל פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר צֻוָּֽה
verses.translit: vypqd 'tm mshh 'l py yhvh kh'shr tsvh
verses.translation: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD , as he was commanded.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְיוּ אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי לֵוִ֖י בִּ/שְׁמֹתָ֑/ם גֵּרְשׁ֕וֹן וּ/קְהָ֖ת וּ/מְרָרִֽי
verses.translit: vyhyv 'lh bny lvy bshmtm grshvn vqht vmrry
verses.translation: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי גֵרְשׁ֖וֹן לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם לִבְנִ֖י וְ/שִׁמְעִֽי
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt bny grshvn lmshpchtm lbny vshm'y
verses.translation: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֥י קְהָ֖ת לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם עַמְרָ֣ם וְ/יִצְהָ֔ר חֶבְר֖וֹן וְ/עֻזִּיאֵֽל
verses.translit: vbny qht lmshpchtm 'mrm vytshr chbrvn v'zy'l
verses.translation: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֧י מְרָרִ֛י לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם מַחְלִ֣י וּ/מוּשִׁ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֛ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַ/לֵּוִ֖י לְ/בֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vbny mrry lmshpchtm mchly vmvshy 'lh hm mshpcht hlvy lbyt 'btm
verses.translation: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.

verses.original: לְ/גֵ֣רְשׁ֔וֹן מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַ/לִּבְנִ֔י וּ/מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/שִּׁמְעִ֑י אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֔ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת הַ/גֵּרְשֻׁנִּֽי
verses.translit: lgrshvn mshpcht hlbny vmshpcht hshm'y 'lh hm mshpcht hgrshny
verses.translation: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.

verses.original: פְּקֻדֵי/הֶם֙ בְּ/מִסְפַּ֣ר כָּל זָכָ֔ר מִ/בֶּן חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה פְּקֻ֣דֵי/הֶ֔ם שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וַ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: pqdyhm bmspr khl zkhr mbn chdsh vm'lh pqdyhm shb't 'lpym vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.

verses.original: מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת הַ/גֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י אַחֲרֵ֧י הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֛ן יַחֲנ֖וּ יָֽמָּ/ה
verses.translit: mshpcht hgrshny 'chry hmshkhn ychnv ymh
verses.translation: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.

verses.original: וּ/נְשִׂ֥יא בֵֽית אָ֖ב לַ/גֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן לָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vnshy' byt 'b lgrshny 'lysf bn l'l
verses.translation: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.

verses.original: וּ/מִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת בְּנֵֽי גֵרְשׁוֹן֙ בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְ/הָ/אֹ֑הֶל מִכְסֵ֕/הוּ וּ/מָסַ֕ךְ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vmshmrt bny grshvn b'hl mv'd hmshkhn vh'hl mkhshv vmskh ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

verses.original: וְ/קַלְעֵ֣י הֶֽ/חָצֵ֗ר וְ/אֶת מָסַךְ֙ פֶּ֣תַח הֶֽ/חָצֵ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֧ר עַל הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֛ן וְ/עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִ֑יב וְ/אֵת֙ מֵֽיתָרָ֔י/ו לְ/כֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vql'y hchtsr v't mskh ptch hchtsr 'shr 'l hmshkhn v'l hmzbch sbyb v't mytryv lkhl 'bdtv
verses.translation: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/קְהָ֗ת מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַֽ/עַמְרָמִי֙ וּ/מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַ/יִּצְהָרִ֔י וּ/מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַֽ/חֶבְרֹנִ֔י וּ/מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָֽ/עָזִּיאֵלִ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַ/קְּהָתִֽי
verses.translit: vlqht mshpcht h'mrmy vmshpcht hytshry vmshpcht hchbrny vmshpcht h'zy'ly 'lh hm mshpcht hqhty
verses.translation: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.

verses.original: בְּ/מִסְפַּר֙ כָּל זָכָ֔ר מִ/בֶּן חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה שְׁמֹנַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ וְ/שֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: bmspr khl zkhr mbn chdsh vm'lh shmnt 'lpym vshsh m'vt shmry mshmrt hqdsh
verses.translation: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.

verses.original: מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת בְּנֵי קְהָ֖ת יַחֲנ֑וּ עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֖ן תֵּימָֽנָ/ה
verses.translit: mshpcht bny qht ychnv 'l yrkh hmshkhn tymnh
verses.translation: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.

verses.original: וּ/נְשִׂ֥יא בֵֽית אָ֖ב לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַ/קְּהָתִ֑י אֶלִיצָפָ֖ן בֶּן עֻזִּיאֵֽל
verses.translit: vnshy' byt 'b lmshpcht hqhty 'lytspn bn 'zy'l
verses.translation: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

verses.translit: vmshmrtm h'rn vhshlchn vhmnrh vhmzbcht vkhly hqdsh 'shr yshrtv bhm vhmskh vkhl 'bdtv
verses.translation: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.

verses.original: וּ/נְשִׂיא֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הַ/לֵּוִ֔י אֶלְעָזָ֖ר בֶּן אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן פְּקֻדַּ֕ת שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: vnshy' nshy'y hlvy 'l'zr bn 'hrn hkhhn pqdt shmry mshmrt hqdsh
verses.translation: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.

verses.original: לִ/מְרָרִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַ/מַּחְלִ֔י וּ/מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/מּוּשִׁ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת מְרָרִֽי
verses.translit: lmrry mshpcht hmchly vmshpcht hmvshy 'lh hm mshpcht mrry
verses.translation: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.

verses.original: וּ/פְקֻדֵי/הֶם֙ בְּ/מִסְפַּ֣ר כָּל זָכָ֔ר מִ/בֶּן חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה שֵׁ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּ/מָאתָֽיִם
verses.translit: vpqdyhm bmspr khl zkhr mbn chdsh vm'lh shsht 'lpym vm'tym
verses.translation: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.

verses.original: וּ/נְשִׂ֤יא בֵֽית אָב֙ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת מְרָרִ֔י צוּרִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן אֲבִיחָ֑יִל עַ֣ל יֶ֧רֶךְ הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֛ן יַחֲנ֖וּ צָפֹֽנָ/ה
verses.translit: vnshy' byt 'b lmshpcht mrry tsvry'l bn 'bychyl 'l yrkh hmshkhn ychnv tspnh
verses.translation: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.

verses.original: וּ/פְקֻדַּ֣ת מִשְׁמֶרֶת֮ בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִי֒ קַרְשֵׁי֙ הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וּ/בְרִיחָ֖י/ו וְ/עַמֻּדָ֣י/ו וַ/אֲדָנָ֑י/ו וְ/כָל כֵּלָ֔י/ו וְ/כֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vpqdt mshmrt bny mrry qrshy hmshkhn vbrychyv v'mdyv v'dnyv vkhl khlyv vkhl 'bdtv
verses.translation: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,

verses.original: וְ/עַמֻּדֵ֧י הֶ/חָצֵ֛ר סָבִ֖יב וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֑ם וִ/יתֵדֹתָ֖/ם וּ/מֵֽיתְרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'mdy hchtsr sbyb v'dnyhm vytdtm vmytryhm
verses.translation: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/חֹנִ֣ים לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֡ן קֵ֣דְמָ/ה לִ/פְנֵי֩ אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵ֨ד מִזְרָ֜חָ/ה מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּ/בָנָ֗י/ו שֹֽׁמְרִים֙ מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַ/מִּקְדָּ֔שׁ לְ/מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/הַ/זָּ֥ר הַ/קָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: vhchnym lpny hmshkhn qdmh lpny 'hl mv'd mzrchh mshh v'hrn vbnyv shmrym mshmrt hmqdsh lmshmrt bny yshr'l vhzr hqrb yvmt
verses.translation: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

verses.original: כָּל פְּקוּדֵ֨י הַ/לְוִיִּ֜ם אֲשֶׁר֩ פָּקַ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְׄ/אַׄהֲׄרֹ֛ׄןׄ עַל פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם כָּל זָכָר֙ מִ/בֶּן חֹ֣דֶשׁ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה שְׁנַ֥יִם וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: khl pqvdy hlvym 'shr pqd mshh v'hrn 'l py yhvh lmshpchtm khl zkhr mbn chdsh vm'lh shnym v'shrym 'lf
verses.translation: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the LORD , throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה פְּקֹ֨ד כָּל בְּכֹ֤ר זָכָר֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ/בֶּן חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה וְ/שָׂ֕א אֵ֖ת מִסְפַּ֥ר שְׁמֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh pqd khl bkhr zkhr lbny yshr'l mbn chdsh vm'lh vsh' 't mspr shmtm
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֨ אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֥ם לִ/י֙ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה תַּ֥חַת כָּל בְּכֹ֖ר בִּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/אֵת֙ בֶּהֱמַ֣ת הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם תַּ֣חַת כָּל בְּכ֔וֹר בְּ/בֶהֱמַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vlqcht 't hlvym ly 'ny yhvh tcht khl bkhr bbny yshr'l v't bhmt hlvym tcht khl bkhvr bbhmt bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the LORD ) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְקֹ֣ד מֹשֶׁ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֑/וֹ אֶֽת כָּל בְּכֹ֖ר בִּ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vypqd mshh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tv 't khl bkhr bbny yshr'l
verses.translation: And Moses numbered, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֩ כָל בְּכ֨וֹר זָכָ֜ר בְּ/מִסְפַּ֥ר שֵׁמ֛וֹת מִ/בֶּן חֹ֥דֶשׁ וָ/מַ֖עְלָ/ה לִ/פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֑ם שְׁנַ֤יִם וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה וְ/שִׁבְעִ֖ים וּ/מָאתָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhy khl bkhvr zkhr bmspr shmvt mbn chdsh vm'lh lpqdyhm shnym v'shrym 'lf shlshh vshb'ym vm'tym
verses.translation: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: קַ֣ח אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם תַּ֤חַת כָּל בְּכוֹר֙ בִּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אֶת בֶּהֱמַ֥ת הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם תַּ֣חַת בְּהֶמְתָּ֑/ם וְ/הָיוּ לִ֥/י הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: qch 't hlvym tcht khl bkhvr bbny yshr'l v't bhmt hlvym tcht bhmtm vhyv ly hlvym 'ny yhvh
verses.translation: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ פְּדוּיֵ֣י הַ/שְּׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְ/הַ/שִּׁבְעִ֖ים וְ/הַ/מָּאתָ֑יִם הָ/עֹֽדְפִים֙ עַל הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם מִ/בְּכ֖וֹר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v't pdvyy hshlshh vhshb'ym vhm'tym h'dpym 'l hlvym mbkhvr bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֗ חֲמֵ֧שֶׁת חֲמֵ֛שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים לַ/גֻּלְגֹּ֑לֶת בְּ/שֶׁ֤קֶל הַ/קֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ תִּקָּ֔ח עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה הַ/שָּֽׁקֶל
verses.translit: vlqcht chmsht chmsht shqlym lglglt bshql hqdsh tqch 'shrym grh hshql
verses.translation: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: (the shekel is twenty gerahs:)

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּ֣ה הַ/כֶּ֔סֶף לְ/אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּ/לְ/בָנָ֑י/ו פְּדוּיֵ֕י הָ/עֹדְפִ֖ים בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vntth hkhsf l'hrn vlbnyv pdvyy h'dpym bhm
verses.translation: And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֖ת כֶּ֣סֶף הַ/פִּדְי֑וֹם מֵ/אֵת֙ הָ/עֹ֣דְפִ֔ים עַ֖ל פְּדוּיֵ֥י הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: vyqch mshh 't khsf hpdyvm m't h'dpym 'l pdvyy hlvym
verses.translation: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:

verses.original: מֵ/אֵ֗ת בְּכ֛וֹר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לָקַ֣ח אֶת הַ/כָּ֑סֶף חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְ/שִׁשִּׁ֜ים וּ/שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת וָ/אֶ֖לֶף בְּ/שֶׁ֥קֶל הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: m't bkhvr bny yshr'l lqch 't hkhsf chmshh vshshym vshlsh m'vt v'lf bshql hqdsh
verses.translation: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary:

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת כֶּ֧סֶף הַ/פְּדֻיִ֛ם לְ/אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּ/לְ/בָנָ֖י/ו עַל פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vytn mshh 't khsf hpdym l'hrn vlbnyv 'l py yhvh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD , as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְ/אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh v'l 'hrn l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

verses.original: נָשֹׂ֗א אֶת רֹאשׁ֙ בְּנֵ֣י קְהָ֔ת מִ/תּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֑י לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם לְ/בֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: nsh' 't r'sh bny qht mtvkh bny lvy lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm
verses.translation: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,

verses.original: מִ/בֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה וְ/עַ֖ד בֶּן חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כָּל בָּא֙ לַ/צָּבָ֔א לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת מְלָאכָ֖ה בְּ/אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: mbn shlshym shnh vm'lh v'd bn chmshym shnh khl b' ltsb' l'shvt ml'khh b'hl mv'd
verses.translation: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: זֹ֛את עֲבֹדַ֥ת בְּנֵי קְהָ֖ת בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד קֹ֖דֶשׁ הַ/קֳּדָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: z't 'bdt bny qht b'hl mv'd qdsh hqdshym
verses.translation: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:

verses.original: וּ/בָ֨א אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּ/בָנָי/ו֙ בִּ/נְסֹ֣עַ הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְ/הוֹרִ֕דוּ אֵ֖ת פָּרֹ֣כֶת הַ/מָּסָ֑ךְ וְ/כִ֨סּוּ בָ֔/הּ אֵ֖ת אֲרֹ֥ן הָ/עֵדֻֽת
verses.translit: vb' 'hrn vbnyv bns' hmchnh vhvrdv 't prkht hmskh vkhsv bh 't 'rn h'dt
verses.translation: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:

verses.original: וְ/נָתְנ֣וּ עָלָ֗י/ו כְּסוּי֙ ע֣וֹר תַּ֔חַשׁ וּ/פָרְשׂ֧וּ בֶֽגֶד כְּלִ֛יל תְּכֵ֖לֶת מִ/לְ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה וְ/שָׂמ֖וּ בַּדָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vntnv 'lyv khsvy 'vr tchsh vprshv bgd khlyl tkhlt mlm'lh vshmv bdyv
verses.translation: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers’ skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֣ל שֻׁלְחַ֣ן הַ/פָּנִ֗ים יִפְרְשׂוּ֮ בֶּ֣גֶד תְּכֵלֶת֒ וְ/נָתְנ֣וּ עָ֠לָי/ו אֶת הַ/קְּעָרֹ֤ת וְ/אֶת הַ/כַּפֹּת֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/מְּנַקִּיֹּ֔ת וְ/אֵ֖ת קְשׂ֣וֹת הַ/נָּ֑סֶךְ וְ/לֶ֥חֶם הַ/תָּמִ֖יד עָלָ֥י/ו יִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: v'l shlchn hpnym yprshv bgd tkhlt vntnv 'lyv 't hq'rt v't hkhpt v't hmnqyt v't qshvt hnskh vlchm htmyd 'lyv yhyh
verses.translation: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:

verses.original: וּ/פָרְשׂ֣וּ עֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם בֶּ֚גֶד תּוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י וְ/כִסּ֣וּ אֹת֔/וֹ בְּ/מִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ וְ/שָׂמ֖וּ אֶת בַּדָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vprshv 'lyhm bgd tvl't shny vkhsv 'tv bmkhsh 'vr tchsh vshmv 't bdyv
verses.translation: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.

verses.original: וְ/לָקְח֣וּ בֶּ֣גֶד תְּכֵ֗לֶת וְ/כִסּ֞וּ אֶת מְנֹרַ֤ת הַ/מָּאוֹר֙ וְ/אֶת נֵ֣רֹתֶ֔י/הָ וְ/אֶת מַלְקָחֶ֖י/הָ וְ/אֶת מַחְתֹּתֶ֑י/הָ וְ/אֵת֙ כָּל כְּלֵ֣י שַׁמְנָ֔/הּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשָׁרְתוּ לָ֖/הּ בָּ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vlqchv bgd tkhlt vkhsv 't mnrt hm'vr v't nrtyh v't mlqchyh v't mchttyh v't khl khly shmnh 'shr yshrtv lh bhm
verses.translation: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:

verses.original: וְ/נָתְנ֤וּ אֹתָ/הּ֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל כֵּלֶ֔י/הָ אֶל מִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ וְ/נָתְנ֖וּ עַל הַ/מּֽוֹט
verses.translit: vntnv 'th v't khl khlyh 'l mkhsh 'vr tchsh vntnv 'l hmvt
verses.translation: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put it upon a bar.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֣ל מִזְבַּ֣ח הַ/זָּהָ֗ב יִפְרְשׂוּ֙ בֶּ֣גֶד תְּכֵ֔לֶת וְ/כִסּ֣וּ אֹת֔/וֹ בְּ/מִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ וְ/שָׂמ֖וּ אֶת בַּדָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'l mzbch hzhb yprshv bgd tkhlt vkhsv 'tv bmkhsh 'vr tchsh vshmv 't bdyv
verses.translation: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:

verses.original: וְ/לָקְחוּ֩ אֶת כָּל כְּלֵ֨י הַ/שָּׁרֵ֜ת אֲשֶׁ֧ר יְשָֽׁרְתוּ בָ֣/ם בַּ/קֹּ֗דֶשׁ וְ/נָֽתְנוּ֙ אֶל בֶּ֣גֶד תְּכֵ֔לֶת וְ/כִסּ֣וּ אוֹתָ֔/ם בְּ/מִכְסֵ֖ה ע֣וֹר תָּ֑חַשׁ וְ/נָתְנ֖וּ עַל הַ/מּֽוֹט
verses.translit: vlqchv 't khl khly hshrt 'shr yshrtv bm bqdsh vntnv 'l bgd tkhlt vkhsv 'vtm bmkhsh 'vr tchsh vntnv 'l hmvt
verses.translation: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers’ skins, and shall put them on a bar:

verses.original: וְ/דִשְּׁנ֖וּ אֶת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וּ/פָרְשׂ֣וּ עָלָ֔י/ו בֶּ֖גֶד אַרְגָּמָֽן
verses.translit: vdshnv 't hmzbch vprshv 'lyv bgd 'rgmn
verses.translation: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:

verses.original: וְ/נָתְנ֣וּ עָ֠לָי/ו אֶֽת כָּל כֵּלָ֞י/ו אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְֽשָׁרְת֧וּ עָלָ֣י/ו בָּ/הֶ֗ם אֶת הַ/מַּחְתֹּ֤ת אֶת הַ/מִּזְלָגֹת֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/יָּעִ֣ים וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּזְרָקֹ֔ת כֹּ֖ל כְּלֵ֣י הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וּ/פָרְשׂ֣וּ עָלָ֗י/ו כְּס֛וּי ע֥וֹר תַּ֖חַשׁ וְ/שָׂמ֥וּ בַדָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vntnv 'lyv 't khl khlyv 'shr yshrtv 'lyv bhm 't hmchtt 't hmzlgt v't hy'ym v't hmzrqt khl khly hmzbch vprshv 'lyv khsvy 'vr tchsh vshmv bdyv
verses.translation: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers’ skins, and put to the staves of it.

verses.original: וְ/כִלָּ֣ה אַֽהֲרֹן וּ֠/בָנָי/ו לְ/כַסֹּ֨ת אֶת הַ/קֹּ֜דֶשׁ וְ/אֶת כָּל כְּלֵ֣י הַ/קֹּדֶשׁ֮ בִּ/נְסֹ֣עַ הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶה֒ וְ/אַחֲרֵי כֵ֗ן יָבֹ֤אוּ בְנֵי קְהָת֙ לָ/שֵׂ֔את וְ/לֹֽא יִגְּע֥וּ אֶל הַ/קֹּ֖דֶשׁ וָ/מֵ֑תוּ אֵ֛לֶּה מַשָּׂ֥א בְנֵֽי קְהָ֖ת בְּ/אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vkhlh 'hrn vbnyv lkhst 't hqdsh v't khl khly hqdsh bns' hmchnh v'chry khn yb'v bny qht lsh't vl' yg'v 'l hqdsh vmtv 'lh msh' bny qht b'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: וּ/פְקֻדַּ֞ת אֶלְעָזָ֣ר בֶּן אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן שֶׁ֤מֶן הַ/מָּאוֹר֙ וּ/קְטֹ֣רֶת הַ/סַּמִּ֔ים וּ/מִנְחַ֥ת הַ/תָּמִ֖יד וְ/שֶׁ֣מֶן הַ/מִּשְׁחָ֑ה פְּקֻדַּ֗ת כָּל הַ/מִּשְׁכָּן֙ וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁר בּ֔/וֹ בְּ/קֹ֖דֶשׁ וּ/בְ/כֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vpqdt 'l'zr bn 'hrn hkhhn shmn hm'vr vqtrt hsmym vmncht htmyd vshmn hmshchh pqdt khl hmshkhn vkhl 'shr bv bqdsh vbkhlyv
verses.translation: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is , in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְ/אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh v'l 'hrn l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

verses.original: אַל תַּכְרִ֕יתוּ אֶת שֵׁ֖בֶט מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַ/קְּהָתִ֑י מִ/תּ֖וֹךְ הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: 'l tkhrytv 't shbt mshpcht hqhty mtvkh hlvym
verses.translation: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:

verses.original: וְ/זֹ֣את עֲשׂ֣וּ לָ/הֶ֗ם וְ/חָיוּ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יָמֻ֔תוּ בְּ/גִשְׁתָּ֖/ם אֶת קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֑ים אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּ/בָנָי/ו֙ יָבֹ֔אוּ וְ/שָׂמ֣וּ אוֹתָ֗/ם אִ֥ישׁ אִ֛ישׁ עַל עֲבֹדָת֖/וֹ וְ/אֶל מַשָּׂאֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vz't 'shv lhm vchyv vl' ymtv bgshtm 't qdsh hqdshym 'hrn vbnyv yb'v vshmv 'vtm 'ysh 'ysh 'l 'bdtv v'l msh'v
verses.translation: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:

verses.original: וְ/לֹא יָבֹ֧אוּ לִ/רְא֛וֹת כְּ/בַלַּ֥ע אֶת הַ/קֹּ֖דֶשׁ וָ/מֵֽתוּ
verses.translit: vl' yb'v lr'vt khbl' 't hqdsh vmtv
verses.translation: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: נָשֹׂ֗א אֶת רֹ֛אשׁ בְּנֵ֥י גֵרְשׁ֖וֹן גַּם הֵ֑ם לְ/בֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָ֖/ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: nsh' 't r'sh bny grshvn gm hm lbyt 'btm lmshpchtm
verses.translation: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;

verses.original: מִ/בֶּן֩ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים שָׁנָ֜ה וָ/מַ֗עְלָ/ה עַ֛ד בֶּן חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה תִּפְקֹ֣ד אוֹתָ֑/ם כָּל הַ/בָּא֙ לִ/צְבֹ֣א צָבָ֔א לַ/עֲבֹ֥ד עֲבֹדָ֖ה בְּ/אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: mbn shlshym shnh vm'lh 'd bn chmshym shnh tpqd 'vtm khl hb' ltsb' tsb' l'bd 'bdh b'hl mv'd
verses.translation: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: זֹ֣את עֲבֹדַ֔ת מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת הַ/גֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י לַ/עֲבֹ֖ד וּ/לְ/מַשָּֽׂא
verses.translit: z't 'bdt mshpcht hgrshny l'bd vlmsh'
verses.translation: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:

verses.original: וְ/נָ֨שְׂא֜וּ אֶת יְרִיעֹ֤ת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּן֙ וְ/אֶת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד מִכְסֵ֕/הוּ וּ/מִכְסֵ֛ה הַ/תַּ֥חַשׁ אֲשֶׁר עָלָ֖י/ו מִ/לְ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה וְ/אֶ֨ת מָסַ֔ךְ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vnsh'v 't yry't hmshkhn v't 'hl mv'd mkhshv vmkhsh htchsh 'shr 'lyv mlm'lh v't mskh ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers’ skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֩ קַלְעֵ֨י הֶֽ/חָצֵ֜ר וְ/אֶת מָסַ֣ךְ פֶּ֣תַח שַׁ֣עַר הֶ/חָצֵ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֤ן וְ/עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ סָבִ֔יב וְ/אֵת֙ מֵֽיתְרֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/אֶֽת כָּל כְּלֵ֖י עֲבֹדָתָ֑/ם וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֧ר יֵעָשֶׂ֛ה לָ/הֶ֖ם וְ/עָבָֽדוּ
verses.translit: v't ql'y hchtsr v't mskh ptch sh'r hchtsr 'shr 'l hmshkhn v'l hmzbch sbyb v't mytryhm v't khl khly 'bdtm v't khl 'shr y'shh lhm v'bdv
verses.translation: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.

verses.original: עַל פִּי֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן וּ/בָנָ֜י/ו תִּהְיֶ֗ה כָּל עֲבֹדַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י הַ/גֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֔י לְ/כָל מַשָּׂאָ֔/ם וּ/לְ/כֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתָ֑/ם וּ/פְקַדְתֶּ֤ם עֲלֵ/הֶם֙ בְּ/מִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת אֵ֖ת כָּל מַשָּׂאָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'l py 'hrn vbnyv thyh khl 'bdt bny hgrshny lkhl msh'm vlkhl 'bdtm vpqdtm 'lhm bmshmrt 't khl msh'm
verses.translation: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.

verses.original: זֹ֣את עֲבֹדַ֗ת מִשְׁפְּחֹ֛ת בְּנֵ֥י הַ/גֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וּ/מִ֨שְׁמַרְתָּ֔/ם בְּ/יַד֙ אִֽיתָמָ֔ר בֶּֽן אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: z't 'bdt mshpcht bny hgrshny b'hl mv'd vmshmrtm byd 'ytmr bn 'hrn hkhhn
verses.translation: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י מְרָרִ֑י לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֥/ם לְ/בֵית אֲבֹתָ֖/ם תִּפְקֹ֥ד אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: bny mrry lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm tpqd 'tm
verses.translation: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;

verses.original: מִ/בֶּן֩ שְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים שָׁנָ֜ה וָ/מַ֗עְלָ/ה וְ/עַ֛ד בֶּן חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה תִּפְקְדֵ֑/ם כָּל הַ/בָּא֙ לַ/צָּבָ֔א לַ/עֲבֹ֕ד אֶת עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: mbn shlshym shnh vm'lh v'd bn chmshym shnh tpqdm khl hb' ltsb' l'bd 't 'bdt 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: וְ/זֹאת֙ מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת מַשָּׂאָ֔/ם לְ/כָל עֲבֹדָתָ֖/ם בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד קַרְשֵׁי֙ הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וּ/בְרִיחָ֖י/ו וְ/עַמּוּדָ֥י/ו וַ/אֲדָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vz't mshmrt msh'm lkhl 'bdtm b'hl mv'd qrshy hmshkhn vbrychyv v'mvdyv v'dnyv
verses.translation: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,

verses.original: וְ/עַמּוּדֵי֩ הֶ/חָצֵ֨ר סָבִ֜יב וְ/אַדְנֵי/הֶ֗ם וִֽ/יתֵדֹתָ/ם֙ וּ/מֵ֣יתְרֵי/הֶ֔ם לְ/כָל כְּלֵי/הֶ֔ם וּ/לְ/כֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתָ֑/ם וּ/בְ/שֵׁמֹ֣ת תִּפְקְד֔וּ אֶת כְּלֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת מַשָּׂאָֽ/ם
verses.translit: v'mvdy hchtsr sbyb v'dnyhm vytdtm vmytryhm lkhl khlyhm vlkhl 'bdtm vbshmt tpqdv 't khly mshmrt msh'm
verses.translation: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.

verses.original: זֹ֣את עֲבֹדַ֗ת מִשְׁפְּחֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֔י לְ/כָל עֲבֹדָתָ֖/ם בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד בְּ/יַד֙ אִֽיתָמָ֔ר בֶּֽן אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: z't 'bdt mshpcht bny mrry lkhl 'bdtm b'hl mv'd byd 'ytmr bn 'hrn hkhhn
verses.translation: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְקֹ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֛ן וּ/נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָ/עֵדָ֖ה אֶת בְּנֵ֣י הַ/קְּהָתִ֑י לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם וּ/לְ/בֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vypqd mshh v'hrn vnshy'y h'dh 't bny hqhty lmshpchtm vlbyt 'btm
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,

verses.original: מִ/בֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה וְ/עַ֖ד בֶּן חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כָּל הַ/בָּא֙ לַ/צָּבָ֔א לַ/עֲבֹדָ֖ה בְּ/אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: mbn shlshym shnh vm'lh v'd bn chmshym shnh khl hb' ltsb' l'bdh b'hl mv'd
verses.translation: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם אַלְפַּ֕יִם שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וַ/חֲמִשִּֽׁים
verses.translit: vyhyv pqdyhm lmshpchtm 'lpym shb' m'vt vchmshym
verses.translation: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.

verses.original: אֵ֤לֶּה פְקוּדֵי֙ מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַ/קְּהָתִ֔י כָּל הָ/עֹבֵ֖ד בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּקַ֤ד מֹשֶׁה֙ וְ/אַהֲרֹ֔ן עַל פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יַד מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: 'lh pqvdy mshpcht hqhty khl h'bd b'hl mv'd 'shr pqd mshh v'hrn 'l py yhvh byd mshh
verses.translation: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

verses.original: וּ/פְקוּדֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁ֑וֹן לְ/מִשְׁפְּחוֹתָ֖/ם וּ/לְ/בֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vpqvdy bny grshvn lmshpchvtm vlbyt 'btm
verses.translation: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,

verses.original: מִ/בֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה וְ/עַ֖ד בֶּן חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כָּל הַ/בָּא֙ לַ/צָּבָ֔א לַ/עֲבֹדָ֖ה בְּ/אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: mbn shlshym shnh vm'lh v'd bn chmshym shnh khl hb' ltsb' l'bdh b'hl mv'd
verses.translation: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽהְיוּ֙ פְּקֻ֣דֵי/הֶ֔ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם אַלְפַּ֕יִם וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וּ/שְׁלֹשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vyhyv pqdyhm lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm 'lpym vshsh m'vt vshlshym
verses.translation: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה פְקוּדֵ֗י מִשְׁפְּחֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁ֔וֹן כָּל הָ/עֹבֵ֖ד בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּקַ֥ד מֹשֶׁ֛ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֖ן עַל פִּ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'lh pqvdy mshpcht bny grshvn khl h'bd b'hl mv'd 'shr pqd mshh v'hrn 'l py yhvh
verses.translation: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD .

verses.original: וּ/פְקוּדֵ֕י מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֑י לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם לְ/בֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vpqvdy mshpcht bny mrry lmshpchtm lbyt 'btm
verses.translation: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,

verses.original: מִ/בֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה וְ/עַ֖ד בֶּן חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כָּל הַ/בָּא֙ לַ/צָּבָ֔א לַ/עֲבֹדָ֖ה בְּ/אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: mbn shlshym shnh vm'lh v'd bn chmshym shnh khl hb' ltsb' l'bdh b'hl mv'd
verses.translation: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּ/מָאתָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyhyv pqdyhm lmshpchtm shlsht 'lpym vm'tym
verses.translation: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה פְקוּדֵ֔י מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֑י אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּקַ֤ד מֹשֶׁה֙ וְ/אַהֲרֹ֔ן עַל פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יַד מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: 'lh pqvdy mshpcht bny mrry 'shr pqd mshh v'hrn 'l py yhvh byd mshh
verses.translation: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

verses.original: כָּֽל הַ/פְּקֻדִ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ פָּקַ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֛ן וּ/נְשִׂיאֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖/ם וּ/לְ/בֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khl hpqdym 'shr pqd mshh v'hrn vnshy'y yshr'l 't hlvym lmshpchtm vlbyt 'btm
verses.translation: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,

verses.original: מִ/בֶּ֨ן שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה וְ/עַ֖ד בֶּן חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה כָּל הַ/בָּ֗א לַ/עֲבֹ֨ד עֲבֹדַ֧ת עֲבֹדָ֛ה וַ/עֲבֹדַ֥ת מַשָּׂ֖א בְּ/אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: mbn shlshym shnh vm'lh v'd bn chmshym shnh khl hb' l'bd 'bdt 'bdh v'bdt msh' b'hl mv'd
verses.translation: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation,

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֖וּ פְּקֻדֵי/הֶ֑ם שְׁמֹנַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֔ים וַ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וּ/שְׁמֹנִֽים
verses.translit: vyhyv pqdyhm shmnt 'lpym vchmsh m'vt vshmnym
verses.translation: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.

verses.original: עַל פִּ֨י יְהוָ֜ה פָּקַ֤ד אוֹתָ/ם֙ בְּ/יַד מֹשֶׁ֔ה אִ֥ישׁ אִ֛ישׁ עַל עֲבֹדָת֖/וֹ וְ/עַל מַשָּׂא֑/וֹ וּ/פְקֻדָ֕י/ו אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: 'l py yhvh pqd 'vtm byd mshh 'ysh 'ysh 'l 'bdtv v'l msh'v vpqdyv 'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: According to the commandment of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: צַ֚ו אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וִֽ/ישַׁלְּחוּ֙ מִן הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה כָּל צָר֖וּעַ וְ/כָל זָ֑ב וְ/כֹ֖ל טָמֵ֥א לָ/נָֽפֶשׁ
verses.translit: tsv 't bny yshr'l vyshlchv mn hmchnh khl tsrv' vkhl zb vkhl tm' lnpsh
verses.translation: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:

verses.original: מִ/זָּכָ֤ר עַד נְקֵבָה֙ תְּשַׁלֵּ֔חוּ אֶל מִ/ח֥וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה תְּשַׁלְּח֑וּ/ם וְ/לֹ֤א יְטַמְּאוּ֙ אֶת מַ֣חֲנֵי/הֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י שֹׁכֵ֥ן בְּ/תוֹכָֽ/ם
verses.translit: mzkhr 'd nqbh tshlchv 'l mchvts lmchnh tshlchvm vl' ytm'v 't mchnyhm 'shr 'ny shkhn btvkhm
verses.translation: Both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲשׂוּ כֵן֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יְשַׁלְּח֣וּ אוֹתָ֔/ם אֶל מִ/ח֖וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן עָשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'shv khn bny yshr'l vyshlchv 'vtm 'l mchvts lmchnh kh'shr dbr yhvh 'l mshh khn 'shv bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the LORD spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֮ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ אִ֣ישׁ אֽוֹ אִשָּׁ֗ה כִּ֤י יַעֲשׂוּ֙ מִ/כָּל חַטֹּ֣את הָֽ/אָדָ֔ם לִ/מְעֹ֥ל מַ֖עַל בַּ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/אָֽשְׁמָ֖ה הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/הִֽוא
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l 'ysh 'v 'shh khy y'shv mkhl cht't h'dm lm'l m'l byhvh v'shmh hnpsh hhv'
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the LORD , and that person be guilty;

verses.original: וְ/הִתְוַדּ֗וּ אֶֽת חַטָּאתָ/ם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂוּ֒ וְ/הֵשִׁ֤יב אֶת אֲשָׁמ/וֹ֙ בְּ/רֹאשׁ֔/וֹ וַ/חֲמִישִׁת֖/וֹ יֹסֵ֣ף עָלָ֑י/ו וְ/נָתַ֕ן לַ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר אָשַׁ֥ם לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhtvdv 't cht'tm 'shr 'shv vhshyb 't 'shmv br'shv vchmyshtv ysf 'lyv vntn l'shr 'shm lv
verses.translation: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.

verses.original: וְ/אִם אֵ֨ין לָ/אִ֜ישׁ גֹּאֵ֗ל לְ/הָשִׁ֤יב הָ/אָשָׁם֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו הָ/אָשָׁ֛ם הַ/מּוּשָׁ֥ב לַ/יהוָ֖ה לַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן מִ/לְּ/בַ֗ד אֵ֚יל הַ/כִּפֻּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְכַפֶּר בּ֖/וֹ עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'm 'yn l'ysh g'l lhshyb h'shm 'lyv h'shm hmvshb lyhvh lkhhn mlbd 'yl hkhprym 'shr ykhpr bv 'lyv
verses.translation: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the LORD , even to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.

verses.original: וְ/כָל תְּרוּמָ֞ה לְ/כָל קָדְשֵׁ֧י בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִ֥יבוּ לַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן ל֥/וֹ יִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vkhl trvmh lkhl qdshy bny yshr'l 'shr yqrybv lkhhn lv yhyh
verses.translation: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֥ישׁ אֶת קֳדָשָׁ֖י/ו ל֣/וֹ יִהְי֑וּ אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִתֵּ֥ן לַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן ל֥/וֹ יִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: v'ysh 't qdshyv lv yhyv 'ysh 'shr ytn lkhhn lv yhyh
