verses.translation: And every man’s hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם אִ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ כִּֽי תִשְׂטֶ֣ה אִשְׁתּ֔/וֹ וּ/מָעֲלָ֥ה ב֖/וֹ מָֽעַל
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm 'ysh 'ysh khy tshth 'shtv vm'lh bv m'l
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man’s wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,

verses.original: וְ/שָׁכַ֨ב אִ֣ישׁ אֹתָ/הּ֮ שִׁכְבַת זֶרַע֒ וְ/נֶעְלַם֙ מֵ/עֵינֵ֣י אִישָׁ֔/הּ וְ/נִסְתְּרָ֖ה וְ/הִ֣יא נִטְמָ֑אָה וְ/עֵד֙ אֵ֣ין בָּ֔/הּ וְ/הִ֖וא לֹ֥א נִתְפָּֽשָׂה
verses.translit: vshkhb 'ysh 'th shkhbt zr' vn'lm m'yny 'yshh vnstrh vhy' ntm'h v'd 'yn bh vhv' l' ntpshh
verses.translation: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;

verses.original: וְ/עָבַ֨ר עָלָ֧י/ו רֽוּחַ קִנְאָ֛ה וְ/קִנֵּ֥א אֶת אִשְׁתּ֖/וֹ וְ/הִ֣וא נִטְמָ֑אָה אוֹ עָבַ֨ר עָלָ֤י/ו רֽוּחַ קִנְאָה֙ וְ/קִנֵּ֣א אֶת אִשְׁתּ֔/וֹ וְ/הִ֖יא לֹ֥א נִטְמָֽאָה
verses.translit: v'br 'lyv rvch qn'h vqn' 't 'shtv vhv' ntm'h 'v 'br 'lyv rvch qn'h vqn' 't 'shtv vhy' l' ntm'h
verses.translation: And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:

verses.original: וְ/הֵבִ֨יא הָ/אִ֣ישׁ אֶת אִשְׁתּ/וֹ֮ אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵן֒ וְ/הֵבִ֤יא אֶת קָרְבָּנָ/הּ֙ עָלֶ֔י/הָ עֲשִׂירִ֥ת הָ/אֵיפָ֖ה קֶ֣מַח שְׂעֹרִ֑ים לֹֽא יִצֹ֨ק עָלָ֜י/ו שֶׁ֗מֶן וְ/לֹֽא יִתֵּ֤ן עָלָי/ו֙ לְבֹנָ֔ה כִּֽי מִנְחַ֤ת קְנָאֹת֙ ה֔וּא מִנְחַ֥ת זִכָּר֖וֹן מַזְכֶּ֥רֶת עָוֺֽן
verses.translit: vhby' h'ysh 't 'shtv 'l hkhhn vhby' 't qrbnh 'lyh 'shyrt h'yph qmch sh'rym l' ytsq 'lyv shmn vl' ytn 'lyv lbnh khy mncht qn't hv' mncht zkhrvn mzkhrt 'vn
verses.translation: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרִ֥יב אֹתָ֖/הּ הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן וְ/הֶֽעֱמִדָ֖/הּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhqryb 'th hkhhn vh'mdh lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD :

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֧ח הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן מַ֥יִם קְדֹשִׁ֖ים בִּ/כְלִי חָ֑רֶשׂ וּ/מִן הֶֽ/עָפָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִהְיֶה֙ בְּ/קַרְקַ֣ע הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יִקַּ֥ח הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן וְ/נָתַ֥ן אֶל הַ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn mym qdshym bkhly chrsh vmn h'pr 'shr yhyh bqrq' hmshkhn yqch hkhhn vntn 'l hmym
verses.translation: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:

verses.original: וְ/הֶעֱמִ֨יד הַ/כֹּהֵ֥ן אֶֽת הָ/אִשָּׁה֮ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ וּ/פָרַע֙ אֶת רֹ֣אשׁ הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֔ה וְ/נָתַ֣ן עַל כַּפֶּ֗י/הָ אֵ֚ת מִנְחַ֣ת הַ/זִּכָּר֔וֹן מִנְחַ֥ת קְנָאֹ֖ת הִ֑וא וּ/בְ/יַ֤ד הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ יִהְי֔וּ מֵ֥י הַ/מָּרִ֖ים הַ/מְאָֽרֲרִֽים
verses.translit: vh'myd hkhhn 't h'shh lpny yhvh vpr' 't r'sh h'shh vntn 'l khpyh 't mncht hzkhrvn mncht qn't hv' vbyd hkhhn yhyv my hmrym hm'rrym
verses.translation: And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD , and uncover the woman’s head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁבִּ֨יעַ אֹתָ֜/הּ הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן וְ/אָמַ֤ר אֶל הָֽ/אִשָּׁה֙ אִם לֹ֨א שָׁכַ֥ב אִישׁ֙ אֹתָ֔/ךְ וְ/אִם לֹ֥א שָׂטִ֛ית טֻמְאָ֖ה תַּ֣חַת אִישֵׁ֑/ךְ הִנָּקִ֕י מִ/מֵּ֛י הַ/מָּרִ֥ים הַֽ/מְאָרֲרִ֖ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vhshby' 'th hkhhn v'mr 'l h'shh 'm l' shkhb 'ysh 'tkh v'm l' shtyt tm'h tcht 'yshkh hnqy mmy hmrym hm'rrym h'lh
verses.translation: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:

verses.original: וְ/אַ֗תְּ כִּ֥י שָׂטִ֛ית תַּ֥חַת אִישֵׁ֖/ךְ וְ/כִ֣י נִטְמֵ֑את וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן אִ֥ישׁ בָּ/ךְ֙ אֶת שְׁכָבְתּ֔/וֹ מִֽ/בַּלְעֲדֵ֖י אִישֵֽׁ/ךְ
verses.translit: v't khy shtyt tcht 'yshkh vkhy ntm't vytn 'ysh bkh 't shkhbtv mbl'dy 'yshkh
verses.translation: But if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁבִּ֨יעַ הַ/כֹּהֵ֥ן אֶֽת הָֽ/אִשָּׁה֮ בִּ/שְׁבֻעַ֣ת הָ/אָלָה֒ וְ/אָמַ֤ר הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ לָֽ/אִשָּׁ֔ה יִתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֥ה אוֹתָ֛/ךְ לְ/אָלָ֥ה וְ/לִ/שְׁבֻעָ֖ה בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ עַמֵּ֑/ךְ בְּ/תֵ֨ת יְהוָ֤ה אֶת יְרֵכֵ/ךְ֙ נֹפֶ֔לֶת וְ/אֶת בִּטְנֵ֖/ךְ צָבָֽה
verses.translit: vhshby' hkhhn 't h'shh bshb't h'lh v'mr hkhhn l'shh ytn yhvh 'vtkh l'lh vlshb'h btvkh 'mkh btt yhvh 't yrkhkh nplt v't btnkh tsbh
verses.translation: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;

verses.original: וּ֠/בָאוּ הַ/מַּ֨יִם הַ/מְאָרְרִ֤ים הָ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ בְּֽ/מֵעַ֔יִ/ךְ לַ/צְבּ֥וֹת בֶּ֖טֶן וְ/לַ/נְפִּ֣ל יָרֵ֑ךְ וְ/אָמְרָ֥ה הָ/אִשָּׁ֖ה אָמֵ֥ן אָמֵֽן
verses.translit: vb'v hmym hm'rrym h'lh bm'ykh ltsbvt btn vlnpl yrkh v'mrh h'shh 'mn 'mn
verses.translation: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.

verses.original: וְ֠/כָתַב אֶת הָ/אָלֹ֥ת הָ/אֵ֛לֶּה הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן בַּ/סֵּ֑פֶר וּ/מָחָ֖ה אֶל מֵ֥י הַ/מָּרִֽים
verses.translit: vkhtb 't h'lt h'lh hkhhn bspr vmchh 'l my hmrym
verses.translation: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁקָה֙ אֶת הָ֣/אִשָּׁ֔ה אֶת מֵ֥י הַ/מָּרִ֖ים הַ/מְאָֽרֲרִ֑ים וּ/בָ֥אוּ בָ֛/הּ הַ/מַּ֥יִם הַֽ/מְאָרֲרִ֖ים לְ/מָרִֽים
verses.translit: vhshqh 't h'shh 't my hmrym hm'rrym vb'v bh hmym hm'rrym lmrym
verses.translation: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֤ח הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ מִ/יַּ֣ד הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֔ה אֵ֖ת מִנְחַ֣ת הַ/קְּנָאֹ֑ת וְ/הֵנִ֤יף אֶת הַ/מִּנְחָה֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְ/הִקְרִ֥יב אֹתָ֖/הּ אֶל הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn myd h'shh 't mncht hqn't vhnyf 't hmnchh lpny yhvh vhqryb 'th 'l hmzbch
verses.translation: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD , and offer it upon the altar:

verses.original: וְ/קָמַ֨ץ הַ/כֹּהֵ֤ן מִן הַ/מִּנְחָה֙ אֶת אַזְכָּ֣רָתָ֔/הּ וְ/הִקְטִ֖יר הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חָ/ה וְ/אַחַ֛ר יַשְׁקֶ֥ה אֶת הָ/אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶת הַ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: vqmts hkhhn mn hmnchh 't 'zkhrth vhqtyr hmzbchh v'chr yshqh 't h'shh 't hmym
verses.translation: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.

verses.original: וְ/הִשְׁקָ֣/הּ אֶת הַ/מַּ֗יִם וְ/הָיְתָ֣ה אִֽם נִטְמְאָה֮ וַ/תִּמְעֹ֣ל מַ֣עַל בְּ/אִישָׁ/הּ֒ וּ/בָ֨אוּ בָ֜/הּ הַ/מַּ֤יִם הַ/מְאָֽרֲרִים֙ לְ/מָרִ֔ים וְ/צָבְתָ֣ה בִטְנָ֔/הּ וְ/נָפְלָ֖ה יְרֵכָ֑/הּ וְ/הָיְתָ֧ה הָ/אִשָּׁ֛ה לְ/אָלָ֖ה בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב עַמָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vhshqh 't hmym vhyth 'm ntm'h vtm'l m'l b'yshh vb'v bh hmym hm'rrym lmrym vtsbth btnh vnplh yrkhh vhyth h'shh l'lh bqrb 'mh
verses.translation: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that , if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.

verses.original: וְ/אִם לֹ֤א נִטְמְאָה֙ הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֔ה וּ/טְהֹרָ֖ה הִ֑וא וְ/נִקְּתָ֖ה וְ/נִזְרְעָ֥ה זָֽרַע
verses.translit: v'm l' ntm'h h'shh vthrh hv' vnqth vnzr'h zr'
verses.translation: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.

verses.original: זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַ/קְּנָאֹ֑ת אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּשְׂטֶ֥ה אִשָּׁ֛ה תַּ֥חַת אִישָׁ֖/הּ וְ/נִטְמָֽאָה
verses.translit: z't tvrt hqn't 'shr tshth 'shh tcht 'yshh vntm'h
verses.translation: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;

verses.original: א֣וֹ אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תַּעֲבֹ֥ר עָלָ֛י/ו ר֥וּחַ קִנְאָ֖ה וְ/קִנֵּ֣א אֶת אִשְׁתּ֑/וֹ וְ/הֶעֱמִ֤יד אֶת הָֽ/אִשָּׁה֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְ/עָ֤שָׂה לָ/הּ֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/תּוֹרָ֖ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: 'v 'ysh 'shr t'br 'lyv rvch qn'h vqn' 't 'shtv vh'myd 't h'shh lpny yhvh v'shh lh hkhhn 't khl htvrh hz't
verses.translation: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD , and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.

verses.original: וְ/נִקָּ֥ה הָ/אִ֖ישׁ מֵ/עָוֺ֑ן וְ/הָ/אִשָּׁ֣ה הַ/הִ֔וא תִּשָּׂ֖א אֶת עֲוֺנָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vnqh h'ysh m'vn vh'shh hhv' tsh' 't 'vnh
verses.translation: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם אִ֣ישׁ אֽוֹ אִשָּׁ֗ה כִּ֤י יַפְלִא֙ לִ/נְדֹּר֙ נֶ֣דֶר נָזִ֔יר לְ/הַזִּ֖יר לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm 'ysh 'v 'shh khy ypl' lndr ndr nzyr lhzyr lyhvh
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate themselves unto the LORD :

verses.original: מִ/יַּ֤יִן וְ/שֵׁכָר֙ יַזִּ֔יר חֹ֥מֶץ יַ֛יִן וְ/חֹ֥מֶץ שֵׁכָ֖ר לֹ֣א יִשְׁתֶּ֑ה וְ/כָל מִשְׁרַ֤ת עֲנָבִים֙ לֹ֣א יִשְׁתֶּ֔ה וַ/עֲנָבִ֛ים לַחִ֥ים וִ/יבֵשִׁ֖ים לֹ֥א יֹאכֵֽל
verses.translit: myyn vshkhr yzyr chmts yyn vchmts shkhr l' yshth vkhl mshrt 'nbym l' yshth v'nbym lchym vybshym l' y'khl
verses.translation: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.

verses.original: כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י נִזְר֑/וֹ מִ/כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵעָשֶׂ֜ה מִ/גֶּ֣פֶן הַ/יַּ֗יִן מֵ/חַרְצַנִּ֛ים וְ/עַד זָ֖ג לֹ֥א יֹאכֵֽל
verses.translit: khl ymy nzrv mkhl 'shr y'shh mgpn hyyn mchrtsnym v'd zg l' y'khl
verses.translation: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.

verses.original: כָּל יְמֵי֙ נֶ֣דֶר נִזְר֔/וֹ תַּ֖עַר לֹא יַעֲבֹ֣ר עַל רֹאשׁ֑/וֹ עַד מְלֹ֨את הַ/יָּמִ֜ם אֲשֶׁר יַזִּ֤יר לַ/יהוָה֙ קָדֹ֣שׁ יִהְיֶ֔ה גַּדֵּ֥ל פֶּ֖רַע שְׂעַ֥ר רֹאשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: khl ymy ndr nzrv t'r l' y'br 'l r'shv 'd ml't hymm 'shr yzyr lyhvh qdsh yhyh gdl pr' sh'r r'shv
verses.translation: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the LORD , he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.

verses.original: כָּל יְמֵ֥י הַזִּיר֖/וֹ לַ/יהוָ֑ה עַל נֶ֥פֶשׁ מֵ֖ת לֹ֥א יָבֹֽא
verses.translit: khl ymy hzyrv lyhvh 'l npsh mt l' yb'
verses.translation: All the days that he separateth himself unto the LORD he shall come at no dead body.

verses.original: לְ/אָבִ֣י/ו וּ/לְ/אִמּ֗/וֹ לְ/אָחִי/ו֙ וּ/לְ/אַ֣חֹת֔/וֹ לֹא יִטַּמָּ֥א לָ/הֶ֖ם בְּ/מֹתָ֑/ם כִּ֛י נֵ֥זֶר אֱלֹהָ֖י/ו עַל רֹאשֽׁ/וֹ
verses.translit: l'byv vl'mv l'chyv vl'chtv l' ytm' lhm bmtm khy nzr 'lhyv 'l r'shv
verses.translation: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.

verses.original: כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י נִזְר֑/וֹ קָדֹ֥שׁ ה֖וּא לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: khl ymy nzrv qdsh hv' lyhvh
verses.translation: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יָמ֨וּת מֵ֤ת עָלָי/ו֙ בְּ/פֶ֣תַע פִּתְאֹ֔ם וְ/טִמֵּ֖א רֹ֣אשׁ נִזְר֑/וֹ וְ/גִלַּ֤ח רֹאשׁ/וֹ֙ בְּ/י֣וֹם טָהֳרָת֔/וֹ בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֖י יְגַלְּחֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: vkhy ymvt mt 'lyv bpt' pt'm vtm' r'sh nzrv vglch r'shv byvm thrtv byvm hshby'y yglchnv
verses.translation: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֗י יָבִא֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י תֹרִ֔ים א֥וֹ שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יוֹנָ֑ה אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vbyvm hshmyny yb' shty trym 'v shny bny yvnh 'l hkhhn 'l ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

verses.original: וְ/עָשָׂ֣ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן אֶחָ֤ד לְ/חַטָּאת֙ וְ/אֶחָ֣ד לְ/עֹלָ֔ה וְ/כִפֶּ֣ר עָלָ֔י/ו מֵ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖א עַל הַ/נָּ֑פֶשׁ וְ/קִדַּ֥שׁ אֶת רֹאשׁ֖/וֹ בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/הֽוּא
verses.translit: v'shh hkhhn 'chd lcht't v'chd l'lh vkhpr 'lyv m'shr cht' 'l hnpsh vqdsh 't r'shv byvm hhv'
verses.translation: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.

verses.original: וְ/הִזִּ֤יר לַֽ/יהוָה֙ אֶת יְמֵ֣י נִזְר֔/וֹ וְ/הֵבִ֛יא כֶּ֥בֶשׂ בֶּן שְׁנָת֖/וֹ לְ/אָשָׁ֑ם וְ/הַ/יָּמִ֤ים הָ/רִאשֹׁנִים֙ יִפְּל֔וּ כִּ֥י טָמֵ֖א נִזְרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhzyr lyhvh 't ymy nzrv vhby' khbsh bn shntv l'shm vhymym hr'shnym yplv khy tm' nzrv
verses.translation: And he shall consecrate unto the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.

verses.original: וְ/זֹ֥את תּוֹרַ֖ת הַ/נָּזִ֑יר בְּ/י֗וֹם מְלֹאת֙ יְמֵ֣י נִזְר֔/וֹ יָבִ֣יא אֹת֔/וֹ אֶל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vz't tvrt hnzyr byvm ml't ymy nzrv yby' 'tv 'l ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרִ֣יב אֶת קָרְבָּנ֣/וֹ לַ/יהוָ֡ה כֶּבֶשׂ֩ בֶּן שְׁנָת֨/וֹ תָמִ֤ים אֶחָד֙ לְ/עֹלָ֔ה וְ/כַבְשָׂ֨ה אַחַ֧ת בַּת שְׁנָתָ֛/הּ תְּמִימָ֖ה לְ/חַטָּ֑את וְ/אַֽיִל אֶחָ֥ד תָּמִ֖ים לִ/שְׁלָמִֽים
verses.translit: vhqryb 't qrbnv lyhvh khbsh bn shntv tmym 'chd l'lh vkhbshh 'cht bt shnth tmymh lcht't v'yl 'chd tmym lshlmym
verses.translation: And he shall offer his offering unto the LORD , one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,

verses.original: וְ/סַ֣ל מַצּ֗וֹת סֹ֤לֶת חַלֹּת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּ/שֶּׁ֔מֶן וּ/רְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֣ים בַּ/שָּׁ֑מֶן וּ/מִנְחָתָ֖/ם וְ/נִסְכֵּי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vsl mtsvt slt chlt blvlt bshmn vrqyqy mtsvt mshchym bshmn vmnchtm vnskhyhm
verses.translation: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרִ֥יב הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/עָשָׂ֥ה אֶת חַטָּאת֖/וֹ וְ/אֶת עֹלָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhqryb hkhhn lpny yhvh v'shh 't cht'tv v't 'ltv
verses.translation: And the priest shall bring them before the LORD , and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הָ/אַ֜יִל יַעֲשֶׂ֨ה זֶ֤בַח שְׁלָמִים֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה עַ֖ל סַ֣ל הַ/מַּצּ֑וֹת וְ/עָשָׂה֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן אֶת מִנְחָת֖/וֹ וְ/אֶת נִסְכּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v't h'yl y'shh zbch shlmym lyhvh 'l sl hmtsvt v'shh hkhhn 't mnchtv v't nskhv
verses.translation: And he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD , with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.

verses.original: וְ/גִלַּ֣ח הַ/נָּזִ֗יר פֶּ֛תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד אֶת רֹ֣אשׁ נִזְר֑/וֹ וְ/לָקַ֗ח אֶת שְׂעַר֙ רֹ֣אשׁ נִזְר֔/וֹ וְ/נָתַן֙ עַל הָ/אֵ֔שׁ אֲשֶׁר תַּ֖חַת זֶ֥בַח הַ/שְּׁלָמִֽים
verses.translit: vglch hnzyr ptch 'hl mv'd 't r'sh nzrv vlqch 't sh'r r'sh nzrv vntn 'l h'sh 'shr tcht zbch hshlmym
verses.translation: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it in the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֨ח הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן אֶת הַ/זְּרֹ֣עַ בְּשֵׁלָה֮ מִן הָ/אַיִל֒ וְֽ/חַלַּ֨ת מַצָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ מִן הַ/סַּ֔ל וּ/רְקִ֥יק מַצָּ֖ה אֶחָ֑ד וְ/נָתַן֙ עַל כַּפֵּ֣י הַ/נָּזִ֔יר אַחַ֖ר הִֽתְגַּלְּח֥/וֹ אֶת נִזְרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn 't hzr' bshlh mn h'yl vchlt mtsh 'cht mn hsl vrqyq mtsh 'chd vntn 'l khpy hnzyr 'chr htglchv 't nzrv
verses.translation: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after the hair of his separation is shaven:

verses.original: וְ/הֵנִיף֩ אוֹתָ֨/ם הַ/כֹּהֵ֥ן תְּנוּפָה֮ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָה֒ קֹ֤דֶשׁ הוּא֙ לַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן עַ֚ל חֲזֵ֣ה הַ/תְּנוּפָ֔ה וְ/עַ֖ל שׁ֣וֹק הַ/תְּרוּמָ֑ה וְ/אַחַ֛ר יִשְׁתֶּ֥ה הַ/נָּזִ֖יר יָֽיִן
verses.translit: vhnyf 'vtm hkhhn tnvph lpny yhvh qdsh hv' lkhhn 'l chzh htnvph v'l shvq htrvmh v'chr yshth hnzyr yyn
verses.translation: And the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD : this is holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.

verses.original: זֹ֣את תּוֹרַ֣ת הַ/נָּזִיר֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִדֹּר֒ קָרְבָּנ֤/וֹ לַֽ/יהוָה֙ עַל נִזְר֔/וֹ מִ/לְּ/בַ֖ד אֲשֶׁר תַּשִּׂ֣יג יָד֑/וֹ כְּ/פִ֤י נִדְר/וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִדֹּ֔ר כֵּ֣ן יַעֲשֶׂ֔ה עַ֖ל תּוֹרַ֥ת נִזְרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: z't tvrt hnzyr 'shr ydr qrbnv lyhvh 'l nzrv mlbd 'shr tshyg ydv khpy ndrv 'shr ydr khn y'shh 'l tvrt nzrv
verses.translation: This is the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, and of his offering unto the LORD for his separation, beside that that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֤ר אֶֽל אַהֲרֹן֙ וְ/אֶל בָּנָ֣י/ו לֵ/אמֹ֔ר כֹּ֥ה תְבָרֲכ֖וּ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אָמ֖וֹר לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: dbr 'l 'hrn v'l bnyv l'mr khh tbrkhv 't bny yshr'l 'mvr lhm
verses.translation: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them,

verses.original: יְבָרֶכְ/ךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה וְ/יִשְׁמְרֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: ybrkhkh yhvh vyshmrkh
verses.translation: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:

verses.original: יָאֵ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה פָּנָ֛י/ו אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ וִֽ/יחֻנֶּֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: y'r yhvh pnyv 'lykh vychnkh
verses.translation: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:

verses.original: יִשָּׂ֨א יְהוָ֤ה פָּנָי/ו֙ אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/יָשֵׂ֥ם לְ/ךָ֖ שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: ysh' yhvh pnyv 'lykh vyshm lkh shlvm
verses.translation: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.

verses.original: וְ/שָׂמ֥וּ אֶת שְׁמִ֖/י עַל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/אֲנִ֖י אֲבָרֲכֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vshmv 't shmy 'l bny yshr'l v'ny 'brkhm
verses.translation: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֡י בְּ/יוֹם֩ כַּלּ֨וֹת מֹשֶׁ֜ה לְ/הָקִ֣ים אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֗ן וַ/יִּמְשַׁ֨ח אֹת֜/וֹ וַ/יְקַדֵּ֤שׁ אֹת/וֹ֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֔י/ו וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֖חַ וְ/אֶת כָּל כֵּלָ֑י/ו וַ/יִּמְשָׁחֵ֖/ם וַ/יְקַדֵּ֥שׁ אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyhy byvm khlvt mshh lhqym 't hmshkhn vymshch 'tv vyqdsh 'tv v't khl khlyv v't hmzbch v't khl khlyv vymshchm vyqdsh 'tm
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְרִ֨יבוּ֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל רָאשֵׁ֖י בֵּ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם הֵ֚ם נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הַ/מַּטֹּ֔ת הֵ֥ם הָ/עֹמְדִ֖ים עַל הַ/פְּקֻדִֽים
verses.translit: vyqrybv nshy'y yshr'l r'shy byt 'btm hm nshy'y hmtt hm h'mdym 'l hpqdym
verses.translation: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:

verses.original: וַ/יָּבִ֨יאוּ אֶת קָרְבָּנָ֜/ם לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה שֵׁשׁ עֶגְלֹ֥ת צָב֙ וּ/שְׁנֵ֣י עָשָׂ֣ר בָּקָ֔ר עֲגָלָ֛ה עַל שְׁנֵ֥י הַ/נְּשִׂאִ֖ים וְ/שׁ֣וֹר לְ/אֶחָ֑ד וַ/יַּקְרִ֥יבוּ אוֹתָ֖/ם לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מִּשְׁכָּֽן
verses.translit: vyby'v 't qrbnm lpny yhvh shsh 'glt tsb vshny 'shr bqr 'glh 'l shny hnsh'ym vshvr l'chd vyqrybv 'vtm lpny hmshkhn
verses.translation: And they brought their offering before the LORD , six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: קַ֚ח מֵֽ/אִתָּ֔/ם וְ/הָי֕וּ לַ/עֲבֹ֕ד אֶת עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְ/נָתַתָּ֤ה אוֹתָ/ם֙ אֶל הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ כְּ/פִ֥י עֲבֹדָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: qch m'tm vhyv l'bd 't 'bdt 'hl mv'd vntth 'vtm 'l hlvym 'ysh khpy 'bdtv
verses.translation: Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת הָ/עֲגָלֹ֖ת וְ/אֶת הַ/בָּקָ֑ר וַ/יִּתֵּ֥ן אוֹתָ֖/ם אֶל הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: vyqch mshh 't h'glt v't hbqr vytn 'vtm 'l hlvym
verses.translation: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.

verses.original: אֵ֣ת שְׁתֵּ֣י הָ/עֲגָלֹ֗ת וְ/אֵת֙ אַרְבַּ֣עַת הַ/בָּקָ֔ר נָתַ֖ן לִ/בְנֵ֣י גֵרְשׁ֑וֹן כְּ/פִ֖י עֲבֹדָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 't shty h'glt v't 'rb't hbqr ntn lbny grshvn khpy 'bdtm
verses.translation: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣ת אַרְבַּ֣ע הָ/עֲגָלֹ֗ת וְ/אֵת֙ שְׁמֹנַ֣ת הַ/בָּקָ֔ר נָתַ֖ן לִ/בְנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֑י כְּ/פִי֙ עֲבֹ֣דָתָ֔/ם בְּ/יַד֙ אִֽיתָמָ֔ר בֶּֽן אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: v't 'rb' h'glt v't shmnt hbqr ntn lbny mrry khpy 'bdtm byd 'ytmr bn 'hrn hkhhn
verses.translation: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֥י קְהָ֖ת לֹ֣א נָתָ֑ן כִּֽי עֲבֹדַ֤ת הַ/קֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ עֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם בַּ/כָּתֵ֖ף יִשָּֽׂאוּ
verses.translit: vlbny qht l' ntn khy 'bdt hqdsh 'lhm bkhtf ysh'v
verses.translation: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְרִ֣יבוּ הַ/נְּשִׂאִ֗ים אֵ֚ת חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ בְּ/י֖וֹם הִמָּשַׁ֣ח אֹת֑/וֹ וַ/יַּקְרִ֧יבוּ הַ/נְּשִׂיאִ֛ם אֶת קָרְבָּנָ֖/ם לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vyqrybv hnsh'ym 't chnkht hmzbch byvm hmshch 'tv vyqrybv hnshy'm 't qrbnm lpny hmzbch
verses.translation: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֑ה נָשִׂ֨יא אֶחָ֜ד לַ/יּ֗וֹם נָשִׂ֤יא אֶחָד֙ לַ/יּ֔וֹם יַקְרִ֨יבוּ֙ אֶת קָרְבָּנָ֔/ם לַ/חֲנֻכַּ֖ת הַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh nshy' 'chd lyvm nshy' 'chd lyvm yqrybv 't qrbnm lchnkht hmzbch
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.

verses.translit: vyhy hmqryb byvm hr'shvn 't qrbnv nchshvn bn 'myndb lmth yhvdh

verses.translit: pr 'chd bn bqr 'yl 'chd khbsh 'chd bn shntv l'lh

verses.translit: pr 'chd bn bqr 'yl 'chd khbsh 'chd bn shntv l'lh
verses.translation: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:

verses.original: שְׂעִיר עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד לְ/חַטָּֽאת
verses.translit: sh'yr 'zym 'chd lcht't
verses.translation: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:

verses.original: וּ/לְ/זֶ֣בַח הַ/שְּׁלָמִים֮ בָּקָ֣ר שְׁנַיִם֒ אֵילִ֤ם חֲמִשָּׁה֙ עַתֻּדִ֣ים חֲמִשָּׁ֔ה כְּבָשִׂ֥ים בְּנֵֽי שָׁנָ֖ה חֲמִשָּׁ֑ה זֶ֛ה קָרְבַּ֥ן אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן עֵינָֽן
verses.translit: vlzbch hshlmym bqr shnym 'ylm chmshh 'tdym chmshh khbshym bny shnh chmshh zh qrbn 'chyr' bn 'ynn
verses.translation: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.

verses.original: זֹ֣את חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֗חַ בְּ/יוֹם֙ הִמָּשַׁ֣ח אֹת֔/וֹ מֵ/אֵ֖ת נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל קַעֲרֹ֨ת כֶּ֜סֶף שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֗ה מִֽזְרְקֵי כֶ֨סֶף֙ שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֔ר כַּפּ֥וֹת זָהָ֖ב שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵֽה
verses.translit: z't chnkht hmzbch byvm hmshch 'tv m't nshy'y yshr'l q'rt khsf shtym 'shrh mzrqy khsf shnym 'shr khpvt zhb shtym 'shrh
verses.translation: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:

verses.original: שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וּ/מֵאָ֗ה הַ/קְּעָרָ֤ה הָֽ/אַחַת֙ כֶּ֔סֶף וְ/שִׁבְעִ֖ים הַ/מִּזְרָ֣ק הָ/אֶחָ֑ד כֹּ֚ל כֶּ֣סֶף הַ/כֵּלִ֔ים אַלְפַּ֥יִם וְ/אַרְבַּע מֵא֖וֹת בְּ/שֶׁ֥קֶל הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: shlshym vm'h hq'rh h'cht khsf vshb'ym hmzrq h'chd khl khsf hkhlym 'lpym v'rb' m'vt bshql hqdsh
verses.translation: Each charger of silver weighing an hundred and thirty shekels , each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels , after the shekel of the sanctuary:

verses.original: כַּפּ֨וֹת זָהָ֤ב שְׁתֵּים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ מְלֵאֹ֣ת קְטֹ֔רֶת עֲשָׂרָ֧ה עֲשָׂרָ֛ה הַ/כַּ֖ף בְּ/שֶׁ֣קֶל הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ כָּל זְהַ֥ב הַ/כַּפּ֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּ/מֵאָֽה
verses.translit: khpvt zhb shtym 'shrh ml't qtrt 'shrh 'shrh hkhf bshql hqdsh khl zhb hkhpvt 'shrym vm'h
verses.translation: The golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels .

verses.original: כָּל הַ/בָּקָ֨ר לָ/עֹלָ֜ה שְׁנֵ֧ים עָשָׂ֣ר פָּרִ֗ים אֵילִ֤ם שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר֙ כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי שָׁנָ֛ה שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר וּ/מִנְחָתָ֑/ם וּ/שְׂעִירֵ֥י עִזִּ֛ים שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר לְ/חַטָּֽאת
verses.translit: khl hbqr l'lh shnym 'shr prym 'ylm shnym 'shr khbshym bny shnh shnym 'shr vmnchtm vsh'yry 'zym shnym 'shr lcht't
verses.translation: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.

verses.original: וְ/כֹ֞ל בְּקַ֣ר זֶ֣בַח הַ/שְּׁלָמִ֗ים עֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְ/אַרְבָּעָה֮ פָּרִים֒ אֵילִ֤ם שִׁשִּׁים֙ עַתֻּדִ֣ים שִׁשִּׁ֔ים כְּבָשִׂ֥ים בְּנֵי שָׁנָ֖ה שִׁשִּׁ֑ים זֹ֚את חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ אַחֲרֵ֖י הִמָּשַׁ֥ח אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vkhl bqr zbch hshlmym 'shrym v'rb'h prym 'ylm shshym 'tdym shshym khbshym bny shnh shshym z't chnkht hmzbch 'chry hmshch 'tv
verses.translation: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/בֹ֨א מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֮ לְ/דַבֵּ֣ר אִתּ/וֹ֒ וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֨ע אֶת הַ/קּ֜וֹל מִדַּבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֗י/ו מֵ/עַ֤ל הַ/כַּפֹּ֨רֶת֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל אֲרֹ֣ן הָ/עֵדֻ֔ת מִ/בֵּ֖ין שְׁנֵ֣י הַ/כְּרֻבִ֑ים וַ/יְדַבֵּ֖ר אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vbb' mshh 'l 'hl mv'd ldbr 'tv vyshm' 't hqvl mdbr 'lyv m'l hkhprt 'shr 'l 'rn h'dt mbyn shny hkhrbym vydbr 'lyv
verses.translation: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֖ אֵלָ֑י/ו בְּ/הַעֲלֹֽתְ/ךָ֙ אֶת הַ/נֵּרֹ֔ת אֶל מוּל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הַ/מְּנוֹרָ֔ה יָאִ֖ירוּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת הַ/נֵּרֽוֹת
verses.translit: dbr 'l 'hrn v'mrt 'lyv bh'ltkh 't hnrt 'l mvl pny hmnvrh y'yrv shb't hnrvt
verses.translation: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ כֵּן֙ אַהֲרֹ֔ן אֶל מוּל֙ פְּנֵ֣י הַ/מְּנוֹרָ֔ה הֶעֱלָ֖ה נֵרֹתֶ֑י/הָ כַּֽ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'sh khn 'hrn 'l mvl pny hmnvrh h'lh nrtyh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וְ/זֶ֨ה מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה הַ/מְּנֹרָה֙ מִקְשָׁ֣ה זָהָ֔ב עַד יְרֵכָ֥/הּ עַד פִּרְחָ֖/הּ מִקְשָׁ֣ה הִ֑וא כַּ/מַּרְאֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶרְאָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן עָשָׂ֖ה אֶת הַ/מְּנֹרָֽה
verses.translit: vzh m'shh hmnrh mqshh zhb 'd yrkhh 'd prchh mqshh hv' khmr'h 'shr hr'h yhvh 't mshh khn 'shh 't hmnrh
verses.translation: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the LORD had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: קַ֚ח אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם מִ/תּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/טִהַרְתָּ֖ אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: qch 't hlvym mtvkh bny yshr'l vthrt 'tm
verses.translation: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

verses.original: וְ/כֹֽה תַעֲשֶׂ֤ה לָ/הֶם֙ לְ/טַֽהֲרָ֔/ם הַזֵּ֥ה עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם מֵ֣י חַטָּ֑את וְ/הֶעֱבִ֤ירוּ תַ֨עַר֙ עַל כָּל בְּשָׂרָ֔/ם וְ/כִבְּס֥וּ בִגְדֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/הִטֶּהָֽרוּ
verses.translit: vkhh t'shh lhm lthrm hzh 'lyhm my cht't vh'byrv t'r 'l khl bshrm vkhbsv bgdyhm vhthrv
verses.translation: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.

verses.original: וְ/לָֽקְחוּ֙ פַּ֣ר בֶּן בָּקָ֔ר וּ/מִנְחָת֔/וֹ סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַ/שָּׁ֑מֶן וּ/פַר שֵׁנִ֥י בֶן בָּקָ֖ר תִּקַּ֥ח לְ/חַטָּֽאת
verses.translit: vlqchv pr bn bqr vmnchtv slt blvlh bshmn vpr shny bn bqr tqch lcht't
verses.translation: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרַבְתָּ֙ אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם לִ/פְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְ/הִ֨קְהַלְתָּ֔ אֶֽת כָּל עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhqrbt 't hlvym lpny 'hl mv'd vhqhlt 't khl 'dt bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרַבְתָּ֥ אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/סָמְכ֧וּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת יְדֵי/הֶ֖ם עַל הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: vhqrbt 't hlvym lpny yhvh vsmkhv bny yshr'l 't ydyhm 'l hlvym
verses.translation: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the LORD : and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:

verses.original: וְ/הֵנִיף֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֤ם תְּנוּפָה֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה מֵ/אֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/הָי֕וּ לַ/עֲבֹ֖ד אֶת עֲבֹדַ֥ת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhnyf 'hrn 't hlvym tnvph lpny yhvh m't bny yshr'l vhyv l'bd 't 'bdt yhvh
verses.translation: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הַ/לְוִיִּם֙ יִסְמְכ֣וּ אֶת יְדֵי/הֶ֔ם עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/פָּרִ֑ים וַ֠/עֲשֵׂה אֶת הָ/אֶחָ֨ד חַטָּ֜את וְ/אֶת הָ/אֶחָ֤ד עֹלָה֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה לְ/כַפֵּ֖ר עַל הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: vhlvym ysmkhv 't ydyhm 'l r'sh hprym v'shh 't h'chd cht't v't h'chd 'lh lyhvh lkhpr 'l hlvym
verses.translation: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the LORD , to make an atonement for the Levites.

verses.original: וְ/הַֽעֲמַדְתָּ֙ אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם לִ/פְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֣י בָנָ֑י/ו וְ/הֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֛/ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vh'mdt 't hlvym lpny 'hrn vlpny bnyv vhnpt 'tm tnvph lyhvh
verses.translation: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/הִבְדַּלְתָּ֙ אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם מִ/תּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/הָ֥יוּ לִ֖/י הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: vhbdlt 't hlvym mtvkh bny yshr'l vhyv ly hlvym
verses.translation: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.

verses.original: וְ/אַֽחֲרֵי כֵן֙ יָבֹ֣אוּ הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם לַ/עֲבֹ֖ד אֶת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְ/טִֽהַרְתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔/ם וְ/הֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖/ם תְּנוּפָֽה
verses.translit: v'chry khn yb'v hlvym l'bd 't 'hl mv'd vthrt 'tm vhnpt 'tm tnvph
verses.translation: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.

verses.original: כִּי֩ נְתֻנִ֨ים נְתֻנִ֥ים הֵ֨מָּה֙ לִ֔/י מִ/תּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל תַּחַת֩ פִּטְרַ֨ת כָּל רֶ֜חֶם בְּכ֥וֹר כֹּל֙ מִ/בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לָקַ֥חְתִּי אֹתָ֖/ם לִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy ntnym ntnym hmh ly mtvkh bny yshr'l tcht ptrt khl rchm bkhvr khl mbny yshr'l lqchty 'tm ly
verses.translation: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לִ֤/י כָל בְּכוֹר֙ בִּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָּ/אָדָ֖ם וּ/בַ/בְּהֵמָ֑ה בְּ/י֗וֹם הַכֹּתִ֤/י כָל בְּכוֹר֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם הִקְדַּ֥שְׁתִּי אֹתָ֖/ם לִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy ly khl bkhvr bbny yshr'l b'dm vbbhmh byvm hkhty khl bkhvr b'rts mtsrym hqdshty 'tm ly
verses.translation: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.

verses.original: וָ/אֶקַּח֙ אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם תַּ֥חַת כָּל בְּכ֖וֹר בִּ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'qch 't hlvym tcht khl bkhvr bbny yshr'l
verses.translation: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.

verses.original: וָ/אֶתְּנָ֨/ה אֶת הַ/לְוִיִּ֜ם נְתֻנִ֣ים לְ/אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּ/לְ/בָנָ֗י/ו מִ/תּוֹךְ֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ לַ/עֲבֹ֞ד אֶת עֲבֹדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וּ/לְ/כַפֵּ֖ר עַל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/לֹ֨א יִהְיֶ֜ה בִּ/בְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ נֶ֔גֶף בְּ/גֶ֥שֶׁת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: v'tnh 't hlvym ntnym l'hrn vlbnyv mtvkh bny yshr'l l'bd 't 'bdt bny yshr'l b'hl mv'd vlkhpr 'l bny yshr'l vl' yhyh bbny yshr'l ngf bgsht bny yshr'l 'l hqdsh
verses.translation: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֨עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֛ן וְ/כָל עֲדַ֥ת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם כְּ֠/כֹל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אֶת מֹשֶׁה֙ לַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם כֵּן עָשׂ֥וּ לָ/הֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'sh mshh v'hrn vkhl 'dt bny yshr'l llvym khkhl 'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh llvym khn 'shv lhm bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽתְחַטְּא֣וּ הַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם וַֽ/יְכַבְּסוּ֙ בִּגְדֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יָּ֨נֶף אַהֲרֹ֥ן אֹתָ֛/ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יְכַפֵּ֧ר עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם אַהֲרֹ֖ן לְ/טַהֲרָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vytcht'v hlvym vykhbsv bgdyhm vynf 'hrn 'tm tnvph lpny yhvh vykhpr 'lyhm 'hrn lthrm
verses.translation: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the LORD ; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.

verses.original: וְ/אַחֲרֵי כֵ֞ן בָּ֣אוּ הַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם לַ/עֲבֹ֤ד אֶת עֲבֹֽדָתָ/ם֙ בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד לִ/פְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֣י בָנָ֑י/ו כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אֶת מֹשֶׁה֙ עַל הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם כֵּ֖ן עָשׂ֥וּ לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'chry khn b'v hlvym l'bd 't 'bdtm b'hl mv'd lpny 'hrn vlpny bnyv kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh 'l hlvym khn 'shv lhm
verses.translation: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: זֹ֖את אֲשֶׁ֣ר לַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם מִ/בֶּן֩ חָמֵ֨שׁ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה יָבוֹא֙ לִ/צְבֹ֣א צָבָ֔א בַּ/עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: z't 'shr llvym mbn chmsh v'shrym shnh vm'lh ybv' ltsb' tsb' b'bdt 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בֶּן֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה יָשׁ֖וּב מִ/צְּבָ֣א הָ/עֲבֹדָ֑ה וְ/לֹ֥א יַעֲבֹ֖ד עֽוֹד
verses.translit: vmbn chmshym shnh yshvb mtsb' h'bdh vl' y'bd 'vd
verses.translation: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof , and shall serve no more:

verses.original: וְ/שֵׁרֵ֨ת אֶת אֶחָ֜י/ו בְּ/אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ לִ/שְׁמֹ֣ר מִשְׁמֶ֔רֶת וַ/עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א יַעֲבֹ֑ד כָּ֛כָה תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם בְּ/מִשְׁמְרֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vshrt 't 'chyv b'hl mv'd lshmr mshmrt v'bdh l' y'bd khkhh t'shh llvym bmshmrtm
verses.translation: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֣ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֣ה בְ/מִדְבַּר סִ֠ינַי בַּ/שָּׁנָ֨ה הַ/שֵּׁנִ֜ית לְ/צֵאתָ֨/ם מֵ/אֶ֧רֶץ מִצְרַ֛יִם בַּ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשׁ֖וֹן לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh bmdbr syny bshnh hshnyt lts'tm m'rts mtsrym bchdsh hr'shvn l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

verses.original: וְ/יַעֲשׂ֧וּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת הַ/פָּ֖סַח בְּ/מוֹעֲדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'shv bny yshr'l 't hpsch bmv'dv
verses.translation: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.

verses.original: בְּ/אַרְבָּעָ֣ה עָשָֽׂר י֠וֹם בַּ/חֹ֨דֶשׁ הַ/זֶּ֜ה בֵּ֧ין הָֽ/עֲרְבַּ֛יִם תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ בְּ/מוֹעֲד֑/וֹ כְּ/כָל חֻקֹּתָ֥י/ו וּ/כְ/כָל מִשְׁפָּטָ֖י/ו תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: b'rb'h 'shr yvm bchdsh hzh byn h'rbym t'shv 'tv bmv'dv khkhl chqtyv vkhkhl mshptyv t'shv 'tv
verses.translation: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַ/עֲשֹׂ֥ת הַ/פָּֽסַח
verses.translit: vydbr mshh 'l bny yshr'l l'sht hpsch
verses.translation: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲשׂ֣וּ אֶת הַ/פֶּ֡סַח בָּ/רִאשׁ֡וֹן בְּ/אַרְבָּעָה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֥וֹם לַ/חֹ֛דֶשׁ בֵּ֥ין הָ/עַרְבַּ֖יִם בְּ/מִדְבַּ֣ר סִינָ֑י כְּ֠/כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן עָשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'shv 't hpsch br'shvn b'rb'h 'shr yvm lchdsh byn h'rbym bmdbr syny khkhl 'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh khn 'shv bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י אֲנָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָי֤וּ טְמֵאִים֙ לְ/נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם וְ/לֹא יָכְל֥וּ לַ/עֲשֹׂת הַ/פֶּ֖סַח בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא וַֽ/יִּקְרְב֞וּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י מֹשֶׁ֛ה וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹ֖ן בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/הֽוּא
verses.translit: vyhy 'nshym 'shr hyv tm'ym lnpsh 'dm vl' ykhlv l'sht hpsch byvm hhv' vyqrbv lpny mshh vlpny 'hrn byvm hhv'
verses.translation: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:

verses.original: וַ֠/יֹּאמְרוּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָ/הֵ֨מָּה֙ אֵלָ֔י/ו אֲנַ֥חְנוּ טְמֵאִ֖ים לְ/נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֑ם לָ֣/מָּה נִגָּרַ֗ע לְ/בִלְתִּ֨י הַקְרִ֜ב אֶת קָרְבַּ֤ן יְהוָה֙ בְּ/מֹ֣עֲד֔/וֹ בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mrv h'nshym hhmh 'lyv 'nchnv tm'ym lnpsh 'dm lmh ngr' lblty hqrb 't qrbn yhvh bm'dv btvkh bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in his appointed season among the children of Israel?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֖ם מֹשֶׁ֑ה עִמְד֣וּ וְ/אֶשְׁמְעָ֔ה מַה יְצַוֶּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhm mshh 'mdv v'shm'h mh ytsvh yhvh lkhm
verses.translation: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the LORD will command concerning you.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֛ר אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אִ֣ישׁ אִ֣ישׁ כִּי יִהְיֶֽה טָמֵ֣א לָ/נֶ֡פֶשׁ אוֹ֩ בְ/דֶ֨רֶךְ רְחֹקָ֜הׄ לָ/כֶ֗ם א֚וֹ לְ/דֹרֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/עָ֥שָׂה פֶ֖סַח לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l l'mr 'ysh 'ysh khy yhyh tm' lnpsh 'v bdrkh rchqh lkhm 'v ldrtykhm v'shh psch lyhvh
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the LORD .

verses.original: בַּ/חֹ֨דֶשׁ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֜י בְּ/אַרְבָּעָ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר י֛וֹם בֵּ֥ין הָ/עַרְבַּ֖יִם יַעֲשׂ֣וּ אֹת֑/וֹ עַל מַצּ֥וֹת וּ/מְרֹרִ֖ים יֹאכְלֻֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: bchdsh hshny b'rb'h 'shr yvm byn h'rbym y'shv 'tv 'l mtsvt vmrrym y'khlhv
verses.translation: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs .

verses.original: לֹֽא יַשְׁאִ֤ירוּ מִמֶּ֨/נּוּ֙ עַד בֹּ֔קֶר וְ/עֶ֖צֶם לֹ֣א יִשְׁבְּרוּ ב֑/וֹ כְּ/כָל חֻקַּ֥ת הַ/פֶּ֖סַח יַעֲשׂ֥וּ אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l' ysh'yrv mmnv 'd bqr v'tsm l' yshbrv bv khkhl chqt hpsch y'shv 'tv
verses.translation: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אִישׁ֩ אֲשֶׁר ה֨וּא טָה֜וֹר וּ/בְ/דֶ֣רֶךְ לֹא הָיָ֗ה וְ/חָדַל֙ לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת הַ/פֶּ֔סַח וְ/נִכְרְתָ֛ה הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/הִ֖וא מֵֽ/עַמֶּ֑י/הָ כִּ֣י קָרְבַּ֣ן יְהוָ֗ה לֹ֤א הִקְרִיב֙ בְּ/מֹ֣עֲד֔/וֹ חֶטְא֥/וֹ יִשָּׂ֖א הָ/אִ֥ישׁ הַ/הֽוּא
verses.translit: vh'ysh 'shr hv' thvr vbdrkh l' hyh vchdl l'shvt hpsch vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' m'myh khy qrbn yhvh l' hqryb bm'dv cht'v ysh' h'ysh hhv'
verses.translation: But the man that is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the LORD in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יָג֨וּר אִתְּ/כֶ֜ם גֵּ֗ר וְ/עָ֤שָֽׂה פֶ֨סַח֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה כְּ/חֻקַּ֥ת הַ/פֶּ֛סַח וּ/כְ/מִשְׁפָּט֖/וֹ כֵּ֣ן יַעֲשֶׂ֑ה חֻקָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֔ם וְ/לַ/גֵּ֖ר וּ/לְ/אֶזְרַ֥ח הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vkhy ygvr 'tkhm gr v'shh psch lyhvh khchqt hpsch vkhmshptv khn y'shh chqh 'cht yhyh lkhm vlgr vl'zrch h'rts
verses.translation: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the LORD ; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/יוֹם֙ הָקִ֣ים אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֔ן כִּסָּ֤ה הֶֽ/עָנָן֙ אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֔ן לְ/אֹ֖הֶל הָ/עֵדֻ֑ת וּ/בָ/עֶ֜רֶב יִהְיֶ֧ה עַֽל הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֛ן כְּ/מַרְאֵה אֵ֖שׁ עַד בֹּֽקֶר
verses.translit: vbyvm hqym 't hmshkhn khsh h'nn 't hmshkhn l'hl h'dt vb'rb yhyh 'l hmshkhn khmr'h 'sh 'd bqr
verses.translation: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely , the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.

verses.original: כֵּ֚ן יִהְיֶ֣ה תָמִ֔יד הֶ/עָנָ֖ן יְכַסֶּ֑/נּוּ וּ/מַרְאֵה אֵ֖שׁ לָֽיְלָה
verses.translit: khn yhyh tmyd h'nn ykhsnv vmr'h 'sh lylh
verses.translation: So it was alway: the cloud covered it by day , and the appearance of fire by night.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/פִ֞י הֵעָלֹ֤ת הֶֽ/עָנָן֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל הָ/אֹ֔הֶל וְ/אַ֣חֲרֵי כֵ֔ן יִסְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ/בִ/מְק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁכָּן שָׁם֙ הֶֽ/עָנָ֔ן שָׁ֥ם יַחֲנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vlpy h'lt h'nn m'l h'hl v'chry khn ys'v bny yshr'l vbmqvm 'shr yshkhn shm h'nn shm ychnv bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.

verses.original: עַל פִּ֣י יְהוָ֗ה יִסְעוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/עַל פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה יַחֲנ֑וּ כָּל יְמֵ֗י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׁכֹּ֧ן הֶ/עָנָ֛ן עַל הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יַחֲנֽוּ
verses.translit: 'l py yhvh ys'v bny yshr'l v'l py yhvh ychnv khl ymy 'shr yshkhn h'nn 'l hmshkhn ychnv
verses.translation: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the LORD they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/הַאֲרִ֧יךְ הֶֽ/עָנָ֛ן עַל הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְ/שָׁמְר֧וּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת יְהוָ֖ה וְ/לֹ֥א יִסָּֽעוּ
verses.translit: vbh'rykh h'nn 'l hmshkhn ymym rbym vshmrv bny yshr'l 't mshmrt yhvh vl' ys'v
verses.translation: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the LORD , and journeyed not.

verses.original: וְ/יֵ֞שׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֧ה הֶֽ/עָנָ֛ן יָמִ֥ים מִסְפָּ֖ר עַל הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֑ן עַל פִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ יַחֲנ֔וּ וְ/עַל פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה יִסָּֽעוּ
verses.translit: vysh 'shr yhyh h'nn ymym mspr 'l hmshkhn 'l py yhvh ychnv v'l py yhvh ys'v
verses.translation: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the LORD they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the LORD they journeyed.

verses.original: וְ/יֵ֞שׁ אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶ֤ה הֶֽ/עָנָן֙ מֵ/עֶ֣רֶב עַד בֹּ֔קֶר וְ/נַעֲלָ֧ה הֶֽ/עָנָ֛ן בַּ/בֹּ֖קֶר וְ/נָסָ֑עוּ א֚וֹ יוֹמָ֣ם וָ/לַ֔יְלָה וְ/נַעֲלָ֥ה הֶ/עָנָ֖ן וְ/נָסָֽעוּ
verses.translit: vysh 'shr yhyh h'nn m'rb 'd bqr vn'lh h'nn bbqr vns'v 'v yvmm vlylh vn'lh h'nn vns'v
verses.translation: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.

verses.original: אֽוֹ יֹמַ֜יִם אוֹ חֹ֣דֶשׁ אוֹ יָמִ֗ים בְּ/הַאֲרִ֨יךְ הֶ/עָנָ֤ן עַל הַ/מִּשְׁכָּן֙ לִ/שְׁכֹּ֣ן עָלָ֔י/ו יַחֲנ֥וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְ/לֹ֣א יִסָּ֑עוּ וּ/בְ/הֵעָלֹת֖/וֹ יִסָּֽעוּ
verses.translit: 'v ymym 'v chdsh 'v ymym bh'rykh h'nn 'l hmshkhn lshkhn 'lyv ychnv bny yshr'l vl' ys'v vbh'ltv ys'v
verses.translation: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.

verses.original: עַל פִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ יַחֲנ֔וּ וְ/עַל פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה יִסָּ֑עוּ אֶת מִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת יְהוָה֙ שָׁמָ֔רוּ עַל פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יַד מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: 'l py yhvh ychnv v'l py yhvh ys'v 't mshmrt yhvh shmrv 'l py yhvh byd mshh
verses.translation: At the commandment of the LORD they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the LORD they journeyed: they kept the charge of the LORD , at the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: עֲשֵׂ֣ה לְ/ךָ֗ שְׁתֵּי֙ חֲצֽוֹצְרֹ֣ת כֶּ֔סֶף מִקְשָׁ֖ה תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑/ם וְ/הָי֤וּ לְ/ךָ֙ לְ/מִקְרָ֣א הָֽ/עֵדָ֔ה וּ/לְ/מַסַּ֖ע אֶת הַֽ/מַּחֲנֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'shh lkh shty chtsvtsrt khsf mqshh t'shh 'tm vhyv lkh lmqr' h'dh vlms' 't hmchnvt
verses.translation: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.

verses.original: וְ/תָקְע֖וּ בָּ/הֵ֑ן וְ/נֽוֹעֲד֤וּ אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ כָּל הָ֣/עֵדָ֔ה אֶל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vtq'v bhn vnv'dv 'lykh khl h'dh 'l ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: וְ/אִם בְּ/אַחַ֖ת יִתְקָ֑עוּ וְ/נוֹעֲד֤וּ אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ הַ/נְּשִׂיאִ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֖י אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'm b'cht ytq'v vnv'dv 'lykh hnshy'ym r'shy 'lpy yshr'l
verses.translation: And if they blow but with one trumpet , then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.

verses.original: וּ/תְקַעְתֶּ֖ם תְּרוּעָ֑ה וְ/נָֽסְעוּ֙ הַֽ/מַּחֲנ֔וֹת הַ/חֹנִ֖ים קֵֽדְמָ/ה
verses.translit: vtq'tm trv'h vns'v hmchnvt hchnym qdmh
verses.translation: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.

verses.original: וּ/תְקַעְתֶּ֤ם תְּרוּעָה֙ שֵׁנִ֔ית וְ/נָֽסְעוּ֙ הַֽ/מַּחֲנ֔וֹת הַ/חֹנִ֖ים תֵּימָ֑נָ/ה תְּרוּעָ֥ה יִתְקְע֖וּ לְ/מַסְעֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vtq'tm trv'h shnyt vns'v hmchnvt hchnym tymnh trv'h ytq'v lms'yhm
verses.translation: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/הַקְהִ֖יל אֶת הַ/קָּהָ֑ל תִּתְקְע֖וּ וְ/לֹ֥א תָרִֽיעוּ
verses.translit: vbhqhyl 't hqhl ttq'v vl' try'v
verses.translation: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים יִתְקְע֖וּ בַּֽ/חֲצֹצְר֑וֹת וְ/הָי֥וּ לָ/כֶ֛ם לְ/חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֖ם לְ/דֹרֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vbny 'hrn hkhhnym ytq'v bchtstsrvt vhyv lkhm lchqt 'vlm ldrtykhm
verses.translation: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי תָבֹ֨אוּ מִלְחָמָ֜ה בְּ/אַרְצְ/כֶ֗ם עַל הַ/צַּר֙ הַ/צֹּרֵ֣ר אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם וַ/הֲרֵעֹתֶ֖ם בַּ/חֲצֹצְר֑וֹת וֲ/נִזְכַּרְתֶּ֗ם לִ/פְנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/נוֹשַׁעְתֶּ֖ם מֵ/אֹיְבֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vkhy tb'v mlchmh b'rtskhm 'l htsr htsrr 'tkhm vhr'tm bchtstsrvt vnzkhrtm lpny yhvh 'lhykhm vnvsh'tm m'ybykhm
verses.translation: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/י֨וֹם שִׂמְחַתְ/כֶ֥ם וּֽ/בְ/מוֹעֲדֵי/כֶם֮ וּ/בְ/רָאשֵׁ֣י חָדְשֵׁי/כֶם֒ וּ/תְקַעְתֶּ֣ם בַּ/חֲצֹֽצְרֹ֗ת עַ֚ל עֹלֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/עַ֖ל זִבְחֵ֣י שַׁלְמֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/הָי֨וּ לָ/כֶ֤ם לְ/זִכָּרוֹן֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vbyvm shmchtkhm vbmv'dykhm vbr'shy chdshykhm vtq'tm bchtstsrt 'l 'ltykhm v'l zbchy shlmykhm vhyv lkhm lzkhrvn lpny 'lhykhm 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֞י בַּ/שָּׁנָ֧ה הַ/שֵּׁנִ֛ית בַּ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֖י בְּ/עֶשְׂרִ֣ים בַּ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ נַעֲלָה֙ הֶֽ/עָנָ֔ן מֵ/עַ֖ל מִשְׁכַּ֥ן הָ/עֵדֻֽת
verses.translit: vyhy bshnh hshnyt bchdsh hshny b'shrym bchdsh n'lh h'nn m'l mshkhn h'dt
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֧וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לְ/מַסְעֵי/הֶ֖ם מִ/מִּדְבַּ֣ר סִינָ֑י וַ/יִּשְׁכֹּ֥ן הֶ/עָנָ֖ן בְּ/מִדְבַּ֥ר פָּארָֽן
verses.translit: vys'v bny yshr'l lms'yhm mmdbr syny vyshkhn h'nn bmdbr p'rn
verses.translation: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ בָּ/רִאשֹׁנָ֑ה עַל פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יַד מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vys'v br'shnh 'l py yhvh byd mshh
verses.translation: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסַּ֞ע דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֧ה בְנֵֽי יְהוּדָ֛ה בָּ/רִאשֹׁנָ֖ה לְ/צִבְאֹתָ֑/ם וְ/עַל צְבָא֔/וֹ נַחְשׁ֖וֹן בֶּן עַמִּינָדָֽב
verses.translit: vys' dgl mchnh bny yhvdh br'shnh ltsb'tm v'l tsb'v nchshvn bn 'myndb
verses.translation: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֨ל צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י יִשָׂשכָ֑ר נְתַנְאֵ֖ל בֶּן צוּעָֽר
verses.translit: v'l tsb' mth bny yshshkhr ntn'l bn tsv'r
verses.translation: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֨ל צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י זְבוּלֻ֑ן אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן חֵלֽוֹן
verses.translit: v'l tsb' mth bny zbvln 'ly'b bn chlvn
verses.translation: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.

verses.original: וְ/הוּרַ֖ד הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֑ן וְ/נָסְע֤וּ בְנֵֽי גֵרְשׁוֹן֙ וּ/בְנֵ֣י מְרָרִ֔י נֹשְׂאֵ֖י הַ/מִּשְׁכָּֽן
verses.translit: vhvrd hmshkhn vns'v bny grshvn vbny mrry nsh'y hmshkhn
verses.translation: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.

verses.original: וְ/נָסַ֗ע דֶּ֛גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה רְאוּבֵ֖ן לְ/צִבְאֹתָ֑/ם וְ/עַל צְבָא֔/וֹ אֱלִיצ֖וּר בֶּן שְׁדֵיאֽוּר
verses.translit: vns' dgl mchnh r'vbn ltsb'tm v'l tsb'v 'lytsvr bn shdy'vr
verses.translation: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֨ל צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֑וֹן שְׁלֻֽמִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן צוּרִֽי שַׁדָּֽי
verses.translit: v'l tsb' mth bny shm'vn shlmy'l bn tsvry shdy
verses.translation: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

verses.original: וְ/עַל צְבָ֖א מַטֵּ֣ה בְנֵי גָ֑ד אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן דְּעוּאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'l tsb' mth bny gd 'lysf bn d'v'l
verses.translation: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

verses.original: וְ/נָסְעוּ֙ הַ/קְּהָתִ֔ים נֹשְׂאֵ֖י הַ/מִּקְדָּ֑שׁ וְ/הֵקִ֥ימוּ אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁכָּ֖ן עַד בֹּאָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vns'v hqhtym nsh'y hmqdsh vhqymv 't hmshkhn 'd b'm
verses.translation: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.

verses.original: וְ/נָסַ֗ע דֶּ֛גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה בְנֵֽי אֶפְרַ֖יִם לְ/צִבְאֹתָ֑/ם וְ/עַל צְבָא֔/וֹ אֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע בֶּן עַמִּיהֽוּד
verses.translit: vns' dgl mchnh bny 'prym ltsb'tm v'l tsb'v 'lyshm' bn 'myhvd
verses.translation: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֨ל צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה גַּמְלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן פְּדָה צֽוּר
verses.translit: v'l tsb' mth bny mnshh gmly'l bn pdh tsvr
verses.translation: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֨ל צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֑ן אֲבִידָ֖ן בֶּן גִּדְעוֹנִֽי
verses.translit: v'l tsb' mth bny bnymn 'bydn bn gd'vny
verses.translation: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.

verses.original: וְ/נָסַ֗ע דֶּ֚גֶל מַחֲנֵ֣ה בְנֵי דָ֔ן מְאַסֵּ֥ף לְ/כָל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֹ֖ת לְ/צִבְאֹתָ֑/ם וְ/עַל צְבָא֔/וֹ אֲחִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן עַמִּישַׁדָּֽי
verses.translit: vns' dgl mchnh bny dn m'sf lkhl hmchnt ltsb'tm v'l tsb'v 'chy'zr bn 'myshdy
verses.translation: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

verses.original: וְ/עַל צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֑ר פַּגְעִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן עָכְרָֽן
verses.translit: v'l tsb' mth bny 'shr pg'y'l bn 'khrn
verses.translation: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.

verses.original: וְ/עַ֨ל צְבָ֔א מַטֵּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֑י אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן עֵינָֽן
verses.translit: v'l tsb' mth bny nptly 'chyr' bn 'ynn
verses.translation: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה מַסְעֵ֥י בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/צִבְאֹתָ֑/ם וַ/יִּסָּֽעוּ
verses.translit: 'lh ms'y bny yshr'l ltsb'tm vys'v
verses.translation: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה לְ֠/חֹבָב בֶּן רְעוּאֵ֣ל הַ/מִּדְיָנִי֮ חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁה֒ נֹסְעִ֣ים אֲנַ֗חְנוּ אֶל הַ/מָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֹת֖/וֹ אֶתֵּ֣ן לָ/כֶ֑ם לְכָ֤/ה אִתָּ֨/נוּ֙ וְ/הֵטַ֣בְנוּ לָ֔/ךְ כִּֽי יְהוָ֥ה דִּבֶּר ט֖וֹב עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh lchbb bn r'v'l hmdyny chtn mshh ns'ym 'nchnv 'l hmqvm 'shr 'mr yhvh 'tv 'tn lkhm lkhh 'tnv vhtbnv lkh khy yhvh dbr tvb 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses’ father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the LORD said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֖י/ו לֹ֣א אֵלֵ֑ךְ כִּ֧י אִם אֶל אַרְצִ֛/י וְ/אֶל מוֹלַדְתִּ֖/י אֵלֵֽךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv l' 'lkh khy 'm 'l 'rtsy v'l mvldty 'lkh
verses.translation: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר אַל נָ֖א תַּעֲזֹ֣ב אֹתָ֑/נוּ כִּ֣י עַל כֵּ֣ן יָדַ֗עְתָּ חֲנֹתֵ֨/נוּ֙ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר וְ/הָיִ֥יתָ לָּ֖/נוּ לְ/עֵינָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l n' t'zb 'tnv khy 'l khn yd't chntnv bmdbr vhyyt lnv l'ynym
verses.translation: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֖ה כִּי תֵלֵ֣ךְ עִמָּ֑/נוּ וְ/הָיָ֣ה הַ/טּ֣וֹב הַ/ה֗וּא אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵיטִ֧יב יְהוָ֛ה עִמָּ֖/נוּ וְ/הֵטַ֥בְנוּ לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vhyh khy tlkh 'mnv vhyh htvb hhv' 'shr yytyb yhvh 'mnv vhtbnv lkh
verses.translation: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the LORD shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְעוּ֙ מֵ/הַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה דֶּ֖רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים וַ/אֲר֨וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֜ה נֹסֵ֣עַ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֗ם דֶּ֚רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֔ים לָ/ת֥וּר לָ/הֶ֖ם מְנוּחָֽה
verses.translit: vys'v mhr yhvh drkh shlsht ymym v'rvn bryt yhvh ns' lpnyhm drkh shlsht ymym ltvr lhm mnvchh
verses.translation: And they departed from the mount of the LORD three days’ journey: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them in the three days’ journey, to search out a resting place for them.

verses.original: וַ/עֲנַ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם יוֹמָ֑ם בְּ/נָסְעָ֖/ם מִן הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: v'nn yhvh 'lyhm yvmm bns'm mn hmchnh
verses.translation: And the cloud of the LORD was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֛י בִּ/נְסֹ֥עַ הָ/אָרֹ֖ן וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֑ה קוּמָ֣/ה יְהוָ֗ה וְ/יָפֻ֨צוּ֙ אֹֽיְבֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/יָנֻ֥סוּ מְשַׂנְאֶ֖י/ךָ מִ/פָּנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vyhy bns' h'rn vy'mr mshh qvmh yhvh vyptsv 'ybykh vynsv mshn'ykh mpnykh
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, LORD , and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/נֻחֹ֖/ה יֹאמַ֑ר שׁוּבָ֣/ה יְהוָ֔ה רִֽבְב֖וֹת אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vbnchh y'mr shvbh yhvh rbbvt 'lpy yshr'l
verses.translation: And when it rested, he said, Return, O LORD , unto the many thousands of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֤י הָ/עָם֙ כְּ/מִתְאֹ֣נְנִ֔ים רַ֖ע בְּ/אָזְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ וַ/יִּ֣חַר אַפּ֔/וֹ וַ/תִּבְעַר בָּ/ם֙ אֵ֣שׁ יְהוָ֔ה וַ/תֹּ֖אכַל בִּ/קְצֵ֥ה הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vyhy h'm khmt'nnym r' b'zny yhvh vyshm' yhvh vychr 'pv vtb'r bm 'sh yhvh vt'khl bqtsh hmchnh
verses.translation: And when the people complained, it displeased the LORD : and the LORD heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the LORD burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.

verses.original: וַ/יִּצְעַ֥ק הָ/עָ֖ם אֶל מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַ/יִּתְפַּלֵּ֤ל מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה וַ/תִּשְׁקַ֖ע הָ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vyts'q h'm 'l mshh vytpll mshh 'l yhvh vtshq' h'sh
verses.translation: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the LORD , the fire was quenched.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֛א שֵֽׁם הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא תַּבְעֵרָ֑ה כִּֽי בָעֲרָ֥ה בָ֖/ם אֵ֥שׁ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqr' shm hmqvm hhv' tb'rh khy b'rh bm 'sh yhvh
verses.translation: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the LORD burnt among them.

verses.original: וְ/הָֽ/אסַפְסֻף֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/קִרְבּ֔/וֹ הִתְאַוּ֖וּ תַּאֲוָ֑ה וַ/יָּשֻׁ֣בוּ וַ/יִּבְכּ֗וּ גַּ֚ם בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מִ֥י יַאֲכִלֵ֖/נוּ בָּשָֽׂר
verses.translit: vh'spsf 'shr bqrbv ht'vv t'vh vyshbv vybkhv gm bny yshr'l vy'mrv my y'khlnv bshr
verses.translation: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?

verses.original: זָכַ֨רְנוּ֙ אֶת הַ/דָּגָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר נֹאכַ֥ל בְּ/מִצְרַ֖יִם חִנָּ֑ם אֵ֣ת הַ/קִּשֻּׁאִ֗ים וְ/אֵת֙ הָֽ/אֲבַטִּחִ֔ים וְ/אֶת הֶ/חָצִ֥יר וְ/אֶת הַ/בְּצָלִ֖ים וְ/אֶת הַ/שּׁוּמִֽים
verses.translit: zkhrnv 't hdgh 'shr n'khl bmtsrym chnm 't hqsh'ym v't h'btchym v't hchtsyr v't hbtslym v't hshvmym
verses.translation: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֛ה נַפְשֵׁ֥/נוּ יְבֵשָׁ֖ה אֵ֣ין כֹּ֑ל בִּלְתִּ֖י אֶל הַ/מָּ֥ן עֵינֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: v'th npshnv ybshh 'yn khl blty 'l hmn 'ynynv
verses.translation: But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/מָּ֕ן כִּ/זְרַע גַּ֖ד ה֑וּא וְ/עֵינ֖/וֹ כְּ/עֵ֥ין הַ/בְּדֹֽלַח
verses.translit: vhmn khzr' gd hv' v'ynv kh'yn hbdlch
verses.translation: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.

verses.original: שָׁטוּ֩ הָ/עָ֨ם וְ/לָֽקְט֜וּ וְ/טָחֲנ֣וּ בָ/רֵחַ֗יִם א֤וֹ דָכוּ֙ בַּ/מְּדֹכָ֔ה וּ/בִשְּׁלוּ֙ בַּ/פָּר֔וּר וְ/עָשׂ֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ עֻג֑וֹת וְ/הָיָ֣ה טַעְמ֔/וֹ כְּ/טַ֖עַם לְשַׁ֥ד הַ/שָּֽׁמֶן
verses.translit: shtv h'm vlqtv vtchnv brchym 'v dkhv bmdkhh vbshlv bprvr v'shv 'tv 'gvt vhyh t'mv kht'm lshd hshmn
verses.translation: And the people went about, and gathered it , and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/רֶ֧דֶת הַ/טַּ֛ל עַל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה לָ֑יְלָה יֵרֵ֥ד הַ/מָּ֖ן עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vbrdt htl 'l hmchnh lylh yrd hmn 'lyv
verses.translation: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֨ע מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת הָ/עָ֗ם בֹּכֶה֙ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔י/ו אִ֖ישׁ לְ/פֶ֣תַח אָהֳל֑/וֹ וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ מְאֹ֔ד וּ/בְ/עֵינֵ֥י מֹשֶׁ֖ה רָֽע
verses.translit: vyshm' mshh 't h'm bkhh lmshpchtyv 'ysh lptch 'hlv vychr 'f yhvh m'd vb'yny mshh r'
verses.translation: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל יְהוָ֗ה לָ/מָ֤ה הֲרֵעֹ֨תָ֙ לְ/עַבְדֶּ֔/ךָ וְ/לָ֛/מָּה לֹא מָצָ֥תִי חֵ֖ן בְּ/עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ לָ/שׂ֗וּם אֶת מַשָּׂ֛א כָּל הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּ֖ה עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l yhvh lmh hr't l'bdkh vlmh l' mtsty chn b'ynykh lshvm 't msh' khl h'm hzh 'ly
verses.translation: And Moses said unto the LORD , Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?

verses.original: הֶ/אָנֹכִ֣י הָרִ֗יתִי אֵ֚ת כָּל הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה אִם אָנֹכִ֖י יְלִדְתִּ֑י/הוּ כִּֽי תֹאמַ֨ר אֵלַ֜/י שָׂאֵ֣/הוּ בְ/חֵיקֶ֗/ךָ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשָּׂ֤א הָ/אֹמֵן֙ אֶת הַ/יֹּנֵ֔ק עַ֚ל הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖עְתָּ לַ/אֲבֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: h'nkhy hryty 't khl h'm hzh 'm 'nkhy yldtyhv khy t'mr 'ly sh'hv bchyqkh kh'shr ysh' h'mn 't hynq 'l h'dmh 'shr nshb't l'btyv
verses.translation: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?

verses.original: מֵ/אַ֤יִן לִ/י֙ בָּשָׂ֔ר לָ/תֵ֖ת לְ/כָל הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֑ה כִּֽי יִבְכּ֤וּ עָלַ/י֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר תְּנָ/ה לָּ֥/נוּ בָשָׂ֖ר וְ/נֹאכֵֽלָה
verses.translit: m'yn ly bshr ltt lkhl h'm hzh khy ybkhv 'ly l'mr tnh lnv bshr vn'khlh
verses.translation: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.

verses.original: לֹֽא אוּכַ֤ל אָנֹכִי֙ לְ/בַדִּ֔/י לָ/שֵׂ֖את אֶת כָּל הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֑ה כִּ֥י כָבֵ֖ד מִמֶּֽ/נִּי
verses.translit: l' 'vkhl 'nkhy lbdy lsh't 't khl h'm hzh khy khbd mmny
verses.translation: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

verses.original: וְ/אִם כָּ֣כָה אַתְּ עֹ֣שֶׂה לִּ֗/י הָרְגֵ֤/נִי נָא֙ הָרֹ֔ג אִם מָצָ֥אתִי חֵ֖ן בְּ/עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/אַל אֶרְאֶ֖ה בְּ/רָעָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: v'm khkhh 't 'shh ly hrgny n' hrg 'm mts'ty chn b'ynykh v'l 'r'h br'ty
verses.translation: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶסְפָ/ה לִּ֞/י שִׁבְעִ֣ים אִישׁ֮ מִ/זִּקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָדַ֔עְתָּ כִּי הֵ֛ם זִקְנֵ֥י הָ/עָ֖ם וְ/שֹׁטְרָ֑י/ו וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֤ אֹתָ/ם֙ אֶל אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְ/הִֽתְיַצְּב֥וּ שָׁ֖ם עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh 'sph ly shb'ym 'ysh mzqny yshr'l 'shr yd't khy hm zqny h'm vshtryv vlqcht 'tm 'l 'hl mv'd vhtytsbv shm 'mkh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.

verses.original: וְ/יָרַדְתִּ֗י וְ/דִבַּרְתִּ֣י עִמְּ/ךָ֮ שָׁם֒ וְ/אָצַלְתִּ֗י מִן הָ/ר֛וּחַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָלֶ֖י/ךָ וְ/שַׂמְתִּ֣י עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/נָשְׂא֤וּ אִתְּ/ךָ֙ בְּ/מַשָּׂ֣א הָ/עָ֔ם וְ/לֹא תִשָּׂ֥א אַתָּ֖ה לְ/בַדֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vyrdty vdbrty 'mkh shm v'tslty mn hrvch 'shr 'lykh vshmty 'lyhm vnsh'v 'tkh bmsh' h'm vl' tsh' 'th lbdkh
verses.translation: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל הָ/עָ֨ם תֹּאמַ֜ר הִתְקַדְּשׁ֣וּ לְ/מָחָר֮ וַ/אֲכַלְתֶּ֣ם בָּשָׂר֒ כִּ֡י בְּכִיתֶם֩ בְּ/אָזְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֜ה לֵ/אמֹ֗ר מִ֤י יַאֲכִלֵ֨/נוּ֙ בָּשָׂ֔ר כִּי ט֥וֹב לָ֖/נוּ בְּ/מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֥ה לָ/כֶ֛ם בָּשָׂ֖ר וַ/אֲכַלְתֶּֽם
verses.translit: v'l h'm t'mr htqdshv lmchr v'khltm bshr khy bkhytm b'zny yhvh l'mr my y'khlnv bshr khy tvb lnv bmtsrym vntn yhvh lkhm bshr v'khltm
verses.translation: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the LORD , saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore the LORD will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.

verses.original: לֹ֣א י֥וֹם אֶחָ֛ד תֹּאכְל֖וּ/ן וְ/לֹ֣א יוֹמָ֑יִם וְ/לֹ֣א חֲמִשָּׁ֣ה יָמִ֗ים וְ/לֹא֙ עֲשָׂרָ֣ה יָמִ֔ים וְ/לֹ֖א עֶשְׂרִ֥ים יֽוֹם
verses.translit: l' yvm 'chd t'khlvn vl' yvmym vl' chmshh ymym vl' 'shrh ymym vl' 'shrym yvm
verses.translation: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;

verses.original: עַ֣ד חֹ֣דֶשׁ יָמִ֗ים עַ֤ד אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא֙ מֵֽ/אַפְּ/כֶ֔ם וְ/הָיָ֥ה לָ/כֶ֖ם לְ/זָרָ֑א יַ֗עַן כִּֽי מְאַסְתֶּ֤ם אֶת יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/קִרְבְּ/כֶ֔ם וַ/תִּבְכּ֤וּ לְ/פָנָי/ו֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לָ֥/מָּה זֶּ֖ה יָצָ֥אנוּ מִ/מִּצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: 'd chdsh ymym 'd 'shr yts' m'pkhm vhyh lkhm lzr' y'n khy m'stm 't yhvh 'shr bqrbkhm vtbkhv lpnyv l'mr lmh zh yts'nv mmtsrym
verses.translation: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the LORD which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֮ מֹשֶׁה֒ שֵׁשׁ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֨לֶף֙ רַגְלִ֔י הָ/עָ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י בְּ/קִרְבּ֑/וֹ וְ/אַתָּ֣ה אָמַ֗רְתָּ בָּשָׂר֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן לָ/הֶ֔ם וְ/אָכְל֖וּ חֹ֥דֶשׁ יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh shsh m'vt 'lf rgly h'm 'shr 'nkhy bqrbv v'th 'mrt bshr 'tn lhm v'khlv chdsh ymym
verses.translation: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am , are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.

verses.original: הֲ/צֹ֧אן וּ/בָקָ֛ר יִשָּׁחֵ֥ט לָ/הֶ֖ם וּ/מָצָ֣א לָ/הֶ֑ם אִ֣ם אֶֽת כָּל דְּגֵ֥י הַ/יָּ֛ם יֵאָסֵ֥ף לָ/הֶ֖ם וּ/מָצָ֥א לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: hts'n vbqr yshcht lhm vmts' lhm 'm 't khl dgy hym y'sf lhm vmts' lhm
verses.translation: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה הֲ/יַ֥ד יְהוָ֖ה תִּקְצָ֑ר עַתָּ֥ה תִרְאֶ֛ה הֲ/יִקְרְ/ךָ֥ דְבָרִ֖/י אִם לֹֽא
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh hyd yhvh tqtsr 'th tr'h hyqrkh dbry 'm l'
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD’s hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַ/יְדַבֵּר֙ אֶל הָ/עָ֔ם אֵ֖ת דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יֶּאֱסֹ֞ף שִׁבְעִ֥ים אִישׁ֙ מִ/זִּקְנֵ֣י הָ/עָ֔ם וַֽ/יַּעֲמֵ֥ד אֹתָ֖/ם סְבִיבֹ֥ת הָ/אֹֽהֶל
verses.translit: vyts' mshh vydbr 'l h'm 't dbry yhvh vy'sf shb'ym 'ysh mzqny h'm vy'md 'tm sbybt h'hl
verses.translation: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the LORD , and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨רֶד יְהוָ֥ה בֶּ/עָנָן֮ וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָי/ו֒ וַ/יָּ֗אצֶל מִן הָ/ר֨וּחַ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֔י/ו וַ/יִּתֵּ֕ן עַל שִׁבְעִ֥ים אִ֖ישׁ הַ/זְּקֵנִ֑ים וַ/יְהִ֗י כְּ/נ֤וֹחַ עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ הָ/ר֔וּחַ וַ/יִּֽתְנַבְּא֖וּ וְ/לֹ֥א יָסָֽפוּ
verses.translit: vyrd yhvh b'nn vydbr 'lyv vy'tsl mn hrvch 'shr 'lyv vytn 'l shb'ym 'ysh hzqnym vyhy khnvch 'lyhm hrvch vytnb'v vl' yspv
verses.translation: And the LORD came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that , when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׁאֲר֣וּ שְׁנֵֽי אֲנָשִׁ֣ים בַּֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֡ה שֵׁ֣ם הָ/אֶחָ֣ד אֶלְדָּ֡ד וְ/שֵׁם֩ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֨י מֵידָ֜ד וַ/תָּ֧נַח עֲלֵי/הֶ֣ם הָ/ר֗וּחַ וְ/הֵ֨מָּה֙ בַּ/כְּתֻבִ֔ים וְ/לֹ֥א יָצְא֖וּ הָ/אֹ֑הֱלָ/ה וַ/יִּֽתְנַבְּא֖וּ בַּֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vysh'rv shny 'nshym bmchnh shm h'chd 'ldd vshm hshny mydd vtnch 'lyhm hrvch vhmh bkhtbym vl' yts'v h'hlh vytnb'v bmchnh
verses.translation: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣רָץ הַ/נַּ֔עַר וַ/יַּגֵּ֥ד לְ/מֹשֶׁ֖ה וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר אֶלְדָּ֣ד וּ/מֵידָ֔ד מִֽתְנַבְּאִ֖ים בַּֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vyrts hn'r vygd lmshh vy'mr 'ldd vmydd mtnb'ym bmchnh
verses.translation: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֜עַן יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן נ֗וּן מְשָׁרֵ֥ת מֹשֶׁ֛ה מִ/בְּחֻרָ֖י/ו וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר אֲדֹנִ֥/י מֹשֶׁ֖ה כְּלָאֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'n yhvsh' bn nvn mshrt mshh mbchryv vy'mr 'dny mshh khl'm
verses.translation: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה הַֽ/מְקַנֵּ֥א אַתָּ֖ה לִ֑/י וּ/מִ֨י יִתֵּ֜ן כָּל עַ֤ם יְהוָה֙ נְבִיאִ֔ים כִּי יִתֵּ֧ן יְהוָ֛ה אֶת רוּח֖/וֹ עֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr lv mshh hmqn' 'th ly vmy ytn khl 'm yhvh nby'ym khy ytn yhvh 't rvchv 'lyhm
verses.translation: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the LORD’s people were prophets, and that the LORD would put his spirit upon them!

verses.original: וַ/יֵּאָסֵ֥ף מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה ה֖וּא וְ/זִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'sf mshh 'l hmchnh hv' vzqny yshr'l
verses.translation: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/ר֜וּחַ נָסַ֣ע מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה וַ/יָּ֣גָז שַׂלְוִים֮ מִן הַ/יָּם֒ וַ/יִּטֹּ֨שׁ עַל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֜ה כְּ/דֶ֧רֶךְ י֣וֹם כֹּ֗ה וּ/כְ/דֶ֤רֶךְ יוֹם֙ כֹּ֔ה סְבִיב֖וֹת הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה וּ/כְ/אַמָּתַ֖יִם עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vrvch ns' m't yhvh vygz shlvym mn hym vytsh 'l hmchnh khdrkh yvm khh vkhdrkh yvm khh sbybvt hmchnh vkh'mtym 'l pny h'rts
verses.translation: And there went forth a wind from the LORD , and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day’s journey on this side, and as it were a day’s journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם הָ/עָ֡ם כָּל הַ/יּוֹם֩ הַ/ה֨וּא וְ/כָל הַ/לַּ֜יְלָה וְ/כֹ֣ל י֣וֹם הַֽ/מָּחֳרָ֗ת וַ/יַּֽאַסְפוּ֙ אֶת הַ/שְּׂלָ֔ו הַ/מַּמְעִ֕יט אָסַ֖ף עֲשָׂרָ֣ה חֳמָרִ֑ים וַ/יִּשְׁטְח֤וּ לָ/הֶם֙ שָׁט֔וֹחַ סְבִיב֖וֹת הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vyqm h'm khl hyvm hhv' vkhl hlylh vkhl yvm hmchrt vy'spv 't hshlv hmm'yt 'sf 'shrh chmrym vyshtchv lhm shtvch sbybvt hmchnh
verses.translation: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.

verses.original: הַ/בָּשָׂ֗ר עוֹדֶ֨/נּוּ֙ בֵּ֣ין שִׁנֵּי/הֶ֔ם טֶ֖רֶם יִכָּרֵ֑ת וְ/אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ חָרָ֣ה בָ/עָ֔ם וַ/יַּ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ בָּ/עָ֔ם מַכָּ֖ה רַבָּ֥ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: hbshr 'vdnv byn shnyhm trm ykhrt v'f yhvh chrh b'm vykh yhvh b'm mkhh rbh m'd
verses.translation: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the LORD was kindled against the people, and the LORD smote the people with a very great plague.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֛א אֶת שֵֽׁם הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/ה֖וּא קִבְר֣וֹת הַֽתַּאֲוָ֑ה כִּי שָׁם֙ קָֽבְר֔וּ אֶת הָ/עָ֖ם הַ/מִּתְאַוִּֽים
verses.translit: vyqr' 't shm hmqvm hhv' qbrvt ht'vh khy shm qbrv 't h'm hmt'vym
verses.translation: And he called the name of that place Kibroth-hattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.

verses.original: מִ/קִּבְר֧וֹת הַֽתַּאֲוָ֛ה נָסְע֥וּ הָ/עָ֖ם חֲצֵר֑וֹת וַ/יִּהְי֖וּ בַּ/חֲצֵרֽוֹת
verses.translit: mqbrvt ht'vh ns'v h'm chtsrvt vyhyv bchtsrvt
verses.translation: And the people journeyed from Kibroth-hattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.

verses.original: וַ/תְּדַבֵּ֨ר מִרְיָ֤ם וְ/אַהֲרֹן֙ בְּ/מֹשֶׁ֔ה עַל אֹד֛וֹת הָ/אִשָּׁ֥ה הַ/כֻּשִׁ֖ית אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָקָ֑ח כִּֽי אִשָּׁ֥ה כֻשִׁ֖ית לָקָֽח
verses.translit: vtdbr mrym v'hrn bmshh 'l 'dvt h'shh hkhshyt 'shr lqch khy 'shh khshyt lqch
verses.translation: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ הֲ/רַ֤ק אַךְ בְּ/מֹשֶׁה֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הֲ/לֹ֖א גַּם בָּ֣/נוּ דִבֵּ֑ר וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֖ע יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mrv hrq 'kh bmshh dbr yhvh hl' gm bnv dbr vyshm' yhvh
verses.translation: And they said, Hath the LORD indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the LORD heard it .

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אִ֥ישׁ מֹשֶׁ֖ה ענו עָנָ֣יו מְאֹ֑ד מִ/כֹּל֙ הָֽ/אָדָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: vh'ysh mshh 'nv 'nyv m'd mkhl h'dm 'shr 'l pny h'dmh
verses.translation: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה פִּתְאֹ֗ם אֶל מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְ/אֶֽל אַהֲרֹן֙ וְ/אֶל מִרְיָ֔ם צְא֥וּ שְׁלָשְׁתְּ/כֶ֖ם אֶל אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַ/יֵּצְא֖וּ שְׁלָשְׁתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh pt'm 'l mshh v'l 'hrn v'l mrym ts'v shlshtkhm 'l 'hl mv'd vyts'v shlshtm
verses.translation: And the LORD spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֤רֶד יְהוָה֙ בְּ/עַמּ֣וּד עָנָ֔ן וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹ֖ד פֶּ֣תַח הָ/אֹ֑הֶל וַ/יִּקְרָא֙ אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּ/מִרְיָ֔ם וַ/יֵּצְא֖וּ שְׁנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyrd yhvh b'mvd 'nn vy'md ptch h'hl vyqr' 'hrn vmrym vyts'v shnyhm
verses.translation: And the LORD came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר שִׁמְעוּ נָ֣א דְבָרָ֑/י אִם יִֽהְיֶה֙ נְבִ֣יאֲ/כֶ֔ם יְהוָ֗ה בַּ/מַּרְאָה֙ אֵלָ֣י/ו אֶתְוַדָּ֔ע בַּ/חֲל֖וֹם אֲדַבֶּר בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr shm'v n' dbry 'm yhyh nby'khm yhvh bmr'h 'lyv 'tvd' bchlvm 'dbr bv
verses.translation: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the LORD will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.

verses.original: לֹא כֵ֖ן עַבְדִּ֣/י מֹשֶׁ֑ה בְּ/כָל בֵּיתִ֖/י נֶאֱמָ֥ן הֽוּא
verses.translit: l' khn 'bdy mshh bkhl byty n'mn hv'
verses.translation: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.
