verses.original: פֶּ֣ה אֶל פֶּ֞ה אֲדַבֶּר בּ֗/וֹ וּ/מַרְאֶה֙ וְ/לֹ֣א בְ/חִידֹ֔ת וּ/תְמֻנַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה יַבִּ֑יט וּ/מַדּ֨וּעַ֙ לֹ֣א יְרֵאתֶ֔ם לְ/דַבֵּ֖ר בְּ/עַבְדִּ֥/י בְ/מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: ph 'l ph 'dbr bv vmr'h vl' bchydt vtmnt yhvh ybyt vmdv' l' yr'tm ldbr b'bdy bmshh
verses.translation: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the LORD shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֧ף יְהוָ֛ה בָּ֖/ם וַ/יֵּלַֽךְ
verses.translit: vychr 'f yhvh bm vylkh
verses.translation: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against them; and he departed.

verses.original: וְ/הֶ/עָנָ֗ן סָ֚ר מֵ/עַ֣ל הָ/אֹ֔הֶל וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה מִרְיָ֖ם מְצֹרַ֣עַת כַּ/שָּׁ֑לֶג וַ/יִּ֧פֶן אַהֲרֹ֛ן אֶל מִרְיָ֖ם וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה מְצֹרָֽעַת
verses.translit: vh'nn sr m'l h'hl vhnh mrym mtsr't khshlg vypn 'hrn 'l mrym vhnh mtsr't
verses.translation: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֶל מֹשֶׁ֑ה בִּ֣י אֲדֹנִ֔/י אַל נָ֨א תָשֵׁ֤ת עָלֵ֨י/נוּ֙ חַטָּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֥ר נוֹאַ֖לְנוּ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָֽאנוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'hrn 'l mshh by 'dny 'l n' tsht 'lynv cht't 'shr nv'lnv v'shr cht'nv
verses.translation: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.

verses.original: אַל נָ֥א תְהִ֖י כַּ/מֵּ֑ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּ/צֵאת/וֹ֙ מֵ/רֶ֣חֶם אִמּ֔/וֹ וַ/יֵּאָכֵ֖ל חֲצִ֥י בְשָׂרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'l n' thy khmt 'shr bts'tv mrchm 'mv vy'khl chtsy bshrv
verses.translation: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother’s womb.

verses.original: וַ/יִּצְעַ֣ק מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אֵ֕ל נָ֛א רְפָ֥א נָ֖א לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyts'q mshh 'l yhvh l'mr 'l n' rp' n' lh
verses.translation: And Moses cried unto the LORD , saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה וְ/אָבִ֨י/הָ֙ יָרֹ֤ק יָרַק֙ בְּ/פָנֶ֔י/הָ הֲ/לֹ֥א תִכָּלֵ֖ם שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים תִּסָּגֵ֞ר שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ מִ/ח֣וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְ/אַחַ֖ר תֵּאָסֵֽף
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh v'byh yrq yrq bpnyh hl' tkhlm shb't ymym tsgr shb't ymym mchvts lmchnh v'chr t'sf
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again .

verses.original: וַ/תִּסָּגֵ֥ר מִרְיָ֛ם מִ/ח֥וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְ/הָ/עָם֙ לֹ֣א נָסַ֔ע עַד הֵאָסֵ֖ף מִרְיָֽם
verses.translit: vtsgr mrym mchvts lmchnh shb't ymym vh'm l' ns' 'd h'sf mrym
verses.translation: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again .

verses.original: וְ/אַחַ֛ר נָסְע֥וּ הָ/עָ֖ם מֵ/חֲצֵר֑וֹת וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/מִדְבַּ֥ר פָּארָֽן
verses.translit: v'chr ns'v h'm mchtsrvt vychnv bmdbr p'rn
verses.translation: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: שְׁלַח לְ/ךָ֣ אֲנָשִׁ֗ים וְ/יָתֻ֨רוּ֙ אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן אֲשֶׁר אֲנִ֥י נֹתֵ֖ן לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִ֣ישׁ אֶחָד֩ אִ֨ישׁ אֶחָ֜ד לְ/מַטֵּ֤ה אֲבֹתָי/ו֙ תִּשְׁלָ֔חוּ כֹּ֖ל נָשִׂ֥יא בָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: shlch lkh 'nshym vytrv 't 'rts khn'n 'shr 'ny ntn lbny yshr'l 'ysh 'chd 'ysh 'chd lmth 'btyv tshlchv khl nshy' bhm
verses.translation: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח אֹתָ֥/ם מֹשֶׁ֛ה מִ/מִּדְבַּ֥ר פָּארָ֖ן עַל פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כֻּלָּ֣/ם אֲנָשִׁ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֥י בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽמָּה
verses.translit: vyshlch 'tm mshh mmdbr p'rn 'l py yhvh khlm 'nshym r'shy bny yshr'l hmh
verses.translation: And Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֖לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֑/ם לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֔ן שַׁמּ֖וּעַ בֶּן זַכּֽוּר
verses.translit: v'lh shmvtm lmth r'vbn shmv' bn zkhvr
verses.translation: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

verses.original: לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה שִׁמְע֔וֹן שָׁפָ֖ט בֶּן חוֹרִֽי
verses.translit: lmth shm'vn shpt bn chvry
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

verses.original: לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה יְהוּדָ֔ה כָּלֵ֖ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּֽה
verses.translit: lmth yhvdh khlb bn ypnh
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

verses.original: לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר יִגְאָ֖ל בֶּן יוֹסֵֽף
verses.translit: lmth yshshkhr yg'l bn yvsf
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

verses.original: לְ/מַטֵּ֥ה אֶפְרָ֖יִם הוֹשֵׁ֥עַ בִּן נֽוּן
verses.translit: lmth 'prym hvsh' bn nvn
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.

verses.original: לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֔ן פַּלְטִ֖י בֶּן רָפֽוּא
verses.translit: lmth bnymn plty bn rpv'
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

verses.original: לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֔ן גַּדִּיאֵ֖ל בֶּן סוֹדִֽי
verses.translit: lmth zbvln gdy'l bn svdy
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

verses.original: לְ/מַטֵּ֥ה יוֹסֵ֖ף לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה גַּדִּ֖י בֶּן סוּסִֽי
verses.translit: lmth yvsf lmth mnshh gdy bn svsy
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely , of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

verses.original: לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה דָ֔ן עַמִּיאֵ֖ל בֶּן גְּמַלִּֽי
verses.translit: lmth dn 'my'l bn gmly
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

verses.original: לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֔ר סְת֖וּר בֶּן מִיכָאֵֽל
verses.translit: lmth 'shr stvr bn mykh'l
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

verses.original: לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֔י נַחְבִּ֖י בֶּן וָפְסִֽי
verses.translit: lmth nptly nchby bn vpsy
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

verses.original: לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה גָ֔ד גְּאוּאֵ֖ל בֶּן מָכִֽי
verses.translit: lmth gd g'v'l bn mkhy
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֖ה לָ/ת֣וּר אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א מֹשֶׁ֛ה לְ/הוֹשֵׁ֥עַ בִּן נ֖וּן יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ
verses.translit: 'lh shmvt h'nshym 'shr shlch mshh ltvr 't h'rts vyqr' mshh lhvsh' bn nvn yhvsh'
verses.translation: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח אֹתָ/ם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה לָ/ת֖וּר אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם עֲל֥וּ זֶה֙ בַּ/נֶּ֔גֶב וַ/עֲלִיתֶ֖ם אֶת הָ/הָֽר
verses.translit: vyshlch 'tm mshh ltvr 't 'rts khn'n vy'mr 'lhm 'lv zh bngb v'lytm 't hhr
verses.translation: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:

verses.original: וּ/רְאִיתֶ֥ם אֶת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ מַה הִ֑וא וְ/אֶת הָ/עָם֙ הַ/יֹּשֵׁ֣ב עָלֶ֔י/הָ הֶ/חָזָ֥ק הוּא֙ הֲ/רָפֶ֔ה הַ/מְעַ֥ט ה֖וּא אִם רָֽב
verses.translit: vr'ytm 't h'rts mh hv' v't h'm hyshb 'lyh hchzq hv' hrph hm't hv' 'm rb
verses.translation: And see the land, what it is; and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;

verses.original: וּ/מָ֣ה הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁר הוּא֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּ֔/הּ הֲ/טוֹבָ֥ה הִ֖וא אִם רָעָ֑ה וּ/מָ֣ה הֶֽ/עָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר הוּא֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּ/הֵ֔נָּה הַ/בְּ/מַֽחֲנִ֖ים אִ֥ם בְּ/מִבְצָרִֽים
verses.translit: vmh h'rts 'shr hv' yshb bh htvbh hv' 'm r'h vmh h'rym 'shr hv' yvshb bhnh hbmchnym 'm bmbtsrym
verses.translation: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;

verses.original: וּ/מָ֣ה הָ֠/אָרֶץ הַ/שְּׁמֵנָ֨ה הִ֜וא אִם רָזָ֗ה הֲ/יֵֽשׁ בָּ֥/הּ עֵץ֙ אִם אַ֔יִן וְ/הִ֨תְחַזַּקְתֶּ֔ם וּ/לְקַחְתֶּ֖ם מִ/פְּרִ֣י הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/הַ֨/יָּמִ֔ים יְמֵ֖י בִּכּוּרֵ֥י עֲנָבִֽים
verses.translit: vmh h'rts hshmnh hv' 'm rzh hysh bh 'ts 'm 'yn vhtchzqtm vlqchtm mpry h'rts vhymym ymy bkhvry 'nbym
verses.translation: And what the land is , whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲל֖וּ וַ/יָּתֻ֣רוּ אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ מִ/מִּדְבַּר צִ֥ן עַד רְחֹ֖ב לְבֹ֥א חֲמָֽת
verses.translit: vy'lv vytrv 't h'rts mmdbr tsn 'd rchb lb' chmt
verses.translation: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲל֣וּ בַ/נֶּגֶב֮ וַ/יָּבֹ֣א עַד חֶבְרוֹן֒ וְ/שָׁ֤ם אֲחִימַן֙ שֵׁשַׁ֣י וְ/תַלְמַ֔י יְלִידֵ֖י הָ/עֲנָ֑ק וְ/חֶבְר֗וֹן שֶׁ֤בַע שָׁנִים֙ נִבְנְתָ֔ה לִ/פְנֵ֖י צֹ֥עַן מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vy'lv bngb vyb' 'd chbrvn vshm 'chymn shshy vtlmy ylydy h'nq vchbrvn shb' shnym nbnth lpny ts'n mtsrym
verses.translation: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were . (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֜אוּ עַד נַ֣חַל אֶשְׁכֹּ֗ל וַ/יִּכְרְת֨וּ מִ/שָּׁ֤ם זְמוֹרָה֙ וְ/אֶשְׁכּ֤וֹל עֲנָבִים֙ אֶחָ֔ד וַ/יִּשָּׂאֻ֥/הוּ בַ/מּ֖וֹט בִּ/שְׁנָ֑יִם וּ/מִן הָ/רִמֹּנִ֖ים וּ/מִן הַ/תְּאֵנִֽים
verses.translit: vyb'v 'd nchl 'shkhl vykhrtv mshm zmvrh v'shkhvl 'nbym 'chd vysh'hv bmvt bshnym vmn hrmnym vmn ht'nym
verses.translation: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.

verses.original: לַ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא קָרָ֖א נַ֣חַל אֶשְׁכּ֑וֹל עַ֚ל אֹד֣וֹת הָֽ/אֶשְׁכּ֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר כָּרְת֥וּ מִ/שָּׁ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: lmqvm hhv' qr' nchl 'shkhvl 'l 'dvt h'shkhvl 'shr khrtv mshm bny yshr'l
verses.translation: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.

verses.original: וַ/יָּשֻׁ֖בוּ מִ/תּ֣וּר הָ/אָ֑רֶץ מִ/קֵּ֖ץ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יֽוֹם
verses.translit: vyshbv mtvr h'rts mqts 'rb'ym yvm
verses.translation: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּלְכ֡וּ וַ/יָּבֹאוּ֩ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֨ה וְ/אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְ/אֶל כָּל עֲדַ֧ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל מִדְבַּ֥ר פָּארָ֖ן קָדֵ֑שָׁ/ה וַ/יָּשִׁ֨יבוּ אוֹתָ֤/ם דָּבָר֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל הָ֣/עֵדָ֔ה וַ/יַּרְא֖וּ/ם אֶת פְּרִ֥י הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vylkhv vyb'v 'l mshh v'l 'hrn v'l khl 'dt bny yshr'l 'l mdbr p'rn qdshh vyshybv 'vtm dbr v't khl h'dh vyr'vm 't pry h'rts
verses.translation: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.

verses.original: וַ/יְסַפְּרוּ ל/וֹ֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ בָּ֕אנוּ אֶל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁלַחְתָּ֑/נוּ וְ֠/גַם זָבַ֨ת חָלָ֥ב וּ/דְבַ֛שׁ הִ֖וא וְ/זֶה פִּרְיָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vysprv lv vy'mrv b'nv 'l h'rts 'shr shlchtnv vgm zbt chlb vdbsh hv' vzh pryh
verses.translation: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.

verses.original: אֶ֚פֶס כִּֽי עַ֣ז הָ/עָ֔ם הַ/יֹּשֵׁ֖ב בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/הֶֽ/עָרִ֗ים בְּצֻר֤וֹת גְּדֹלֹת֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְ/גַם יְלִדֵ֥י הָֽ/עֲנָ֖ק רָאִ֥ינוּ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: 'ps khy 'z h'm hyshb b'rts vh'rym btsrvt gdlt m'd vgm yldy h'nq r'ynv shm
verses.translation: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.

verses.original: עֲמָלֵ֥ק יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ הַ/נֶּ֑גֶב וְ֠/הַֽ/חִתִּי וְ/הַ/יְבוּסִ֤י וְ/הָֽ/אֱמֹרִי֙ יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּ/הָ֔ר וְ/הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִי֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב עַל הַ/יָּ֔ם וְ/עַ֖ל יַ֥ד הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: 'mlq yvshb b'rts hngb vhchty vhybvsy vh'mry yvshb bhr vhkhn'ny yshb 'l hym v'l yd hyrdn
verses.translation: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֧הַס כָּלֵ֛ב אֶת הָ/עָ֖ם אֶל מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֗אמֶר עָלֹ֤ה נַעֲלֶה֙ וְ/יָרַ֣שְׁנוּ אֹתָ֔/הּ כִּֽי יָכ֥וֹל נוּכַ֖ל לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vyhs khlb 't h'm 'l mshh vy'mr 'lh n'lh vyrshnv 'th khy ykhvl nvkhl lh
verses.translation: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.

verses.original: וְ/הָ֨/אֲנָשִׁ֜ים אֲשֶׁר עָל֤וּ עִמּ/וֹ֙ אָֽמְר֔וּ לֹ֥א נוּכַ֖ל לַ/עֲל֣וֹת אֶל הָ/עָ֑ם כִּֽי חָזָ֥ק ה֖וּא מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: vh'nshym 'shr 'lv 'mv 'mrv l' nvkhl l'lvt 'l h'm khy chzq hv' mmnv
verses.translation: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.

verses.original: וַ/יּוֹצִ֜יאוּ דִּבַּ֤ת הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּר֣וּ אֹתָ֔/הּ אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הָ/אָ֡רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ עָבַ֨רְנוּ בָ֜/הּ לָ/ת֣וּר אֹתָ֗/הּ אֶ֣רֶץ אֹכֶ֤לֶת יוֹשְׁבֶ֨י/הָ֙ הִ֔וא וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֛ם אֲשֶׁר רָאִ֥ינוּ בְ/תוֹכָ֖/הּ אַנְשֵׁ֥י מִדּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyvtsy'v dbt h'rts 'shr trv 'th 'l bny yshr'l l'mr h'rts 'shr 'brnv bh ltvr 'th 'rts 'khlt yvshbyh hv' vkhl h'm 'shr r'ynv btvkhh 'nshy mdvt
verses.translation: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁ֣ם רָאִ֗ינוּ אֶת הַ/נְּפִילִ֛ים בְּנֵ֥י עֲנָ֖ק מִן הַ/נְּפִלִ֑ים וַ/נְּהִ֤י בְ/עֵינֵ֨י/נוּ֙ כַּֽ/חֲגָבִ֔ים וְ/כֵ֥ן הָיִ֖ינוּ בְּ/עֵינֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vshm r'ynv 't hnpylym bny 'nq mn hnplym vnhy b'ynynv khchgbym vkhn hyynv b'ynyhm
verses.translation: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.

verses.original: וַ/תִּשָּׂא֙ כָּל הָ֣/עֵדָ֔ה וַֽ/יִּתְּנ֖וּ אֶת קוֹלָ֑/ם וַ/יִּבְכּ֥וּ הָ/עָ֖ם בַּ/לַּ֥יְלָה הַ/הֽוּא
verses.translit: vtsh' khl h'dh vytnv 't qvlm vybkhv h'm blylh hhv'
verses.translation: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

verses.original: וַ/יִּלֹּ֨נוּ֙ עַל מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְ/עַֽל אַהֲרֹ֔ן כֹּ֖ל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽ/יֹּאמְר֨וּ אֲלֵ/הֶ֜ם כָּל הָ/עֵדָ֗ה לוּ מַ֨תְנוּ֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם א֛וֹ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֥ר הַ/זֶּ֖ה לוּ מָֽתְנוּ
verses.translit: vylnv 'l mshh v'l 'hrn khl bny yshr'l vy'mrv 'lhm khl h'dh lv mtnv b'rts mtsrym 'v bmdbr hzh lv mtnv
verses.translation: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!

verses.original: וְ/לָ/מָ֣ה יְ֠הוָה מֵבִ֨יא אֹתָ֜/נוּ אֶל הָ/אָ֤רֶץ הַ/זֹּאת֙ לִ/נְפֹּ֣ל בַּ/חֶ֔רֶב נָשֵׁ֥י/נוּ וְ/טַפֵּ֖/נוּ יִהְי֣וּ לָ/בַ֑ז הֲ/ל֧וֹא ט֦וֹב לָ֖/נוּ שׁ֥וּב מִצְרָֽיְמָ/ה
verses.translit: vlmh yhvh mby' 'tnv 'l h'rts hz't lnpl bchrb nshynv vtpnv yhyv lbz hlv' tvb lnv shvb mtsrymh
verses.translation: And wherefore hath the LORD brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל אָחִ֑י/ו נִתְּנָ֥ה רֹ֖אשׁ וְ/נָשׁ֥וּבָה מִצְרָֽיְמָ/ה
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'ysh 'l 'chyv ntnh r'sh vnshvbh mtsrymh
verses.translation: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפֹּ֥ל מֹשֶׁ֛ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֖ן עַל פְּנֵי/הֶ֑ם לִ/פְנֵ֕י כָּל קְהַ֥ל עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vypl mshh v'hrn 'l pnyhm lpny khl qhl 'dt bny yshr'l
verses.translation: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

verses.original: וִ/יהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן נ֗וּן וְ/כָלֵב֙ בֶּן יְפֻנֶּ֔ה מִן הַ/תָּרִ֖ים אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ קָרְע֖וּ בִּגְדֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyhvsh' bn nvn vkhlb bn ypnh mn htrym 't h'rts qr'v bgdyhm
verses.translation: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֶל כָּל עֲדַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָבַ֤רְנוּ בָ/הּ֙ לָ/ת֣וּר אֹתָ֔/הּ טוֹבָ֥ה הָ/אָ֖רֶץ מְאֹ֥ד מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'l khl 'dt bny yshr'l l'mr h'rts 'shr 'brnv bh ltvr 'th tvbh h'rts m'd m'd
verses.translation: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.

verses.original: אִם חָפֵ֥ץ בָּ֨/נוּ֙ יְהוָ֔ה וְ/הֵבִ֤יא אֹתָ֨/נוּ֙ אֶל הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֔את וּ/נְתָנָ֖/הּ לָ֑/נוּ אֶ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר הִ֛וא זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּ/דְבָֽשׁ
verses.translit: 'm chpts bnv yhvh vhby' 'tnv 'l h'rts hz't vntnh lnv 'rts 'shr hv' zbt chlb vdbsh
verses.translation: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ בַּֽ/יהוָה֮ אַל תִּמְרֹדוּ֒ וְ/אַתֶּ֗ם אַל תִּֽירְאוּ֙ אֶת עַ֣ם הָ/אָ֔רֶץ כִּ֥י לַחְמֵ֖/נוּ הֵ֑ם סָ֣ר צִלָּ֧/ם מֵ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֛ם וַֽ/יהוָ֥ה אִתָּ֖/נוּ אַל תִּירָאֻֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'kh byhvh 'l tmrdv v'tm 'l tyr'v 't 'm h'rts khy lchmnv hm sr tslm m'lyhm vyhvh 'tnv 'l tyr'm
verses.translation: Only rebel not ye against the LORD , neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the LORD is with us: fear them not.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ כָּל הָ֣/עֵדָ֔ה לִ/רְגּ֥וֹם אֹתָ֖/ם בָּ/אֲבָנִ֑ים וּ/כְב֣וֹד יְהוָ֗ה נִרְאָה֙ בְּ/אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד אֶֽל כָּל בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mrv khl h'dh lrgvm 'tm b'bnym vkhbvd yhvh nr'h b'hl mv'd 'l khl bny yshr'l
verses.translation: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the LORD appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה עַד אָ֥נָה יְנַאֲצֻ֖/נִי הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֑ה וְ/עַד אָ֨נָה֙ לֹא יַאֲמִ֣ינוּ בִ֔/י בְּ/כֹל֙ הָֽ/אֹת֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי בְּ/קִרְבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh 'd 'nh yn'tsny h'm hzh v'd 'nh l' y'mynv by bkhl h'tvt 'shr 'shyty bqrbv
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?

verses.original: אַכֶּ֥/נּוּ בַ/דֶּ֖בֶר וְ/אוֹרִשֶׁ֑/נּוּ וְ/אֶֽעֱשֶׂה֙ אֹֽתְ/ךָ֔ לְ/גוֹי גָּד֥וֹל וְ/עָצ֖וּם מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 'khnv bdbr v'vrshnv v''shh 'tkh lgvy gdvl v'tsvm mmnv
verses.translation: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל יְהוָ֑ה וְ/שָׁמְע֣וּ מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּֽי הֶעֱלִ֧יתָ בְ/כֹחֲ/ךָ֛ אֶת הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּ֖ה מִ/קִּרְבּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l yhvh vshm'v mtsrym khy h'lyt bkhchkh 't h'm hzh mqrbv
verses.translation: And Moses said unto the LORD , Then the Egyptians shall hear it , (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)

verses.original: וְ/אָמְר֗וּ אֶל יוֹשֵׁב֮ הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּאת֒ שָֽׁמְעוּ֙ כִּֽי אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/קֶ֖רֶב הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֑ה אֲשֶׁר עַ֨יִן בְּ/עַ֜יִן נִרְאָ֣ה אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה וַ/עֲנָֽנְ/ךָ֙ עֹמֵ֣ד עֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם וּ/בְ/עַמֻּ֣ד עָנָ֗ן אַתָּ֨ה הֹלֵ֤ךְ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶם֙ יוֹמָ֔ם וּ/בְ/עַמּ֥וּד אֵ֖שׁ לָֽיְלָה
verses.translit: v'mrv 'l yvshb h'rts hz't shm'v khy 'th yhvh bqrb h'm hzh 'shr 'yn b'yn nr'h 'th yhvh v'nnkh 'md 'lhm vb'md 'nn 'th hlkh lpnyhm yvmm vb'mvd 'sh lylh
verses.translation: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou LORD art among this people, that thou LORD art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.

verses.original: וְ/הֵמַתָּ֛ה אֶת הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּ֖ה כְּ/אִ֣ישׁ אֶחָ֑ד וְ/אָֽמְרוּ֙ הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר שָׁמְע֥וּ אֶֽת שִׁמְעֲ/ךָ֖ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vhmth 't h'm hzh kh'ysh 'chd v'mrv hgvym 'shr shm'v 't shm'kh l'mr
verses.translation: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,

verses.original: מִ/בִּלְתִּ֞י יְכֹ֣לֶת יְהוָ֗ה לְ/הָבִיא֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֶל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֣ע לָ/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּשְׁחָטֵ֖/ם בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: mblty ykhlt yhvh lhby' 't h'm hzh 'l h'rts 'shr nshb' lhm vyshchtm bmdbr
verses.translation: Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֕ה יִגְדַּל נָ֖א כֹּ֣חַ אֲדֹנָ֑/י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: v'th ygdl n' khch 'dny kh'shr dbrt l'mr
verses.translation: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my Lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,

verses.original: יְהוָ֗ה אֶ֤רֶךְ אַפַּ֨יִם֙ וְ/רַב חֶ֔סֶד נֹשֵׂ֥א עָוֺ֖ן וָ/פָ֑שַׁע וְ/נַקֵּה֙ לֹ֣א יְנַקֶּ֔ה פֹּקֵ֞ד עֲוֺ֤ן אָבוֹת֙ עַל בָּנִ֔ים עַל שִׁלֵּשִׁ֖ים וְ/עַל רִבֵּעִֽים
verses.translit: yhvh 'rkh 'pym vrb chsd nsh' 'vn vpsh' vnqh l' ynqh pqd 'vn 'bvt 'l bnym 'l shlshym v'l rb'ym
verses.translation: The LORD is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty , visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation .

verses.original: סְלַֽח נָ֗א לַ/עֲוֺ֛ן הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּ֖ה כְּ/גֹ֣דֶל חַסְדֶּ֑/ךָ וְ/כַ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֨אתָה֙ לָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה מִ/מִּצְרַ֖יִם וְ/עַד הֵֽנָּה
verses.translit: slch n' l'vn h'm hzh khgdl chsdkh vkh'shr nsh'th l'm hzh mmtsrym v'd hnh
verses.translation: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָ֔ה סָלַ֖חְתִּי כִּ/דְבָרֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh slchty khdbrkh
verses.translation: And the LORD said, I have pardoned according to thy word:

verses.original: וְ/אוּלָ֖ם חַי אָ֑נִי וְ/יִמָּלֵ֥א כְבוֹד יְהוָ֖ה אֶת כָּל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: v'vlm chy 'ny vyml' khbvd yhvh 't khl h'rts
verses.translation: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD .

verses.original: כִּ֣י כָל הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֗ים הָ/רֹאִ֤ים אֶת כְּבֹדִ/י֙ וְ/אֶת אֹ֣תֹתַ֔/י אֲשֶׁר עָשִׂ֥יתִי בְ/מִצְרַ֖יִם וּ/בַ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר וַ/יְנַסּ֣וּ אֹתִ֗/י זֶ֚ה עֶ֣שֶׂר פְּעָמִ֔ים וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ בְּ/קוֹלִֽ/י
verses.translit: khy khl h'nshym hr'ym 't khbdy v't 'tty 'shr 'shyty bmtsrym vbmdbr vynsv 'ty zh 'shr p'mym vl' shm'v bqvly
verses.translation: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;

verses.original: אִם יִרְאוּ֙ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖עְתִּי לַ/אֲבֹתָ֑/ם וְ/כָל מְנַאֲצַ֖/י לֹ֥א יִרְאֽוּ/הָ
verses.translit: 'm yr'v 't h'rts 'shr nshb'ty l'btm vkhl mn'tsy l' yr'vh
verses.translation: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:

verses.original: וְ/עַבְדִּ֣/י כָלֵ֗ב עֵ֣קֶב הָֽיְתָ֞ה ר֤וּחַ אַחֶ֨רֶת֙ עִמּ֔/וֹ וַ/יְמַלֵּ֖א אַחֲרָ֑/י וַ/הֲבִֽיאֹתִ֗י/ו אֶל הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁר בָּ֣א שָׁ֔מָּ/ה וְ/זַרְע֖/וֹ יוֹרִשֶֽׁ/נָּה
verses.translit: v'bdy khlb 'qb hyth rvch 'chrt 'mv vyml' 'chry vhby'tyv 'l h'rts 'shr b' shmh vzr'v yvrshnh
verses.translation: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.

verses.original: וְ/הָֽ/עֲמָלֵקִ֥י וְ/הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֖י יוֹשֵׁ֣ב בָּ/עֵ֑מֶק מָחָ֗ר פְּנ֨וּ וּ/סְע֥וּ לָ/כֶ֛ם הַ/מִּדְבָּ֖ר דֶּ֥רֶךְ יַם סֽוּף
verses.translit: vh'mlqy vhkhn'ny yvshb b'mq mchr pnv vs'v lkhm hmdbr drkh ym svf
verses.translation: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְ/אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh v'l 'hrn l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

verses.original: עַד מָתַ֗י לָ/עֵדָ֤ה הָֽ/רָעָה֙ הַ/זֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥מָּה מַלִּינִ֖ים עָלָ֑/י אֶת תְּלֻנּ֞וֹת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵ֧מָּה מַלִּינִ֛ים עָלַ֖/י שָׁמָֽעְתִּי
verses.translit: 'd mty l'dh hr'h hz't 'shr hmh mlynym 'ly 't tlnvt bny yshr'l 'shr hmh mlynym 'ly shm'ty
verses.translation: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.

verses.original: אֱמֹ֣ר אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם חַי אָ֨נִי֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה אִם לֹ֕א כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּרְתֶּ֖ם בְּ/אָזְנָ֑/י כֵּ֖ן אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'mr 'lhm chy 'ny n'm yhvh 'm l' kh'shr dbrtm b'zny khn ''shh lkhm
verses.translation: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the LORD , as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:

verses.original: בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֣ר הַ֠/זֶּה יִפְּל֨וּ פִגְרֵי/כֶ֜ם וְ/כָל פְּקֻדֵי/כֶם֙ לְ/כָל מִסְפַּרְ/כֶ֔ם מִ/בֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֲלִֽינֹתֶ֖ם עָלָֽ/י
verses.translit: bmdbr hzh yplv pgrykhm vkhl pqdykhm lkhl msprkhm mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh 'shr hlyntm 'ly
verses.translation: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me,

verses.original: אִם אַתֶּם֙ תָּבֹ֣אוּ אֶל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֨אתִי֙ אֶת יָדִ֔/י לְ/שַׁכֵּ֥ן אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם בָּ֑/הּ כִּ֚י אִם כָּלֵ֣ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּ֔ה וִ/יהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן נֽוּן
verses.translit: 'm 'tm tb'v 'l h'rts 'shr nsh'ty 't ydy lshkhn 'tkhm bh khy 'm khlb bn ypnh vyhvsh' bn nvn
verses.translation: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.original: וְ/טַ֨פְּ/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם לָ/בַ֣ז יִהְיֶ֑ה וְ/הֵבֵיאתִ֣י אֹתָ֔/ם וְ/יָֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מְאַסְתֶּ֖ם בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vtpkhm 'shr 'mrtm lbz yhyh vhby'ty 'tm vyd'v 't h'rts 'shr m'stm bh
verses.translation: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.

verses.original: וּ/פִגְרֵי/כֶ֖ם אַתֶּ֑ם יִפְּל֖וּ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vpgrykhm 'tm yplv bmdbr hzh
verses.translation: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.

verses.original: וּ֠/בְנֵי/כֶם יִהְי֨וּ רֹעִ֤ים בַּ/מִּדְבָּר֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְ/נָשְׂא֖וּ אֶת זְנוּתֵי/כֶ֑ם עַד תֹּ֥ם פִּגְרֵי/כֶ֖ם בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: vbnykhm yhyv r'ym bmdbr 'rb'ym shnh vnsh'v 't znvtykhm 'd tm pgrykhm bmdbr
verses.translation: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.

verses.original: בְּ/מִסְפַּ֨ר הַ/יָּמִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר תַּרְתֶּ֣ם אֶת הָ/אָרֶץ֮ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים יוֹם֒ י֣וֹם לַ/שָּׁנָ֞ה י֣וֹם לַ/שָּׁנָ֗ה תִּשְׂאוּ֙ אֶת עֲוֺנֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֖ם אֶת תְּנוּאָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: bmspr hymym 'shr trtm 't h'rts 'rb'ym yvm yvm lshnh yvm lshnh tsh'v 't 'vntykhm 'rb'ym shnh vyd'tm 't tnv'ty
verses.translation: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.

verses.original: אֲנִ֣י יְהוָה֮ דִּבַּרְתִּי֒ אִם לֹ֣א זֹ֣את אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֗ה לְ/כָל הָ/עֵדָ֤ה הָֽ/רָעָה֙ הַ/זֹּ֔את הַ/נּוֹעָדִ֖ים עָלָ֑/י בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֥ר הַ/זֶּ֛ה יִתַּ֖מּוּ וְ/שָׁ֥ם יָמֻֽתוּ
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh dbrty 'm l' z't ''shh lkhl h'dh hr'h hz't hnv'dym 'ly bmdbr hzh ytmv vshm ymtv
verses.translation: I the LORD have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.

verses.original: וְ/הָ֣/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֖ה לָ/ת֣וּר אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וַ/יָּשֻׁ֗בוּ ו/ילונו וַ/יַּלִּ֤ינוּ עָלָי/ו֙ אֶת כָּל הָ֣/עֵדָ֔ה לְ/הוֹצִ֥יא דִבָּ֖ה עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vh'nshym 'shr shlch mshh ltvr 't h'rts vyshbv vylvnv vylynv 'lyv 't khl h'dh lhvtsy' dbh 'l h'rts
verses.translation: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,

verses.original: וַ/יָּמֻ֨תוּ֙ הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים מוֹצִאֵ֥י דִבַּת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ רָעָ֑ה בַּ/מַּגֵּפָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vymtv h'nshym mvts'y dbt h'rts r'h bmgph lpny yhvh
verses.translation: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the LORD .

verses.original: וִ/יהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן נ֔וּן וְ/כָלֵ֖ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּ֑ה חָיוּ֙ מִן הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָ/הֵ֔ם הַֽ/הֹלְכִ֖ים לָ/ת֥וּר אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vyhvsh' bn nvn vkhlb bn ypnh chyv mn h'nshym hhm hhlkhym ltvr 't h'rts
verses.translation: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still .

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אֶֽל כָּל בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַ/יִּֽתְאַבְּל֥וּ הָ/עָ֖ם מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vydbr mshh 't hdbrym h'lh 'l khl bny yshr'l vyt'blv h'm m'd
verses.translation: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.

verses.original: וַ/יַּשְׁכִּ֣מוּ בַ/בֹּ֔קֶר וַ/יַּֽעֲל֥וּ אֶל רֹאשׁ הָ/הָ֖ר לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הִנֶּ֗/נּוּ וְ/עָלִ֛ינוּ אֶל הַ/מָּק֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה כִּ֥י חָטָֽאנוּ
verses.translit: vyshkhmv bbqr vy'lv 'l r'sh hhr l'mr hnnv v'lynv 'l hmqvm 'shr 'mr yhvh khy cht'nv
verses.translation: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here , and will go up unto the place which the LORD hath promised: for we have sinned.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה לָ֥/מָּה זֶּ֛ה אַתֶּ֥ם עֹבְרִ֖ים אֶת פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/הִ֖וא לֹ֥א תִצְלָֽח
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh lmh zh 'tm 'brym 't py yhvh vhv' l' ttslch
verses.translation: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the LORD ? but it shall not prosper.

verses.original: אַֽל תַּעֲל֔וּ כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/קִרְבְּ/כֶ֑ם וְ/לֹא֙ תִּנָּ֣גְפ֔וּ לִ/פְנֵ֖י אֹיְבֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'l t'lv khy 'yn yhvh bqrbkhm vl' tngpv lpny 'ybykhm
verses.translation: Go not up, for the LORD is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.

verses.original: כִּי֩ הָ/עֲמָלֵקִ֨י וְ/הַ/כְּנַעֲנִ֥י שָׁם֙ לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֔ם וּ/נְפַלְתֶּ֖ם בֶּ/חָ֑רֶב כִּֽי עַל כֵּ֤ן שַׁבְתֶּם֙ מֵ/אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְ/לֹא יִהְיֶ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khy h'mlqy vhkhn'ny shm lpnykhm vnpltm bchrb khy 'l khn shbtm m'chry yhvh vl' yhyh yhvh 'mkhm
verses.translation: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the LORD , therefore the LORD will not be with you.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעְפִּ֕לוּ לַ/עֲל֖וֹת אֶל רֹ֣אשׁ הָ/הָ֑ר וַ/אֲר֤וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָה֙ וּ/מֹשֶׁ֔ה לֹא מָ֖שׁוּ מִ/קֶּ֥רֶב הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vy'plv l'lvt 'l r'sh hhr v'rvn bryt yhvh vmshh l' mshv mqrb hmchnh
verses.translation: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the LORD , and Moses, departed not out of the camp.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֤רֶד הָ/עֲמָלֵקִי֙ וְ/הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֔י הַ/יֹּשֵׁ֖ב בָּ/הָ֣ר הַ/ה֑וּא וַ/יַּכּ֥וּ/ם וַֽ/יַּכְּת֖וּ/ם עַד הַֽ/חָרְמָֽה
verses.translit: vyrd h'mlqy vhkhn'ny hyshb bhr hhv' vykhvm vykhtvm 'd hchrmh
verses.translation: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם כִּ֣י תָבֹ֗אוּ אֶל אֶ֨רֶץ֙ מוֹשְׁבֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י נֹתֵ֥ן לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm khy tb'v 'l 'rts mvshbtykhm 'shr 'ny ntn lkhm
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,

verses.original: וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם אִשֶּׁ֤ה לַֽ/יהוָה֙ עֹלָ֣ה אוֹ זֶ֔בַח לְ/פַלֵּא נֶ֨דֶר֙ א֣וֹ בִ/נְדָבָ֔ה א֖וֹ בְּ/מֹעֲדֵי/כֶ֑ם לַ/עֲשׂ֞וֹת רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה מִן הַ/בָּקָ֖ר א֥וֹ מִן הַ/צֹּֽאן
verses.translit: v'shytm 'shh lyhvh 'lh 'v zbch lpl' ndr 'v bndbh 'v bm'dykhm l'shvt rych nychch lyhvh mn hbqr 'v mn hts'n
verses.translation: And will make an offering by fire unto the LORD , a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the LORD , of the herd, or of the flock:

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרִ֛יב הַ/מַּקְרִ֥יב קָרְבָּנ֖/וֹ לַֽ/יהוָ֑ה מִנְחָה֙ סֹ֣לֶת עִשָּׂר֔וֹן בָּל֕וּל בִּ/רְבִעִ֥ית הַ/הִ֖ין שָֽׁמֶן
verses.translit: vhqryb hmqryb qrbnv lyhvh mnchh slt 'shrvn blvl brb'yt hhyn shmn
verses.translation: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the LORD bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.

verses.original: וְ/יַ֤יִן לַ/נֶּ֨סֶךְ֙ רְבִיעִ֣ית הַ/הִ֔ין תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה עַל הָ/עֹלָ֖ה א֣וֹ לַ/זָּ֑בַח לַ/כֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָ/אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vyyn lnskh rby'yt hhyn t'shh 'l h'lh 'v lzbch lkhbsh h'chd
verses.translation: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.

verses.original: א֤וֹ לָ/אַ֨יִל֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה מִנְחָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת שְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֑ים בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַ/שֶּׁ֖מֶן שְׁלִשִׁ֥ית הַ/הִֽין
verses.translit: 'v l'yl t'shh mnchh slt shny 'shrnym blvlh bshmn shlshyt hhyn
verses.translation: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.

verses.original: וְ/יַ֥יִן לַ/נֶּ֖סֶךְ שְׁלִשִׁ֣ית הַ/הִ֑ין תַּקְרִ֥יב רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyyn lnskh shlshyt hhyn tqryb rych nychch lyhvh
verses.translation: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי תַעֲשֶׂ֥ה בֶן בָּקָ֖ר עֹלָ֣ה אוֹ זָ֑בַח לְ/פַלֵּא נֶ֥דֶר אֽוֹ שְׁלָמִ֖ים לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vkhy t'shh bn bqr 'lh 'v zbch lpl' ndr 'v shlmym lyhvh
verses.translation: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the LORD :

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרִ֤יב עַל בֶּן הַ/בָּקָר֙ מִנְחָ֔ה סֹ֖לֶת שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֑ים בָּל֥וּל בַּ/שֶּׁ֖מֶן חֲצִ֥י הַ/הִֽין
verses.translit: vhqryb 'l bn hbqr mnchh slt shlshh 'shrnym blvl bshmn chtsy hhyn
verses.translation: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.

verses.original: וְ/יַ֛יִן תַּקְרִ֥יב לַ/נֶּ֖סֶךְ חֲצִ֣י הַ/הִ֑ין אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyyn tqryb lnskh chtsy hhyn 'shh rych nychch lyhvh
verses.translation: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD .

verses.original: כָּ֣כָה יֵעָשֶׂ֗ה לַ/שּׁוֹר֙ הָֽ/אֶחָ֔ד א֖וֹ לָ/אַ֣יִל הָ/אֶחָ֑ד אֽוֹ לַ/שֶּׂ֥ה בַ/כְּבָשִׂ֖ים א֥וֹ בָ/עִזִּֽים
verses.translit: khkhh y'shh lshvr h'chd 'v l'yl h'chd 'v lshh bkhbshym 'v b'zym
verses.translation: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.

verses.translit: khmspr 'shr t'shv khkhh t'shv l'chd khmsprm
verses.translation: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.

verses.original: כָּל הָ/אֶזְרָ֥ח יַעֲשֶׂה כָּ֖כָה אֶת אֵ֑לֶּה לְ/הַקְרִ֛יב אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: khl h'zrch y'shh khkhh 't 'lh lhqryb 'shh rych nychch lyhvh
verses.translation: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יָגוּר֩ אִתְּ/כֶ֨ם גֵּ֜ר א֤וֹ אֲשֶֽׁר בְּ/תֽוֹכְ/כֶם֙ לְ/דֹרֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/עָשָׂ֛ה אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַ/יהוָ֑ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ כֵּ֥ן יַעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vkhy ygvr 'tkhm gr 'v 'shr btvkhkhm ldrtykhm v'shh 'shh rych nychch lyhvh kh'shr t'shv khn y'shh
verses.translation: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD ; as ye do, so he shall do.

verses.original: הַ/קָּהָ֕ל חֻקָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת לָ/כֶ֖ם וְ/לַ/גֵּ֣ר הַ/גָּ֑ר חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְ/דֹרֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם כָּ/כֶ֛ם כַּ/גֵּ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hqhl chqh 'cht lkhm vlgr hgr chqt 'vlm ldrtykhm khkhm khgr yhyh lpny yhvh
verses.translation: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you , an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are , so shall the stranger be before the LORD .

verses.original: תּוֹרָ֥ה אַחַ֛ת וּ/מִשְׁפָּ֥ט אֶחָ֖ד יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֑ם וְ/לַ/גֵּ֖ר הַ/גָּ֥ר אִתְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: tvrh 'cht vmshpt 'chd yhyh lkhm vlgr hgr 'tkhm
verses.translation: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם בְּ/בֹֽאֲ/כֶם֙ אֶל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֛י מֵבִ֥יא אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm bb'khm 'l h'rts 'shr 'ny mby' 'tkhm shmh
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֕ה בַּ/אֲכָלְ/כֶ֖ם מִ/לֶּ֣חֶם הָ/אָ֑רֶץ תָּרִ֥ימוּ תְרוּמָ֖ה לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhyh b'khlkhm mlchm h'rts trymv trvmh lyhvh
verses.translation: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the LORD .

verses.original: רֵאשִׁית֙ עֲרִסֹ֣תֵ/כֶ֔ם חַלָּ֖ה תָּרִ֣ימוּ תְרוּמָ֑ה כִּ/תְרוּמַ֣ת גֹּ֔רֶן כֵּ֖ן תָּרִ֥ימוּ אֹתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: r'shyt 'rstkhm chlh trymv trvmh khtrvmt grn khn trymv 'th
verses.translation: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.

verses.original: מֵ/רֵאשִׁית֙ עֲרִסֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם תִּתְּנ֥וּ לַ/יהוָ֖ה תְּרוּמָ֑ה לְ/דֹרֹ֖תֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: mr'shyt 'rstykhm ttnv lyhvh trvmh ldrtykhm
verses.translation: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD an heave offering in your generations.

verses.original: וְ/כִ֣י תִשְׁגּ֔וּ וְ/לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/מִּצְוֺ֖ת הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vkhy tshgv vl' t'shv 't khl hmtsvt h'lh 'shr dbr yhvh 'l mshh
verses.translation: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the LORD hath spoken unto Moses,

verses.original: אֵת֩ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם בְּ/יַד מֹשֶׁ֑ה מִן הַ/יּ֞וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה וָ/הָ֖לְאָה לְ/דֹרֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 't khl 'shr tsvh yhvh 'lykhm byd mshh mn hyvm 'shr tsvh yhvh vhl'h ldrtykhm
verses.translation: Even all that the LORD hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the LORD commanded Moses , and henceforward among your generations;

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה אִ֣ם מֵ/עֵינֵ֣י הָ/עֵדָה֮ נֶעֶשְׂתָ֣ה לִ/שְׁגָגָה֒ וְ/עָשׂ֣וּ כָל הָ/עֵדָ֡ה פַּ֣ר בֶּן בָּקָר֩ אֶחָ֨ד לְ/עֹלָ֜ה לְ/רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה וּ/מִנְחָת֥/וֹ וְ/נִסְכּ֖/וֹ כַּ/מִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ/שְׂעִיר עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד לְ/חַטָּֽת
verses.translit: vhyh 'm m'yny h'dh n'shth lshggh v'shv khl h'dh pr bn bqr 'chd l'lh lrych nychch lyhvh vmnchtv vnskhv khmshpt vsh'yr 'zym 'chd lchtt
verses.translation: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the LORD , with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.

verses.original: וְ/כִפֶּ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן עַֽל כָּל עֲדַ֛ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְ/נִסְלַ֣ח לָ/הֶ֑ם כִּֽי שְׁגָגָ֣ה הִ֔וא וְ/הֵם֩ הֵבִ֨יאוּ אֶת קָרְבָּנָ֜/ם אִשֶּׁ֣ה לַֽ/יהוָ֗ה וְ/חַטָּאתָ֛/ם לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עַל שִׁגְגָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vkhpr hkhhn 'l khl 'dt bny yshr'l vnslch lhm khy shggh hv' vhm hby'v 't qrbnm 'shh lyhvh vcht'tm lpny yhvh 'l shggtm
verses.translation: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD , and their sin offering before the LORD , for their ignorance:

verses.original: וְ/נִסְלַ֗ח לְ/כָל עֲדַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/לַ/גֵּ֖ר הַ/גָּ֣ר בְּ/תוֹכָ֑/ם כִּ֥י לְ/כָל הָ/עָ֖ם בִּ/שְׁגָגָֽה
verses.translit: vnslch lkhl 'dt bny yshr'l vlgr hgr btvkhm khy lkhl h'm bshggh
verses.translation: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.

verses.original: וְ/אִם נֶ֥פֶשׁ אַחַ֖ת תֶּחֱטָ֣א בִ/שְׁגָגָ֑ה וְ/הִקְרִ֛יבָה עֵ֥ז בַּת שְׁנָתָ֖/הּ לְ/חַטָּֽאת
verses.translit: v'm npsh 'cht tcht' bshggh vhqrybh 'z bt shnth lcht't
verses.translation: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.

verses.original: וְ/כִפֶּ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן עַל הַ/נֶּ֧פֶשׁ הַ/שֹּׁגֶ֛גֶת בְּ/חֶטְאָ֥ה בִ/שְׁגָגָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לְ/כַפֵּ֥ר עָלָ֖י/ו וְ/נִסְלַ֥ח לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vkhpr hkhhn 'l hnpsh hshggt bcht'h bshggh lpny yhvh lkhpr 'lyv vnslch lv
verses.translation: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the LORD , to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.

verses.original: הָֽ/אֶזְרָח֙ בִּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/לַ/גֵּ֖ר הַ/גָּ֣ר בְּ/תוֹכָ֑/ם תּוֹרָ֤ה אַחַת֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֔ם לָ/עֹשֶׂ֖ה בִּ/שְׁגָגָֽה
verses.translit: h'zrch bbny yshr'l vlgr hgr btvkhm tvrh 'cht yhyh lkhm l'shh bshggh
verses.translation: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נֶּ֜פֶשׁ אֲשֶֽׁר תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה בְּ/יָ֣ד רָמָ֗ה מִן הָֽ/אֶזְרָח֙ וּ/מִן הַ/גֵּ֔ר אֶת יְהוָ֖ה ה֣וּא מְגַדֵּ֑ף וְ/נִכְרְתָ֛ה הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/הִ֖וא מִ/קֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vhnpsh 'shr t'shh byd rmh mn h'zrch vmn hgr 't yhvh hv' mgdf vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' mqrb 'mh
verses.translation: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the LORD ; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.

verses.original: כִּ֤י דְבַר יְהוָה֙ בָּזָ֔ה וְ/אֶת מִצְוָת֖/וֹ הֵפַ֑ר הִכָּרֵ֧ת תִּכָּרֵ֛ת הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/הִ֖וא עֲוֺנָ֥/ה בָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy dbr yhvh bzh v't mtsvtv hpr hkhrt tkhrt hnpsh hhv' 'vnh bh
verses.translation: Because he hath despised the word of the LORD , and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר וַֽ/יִּמְצְא֗וּ אִ֛ישׁ מְקֹשֵׁ֥שׁ עֵצִ֖ים בְּ/י֥וֹם הַ/שַּׁבָּֽת
verses.translit: vyhyv bny yshr'l bmdbr vymts'v 'ysh mqshsh 'tsym byvm hshbt
verses.translation: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְרִ֣יבוּ אֹת֔/וֹ הַ/מֹּצְאִ֥ים אֹת֖/וֹ מְקֹשֵׁ֣שׁ עֵצִ֑ים אֶל מֹשֶׁה֙ וְ/אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְ/אֶ֖ל כָּל הָ/עֵדָֽה
verses.translit: vyqrybv 'tv hmts'ym 'tv mqshsh 'tsym 'l mshh v'l 'hrn v'l khl h'dh
verses.translation: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.

verses.original: וַ/יַּנִּ֥יחוּ אֹת֖/וֹ בַּ/מִּשְׁמָ֑ר כִּ֚י לֹ֣א פֹרַ֔שׁ מַה יֵּעָשֶׂ֖ה לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vynychv 'tv bmshmr khy l' prsh mh y'shh lv
verses.translation: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה מ֥וֹת יוּמַ֖ת הָ/אִ֑ישׁ רָג֨וֹם אֹת֤/וֹ בָֽ/אֲבָנִים֙ כָּל הָ֣/עֵדָ֔ה מִ/ח֖וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh mvt yvmt h'ysh rgvm 'tv b'bnym khl h'dh mchvts lmchnh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּצִ֨יאוּ אֹת֜/וֹ כָּל הָ/עֵדָ֗ה אֶל מִ/חוּץ֙ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה וַ/יִּרְגְּמ֥וּ אֹת֛/וֹ בָּ/אֲבָנִ֖ים וַ/יָּמֹ֑ת כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vytsy'v 'tv khl h'dh 'l mchvts lmchnh vyrgmv 'tv b'bnym vymt kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם וְ/עָשׂ֨וּ לָ/הֶ֥ם צִיצִ֛ת עַל כַּנְפֵ֥י בִגְדֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/דֹרֹתָ֑/ם וְ/נָֽתְנ֛וּ עַל צִיצִ֥ת הַ/כָּנָ֖ף פְּתִ֥יל תְּכֵֽלֶת
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm v'shv lhm tsytst 'l khnpy bgdyhm ldrtm vntnv 'l tsytst hkhnf ptyl tkhlt
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה לָ/כֶם֮ לְ/צִיצִת֒ וּ/רְאִיתֶ֣ם אֹת֗/וֹ וּ/זְכַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת כָּל מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑/ם וְ/לֹֽא תָתֻ֜רוּ אַחֲרֵ֤י לְבַבְ/כֶם֙ וְ/אַחֲרֵ֣י עֵֽינֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּ֥ם זֹנִ֖ים אַחֲרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vhyh lkhm ltsytst vr'ytm 'tv vzkhrtm 't khl mtsvt yhvh v'shytm 'tm vl' ttrv 'chry lbbkhm v'chry 'ynykhm 'shr 'tm znym 'chryhm
verses.translation: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD , and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:

verses.original: לְמַ֣עַן תִּזְכְּר֔וּ וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֶת כָּל מִצְוֺתָ֑/י וִ/הְיִיתֶ֥ם קְדֹשִׁ֖ים לֵֽ/אלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: lm'n tzkhrv v'shytm 't khl mtsvty vhyytm qdshym l'lhykhm
verses.translation: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.

verses.original: אֲנִ֞י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר הוֹצֵ֤אתִי אֶתְ/כֶם֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לִ/הְי֥וֹת לָ/כֶ֖ם לֵ/אלֹהִ֑ים אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm 'shr hvts'ty 'tkhm m'rts mtsrym lhyvt lkhm l'lhym 'ny yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: I am the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD your God.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח קֹ֔רַח בֶּן יִצְהָ֥ר בֶּן קְהָ֖ת בֶּן לֵוִ֑י וְ/דָתָ֨ן וַ/אֲבִירָ֜ם בְּנֵ֧י אֱלִיאָ֛ב וְ/א֥וֹן בֶּן פֶּ֖לֶת בְּנֵ֥י רְאוּבֵֽן
verses.translit: vyqch qrch bn ytshr bn qht bn lvy vdtn v'byrm bny 'ly'b v'vn bn plt bny r'vbn
verses.translation: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:

verses.original: וַ/יָּקֻ֨מוּ֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַ/אֲנָשִׁ֥ים מִ/בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּ/מָאתָ֑יִם נְשִׂיאֵ֥י עֵדָ֛ה קְרִאֵ֥י מוֹעֵ֖ד אַנְשֵׁי שֵֽׁם
verses.translit: vyqmv lpny mshh v'nshym mbny yshr'l chmshym vm'tym nshy'y 'dh qr'y mv'd 'nshy shm
verses.translation: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽקָּהֲל֞וּ עַל מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְ/עַֽל אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ אֲלֵ/הֶם֮ רַב לָ/כֶם֒ כִּ֤י כָל הָֽ/עֵדָה֙ כֻּלָּ֣/ם קְדֹשִׁ֔ים וּ/בְ/תוֹכָ֖/ם יְהוָ֑ה וּ/מַדּ֥וּעַ תִּֽתְנַשְּׂא֖וּ עַל קְהַ֥ל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqhlv 'l mshh v'l 'hrn vy'mrv 'lhm rb lkhm khy khl h'dh khlm qdshym vbtvkhm yhvh vmdv' ttnsh'v 'l qhl yhvh
verses.translation: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the LORD is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the LORD ?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַ/יִּפֹּ֖ל עַל פָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyshm' mshh vypl 'l pnyv
verses.translation: And when Moses heard it , he fell upon his face:

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֨ר אֶל קֹ֜רַח וְ/אֶֽל כָּל עֲדָת/וֹ֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ בֹּ֠קֶר וְ/יֹדַ֨ע יְהוָ֧ה אֶת אֲשֶׁר ל֛/וֹ וְ/אֶת הַ/קָּד֖וֹשׁ וְ/הִקְרִ֣יב אֵלָ֑י/ו וְ/אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְחַר בּ֖/וֹ יַקְרִ֥יב אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vydbr 'l qrch v'l khl 'dtv l'mr bqr vyd' yhvh 't 'shr lv v't hqdvsh vhqryb 'lyv v't 'shr ybchr bv yqryb 'lyv
verses.translation: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow the LORD will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.

verses.original: זֹ֖את עֲשׂ֑וּ קְחוּ לָ/כֶ֣ם מַחְתּ֔וֹת קֹ֖רַח וְ/כָל עֲדָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: z't 'shv qchv lkhm mchtvt qrch vkhl 'dtv
verses.translation: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;

verses.original: וּ/תְנ֣וּ בָ/הֵ֣ן אֵ֡שׁ וְ/שִׂימוּ֩ עֲלֵי/הֶ֨ן קְטֹ֜רֶת לִ/פְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ מָחָ֔ר וְ/הָיָ֗ה הָ/אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה ה֣וּא הַ/קָּד֑וֹשׁ רַב לָ/כֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י לֵוִֽי
verses.translit: vtnv bhn 'sh vshymv 'lyhn qtrt lpny yhvh mchr vhyh h'ysh 'shr ybchr yhvh hv' hqdvsh rb lkhm bny lvy
verses.translation: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before the LORD to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom the LORD doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל קֹ֑רַח שִׁמְעוּ נָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י לֵוִֽי
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l qrch shm'v n' bny lvy
verses.translation: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:

verses.original: הַ/מְעַ֣ט מִ/כֶּ֗ם כִּֽי הִבְדִּיל֩ אֱלֹהֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶתְ/כֶם֙ מֵ/עֲדַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְ/הַקְרִ֥יב אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם אֵלָ֑י/ו לַ/עֲבֹ֗ד אֶת עֲבֹדַת֙ מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֔ה וְ/לַ/עֲמֹ֛ד לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָ/עֵדָ֖ה לְ/שָׁרְתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: hm't mkhm khy hbdyl 'lhy yshr'l 'tkhm m'dt yshr'l lhqryb 'tkhm 'lyv l'bd 't 'bdt mshkhn yhvh vl'md lpny h'dh lshrtm
verses.translation: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the LORD , and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְרֵב֙ אֹֽתְ/ךָ֔ וְ/אֶת כָּל אַחֶ֥י/ךָ בְנֵי לֵוִ֖י אִתָּ֑/ךְ וּ/בִקַּשְׁתֶּ֖ם גַּם כְּהֻנָּֽה
verses.translit: vyqrb 'tkh v't khl 'chykh bny lvy 'tkh vbqshtm gm khhnh
verses.translation: And he hath brought thee near to him , and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֗ן אַתָּה֙ וְ/כָל עֲדָ֣תְ/ךָ֔ הַ/נֹּעָדִ֖ים עַל יְהוָ֑ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֣ן מַה ה֔וּא כִּ֥י תלונו תַלִּ֖ינוּ עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: lkhn 'th vkhl 'dtkh hn'dym 'l yhvh v'hrn mh hv' khy tlvnv tlynv 'lyv
verses.translation: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against the LORD : and what is Aaron, that ye murmur against him?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח מֹשֶׁ֔ה לִ/קְרֹ֛א לְ/דָתָ֥ן וְ/לַ/אֲבִירָ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י אֱלִיאָ֑ב וַ/יֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹ֥א נַעֲלֶֽה
verses.translit: vyshlch mshh lqr' ldtn vl'byrm bny 'ly'b vy'mrv l' n'lh
verses.translation: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:

verses.original: הַ/מְעַ֗ט כִּ֤י הֶֽעֱלִיתָ֨/נוּ֙ מֵ/אֶ֨רֶץ זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּ/דְבַ֔שׁ לַ/הֲמִיתֵ֖/נוּ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר כִּֽי תִשְׂתָּרֵ֥ר עָלֵ֖י/נוּ גַּם הִשְׂתָּרֵֽר
verses.translit: hm't khy h'lytnv m'rts zbt chlb vdbsh lhmytnv bmdbr khy tshtrr 'lynv gm hshtrr
verses.translation: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?

verses.original: אַ֡ף לֹ֣א אֶל אֶרֶץ֩ זָבַ֨ת חָלָ֤ב וּ/דְבַשׁ֙ הֲבִ֣יאֹתָ֔/נוּ וַ/תִּ֨תֶּן לָ֔/נוּ נַחֲלַ֖ת שָׂדֶ֣ה וָ/כָ֑רֶם הַ/עֵינֵ֞י הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֥ים הָ/הֵ֛ם תְּנַקֵּ֖ר לֹ֥א נַעֲלֶֽה
verses.translit: 'f l' 'l 'rts zbt chlb vdbsh hby'tnv vttn lnv nchlt shdh vkhrm h'yny h'nshym hhm tnqr l' n'lh
verses.translation: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.

verses.original: וַ/יִּ֤חַר לְ/מֹשֶׁה֙ מְאֹ֔ד וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה אַל תֵּ֖פֶן אֶל מִנְחָתָ֑/ם לֹ֠א חֲמ֨וֹר אֶחָ֤ד מֵ/הֶם֙ נָשָׂ֔אתִי וְ/לֹ֥א הֲרֵעֹ֖תִי אֶת אַחַ֥ד מֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vychr lmshh m'd vy'mr 'l yhvh 'l tpn 'l mnchtm l' chmvr 'chd mhm nsh'ty vl' hr'ty 't 'chd mhm
verses.translation: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto the LORD , Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל קֹ֔רַח אַתָּה֙ וְ/כָל עֲדָ֣תְ/ךָ֔ הֱי֖וּ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אַתָּ֥ה וָ/הֵ֛ם וְ/אַהֲרֹ֖ן מָחָֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l qrch 'th vkhl 'dtkh hyv lpny yhvh 'th vhm v'hrn mchr
verses.translation: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the LORD , thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:

verses.original: וּ/קְח֣וּ אִ֣ישׁ מַחְתָּת֗/וֹ וּ/נְתַתֶּ֤ם עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ קְטֹ֔רֶת וְ/הִקְרַבְתֶּ֞ם לִ/פְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ אִ֣ישׁ מַחְתָּת֔/וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּ/מָאתַ֖יִם מַחְתֹּ֑ת וְ/אַתָּ֥ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֖ן אִ֥ישׁ מַחְתָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vqchv 'ysh mchttv vnttm 'lyhm qtrt vhqrbtm lpny yhvh 'ysh mchttv chmshym vm'tym mchtt v'th v'hrn 'ysh mchttv
verses.translation: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring ye before the LORD every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְח֞וּ אִ֣ישׁ מַחְתָּת֗/וֹ וַ/יִּתְּנ֤וּ עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ אֵ֔שׁ וַ/יָּשִׂ֥ימוּ עֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם קְטֹ֑רֶת וַֽ/יַּעַמְד֗וּ פֶּ֛תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וּ/מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְ/אַהֲרֹֽן
verses.translit: vyqchv 'ysh mchttv vytnv 'lyhm 'sh vyshymv 'lyhm qtrt vy'mdv ptch 'hl mv'd vmshh v'hrn
verses.translation: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְהֵ֨ל עֲלֵי/הֶ֥ם קֹ֨רַח֙ אֶת כָּל הָ֣/עֵדָ֔ה אֶל פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַ/יֵּרָ֥א כְבוֹד יְהוָ֖ה אֶל כָּל הָ/עֵדָֽה
verses.translit: vyqhl 'lyhm qrch 't khl h'dh 'l ptch 'hl mv'd vyr' khbvd yhvh 'l khl h'dh
verses.translation: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the congregation.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְ/אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh v'l 'hrn l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

verses.original: הִבָּ֣דְל֔וּ מִ/תּ֖וֹךְ הָ/עֵדָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֑את וַ/אַכַלֶּ֥ה אֹתָ֖/ם כְּ/רָֽגַע
verses.translit: hbdlv mtvkh h'dh hz't v'khlh 'tm khrg'
verses.translation: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְּל֤וּ עַל פְּנֵי/הֶם֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ אֵ֕ל אֱלֹהֵ֥י הָ/רוּחֹ֖ת לְ/כָל בָּשָׂ֑ר הָ/אִ֤ישׁ אֶחָד֙ יֶחֱטָ֔א וְ/עַ֥ל כָּל הָ/עֵדָ֖ה תִּקְצֹֽף
verses.translit: vyplv 'l pnyhm vy'mrv 'l 'lhy hrvcht lkhl bshr h'ysh 'chd ycht' v'l khl h'dh tqtsf
verses.translation: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֥ר אֶל הָ/עֵדָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר הֵֽעָלוּ֙ מִ/סָּבִ֔יב לְ/מִשְׁכַּן קֹ֖רַח דָּתָ֥ן וַ/אֲבִירָֽם
verses.translit: dbr 'l h'dh l'mr h'lv msbyb lmshkhn qrch dtn v'byrm
verses.translation: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ אֶל דָּתָ֣ן וַ/אֲבִירָ֑ם וַ/יֵּלְכ֥וּ אַחֲרָ֖י/ו זִקְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyqm mshh vylkh 'l dtn v'byrm vylkhv 'chryv zqny yshr'l
verses.translation: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֨ר אֶל הָ/עֵדָ֜ה לֵ/אמֹ֗ר ס֣וּרוּ נָ֡א מֵ/עַל֩ אָהֳלֵ֨י הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָֽ/רְשָׁעִים֙ הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה וְ/אַֽל תִּגְּע֖וּ בְּ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ/הֶ֑ם פֶּן תִּסָּפ֖וּ בְּ/כָל חַטֹּאתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vydbr 'l h'dh l'mr svrv n' m'l 'hly h'nshym hrsh'ym h'lh v'l tg'v bkhl 'shr lhm pn tspv bkhl cht'tm
verses.translation: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּעָל֗וּ מֵ/עַ֧ל מִשְׁכַּן קֹ֛רֶח דָּתָ֥ן וַ/אֲבִירָ֖ם מִ/סָּבִ֑יב וְ/דָתָ֨ן וַ/אֲבִירָ֜ם יָצְא֣וּ נִצָּבִ֗ים פֶּ֚תַח אָֽהֳלֵי/הֶ֔ם וּ/נְשֵׁי/הֶ֥ם וּ/בְנֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/טַפָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vy'lv m'l mshkhn qrch dtn v'byrm msbyb vdtn v'byrm yts'v ntsbym ptch 'hlyhm vnshyhm vbnyhm vtpm
verses.translation: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֮ מֹשֶׁה֒ בְּ/זֹאת֙ תֵּֽדְע֔וּ/ן כִּֽי יְהוָ֣ה שְׁלָחַ֔/נִי לַ/עֲשׂ֕וֹת אֵ֥ת כָּל הַֽ/מַּעֲשִׂ֖ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה כִּי לֹ֖א מִ/לִּבִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh bz't td'vn khy yhvh shlchny l'shvt 't khl hm'shym h'lh khy l' mlby
verses.translation: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that the LORD hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.

verses.original: אִם כְּ/מ֤וֹת כָּל הָֽ/אָדָם֙ יְמֻת֣וּ/ן אֵ֔לֶּה וּ/פְקֻדַּת֙ כָּל הָ֣/אָדָ֔ם יִפָּקֵ֖ד עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם לֹ֥א יְהוָ֖ה שְׁלָחָֽ/נִי
verses.translit: 'm khmvt khl h'dm ymtvn 'lh vpqdt khl h'dm ypqd 'lyhm l' yhvh shlchny
verses.translation: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then the LORD hath not sent me.

verses.original: וְ/אִם בְּרִיאָ֞ה יִבְרָ֣א יְהוָ֗ה וּ/פָצְתָ֨ה הָ/אֲדָמָ֤ה אֶת פִּ֨י/הָ֙ וּ/בָלְעָ֤ה אֹתָ/ם֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ/הֶ֔ם וְ/יָרְד֥וּ חַיִּ֖ים שְׁאֹ֑לָ/ה וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּ֧י נִֽאֲצ֛וּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'm bry'h ybr' yhvh vptsth h'dmh 't pyh vbl'h 'tm v't khl 'shr lhm vyrdv chyym sh'lh vyd'tm khy n'tsv h'nshym h'lh 't yhvh
verses.translation: But if the LORD make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ כְּ/כַלֹּת֔/וֹ לְ/דַבֵּ֕ר אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וַ/תִּבָּקַ֥ע הָ/אֲדָמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּחְתֵּי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyhy khkhltv ldbr 't khl hdbrym h'lh vtbq' h'dmh 'shr tchtyhm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:

verses.original: וַ/תִּפְתַּ֤ח הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ אֶת פִּ֔י/הָ וַ/תִּבְלַ֥ע אֹתָ֖/ם וְ/אֶת בָּתֵּי/הֶ֑ם וְ/אֵ֤ת כָּל הָ/אָדָם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ/קֹ֔רַח וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל הָ/רֲכֽוּשׁ
verses.translit: vtptch h'rts 't pyh vtbl' 'tm v't btyhm v't khl h'dm 'shr lqrch v't khl hrkhvsh
verses.translation: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨רְד֜וּ הֵ֣ם וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָ/הֶ֛ם חַיִּ֖ים שְׁאֹ֑לָ/ה וַ/תְּכַ֤ס עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וַ/יֹּאבְד֖וּ מִ/תּ֥וֹךְ הַ/קָּהָֽל
verses.translit: vyrdv hm vkhl 'shr lhm chyym sh'lh vtkhs 'lyhm h'rts vy'bdv mtvkh hqhl
verses.translation: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.

verses.original: וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֛ר סְבִיבֹתֵי/הֶ֖ם נָ֣סוּ לְ/קֹלָ֑/ם כִּ֣י אָֽמְר֔וּ פֶּן תִּבְלָעֵ֖/נוּ הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vkhl yshr'l 'shr sbybtyhm nsv lqlm khy 'mrv pn tbl'nv h'rts
verses.translation: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also .

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֥שׁ יָצְאָ֖ה מֵ/אֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וַ/תֹּ֗אכַל אֵ֣ת הַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּ/מָאתַ֨יִם֙ אִ֔ישׁ מַקְרִיבֵ֖י הַ/קְּטֹֽרֶת
verses.translit: v'sh yts'h m't yhvh vt'khl 't hchmshym vm'tym 'ysh mqryby hqtrt
verses.translation: And there came out a fire from the LORD , and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.
And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.

The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the LORD , therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.
And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar:

To be a memorial unto the children of Israel, that no stranger, which is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the LORD ; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as the LORD said to him by the hand of Moses.
But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of the LORD .

And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD appeared.
And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.
And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.

And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from the LORD ; the plague is begun.
And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.
And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.
And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: אֱמֹ֨ר אֶל אֶלְעָזָ֜ר בֶּן אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן וְ/יָרֵ֤ם אֶת הַ/מַּחְתֹּת֙ מִ/בֵּ֣ין הַ/שְּׂרֵפָ֔ה וְ/אֶת הָ/אֵ֖שׁ זְרֵה הָ֑לְאָה כִּ֖י קָדֵֽשׁוּ
verses.translit: 'mr 'l 'l'zr bn 'hrn hkhhn vyrm 't hmchtt mbyn hshrph v't h'sh zrh hl'h khy qdshv
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write thou every man’s name upon his rod.

verses.original: אֵ֡ת מַחְתּוֹת֩ הַֽ/חַטָּאִ֨ים הָ/אֵ֜לֶּה בְּ/נַפְשֹׁתָ֗/ם וְ/עָשׂ֨וּ אֹתָ֜/ם רִקֻּעֵ֤י פַחִים֙ צִפּ֣וּי לַ/מִּזְבֵּ֔חַ כִּֽי הִקְרִיבֻ֥/ם לִ/פְנֵֽי יְהוָ֖ה וַ/יִּקְדָּ֑שׁוּ וְ/יִֽהְי֥וּ לְ/א֖וֹת לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: 't mchtvt hcht'ym h'lh bnpshtm v'shv 'tm rq'y pchym tspvy lmzbch khy hqrybm lpny yhvh vyqdshv vyhyv l'vt lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: And thou shalt write Aaron’s name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֞ח אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן אֵ֚ת מַחְתּ֣וֹת הַ/נְּחֹ֔שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִקְרִ֖יבוּ הַ/שְּׂרֻפִ֑ים וַֽ/יְרַקְּע֖וּ/ם צִפּ֥וּי לַ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vyqch 'l'zr hkhhn 't mchtvt hnchsht 'shr hqrybv hshrpym vyrq'vm tspvy lmzbch
verses.translation: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.

verses.original: זִכָּר֞וֹן לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לְ֠מַעַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא יִקְרַ֜ב אִ֣ישׁ זָ֗ר אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹ֣א מִ/זֶּ֤רַע אַהֲרֹן֙ ה֔וּא לְ/הַקְטִ֥יר קְטֹ֖רֶת לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֤ה כְ/קֹ֨רַח֙ וְ/כַ֣/עֲדָת֔/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה בְּ/יַד מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: zkhrvn lbny yshr'l lm'n 'shr l' yqrb 'ysh zr 'shr l' mzr' 'hrn hv' lhqtyr qtrt lpny yhvh vl' yhyh khqrch vkh'dtv kh'shr dbr yhvh byd mshh lv
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that the man’s rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur against you.

verses.original: וַ/יִּלֹּ֜נוּ כָּל עֲדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִֽ/מָּחֳרָ֔ת עַל מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְ/עַֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אַתֶּ֥ם הֲמִתֶּ֖ם אֶת עַ֥ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vylnv khl 'dt bny yshr'l mmchrt 'l mshh v'l 'hrn l'mr 'tm hmtm 't 'm yhvh
verses.translation: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י בְּ/הִקָּהֵ֤ל הָֽ/עֵדָה֙ עַל מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְ/עַֽל אַהֲרֹ֔ן וַ/יִּפְנוּ֙ אֶל אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה כִסָּ֖ה/וּ הֶ/עָנָ֑ן וַ/יֵּרָ֖א כְּב֥וֹד יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyhy bhqhl h'dh 'l mshh v'l 'hrn vypnv 'l 'hl mv'd vhnh khshv h'nn vyr' khbvd yhvh
verses.translation: And Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the tabernacle of witness.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֤א מֹשֶׁה֙ וְ/אַהֲרֹ֔ן אֶל פְּנֵ֖י אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vyb' mshh v'hrn 'l pny 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.

verses.original: הֵרֹ֗מּוּ מִ/תּוֹךְ֙ הָ/עֵדָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֔את וַ/אֲכַלֶּ֥ה אֹתָ֖/ם כְּ/רָ֑גַע וַֽ/יִּפְּל֖וּ עַל פְּנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: hrmv mtvkh h'dh hz't v'khlh 'tm khrg' vyplv 'l pnyhm
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Bring Aaron’s rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֗ן קַ֣ח אֶת הַ֠/מַּחְתָּה וְ/תֶן עָלֶ֨י/הָ אֵ֜שׁ מֵ/עַ֤ל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ וְ/שִׂ֣ים קְטֹ֔רֶת וְ/הוֹלֵ֧ךְ מְהֵרָ֛ה אֶל הָ/עֵדָ֖ה וְ/כַפֵּ֣ר עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם כִּֽי יָצָ֥א הַ/קֶּ֛צֶף מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה הֵחֵ֥ל הַ/נָּֽגֶף
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l 'hrn qch 't hmchth vtn 'lyh 'sh m'l hmzbch vshym qtrt vhvlkh mhrh 'l h'dh vkhpr 'lyhm khy yts' hqtsf mlpny yhvh hchl hngf
verses.translation: And Moses did so: as the LORD commanded him, so did he.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח אַהֲרֹ֜ן כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֗ה וַ/יָּ֨רָץ֙ אֶל תּ֣וֹך הַ/קָּהָ֔ל וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה הֵחֵ֥ל הַ/נֶּ֖גֶף בָּ/עָ֑ם וַ/יִּתֵּן֙ אֶֽת הַ/קְּטֹ֔רֶת וַ/יְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyqch 'hrn kh'shr dbr mshh vyrts 'l tvkh hqhl vhnh hchl hngf b'm vytn 't hqtrt vykhpr 'l h'm
verses.translation: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעֲמֹ֥ד בֵּֽין הַ/מֵּתִ֖ים וּ/בֵ֣ין הַֽ/חַיִּ֑ים וַ/תֵּעָצַ֖ר הַ/מַּגֵּפָֽה
verses.translit: vy'md byn hmtym vbyn hchyym vt'tsr hmgph
verses.translation: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the LORD shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֔ן אַתָּ֗ה וּ/בָנֶ֤י/ךָ וּ/בֵית אָבִ֨י/ךָ֙ אִתָּ֔/ךְ תִּשְׂא֖וּ אֶת עֲוֺ֣ן הַ/מִּקְדָּ֑שׁ וְ/אַתָּה֙ וּ/בָנֶ֣י/ךָ אִתָּ֔/ךְ תִּשְׂא֖וּ אֶת עֲוֺ֥ן כְּהֻנַּתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l 'hrn 'th vbnykh vbyt 'bykh 'tkh tsh'v 't 'vn hmqdsh v'th vbnykh 'tkh tsh'v 't 'vn khhntkhm
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father’s house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֣ם אֶת אַחֶי/ךָ֩ מַטֵּ֨ה לֵוִ֜י שֵׁ֤בֶט אָבִ֨י/ךָ֙ הַקְרֵ֣ב אִתָּ֔/ךְ וְ/יִלָּו֥וּ עָלֶ֖י/ךָ וִֽ/ישָׁרְת֑וּ/ךָ וְ/אַתָּה֙ וּ/בָנֶ֣י/ךָ אִתָּ֔/ךְ לִ/פְנֵ֖י אֹ֥הֶל הָ/עֵדֻֽת
verses.translit: vgm 't 'chykh mth lvy shbt 'bykh hqrb 'tkh vylvv 'lykh vyshrtvkh v'th vbnykh 'tkh lpny 'hl h'dt
verses.translation: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.

verses.original: וְ/שָֽׁמְרוּ֙ מִֽשְׁמַרְתְּ/ךָ֔ וּ/מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת כָּל הָ/אֹ֑הֶל אַךְ֩ אֶל כְּלֵ֨י הַ/קֹּ֤דֶשׁ וְ/אֶל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ לֹ֣א יִקְרָ֔בוּ וְ/לֹֽא יָמֻ֥תוּ גַם הֵ֖ם גַּם אַתֶּֽם
verses.translit: vshmrv mshmrtkh vmshmrt khl h'hl 'kh 'l khly hqdsh v'l hmzbch l' yqrbv vl' ymtv gm hm gm 'tm
verses.translation: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.

verses.original: וְ/נִלְו֣וּ עָלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/שָֽׁמְר֗וּ אֶת מִשְׁמֶ֨רֶת֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד לְ/כֹ֖ל עֲבֹדַ֣ת הָ/אֹ֑הֶל וְ/זָ֖ר לֹא יִקְרַ֥ב אֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vnlvv 'lykh vshmrv 't mshmrt 'hl mv'd lkhl 'bdt h'hl vzr l' yqrb 'lykhm
verses.translation: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּ֗ם אֵ֚ת מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַ/קֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְ/אֵ֖ת מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְ/לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֥ה ע֛וֹד קֶ֖צֶף עַל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vshmrtm 't mshmrt hqdsh v't mshmrt hmzbch vl' yhyh 'vd qtsf 'l bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/אֲנִ֗י הִנֵּ֤ה לָקַ֨חְתִּי֙ אֶת אֲחֵי/כֶ֣ם הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם מִ/תּ֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לָ/כֶ֞ם מַתָּנָ֤ה נְתֻנִים֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה לַ/עֲבֹ֕ד אֶת עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: v'ny hnh lqchty 't 'chykhm hlvym mtvkh bny yshr'l lkhm mtnh ntnym lyhvh l'bd 't 'bdt 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are given as a gift for the LORD , to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֣ה וּ/בָנֶ֣י/ךָ אִ֠תְּ/ךָ תִּשְׁמְר֨וּ אֶת כְּהֻנַּתְ/כֶ֜ם לְ/כָל דְּבַ֧ר הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֛חַ וּ/לְ/מִ/בֵּ֥ית לַ/פָּרֹ֖כֶת וַ/עֲבַדְתֶּ֑ם עֲבֹדַ֣ת מַתָּנָ֗ה אֶתֵּן֙ אֶת כְּהֻנַּתְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/הַ/זָּ֥ר הַ/קָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: v'th vbnykh 'tkh tshmrv 't khhntkhm lkhl dbr hmzbch vlmbyt lprkht v'bdtm 'bdt mtnh 'tn 't khhntkhm vhzr hqrb yvmt
verses.translation: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest’s office for every thing of the altar, and within the vail; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest’s office unto you as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֶֽל אַהֲרֹן֒ וַ/אֲנִי֙ הִנֵּ֣ה נָתַ֣תִּֽי לְ/ךָ֔ אֶת מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת תְּרוּמֹתָ֑/י לְ/כָל קָדְשֵׁ֣י בְנֵֽי יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל לְ/ךָ֨ נְתַתִּ֧י/ם לְ/מָשְׁחָ֛ה וּ/לְ/בָנֶ֖י/ךָ לְ/חָק עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l 'hrn v'ny hnh ntty lkh 't mshmrt trvmty lkhl qdshy bny yshr'l lkh nttym lmshchh vlbnykh lchq 'vlm
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.

verses.original: זֶֽה יִהְיֶ֥ה לְ/ךָ֛ מִ/קֹּ֥דֶשׁ הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֖ים מִן הָ/אֵ֑שׁ כָּל קָ֠רְבָּנָ/ם לְֽ/כָל מִנְחָתָ֞/ם וּ/לְ/כָל חַטָּאתָ֗/ם וּ/לְ/כָל אֲשָׁמָ/ם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָשִׁ֣יבוּ לִ֔/י קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֥ים לְ/ךָ֛ ה֖וּא וּ/לְ/בָנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: zh yhyh lkh mqdsh hqdshym mn h'sh khl qrbnm lkhl mnchtm vlkhl cht'tm vlkhl 'shmm 'shr yshybv ly qdsh qdshym lkh hv' vlbnykh
verses.translation: This shall be thine of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.

verses.original: בְּ/קֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֖ים תֹּאכֲלֶ֑/נּוּ כָּל זָכָר֙ יֹאכַ֣ל אֹת֔/וֹ קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִֽהְיֶה לָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: bqdsh hqdshym t'khlnv khl zkhr y'khl 'tv qdsh yhyh lkh
verses.translation: In the most holy place shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto thee.

verses.original: וְ/זֶה לְּ/ךָ֞ תְּרוּמַ֣ת מַתָּנָ֗/ם לְ/כָל תְּנוּפֹת֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ לְ/ךָ֣ נְתַתִּ֗י/ם וּ/לְ/בָנֶ֧י/ךָ וְ/לִ/בְנֹתֶ֛י/ךָ אִתְּ/ךָ֖ לְ/חָק עוֹלָ֑ם כָּל טָה֥וֹר בְּ/בֵיתְ/ךָ֖ יֹאכַ֥ל אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vzh lkh trvmt mtnm lkhl tnvpt bny yshr'l lkh nttym vlbnykh vlbntykh 'tkh lchq 'vlm khl thvr bbytkh y'khl 'tv
verses.translation: And this is thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.

verses.original: כֹּ֚ל חֵ֣לֶב יִצְהָ֔ר וְ/כָל חֵ֖לֶב תִּיר֣וֹשׁ וְ/דָגָ֑ן רֵאשִׁיתָ֛/ם אֲשֶׁר יִתְּנ֥וּ לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה לְ/ךָ֥ נְתַתִּֽי/ם
verses.translit: khl chlb ytshr vkhl chlb tyrvsh vdgn r'shytm 'shr ytnv lyhvh lkh nttym
verses.translation: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the LORD , them have I given thee.

verses.original: בִּכּוּרֵ֞י כָּל אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּ/אַרְצָ֛/ם אֲשֶׁר יָבִ֥יאוּ לַ/יהוָ֖ה לְ/ךָ֣ יִהְיֶ֑ה כָּל טָה֥וֹר בְּ/בֵיתְ/ךָ֖ יֹאכֲלֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: bkhvry khl 'shr b'rtsm 'shr yby'v lyhvh lkh yhyh khl thvr bbytkh y'khlnv
verses.translation: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto the LORD , shall be thine; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it.

verses.original: כָּל חֵ֥רֶם בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/ךָ֥ יִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: khl chrm byshr'l lkh yhyh
verses.translation: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.

verses.original: כָּל פֶּ֣טֶר רֶ֠חֶם לְֽ/כָל בָּשָׂ֞ר אֲשֶׁר יַקְרִ֧יבוּ לַֽ/יהוָ֛ה בָּ/אָדָ֥ם וּ/בַ/בְּהֵמָ֖ה יִֽהְיֶה לָּ֑/ךְ אַ֣ךְ פָּדֹ֣ה תִפְדֶּ֗ה אֵ֚ת בְּכ֣וֹר הָֽ/אָדָ֔ם וְ/אֵ֛ת בְּכֽוֹר הַ/בְּהֵמָ֥ה הַ/טְּמֵאָ֖ה תִּפְדֶּֽה
verses.translit: khl ptr rchm lkhl bshr 'shr yqrybv lyhvh b'dm vbbhmh yhyh lkh 'kh pdh tpdh 't bkhvr h'dm v't bkhvr hbhmh htm'h tpdh
verses.translation: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto the LORD , whether it be of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.

verses.original: וּ/פְדוּיָ/ו֙ מִ/בֶּן חֹ֣דֶשׁ תִּפְדֶּ֔ה בְּ/עֶ֨רְכְּ/ךָ֔ כֶּ֛סֶף חֲמֵ֥שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים בְּ/שֶׁ֣קֶל הַ/קֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה הֽוּא
verses.translit: vpdvyv mbn chdsh tpdh b'rkhkh khsf chmsht shqlym bshql hqdsh 'shrym grh hv'
verses.translation: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ בְּֽכוֹר שׁ֡וֹר אֽוֹ בְכ֨וֹר כֶּ֜שֶׂב אֽוֹ בְכ֥וֹר עֵ֛ז לֹ֥א תִפְדֶּ֖ה קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֑ם אֶת דָּמָ֞/ם תִּזְרֹ֤ק עַל הַ/מִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ וְ/אֶת חֶלְבָּ֣/ם תַּקְטִ֔יר אִשֶּׁ֛ה לְ/רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'kh bkhvr shvr 'v bkhvr khshb 'v bkhvr 'z l' tpdh qdsh hm 't dmm tzrq 'l hmzbch v't chlbm tqtyr 'shh lrych nychch lyhvh
verses.translation: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they are holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto the LORD .

verses.original: וּ/בְשָׂרָ֖/ם יִהְיֶה לָּ֑/ךְ כַּ/חֲזֵ֧ה הַ/תְּנוּפָ֛ה וּ/כְ/שׁ֥וֹק הַ/יָּמִ֖ין לְ/ךָ֥ יִהְיֶֽה
verses.translit: vbshrm yhyh lkh khchzh htnvph vkhshvq hymyn lkh yhyh
verses.translation: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ל תְּרוּמֹ֣ת הַ/קֳּדָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֥ימוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לַֽ/יהוָה֒ נָתַ֣תִּֽי לְ/ךָ֗ וּ/לְ/בָנֶ֧י/ךָ וְ/לִ/בְנֹתֶ֛י/ךָ אִתְּ/ךָ֖ לְ/חָק עוֹלָ֑ם בְּרִית֩ מֶ֨לַח עוֹלָ֥ם הִוא֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְ/ךָ֖ וּ/לְ/זַרְעֲ/ךָ֥ אִתָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khl trvmt hqdshym 'shr yrymv bny yshr'l lyhvh ntty lkh vlbnykh vlbntykh 'tkh lchq 'vlm bryt mlch 'vlm hv' lpny yhvh lkh vlzr'kh 'tkh
verses.translation: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto the LORD , have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before the LORD unto thee and to thy seed with thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֗ן בְּ/אַרְצָ/ם֙ לֹ֣א תִנְחָ֔ל וְ/חֵ֕לֶק לֹא יִהְיֶ֥ה לְ/ךָ֖ בְּ/תוֹכָ֑/ם אֲנִ֤י חֶלְקְ/ךָ֙ וְ/נַחֲלָ֣תְ/ךָ֔ בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l 'hrn b'rtsm l' tnchl vchlq l' yhyh lkh btvkhm 'ny chlqkh vnchltkh btvkh bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י הִנֵּ֥ה נָתַ֛תִּי כָּל מַֽעֲשֵׂ֥ר בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/נַחֲלָ֑ה חֵ֤לֶף עֲבֹֽדָתָ/ם֙ אֲשֶׁר הֵ֣ם עֹֽבְדִ֔ים אֶת עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vlbny lvy hnh ntty khl m'shr byshr'l lnchlh chlf 'bdtm 'shr hm 'bdym 't 'bdt 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא יִקְרְב֥וּ ע֛וֹד בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶל אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לָ/שֵׂ֥את חֵ֖טְא לָ/מֽוּת
verses.translit: vl' yqrbv 'vd bny yshr'l 'l 'hl mv'd lsh't cht' lmvt
