verses.translation: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.

verses.original: וְ/עָבַ֨ד הַ/לֵּוִ֜י ה֗וּא אֶת עֲבֹדַת֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְ/הֵ֖ם יִשְׂא֣וּ עֲוֺנָ֑/ם חֻקַּ֤ת עוֹלָם֙ לְ/דֹרֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם וּ/בְ/תוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א יִנְחֲל֖וּ נַחֲלָֽה
verses.translit: v'bd hlvy hv' 't 'bdt 'hl mv'd vhm ysh'v 'vnm chqt 'vlm ldrtykhm vbtvkh bny yshr'l l' ynchlv nchlh
verses.translation: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance.

verses.original: כִּ֞י אֶת מַעְשַׂ֣ר בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרִ֤ימוּ לַֽ/יהוָה֙ תְּרוּמָ֔ה נָתַ֥תִּי לַ/לְוִיִּ֖ם לְ/נַחֲלָ֑ה עַל כֵּן֙ אָמַ֣רְתִּי לָ/הֶ֔ם בְּ/תוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לֹ֥א יִנְחֲל֖וּ נַחֲלָֽה
verses.translit: khy 't m'shr bny yshr'l 'shr yrymv lyhvh trvmh ntty llvym lnchlh 'l khn 'mrty lhm btvkh bny yshr'l l' ynchlv nchlh
verses.translation: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer as an heave offering unto the LORD , I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: וְ/אֶל הַ/לְוִיִּ֣ם תְּדַבֵּר֮ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵ/הֶם֒ כִּֽי תִ֠קְחוּ מֵ/אֵ֨ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת הַֽ/מַּעֲשֵׂ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֧תִּי לָ/כֶ֛ם מֵ/אִתָּ֖/ם בְּ/נַחֲלַתְ/כֶ֑ם וַ/הֲרֵמֹתֶ֤ם מִמֶּ֨/נּוּ֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מַעֲשֵׂ֖ר מִן הַֽ/מַּעֲשֵֽׂר
verses.translit: v'l hlvym tdbr v'mrt 'lhm khy tqchv m't bny yshr'l 't hm'shr 'shr ntty lkhm m'tm bnchltkhm vhrmtm mmnv trvmt yhvh m'shr mn hm'shr
verses.translation: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the LORD , even a tenth part of the tithe.

verses.original: וְ/נֶחְשַׁ֥ב לָ/כֶ֖ם תְּרוּמַתְ/כֶ֑ם כַּ/דָּגָן֙ מִן הַ/גֹּ֔רֶן וְ/כַֽ/מְלֵאָ֖ה מִן הַ/יָּֽקֶב
verses.translit: vnchshb lkhm trvmtkhm khdgn mn hgrn vkhml'h mn hyqb
verses.translation: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.

verses.original: כֵּ֣ן תָּרִ֤ימוּ גַם אַתֶּם֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה מִ/כֹּל֙ מַעְשְׂרֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּקְח֔וּ מֵ/אֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּ/נְתַתֶּ֤ם מִמֶּ֨/נּוּ֙ אֶת תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְ/אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: khn trymv gm 'tm trvmt yhvh mkhl m'shrtykhm 'shr tqchv m't bny yshr'l vnttm mmnv 't trvmt yhvh l'hrn hkhhn
verses.translation: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the LORD of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the LORD’s heave offering to Aaron the priest.

verses.original: מִ/כֹּל֙ מַתְּנֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם תָּרִ֕ימוּ אֵ֖ת כָּל תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה מִ/כָּל חֶלְבּ֔/וֹ אֶֽת מִקְדְּשׁ֖/וֹ מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: mkhl mtntykhm trymv 't khl trvmt yhvh mkhl chlbv 't mqdshv mmnv
verses.translation: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the LORD , of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם בַּ/הֲרִֽימְ/כֶ֤ם אֶת חֶלְבּ/וֹ֙ מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ וְ/נֶחְשַׁב֙ לַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם כִּ/תְבוּאַ֥ת גֹּ֖רֶן וְ/כִ/תְבוּאַ֥ת יָֽקֶב
verses.translit: v'mrt 'lhm bhrymkhm 't chlbv mmnv vnchshb llvym khtbv't grn vkhtbv't yqb
verses.translation: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.

verses.original: וַ/אֲכַלְתֶּ֤ם אֹת/וֹ֙ בְּ/כָל מָק֔וֹם אַתֶּ֖ם וּ/בֵֽיתְ/כֶ֑ם כִּֽי שָׂכָ֥ר הוּא֙ לָ/כֶ֔ם חֵ֥לֶף עֲבֹֽדַתְ/כֶ֖ם בְּ/אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: v'khltm 'tv bkhl mqvm 'tm vbytkhm khy shkhr hv' lkhm chlf 'bdtkhm b'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא תִשְׂא֤וּ עָלָי/ו֙ חֵ֔טְא בַּ/הֲרִֽימְ/כֶ֥ם אֶת חֶלְבּ֖/וֹ מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ וְ/אֶת קָדְשֵׁ֧י בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל לֹ֥א תְחַלְּל֖וּ וְ/לֹ֥א תָמֽוּתוּ
verses.translit: vl' tsh'v 'lyv cht' bhrymkhm 't chlbv mmnv v't qdshy bny yshr'l l' tchllv vl' tmvtv
verses.translation: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְ/אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh v'l 'hrn l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

verses.original: זֹ֚את חֻקַּ֣ת הַ/תּוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר דַּבֵּ֣ר אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְ/יִקְח֣וּ אֵלֶי/ךָ֩ פָרָ֨ה אֲדֻמָּ֜ה תְּמִימָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֵֽין בָּ/הּ֙ מ֔וּם אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא עָלָ֥ה עָלֶ֖י/הָ עֹֽל
verses.translit: z't chqt htvrh 'shr tsvh yhvh l'mr dbr 'l bny yshr'l vyqchv 'lykh prh 'dmh tmymh 'shr 'yn bh mvm 'shr l' 'lh 'lyh 'l
verses.translation: This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and upon which never came yoke:

verses.original: וּ/נְתַתֶּ֣ם אֹתָ֔/הּ אֶל אֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן וְ/הוֹצִ֤יא אֹתָ/הּ֙ אֶל מִ/ח֣וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְ/שָׁחַ֥ט אֹתָ֖/הּ לְ/פָנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vnttm 'th 'l 'l'zr hkhhn vhvtsy' 'th 'l mchvts lmchnh vshcht 'th lpnyv
verses.translation: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֞ח אֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן מִ/דָּמָ֖/הּ בְּ/אֶצְבָּע֑/וֹ וְ/הִזָּ֞ה אֶל נֹ֨כַח פְּנֵ֧י אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵ֛ד מִ/דָּמָ֖/הּ שֶׁ֥בַע פְּעָמִֽים
verses.translit: vlqch 'l'zr hkhhn mdmh b'tsb'v vhzh 'l nkhch pny 'hl mv'd mdmh shb' p'mym
verses.translation: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:

verses.original: וְ/שָׂרַ֥ף אֶת הַ/פָּרָ֖ה לְ/עֵינָ֑י/ו אֶת עֹרָ֤/הּ וְ/אֶת בְּשָׂרָ/הּ֙ וְ/אֶת דָּמָ֔/הּ עַל פִּרְשָׁ֖/הּ יִשְׂרֹֽף
verses.translit: vshrf 't hprh l'ynyv 't 'rh v't bshrh v't dmh 'l prshh yshrf
verses.translation: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֣ח הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן עֵ֥ץ אֶ֛רֶז וְ/אֵז֖וֹב וּ/שְׁנִ֣י תוֹלָ֑עַת וְ/הִשְׁלִ֕יךְ אֶל תּ֖וֹךְ שְׂרֵפַ֥ת הַ/פָּרָֽה
verses.translit: vlqch hkhhn 'ts 'rz v'zvb vshny tvl't vhshlykh 'l tvkh shrpt hprh
verses.translation: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.

verses.original: וְ/כִבֶּ֨ס בְּגָדָ֜י/ו הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן וְ/רָחַ֤ץ בְּשָׂר/וֹ֙ בַּ/מַּ֔יִם וְ/אַחַ֖ר יָב֣וֹא אֶל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְ/טָמֵ֥א הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vkhbs bgdyv hkhhn vrchts bshrv bmym v'chr ybv' 'l hmchnh vtm' hkhhn 'd h'rb
verses.translation: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/שֹּׂרֵ֣ף אֹתָ֔/הּ יְכַבֵּ֤ס בְּגָדָי/ו֙ בַּ/מַּ֔יִם וְ/רָחַ֥ץ בְּשָׂר֖/וֹ בַּ/מָּ֑יִם וְ/טָמֵ֖א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vhshrf 'th ykhbs bgdyv bmym vrchts bshrv bmym vtm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.

verses.original: וְ/אָסַ֣ף אִ֣ישׁ טָה֗וֹר אֵ֚ת אֵ֣פֶר הַ/פָּרָ֔ה וְ/הִנִּ֛יחַ מִ/ח֥וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה בְּ/מָק֣וֹם טָה֑וֹר וְ֠/הָיְתָה לַ/עֲדַ֨ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל לְ/מִשְׁמֶ֛רֶת לְ/מֵ֥י נִדָּ֖ה חַטָּ֥את הִֽוא
verses.translit: v'sf 'ysh thvr 't 'pr hprh vhnych mchvts lmchnh bmqvm thvr vhyth l'dt bny yshr'l lmshmrt lmy ndh cht't hv'
verses.translation: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.

verses.original: וְ֠/כִבֶּס הָ/אֹסֵ֨ף אֶת אֵ֤פֶר הַ/פָּרָה֙ אֶת בְּגָדָ֔י/ו וְ/טָמֵ֖א עַד הָ/עָ֑רֶב וְֽ/הָיְתָ֞ה לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְ/לַ/גֵּ֛ר הַ/גָּ֥ר בְּ/תוֹכָ֖/ם לְ/חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָֽם
verses.translit: vkhbs h'sf 't 'pr hprh 't bgdyv vtm' 'd h'rb vhyth lbny yshr'l vlgr hgr btvkhm lchqt 'vlm
verses.translation: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.

verses.original: הַ/נֹּגֵ֥עַ בְּ/מֵ֖ת לְ/כָל נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֑ם וְ/טָמֵ֖א שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: hng' bmt lkhl npsh 'dm vtm' shb't ymym
verses.translation: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

verses.original: ה֣וּא יִתְחַטָּא ב֞/וֹ בַּ/יּ֧וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֛י וּ/בַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֖י יִטְהָ֑ר וְ/אִם לֹ֨א יִתְחַטָּ֜א בַּ/יּ֧וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֛י וּ/בַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֖י לֹ֥א יִטְהָֽר
verses.translit: hv' ytcht' bv byvm hshlyshy vbyvm hshby'y ythr v'm l' ytcht' byvm hshlyshy vbyvm hshby'y l' ythr
verses.translation: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

verses.original: כָּֽל הַ/נֹּגֵ֡עַ בְּ/מֵ֣ת בְּ/נֶפֶשׁ֩ הָ/אָדָ֨ם אֲשֶׁר יָמ֜וּת וְ/לֹ֣א יִתְחַטָּ֗א אֶת מִשְׁכַּ֤ן יְהוָה֙ טִמֵּ֔א וְ/נִכְרְתָ֛ה הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/הִ֖וא מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּי֩ מֵ֨י נִדָּ֜ה לֹא זֹרַ֤ק עָלָי/ו֙ טָמֵ֣א יִהְיֶ֔ה ע֖וֹד טֻמְאָת֥/וֹ בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khl hng' bmt bnpsh h'dm 'shr ymvt vl' ytcht' 't mshkhn yhvh tm' vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' myshr'l khy my ndh l' zrq 'lyv tm' yhyh 'vd tm'tv bv
verses.translation: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the LORD ; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.

verses.original: זֹ֚את הַ/תּוֹרָ֔ה אָדָ֖ם כִּֽי יָמ֣וּת בְּ/אֹ֑הֶל כָּל הַ/בָּ֤א אֶל הָ/אֹ֨הֶל֙ וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּ/אֹ֔הֶל יִטְמָ֖א שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: z't htvrh 'dm khy ymvt b'hl khl hb' 'l h'hl vkhl 'shr b'hl ytm' shb't ymym
verses.translation: This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

verses.original: וְ/כֹל֙ כְּלִ֣י פָת֔וּחַ אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֵין צָמִ֥יד פָּתִ֖יל עָלָ֑י/ו טָמֵ֖א הֽוּא
verses.translit: vkhl khly ptvch 'shr 'yn tsmyd ptyl 'lyv tm' hv'
verses.translation: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.

verses.original: וְ/כֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּ֜ע עַל פְּנֵ֣י הַ/שָּׂדֶ֗ה בַּֽ/חֲלַל חֶ֨רֶב֙ א֣וֹ בְ/מֵ֔ת אֽוֹ בְ/עֶ֥צֶם אָדָ֖ם א֣וֹ בְ/קָ֑בֶר יִטְמָ֖א שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vkhl 'shr yg' 'l pny hshdh bchll chrb 'v bmt 'v b'tsm 'dm 'v bqbr ytm' shb't ymym
verses.translation: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

verses.original: וְ/לָֽקְחוּ֙ לַ/טָּמֵ֔א מֵ/עֲפַ֖ר שְׂרֵפַ֣ת הַֽ/חַטָּ֑את וְ/נָתַ֥ן עָלָ֛י/ו מַ֥יִם חַיִּ֖ים אֶל כֶּֽלִי
verses.translit: vlqchv ltm' m'pr shrpt hcht't vntn 'lyv mym chyym 'l khly
verses.translation: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:

verses.original: וְ/לָקַ֨ח אֵז֜וֹב וְ/טָבַ֣ל בַּ/מַּיִם֮ אִ֣ישׁ טָהוֹר֒ וְ/הִזָּ֤ה עַל הָ/אֹ֨הֶל֙ וְ/עַל כָּל הַ/כֵּלִ֔ים וְ/עַל הַ/נְּפָשׁ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָֽיוּ שָׁ֑ם וְ/עַל הַ/נֹּגֵ֗עַ בַּ/עֶ֨צֶם֙ א֣וֹ בֶֽ/חָלָ֔ל א֥וֹ בַ/מֵּ֖ת א֥וֹ בַ/קָּֽבֶר
verses.translit: vlqch 'zvb vtbl bmym 'ysh thvr vhzh 'l h'hl v'l khl hkhlym v'l hnpshvt 'shr hyv shm v'l hng' b'tsm 'v bchll 'v bmt 'v bqbr
verses.translation: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:

verses.original: וְ/הִזָּ֤ה הַ/טָּהֹר֙ עַל הַ/טָּמֵ֔א בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֖י וּ/בַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֑י וְ/חִטְּא/וֹ֙ בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י וְ/כִבֶּ֧ס בְּגָדָ֛י/ו וְ/רָחַ֥ץ בַּ/מַּ֖יִם וְ/טָהֵ֥ר בָּ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vhzh hthr 'l htm' byvm hshlyshy vbyvm hshby'y vcht'v byvm hshby'y vkhbs bgdyv vrchts bmym vthr b'rb
verses.translation: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֤ישׁ אֲשֶׁר יִטְמָא֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יִתְחַטָּ֔א וְ/נִכְרְתָ֛ה הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/הִ֖וא מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ הַ/קָּהָ֑ל כִּי֩ אֶת מִקְדַּ֨שׁ יְהוָ֜ה טִמֵּ֗א מֵ֥י נִדָּ֛ה לֹא זֹרַ֥ק עָלָ֖י/ו טָמֵ֥א הֽוּא
verses.translit: v'ysh 'shr ytm' vl' ytcht' vnkhrth hnpsh hhv' mtvkh hqhl khy 't mqdsh yhvh tm' my ndh l' zrq 'lyv tm' hv'
verses.translation: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the LORD : the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.

verses.original: וְ/הָיְתָ֥ה לָּ/הֶ֖ם לְ/חֻקַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם וּ/מַזֵּ֤ה מֵֽי הַ/נִּדָּה֙ יְכַבֵּ֣ס בְּגָדָ֔י/ו וְ/הַ/נֹּגֵ֨עַ֙ בְּ/מֵ֣י הַ/נִּדָּ֔ה יִטְמָ֖א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vhyth lhm lchqt 'vlm vmzh my hndh ykhbs bgdyv vhng' bmy hndh ytm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.

verses.original: וְ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר יִגַּע בּ֥/וֹ הַ/טָּמֵ֖א יִטְמָ֑א וְ/הַ/נֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַ/נֹּגַ֖עַת תִּטְמָ֥א עַד הָ/עָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vkhl 'shr yg' bv htm' ytm' vhnpsh hng't ttm' 'd h'rb
verses.translation: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣אוּ בְנֵֽי יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל כָּל הָ֨/עֵדָ֤ה מִדְבַּר צִן֙ בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽ/רִאשׁ֔וֹן וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב הָ/עָ֖ם בְּ/קָדֵ֑שׁ וַ/תָּ֤מָת שָׁם֙ מִרְיָ֔ם וַ/תִּקָּבֵ֖ר שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyb'v bny yshr'l khl h'dh mdbr tsn bchdsh hr'shvn vyshb h'm bqdsh vtmt shm mrym vtqbr shm
verses.translation: Then came the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא הָ֥יָה מַ֖יִם לָ/עֵדָ֑ה וַ/יִּקָּ֣הֲל֔וּ עַל מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְ/עַֽל אַהֲרֹֽן
verses.translit: vl' hyh mym l'dh vyqhlv 'l mshh v'l 'hrn
verses.translation: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥רֶב הָ/עָ֖ם עִם מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר וְ/ל֥וּ גָוַ֛עְנוּ בִּ/גְוַ֥ע אַחֵ֖י/נוּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyrb h'm 'm mshh vy'mrv l'mr vlv gv'nv bgv' 'chynv lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the LORD !

verses.original: וְ/לָ/מָ֤ה הֲבֵאתֶם֙ אֶת קְהַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה אֶל הַ/מִּדְבָּ֖ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה לָ/מ֣וּת שָׁ֔ם אֲנַ֖חְנוּ וּ/בְעִירֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vlmh hb'tm 't qhl yhvh 'l hmdbr hzh lmvt shm 'nchnv vb'yrnv
verses.translation: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?

verses.original: וְ/לָ/מָ֤ה הֶֽעֱלִיתֻ֨/נוּ֙ מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם לְ/הָבִ֣יא אֹתָ֔/נוּ אֶל הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הָ/רָ֖ע הַ/זֶּ֑ה לֹ֣א מְק֣וֹם זֶ֗רַע וּ/תְאֵנָ֤ה וְ/גֶ֨פֶן֙ וְ/רִמּ֔וֹן וּ/מַ֥יִם אַ֖יִן לִ/שְׁתּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vlmh h'lytnv mmtsrym lhby' 'tnv 'l hmqvm hr' hzh l' mqvm zr' vt'nh vgpn vrmvn vmym 'yn lshtvt
verses.translation: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֜ן מִ/פְּנֵ֣י הַ/קָּהָ֗ל אֶל פֶּ֨תַח֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וַֽ/יִּפְּל֖וּ עַל פְּנֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יֵּרָ֥א כְבוֹד יְהוָ֖ה אֲלֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyb' mshh v'hrn mpny hqhl 'l ptch 'hl mv'd vyplv 'l pnyhm vyr' khbvd yhvh 'lyhm
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto them.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: קַ֣ח אֶת הַ/מַּטֶּ֗ה וְ/הַקְהֵ֤ל אֶת הָ/עֵדָה֙ אַתָּה֙ וְ/אַהֲרֹ֣ן אָחִ֔י/ךָ וְ/דִבַּרְתֶּ֧ם אֶל הַ/סֶּ֛לַע לְ/עֵינֵי/הֶ֖ם וְ/נָתַ֣ן מֵימָ֑י/ו וְ/הוֹצֵאתָ֨ לָ/הֶ֥ם מַ֨יִם֙ מִן הַ/סֶּ֔לַע וְ/הִשְׁקִיתָ֥ אֶת הָ/עֵדָ֖ה וְ/אֶת בְּעִירָֽ/ם
verses.translit: qch 't hmth vhqhl 't h'dh 'th v'hrn 'chykh vdbrtm 'l hsl' l'ynyhm vntn mymyv vhvts't lhm mym mn hsl' vhshqyt 't h'dh v't b'yrm
verses.translation: Take the rod, and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת הַ/מַּטֶּ֖ה מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: vyqch mshh 't hmth mlpny yhvh kh'shr tsvhv
verses.translation: And Moses took the rod from before the LORD , as he commanded him.

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְהִ֜לוּ מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֛ן אֶת הַ/קָּהָ֖ל אֶל פְּנֵ֣י הַ/סָּ֑לַע וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר לָ/הֶ֗ם שִׁמְעוּ נָא֙ הַ/מֹּרִ֔ים הֲ/מִן הַ/סֶּ֣לַע הַ/זֶּ֔ה נוֹצִ֥יא לָ/כֶ֖ם מָֽיִם
verses.translit: vyqhlv mshh v'hrn 't hqhl 'l pny hsl' vy'mr lhm shm'v n' hmrym hmn hsl' hzh nvtsy' lkhm mym
verses.translation: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨רֶם מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת יָד֗/וֹ וַ/יַּ֧ךְ אֶת הַ/סֶּ֛לַע בְּ/מַטֵּ֖/הוּ פַּעֲמָ֑יִם וַ/יֵּצְאוּ֙ מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים וַ/תֵּ֥שְׁתְּ הָ/עֵדָ֖ה וּ/בְעִירָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyrm mshh 't ydv vykh 't hsl' bmthv p'mym vyts'v mym rbym vtsht h'dh vb'yrm
verses.translation: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר יְהוָה֮ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֣ה וְ/אֶֽל אַהֲרֹן֒ יַ֚עַן לֹא הֶאֱמַנְתֶּ֣ם בִּ֔/י לְ/הַ֨קְדִּישֵׁ֔/נִי לְ/עֵינֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לָ/כֵ֗ן לֹ֤א תָבִ֨יאוּ֙ אֶת הַ/קָּהָ֣ל הַ/זֶּ֔ה אֶל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥תִּי לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh v'l 'hrn y'n l' h'mntm by lhqdyshny l'yny bny yshr'l lkhn l' tby'v 't hqhl hzh 'l h'rts 'shr ntty lhm
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.

verses.original: הֵ֚מָּה מֵ֣י מְרִיבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר רָב֥וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּקָּדֵ֖שׁ בָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: hmh my mrybh 'shr rbv bny yshr'l 't yhvh vyqdsh bm
verses.translation: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD , and he was sanctified in them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֧ה מַלְאָכִ֛ים מִ/קָּדֵ֖שׁ אֶל מֶ֣לֶךְ אֱד֑וֹם כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אָחִ֣י/ךָ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתָּ אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/תְּלָאָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר מְצָאָֽתְ/נוּ
verses.translit: vyshlch mshh ml'khym mqdsh 'l mlkh 'dvm khh 'mr 'chykh yshr'l 'th yd't 't khl htl'h 'shr mts'tnv
verses.translation: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:

verses.original: וַ/יֵּרְד֤וּ אֲבֹתֵ֨י/נוּ֙ מִצְרַ֔יְמָ/ה וַ/נֵּ֥שֶׁב בְּ/מִצְרַ֖יִם יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וַ/יָּרֵ֥עוּ לָ֛/נוּ מִצְרַ֖יִם וְ/לַ/אֲבֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vyrdv 'btynv mtsrymh vnshb bmtsrym ymym rbym vyr'v lnv mtsrym vl'btynv
verses.translation: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:

verses.original: וַ/נִּצְעַ֤ק אֶל יְהוָה֙ וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֣ע קֹלֵ֔/נוּ וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֣ח מַלְאָ֔ךְ וַ/יֹּצִאֵ֖/נוּ מִ/מִּצְרָ֑יִם וְ/הִנֵּה֙ אֲנַ֣חְנוּ בְ/קָדֵ֔שׁ עִ֖יר קְצֵ֥ה גְבוּלֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vnts'q 'l yhvh vyshm' qlnv vyshlch ml'kh vyts'nv mmtsrym vhnh 'nchnv bqdsh 'yr qtsh gbvlkh
verses.translation: And when we cried unto the LORD , he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:

verses.original: נַעְבְּרָה נָּ֣א בְ/אַרְצֶ֗/ךָ לֹ֤א נַעֲבֹר֙ בְּ/שָׂדֶ֣ה וּ/בְ/כֶ֔רֶם וְ/לֹ֥א נִשְׁתֶּ֖ה מֵ֣י בְאֵ֑ר דֶּ֧רֶךְ הַ/מֶּ֣לֶךְ נֵלֵ֗ךְ לֹ֤א נִטֶּה֙ יָמִ֣ין וּ/שְׂמֹ֔אול עַ֥ד אֲשֶֽׁר נַעֲבֹ֖ר גְּבוּלֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: n'brh n' b'rtskh l' n'br bshdh vbkhrm vl' nshth my b'r drkh hmlkh nlkh l' nth ymyn vshm'vl 'd 'shr n'br gbvlkh
verses.translation: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king’s high way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ אֱד֔וֹם לֹ֥א תַעֲבֹ֖ר בִּ֑/י פֶּן בַּ/חֶ֖רֶב אֵצֵ֥א לִ/קְרָאתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv 'dvm l' t'br by pn bchrb 'ts' lqr'tkh
verses.translation: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֨וּ אֵלָ֥י/ו בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל בַּֽ/מְסִלָּ֣ה נַעֲלֶה֒ וְ/אִם מֵימֶ֤י/ךָ נִשְׁתֶּה֙ אֲנִ֣י וּ/מִקְנַ֔/י וְ/נָתַתִּ֖י מִכְרָ֑/ם רַ֥ק אֵין דָּבָ֖ר בְּ/רַגְלַ֥/י אֶֽעֱבֹֽרָה
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'lyv bny yshr'l bmslh n'lh v'm mymykh nshth 'ny vmqny vntty mkhrm rq 'yn dbr brgly ''brh
verses.translation: And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing any thing else , go through on my feet.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר לֹ֣א תַעֲבֹ֑ר וַ/יֵּצֵ֤א אֱדוֹם֙ לִ/קְרָאת֔/וֹ בְּ/עַ֥ם כָּבֵ֖ד וּ/בְ/יָ֥ד חֲזָקָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr l' t'br vyts' 'dvm lqr'tv b'm khbd vbyd chzqh
verses.translation: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.

verses.original: וַ/יְמָאֵ֣ן אֱד֗וֹם נְתֹן֙ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עֲבֹ֖ר בִּ/גְבֻל֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֥ט יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵ/עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vym'n 'dvm ntn 't yshr'l 'br bgblv vyt yshr'l m'lyv
verses.translation: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/קָּדֵ֑שׁ וַ/יָּבֹ֧אוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל כָּל הָ/עֵדָ֖ה הֹ֥ר הָ/הָֽר
verses.translit: vys'v mqdsh vyb'v bny yshr'l khl h'dh hr hhr
verses.translation: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֧אמֶר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְ/אֶֽל אַהֲרֹ֖ן בְּ/הֹ֣ר הָ/הָ֑ר עַל גְּב֥וּל אֶֽרֶץ אֱד֖וֹם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh v'l 'hrn bhr hhr 'l gbvl 'rts 'dvm l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,

verses.original: יֵאָסֵ֤ף אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל עַמָּ֔י/ו כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָבֹא֙ אֶל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַ֛ל אֲשֶׁר מְרִיתֶ֥ם אֶת פִּ֖/י לְ/מֵ֥י מְרִיבָֽה
verses.translit: y'sf 'hrn 'l 'myv khy l' yb' 'l h'rts 'shr ntty lbny yshr'l 'l 'shr mrytm 't py lmy mrybh
verses.translation: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.

verses.original: קַ֚ח אֶֽת אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְ/אֶת אֶלְעָזָ֖ר בְּנ֑/וֹ וְ/הַ֥עַל אֹתָ֖/ם הֹ֥ר הָ/הָֽר
verses.translit: qch 't 'hrn v't 'l'zr bnv vh'l 'tm hr hhr
verses.translation: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:

verses.original: וְ/הַפְשֵׁ֤ט אֶֽת אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת בְּגָדָ֔י/ו וְ/הִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֖/ם אֶת אֶלְעָזָ֣ר בְּנ֑/וֹ וְ/אַהֲרֹ֥ן יֵאָסֵ֖ף וּ/מֵ֥ת שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vhpsht 't 'hrn 't bgdyv vhlbshtm 't 'l'zr bnv v'hrn y'sf vmt shm
verses.translation: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people , and shall die there.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה וַֽ/יַּעֲלוּ֙ אֶל הֹ֣ר הָ/הָ֔ר לְ/עֵינֵ֖י כָּל הָ/עֵדָֽה
verses.translit: vy'sh mshh kh'shr tsvh yhvh vy'lv 'l hr hhr l'yny khl h'dh
verses.translation: And Moses did as the LORD commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

verses.original: וַ/יַּפְשֵׁט֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה אֶֽת אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת בְּגָדָ֗י/ו וַ/יַּלְבֵּ֤שׁ אֹתָ/ם֙ אֶת אֶלְעָזָ֣ר בְּנ֔/וֹ וַ/יָּ֧מָת אַהֲרֹ֛ן שָׁ֖ם בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ הָ/הָ֑ר וַ/יֵּ֧רֶד מֹשֶׁ֛ה וְ/אֶלְעָזָ֖ר מִן הָ/הָֽר
verses.translit: vypsht mshh 't 'hrn 't bgdyv vylbsh 'tm 't 'l'zr bnv vymt 'hrn shm br'sh hhr vyrd mshh v'l'zr mn hhr
verses.translation: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.

verses.original: וַ/יִּרְאוּ֙ כָּל הָ֣/עֵדָ֔ה כִּ֥י גָוַ֖ע אַהֲרֹ֑ן וַ/יִּבְכּ֤וּ אֶֽת אַהֲרֹן֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים י֔וֹם כֹּ֖ל בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyr'v khl h'dh khy gv' 'hrn vybkhv 't 'hrn shlshym yvm khl byt yshr'l
verses.translation: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֞ע הַ/כְּנַעֲנִ֤י מֶֽלֶךְ עֲרָד֙ יֹשֵׁ֣ב הַ/נֶּ֔גֶב כִּ֚י בָּ֣א יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל דֶּ֖רֶךְ הָ/אֲתָרִ֑ים וַ/יִּלָּ֨חֶם֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יִּ֥שְׁבְּ מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ שֶֽׁבִי
verses.translit: vyshm' hkhn'ny mlkh 'rd yshb hngb khy b' yshr'l drkh h'trym vylchm byshr'l vyshb mmnv shby
verses.translation: And when king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Israel, and took some of them prisoners.

verses.original: וַ/יִּדַּ֨ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל נֶ֛דֶר לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר אִם נָתֹ֨ן תִּתֵּ֜ן אֶת הָ/עָ֤ם הַ/זֶּה֙ בְּ/יָדִ֔/י וְ/הַֽחֲרַמְתִּ֖י אֶת עָרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vydr yshr'l ndr lyhvh vy'mr 'm ntn ttn 't h'm hzh bydy vhchrmty 't 'ryhm
verses.translation: And Israel vowed a vow unto the LORD , and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֨ע יְהוָ֜ה בְּ/ק֣וֹל יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַ/יִּתֵּן֙ אֶת הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֔י וַ/יַּחֲרֵ֥ם אֶתְ/הֶ֖ם וְ/אֶת עָרֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א שֵׁם הַ/מָּק֖וֹם חָרְמָֽה
verses.translit: vyshm' yhvh bqvl yshr'l vytn 't hkhn'ny vychrm 'thm v't 'ryhm vyqr' shm hmqvm chrmh
verses.translation: And the LORD hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֞וּ מֵ/הֹ֤ר הָ/הָר֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יַם ס֔וּף לִ/סְבֹ֖ב אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֑וֹם וַ/תִּקְצַ֥ר נֶֽפֶשׁ הָ/עָ֖ם בַּ/דָּֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: vys'v mhr hhr drkh ym svf lsbb 't 'rts 'dvm vtqtsr npsh h'm bdrkh
verses.translation: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר הָ/עָ֗ם בֵּֽ/אלֹהִים֮ וּ/בְ/מֹשֶׁה֒ לָ/מָ֤ה הֶֽעֱלִיתֻ֨/נוּ֙ מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם לָ/מ֖וּת בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין לֶ֨חֶם֙ וְ/אֵ֣ין מַ֔יִם וְ/נַפְשֵׁ֣/נוּ קָ֔צָה בַּ/לֶּ֖חֶם הַ/קְּלֹקֵֽל
verses.translit: vydbr h'm b'lhym vbmshh lmh h'lytnv mmtsrym lmvt bmdbr khy 'yn lchm v'yn mym vnpshnv qtsh blchm hqlql
verses.translation: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.

verses.original: וַ/יְשַׁלַּ֨ח יְהוָ֜ה בָּ/עָ֗ם אֵ֚ת הַ/נְּחָשִׁ֣ים הַ/שְּׂרָפִ֔ים וַֽ/יְנַשְּׁכ֖וּ אֶת הָ/עָ֑ם וַ/יָּ֥מָת עַם רָ֖ב מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyshlch yhvh b'm 't hnchshym hshrpym vynshkhv 't h'm vymt 'm rb myshr'l
verses.translation: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹא֩ הָ/עָ֨ם אֶל מֹשֶׁ֜ה וַ/יֹּאמְר֣וּ חָטָ֗אנוּ כִּֽי דִבַּ֤רְנוּ בַֽ/יהוָה֙ וָ/בָ֔/ךְ הִתְפַּלֵּל֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה וְ/יָסֵ֥ר מֵ/עָלֵ֖י/נוּ אֶת הַ/נָּחָ֑שׁ וַ/יִּתְפַּלֵּ֥ל מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּעַ֥ד הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyb' h'm 'l mshh vy'mrv cht'nv khy dbrnv byhvh vbkh htpll 'l yhvh vysr m'lynv 't hnchsh vytpll mshh b'd h'm
verses.translation: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD , and against thee; pray unto the LORD , that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה עֲשֵׂ֤ה לְ/ךָ֙ שָׂרָ֔ף וְ/שִׂ֥ים אֹת֖/וֹ עַל נֵ֑ס וְ/הָיָה֙ כָּל הַ/נָּשׁ֔וּךְ וְ/רָאָ֥ה אֹת֖/וֹ וָ/חָֽי
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh 'shh lkh shrf vshym 'tv 'l ns vhyh khl hnshvkh vr'h 'tv vchy
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֤עַשׂ מֹשֶׁה֙ נְחַ֣שׁ נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וַ/יְשִׂמֵ֖/הוּ עַל הַ/נֵּ֑ס וְ/הָיָ֗ה אִם נָשַׁ֤ךְ הַ/נָּחָשׁ֙ אֶת אִ֔ישׁ וְ/הִבִּ֛יט אֶל נְחַ֥שׁ הַ/נְּחֹ֖שֶׁת וָ/חָֽי
verses.translit: vy'sh mshh nchsh nchsht vyshmhv 'l hns vhyh 'm nshkh hnchsh 't 'ysh vhbyt 'l nchsh hnchsht vchy
verses.translation: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/אֹבֹֽת
verses.translit: vys'v bny yshr'l vychnv b'bt
verses.translation: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מֵ/אֹבֹ֑ת וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֞וּ בְּ/עִיֵּ֣י הָֽעֲבָרִ֗ים בַּ/מִּדְבָּר֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל פְּנֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב מִ/מִּזְרַ֖ח הַ/שָּֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: vys'v m'bt vychnv b'yy h'brym bmdbr 'shr 'l pny mv'b mmzrch hshmsh
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ije-abarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.

verses.original: מִ/שָּׁ֖ם נָסָ֑עוּ וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/נַ֥חַל זָֽרֶד
verses.translit: mshm ns'v vychnv bnchl zrd
verses.translation: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.

verses.original: מִ/שָּׁם֮ נָסָעוּ֒ וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֗וּ מֵ/עֵ֤בֶר אַרְנוֹן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר הַ/יֹּצֵ֖א מִ/גְּב֣וּל הָֽ/אֱמֹרִ֑י כִּ֤י אַרְנוֹן֙ גְּב֣וּל מוֹאָ֔ב בֵּ֥ין מוֹאָ֖ב וּ/בֵ֥ין הָ/אֱמֹרִֽי
verses.translit: mshm ns'v vychnv m'br 'rnvn 'shr bmdbr hyts' mgbvl h'mry khy 'rnvn gbvl mv'b byn mv'b vbyn h'mry
verses.translation: From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites: for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

verses.original: עַל כֵּן֙ יֵֽאָמַ֔ר בְּ/סֵ֖פֶר מִלְחֲמֹ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה אֶת וָהֵ֣ב בְּ/סוּפָ֔ה וְ/אֶת הַ/נְּחָלִ֖ים אַרְנֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'l khn y'mr bspr mlchmt yhvh 't vhb bsvph v't hnchlym 'rnvn
verses.translation: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the LORD , What he did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon,

verses.original: וְ/אֶ֨שֶׁד֙ הַ/נְּחָלִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָטָ֖ה לְ/שֶׁ֣בֶת עָ֑ר וְ/נִשְׁעַ֖ן לִ/גְב֥וּל מוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: v'shd hnchlym 'shr nth lshbt 'r vnsh'n lgbvl mv'b
verses.translation: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, and lieth upon the border of Moab.

verses.original: וּ/מִ/שָּׁ֖ם בְּאֵ֑רָ/ה הִ֣וא הַ/בְּאֵ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ לְ/מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֱסֹף֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם וְ/אֶתְּנָ֥ה לָ/הֶ֖ם מָֽיִם
verses.translit: vmshm b'rh hv' hb'r 'shr 'mr yhvh lmshh 'sf 't h'm v'tnh lhm mym
verses.translation: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof the LORD spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.

verses.original: אָ֚ז יָשִׁ֣יר יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת הַ/שִּׁירָ֖ה הַ/זֹּ֑את עֲלִ֥י בְאֵ֖ר עֱנוּ לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'z yshyr yshr'l 't hshyrh hz't 'ly b'r 'nv lh
verses.translation: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:

verses.original: בְּאֵ֞ר חֲפָר֣וּ/הָ שָׂרִ֗ים כָּר֨וּ/הָ֙ נְדִיבֵ֣י הָ/עָ֔ם בִּ/מְחֹקֵ֖ק בְּ/מִשְׁעֲנֹתָ֑/ם וּ/מִ/מִּדְבָּ֖ר מַתָּנָֽה
verses.translit: b'r chprvh shrym khrvh ndyby h'm bmchqq bmsh'ntm vmmdbr mtnh
verses.translation: The princes digged the well, the nobles of the people digged it, by the direction of the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah:

verses.original: וּ/מִ/מַּתָּנָ֖ה נַחֲלִיאֵ֑ל וּ/מִ/נַּחֲלִיאֵ֖ל בָּמֽוֹת
verses.translit: vmmtnh nchly'l vmnchly'l bmvt
verses.translation: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:

verses.original: וּ/מִ/בָּמ֗וֹת הַ/גַּיְא֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ בִּ/שְׂדֵ֣ה מוֹאָ֔ב רֹ֖אשׁ הַ/פִּסְגָּ֑ה וְ/נִשְׁקָ֖פָה עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַ/יְשִׁימֹֽן
verses.translit: vmbmvt hgy' 'shr bshdh mv'b r'sh hpsgh vnshqph 'l pny hyshymn
verses.translation: And from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh toward Jeshimon.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מַלְאָכִ֔ים אֶל סִיחֹ֥ן מֶֽלֶךְ הָ/אֱמֹרִ֖י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyshlch yshr'l ml'khym 'l sychn mlkh h'mry l'mr
verses.translation: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

verses.original: אֶעְבְּרָ֣ה בְ/אַרְצֶ֗/ךָ לֹ֤א נִטֶּה֙ בְּ/שָׂדֶ֣ה וּ/בְ/כֶ֔רֶם לֹ֥א נִשְׁתֶּ֖ה מֵ֣י בְאֵ֑ר בְּ/דֶ֤רֶךְ הַ/מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ נֵלֵ֔ךְ עַ֥ד אֲשֶֽׁר נַעֲבֹ֖ר גְּבֻלֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: ''brh b'rtskh l' nth bshdh vbkhrm l' nshth my b'r bdrkh hmlkh nlkh 'd 'shr n'br gblkh
verses.translation: Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king’s high way, until we be past thy borders.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא נָתַ֨ן סִיחֹ֣ן אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ עֲבֹ֣ר בִּ/גְבֻל/וֹ֒ וַ/יֶּאֱסֹ֨ף סִיחֹ֜ן אֶת כָּל עַמּ֗/וֹ וַ/יֵּצֵ֞א לִ/קְרַ֤את יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הַ/מִּדְבָּ֔רָ/ה וַ/יָּבֹ֖א יָ֑הְצָ/ה וַ/יִּלָּ֖חֶם בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vl' ntn sychn 't yshr'l 'br bgblv vy'sf sychn 't khl 'mv vyts' lqr't yshr'l hmdbrh vyb' yhtsh vylchm byshr'l
verses.translation: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכֵּ֥/הוּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/פִי חָ֑רֶב וַ/יִּירַ֨שׁ אֶת אַרְצ֜/וֹ מֵֽ/אַרְנֹ֗ן עַד יַבֹּק֙ עַד בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן כִּ֣י עַ֔ז גְּב֖וּל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vykhhv yshr'l lpy chrb vyyrsh 't 'rtsv m'rnn 'd ybq 'd bny 'mvn khy 'z gbvl bny 'mvn
verses.translation: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּח֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵ֥ת כָּל הֶ/עָרִ֖ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה וַ/יֵּ֤שֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּ/כָל עָרֵ֣י הָֽ/אֱמֹרִ֔י בְּ/חֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן וּ/בְ/כָל בְּנֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vyqch yshr'l 't khl h'rym h'lh vyshb yshr'l bkhl 'ry h'mry bchshbvn vbkhl bntyh
verses.translation: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.

verses.original: כִּ֣י חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן עִ֗יר סִיחֹ֛ן מֶ֥לֶךְ הָ/אֱמֹרִ֖י הִ֑וא וְ/ה֣וּא נִלְחַ֗ם בְּ/מֶ֤לֶךְ מוֹאָב֙ הָֽ/רִאשׁ֔וֹן וַ/יִּקַּ֧ח אֶת כָּל אַרְצ֛/וֹ מִ/יָּד֖/וֹ עַד אַרְנֹֽן
verses.translit: khy chshbvn 'yr sychn mlkh h'mry hv' vhv' nlchm bmlkh mv'b hr'shvn vyqch 't khl 'rtsv mydv 'd 'rnn
verses.translation: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֛ן יֹאמְר֥וּ הַ/מֹּשְׁלִ֖ים בֹּ֣אוּ חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן תִּבָּנֶ֥ה וְ/תִכּוֹנֵ֖ן עִ֥יר סִיחֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'l khn y'mrv hmshlym b'v chshbvn tbnh vtkhvnn 'yr sychvn
verses.translation: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:

verses.original: כִּי אֵשׁ֙ יָֽצְאָ֣ה מֵֽ/חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן לֶהָבָ֖ה מִ/קִּרְיַ֣ת סִיחֹ֑ן אָֽכְלָה֙ עָ֣ר מוֹאָ֔ב בַּעֲלֵ֖י בָּמ֥וֹת אַרְנֹֽן
verses.translit: khy 'sh yts'h mchshbvn lhbh mqryt sychn 'khlh 'r mv'b b'ly bmvt 'rnn
verses.translation: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it hath consumed Ar of Moab, and the lords of the high places of Arnon.

verses.original: אוֹי לְ/ךָ֣ מוֹאָ֔ב אָבַ֖דְתָּ עַם כְּמ֑וֹשׁ נָתַ֨ן בָּנָ֤י/ו פְּלֵיטִם֙ וּ/בְנֹתָ֣י/ו בַּ/שְּׁבִ֔ית לְ/מֶ֥לֶךְ אֱמֹרִ֖י סִיחֽוֹן
verses.translit: 'vy lkh mv'b 'bdt 'm khmvsh ntn bnyv plytm vbntyv bshbyt lmlkh 'mry sychvn
verses.translation: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he hath given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.

verses.original: וַ/נִּירָ֛/ם אָבַ֥ד חֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן עַד דִּיב֑וֹן וַ/נַּשִּׁ֣ים עַד נֹ֔פַח אֲשֶׁ֖רׄ עַד מֵֽידְבָֽא
verses.translit: vnyrm 'bd chshbvn 'd dybvn vnshym 'd npch 'shr 'd mydb'
verses.translation: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which reacheth unto Medeba.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨שֶׁב֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּ/אֶ֖רֶץ הָ/אֱמֹרִֽי
verses.translit: vyshb yshr'l b'rts h'mry
verses.translation: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ לְ/רַגֵּ֣ל אֶת יַעְזֵ֔ר וַֽ/יִּלְכְּד֖וּ בְּנֹתֶ֑י/הָ ו/יירש וַ/יּ֖וֹרֶשׁ אֶת הָ/אֱמֹרִ֥י אֲשֶׁר שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vyshlch mshh lrgl 't y'zr vylkhdv bntyh vyyrsh vyvrsh 't h'mry 'shr shm
verses.translation: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְנוּ֙ וַֽ/יַּעֲל֔וּ דֶּ֖רֶךְ הַ/בָּשָׁ֑ן וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א עוֹג֩ מֶֽלֶךְ הַ/בָּשָׁ֨ן לִ/קְרָאתָ֜/ם ה֧וּא וְ/כָל עַמּ֛/וֹ לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה אֶדְרֶֽעִי
verses.translit: vypnv vy'lv drkh hbshn vyts' 'vg mlkh hbshn lqr'tm hv' vkhl 'mv lmlchmh 'dr'y
verses.translation: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל מֹשֶׁה֙ אַל תִּירָ֣א אֹת֔/וֹ כִּ֣י בְ/יָדְ/ךָ֞ נָתַ֧תִּי אֹת֛/וֹ וְ/אֶת כָּל עַמּ֖/וֹ וְ/אֶת אַרְצ֑/וֹ וְ/עָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֗יתָ לְ/סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽ/אֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּ/חֶשְׁבּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh 'l tyr' 'tv khy bydkh ntty 'tv v't khl 'mv v't 'rtsv v'shyt lv kh'shr 'shyt lsychn mlkh h'mry 'shr yvshb bchshbvn
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.

verses.original: וַ/יַּכּ֨וּ אֹת֤/וֹ וְ/אֶת בָּנָי/ו֙ וְ/אֶת כָּל עַמּ֔/וֹ עַד בִּלְתִּ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר ל֖/וֹ שָׂרִ֑יד וַ/יִּֽירְשׁ֖וּ אֶת אַרְצֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vykhv 'tv v't bnyv v't khl 'mv 'd blty hsh'yr lv shryd vyyrshv 't 'rtsv
verses.translation: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽ/יַּחֲנוּ֙ בְּ/עַֽרְב֣וֹת מוֹאָ֔ב מֵ/עֵ֖בֶר לְ/יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ
verses.translit: vys'v bny yshr'l vychnv b'rbvt mv'b m'br lyrdn yrchv
verses.translation: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֥רְא בָּלָ֖ק בֶּן צִפּ֑וֹר אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֥ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לָֽ/אֱמֹרִֽי
verses.translit: vyr' blq bn tspvr 't khl 'shr 'shh yshr'l l'mry
verses.translation: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֨גָר מוֹאָ֜ב מִ/פְּנֵ֥י הָ/עָ֛ם מְאֹ֖ד כִּ֣י רַב ה֑וּא וַ/יָּ֣קָץ מוֹאָ֔ב מִ/פְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vygr mv'b mpny h'm m'd khy rb hv' vyqts mv'b mpny bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר מוֹאָ֜ב אֶל זִקְנֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן עַתָּ֞ה יְלַחֲכ֤וּ הַ/קָּהָל֙ אֶת כָּל סְבִ֣יבֹתֵ֔י/נוּ כִּ/לְחֹ֣ךְ הַ/שּׁ֔וֹר אֵ֖ת יֶ֣רֶק הַ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה וּ/בָלָ֧ק בֶּן צִפּ֛וֹר מֶ֥לֶךְ לְ/מוֹאָ֖ב בָּ/עֵ֥ת הַ/הִֽוא
verses.translit: vy'mr mv'b 'l zqny mdyn 'th ylchkhv hqhl 't khl sbybtynv khlchkh hshvr 't yrq hshdh vblq bn tspvr mlkh lmv'b b't hhv'
verses.translation: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח מַלְאָכִ֜ים אֶל בִּלְעָ֣ם בֶּן בְּע֗וֹר פְּ֠תוֹרָ/ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר עַל הַ/נָּהָ֛ר אֶ֥רֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּ֖/וֹ לִ/קְרֹא ל֑/וֹ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר הִ֠נֵּה עַ֣ם יָצָ֤א מִ/מִּצְרַ֨יִם֙ הִנֵּ֤ה כִסָּה֙ אֶת עֵ֣ין הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וְ/ה֥וּא יֹשֵׁ֖ב מִ/מֻּלִֽ/י
verses.translit: vyshlch ml'khym 'l bl'm bn b'vr ptvrh 'shr 'l hnhr 'rts bny 'mv lqr' lv l'mr hnh 'm yts' mmtsrym hnh khsh 't 'yn h'rts vhv' yshb mmly
verses.translation: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֩ לְכָ/ה נָּ֨א אָֽרָ/ה לִּ֜/י אֶת הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֗ה כִּֽי עָצ֥וּם הוּא֙ מִמֶּ֔/נִּי אוּלַ֤י אוּכַל֙ נַכֶּה בּ֔/וֹ וַ/אֲגָרְשֶׁ֖/נּוּ מִן הָ/אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֣י יָדַ֗עְתִּי אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר תְּבָרֵךְ֙ מְבֹרָ֔ךְ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּאֹ֖ר יוּאָֽר
verses.translit: v'th lkhh n' 'rh ly 't h'm hzh khy 'tsvm hv' mmny 'vly 'vkhl nkhh bv v'grshnv mn h'rts khy yd'ty 't 'shr tbrkh mbrkh v'shr t'r yv'r
verses.translation: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ זִקְנֵ֤י מוֹאָב֙ וְ/זִקְנֵ֣י מִדְיָ֔ן וּ/קְסָמִ֖ים בְּ/יָדָ֑/ם וַ/יָּבֹ֨אוּ֙ אֶל בִּלְעָ֔ם וַ/יְדַבְּר֥וּ אֵלָ֖י/ו דִּבְרֵ֥י בָלָֽק
verses.translit: vylkhv zqny mv'b vzqny mdyn vqsmym bydm vyb'v 'l bl'm vydbrv 'lyv dbry blq
verses.translation: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם לִ֤ינוּ פֹה֙ הַ/לַּ֔יְלָה וַ/הֲשִׁבֹתִ֤י אֶתְ/כֶם֙ דָּבָ֔ר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑/י וַ/יֵּשְׁב֥וּ שָׂרֵֽי מוֹאָ֖ב עִם בִּלְעָֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm lynv ph hlylh vhshbty 'tkhm dbr kh'shr ydbr yhvh 'ly vyshbv shry mv'b 'm bl'm
verses.translation: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל בִּלְעָ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֕אמֶר מִ֛י הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vyb' 'lhym 'l bl'm vy'mr my h'nshym h'lh 'mkh
verses.translation: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר בִּלְעָ֖ם אֶל הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים בָּלָ֧ק בֶּן צִפֹּ֛ר מֶ֥לֶךְ מוֹאָ֖ב שָׁלַ֥ח אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr bl'm 'l h'lhym blq bn tspr mlkh mv'b shlch 'ly
verses.translation: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, saying ,

verses.original: הִנֵּ֤ה הָ/עָם֙ הַ/יֹּצֵ֣א מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם וַ/יְכַ֖ס אֶת עֵ֣ין הָ/אָ֑רֶץ עַתָּ֗ה לְכָ֤/ה קָֽבָ/ה לִּ/י֙ אֹת֔/וֹ אוּלַ֥י אוּכַ֛ל לְ/הִלָּ֥חֶם בּ֖/וֹ וְ/גֵרַשְׁתִּֽי/ו
verses.translit: hnh h'm hyts' mmtsrym vykhs 't 'yn h'rts 'th lkhh qbh ly 'tv 'vly 'vkhl lhlchm bv vgrshtyv
verses.translation: Behold, there is a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶל בִּלְעָ֔ם לֹ֥א תֵלֵ֖ךְ עִמָּ/הֶ֑ם לֹ֤א תָאֹר֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם כִּ֥י בָר֖וּךְ הֽוּא
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lhym 'l bl'm l' tlkh 'mhm l' t'r 't h'm khy brvkh hv'
verses.translation: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they are blessed.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤קָם בִּלְעָם֙ בַּ/בֹּ֔קֶר וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל שָׂרֵ֣י בָלָ֔ק לְכ֖וּ אֶֽל אַרְצְ/כֶ֑ם כִּ֚י מֵאֵ֣ן יְהוָ֔ה לְ/תִתִּ֖/י לַ/הֲלֹ֥ךְ עִמָּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vyqm bl'm bbqr vy'mr 'l shry blq lkhv 'l 'rtskhm khy m'n yhvh ltty lhlkh 'mkhm
verses.translation: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the LORD refuseth to give me leave to go with you.

verses.original: וַ/יָּק֨וּמוּ֙ שָׂרֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל בָּלָ֑ק וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ מֵאֵ֥ן בִּלְעָ֖ם הֲלֹ֥ךְ עִמָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vyqvmv shry mv'b vyb'v 'l blq vy'mrv m'n bl'm hlkh 'mnv
verses.translation: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥סֶף ע֖וֹד בָּלָ֑ק שְׁלֹ֣חַ שָׂרִ֔ים רַבִּ֥ים וְ/נִכְבָּדִ֖ים מֵ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vysf 'vd blq shlch shrym rbym vnkhbdym m'lh
verses.translation: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ אֶל בִּלְעָ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל֗/וֹ כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ בָּלָ֣ק בֶּן צִפּ֔וֹר אַל נָ֥א תִמָּנַ֖ע מֵ/הֲלֹ֥ךְ אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vyb'v 'l bl'm vy'mrv lv khh 'mr blq bn tspvr 'l n' tmn' mhlkh 'ly
verses.translation: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:

verses.original: כִּֽי כַבֵּ֤ד אֲכַבֶּדְ/ךָ֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר תֹּאמַ֥ר אֵלַ֖/י אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֑ה וּ/לְכָ/ה נָּא֙ קָֽבָ/ה לִּ֔/י אֵ֖ת הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: khy khbd 'khbdkh m'd vkhl 'shr t'mr 'ly ''shh vlkhh n' qbh ly 't h'm hzh
verses.translation: For I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַן בִּלְעָ֗ם וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל עַבְדֵ֣י בָלָ֔ק אִם יִתֶּן לִ֥/י בָלָ֛ק מְלֹ֥א בֵית֖/וֹ כֶּ֣סֶף וְ/זָהָ֑ב לֹ֣א אוּכַ֗ל לַ/עֲבֹר֙ אֶת פִּי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔/י לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת קְטַנָּ֖ה א֥וֹ גְדוֹלָֽה
verses.translit: vy'n bl'm vy'mr 'l 'bdy blq 'm ytn ly blq ml' bytv khsf vzhb l' 'vkhl l'br 't py yhvh 'lhy l'shvt qtnh 'v gdvlh
verses.translation: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֗ה שְׁב֨וּ נָ֥א בָ/זֶ֛ה גַּם אַתֶּ֖ם הַ/לָּ֑יְלָה וְ/אֵ֣דְעָ֔ה מַה יֹּסֵ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה דַּבֵּ֥ר עִמִּֽ/י
verses.translit: v'th shbv n' bzh gm 'tm hlylh v'd'h mh ysf yhvh dbr 'my
verses.translation: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the LORD will say unto me more.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֨א אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֶל בִּלְעָם֮ לַיְלָה֒ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗/וֹ אִם לִ/קְרֹ֤א לְ/ךָ֙ בָּ֣אוּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים ק֖וּם לֵ֣ךְ אִתָּ֑/ם וְ/אַ֗ךְ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר אֲדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ אֹת֥/וֹ תַעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vyb' 'lhym 'l bl'm lylh vy'mr lv 'm lqr' lkh b'v h'nshym qvm lkh 'tm v'kh 't hdbr 'shr 'dbr 'lykh 'tv t'shh
verses.translation: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up, and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֤קָם בִּלְעָם֙ בַּ/בֹּ֔קֶר וַֽ/יַּחֲבֹ֖שׁ אֶת אֲתֹנ֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ עִם שָׂרֵ֥י מוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: vyqm bl'm bbqr vychbsh 't 'tnv vylkh 'm shry mv'b
verses.translation: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֣ף אֱלֹהִים֮ כִּֽי הוֹלֵ֣ךְ הוּא֒ וַ/יִּתְיַצֵּ֞ב מַלְאַ֧ךְ יְהוָ֛ה בַּ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ לְ/שָׂטָ֣ן ל֑/וֹ וְ/הוּא֙ רֹכֵ֣ב עַל אֲתֹנ֔/וֹ וּ/שְׁנֵ֥י נְעָרָ֖י/ו עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vychr 'f 'lhym khy hvlkh hv' vytytsb ml'kh yhvh bdrkh lshtn lv vhv' rkhb 'l 'tnv vshny n'ryv 'mv
verses.translation: And God’s anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the LORD stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֣רֶא הָ/אָתוֹן֩ אֶת מַלְאַ֨ךְ יְהוָ֜ה נִצָּ֣ב בַּ/דֶּ֗רֶךְ וְ/חַרְבּ֤/וֹ שְׁלוּפָה֙ בְּ/יָד֔/וֹ וַ/תֵּ֤ט הָֽ/אָתוֹן֙ מִן הַ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ וַ/תֵּ֖לֶךְ בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה וַ/יַּ֤ךְ בִּלְעָם֙ אֶת הָ֣/אָת֔וֹן לְ/הַטֹּתָ֖/הּ הַ/דָּֽרֶךְ
verses.translit: vtr' h'tvn 't ml'kh yhvh ntsb bdrkh vchrbv shlvph bydv vtt h'tvn mn hdrkh vtlkh bshdh vykh bl'm 't h'tvn lhtth hdrkh
verses.translation: And the ass saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹד֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה בְּ/מִשְׁע֖וֹל הַ/כְּרָמִ֑ים גָּדֵ֥ר מִ/זֶּ֖ה וְ/גָדֵ֥ר מִ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'md ml'kh yhvh bmsh'vl hkhrmym gdr mzh vgdr mzh
verses.translation: But the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֨רֶא הָ/אָת֜וֹן אֶת מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֗ה וַ/תִּלָּחֵץ֙ אֶל הַ/קִּ֔יר וַ/תִּלְחַ֛ץ אֶת רֶ֥גֶל בִּלְעָ֖ם אֶל הַ/קִּ֑יר וַ/יֹּ֖סֶף לְ/הַכֹּתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vtr' h'tvn 't ml'kh yhvh vtlchts 'l hqyr vtlchts 't rgl bl'm 'l hqyr vysf lhkhth
verses.translation: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD , she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall: and he smote her again.

verses.original: וַ/יּ֥וֹסֶף מַלְאַךְ יְהוָ֖ה עֲב֑וֹר וַֽ/יַּעֲמֹד֙ בְּ/מָק֣וֹם צָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֵֽין דֶּ֥רֶךְ לִ/נְט֖וֹת יָמִ֥ין וּ/שְׂמֹֽאול
verses.translit: vyvsf ml'kh yhvh 'bvr vy'md bmqvm tsr 'shr 'yn drkh lntvt ymyn vshm'vl
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּ֤רֶא הָֽ/אָתוֹן֙ אֶת מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה וַ/תִּרְבַּ֖ץ תַּ֣חַת בִּלְעָ֑ם וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֣ף בִּלְעָ֔ם וַ/יַּ֥ךְ אֶת הָ/אָת֖וֹן בַּ/מַּקֵּֽל
verses.translit: vtr' h'tvn 't ml'kh yhvh vtrbts tcht bl'm vychr 'f bl'm vykh 't h'tvn bmql
verses.translation: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD , she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam’s anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְתַּ֥ח יְהוָ֖ה אֶת פִּ֣י הָ/אָת֑וֹן וַ/תֹּ֤אמֶר לְ/בִלְעָם֙ מֶה עָשִׂ֣יתִֽי לְ/ךָ֔ כִּ֣י הִכִּיתַ֔/נִי זֶ֖ה שָׁלֹ֥שׁ רְגָלִֽים
verses.translit: vyptch yhvh 't py h'tvn vt'mr lbl'm mh 'shyty lkh khy hkhytny zh shlsh rglym
verses.translation: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר בִּלְעָם֙ לָֽ/אָת֔וֹן כִּ֥י הִתְעַלַּ֖לְתְּ בִּ֑/י ל֤וּ יֶשׁ חֶ֨רֶב֙ בְּ/יָדִ֔/י כִּ֥י עַתָּ֖ה הֲרַגְתִּֽי/ךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr bl'm l'tvn khy ht'llt by lv ysh chrb bydy khy 'th hrgtykh
verses.translation: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.

verses.original: וַ/תֹּ֨אמֶר הָ/אָת֜וֹן אֶל בִּלְעָ֗ם הֲ/לוֹא֩ אָנֹכִ֨י אֲתֹֽנְ/ךָ֜ אֲשֶׁר רָכַ֣בְתָּ עָלַ֗/י מֵ/עֽוֹדְ/ךָ֙ עַד הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה הַֽ/הַסְכֵּ֣ן הִסְכַּ֔נְתִּי לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת לְ/ךָ֖ כֹּ֑ה וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר לֹֽא
verses.translit: vt'mr h'tvn 'l bl'm hlv' 'nkhy 'tnkh 'shr rkhbt 'ly m'vdkh 'd hyvm hzh hhskhn hskhnty l'shvt lkh khh vy'mr l'
verses.translation: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? And he said, Nay.

verses.original: וַ/יְגַ֣ל יְהוָה֮ אֶת עֵינֵ֣י בִלְעָם֒ וַ/יַּ֞רְא אֶת מַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ נִצָּ֣ב בַּ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ וְ/חַרְבּ֥/וֹ שְׁלֻפָ֖ה בְּ/יָד֑/וֹ וַ/יִּקֹּ֥ד וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לְ/אַפָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vygl yhvh 't 'yny bl'm vyr' 't ml'kh yhvh ntsb bdrkh vchrbv shlph bydv vyqd vyshtchv l'pyv
verses.translation: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָי/ו֙ מַלְאַ֣ךְ יְהוָ֔ה עַל מָ֗ה הִכִּ֨יתָ֙ אֶת אֲתֹ֣נְ/ךָ֔ זֶ֖ה שָׁל֣וֹשׁ רְגָלִ֑ים הִנֵּ֤ה אָנֹכִי֙ יָצָ֣אתִי לְ/שָׂטָ֔ן כִּֽי יָרַ֥ט הַ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ לְ/נֶגְדִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv ml'kh yhvh 'l mh hkhyt 't 'tnkh zh shlvsh rglym hnh 'nkhy yts'ty lshtn khy yrt hdrkh lngdy
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because thy way is perverse before me:

verses.original: וַ/תִּרְאַ֨/נִי֙ הָֽ/אָת֔וֹן וַ/תֵּ֣ט לְ/פָנַ֔/י זֶ֖ה שָׁלֹ֣שׁ רְגָלִ֑ים אוּלַי֙ נָטְתָ֣ה מִ/פָּנַ֔/י כִּ֥י עַתָּ֛ה גַּם אֹתְ/כָ֥ה הָרַ֖גְתִּי וְ/אוֹתָ֥/הּ הֶחֱיֵֽיתִי
verses.translit: vtr'ny h'tvn vtt lpny zh shlsh rglym 'vly ntth mpny khy 'th gm 'tkhh hrgty v'vth hchyyty
verses.translation: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר בִּלְעָ֜ם אֶל מַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ חָטָ֔אתִי כִּ֚י לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֥י אַתָּ֛ה נִצָּ֥ב לִ/קְרָאתִ֖/י בַּ/דָּ֑רֶךְ וְ/עַתָּ֛ה אִם רַ֥ע בְּ/עֵינֶ֖י/ךָ אָשׁ֥וּבָה לִּֽ/י
verses.translit: vy'mr bl'm 'l ml'kh yhvh cht'ty khy l' yd'ty khy 'th ntsb lqr'ty bdrkh v'th 'm r' b'ynykh 'shvbh ly
verses.translation: And Balaam said unto the angel of the LORD , I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמֶר֩ מַלְאַ֨ךְ יְהוָ֜ה אֶל בִּלְעָ֗ם לֵ֚ךְ עִם הָ֣/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים וְ/אֶ֗פֶס אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר אֲדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ אֹת֣/וֹ תְדַבֵּ֑ר וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ בִּלְעָ֖ם עִם שָׂרֵ֥י בָלָֽק
verses.translit: vy'mr ml'kh yhvh 'l bl'm lkh 'm h'nshym v'ps 't hdbr 'shr 'dbr 'lykh 'tv tdbr vylkh bl'm 'm shry blq
verses.translation: And the angel of the LORD said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֥ע בָּלָ֖ק כִּ֣י בָ֣א בִלְעָ֑ם וַ/יֵּצֵ֨א לִ/קְרָאת֜/וֹ אֶל עִ֣יר מוֹאָ֗ב אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל גְּב֣וּל אַרְנֹ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּ/קְצֵ֥ה הַ/גְּבֽוּל
verses.translit: vyshm' blq khy b' bl'm vyts' lqr'tv 'l 'yr mv'b 'shr 'l gbvl 'rnn 'shr bqtsh hgbvl
verses.translation: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which is in the border of Arnon, which is in the utmost coast.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר בָּלָ֜ק אֶל בִּלְעָ֗ם הֲ/לֹא֩ שָׁלֹ֨חַ שָׁלַ֤חְתִּי אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לִ/קְרֹא לָ֔/ךְ לָ֥/מָּה לֹא הָלַ֖כְתָּ אֵלָ֑/י הַֽ/אֻמְנָ֔ם לֹ֥א אוּכַ֖ל כַּבְּדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vy'mr blq 'l bl'm hl' shlch shlchty 'lykh lqr' lkh lmh l' hlkht 'ly h'mnm l' 'vkhl khbdkh
verses.translation: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר בִּלְעָ֜ם אֶל בָּלָ֗ק הִֽנֵּה בָ֨אתִי֙ אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ עַתָּ֕ה הֲ/יָכ֥וֹל אוּכַ֖ל דַּבֵּ֣ר מְא֑וּמָה הַ/דָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָשִׂ֧ים אֱלֹהִ֛ים בְּ/פִ֖/י אֹת֥/וֹ אֲדַבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr bl'm 'l blq hnh b'ty 'lykh 'th hykhvl 'vkhl dbr m'vmh hdbr 'shr yshym 'lhym bpy 'tv 'dbr
verses.translation: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥לֶךְ בִּלְעָ֖ם עִם בָּלָ֑ק וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ קִרְיַ֥ת חֻצֽוֹת
verses.translit: vylkh bl'm 'm blq vyb'v qryt chtsvt
verses.translation: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjath-huzoth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּזְבַּ֥ח בָּלָ֖ק בָּקָ֣ר וָ/צֹ֑אן וַ/יְשַׁלַּ֣ח לְ/בִלְעָ֔ם וְ/לַ/שָּׂרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyzbch blq bqr vts'n vyshlch lbl'm vlshrym 'shr 'tv
verses.translation: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י בַ/בֹּ֔קֶר וַ/יִּקַּ֤ח בָּלָק֙ אֶת בִּלְעָ֔ם וַֽ/יַּעֲלֵ֖/הוּ בָּמ֣וֹת בָּ֑עַל וַ/יַּ֥רְא מִ/שָּׁ֖ם קְצֵ֥ה הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyhy bbqr vyqch blq 't bl'm vy'lhv bmvt b'l vyr' mshm qtsh h'm
verses.translation: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost part of the people.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר בִּלְעָם֙ אֶל בָּלָ֔ק בְּנֵה לִ֥/י בָ/זֶ֖ה שִׁבְעָ֣ה מִזְבְּחֹ֑ת וְ/הָכֵ֥ן לִ/י֙ בָּ/זֶ֔ה שִׁבְעָ֥ה פָרִ֖ים וְ/שִׁבְעָ֥ה אֵילִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr bl'm 'l blq bnh ly bzh shb'h mzbcht vhkhn ly bzh shb'h prym vshb'h 'ylym
verses.translation: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.

verses.translit: vy'sh blq kh'shr dbr bl'm vy'l blq vbl'm pr v'yl bmzbch
verses.translation: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר בִּלְעָ֜ם לְ/בָלָ֗ק הִתְיַצֵּב֮ עַל עֹלָתֶ/ךָ֒ וְ/אֵֽלְכָ֗ה אוּלַ֞י יִקָּרֵ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לִ/קְרָאתִ֔/י וּ/דְבַ֥ר מַה יַּרְאֵ֖/נִי וְ/הִגַּ֣דְתִּי לָ֑/ךְ וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ שֶֽׁפִי
verses.translit: vy'mr bl'm lblq htytsb 'l 'ltkh v'lkhh 'vly yqrh yhvh lqr'ty vdbr mh yr'ny vhgdty lkh vylkh shpy
verses.translation: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the LORD will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקָּ֥ר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל בִּלְעָ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗י/ו אֶת שִׁבְעַ֤ת הַֽ/מִּזְבְּחֹת֙ עָרַ֔כְתִּי וָ/אַ֛עַל פָּ֥ר וָ/אַ֖יִל בַּ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vyqr 'lhym 'l bl'm vy'mr 'lyv 't shb't hmzbcht 'rkhty v''l pr v'yl bmzbch
verses.translation: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֧שֶׂם יְהוָ֛ה דָּבָ֖ר בְּ/פִ֣י בִלְעָ֑ם וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר שׁ֥וּב אֶל בָּלָ֖ק וְ/כֹ֥ה תְדַבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vyshm yhvh dbr bpy bl'm vy'mr shvb 'l blq vkhh tdbr
verses.translation: And the LORD put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣שָׁב אֵלָ֔י/ו וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה נִצָּ֖ב עַל עֹלָת֑/וֹ ה֖וּא וְ/כָל שָׂרֵ֥י מוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: vyshb 'lyv vhnh ntsb 'l 'ltv hv' vkhl shry mv'b
verses.translation: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖/וֹ וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר מִן אֲ֠רָם יַנְחֵ֨/נִי בָלָ֤ק מֶֽלֶךְ מוֹאָב֙ מֵֽ/הַרְרֵי קֶ֔דֶם לְכָ/ה֙ אָֽרָ/ה לִּ֣/י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּ/לְכָ֖/ה זֹעֲמָ֥/ה יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vysh' mshlv vy'mr mn 'rm ynchny blq mlkh mv'b mhrry qdm lkhh 'rh ly y'qb vlkhh z'mh yshr'l
verses.translation: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying , Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.

verses.original: מָ֣ה אֶקֹּ֔ב לֹ֥א קַבֹּ֖/ה אֵ֑ל וּ/מָ֣ה אֶזְעֹ֔ם לֹ֥א זָעַ֖ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: mh 'qb l' qbh 'l vmh 'z'm l' z'm yhvh
verses.translation: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom the LORD hath not defied?

verses.original: כִּֽי מֵ/רֹ֤אשׁ צֻרִים֙ אֶרְאֶ֔/נּוּ וּ/מִ/גְּבָע֖וֹת אֲשׁוּרֶ֑/נּוּ הֶן עָם֙ לְ/בָדָ֣ד יִשְׁכֹּ֔ן וּ/בַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם לֹ֥א יִתְחַשָּֽׁב
verses.translit: khy mr'sh tsrym 'r'nv vmgb'vt 'shvrnv hn 'm lbdd yshkhn vbgvym l' ytchshb
verses.translation: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.

verses.original: מִ֤י מָנָה֙ עֲפַ֣ר יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּ/מִסְפָּ֖ר אֶת רֹ֣בַע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל תָּמֹ֤ת נַפְשִׁ/י֙ מ֣וֹת יְשָׁרִ֔ים וּ/תְהִ֥י אַחֲרִיתִ֖/י כָּמֹֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: my mnh 'pr y'qb vmspr 't rb' yshr'l tmt npshy mvt yshrym vthy 'chryty khmhv
verses.translation: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר בָּלָק֙ אֶל בִּלְעָ֔ם מֶ֥ה עָשִׂ֖יתָ לִ֑/י לָ/קֹ֤ב אֹיְבַ/י֙ לְקַחְתִּ֔י/ךָ וְ/הִנֵּ֖ה בֵּרַ֥כְתָּ בָרֵֽךְ
verses.translit: vy'mr blq 'l bl'm mh 'shyt ly lqb 'yby lqchtykh vhnh brkht brkh
verses.translation: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֖עַן וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר הֲ/לֹ֗א אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָשִׂ֤ים יְהוָה֙ בְּ/פִ֔/י אֹת֥/וֹ אֶשְׁמֹ֖ר לְ/דַבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vy'n vy'mr hl' 't 'shr yshym yhvh bpy 'tv 'shmr ldbr
verses.translation: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD hath put in my mouth?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜י/ו בָּלָ֗ק לך לְכָ/ה נָּ֨א אִתִּ֜/י אֶל מָק֤וֹם אַחֵר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּרְאֶ֣/נּוּ מִ/שָּׁ֔ם אֶ֚פֶס קָצֵ֣/הוּ תִרְאֶ֔ה וְ/כֻלּ֖/וֹ לֹ֣א תִרְאֶ֑ה וְ/קָבְ/נוֹ לִ֖/י מִ/שָּֽׁם
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyv blq lkh lkhh n' 'ty 'l mqvm 'chr 'shr tr'nv mshm 'ps qtshv tr'h vkhlv l' tr'h vqbnv ly mshm
verses.translation: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקָּחֵ֨/הוּ֙ שְׂדֵ֣ה צֹפִ֔ים אֶל רֹ֖אשׁ הַ/פִּסְגָּ֑ה וַ/יִּ֨בֶן֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה מִזְבְּחֹ֔ת וַ/יַּ֛עַל פָּ֥ר וָ/אַ֖יִל בַּ/מִּזְבֵּֽחַ
verses.translit: vyqchhv shdh tspym 'l r'sh hpsgh vybn shb'h mzbcht vy'l pr v'yl bmzbch
verses.translation: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל בָּלָ֔ק הִתְיַצֵּ֥ב כֹּ֖ה עַל עֹלָתֶ֑/ךָ וְ/אָנֹכִ֖י אִקָּ֥רֶה כֹּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l blq htytsb khh 'l 'ltkh v'nkhy 'qrh khh
verses.translation: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet the Lord yonder.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקָּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל בִּלְעָ֔ם וַ/יָּ֥שֶׂם דָּבָ֖ר בְּ/פִ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֛אמֶר שׁ֥וּב אֶל בָּלָ֖ק וְ/כֹ֥ה תְדַבֵּֽר
verses.translit: vyqr yhvh 'l bl'm vyshm dbr bpyv vy'mr shvb 'l blq vkhh tdbr
verses.translation: And the LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֣א אֵלָ֗י/ו וְ/הִנּ֤/וֹ נִצָּב֙ עַל עֹ֣לָת֔/וֹ וְ/שָׂרֵ֥י מוֹאָ֖ב אִתּ֑/וֹ וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר ל/וֹ֙ בָּלָ֔ק מַה דִּבֶּ֖ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyb' 'lyv vhnv ntsb 'l 'ltv vshry mv'b 'tv vy'mr lv blq mh dbr yhvh
verses.translation: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the LORD spoken?

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖/וֹ וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר ק֤וּם בָּלָק֙ וּֽ/שֲׁמָ֔ע הַאֲזִ֥ינָ/ה עָדַ֖/י בְּנ֥/וֹ צִפֹּֽר
verses.translit: vysh' mshlv vy'mr qvm blq vshm' h'zynh 'dy bnv tspr
verses.translation: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:

verses.original: לֹ֣א אִ֥ישׁ אֵל֙ וִֽ/יכַזֵּ֔ב וּ/בֶן אָדָ֖ם וְ/יִתְנֶחָ֑ם הַ/ה֤וּא אָמַר֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יַעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְ/דִבֶּ֖ר וְ/לֹ֥א יְקִימֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: l' 'ysh 'l vykhzb vbn 'dm vytnchm hhv' 'mr vl' y'shh vdbr vl' yqymnh
verses.translation: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it ? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?

verses.original: הִנֵּ֥ה בָרֵ֖ךְ לָקָ֑חְתִּי וּ/בֵרֵ֖ךְ וְ/לֹ֥א אֲשִׁיבֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: hnh brkh lqchty vbrkh vl' 'shybnh
verses.translation: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.

verses.original: לֹֽא הִבִּ֥יט אָ֨וֶן֙ בְּ/יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/לֹא רָאָ֥ה עָמָ֖ל בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהָי/ו֙ עִמּ֔/וֹ וּ/תְרוּעַ֥ת מֶ֖לֶךְ בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l' hbyt 'vn by'qb vl' r'h 'ml byshr'l yhvh 'lhyv 'mv vtrv't mlkh bv
verses.translation: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the LORD his God is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.

verses.original: אֵ֖ל מוֹצִיאָ֣/ם מִ/מִּצְרָ֑יִם כְּ/תוֹעֲפֹ֥ת רְאֵ֖ם לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'l mvtsy'm mmtsrym khtv'pt r'm lv
verses.translation: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.

verses.original: כִּ֤י לֹא נַ֨חַשׁ֙ בְּ/יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְ/לֹא קֶ֖סֶם בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כָּ/עֵ֗ת יֵאָמֵ֤ר לְ/יַעֲקֹב֙ וּ/לְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מַה פָּ֖עַל אֵֽל
verses.translit: khy l' nchsh by'qb vl' qsm byshr'l kh't y'mr ly'qb vlyshr'l mh p'l 'l
verses.translation: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!

verses.original: הֶן עָם֙ כְּ/לָבִ֣יא יָק֔וּם וְ/כַ/אֲרִ֖י יִתְנַשָּׂ֑א לֹ֤א יִשְׁכַּב֙ עַד יֹ֣אכַל טֶ֔רֶף וְ/דַם חֲלָלִ֖ים יִשְׁתֶּֽה
verses.translit: hn 'm khlby' yqvm vkh'ry ytnsh' l' yshkhb 'd y'khl trf vdm chllym yshth
verses.translation: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר בָּלָק֙ אֶל בִּלְעָ֔ם גַּם קֹ֖ב לֹ֣א תִקֳּבֶ֑/נּוּ גַּם בָּרֵ֖ךְ לֹ֥א תְבָרֲכֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr blq 'l bl'm gm qb l' tqbnv gm brkh l' tbrkhnv
verses.translation: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַן בִּלְעָ֔ם וַ/יֹּ֖אמֶר אֶל בָּלָ֑ק הֲ/לֹ֗א דִּבַּ֤רְתִּי אֵלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֥/וֹ אֶֽעֱשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vy'n bl'm vy'mr 'l blq hl' dbrty 'lykh l'mr khl 'shr ydbr yhvh 'tv ''shh
verses.translation: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the LORD speaketh, that I must do?

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר בָּלָק֙ אֶל בִּלְעָ֔ם לְכָ/ה נָּא֙ אֶקָּ֣חֲ/ךָ֔ אֶל מָק֖וֹם אַחֵ֑ר אוּלַ֤י יִישַׁר֙ בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י הָ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְ/קַבֹּ֥ת/וֹ לִ֖/י מִ/שָּֽׁם
verses.translit: vy'mr blq 'l bl'm lkhh n' 'qchkh 'l mqvm 'chr 'vly yyshr b'yny h'lhym vqbtv ly mshm
verses.translation: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֥ח בָּלָ֖ק אֶת בִּלְעָ֑ם רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/פְּע֔וֹר הַ/נִּשְׁקָ֖ף עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַ/יְשִׁימֹֽן
verses.translit: vyqch blq 't bl'm r'sh hp'vr hnshqf 'l pny hyshymn
verses.translation: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר בִּלְעָם֙ אֶל בָּלָ֔ק בְּנֵה לִ֥/י בָ/זֶ֖ה שִׁבְעָ֣ה מִזְבְּחֹ֑ת וְ/הָכֵ֥ן לִ/י֙ בָּ/זֶ֔ה שִׁבְעָ֥ה פָרִ֖ים וְ/שִׁבְעָ֥ה אֵילִֽים
verses.translit: vy'mr bl'm 'l blq bnh ly bzh shb'h mzbcht vhkhn ly bzh shb'h prym vshb'h 'ylym
verses.translation: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.

verses.translit: vy'sh blq kh'shr 'mr bl'm vy'l pr v'yl bmzbch
verses.translation: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣רְא בִּלְעָ֗ם כִּ֣י ט֞וֹב בְּ/עֵינֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ לְ/בָרֵ֣ךְ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/לֹא הָלַ֥ךְ כְּ/פַֽעַם בְּ/פַ֖עַם לִ/קְרַ֣את נְחָשִׁ֑ים וַ/יָּ֥שֶׁת אֶל הַ/מִּדְבָּ֖ר פָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vyr' bl'm khy tvb b'yny yhvh lbrkh 't yshr'l vl' hlkh khp'm bp'm lqr't nchshym vysht 'l hmdbr pnyv
verses.translation: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֨א בִלְעָ֜ם אֶת עֵינָ֗י/ו וַ/יַּרְא֙ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שֹׁכֵ֖ן לִ/שְׁבָטָ֑י/ו וַ/תְּהִ֥י עָלָ֖י/ו ר֥וּחַ אֱלֹהִֽים
verses.translit: vysh' bl'm 't 'ynyv vyr' 't yshr'l shkhn lshbtyv vthy 'lyv rvch 'lhym
verses.translation: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding in his tents according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖/וֹ וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר נְאֻ֤ם בִּלְעָם֙ בְּנ֣/וֹ בְעֹ֔ר וּ/נְאֻ֥ם הַ/גֶּ֖בֶר שְׁתֻ֥ם הָ/עָֽיִן
verses.translit: vysh' mshlv vy'mr n'm bl'm bnv b'r vn'm hgbr shtm h'yn
verses.translation: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:

verses.original: נְאֻ֕ם שֹׁמֵ֖עַ אִמְרֵי אֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר מַחֲזֵ֤ה שַׁדַּי֙ יֶֽחֱזֶ֔ה נֹפֵ֖ל וּ/גְל֥וּי עֵינָֽיִם
verses.translit: n'm shm' 'mry 'l 'shr mchzh shdy ychzh npl vglvy 'ynym
verses.translation: He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance , but having his eyes open:

verses.original: מַה טֹּ֥בוּ אֹהָלֶ֖י/ךָ יַעֲקֹ֑ב מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶ֖י/ךָ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: mh tbv 'hlykh y'qb mshkhntykh yshr'l
verses.translation: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!

verses.original: כִּ/נְחָלִ֣ים נִטָּ֔יוּ כְּ/גַנֹּ֖ת עֲלֵ֣י נָהָ֑ר כַּ/אֲהָלִים֙ נָטַ֣ע יְהוָ֔ה כַּ/אֲרָזִ֖ים עֲלֵי מָֽיִם
verses.translit: khnchlym ntyv khgnt 'ly nhr kh'hlym nt' yhvh kh'rzym 'ly mym
verses.translation: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river’s side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters.

verses.original: יִֽזַּל מַ֨יִם֙ מִ/דָּ֣לְיָ֔/ו וְ/זַרְע֖/וֹ בְּ/מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים וְ/יָרֹ֤ם מֵֽ/אֲגַג֙ מַלְכּ֔/וֹ וְ/תִנַּשֵּׂ֖א מַלְכֻתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: yzl mym mdlyv vzr'v bmym rbym vyrm m'gg mlkhv vtnsh' mlkhtv
verses.translation: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.

verses.original: אֵ֚ל מוֹצִיא֣/וֹ מִ/מִּצְרַ֔יִם כְּ/תוֹעֲפֹ֥ת רְאֵ֖ם ל֑/וֹ יֹאכַ֞ל גּוֹיִ֣ם צָרָ֗י/ו וְ/עַצְמֹתֵי/הֶ֛ם יְגָרֵ֖ם וְ/חִצָּ֥י/ו יִמְחָֽץ
verses.translit: 'l mvtsy'v mmtsrym khtv'pt r'm lv y'khl gvym tsryv v'tsmtyhm ygrm vchtsyv ymchts
verses.translation: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.

verses.original: כָּרַ֨ע שָׁכַ֧ב כַּ/אֲרִ֛י וּ/כְ/לָבִ֖יא מִ֣י יְקִימֶ֑/נּוּ מְבָרֲכֶ֣י/ךָ בָר֔וּךְ וְ/אֹרְרֶ֖י/ךָ אָרֽוּר
verses.translit: khr' shkhb kh'ry vkhlby' my yqymnv mbrkhykh brvkh v'rrykh 'rvr
verses.translation: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֤ף בָּלָק֙ אֶל בִּלְעָ֔ם וַ/יִּסְפֹּ֖ק אֶת כַּפָּ֑י/ו וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר בָּלָ֜ק אֶל בִּלְעָ֗ם לָ/קֹ֤ב אֹֽיְבַ/י֙ קְרָאתִ֔י/ךָ וְ/הִנֵּה֙ בֵּרַ֣כְתָּ בָרֵ֔ךְ זֶ֖ה שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִֽים
verses.translit: vychr 'f blq 'l bl'm vyspq 't khpyv vy'mr blq 'l bl'm lqb 'yby qr'tykh vhnh brkht brkh zh shlsh p'mym
verses.translation: And Balak’s anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֖ה בְּרַח לְ/ךָ֣ אֶל מְקוֹמֶ֑/ךָ אָמַ֨רְתִּי֙ כַּבֵּ֣ד אֲכַבֶּדְ/ךָ֔ וְ/הִנֵּ֛ה מְנָעֲ/ךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה מִ/כָּבֽוֹד
verses.translit: v'th brch lkh 'l mqvmkh 'mrty khbd 'khbdkh vhnh mn'kh yhvh mkhbvd
verses.translation: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the LORD hath kept thee back from honour.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר בִּלְעָ֖ם אֶל בָּלָ֑ק הֲ/לֹ֗א גַּ֧ם אֶל מַלְאָכֶ֛י/ךָ אֲשֶׁר שָׁלַ֥חְתָּ אֵלַ֖/י דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr bl'm 'l blq hl' gm 'l ml'khykh 'shr shlcht 'ly dbrty l'mr
verses.translation: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying,

verses.original: אִם יִתֶּן לִ֨/י בָלָ֜ק מְלֹ֣א בֵית/וֹ֮ כֶּ֣סֶף וְ/זָהָב֒ לֹ֣א אוּכַ֗ל לַ/עֲבֹר֙ אֶת פִּ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת טוֹבָ֛ה א֥וֹ רָעָ֖ה מִ/לִּבִּ֑/י אֲשֶׁר יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֥/וֹ אֲדַבֵּֽר
verses.translit: 'm ytn ly blq ml' bytv khsf vzhb l' 'vkhl l'br 't py yhvh l'shvt tvbh 'v r'h mlby 'shr ydbr yhvh 'tv 'dbr
verses.translation: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the LORD , to do either good or bad of mine own mind; but what the LORD saith, that will I speak?

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֕ה הִנְנִ֥/י הוֹלֵ֖ךְ לְ/עַמִּ֑/י לְכָ/ה֙ אִיעָ֣צְ/ךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲשֶׂ֜ה הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּ֛ה לְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֖ בְּ/אַחֲרִ֥ית הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: v'th hnny hvlkh l'my lkhh 'y'tskh 'shr y'shh h'm hzh l'mkh b'chryt hymym
verses.translation: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come therefore, and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖/וֹ וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר נְאֻ֤ם בִּלְעָם֙ בְּנ֣/וֹ בְעֹ֔ר וּ/נְאֻ֥ם הַ/גֶּ֖בֶר שְׁתֻ֥ם הָ/עָֽיִן
verses.translit: vysh' mshlv vy'mr n'm bl'm bnv b'r vn'm hgbr shtm h'yn
verses.translation: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:

verses.original: נְאֻ֗ם שֹׁמֵ֨עַ֙ אִמְרֵי אֵ֔ל וְ/יֹדֵ֖עַ דַּ֣עַת עֶלְי֑וֹן מַחֲזֵ֤ה שַׁדַּי֙ יֶֽחֱזֶ֔ה נֹפֵ֖ל וּ/גְל֥וּי עֵינָֽיִם
verses.translit: n'm shm' 'mry 'l vyd' d't 'lyvn mchzh shdy ychzh npl vglvy 'ynym
verses.translation: He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance , but having his eyes open:

verses.original: אֶרְאֶ֨/נּוּ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א עַתָּ֔ה אֲשׁוּרֶ֖/נּוּ וְ/לֹ֣א קָר֑וֹב דָּרַ֨ךְ כּוֹכָ֜ב מִֽ/יַּעֲקֹ֗ב וְ/קָ֥ם שֵׁ֨בֶט֙ מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּ/מָחַץ֙ פַּאֲתֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב וְ/קַרְקַ֖ר כָּל בְּנֵי שֵֽׁת
verses.translit: 'r'nv vl' 'th 'shvrnv vl' qrvb drkh khvkhb my'qb vqm shbt myshr'l vmchts p'ty mv'b vqrqr khl bny sht
verses.translation: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֨ה אֱד֜וֹם יְרֵשָׁ֗ה וְ/הָיָ֧ה יְרֵשָׁ֛ה שֵׂעִ֖יר אֹיְבָ֑י/ו וְ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֹ֥שֶׂה חָֽיִל
verses.translit: vhyh 'dvm yrshh vhyh yrshh sh'yr 'ybyv vyshr'l 'shh chyl
verses.translation: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.

verses.original: וְ/יֵ֖רְדְּ מִֽ/יַּעֲקֹ֑ב וְ/הֶֽאֱבִ֥יד שָׂרִ֖יד מֵ/עִֽיר
verses.translit: vyrd my'qb vh'byd shryd m'yr
verses.translation: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְא֙ אֶת עֲמָלֵ֔ק וַ/יִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖/וֹ וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר רֵאשִׁ֤ית גּוֹיִם֙ עֲמָלֵ֔ק וְ/אַחֲרִית֖/וֹ עֲדֵ֥י אֹבֵֽד
verses.translit: vyr' 't 'mlq vysh' mshlv vy'mr r'shyt gvym 'mlq v'chrytv 'dy 'bd
verses.translation: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever.

verses.original: וַ/יַּרְא֙ אֶת הַ/קֵּינִ֔י וַ/יִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖/וֹ וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר אֵיתָן֙ מֽוֹשָׁבֶ֔/ךָ וְ/שִׂ֥ים בַּ/סֶּ֖לַע קִנֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vyr' 't hqyny vysh' mshlv vy'mr 'ytn mvshbkh vshym bsl' qnkh
verses.translation: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.

verses.original: כִּ֥י אִם יִהְיֶ֖ה לְ/בָ֣עֵֽר קָ֑יִן עַד מָ֖ה אַשּׁ֥וּר תִּשְׁבֶּֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: khy 'm yhyh lb'r qyn 'd mh 'shvr tshbkh
verses.translation: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖/וֹ וַ/יֹּאמַ֑ר א֕וֹי מִ֥י יִחְיֶ֖ה מִ/שֻּׂמ֥/וֹ אֵֽל
verses.translit: vysh' mshlv vy'mr 'vy my ychyh mshmv 'l
verses.translation: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!

verses.original: וְ/צִים֙ מִ/יַּ֣ד כִּתִּ֔ים וְ/עִנּ֥וּ אַשּׁ֖וּר וְ/עִנּוּ עֵ֑בֶר וְ/גַם ה֖וּא עֲדֵ֥י אֹבֵֽד
verses.translit: vtsym myd khtym v'nv 'shvr v'nv 'br vgm hv' 'dy 'bd
verses.translation: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֣קָם בִּלְעָ֔ם וַ/יֵּ֖לֶךְ וַ/יָּ֣שָׁב לִ/מְקֹמ֑/וֹ וְ/גַם בָּלָ֖ק הָלַ֥ךְ לְ/דַרְכּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyqm bl'm vylkh vyshb lmqmv vgm blq hlkh ldrkhv
verses.translation: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֥שֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּ/שִּׁטִּ֑ים וַ/יָּ֣חֶל הָ/עָ֔ם לִ/זְנ֖וֹת אֶל בְּנ֥וֹת מוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: vyshb yshr'l bshtym vychl h'm lznvt 'l bnvt mv'b
verses.translation: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקְרֶ֣אןָ לָ/עָ֔ם לְ/זִבְחֵ֖י אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֑ן וַ/יֹּ֣אכַל הָ/עָ֔ם וַ/יִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֖וּ לֵֽ/אלֹהֵי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: vtqr'n l'm lzbchy 'lhyhn vy'khl h'm vyshtchvv l'lhyhn
verses.translation: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.

verses.original: וַ/יִּצָּ֥מֶד יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ/בַ֣עַל פְּע֑וֹר וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytsmd yshr'l lb'l p'vr vychr 'f yhvh byshr'l
verses.translation: And Israel joined himself unto Baal-peor: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה קַ֚ח אֶת כָּל רָאשֵׁ֣י הָ/עָ֔ם וְ/הוֹקַ֥ע אוֹתָ֛/ם לַ/יהוָ֖ה נֶ֣גֶד הַ/שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וְ/יָשֹׁ֛ב חֲר֥וֹן אַף יְהוָ֖ה מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh qch 't khl r'shy h'm vhvq' 'vtm lyhvh ngd hshmsh vyshb chrvn 'f yhvh myshr'l
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the LORD against the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may be turned away from Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל שֹׁפְטֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הִרְגוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֲנָשָׁ֔י/ו הַ/נִּצְמָדִ֖ים לְ/בַ֥עַל פְּעֽוֹר
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l shpty yshr'l hrgv 'ysh 'nshyv hntsmdym lb'l p'vr
verses.translation: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baal-peor.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֡ה אִישׁ֩ מִ/בְּנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל בָּ֗א וַ/יַּקְרֵ֤ב אֶל אֶחָי/ו֙ אֶת הַ/מִּדְיָנִ֔ית לְ/עֵינֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה וּ/לְ/עֵינֵ֖י כָּל עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/הֵ֣מָּה בֹכִ֔ים פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד
verses.translit: vhnh 'ysh mbny yshr'l b' vyqrb 'l 'chyv 't hmdynyt l'yny mshh vl'yny khl 'dt bny yshr'l vhmh bkhym ptch 'hl mv'd
verses.translation: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
