verses.original: וַ/יַּ֗רְא פִּֽינְחָס֙ בֶּן אֶלְעָזָ֔ר בֶּֽן אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן וַ/יָּ֨קָם֙ מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ הָֽ/עֵדָ֔ה וַ/יִּקַּ֥ח רֹ֖מַח בְּ/יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyr' pynchs bn 'l'zr bn 'hrn hkhhn vyqm mtvkh h'dh vyqch rmch bydv
verses.translation: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it , he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;

verses.original: וַ֠/יָּבֹא אַחַ֨ר אִֽישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶל הַ/קֻּבָּ֗ה וַ/יִּדְקֹר֙ אֶת שְׁנֵי/הֶ֔ם אֵ֚ת אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אֶת הָ/אִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל קֳבָתָ֑/הּ וַ/תֵּֽעָצַר֙ הַ/מַּגֵּפָ֔ה מֵ/עַ֖ל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyb' 'chr 'ysh yshr'l 'l hqbh vydqr 't shnyhm 't 'ysh yshr'l v't h'shh 'l qbth vt'tsr hmgph m'l bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֕וּ הַ/מֵּתִ֖ים בַּ/מַּגֵּפָ֑ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vyhyv hmtym bmgph 'rb'h v'shrym 'lf
verses.translation: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: פִּֽינְחָ֨ס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָ֜ר בֶּן אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן הֵשִׁ֤יב אֶת חֲמָתִ/י֙ מֵ/עַ֣ל בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּ/קַנְא֥/וֹ אֶת קִנְאָתִ֖/י בְּ/תוֹכָ֑/ם וְ/לֹא כִלִּ֥יתִי אֶת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/קִנְאָתִֽ/י
verses.translit: pynchs bn 'l'zr bn 'hrn hkhhn hshyb 't chmty m'l bny yshr'l bqn'v 't qn'ty btvkhm vl' khlyty 't bny yshr'l bqn'ty
verses.translation: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.

verses.original: לָ/כֵ֖ן אֱמֹ֑ר הִנְנִ֨/י נֹתֵ֥ן ל֛/וֹ אֶת בְּרִיתִ֖/י שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: lkhn 'mr hnny ntn lv 't bryty shlvm
verses.translation: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:

verses.original: וְ/הָ֤יְתָה לּ/וֹ֙ וּ/לְ/זַרְע֣/וֹ אַחֲרָ֔י/ו בְּרִ֖ית כְּהֻנַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֤ר קִנֵּא֙ לֵֽ/אלֹהָ֔י/ו וַ/יְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhyth lv vlzr'v 'chryv bryt khhnt 'vlm tcht 'shr qn' l'lhyv vykhpr 'l bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/שֵׁם֩ אִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הַ/מֻּכֶּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֻכָּה֙ אֶת הַ/מִּדְיָנִ֔ית זִמְרִ֖י בֶּן סָל֑וּא נְשִׂ֥יא בֵֽית אָ֖ב לַ/שִּׁמְעֹנִֽי
verses.translit: vshm 'ysh yshr'l hmkhh 'shr hkhh 't hmdynyt zmry bn slv' nshy' byt 'b lshm'ny
verses.translation: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.

verses.original: וְ/שֵׁ֨ם הָֽ/אִשָּׁ֧ה הַ/מֻּכָּ֛ה הַ/מִּדְיָנִ֖ית כָּזְבִּ֣י בַת צ֑וּר רֹ֣אשׁ אֻמּ֥וֹת בֵּֽית אָ֛ב בְּ/מִדְיָ֖ן הֽוּא
verses.translit: vshm h'shh hmkhh hmdynyt khzby bt tsvr r'sh 'mvt byt 'b bmdyn hv'
verses.translation: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head over a people, and of a chief house in Midian.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: צָר֖וֹר אֶת הַ/מִּדְיָנִ֑ים וְ/הִכִּיתֶ֖ם אוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: tsrvr 't hmdynym vhkhytm 'vtm
verses.translation: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:

verses.original: כִּ֣י צֹרְרִ֥ים הֵם֙ לָ/כֶ֔ם בְּ/נִכְלֵי/הֶ֛ם אֲשֶׁר נִכְּל֥וּ לָ/כֶ֖ם עַל דְּבַר פְּע֑וֹר וְ/עַל דְּבַ֞ר כָּזְבִּ֨י בַת נְשִׂ֤יא מִדְיָן֙ אֲחֹתָ֔/ם הַ/מֻּכָּ֥ה בְ/יוֹם הַ/מַּגֵּפָ֖ה עַל דְּבַר פְּעֽוֹר
verses.translit: khy tsrrym hm lkhm bnkhlyhm 'shr nkhlv lkhm 'l dbr p'vr v'l dbr khzby bt nshy' mdyn 'chtm hmkhh byvm hmgph 'l dbr p'vr
verses.translation: For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor’s sake.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְ/אֶ֧ל אֶלְעָזָ֛ר בֶּן אַהֲרֹ֥ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh v'l 'l'zr bn 'hrn hkhhn l'mr
verses.translation: And it came to pass after the plague, that the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

verses.original: שְׂא֞וּ אֶת רֹ֣אשׁ כָּל עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֛ה וָ/מַ֖עְלָ/ה לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם כָּל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָ֖א בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: sh'v 't r'sh khl 'dt bny yshr'l mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh lbyt 'btm khl yts' tsb' byshr'l
verses.translation: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers’ house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֨ר מֹשֶׁ֜ה וְ/אֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן אֹתָ֖/ם בְּ/עַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֑ב עַל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵח֖וֹ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr mshh v'l'zr hkhhn 'tm b'rbt mv'b 'l yrdn yrchv l'mr
verses.translation: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

verses.original: מִ/בֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֩ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה אֶת מֹשֶׁה֙ וּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַ/יֹּצְאִ֖ים מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh vbny yshr'l hyts'ym m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Take the sum of the people , from twenty years old and upward; as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.

verses.original: רְאוּבֵ֖ן בְּכ֣וֹר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֗ן חֲנוֹךְ֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַ/חֲנֹכִ֔י לְ/פַלּ֕וּא מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/פַּלֻּאִֽי
verses.translit: r'vbn bkhvr yshr'l bny r'vbn chnvkh mshpcht hchnkhy lplv' mshpcht hpl'y
verses.translation: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:

verses.original: לְ/חֶצְרֹ֕ן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽ/חֶצְרוֹנִ֑י לְ/כַרְמִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/כַּרְמִֽי
verses.translit: lchtsrn mshpcht hchtsrvny lkhrmy mshpcht hkhrmy
verses.translation: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הָ/רֻֽאוּבֵנִ֑י וַ/יִּהְי֣וּ פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֗ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה וְ/אַרְבָּעִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וּ/שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וּ/שְׁלֹשִֽׁים
verses.translit: 'lh mshpcht hr'vbny vyhyv pqdyhm shlshh v'rb'ym 'lf vshb' m'vt vshlshym
verses.translation: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֥י פַלּ֖וּא אֱלִיאָֽב
verses.translit: vbny plv' 'ly'b
verses.translation: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י אֱלִיאָ֔ב נְמוּאֵ֖ל וְ/דָתָ֣ן וַ/אֲבִירָ֑ם הֽוּא דָתָ֨ן וַ/אֲבִירָ֜ם קרואי קְרִיאֵ֣י הָ/עֵדָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִצּ֜וּ עַל מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְ/עַֽל אַהֲרֹן֙ בַּ/עֲדַת קֹ֔רַח בְּ/הַצֹּתָ֖/ם עַל יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vbny 'ly'b nmv'l vdtn v'byrm hv' dtn v'byrm qrv'y qry'y h'dh 'shr htsv 'l mshh v'l 'hrn b'dt qrch bhtstm 'l yhvh
verses.translation: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, which were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the LORD :

verses.original: וַ/תִּפְתַּ֨ח הָ/אָ֜רֶץ אֶת פִּ֗י/הָ וַ/תִּבְלַ֥ע אֹתָ֛/ם וְ/אֶת קֹ֖רַח בְּ/מ֣וֹת הָ/עֵדָ֑ה בַּ/אֲכֹ֣ל הָ/אֵ֗שׁ אֵ֣ת חֲמִשִּׁ֤ים וּ/מָאתַ֨יִם֙ אִ֔ישׁ וַ/יִּהְי֖וּ לְ/נֵֽס
verses.translit: vtptch h'rts 't pyh vtbl' 'tm v't qrch bmvt h'dh b'khl h'sh 't chmshym vm'tym 'ysh vyhyv lns
verses.translation: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵי קֹ֖רַח לֹא מֵֽתוּ
verses.translit: vbny qrch l' mtv
verses.translation: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְעוֹן֮ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ/ם֒ לִ/נְמוּאֵ֗ל מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַ/נְּמ֣וּאֵלִ֔י לְ/יָמִ֕ין מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/יָּמִינִ֑י לְ/יָכִ֕ין מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/יָּכִינִֽי
verses.translit: bny shm'vn lmshpchtm lnmv'l mshpcht hnmv'ly lymyn mshpcht hymyny lykhyn mshpcht hykhyny
verses.translation: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:

verses.original: לְ/זֶ֕רַח מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/זַּרְחִ֑י לְ/שָׁא֕וּל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/שָּׁאוּלִֽי
verses.translit: lzrch mshpcht hzrchy lsh'vl mshpcht hsh'vly
verses.translation: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַ/שִּׁמְעֹנִ֑י שְׁנַ֧יִם וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּ/מָאתָֽיִם
verses.translit: 'lh mshpcht hshm'ny shnym v'shrym 'lf vm'tym
verses.translation: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י גָד֮ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ/ם֒ לִ/צְפ֗וֹן מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַ/צְּפוֹנִ֔י לְ/חַגִּ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽ/חַגִּ֑י לְ/שׁוּנִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/שּׁוּנִֽי
verses.translit: bny gd lmshpchtm ltspvn mshpcht htspvny lchgy mshpcht hchgy lshvny mshpcht hshvny
verses.translation: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:

verses.original: לְ/אָזְנִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָ/אָזְנִ֑י לְ/עֵרִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָ/עֵרִֽי
verses.translit: l'zny mshpcht h'zny l'ry mshpcht h'ry
verses.translation: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:

verses.original: לַ/אֲר֕וֹד מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָ/אֲרוֹדִ֑י לְ/אַ֨רְאֵלִ֔י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָ/אַרְאֵלִֽי
verses.translit: l'rvd mshpcht h'rvdy l'r'ly mshpcht h'r'ly
verses.translation: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת בְּנֵֽי גָ֖ד לִ/פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'lh mshpcht bny gd lpqdyhm 'rb'ym 'lf vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה עֵ֣ר וְ/אוֹנָ֑ן וַ/יָּ֥מָת עֵ֛ר וְ/אוֹנָ֖ן בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן
verses.translit: bny yhvdh 'r v'vnn vymt 'r v'vnn b'rts khn'n
verses.translation: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֣וּ בְנֵי יְהוּדָה֮ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ/ם֒ לְ/שֵׁלָ֗ה מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַ/שֵּׁ֣לָנִ֔י לְ/פֶ֕רֶץ מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/פַּרְצִ֑י לְ/זֶ֕רַח מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/זַּרְחִֽי
verses.translit: vyhyv bny yhvdh lmshpchtm lshlh mshpcht hshlny lprts mshpcht hprtsy lzrch mshpcht hzrchy
verses.translation: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֣וּ בְנֵי פֶ֔רֶץ לְ/חֶצְרֹ֕ן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽ/חֶצְרֹנִ֑י לְ/חָמ֕וּל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הֶ/חָמוּלִֽי
verses.translit: vyhyv bny prts lchtsrn mshpcht hchtsrny lchmvl mshpcht hchmvly
verses.translation: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת יְהוּדָ֖ה לִ/פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֑ם שִׁשָּׁ֧ה וְ/שִׁבְעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'lh mshpcht yhvdh lpqdyhm shshh vshb'ym 'lf vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י יִשָּׂשכָר֙ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔/ם תּוֹלָ֕ע מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/תּוֹלָעִ֑י לְ/פֻוָ֕ה מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/פּוּנִֽי
verses.translit: bny yshshkhr lmshpchtm tvl' mshpcht htvl'y lpvh mshpcht hpvny
verses.translation: Of the sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:

verses.original: לְ/יָשׁ֕וּב מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/יָּשׁוּבִ֑י לְ/שִׁמְרֹ֕ן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/שִּׁמְרֹנִֽי
verses.translit: lyshvb mshpcht hyshvby lshmrn mshpcht hshmrny
verses.translation: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת יִשָּׂשכָ֖ר לִ/פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וְ/שִׁשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּ/שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'lh mshpcht yshshkhr lpqdyhm 'rb'h vshshym 'lf vshlsh m'vt
verses.translation: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י זְבוּלֻן֮ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ/ם֒ לְ/סֶ֗רֶד מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַ/סַּרְדִּ֔י לְ/אֵל֕וֹן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָ/אֵלֹנִ֑י לְ/יַ֨חְלְאֵ֔ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/יַּחְלְאֵלִֽי
verses.translit: bny zbvln lmshpchtm lsrd mshpcht hsrdy l'lvn mshpcht h'lny lychl'l mshpcht hychl'ly
verses.translation: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַ/זְּבוּלֹנִ֖י לִ/פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֑ם שִׁשִּׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'lh mshpcht hzbvlny lpqdyhm shshym 'lf vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י יוֹסֵ֖ף לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה וְ/אֶפְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: bny yvsf lmshpchtm mnshh v'prym
verses.translation: The sons of Joseph after their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה לְ/מָכִיר֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַ/מָּכִירִ֔י וּ/מָכִ֖יר הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת גִּלְעָ֑ד לְ/גִלְעָ֕ד מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/גִּלְעָדִֽי
verses.translit: bny mnshh lmkhyr mshpcht hmkhyry vmkhyr hvlyd 't gl'd lgl'd mshpcht hgl'dy
verses.translation: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites.

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י גִלְעָ֔ד אִיעֶ֕זֶר מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָ/אִֽיעֶזְרִ֑י לְ/חֵ֕לֶק מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽ/חֶלְקִֽי
verses.translit: 'lh bny gl'd 'y'zr mshpcht h'y'zry lchlq mshpcht hchlqy
verses.translation: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:

verses.original: וְ/אַ֨שְׂרִיאֵ֔ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָֽ/אַשְׂרִֽאֵלִ֑י וְ/שֶׁ֕כֶם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/שִּׁכְמִֽי
verses.translit: v'shry'l mshpcht h'shr'ly vshkhm mshpcht hshkhmy
verses.translation: And of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמִידָ֕ע מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/שְּׁמִידָעִ֑י וְ/חֵ֕פֶר מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽ/חֶפְרִֽי
verses.translit: vshmyd' mshpcht hshmyd'y vchpr mshpcht hchpry
verses.translation: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

verses.original: וּ/צְלָפְחָ֣ד בֶּן חֵ֗פֶר לֹא הָ֥יוּ ל֛/וֹ בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם בָּנ֑וֹת וְ/שֵׁם֙ בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָ֔ד מַחְלָ֣ה וְ/נֹעָ֔ה חָגְלָ֥ה מִלְכָּ֖ה וְ/תִרְצָֽה
verses.translit: vtslpchd bn chpr l' hyv lv bnym khy 'm bnvt vshm bnvt tslpchd mchlh vn'h chglh mlkhh vtrtsh
verses.translation: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וּ/פְקֻ֣דֵי/הֶ֔ם שְׁנַ֧יִם וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּ/שְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'lh mshpcht mnshh vpqdyhm shnym vchmshym 'lf vshb' m'vt
verses.translation: These are the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בְנֵי אֶפְרַיִם֮ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ/ם֒ לְ/שׁוּתֶ֗לַח מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַ/שֻּׁ֣תַלְחִ֔י לְ/בֶ֕כֶר מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/בַּכְרִ֑י לְ/תַ֕חַן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽ/תַּחֲנִֽי
verses.translit: 'lh bny 'prym lmshpchtm lshvtlch mshpcht hshtlchy lbkhr mshpcht hbkhry ltchn mshpcht htchny
verses.translation: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י שׁוּתָ֑לַח לְ/עֵרָ֕ן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָ/עֵרָנִֽי
verses.translit: v'lh bny shvtlch l'rn mshpcht h'rny
verses.translation: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֤ת בְּנֵי אֶפְרַ֨יִם֙ לִ/פְקֻ֣דֵי/הֶ֔ם שְׁנַ֧יִם וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַ/חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵי יוֹסֵ֖ף לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'lh mshpcht bny 'prym lpqdyhm shnym vshlshym 'lf vchmsh m'vt 'lh bny yvsf lmshpchtm
verses.translation: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִן֮ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ/ם֒ לְ/בֶ֗לַע מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַ/בַּלְעִ֔י לְ/אַשְׁבֵּ֕ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָֽ/אַשְׁבֵּלִ֑י לַ/אֲחִירָ֕ם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָ/אֲחִירָמִֽי
verses.translit: bny bnymn lmshpchtm lbl' mshpcht hbl'y l'shbl mshpcht h'shbly l'chyrm mshpcht h'chyrmy
verses.translation: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:

verses.original: לִ/שְׁפוּפָ֕ם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/שּׁוּפָמִ֑י לְ/חוּפָ֕ם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/חוּפָמִֽי
verses.translit: lshpvpm mshpcht hshvpmy lchvpm mshpcht hchvpmy
verses.translation: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֥וּ בְנֵי בֶ֖לַע אַ֣רְדְּ וְ/נַעֲמָ֑ן מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הָֽ/אַרְדִּ֔י לְ/נַֽעֲמָ֔ן מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽ/נַּעֲמִֽי
verses.translit: vyhyv bny bl' 'rd vn'mn mshpcht h'rdy ln'mn mshpcht hn'my
verses.translation: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard , the family of the Ardites: and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

verses.original: אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵי בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם וּ/פְקֻ֣דֵי/הֶ֔ם חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְ/שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'lh bny bnymn lmshpchtm vpqdyhm chmshh v'rb'ym 'lf vshsh m'vt
verses.translation: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.

verses.original: אֵ֤לֶּה בְנֵי דָן֙ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔/ם לְ/שׁוּחָ֕ם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/שּׁוּחָמִ֑י אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת דָּ֖ן לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'lh bny dn lmshpchtm lshvchm mshpcht hshvchmy 'lh mshpcht dn lmshpchtm
verses.translation: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

verses.original: כָּל מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַ/שּׁוּחָמִ֖י לִ/פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וְ/שִׁשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: khl mshpcht hshvchmy lpqdyhm 'rb'h vshshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt
verses.translation: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י אָשֵׁר֮ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ/ם֒ לְ/יִמְנָ֗ה מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַ/יִּמְנָ֔ה לְ/יִשְׁוִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/יִּשְׁוִ֑י לִ/בְרִיעָ֕ה מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/בְּרִיעִֽי
verses.translit: bny 'shr lmshpchtm lymnh mshpcht hymnh lyshvy mshpcht hyshvy lbry'h mshpcht hbry'y
verses.translation: Of the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֣י בְרִיעָ֔ה לְ/חֶ֕בֶר מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַֽ/חֶבְרִ֑י לְ/מַ֨לְכִּיאֵ֔ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/מַּלְכִּיאֵלִֽי
verses.translit: lbny bry'h lchbr mshpcht hchbry lmlkhy'l mshpcht hmlkhy'ly
verses.translation: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

verses.original: וְ/שֵׁ֥ם בַּת אָשֵׁ֖ר שָֽׂרַח
verses.translit: vshm bt 'shr shrch
verses.translation: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת בְּנֵי אָשֵׁ֖ר לִ/פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֑ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֧ה וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'lh mshpcht bny 'shr lpqdyhm shlshh vchmshym 'lf v'rb' m'vt
verses.translation: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֤י נַפְתָּלִי֙ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔/ם לְ/יַ֨חְצְאֵ֔ל מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/יַּחְצְאֵלִ֑י לְ/גוּנִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/גּוּנִֽי
verses.translit: bny nptly lmshpchtm lychts'l mshpcht hychts'ly lgvny mshpcht hgvny
verses.translation: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:

verses.original: לְ/יֵ֕צֶר מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/יִּצְרִ֑י לְ/שִׁלֵּ֕ם מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/שִּׁלֵּמִֽי
verses.translit: lytsr mshpcht hytsry lshlm mshpcht hshlmy
verses.translation: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת נַפְתָּלִ֖י לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑/ם וּ/פְקֻ֣דֵי/הֶ֔ם חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: 'lh mshpcht nptly lmshpchtm vpqdyhm chmshh v'rb'ym 'lf v'rb' m'vt
verses.translation: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.

verses.original: אֵ֗לֶּה פְּקוּדֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שֵׁשׁ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף וָ/אָ֑לֶף שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וּ/שְׁלֹשִֽׁים
verses.translit: 'lh pqvdy bny yshr'l shsh m'vt 'lf v'lf shb' m'vt vshlshym
verses.translation: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: לָ/אֵ֗לֶּה תֵּחָלֵ֥ק הָ/אָ֛רֶץ בְּ/נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּ/מִסְפַּ֥ר שֵׁמֽוֹת
verses.translit: l'lh tchlq h'rts bnchlh bmspr shmvt
verses.translation: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

verses.original: לָ/רַ֗ב תַּרְבֶּה֙ נַחֲלָת֔/וֹ וְ/לַ/מְעַ֕ט תַּמְעִ֖יט נַחֲלָת֑/וֹ אִ֚ישׁ לְ/פִ֣י פְקֻדָ֔י/ו יֻתַּ֖ן נַחֲלָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: lrb trbh nchltv vlm't tm'yt nchltv 'ysh lpy pqdyv ytn nchltv
verses.translation: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.

verses.original: אַךְ בְּ/גוֹרָ֕ל יֵחָלֵ֖ק אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ לִ/שְׁמ֥וֹת מַטּוֹת אֲבֹתָ֖/ם יִנְחָֽלוּ
verses.translit: 'kh bgvrl ychlq 't h'rts lshmvt mtvt 'btm ynchlv
verses.translation: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

verses.original: עַל פִּי֙ הַ/גּוֹרָ֔ל תֵּחָלֵ֖ק נַחֲלָת֑/וֹ בֵּ֥ין רַ֖ב לִ/מְעָֽט
verses.translit: 'l py hgvrl tchlq nchltv byn rb lm't
verses.translation: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה פְקוּדֵ֣י הַ/לֵּוִי֮ לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ/ם֒ לְ/גֵרְשׁ֗וֹן מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַ/גֵּ֣רְשֻׁנִּ֔י לִ/קְהָ֕ת מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/קְּהָתִ֑י לִ/מְרָרִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/מְּרָרִֽי
verses.translit: v'lh pqvdy hlvy lmshpchtm lgrshvn mshpcht hgrshny lqht mshpcht hqhty lmrry mshpcht hmrry
verses.translation: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה מִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת לֵוִ֗י מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת הַ/לִּבְנִ֜י מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַֽ/חֶבְרֹנִי֙ מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַ/מַּחְלִי֙ מִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַ/מּוּשִׁ֔י מִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַ/קָּרְחִ֑י וּ/קְהָ֖ת הוֹלִ֥ד אֶת עַמְרָֽם
verses.translit: 'lh mshpcht lvy mshpcht hlbny mshpcht hchbrny mshpcht hmchly mshpcht hmvshy mshpcht hqrchy vqht hvld 't 'mrm
verses.translation: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.

verses.original: וְ/שֵׁ֣ם אֵ֣שֶׁת עַמְרָ֗ם יוֹכֶ֨בֶד֙ בַּת לֵוִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָלְדָ֥ה אֹתָ֛/הּ לְ/לֵוִ֖י בְּ/מִצְרָ֑יִם וַ/תֵּ֣לֶד לְ/עַמְרָ֗ם אֶֽת אַהֲרֹן֙ וְ/אֶת מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְ/אֵ֖ת מִרְיָ֥ם אֲחֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vshm 'sht 'mrm yvkhbd bt lvy 'shr yldh 'th llvy bmtsrym vtld l'mrm 't 'hrn v't mshh v't mrym 'chtm
verses.translation: And the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

verses.original: וַ/יִּוָּלֵ֣ד לְ/אַהֲרֹ֔ן אֶת נָדָ֖ב וְ/אֶת אֲבִיה֑וּא אֶת אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְ/אֶת אִיתָמָֽר
verses.translit: vyvld l'hrn 't ndb v't 'byhv' 't 'l'zr v't 'ytmr
verses.translation: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.original: וַ/יָּ֥מָת נָדָ֖ב וַ/אֲבִיה֑וּא בְּ/הַקְרִיבָ֥/ם אֵשׁ זָרָ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vymt ndb v'byhv' bhqrybm 'sh zrh lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּהְי֣וּ פְקֻדֵי/הֶ֗ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה וְ/עֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף כָּל זָכָ֖ר מִ/בֶּן חֹ֣דֶשׁ וָ/מָ֑עְלָ/ה כִּ֣י לֹ֣א הָתְפָּקְד֗וּ בְּ/תוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֠י לֹא נִתַּ֤ן לָ/הֶם֙ נַחֲלָ֔ה בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyhyv pqdyhm shlshh v'shrym 'lf khl zkhr mbn chdsh vm'lh khy l' htpqdv btvkh bny yshr'l khy l' ntn lhm nchlh btvkh bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה פְּקוּדֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְ/אֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּֽקְד֜וּ אֶת בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּ/עַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עַ֖ל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ
verses.translit: 'lh pqvdy mshh v'l'zr hkhhn 'shr pqdv 't bny yshr'l b'rbt mv'b 'l yrdn yrchv
verses.translation: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ לֹא הָ֣יָה אִ֔ישׁ מִ/פְּקוּדֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְ/אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּקְד֛וּ אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/מִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי
verses.translit: vb'lh l' hyh 'ysh mpqvdy mshh v'hrn hkhhn 'shr pqdv 't bny yshr'l bmdbr syny
verses.translation: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.original: כִּֽי אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ לָ/הֶ֔ם מ֥וֹת יָמֻ֖תוּ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר וְ/לֹא נוֹתַ֤ר מֵ/הֶם֙ אִ֔ישׁ כִּ֚י אִם כָּלֵ֣ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּ֔ה וִ/יהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן נֽוּן
verses.translit: khy 'mr yhvh lhm mvt ymtv bmdbr vl' nvtr mhm 'ysh khy 'm khlb bn ypnh vyhvsh' bn nvn
verses.translation: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקְרַ֜בְנָה בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָ֗ד בֶּן חֵ֤פֶר בֶּן גִּלְעָד֙ בֶּן מָכִ֣יר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בֶן יוֹסֵ֑ף וְ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת בְּנֹתָ֔י/ו מַחְלָ֣ה נֹעָ֔ה וְ/חָגְלָ֥ה וּ/מִלְכָּ֖ה וְ/תִרְצָֽה
verses.translit: vtqrbnh bnvt tslpchd bn chpr bn gl'd bn mkhyr bn mnshh lmshpcht mnshh bn yvsf v'lh shmvt bntyv mchlh n'h vchglh vmlkhh vtrtsh
verses.translation: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.original: וַֽ/תַּעֲמֹ֜דְנָה לִ/פְנֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֗ה וְ/לִ/פְנֵי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/נְּשִׂיאִ֖ם וְ/כָל הָ/עֵדָ֑ה פֶּ֥תַח אֹֽהֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vt'mdnh lpny mshh vlpny 'l'zr hkhhn vlpny hnshy'm vkhl h'dh ptch 'hl mv'd l'mr
verses.translation: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,

verses.original: אָבִי/נוּ֮ מֵ֣ת בַּ/מִּדְבָּר֒ וְ/ה֨וּא לֹא הָיָ֜ה בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ הָ/עֵדָ֗ה הַ/נּוֹעָדִ֛ים עַל יְהוָ֖ה בַּ/עֲדַת קֹ֑רַח כִּֽי בְ/חֶטְא֣/וֹ מֵ֔ת וּ/בָנִ֖ים לֹא הָ֥יוּ לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'bynv mt bmdbr vhv' l' hyh btvkh h'dh hnv'dym 'l yhvh b'dt qrch khy bcht'v mt vbnym l' hyv lv
verses.translation: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.

verses.original: לָ֣/מָּה יִגָּרַ֤ע שֵׁם אָבִ֨י/נוּ֙ מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ מִשְׁפַּחְתּ֔/וֹ כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין ל֖/וֹ בֵּ֑ן תְּנָ/ה לָּ֣/נוּ אֲחֻזָּ֔ה בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ אֲחֵ֥י אָבִֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: lmh ygr' shm 'bynv mtvkh mshpchtv khy 'yn lv bn tnh lnv 'chzh btvkh 'chy 'bynv
verses.translation: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.

verses.original: וַ/יַּקְרֵ֥ב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת מִשְׁפָּטָ֖/ן לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqrb mshh 't mshptn lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: כֵּ֗ן בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָד֮ דֹּבְרֹת֒ נָתֹ֨ן תִּתֵּ֤ן לָ/הֶם֙ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת נַחֲלָ֔ה בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ אֲחֵ֣י אֲבִי/הֶ֑ם וְ/הַֽעֲבַרְתָּ֛ אֶת נַחֲלַ֥ת אֲבִי/הֶ֖ן לָ/הֶֽן
verses.translit: khn bnvt tslpchd dbrt ntn ttn lhm 'chzt nchlh btvkh 'chy 'byhm vh'brt 't nchlt 'byhn lhn
verses.translation: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.

verses.original: וְ/אֶל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אִ֣ישׁ כִּֽי יָמ֗וּת וּ/בֵן֙ אֵ֣ין ל֔/וֹ וְ/הַֽעֲבַרְתֶּ֥ם אֶת נַחֲלָת֖/וֹ לְ/בִתּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'l bny yshr'l tdbr l'mr 'ysh khy ymvt vbn 'yn lv vh'brtm 't nchltv lbtv
verses.translation: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.

verses.original: וְ/אִם אֵ֥ין ל֖/וֹ בַּ֑ת וּ/נְתַתֶּ֥ם אֶת נַחֲלָת֖/וֹ לְ/אֶחָי/ו
verses.translit: v'm 'yn lv bt vnttm 't nchltv l'chyv
verses.translation: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.

verses.original: וְ/אִם אֵ֥ין ל֖/וֹ אַחִ֑ים וּ/נְתַתֶּ֥ם אֶת נַחֲלָת֖/וֹ לַ/אֲחֵ֥י אָבִֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'm 'yn lv 'chym vnttm 't nchltv l'chy 'byv
verses.translation: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father’s brethren.

verses.original: וְ/אִם אֵ֣ין אַחִים֮ לְ/אָבִי/ו֒ וּ/נְתַתֶּ֣ם אֶת נַחֲלָת֗/וֹ לִ/שְׁאֵר֞/וֹ הַ/קָּרֹ֥ב אֵלָ֛י/ו מִ/מִּשְׁפַּחְתּ֖/וֹ וְ/יָרַ֣שׁ אֹתָ֑/הּ וְֽ/הָ֨יְתָ֜ה לִ/בְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לְ/חֻקַּ֣ת מִשְׁפָּ֔ט כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: v'm 'yn 'chym l'byv vnttm 't nchltv lsh'rv hqrb 'lyv mmshpchtv vyrsh 'th vhyth lbny yshr'l lchqt mshpt kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה עֲלֵ֛ה אֶל הַ֥ר הָ/עֲבָרִ֖ים הַ/זֶּ֑ה וּ/רְאֵה֙ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh 'lh 'l hr h'brym hzh vr'h 't h'rts 'shr ntty lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.

verses.original: וְ/רָאִ֣יתָה אֹתָ֔/הּ וְ/נֶאֱסַפְתָּ֥ אֶל עַמֶּ֖י/ךָ גַּם אָ֑תָּה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר נֶאֱסַ֖ף אַהֲרֹ֥ן אָחִֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vr'yth 'th vn'spt 'l 'mykh gm 'th kh'shr n'sf 'hrn 'chykh
verses.translation: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֩ מְרִיתֶ֨ם פִּ֜/י בְּ/מִדְבַּר צִ֗ן בִּ/מְרִיבַת֙ הָֽ/עֵדָ֔ה לְ/הַקְדִּישֵׁ֥/נִי בַ/מַּ֖יִם לְ/עֵינֵי/הֶ֑ם הֵ֛ם מֵֽי מְרִיבַ֥ת קָדֵ֖שׁ מִדְבַּר צִֽן
verses.translit: kh'shr mrytm py bmdbr tsn bmrybt h'dh lhqdyshny bmym l'ynyhm hm my mrybt qdsh mdbr tsn
verses.translation: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֣ר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr mshh 'l yhvh l'mr
verses.translation: And Moses spake unto the LORD , saying,

verses.original: יִפְקֹ֣ד יְהוָ֔ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י הָ/רוּחֹ֖ת לְ/כָל בָּשָׂ֑ר אִ֖ישׁ עַל הָ/עֵדָֽה
verses.translit: ypqd yhvh 'lhy hrvcht lkhl bshr 'ysh 'l h'dh
verses.translation: Let the LORD , the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵ֣א לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֗ם וַ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר יָבֹא֙ לִ/פְנֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹצִיאֵ֖/ם וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְבִיאֵ֑/ם וְ/לֹ֤א תִהְיֶה֙ עֲדַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה כַּ/צֹּ֕אן אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֵין לָ/הֶ֖ם רֹעֶֽה
verses.translit: 'shr yts' lpnyhm v'shr yb' lpnyhm v'shr yvtsy'm v'shr yby'm vl' thyh 'dt yhvh khts'n 'shr 'yn lhm r'h
verses.translation: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה קַח לְ/ךָ֙ אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן נ֔וּן אִ֖ישׁ אֲשֶׁר ר֣וּחַ בּ֑/וֹ וְ/סָמַכְתָּ֥ אֶת יָדְ/ךָ֖ עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh qch lkh 't yhvsh' bn nvn 'ysh 'shr rvch bv vsmkht 't ydkh 'lyv
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;

verses.original: וְ/הַֽעֲמַדְתָּ֣ אֹת֗/וֹ לִ/פְנֵי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֖י כָּל הָ/עֵדָ֑ה וְ/צִוִּיתָ֥ה אֹת֖/וֹ לְ/עֵינֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vh'mdt 'tv lpny 'l'zr hkhhn vlpny khl h'dh vtsvyth 'tv l'ynyhm
verses.translation: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּ֥ה מֵ/הֽוֹדְ/ךָ֖ עָלָ֑י/ו לְמַ֣עַן יִשְׁמְע֔וּ כָּל עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vntth mhvdkh 'lyv lm'n yshm'v khl 'dt bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.

verses.original: וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֨י אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ יַעֲמֹ֔ד וְ/שָׁ֥אַל ל֛/וֹ בְּ/מִשְׁפַּ֥ט הָ/אוּרִ֖ים לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה עַל פִּ֨י/ו יֵצְא֜וּ וְ/עַל פִּ֣י/ו יָבֹ֗אוּ ה֛וּא וְ/כָל בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל אִתּ֖/וֹ וְ/כָל הָ/עֵדָֽה
verses.translit: vlpny 'l'zr hkhhn y'md vsh'l lv bmshpt h'vrym lpny yhvh 'l pyv yts'v v'l pyv yb'v hv' vkhl bny yshr'l 'tv vkhl h'dh
verses.translation: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the LORD : at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֑/וֹ וַ/יִּקַּ֣ח אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ וַ/יַּֽעֲמִדֵ֨/הוּ֙ לִ/פְנֵי֙ אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֖י כָּל הָ/עֵדָֽה
verses.translit: vy'sh mshh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'tv vyqch 't yhvsh' vy'mdhv lpny 'l'zr hkhhn vlpny khl h'dh
verses.translation: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְמֹ֧ךְ אֶת יָדָ֛י/ו עָלָ֖י/ו וַ/יְצַוֵּ֑/הוּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/יַד מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vysmkh 't ydyv 'lyv vytsvhv kh'shr dbr yhvh byd mshh
verses.translation: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: צַ֚ו אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם אֶת קָרְבָּנִ֨/י לַחְמִ֜/י לְ/אִשַּׁ֗/י רֵ֚יחַ נִֽיחֹחִ֔/י תִּשְׁמְר֕וּ לְ/הַקְרִ֥יב לִ֖/י בְּ/מוֹעֲדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: tsv 't bny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm 't qrbny lchmy l'shy rych nychchy tshmrv lhqryb ly bmv'dv
verses.translation: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ לָ/הֶ֔ם זֶ֚ה הָֽ/אִשֶּׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּקְרִ֖יבוּ לַ/יהוָ֑ה כְּבָשִׂ֨ים בְּנֵֽי שָׁנָ֧ה תְמִימִ֛ם שְׁנַ֥יִם לַ/יּ֖וֹם עֹלָ֥ה תָמִֽיד
verses.translit: v'mrt lhm zh h'shh 'shr tqrybv lyhvh khbshym bny shnh tmymm shnym lyvm 'lh tmyd
verses.translation: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the LORD ; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

verses.original: אֶת הַ/כֶּ֥בֶשׂ אֶחָ֖ד תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה בַ/בֹּ֑קֶר וְ/אֵת֙ הַ/כֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֥ין הָֽ/עַרְבָּֽיִם
verses.translit: 't hkhbsh 'chd t'shh bbqr v't hkhbsh hshny t'shh byn h'rbym
verses.translation: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;

verses.original: וַ/עֲשִׂירִ֧ית הָ/אֵיפָ֛ה סֹ֖לֶת לְ/מִנְחָ֑ה בְּלוּלָ֛ה בְּ/שֶׁ֥מֶן כָּתִ֖ית רְבִיעִ֥ת הַ/הִֽין
verses.translit: v'shyryt h'yph slt lmnchh blvlh bshmn khtyt rby't hhyn
verses.translation: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.

verses.original: עֹלַ֖ת תָּמִ֑יד הָ/עֲשֻׂיָה֙ בְּ/הַ֣ר סִינַ֔י לְ/רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: 'lt tmyd h'shyh bhr syny lrych nychch 'shh lyhvh
verses.translation: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/נִסְכּ/וֹ֙ רְבִיעִ֣ת הַ/הִ֔ין לַ/כֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָ/אֶחָ֑ד בַּ/קֹּ֗דֶשׁ הַסֵּ֛ךְ נֶ֥סֶךְ שֵׁכָ֖ר לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vnskhv rby't hhyn lkhbsh h'chd bqdsh hskh nskh shkhr lyhvh
verses.translation: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the LORD for a drink offering.

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ הַ/כֶּ֣בֶשׂ הַ/שֵּׁנִ֔י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֣ין הָֽ/עַרְבָּ֑יִם כְּ/מִנְחַ֨ת הַ/בֹּ֤קֶר וּ/כְ/נִסְכּ/וֹ֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה אִשֵּׁ֛ה רֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: v't hkhbsh hshny t'shh byn h'rbym khmncht hbqr vkhnskhv t'shh 'shh rych nychch lyhvh
verses.translation: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it , a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD .

verses.original: וּ/בְ/יוֹם֙ הַ/שַּׁבָּ֔ת שְׁנֵֽי כְבָשִׂ֥ים בְּנֵֽי שָׁנָ֖ה תְּמִימִ֑ם וּ/שְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֧לֶת מִנְחָ֛ה בְּלוּלָ֥ה בַ/שֶּׁ֖מֶן וְ/נִסְכּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vbyvm hshbt shny khbshym bny shnh tmymm vshny 'shrnym slt mnchh blvlh bshmn vnskhv
verses.translation: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:

verses.original: עֹלַ֥ת שַׁבַּ֖ת בְּ/שַׁבַּתּ֑/וֹ עַל עֹלַ֥ת הַ/תָּמִ֖יד וְ/נִסְכָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'lt shbt bshbtv 'l 'lt htmyd vnskhh
verses.translation: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/רָאשֵׁי֙ חָדְשֵׁי/כֶ֔ם תַּקְרִ֥יבוּ עֹלָ֖ה לַ/יהוָ֑ה פָּרִ֨ים בְּנֵֽי בָקָ֤ר שְׁנַ֨יִם֙ וְ/אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֔ד כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי שָׁנָ֛ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה תְּמִימִֽם
verses.translit: vbr'shy chdshykhm tqrybv 'lh lyhvh prym bny bqr shnym v'yl 'chd khbshym bny shnh shb'h tmymm
verses.translation: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD ; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;

verses.original: וּ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶן לַ/פָּ֖ר הָ/אֶחָ֑ד וּ/שְׁנֵ֣י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֗ים סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶן לָ/אַ֖יִל הָֽ/אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vshlshh 'shrnym slt mnchh blvlh bshmn lpr h'chd vshny 'shrnym slt mnchh blvlh bshmn l'yl h'chd
verses.translation: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;

verses.original: וְ/עִשָּׂרֹ֣ן עִשָּׂר֗וֹן סֹ֤לֶת מִנְחָה֙ בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶן לַ/כֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָ/אֶחָ֑ד עֹלָה֙ רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'shrn 'shrvn slt mnchh blvlh bshmn lkhbsh h'chd 'lh rych nychch 'shh lyhvh
verses.translation: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/נִסְכֵּי/הֶ֗ם חֲצִ֣י הַ/הִין֩ יִהְיֶ֨ה לַ/פָּ֜ר וּ/שְׁלִישִׁ֧ת הַ/הִ֣ין לָ/אַ֗יִל וּ/רְבִיעִ֥ת הַ/הִ֛ין לַ/כֶּ֖בֶשׂ יָ֑יִן זֹ֣את עֹלַ֥ת חֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ בְּ/חָדְשׁ֔/וֹ לְ/חָדְשֵׁ֖י הַ/שָּׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vnskhyhm chtsy hhyn yhyh lpr vshlysht hhyn l'yl vrby't hhyn lkhbsh yyn z't 'lt chdsh bchdshv lchdshy hshnh
verses.translation: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

verses.original: וּ/שְׂעִ֨יר עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֛ד לְ/חַטָּ֖את לַ/יהוָ֑ה עַל עֹלַ֧ת הַ/תָּמִ֛יד יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה וְ/נִסְכּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vsh'yr 'zym 'chd lcht't lyhvh 'l 'lt htmyd y'shh vnskhv
verses.translation: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the LORD shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשׁ֗וֹן בְּ/אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר י֖וֹם לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ פֶּ֖סַח לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vbchdsh hr'shvn b'rb'h 'shr yvm lchdsh psch lyhvh
verses.translation: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the LORD .

verses.original: וּ/בַ/חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר י֛וֹם לַ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ/זֶּ֖ה חָ֑ג שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים מַצּ֖וֹת יֵאָכֵֽל
verses.translit: vbchmshh 'shr yvm lchdsh hzh chg shb't ymym mtsvt y'khl
verses.translation: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.

verses.original: בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הָ/רִאשׁ֖וֹן מִקְרָא קֹ֑דֶשׁ כָּל מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: byvm hr'shvn mqr' qdsh khl ml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv
verses.translation: In the first day shall be an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein:

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם אִשֶּׁ֤ה עֹלָה֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי בָקָ֛ר שְׁנַ֖יִם וְ/אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד וְ/שִׁבְעָ֤ה כְבָשִׂים֙ בְּנֵ֣י שָׁנָ֔ה תְּמִימִ֖ם יִהְי֥וּ לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhqrbtm 'shh 'lh lyhvh prym bny bqr shnym v'yl 'chd vshb'h khbshym bny shnh tmymm yhyv lkhm
verses.translation: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the LORD ; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:

verses.original: וּ/מִ֨נְחָתָ֔/ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַ/שָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים לַ/פָּ֗ר וּ/שְׁנֵ֧י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֛ים לָ/אַ֖יִל תַּעֲשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: vmnchtm slt blvlh bshmn shlshh 'shrnym lpr vshny 'shrnym l'yl t'shv
verses.translation: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;

verses.original: עִשָּׂר֤וֹן עִשָּׂרוֹן֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה לַ/כֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָ/אֶחָ֑ד לְ/שִׁבְעַ֖ת הַ/כְּבָשִֽׂים
verses.translit: 'shrvn 'shrvn t'shh lkhbsh h'chd lshb't hkhbshym
verses.translation: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

verses.original: וּ/שְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד לְ/כַפֵּ֖ר עֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vsh'yr cht't 'chd lkhpr 'lykhm
verses.translation: And one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.

verses.original: מִ/לְּ/בַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַ/בֹּ֔קֶר אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְ/עֹלַ֣ת הַ/תָּמִ֑יד תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ אֶת אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: mlbd 'lt hbqr 'shr l'lt htmyd t'shv 't 'lh
verses.translation: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

verses.original: כָּ/אֵ֜לֶּה תַּעֲשׂ֤וּ לַ/יּוֹם֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים לֶ֛חֶם אִשֵּׁ֥ה רֵֽיחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַ/יהוָ֑ה עַל עוֹלַ֧ת הַ/תָּמִ֛יד יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה וְ/נִסְכּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: kh'lh t'shv lyvm shb't ymym lchm 'shh rych nychch lyhvh 'l 'vlt htmyd y'shh vnskhv
verses.translation: After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD : it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/יּוֹם֙ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י מִקְרָא קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֑ם כָּל מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: vbyvm hshby'y mqr' qdsh yhyh lkhm khl ml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv
verses.translation: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/י֣וֹם הַ/בִּכּוּרִ֗ים בְּ/הַקְרִ֨יבְ/כֶ֜ם מִנְחָ֤ה חֲדָשָׁה֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה בְּ/שָׁבֻעֹ֖תֵי/כֶ֑ם מִֽקְרָא קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֔ם כָּל מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: vbyvm hbkhvrym bhqrybkhm mnchh chdshh lyhvh bshb'tykhm mqr' qdsh yhyh lkhm khl ml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv
verses.translation: Also in the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering unto the LORD , after your weeks be out , ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עוֹלָ֜ה לְ/רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי בָקָ֛ר שְׁנַ֖יִם אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד שִׁבְעָ֥ה כְבָשִׂ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: vhqrbtm 'vlh lrych nychch lyhvh prym bny bqr shnym 'yl 'chd shb'h khbshym bny shnh
verses.translation: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD ; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;

verses.original: וּ/מִנְחָתָ֔/ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַ/שָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַ/פָּ֣ר הָֽ/אֶחָ֔ד שְׁנֵי֙ עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים לָ/אַ֖יִל הָ/אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vmnchtm slt blvlh bshmn shlshh 'shrnym lpr h'chd shny 'shrnym l'yl h'chd
verses.translation: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,

verses.original: עִשָּׂרוֹן֙ עִשָּׂר֔וֹן לַ/כֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָ/אֶחָ֑ד לְ/שִׁבְעַ֖ת הַ/כְּבָשִֽׂים
verses.translit: 'shrvn 'shrvn lkhbsh h'chd lshb't hkhbshym
verses.translation: A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;

verses.original: שְׂעִ֥יר עִזִּ֖ים אֶחָ֑ד לְ/כַפֵּ֖ר עֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: sh'yr 'zym 'chd lkhpr 'lykhm
verses.translation: And one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.

verses.original: מִ/לְּ/בַ֞ד עֹלַ֧ת הַ/תָּמִ֛יד וּ/מִנְחָת֖/וֹ תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ תְּמִימִ֥ם יִהְיוּ לָ/כֶ֖ם וְ/נִסְכֵּי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: mlbd 'lt htmyd vmnchtv t'shv tmymm yhyv lkhm vnskhyhm
verses.translation: Ye shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/חֹ֨דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֜י בְּ/אֶחָ֣ד לַ/חֹ֗דֶשׁ מִֽקְרָא קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֔ם כָּל מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ י֥וֹם תְּרוּעָ֖ה יִהְיֶ֥ה לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vbchdsh hshby'y b'chd lchdsh mqr' qdsh yhyh lkhm khl ml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv yvm trv'h yhyh lkhm
verses.translation: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you.

verses.original: וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה לְ/רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה פַּ֧ר בֶּן בָּקָ֛ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי שָׁנָ֛ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה תְּמִימִֽם
verses.translit: v'shytm 'lh lrych nychch lyhvh pr bn bqr 'chd 'yl 'chd khbshym bny shnh shb'h tmymm
verses.translation: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD ; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year without blemish:

verses.original: וּ/מִנְחָתָ֔/ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַ/שָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַ/פָּ֔ר שְׁנֵ֥י עֶשְׂרֹנִ֖ים לָ/אָֽיִל
verses.translit: vmnchtm slt blvlh bshmn shlshh 'shrnym lpr shny 'shrnym l'yl
verses.translation: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram,

verses.original: וְ/עִשָּׂר֣וֹן אֶחָ֔ד לַ/כֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָ/אֶחָ֑ד לְ/שִׁבְעַ֖ת הַ/כְּבָשִֽׂים
verses.translit: v'shrvn 'chd lkhbsh h'chd lshb't hkhbshym
verses.translation: And one tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

verses.original: וּ/שְׂעִיר עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את לְ/כַפֵּ֖ר עֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vsh'yr 'zym 'chd cht't lkhpr 'lykhm
verses.translation: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you:

verses.original: מִ/לְּ/בַד֩ עֹלַ֨ת הַ/חֹ֜דֶשׁ וּ/מִנְחָתָ֗/הּ וְ/עֹלַ֤ת הַ/תָּמִיד֙ וּ/מִנְחָתָ֔/הּ וְ/נִסְכֵּי/הֶ֖ם כְּ/מִשְׁפָּטָ֑/ם לְ/רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: mlbd 'lt hchdsh vmnchth v'lt htmyd vmnchth vnskhyhm khmshptm lrych nychch 'shh lyhvh
verses.translation: Beside the burnt offering of the month, and his meat offering, and the daily burnt offering, and his meat offering, and their drink offerings, according unto their manner, for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD .

verses.original: וּ/בֶ/עָשׂוֹר֩ לַ/חֹ֨דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֜י הַ/זֶּ֗ה מִֽקְרָא קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֔ם וְ/עִנִּיתֶ֖ם אֶת נַפְשֹׁתֵי/כֶ֑ם כָּל מְלָאכָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: vb'shvr lchdsh hshby'y hzh mqr' qdsh yhyh lkhm v'nytm 't npshtykhm khl ml'khh l' t'shv
verses.translation: And ye shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month an holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls: ye shall not do any work therein:

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֤ה לַֽ/יהוָה֙ רֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ פַּ֧ר בֶּן בָּקָ֛ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֤ים בְּנֵֽי שָׁנָה֙ שִׁבְעָ֔ה תְּמִימִ֖ם יִהְי֥וּ לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhqrbtm 'lh lyhvh rych nychch pr bn bqr 'chd 'yl 'chd khbshym bny shnh shb'h tmymm yhyv lkhm
verses.translation: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD for a sweet savour; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish:

verses.original: וּ/מִנְחָתָ֔/ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַ/שָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לַ/פָּ֔ר שְׁנֵי֙ עֶשְׂרֹנִ֔ים לָ/אַ֖יִל הָ/אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: vmnchtm slt blvlh bshmn shlshh 'shrnym lpr shny 'shrnym l'yl h'chd
verses.translation: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals to a bullock, and two tenth deals to one ram,

verses.original: עִשָּׂרוֹן֙ עִשָּׂר֔וֹן לַ/כֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָ/אֶחָ֑ד לְ/שִׁבְעַ֖ת הַ/כְּבָשִֽׂים
verses.translit: 'shrvn 'shrvn lkhbsh h'chd lshb't hkhbshym
verses.translation: A several tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:

verses.original: שְׂעִיר עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את מִ/לְּ/בַ֞ד חַטַּ֤את הַ/כִּפֻּרִים֙ וְ/עֹלַ֣ת הַ/תָּמִ֔יד וּ/מִנְחָתָ֖/הּ וְ/נִסְכֵּי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: sh'yr 'zym 'chd cht't mlbd cht't hkhprym v'lt htmyd vmnchth vnskhyhm
verses.translation: One kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering of it, and their drink offerings.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/חֲמִשָּׁה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֜וֹם לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֗י מִֽקְרָא קֹ֨דֶשׁ֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֔ם כָּל מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ וְ/חַגֹּתֶ֥ם חַ֛ג לַ/יהוָ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים
verses.translit: vbchmshh 'shr yvm lchdsh hshby'y mqr' qdsh yhyh lkhm khl ml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv vchgtm chg lyhvh shb't ymym
verses.translation: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days:

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה אִשֵּׁ֨ה רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי בָקָ֛ר שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִ֥ם יִהְיֽוּ
verses.translit: vhqrbtm 'lh 'shh rych nychch lyhvh prym bny bqr shlshh 'shr 'ylm shnym khbshym bny shnh 'rb'h 'shr tmymm yhyv
verses.translation: And ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD ; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish:

verses.original: וּ/מִנְחָתָ֔/ם סֹ֖לֶת בְּלוּלָ֣ה בַ/שָּׁ֑מֶן שְׁלֹשָׁ֨ה עֶשְׂרֹנִ֜ים לַ/פָּ֣ר הָֽ/אֶחָ֗ד לִ/שְׁלֹשָׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ פָּרִ֔ים שְׁנֵ֤י עֶשְׂרֹנִים֙ לָ/אַ֣יִל הָֽ/אֶחָ֔ד לִ/שְׁנֵ֖י הָ/אֵילִֽם
verses.translit: vmnchtm slt blvlh bshmn shlshh 'shrnym lpr h'chd lshlshh 'shr prym shny 'shrnym l'yl h'chd lshny h'ylm
verses.translation: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth deals to each ram of the two rams,

verses.original: וְ/עִשָּׂרׄוֹן֙ עִשָּׂר֔וֹן לַ/כֶּ֖בֶשׂ הָ/אֶחָ֑ד לְ/אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר כְּבָשִֽׂים
verses.translit: v'shrvn 'shrvn lkhbsh h'chd l'rb'h 'shr khbshym
verses.translation: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:

verses.original: וּ/שְׂעִיר עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את מִ/לְּ/בַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַ/תָּמִ֔יד מִנְחָתָ֖/הּ וְ/נִסְכָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vsh'yr 'zym 'chd cht't mlbd 'lt htmyd mnchth vnskhh
verses.translation: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שֵּׁנִ֗י פָּרִ֧ים בְּנֵי בָקָ֛ר שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם
verses.translit: vbyvm hshny prym bny bqr shnym 'shr 'ylm shnym khbshym bny shnh 'rb'h 'shr tmymm
verses.translation: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:

verses.original: וּ/מִנְחָתָ֣/ם וְ/נִסְכֵּי/הֶ֡ם לַ֠/פָּרִים לָ/אֵילִ֧ם וְ/לַ/כְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּ/מִסְפָּרָ֖/ם כַּ/מִּשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: vmnchtm vnskhyhm lprym l'ylm vlkhbshym bmsprm khmshpt
verses.translation: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

verses.original: וּ/שְׂעִיר עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את מִ/לְּ/בַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַ/תָּמִ֔יד וּ/מִנְחָתָ֖/הּ וְ/נִסְכֵּי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vsh'yr 'zym 'chd cht't mlbd 'lt htmyd vmnchth vnskhyhm
verses.translation: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering thereof, and their drink offerings.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/יּ֧וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁ֛י פָּרִ֥ים עַשְׁתֵּי עָשָׂ֖ר אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם
verses.translit: vbyvm hshlyshy prym 'shty 'shr 'ylm shnym khbshym bny shnh 'rb'h 'shr tmymm
verses.translation: And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;

verses.original: וּ/מִנְחָתָ֣/ם וְ/נִסְכֵּי/הֶ֡ם לַ֠/פָּרִים לָ/אֵילִ֧ם וְ/לַ/כְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּ/מִסְפָּרָ֖/ם כַּ/מִּשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: vmnchtm vnskhyhm lprym l'ylm vlkhbshym bmsprm khmshpt
verses.translation: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

verses.original: וּ/שְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד מִ/לְּ/בַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַ/תָּמִ֔יד וּ/מִנְחָתָ֖/הּ וְ/נִסְכָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vsh'yr cht't 'chd mlbd 'lt htmyd vmnchth vnskhh
verses.translation: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/יּ֧וֹם הָ/רְבִיעִ֛י פָּרִ֥ים עֲשָׂרָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם
verses.translit: vbyvm hrby'y prym 'shrh 'ylm shnym khbshym bny shnh 'rb'h 'shr tmymm
verses.translation: And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:

verses.original: מִנְחָתָ֣/ם וְ/נִסְכֵּי/הֶ֡ם לַ֠/פָּרִים לָ/אֵילִ֧ם וְ/לַ/כְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּ/מִסְפָּרָ֖/ם כַּ/מִּשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: mnchtm vnskhyhm lprym l'ylm vlkhbshym bmsprm khmshpt
verses.translation: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

verses.original: וּ/שְׂעִיר עִזִּ֥ים אֶחָ֖ד חַטָּ֑את מִ/לְּ/בַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַ/תָּמִ֔יד מִנְחָתָ֖/הּ וְ/נִסְכָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vsh'yr 'zym 'chd cht't mlbd 'lt htmyd mnchth vnskhh
verses.translation: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/יּ֧וֹם הַ/חֲמִישִׁ֛י פָּרִ֥ים תִּשְׁעָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵֽי שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם
verses.translit: vbyvm hchmyshy prym tsh'h 'ylm shnym khbshym bny shnh 'rb'h 'shr tmymm
verses.translation: And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:

verses.original: וּ/מִנְחָתָ֣/ם וְ/נִסְכֵּי/הֶ֡ם לַ֠/פָּרִים לָ/אֵילִ֧ם וְ/לַ/כְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּ/מִסְפָּרָ֖/ם כַּ/מִּשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: vmnchtm vnskhyhm lprym l'ylm vlkhbshym bmsprm khmshpt
verses.translation: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

verses.original: וּ/שְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד מִ/לְּ/בַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַ/תָּמִ֔יד וּ/מִנְחָתָ֖/הּ וְ/נִסְכָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vsh'yr cht't 'chd mlbd 'lt htmyd vmnchth vnskhh
verses.translation: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/יּ֧וֹם הַ/שִּׁשִּׁ֛י פָּרִ֥ים שְׁמֹנָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם
verses.translit: vbyvm hshshy prym shmnh 'ylm shnym khbshym bny shnh 'rb'h 'shr tmymm
verses.translation: And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:

verses.original: וּ/מִנְחָתָ֣/ם וְ/נִסְכֵּי/הֶ֡ם לַ֠/פָּרִים לָ/אֵילִ֧ם וְ/לַ/כְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּ/מִסְפָּרָ֖/ם כַּ/מִּשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: vmnchtm vnskhyhm lprym l'ylm vlkhbshym bmsprm khmshpt
verses.translation: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

verses.original: וּ/שְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד מִ/לְּ/בַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַ/תָּמִ֔יד מִנְחָתָ֖/הּ וּ/נְסָכֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vsh'yr cht't 'chd mlbd 'lt htmyd mnchth vnskhyh
verses.translation: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/יּ֧וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֛י פָּרִ֥ים שִׁבְעָ֖ה אֵילִ֣ם שְׁנָ֑יִם כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי שָׁנָ֛ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר תְּמִימִֽם
verses.translit: vbyvm hshby'y prym shb'h 'ylm shnym khbshym bny shnh 'rb'h 'shr tmymm
verses.translation: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:

verses.original: וּ/מִנְחָתָ֣/ם וְ/נִסְכֵּ/הֶ֡ם לַ֠/פָּרִים לָ/אֵילִ֧ם וְ/לַ/כְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּ/מִסְפָּרָ֖/ם כְּ/מִשְׁפָּטָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vmnchtm vnskhhm lprym l'ylm vlkhbshym bmsprm khmshptm
verses.translation: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

verses.original: וּ/שְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד מִ/לְּ/בַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַ/תָּמִ֔יד מִנְחָתָ֖/הּ וְ/נִסְכָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vsh'yr cht't 'chd mlbd 'lt htmyd mnchth vnskhh
verses.translation: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.

verses.original: בַּ/יּוֹם֙ הַ/שְּׁמִינִ֔י עֲצֶ֖רֶת תִּהְיֶ֣ה לָ/כֶ֑ם כָּל מְלֶ֥אכֶת עֲבֹדָ֖ה לֹ֥א תַעֲשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: byvm hshmyny 'tsrt thyh lkhm khl ml'kht 'bdh l' t'shv
verses.translation: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no servile work therein:

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרַבְתֶּ֨ם עֹלָ֜ה אִשֵּׁ֨ה רֵ֤יחַ נִיחֹ֨חַ֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה פַּ֥ר אֶחָ֖ד אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֑ד כְּבָשִׂ֧ים בְּנֵי שָׁנָ֛ה שִׁבְעָ֖ה תְּמִימִֽם
verses.translit: vhqrbtm 'lh 'shh rych nychch lyhvh pr 'chd 'yl 'chd khbshym bny shnh shb'h tmymm
verses.translation: But ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD : one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:

verses.original: מִנְחָתָ֣/ם וְ/נִסְכֵּי/הֶ֗ם לַ/פָּ֨ר לָ/אַ֧יִל וְ/לַ/כְּבָשִׂ֛ים בְּ/מִסְפָּרָ֖/ם כַּ/מִּשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: mnchtm vnskhyhm lpr l'yl vlkhbshym bmsprm khmshpt
verses.translation: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:

verses.original: וּ/שְׂעִ֥יר חַטָּ֖את אֶחָ֑ד מִ/לְּ/בַד֙ עֹלַ֣ת הַ/תָּמִ֔יד וּ/מִנְחָתָ֖/הּ וְ/נִסְכָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vsh'yr cht't 'chd mlbd 'lt htmyd vmnchth vnskhh
verses.translation: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.

verses.original: אֵ֛לֶּה תַּעֲשׂ֥וּ לַ/יהוָ֖ה בְּ/מוֹעֲדֵי/כֶ֑ם לְ/בַ֨ד מִ/נִּדְרֵי/כֶ֜ם וְ/נִדְבֹתֵי/כֶ֗ם לְ/עֹלֹֽתֵי/כֶם֙ וּ/לְ/מִנְחֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם וּ/לְ/נִסְכֵּי/כֶ֖ם וּ/לְ/שַׁלְמֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'lh t'shv lyhvh bmv'dykhm lbd mndrykhm vndbtykhm l'ltykhm vlmnchtykhm vlnskhykhm vlshlmykhm
verses.translation: These things ye shall do unto the LORD in your set feasts, beside your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meat offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.
And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּ/כֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'l bny yshr'l khkhl 'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל רָאשֵׁ֣י הַ/מַּטּ֔וֹת לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר זֶ֣ה הַ/דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vydbr mshh 'l r'shy hmtvt lbny yshr'l l'mr zh hdbr 'shr tsvh yhvh
verses.translation: If a man vow a vow unto the LORD , or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.

verses.original: אִישׁ֩ כִּֽי יִדֹּ֨ר נֶ֜דֶר לַֽ/יהוָ֗ה אֽוֹ הִשָּׁ֤בַע שְׁבֻעָה֙ לֶ/אְסֹ֤ר אִסָּר֙ עַל נַפְשׁ֔/וֹ לֹ֥א יַחֵ֖ל דְּבָר֑/וֹ כְּ/כָל הַ/יֹּצֵ֥א מִ/פִּ֖י/ו יַעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: 'ysh khy ydr ndr lyhvh 'v hshb' shb'h l'sr 'sr 'l npshv l' ychl dbrv khkhl hyts' mpyv y'shh
verses.translation: If a woman also vow a vow unto the LORD , and bind herself by a bond, being in her father’s house in her youth;

verses.original: וְ/אִשָּׁ֕ה כִּֽי תִדֹּ֥ר נֶ֖דֶר לַ/יהוָ֑ה וְ/אָסְרָ֥ה אִסָּ֛ר בְּ/בֵ֥ית אָבִ֖י/הָ בִּ/נְעֻרֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: v'shh khy tdr ndr lyhvh v'srh 'sr bbyt 'byh bn'ryh
verses.translation: And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמַ֨ע אָבִ֜י/הָ אֶת נִדְרָ֗/הּ וֶֽ/אֱסָרָ/הּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָֽסְרָ֣ה עַל נַפְשָׁ֔/הּ וְ/הֶחֱרִ֥ישׁ לָ֖/הּ אָבִ֑י/הָ וְ/קָ֨מוּ֙ כָּל נְדָרֶ֔י/הָ וְ/כָל אִסָּ֛ר אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָ֥ה עַל נַפְשָׁ֖/הּ יָקֽוּם
verses.translit: vshm' 'byh 't ndrh v'srh 'shr 'srh 'l npshh vhchrysh lh 'byh vqmv khl ndryh vkhl 'sr 'shr 'srh 'l npshh yqvm
verses.translation: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the LORD shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.

verses.original: וְ/אִם הֵנִ֨יא אָבִ֣י/הָ אֹתָ/הּ֮ בְּ/י֣וֹם שָׁמְע/וֹ֒ כָּל נְדָרֶ֗י/הָ וֶֽ/אֱסָרֶ֛י/הָ אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָ֥ה עַל נַפְשָׁ֖/הּ לֹ֣א יָק֑וּם וַֽ/יהוָה֙ יִֽסְלַח לָ֔/הּ כִּי הֵנִ֥יא אָבִ֖י/הָ אֹתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'm hny' 'byh 'th byvm shm'v khl ndryh v'sryh 'shr 'srh 'l npshh l' yqvm vyhvh yslch lh khy hny' 'byh 'th
verses.translation: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;

verses.original: וְ/אִם הָי֤וֹ תִֽהְיֶה֙ לְ/אִ֔ישׁ וּ/נְדָרֶ֖י/הָ עָלֶ֑י/הָ א֚וֹ מִבְטָ֣א שְׂפָתֶ֔י/הָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָסְרָ֖ה עַל נַפְשָֽׁ/הּ
verses.translit: v'm hyv thyh l'ysh vndryh 'lyh 'v mbt' shptyh 'shr 'srh 'l npshh
verses.translation: And her husband heard it , and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמַ֥ע אִישָׁ֛/הּ בְּ/י֥וֹם שָׁמְע֖/וֹ וְ/הֶחֱרִ֣ישׁ לָ֑/הּ וְ/קָ֣מוּ נְדָרֶ֗י/הָ וֶֽ/אֱסָרֶ֛/הָ אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָ֥ה עַל נַפְשָׁ֖/הּ יָקֻֽמוּ
verses.translit: vshm' 'yshh byvm shm'v vhchrysh lh vqmv ndryh v'srh 'shr 'srh 'l npshh yqmv
verses.translation: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and the LORD shall forgive her.

verses.original: וְ֠/אִם בְּ/י֨וֹם שְׁמֹ֣עַ אִישָׁ/הּ֮ יָנִ֣יא אוֹתָ/הּ֒ וְ/הֵפֵ֗ר אֶת נִדְרָ/הּ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלֶ֔י/הָ וְ/אֵת֙ מִבְטָ֣א שְׂפָתֶ֔י/הָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָסְרָ֖ה עַל נַפְשָׁ֑/הּ וַ/יהוָ֖ה יִֽסְלַֽח לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'm byvm shm' 'yshh yny' 'vth vhpr 't ndrh 'shr 'lyh v't mbt' shptyh 'shr 'srh 'l npshh vyhvh yslch lh
verses.translation: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.

verses.original: וְ/נֵ֥דֶר אַלְמָנָ֖ה וּ/גְרוּשָׁ֑ה כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָ֥ה עַל נַפְשָׁ֖/הּ יָק֥וּם עָלֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vndr 'lmnh vgrvshh khl 'shr 'srh 'l npshh yqvm 'lyh
verses.translation: And if she vowed in her husband’s house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;

verses.original: וְ/אִם בֵּ֥ית אִישָׁ֖/הּ נָדָ֑רָה אֽוֹ אָסְרָ֥ה אִסָּ֛ר עַל נַפְשָׁ֖/הּ בִּ/שְׁבֻעָֽה
verses.translit: v'm byt 'yshh ndrh 'v 'srh 'sr 'l npshh bshb'h
verses.translation: And her husband heard it , and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמַ֤ע אִישָׁ/הּ֙ וְ/הֶחֱרִ֣שׁ לָ֔/הּ לֹ֥א הֵנִ֖יא אֹתָ֑/הּ וְ/קָ֨מוּ֙ כָּל נְדָרֶ֔י/הָ וְ/כָל אִסָּ֛ר אֲשֶׁר אָסְרָ֥ה עַל נַפְשָׁ֖/הּ יָקֽוּם
verses.translit: vshm' 'yshh vhchrsh lh l' hny' 'th vqmv khl ndryh vkhl 'sr 'shr 'srh 'l npshh yqvm
verses.translation: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the LORD shall forgive her.

verses.original: וְ/אִם הָפֵר֩ יָפֵ֨ר אֹתָ֥/ם אִישָׁ/הּ֮ בְּ/י֣וֹם שָׁמְע/וֹ֒ כָּל מוֹצָ֨א שְׂפָתֶ֧י/הָ לִ/נְדָרֶ֛י/הָ וּ/לְ/אִסַּ֥ר נַפְשָׁ֖/הּ לֹ֣א יָק֑וּם אִישָׁ֣/הּ הֲפֵרָ֔/ם וַ/יהוָ֖ה יִֽסְלַֽח לָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'm hpr ypr 'tm 'yshh byvm shm'v khl mvts' shptyh lndryh vl'sr npshh l' yqvm 'yshh hprm vyhvh yslch lh
verses.translation: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

verses.original: כָּל נֵ֛דֶר וְ/כָל שְׁבֻעַ֥ת אִסָּ֖ר לְ/עַנֹּ֣ת נָ֑פֶשׁ אִישָׁ֥/הּ יְקִימֶ֖/נּוּ וְ/אִישָׁ֥/הּ יְפֵרֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: khl ndr vkhl shb't 'sr l'nt npsh 'yshh yqymnv v'yshh yprnv
verses.translation: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them .

verses.original: וְ/אִם הַחֲרֵשׁ֩ יַחֲרִ֨ישׁ לָ֥/הּ אִישָׁ/הּ֮ מִ/יּ֣וֹם אֶל יוֹם֒ וְ/הֵקִים֙ אֶת כָּל נְדָרֶ֔י/הָ א֥וֹ אֶת כָּל אֱסָרֶ֖י/הָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלֶ֑י/הָ הֵקִ֣ים אֹתָ֔/ם כִּי הֶחֱרִ֥שׁ לָ֖/הּ בְּ/י֥וֹם שָׁמְעֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'm hchrsh ychrysh lh 'yshh myvm 'l yvm vhqym 't khl ndryh 'v 't khl 'sryh 'shr 'lyh hqym 'tm khy hchrsh lh byvm shm'v
verses.translation: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.

verses.original: וְ/אִם הָפֵ֥ר יָפֵ֛ר אֹתָ֖/ם אַחֲרֵ֣י שָׁמְע֑/וֹ וְ/נָשָׂ֖א אֶת עֲוֺנָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'm hpr ypr 'tm 'chry shm'v vnsh' 't 'vnh
verses.translation: These are the statutes, which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father’s house.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: נְקֹ֗ם נִקְמַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵ/אֵ֖ת הַ/מִּדְיָנִ֑ים אַחַ֖ר תֵּאָסֵ֥ף אֶל עַמֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: nqm nqmt bny yshr'l m't hmdynym 'chr t'sf 'l 'mykh
verses.translation: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל הָ/עָ֣ם לֵ/אמֹ֔ר הֵחָלְצ֧וּ מֵ/אִתְּ/כֶ֛ם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לַ/צָּבָ֑א וְ/יִהְיוּ֙ עַל מִדְיָ֔ן לָ/תֵ֥ת נִקְמַת יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/מִדְיָֽן
verses.translit: vydbr mshh 'l h'm l'mr hchltsv m'tkhm 'nshym ltsb' vyhyv 'l mdyn ltt nqmt yhvh bmdyn
verses.translation: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD of Midian.

verses.original: אֶ֚לֶף לַ/מַּטֶּ֔ה אֶ֖לֶף לַ/מַּטֶּ֑ה לְ/כֹל֙ מַטּ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תִּשְׁלְח֖וּ לַ/צָּבָֽא
verses.translit: 'lf lmth 'lf lmth lkhl mtvt yshr'l tshlchv ltsb'
verses.translation: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.

verses.original: וַ/יִּמָּֽסְרוּ֙ מֵ/אַלְפֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶ֖לֶף לַ/מַּטֶּ֑ה שְׁנֵים עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֖לֶף חֲלוּצֵ֥י צָבָֽא
verses.translit: vymsrv m'lpy yshr'l 'lf lmth shnym 'shr 'lf chlvtsy tsb'
verses.translation: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁלַ֨ח אֹתָ֥/ם מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶ֥לֶף לַ/מַּטֶּ֖ה לַ/צָּבָ֑א אֹ֠תָ/ם וְ/אֶת פִּ֨ינְחָ֜ס בֶּן אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ לַ/צָּבָ֔א וּ/כְלֵ֥י הַ/קֹּ֛דֶשׁ וַ/חֲצֹצְר֥וֹת הַ/תְּרוּעָ֖ה בְּ/יָדֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyshlch 'tm mshh 'lf lmth ltsb' 'tm v't pynchs bn 'l'zr hkhhn ltsb' vkhly hqdsh vchtstsrvt htrv'h bydv
verses.translation: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּצְבְּאוּ֙ עַל מִדְיָ֔ן כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַ/יַּֽהַרְג֖וּ כָּל זָכָֽר
verses.translit: vytsb'v 'l mdyn kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh vyhrgv khl zkhr
verses.translation: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת מַלְכֵ֨י מִדְיָ֜ן הָרְג֣וּ עַל חַלְלֵי/הֶ֗ם אֶת אֱוִ֤י וְ/אֶת רֶ֨קֶם֙ וְ/אֶת צ֤וּר וְ/אֶת חוּר֙ וְ/אֶת רֶ֔בַע חֲמֵ֖שֶׁת מַלְכֵ֣י מִדְיָ֑ן וְ/אֵת֙ בִּלְעָ֣ם בֶּן בְּע֔וֹר הָרְג֖וּ בֶּ/חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: v't mlkhy mdyn hrgv 'l chllyhm 't 'vy v't rqm v't tsvr v't chvr v't rb' chmsht mlkhy mdyn v't bl'm bn b'vr hrgv bchrb
verses.translation: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely , Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁבּ֧וּ בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת נְשֵׁ֥י מִדְיָ֖ן וְ/אֶת טַפָּ֑/ם וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל בְּהֶמְתָּ֧/ם וְ/אֶת כָּל מִקְנֵ/הֶ֛ם וְ/אֶת כָּל חֵילָ֖/ם בָּזָֽזוּ
verses.translit: vyshbv bny yshr'l 't nshy mdyn v't tpm v't khl bhmtm v't khl mqnhm v't khl chylm bzzv
verses.translation: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֤ת כָּל עָרֵי/הֶם֙ בְּ/מ֣וֹשְׁבֹתָ֔/ם וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל טִֽירֹתָ֑/ם שָׂרְפ֖וּ בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: v't khl 'ryhm bmvshbtm v't khl tyrtm shrpv b'sh
verses.translation: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְחוּ֙ אֶת כָּל הַ/שָּׁלָ֔ל וְ/אֵ֖ת כָּל הַ/מַּלְק֑וֹחַ בָּ/אָדָ֖ם וּ/בַ/בְּהֵמָֽה
verses.translit: vyqchv 't khl hshll v't khl hmlqvch b'dm vbbhmh
verses.translation: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.

verses.original: וַ/יָּבִ֡אוּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה֩ וְ/אֶל אֶלְעָזָ֨ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן וְ/אֶל עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶת הַ/שְּׁבִ֧י וְ/אֶת הַ/מַּלְק֛וֹחַ וְ/אֶת הַ/שָּׁלָ֖ל אֶל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה אֶל עַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ
verses.translit: vyb'v 'l mshh v'l 'l'zr hkhhn v'l 'dt bny yshr'l 't hshby v't hmlqvch v't hshll 'l hmchnh 'l 'rbt mv'b 'shr 'l yrdn yrchv
verses.translation: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨צְא֜וּ מֹשֶׁ֨ה וְ/אֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן וְ/כָל נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָ/עֵדָ֖ה לִ/קְרָאתָ֑/ם אֶל מִ/ח֖וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vyts'v mshh v'l'zr hkhhn vkhl nshy'y h'dh lqr'tm 'l mchvts lmchnh
verses.translation: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְצֹ֣ף מֹשֶׁ֔ה עַ֖ל פְּקוּדֵ֣י הֶ/חָ֑יִל שָׂרֵ֤י הָ/אֲלָפִים֙ וְ/שָׂרֵ֣י הַ/מֵּא֔וֹת הַ/בָּאִ֖ים מִ/צְּבָ֥א הַ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: vyqtsf mshh 'l pqvdy hchyl shry h'lpym vshry hm'vt hb'ym mtsb' hmlchmh
verses.translation: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶ֖ם מֹשֶׁ֑ה הַֽ/חִיִּיתֶ֖ם כָּל נְקֵבָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm mshh hchyytm khl nqbh
verses.translation: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?

verses.original: הֵ֣ן הֵ֜נָּה הָי֨וּ לִ/בְנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בִּ/דְבַ֣ר בִּלְעָ֔ם לִ/מְסָר מַ֥עַל בַּ/יהוָ֖ה עַל דְּבַר פְּע֑וֹר וַ/תְּהִ֥י הַ/מַּגֵּפָ֖ה בַּ/עֲדַ֥ת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: hn hnh hyv lbny yshr'l bdbr bl'm lmsr m'l byhvh 'l dbr p'vr vthy hmgph b'dt yhvh
verses.translation: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֕ה הִרְג֥וּ כָל זָכָ֖ר בַּ/טָּ֑ף וְ/כָל אִשָּׁ֗ה יֹדַ֥עַת אִ֛ישׁ לְ/מִשְׁכַּ֥ב זָכָ֖ר הֲרֹֽגוּ
verses.translit: v'th hrgv khl zkhr btf vkhl 'shh yd't 'ysh lmshkhb zkhr hrgv
verses.translation: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.

verses.original: וְ/כֹל֙ הַ/טַּ֣ף בַּ/נָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא יָדְע֖וּ מִשְׁכַּ֣ב זָכָ֑ר הַחֲי֖וּ לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vkhl htf bnshym 'shr l' yd'v mshkhb zkhr hchyv lkhm
verses.translation: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּ֗ם חֲנ֛וּ מִ/ח֥וּץ לַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֖ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים כֹּל֩ הֹרֵ֨ג נֶ֜פֶשׁ וְ/כֹ֣ל נֹגֵ֣עַ בֶּֽ/חָלָ֗ל תִּֽתְחַטְּא֞וּ בַּ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/שְּׁלִישִׁי֙ וּ/בַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י אַתֶּ֖ם וּ/שְׁבִי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'tm chnv mchvts lmchnh shb't ymym khl hrg npsh vkhl ng' bchll ttcht'v byvm hshlyshy vbyvm hshby'y 'tm vshbykhm
verses.translation: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.

verses.original: וְ/כָל בֶּ֧גֶד וְ/כָל כְּלִי ע֛וֹר וְ/כָל מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה עִזִּ֖ים וְ/כָל כְּלִי עֵ֑ץ תִּתְחַטָּֽאוּ
verses.translit: vkhl bgd vkhl khly 'vr vkhl m'shh 'zym vkhl khly 'ts ttcht'v
verses.translation: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats’ hair , and all things made of wood.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ אֶל אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַ/צָּבָ֔א הַ/בָּאִ֖ים לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה זֹ֚את חֻקַּ֣ת הַ/תּוֹרָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'l'zr hkhhn 'l 'nshy htsb' hb'ym lmlchmh z't chqt htvrh 'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the LORD commanded Moses;

verses.original: אַ֥ךְ אֶת הַ/זָּהָ֖ב וְ/אֶת הַ/כָּ֑סֶף אֶֽת הַ/נְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ אֶת הַ/בַּרְזֶ֔ל אֶֽת הַ/בְּדִ֖יל וְ/אֶת הָ/עֹפָֽרֶת
verses.translit: 'kh 't hzhb v't hkhsf 't hnchsht 't hbrzl 't hbdyl v't h'prt
verses.translation: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

verses.original: כָּל דָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר יָבֹ֣א בָ/אֵ֗שׁ תַּעֲבִ֤ירוּ בָ/אֵשׁ֙ וְ/טָהֵ֔ר אַ֕ךְ בְּ/מֵ֥י נִדָּ֖ה יִתְחַטָּ֑א וְ/כֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא יָבֹ֛א בָּ/אֵ֖שׁ תַּעֲבִ֥ירוּ בַ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: khl dbr 'shr yb' b'sh t'byrv b'sh vthr 'kh bmy ndh ytcht' vkhl 'shr l' yb' b'sh t'byrv bmym
verses.translation: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.

verses.original: וְ/כִבַּסְתֶּ֧ם בִּגְדֵי/כֶ֛ם בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֖י וּ/טְהַרְתֶּ֑ם וְ/אַחַ֖ר תָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶֽה
verses.translit: vkhbstm bgdykhm byvm hshby'y vthrtm v'chr tb'v 'l hmchnh
verses.translation: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: שָׂ֗א אֵ֣ת רֹ֤אשׁ מַלְק֨וֹחַ֙ הַ/שְּׁבִ֔י בָּ/אָדָ֖ם וּ/בַ/בְּהֵמָ֑ה אַתָּה֙ וְ/אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/רָאשֵׁ֖י אֲב֥וֹת הָ/עֵדָֽה
verses.translit: sh' 't r'sh mlqvch hshby b'dm vbbhmh 'th v'l'zr hkhhn vr'shy 'bvt h'dh
verses.translation: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:

verses.original: וְ/חָצִ֨יתָ֙ אֶת הַ/מַּלְק֔וֹחַ בֵּ֚ין תֹּפְשֵׂ֣י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה הַ/יֹּצְאִ֖ים לַ/צָּבָ֑א וּ/בֵ֖ין כָּל הָ/עֵדָֽה
verses.translit: vchtsyt 't hmlqvch byn tpshy hmlchmh hyts'ym ltsb' vbyn khl h'dh
verses.translation: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:

verses.original: וַ/הֲרֵמֹתָ֨ מֶ֜כֶס לַֽ/יהוָ֗ה מֵ/אֵ֞ת אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַ/מִּלְחָמָה֙ הַ/יֹּצְאִ֣ים לַ/צָּבָ֔א אֶחָ֣ד נֶ֔פֶשׁ מֵ/חֲמֵ֖שׁ הַ/מֵּא֑וֹת מִן הָ/אָדָם֙ וּ/מִן הַ/בָּקָ֔ר וּ/מִן הַ/חֲמֹרִ֖ים וּ/מִן הַ/צֹּֽאן
verses.translit: vhrmt mkhs lyhvh m't 'nshy hmlchmh hyts'ym ltsb' 'chd npsh mchmsh hm'vt mn h'dm vmn hbqr vmn hchmrym vmn hts'n
verses.translation: And levy a tribute unto the LORD of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:
