verses.original: מִ/מַּֽחֲצִיתָ֖/ם תִּקָּ֑חוּ וְ/נָתַתָּ֛ה לְ/אֶלְעָזָ֥ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן תְּרוּמַ֥ת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: mmchtsytm tqchv vntth l'l'zr hkhhn trvmt yhvh
verses.translation: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the LORD .

verses.original: וּ/מִ/מַּחֲצִ֨ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל תִּקַּ֣ח אֶחָ֣ד אָחֻ֣ז מִן הַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֗ים מִן הָ/אָדָ֧ם מִן הַ/בָּקָ֛ר מִן הַ/חֲמֹרִ֥ים וּ/מִן הַ/צֹּ֖אן מִ/כָּל הַ/בְּהֵמָ֑ה וְ/נָתַתָּ֤ה אֹתָ/ם֙ לַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם שֹׁמְרֵ֕י מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת מִשְׁכַּ֥ן יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vmmchtst bny yshr'l tqch 'chd 'chz mn hchmshym mn h'dm mn hbqr mn hchmrym vmn hts'n mkhl hbhmh vntth 'tm llvym shmry mshmrt mshkhn yhvh
verses.translation: And of the children of Israel’s half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יַּ֣עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֔ה וְ/אֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'sh mshh v'l'zr hkhhn kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ הַ/מַּלְק֔וֹחַ יֶ֣תֶר הַ/בָּ֔ז אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּזְז֖וּ עַ֣ם הַ/צָּבָ֑א צֹ֗אן שֵׁשׁ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֛לֶף וְ/שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַ/חֲמֵֽשֶׁת אֲלָפִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy hmlqvch ytr hbz 'shr bzzv 'm htsb' ts'n shsh m'vt 'lf vshb'ym 'lf vchmsht 'lpym
verses.translation: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,

verses.original: וּ/בָקָ֕ר שְׁנַ֥יִם וְ/שִׁבְעִ֖ים אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vbqr shnym vshb'ym 'lf
verses.translation: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,

verses.original: וַ/חֲמֹרִ֕ים אֶחָ֥ד וְ/שִׁשִּׁ֖ים אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vchmrym 'chd vshshym 'lf
verses.translation: And threescore and one thousand asses,

verses.original: וְ/נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם מִן הַ֨/נָּשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא יָדְע֖וּ מִשְׁכַּ֣ב זָכָ֑ר כָּל נֶ֕פֶשׁ שְׁנַ֥יִם וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vnpsh 'dm mn hnshym 'shr l' yd'v mshkhb zkhr khl npsh shnym vshlshym 'lf
verses.translation: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִי֙ הַֽ/מֶּחֱצָ֔ה חֵ֕לֶק הַ/יֹּצְאִ֖ים בַּ/צָּבָ֑א מִסְפַּ֣ר הַ/צֹּ֗אן שְׁלֹשׁ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֨לֶף֙ וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וְ/שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וַ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vthy hmchtsh chlq hyts'ym btsb' mspr hts'n shlsh m'vt 'lf vshlshym 'lf vshb't 'lpym vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֛י הַ/מֶּ֥כֶס לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה מִן הַ/צֹּ֑אן שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חָמֵ֥שׁ וְ/שִׁבְעִֽים
verses.translit: vyhy hmkhs lyhvh mn hts'n shsh m'vt chmsh vshb'ym
verses.translation: And the LORD’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.

verses.original: וְ/הַ֨/בָּקָ֔ר שִׁשָּׁ֥ה וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים אָ֑לֶף וּ/מִכְסָ֥/ם לַ/יהוָ֖ה שְׁנַ֥יִם וְ/שִׁבְעִֽים
verses.translit: vhbqr shshh vshlshym 'lf vmkhsm lyhvh shnym vshb'ym
verses.translation: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the LORD’s tribute was threescore and twelve.

verses.original: וַ/חֲמֹרִ֕ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַ/חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת וּ/מִכְסָ֥/ם לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה אֶחָ֥ד וְ/שִׁשִּֽׁים
verses.translit: vchmrym shlshym 'lf vchmsh m'vt vmkhsm lyhvh 'chd vshshym
verses.translation: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the LORD’s tribute was threescore and one.

verses.original: וְ/נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָ֑לֶף וּ/מִכְסָ/ם֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה שְׁנַ֥יִם וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים נָֽפֶשׁ
verses.translit: vnpsh 'dm shshh 'shr 'lf vmkhsm lyhvh shnym vshlshym npsh
verses.translation: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the LORD’s tribute was thirty and two persons.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֗ה אֶת מֶ֨כֶס֙ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְ/אֶלְעָזָ֖ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֑ן כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vytn mshh 't mkhs trvmt yhvh l'l'zr hkhhn kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD’s heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וּ/מִֽ/מַּחֲצִ֖ית בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר֙ חָצָ֣ה מֹשֶׁ֔ה מִן הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֖ים הַ/צֹּבְאִֽים
verses.translit: vmmchtsyt bny yshr'l 'shr chtsh mshh mn h'nshym htsb'ym
verses.translation: And of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,

verses.original: וַ/תְּהִ֛י מֶחֱצַ֥ת הָ/עֵדָ֖ה מִן הַ/צֹּ֑אן שְׁלֹשׁ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֨לֶף֙ וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וַ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vthy mchtst h'dh mn hts'n shlsh m'vt 'lf vshlshym 'lf shb't 'lpym vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,

verses.original: וּ/בָקָ֕ר שִׁשָּׁ֥ה וּ/שְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vbqr shshh vshlshym 'lf
verses.translation: And thirty and six thousand beeves,

verses.original: וַ/חֲמֹרִ֕ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַ/חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vchmrym shlshym 'lf vchmsh m'vt
verses.translation: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,

verses.original: וְ/נֶ֣פֶשׁ אָדָ֔ם שִׁשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָֽלֶף
verses.translit: vnpsh 'dm shshh 'shr 'lf
verses.translation: And sixteen thousand persons;)

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה מִ/מַּחֲצִ֣ת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֶת הָֽ/אָחֻז֙ אֶחָ֣ד מִן הַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֔ים מִן הָ/אָדָ֖ם וּ/מִן הַ/בְּהֵמָ֑ה וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן אֹתָ֜/ם לַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם שֹֽׁמְרֵי֙ מִשְׁמֶ֨רֶת֙ מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶֽׁה
verses.translit: vyqch mshh mmchtst bny yshr'l 't h'chz 'chd mn hchmshym mn h'dm vmn hbhmh vytn 'tm llvym shmry mshmrt mshkhn yhvh kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh
verses.translation: Even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD ; as the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּקְרְבוּ֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה הַ/פְּקֻדִ֕ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְ/אַלְפֵ֣י הַ/צָּבָ֑א שָׂרֵ֥י הָ/אֲלָפִ֖ים וְ/שָׂרֵ֥י הַ/מֵּאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyqrbv 'l mshh hpqdym 'shr l'lpy htsb' shry h'lpym vshry hm'vt
verses.translation: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה עֲבָדֶ֣י/ךָ נָֽשְׂא֗וּ אֶת רֹ֛אשׁ אַנְשֵׁ֥י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/יָדֵ֑/נוּ וְ/לֹא נִפְקַ֥ד מִמֶּ֖/נּוּ אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'l mshh 'bdykh nsh'v 't r'sh 'nshy hmlchmh 'shr bydnv vl' npqd mmnv 'ysh
verses.translation: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.

verses.original: וַ/נַּקְרֵ֞ב אֶת קָרְבַּ֣ן יְהוָ֗ה אִישׁ֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר מָצָ֤א כְלִֽי זָהָב֙ אֶצְעָדָ֣ה וְ/צָמִ֔יד טַבַּ֖עַת עָגִ֣יל וְ/כוּמָ֑ז לְ/כַפֵּ֥ר עַל נַפְשֹׁתֵ֖י/נוּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vnqrb 't qrbn yhvh 'ysh 'shr mts' khly zhb 'ts'dh vtsmyd tb't 'gyl vkhvmz lkhpr 'l npshtynv lpny yhvh
verses.translation: We have therefore brought an oblation for the LORD , what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה וְ/אֶלְעָזָ֧ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת הַ/זָּהָ֖ב מֵֽ/אִתָּ֑/ם כֹּ֖ל כְּלִ֥י מַעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vyqch mshh v'l'zr hkhhn 't hzhb m'tm khl khly m'shh
verses.translation: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֣י כָּל זְהַ֣ב הַ/תְּרוּמָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵרִ֨ימוּ֙ לַֽ/יהוָ֔ה שִׁשָּׁ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר אֶ֛לֶף שְׁבַע מֵא֥וֹת וַ/חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים שָׁ֑קֶל מֵ/אֵת֙ שָׂרֵ֣י הָֽ/אֲלָפִ֔ים וּ/מֵ/אֵ֖ת שָׂרֵ֥י הַ/מֵּאֽוֹת
verses.translit: vyhy khl zhb htrvmh 'shr hrymv lyhvh shshh 'shr 'lf shb' m'vt vchmshym shql m't shry h'lpym vm't shry hm'vt
verses.translation: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the LORD , of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁי֙ הַ/צָּבָ֔א בָּזְז֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'nshy htsb' bzzv 'ysh lv
verses.translation: ( For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)

verses.original: וַ/יִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה וְ/אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ אֶת הַ/זָּהָ֔ב מֵ/אֵ֛ת שָׂרֵ֥י הָ/אֲלָפִ֖ים וְ/הַ/מֵּא֑וֹת וַ/יָּבִ֤אוּ אֹת/וֹ֙ אֶל אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד זִכָּר֥וֹן לִ/בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vyqch mshh v'l'zr hkhhn 't hzhb m't shry h'lpym vhm'vt vyb'v 'tv 'l 'hl mv'd zkhrvn lbny yshr'l lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD .

verses.original: וּ/מִקְנֶ֣ה רַ֗ב הָיָ֞ה לִ/בְנֵ֧י רְאוּבֵ֛ן וְ/לִ/בְנֵי גָ֖ד עָצ֣וּם מְאֹ֑ד וַ/יִּרְא֞וּ אֶת אֶ֤רֶץ יַעְזֵר֙ וְ/אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ גִּלְעָ֔ד וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה הַ/מָּק֖וֹם מְק֥וֹם מִקְנֶֽה
verses.translit: vmqnh rb hyh lbny r'vbn vlbny gd 'tsvm m'd vyr'v 't 'rts y'zr v't 'rts gl'd vhnh hmqvm mqvm mqnh
verses.translation: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;

verses.original: וַ/יָּבֹ֥אוּ בְנֵֽי גָ֖ד וּ/בְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֑ן וַ/יֹּאמְר֤וּ אֶל מֹשֶׁה֙ וְ/אֶל אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/אֶל נְשִׂיאֵ֥י הָ/עֵדָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyb'v bny gd vbny r'vbn vy'mrv 'l mshh v'l 'l'zr hkhhn v'l nshy'y h'dh l'mr
verses.translation: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,

verses.original: עֲטָר֤וֹת וְ/דִיבֹן֙ וְ/יַעְזֵ֣ר וְ/נִמְרָ֔ה וְ/חֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן וְ/אֶלְעָלֵ֑ה וּ/שְׂבָ֥ם וּ/נְב֖וֹ וּ/בְעֹֽן
verses.translit: 'trvt vdybn vy'zr vnmrh vchshbvn v'l'lh vshbm vnbv vb'n
verses.translation: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,

verses.original: הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לִ/פְנֵי֙ עֲדַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶ֥רֶץ מִקְנֶ֖ה הִ֑וא וְ/לַֽ/עֲבָדֶ֖י/ךָ מִקְנֶֽה
verses.translit: h'rts 'shr hkhh yhvh lpny 'dt yshr'l 'rts mqnh hv' vl'bdykh mqnh
verses.translation: Even the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ אִם מָצָ֤אנוּ חֵן֙ בְּ/עֵינֶ֔י/ךָ יֻתַּ֞ן אֶת הָ/אָ֧רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֛את לַ/עֲבָדֶ֖י/ךָ לַ/אֲחֻזָּ֑ה אַל תַּעֲבִרֵ֖/נוּ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: vy'mrv 'm mts'nv chn b'ynykh ytn 't h'rts hz't l'bdykh l'chzh 'l t'brnv 't hyrdn
verses.translation: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה לִ/בְנֵי גָ֖ד וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֑ן הַ/אַֽחֵי/כֶ֗ם יָבֹ֨אוּ֙ לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְ/אַתֶּ֖ם תֵּ֥שְׁבוּ פֹֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh lbny gd vlbny r'vbn h'chykhm yb'v lmlchmh v'tm tshbv ph
verses.translation: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?

verses.original: וְ/לָ֣/מָּה תנואו/ן תְנִיא֔וּ/ן אֶת לֵ֖ב בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מֵֽ/עֲבֹר֙ אֶל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥ן לָ/הֶ֖ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vlmh tnv'vn tny'vn 't lb bny yshr'l m'br 'l h'rts 'shr ntn lhm yhvh
verses.translation: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them?

verses.original: כֹּ֥ה עָשׂ֖וּ אֲבֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם בְּ/שָׁלְחִ֥/י אֹתָ֛/ם מִ/קָּדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵ֖עַ לִ/רְא֥וֹת אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: khh 'shv 'btykhm bshlchy 'tm mqdsh brn' lr'vt 't h'rts
verses.translation: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.

verses.original: וַֽ/יַּעֲל֞וּ עַד נַ֣חַל אֶשְׁכּ֗וֹל וַ/יִּרְאוּ֙ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וַ/יָּנִ֕יאוּ אֶת לֵ֖ב בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְ/בִלְתִּי בֹא֙ אֶל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥ן לָ/הֶ֖ם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vy'lv 'd nchl 'shkhvl vyr'v 't h'rts vyny'v 't lb bny yshr'l lblty b' 'l h'rts 'shr ntn lhm yhvh
verses.translation: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בַּ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא וַ/יִּשָּׁבַ֖ע לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vychr 'f yhvh byvm hhv' vyshb' l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD’s anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,

verses.original: אִם יִרְא֨וּ הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֜ים הָ/עֹלִ֣ים מִ/מִּצְרַ֗יִם מִ/בֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָ/מַ֔עְלָ/ה אֵ֚ת הָ/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֛עְתִּי לְ/אַבְרָהָ֥ם לְ/יִצְחָ֖ק וּֽ/לְ/יַעֲקֹ֑ב כִּ֥י לֹא מִלְא֖וּ אַחֲרָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'm yr'v h'nshym h'lym mmtsrym mbn 'shrym shnh vm'lh 't h'dmh 'shr nshb'ty l'brhm lytschq vly'qb khy l' ml'v 'chry
verses.translation: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:

verses.original: בִּלְתִּ֞י כָּלֵ֤ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה֙ הַ/קְּנִזִּ֔י וִ/יהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן נ֑וּן כִּ֥י מִלְא֖וּ אַחֲרֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: blty khlb bn ypnh hqnzy vyhvsh' bn nvn khy ml'v 'chry yhvh
verses.translation: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD .

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽחַר אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַ/יְנִעֵ/ם֙ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה עַד תֹּם֙ כָּל הַ/דּ֔וֹר הָ/עֹשֶׂ֥ה הָ/רַ֖ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vychr 'f yhvh byshr'l vyn'm bmdbr 'rb'ym shnh 'd tm khl hdvr h'shh hr' b'yny yhvh
verses.translation: And the LORD’s anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the LORD , was consumed.

verses.original: וְ/הִנֵּ֣ה קַמְתֶּ֗ם תַּ֚חַת אֲבֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם תַּרְבּ֖וּת אֲנָשִׁ֣ים חַטָּאִ֑ים לִ/סְפּ֣וֹת ע֗וֹד עַ֛ל חֲר֥וֹן אַף יְהוָ֖ה אֶל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhnh qmtm tcht 'btykhm trbvt 'nshym cht'ym lspvt 'vd 'l chrvn 'f yhvh 'l yshr'l
verses.translation: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers’ stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.

verses.original: כִּ֤י תְשׁוּבֻ/ן֙ מֵֽ/אַחֲרָ֔י/ו וְ/יָסַ֣ף ע֔וֹד לְ/הַנִּיח֖/וֹ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר וְ/שִֽׁחַתֶּ֖ם לְ/כָל הָ/עָ֥ם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: khy tshvbn m'chryv vysf 'vd lhnychv bmdbr vshchtm lkhl h'm hzh
verses.translation: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.

verses.original: וַ/יִּגְּשׁ֤וּ אֵלָי/ו֙ וַ֣/יֹּאמְר֔וּ גִּדְרֹ֥ת צֹ֛אן נִבְנֶ֥ה לְ/מִקְנֵ֖/נוּ פֹּ֑ה וְ/עָרִ֖ים לְ/טַפֵּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vygshv 'lyv vy'mrv gdrt ts'n nbnh lmqnnv ph v'rym ltpnv
verses.translation: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:

verses.original: וַ/אֲנַ֜חְנוּ נֵחָלֵ֣ץ חֻשִׁ֗ים לִ/פְנֵי֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִם הֲבִֽיאֹנֻ֖/ם אֶל מְקוֹמָ֑/ם וְ/יָשַׁ֤ב טַפֵּ֨/נוּ֙ בְּ/עָרֵ֣י הַ/מִּבְצָ֔ר מִ/פְּנֵ֖י יֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: v'nchnv nchlts chshym lpny bny yshr'l 'd 'shr 'm hby'nm 'l mqvmm vyshb tpnv b'ry hmbtsr mpny yshby h'rts
verses.translation: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

verses.original: לֹ֥א נָשׁ֖וּב אֶל בָּתֵּ֑י/נוּ עַ֗ד הִתְנַחֵל֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֖ישׁ נַחֲלָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l' nshvb 'l btynv 'd htnchl bny yshr'l 'ysh nchltv
verses.translation: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.

verses.original: כִּ֣י לֹ֤א נִנְחַל֙ אִתָּ֔/ם מֵ/עֵ֥בֶר לַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן וָ/הָ֑לְאָה כִּ֣י בָ֤אָה נַחֲלָתֵ֨/נוּ֙ אֵלֵ֔י/נוּ מֵ/עֵ֥בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרָֽחָ/ה
verses.translit: khy l' nnchl 'tm m'br lyrdn vhl'h khy b'h nchltnv 'lynv m'br hyrdn mzrchh
verses.translation: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר אֲלֵי/הֶם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אִֽם תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ/ן אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה אִם תֵּחָֽלְצ֛וּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לַ/מִּלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr 'lyhm mshh 'm t'shvn 't hdbr hzh 'm tchltsv lpny yhvh lmlchmh
verses.translation: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the LORD to war,

verses.original: וְ/עָבַ֨ר לָ/כֶ֧ם כָּל חָל֛וּץ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה עַ֧ד הוֹרִישׁ֛/וֹ אֶת אֹיְבָ֖י/ו מִ/פָּנָֽי/ו
verses.translit: v'br lkhm khl chlvts 't hyrdn lpny yhvh 'd hvryshv 't 'ybyv mpnyv
verses.translation: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the LORD , until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,

verses.original: וְ/נִכְבְּשָׁ֨ה הָ/אָ֜רֶץ לִ/פְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ וְ/אַחַ֣ר תָּשֻׁ֔בוּ וִ/הְיִיתֶ֧ם נְקִיִּ֛ים מֵ/יְהוָ֖ה וּ/מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ֠/הָיְתָה הָ/אָ֨רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֥את לָ/כֶ֛ם לַ/אֲחֻזָּ֖ה לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vnkhbshh h'rts lpny yhvh v'chr tshbv vhyytm nqyym myhvh vmyshr'l vhyth h'rts hz't lkhm l'chzh lpny yhvh
verses.translation: And the land be subdued before the LORD : then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the LORD , and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD .

verses.original: וְ/אִם לֹ֤א תַעֲשׂוּ/ן֙ כֵּ֔ן הִנֵּ֥ה חֲטָאתֶ֖ם לַ/יהוָ֑ה וּ/דְעוּ֙ חַטַּאתְ/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּמְצָ֖א אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'm l' t'shvn khn hnh cht'tm lyhvh vd'v cht'tkhm 'shr tmts' 'tkhm
verses.translation: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD : and be sure your sin will find you out.

verses.original: בְּנֽוּ לָ/כֶ֤ם עָרִים֙ לְ/טַפְּ/כֶ֔ם וּ/גְדֵרֹ֖ת לְ/צֹנַאֲ/כֶ֑ם וְ/הַ/יֹּצֵ֥א מִ/פִּי/כֶ֖ם תַּעֲשֽׂוּ
verses.translit: bnv lkhm 'rym ltpkhm vgdrt ltsn'khm vhyts' mpykhm t'shv
verses.translation: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר בְּנֵי גָד֙ וּ/בְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֶל מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר עֲבָדֶ֣י/ךָ יַעֲשׂ֔וּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖/י מְצַוֶּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr bny gd vbny r'vbn 'l mshh l'mr 'bdykh y'shv kh'shr 'dny mtsvh
verses.translation: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.

verses.original: טַפֵּ֣/נוּ נָשֵׁ֔י/נוּ מִקְנֵ֖/נוּ וְ/כָל בְּהֶמְתֵּ֑/נוּ יִֽהְיוּ שָׁ֖ם בְּ/עָרֵ֥י הַ/גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: tpnv nshynv mqnnv vkhl bhmtnv yhyv shm b'ry hgl'd
verses.translation: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:

verses.original: וַ/עֲבָדֶ֨י/ךָ יַֽעַבְר֜וּ כָּל חֲל֥וּץ צָבָ֛א לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖/י דֹּבֵֽר
verses.translit: v'bdykh y'brv khl chlvts tsb' lpny yhvh lmlchmh kh'shr 'dny dbr
verses.translation: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord saith.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֤ו לָ/הֶם֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֚ת אֶלְעָזָ֣ר הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וְ/אֵ֖ת יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן נ֑וּן וְ/אֶת רָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַ/מַּטּ֖וֹת לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vytsv lhm mshh 't 'l'zr hkhhn v't yhvsh' bn nvn v't r'shy 'bvt hmtvt lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם אִם יַעַבְר֣וּ בְנֵי גָ֣ד וּ/בְנֵי רְאוּבֵ֣ן אִ֠תְּ/כֶם אֶֽת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֞ן כָּל חָל֤וּץ לַ/מִּלְחָמָה֙ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְ/נִכְבְּשָׁ֥ה הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֑ם וּ/נְתַתֶּ֥ם לָ/הֶ֛ם אֶת אֶ֥רֶץ הַ/גִּלְעָ֖ד לַ/אֲחֻזָּֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr mshh 'lhm 'm y'brv bny gd vbny r'vbn 'tkhm 't hyrdn khl chlvts lmlchmh lpny yhvh vnkhbshh h'rts lpnykhm vnttm lhm 't 'rts hgl'd l'chzh
verses.translation: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the LORD , and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:

verses.original: וְ/אִם לֹ֧א יַֽעַבְר֛וּ חֲלוּצִ֖ים אִתְּ/כֶ֑ם וְ/נֹֽאחֲז֥וּ בְ/תֹכְ/כֶ֖ם בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן
verses.translit: v'm l' y'brv chlvtsym 'tkhm vn'chzv btkhkhm b'rts khn'n
verses.translation: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.

verses.original: וַ/יַּֽעֲנ֧וּ בְנֵי גָ֛ד וּ/בְנֵ֥י רְאוּבֵ֖ן לֵ/אמֹ֑ר אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל עֲבָדֶ֖י/ךָ כֵּ֥ן נַעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vy'nv bny gd vbny r'vbn l'mr 't 'shr dbr yhvh 'l 'bdykh khn n'shh
verses.translation: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.

verses.original: נַ֣חְנוּ נַעֲבֹ֧ר חֲלוּצִ֛ים לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וְ/אִתָּ֨/נוּ֙ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת נַחֲלָתֵ֔/נוּ מֵ/עֵ֖בֶר לַ/יַּרְדֵּֽן
verses.translit: nchnv n'br chlvtsym lpny yhvh 'rts khn'n v'tnv 'chzt nchltnv m'br lyrdn
verses.translation: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן לָ/הֶ֣ם מֹשֶׁ֡ה לִ/בְנֵי גָד֩ וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֨י רְאוּבֵ֜ן וְ/לַ/חֲצִ֣י שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה בֶן יוֹסֵ֗ף אֶת מַמְלֶ֨כֶת֙ סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽ/אֱמֹרִ֔י וְ/אֶת מַמְלֶ֔כֶת ע֖וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/בָּשָׁ֑ן הָ/אָ֗רֶץ לְ/עָרֶ֨י/הָ֙ בִּ/גְבֻלֹ֔ת עָרֵ֥י הָ/אָ֖רֶץ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vytn lhm mshh lbny gd vlbny r'vbn vlchtsy shbt mnshh bn yvsf 't mmlkht sychn mlkh h'mry v't mmlkht 'vg mlkh hbshn h'rts l'ryh bgblt 'ry h'rts sbyb
verses.translation: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.

verses.original: וַ/יִּבְנ֣וּ בְנֵי גָ֔ד אֶת דִּיבֹ֖ן וְ/אֶת עֲטָרֹ֑ת וְ/אֵ֖ת עֲרֹעֵֽר
verses.translit: vybnv bny gd 't dybn v't 'trt v't 'r'r
verses.translation: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת עַטְרֹ֥ת שׁוֹפָ֛ן וְ/אֶת יַעְזֵ֖ר וְ/יָגְבֳּהָֽה
verses.translit: v't 'trt shvpn v't y'zr vygbhh
verses.translation: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת בֵּ֥ית נִמְרָ֖ה וְ/אֶת בֵּ֣ית הָרָ֑ן עָרֵ֥י מִבְצָ֖ר וְ/גִדְרֹ֥ת צֹֽאן
verses.translit: v't byt nmrh v't byt hrn 'ry mbtsr vgdrt ts'n
verses.translation: And Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֤י רְאוּבֵן֙ בָּנ֔וּ אֶת חֶשְׁבּ֖וֹן וְ/אֶת אֶלְעָלֵ֑א וְ/אֵ֖ת קִרְיָתָֽיִם
verses.translit: vbny r'vbn bnv 't chshbvn v't 'l'l' v't qrytym
verses.translation: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת נְב֞וֹ וְ/אֶת בַּ֧עַל מְע֛וֹן מֽוּסַבֹּ֥ת שֵׁ֖ם וְ/אֶת שִׂבְמָ֑ה וַ/יִּקְרְא֣וּ בְ/שֵׁמֹ֔ת אֶת שְׁמ֥וֹת הֶ/עָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּנֽוּ
verses.translit: v't nbv v't b'l m'vn mvsbt shm v't shbmh vyqr'v bshmt 't shmvt h'rym 'shr bnv
verses.translation: And Nebo, and Baal-meon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ בְּנֵ֨י מָכִ֧יר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁ֛ה גִּלְעָ֖דָ/ה וַֽ/יִּלְכְּדֻ֑/הָ וַ/יּ֖וֹרֶשׁ אֶת הָ/אֱמֹרִ֥י אֲשֶׁר בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vylkhv bny mkhyr bn mnshh gl'dh vylkhdh vyvrsh 't h'mry 'shr bh
verses.translation: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֤ן מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת הַ/גִּלְעָ֔ד לְ/מָכִ֖יר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַ/יֵּ֖שֶׁב בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vytn mshh 't hgl'd lmkhyr bn mnshh vyshb bh
verses.translation: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.

verses.original: וְ/יָאִ֤יר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁה֙ הָלַ֔ךְ וַ/יִּלְכֹּ֖ד אֶת חַוֺּתֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/יִּקְרָ֥א אֶתְ/הֶ֖ן חַוֺּ֥ת יָאִֽיר
verses.translit: vy'yr bn mnshh hlkh vylkhd 't chvtyhm vyqr' 'thn chvt y'yr
verses.translation: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havoth-jair.

verses.original: וְ/נֹ֣בַח הָלַ֔ךְ וַ/יִּלְכֹּ֥ד אֶת קְנָ֖ת וְ/אֶת בְּנֹתֶ֑י/הָ וַ/יִּקְרָ֧א לָ֦/ה נֹ֖בַח בִּ/שְׁמֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vnbch hlkh vylkhd 't qnt v't bntyh vyqr' lh nbch bshmv
verses.translation: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

verses.original: אֵ֜לֶּה מַסְעֵ֣י בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָצְא֛וּ מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לְ/צִבְאֹתָ֑/ם בְּ/יַד מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְ/אַהֲרֹֽן
verses.translit: 'lh ms'y bny yshr'l 'shr yts'v m'rts mtsrym ltsb'tm byd mshh v'hrn
verses.translation: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְתֹּ֨ב מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת מוֹצָאֵי/הֶ֛ם לְ/מַסְעֵי/הֶ֖ם עַל פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/אֵ֥לֶּה מַסְעֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/מוֹצָאֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vykhtb mshh 't mvts'yhm lms'yhm 'l py yhvh v'lh ms'yhm lmvts'yhm
verses.translation: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD : and these are their journeys according to their goings out.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֤וּ מֵֽ/רַעְמְסֵס֙ בַּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽ/רִאשׁ֔וֹן בַּ/חֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֛ר י֖וֹם לַ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/רִאשׁ֑וֹן מִֽ/מָּחֳרַ֣ת הַ/פֶּ֗סַח יָצְא֤וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּ/יָ֣ד רָמָ֔ה לְ/עֵינֵ֖י כָּל מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vys'v mr'mss bchdsh hr'shvn bchmshh 'shr yvm lchdsh hr'shvn mmchrt hpsch yts'v bny yshr'l byd rmh l'yny khl mtsrym
verses.translation: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.

verses.original: וּ/מִצְרַ֣יִם מְקַבְּרִ֗ים אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בָּ/הֶ֖ם כָּל בְּכ֑וֹר וּ/בֵ/אלֹ֣הֵי/הֶ֔ם עָשָׂ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה שְׁפָטִֽים
verses.translit: vmtsrym mqbrym 't 'shr hkhh yhvh bhm khl bkhvr vb'lhyhm 'shh yhvh shptym
verses.translation: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the LORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֥וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵ/רַעְמְסֵ֑ס וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/סֻכֹּֽת
verses.translit: vys'v bny yshr'l mr'mss vychnv bskht
verses.translation: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/סֻּכֹּ֑ת וַ/יַּחֲנ֣וּ בְ/אֵתָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בִּ/קְצֵ֥ה הַ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: vys'v mskht vychnv b'tm 'shr bqtsh hmdbr
verses.translation: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְעוּ֙ מֵֽ/אֵתָ֔ם וַ/יָּ֨שָׁב֙ עַל פִּ֣י הַחִירֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל פְּנֵ֖י בַּ֣עַל צְפ֑וֹן וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ לִ/פְנֵ֥י מִגְדֹּֽל
verses.translit: vys'v m'tm vyshb 'l py hchyrt 'shr 'l pny b'l tspvn vychnv lpny mgdl
verses.translation: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pi-hahiroth, which is before Baal-zephon: and they pitched before Migdol.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְעוּ֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י הַֽ/חִירֹ֔ת וַ/יַּֽעַבְר֥וּ בְ/תוֹךְ הַ/יָּ֖ם הַ/מִּדְבָּ֑רָ/ה וַ/יֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ דֶּ֣רֶךְ שְׁלֹ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ בְּ/מִדְבַּ֣ר אֵתָ֔ם וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/מָרָֽה
verses.translit: vys'v mpny hchyrt vy'brv btvkh hym hmdbrh vylkhv drkh shlsht ymym bmdbr 'tm vychnv bmrh
verses.translation: And they departed from before Pi-hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְעוּ֙ מִ/מָּרָ֔ה וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ אֵילִ֑מָ/ה וּ֠/בְ/אֵילִם שְׁתֵּ֣ים עֶשְׂרֵ֞ה עֵינֹ֥ת מַ֛יִם וְ/שִׁבְעִ֥ים תְּמָרִ֖ים וַ/יַּחֲנוּ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vys'v mmrh vyb'v 'ylmh vb'ylm shtym 'shrh 'ynt mym vshb'ym tmrym vychnv shm
verses.translation: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מֵ/אֵילִ֑ם וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ עַל יַם סֽוּף
verses.translit: vys'v m'ylm vychnv 'l ym svf
verses.translation: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/יַּם ס֑וּף וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/מִדְבַּר סִֽין
verses.translit: vys'v mym svf vychnv bmdbr syn
verses.translation: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/מִּדְבַּר סִ֑ין וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/דָפְקָֽה
verses.translit: vys'v mmdbr syn vychnv bdpqh
verses.translation: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/דָּפְקָ֑ה וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/אָלֽוּשׁ
verses.translit: vys'v mdpqh vychnv b'lvsh
verses.translation: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מֵ/אָל֑וּשׁ וַֽ/יַּחֲנוּ֙ בִּ/רְפִידִ֔ם וְ/לֹא הָ֨יָה שָׁ֥ם מַ֛יִם לָ/עָ֖ם לִ/שְׁתּֽוֹת
verses.translit: vys'v m'lvsh vychnv brpydm vl' hyh shm mym l'm lshtvt
verses.translation: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מֵ/רְפִידִ֑ם וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/מִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי
verses.translit: vys'v mrpydm vychnv bmdbr syny
verses.translation: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/מִּדְבַּ֣ר סִינָ֑י וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/קִבְרֹ֥ת הַֽתַּאֲוָֽה
verses.translit: vys'v mmdbr syny vychnv bqbrt ht'vh
verses.translation: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibroth-hattaavah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/קִּבְרֹ֣ת הַֽתַּאֲוָ֑ה וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּ/חֲצֵרֹֽת
verses.translit: vys'v mqbrt ht'vh vychnv bchtsrt
verses.translation: And they departed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מֵ/חֲצֵרֹ֑ת וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/רִתְמָֽה
verses.translit: vys'v mchtsrt vychnv brtmh
verses.translation: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מֵ/רִתְמָ֑ה וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/רִמֹּ֥ן פָּֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vys'v mrtmh vychnv brmn prts
verses.translation: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmon-parez.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מֵ/רִמֹּ֣ן פָּ֑רֶץ וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/לִבְנָֽה
verses.translit: vys'v mrmn prts vychnv blbnh
verses.translation: And they departed from Rimmon-parez, and pitched in Libnah.

verses.translit: vys'v mlbnh vychnv brsh
verses.translation: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מֵ/רִסָּ֑ה וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בִּ/קְהֵלָֽתָה
verses.translit: vys'v mrsh vychnv bqhlth
verses.translation: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/קְּהֵלָ֑תָה וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/הַר שָֽׁפֶר
verses.translit: vys'v mqhlth vychnv bhr shpr
verses.translation: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מֵֽ/הַר שָׁ֑פֶר וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּ/חֲרָדָֽה
verses.translit: vys'v mhr shpr vychnv bchrdh
verses.translation: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מֵ/חֲרָדָ֑ה וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/מַקְהֵלֹֽת
verses.translit: vys'v mchrdh vychnv bmqhlt
verses.translation: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/מַּקְהֵלֹ֑ת וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/תָֽחַת
verses.translit: vys'v mmqhlt vychnv btcht
verses.translation: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/תָּ֑חַת וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/תָֽרַח
verses.translit: vys'v mtcht vychnv btrch
verses.translation: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/תָּ֑רַח וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/מִתְקָֽה
verses.translit: vys'v mtrch vychnv bmtqh
verses.translation: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/מִּתְקָ֑ה וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/חַשְׁמֹנָֽה
verses.translit: vys'v mmtqh vychnv bchshmnh
verses.translation: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מֵֽ/חַשְׁמֹנָ֑ה וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/מֹסֵרֽוֹת
verses.translit: vys'v mchshmnh vychnv bmsrvt
verses.translation: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/מֹּסֵר֑וֹת וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בִּ/בְנֵ֥י יַעֲקָֽן
verses.translit: vys'v mmsrvt vychnv bbny y'qn
verses.translation: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Bene-jaakan.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/בְּנֵ֣י יַעֲקָ֑ן וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/חֹ֥ר הַגִּדְגָּֽד
verses.translit: vys'v mbny y'qn vychnv bchr hgdgd
verses.translation: And they removed from Bene-jaakan, and encamped at Hor-hagidgad.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מֵ/חֹ֣ר הַגִּדְגָּ֑ד וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/יָטְבָֽתָה
verses.translit: vys'v mchr hgdgd vychnv bytbth
verses.translation: And they went from Hor-hagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/יָּטְבָ֑תָה וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/עַבְרֹנָֽה
verses.translit: vys'v mytbth vychnv b'brnh
verses.translation: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מֵֽ/עַבְרֹנָ֑ה וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/עֶצְי֥וֹן גָּֽבֶר
verses.translit: vys'v m'brnh vychnv b'tsyvn gbr
verses.translation: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Ezion-gaber.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מֵ/עֶצְי֣וֹן גָּ֑בֶר וַ/יַּחֲנ֥וּ בְ/מִדְבַּר צִ֖ן הִ֥וא קָדֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vys'v m'tsyvn gbr vychnv bmdbr tsn hv' qdsh
verses.translation: And they removed from Ezion-gaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/קָּדֵ֑שׁ וַֽ/יַּחֲנוּ֙ בְּ/הֹ֣ר הָ/הָ֔ר בִּ/קְצֵ֖ה אֶ֥רֶץ אֱדֽוֹם
verses.translit: vys'v mqdsh vychnv bhr hhr bqtsh 'rts 'dvm
verses.translation: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

verses.original: וַ/יַּעַל֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן הַ/כֹּהֵ֜ן אֶל הֹ֥ר הָ/הָ֛ר עַל פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וַ/יָּ֣מָת שָׁ֑ם בִּ/שְׁנַ֣ת הָֽ/אַרְבָּעִ֗ים לְ/צֵ֤את בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם בַּ/חֹ֥דֶשׁ הַ/חֲמִישִׁ֖י בְּ/אֶחָ֥ד לַ/חֹֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: vy'l 'hrn hkhhn 'l hr hhr 'l py yhvh vymt shm bshnt h'rb'ym lts't bny yshr'l m'rts mtsrym bchdsh hchmyshy b'chd lchdsh
verses.translation: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD , and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.

verses.original: וְ/אַהֲרֹ֔ן בֶּן שָׁלֹ֧שׁ וְ/עֶשְׂרִ֛ים וּ/מְאַ֖ת שָׁנָ֑ה בְּ/מֹת֖/וֹ בְּ/הֹ֥ר הָ/הָֽר
verses.translit: v'hrn bn shlsh v'shrym vm't shnh bmtv bhr hhr
verses.translation: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֗ע הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִי֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ עֲרָ֔ד וְ/הֽוּא יֹשֵׁ֥ב בַּ/נֶּ֖גֶב בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן בְּ/בֹ֖א בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyshm' hkhn'ny mlkh 'rd vhv' yshb bngb b'rts khn'n bb' bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מֵ/הֹ֣ר הָ/הָ֑ר וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/צַלְמֹנָֽה
verses.translit: vys'v mhr hhr vychnv btslmnh
verses.translation: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/צַּלְמֹנָ֑ה וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/פוּנֹֽן
verses.translit: vys'v mtslmnh vychnv bpvnn
verses.translation: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/פּוּנֹ֑ן וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/אֹבֹֽת
verses.translit: vys'v mpvnn vychnv b'bt
verses.translation: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מֵ/אֹבֹ֑ת וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֛וּ בְּ/עִיֵּ֥י הָעֲבָרִ֖ים בִּ/גְב֥וּל מוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: vys'v m'bt vychnv b'yy h'brym bgbvl mv'b
verses.translation: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ije-abarim, in the border of Moab.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מֵ/עִיִּ֑ים וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/דִיבֹ֥ן גָּֽד
verses.translit: vys'v m'yym vychnv bdybn gd
verses.translation: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibon-gad.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מִ/דִּיבֹ֣ן גָּ֑ד וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֖וּ בְּ/עַלְמֹ֥ן דִּבְלָתָֽיְמָ/ה
verses.translit: vys'v mdybn gd vychnv b'lmn dbltymh
verses.translation: And they removed from Dibon-gad, and encamped in Almon-diblathaim.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מֵ/עַלְמֹ֣ן דִּבְלָתָ֑יְמָ/ה וַֽ/יַּחֲנ֛וּ בְּ/הָרֵ֥י הָ/עֲבָרִ֖ים לִ/פְנֵ֥י נְבֽוֹ
verses.translit: vys'v m'lmn dbltymh vychnv bhry h'brym lpny nbv
verses.translation: And they removed from Almon-diblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

verses.original: וַ/יִּסְע֖וּ מֵ/הָרֵ֣י הָ/עֲבָרִ֑ים וַֽ/יַּחֲנוּ֙ בְּ/עַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עַ֖ל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ
verses.translit: vys'v mhry h'brym vychnv b'rbt mv'b 'l yrdn yrchv
verses.translation: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

verses.original: וַ/יַּחֲנ֤וּ עַל הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֙ מִ/בֵּ֣ית הַיְשִׁמֹ֔ת עַ֖ד אָבֵ֣ל הַשִּׁטִּ֑ים בְּ/עַֽרְבֹ֖ת מוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: vychnv 'l hyrdn mbyt hyshmt 'd 'bl hshtym b'rbt mv'b
verses.translation: And they pitched by Jordan, from Beth-jesimoth even unto Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּ/עַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֑ב עַל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵח֖וֹ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh b'rbt mv'b 'l yrdn yrchv l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם כִּ֥י אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm khy 'tm 'brym 't hyrdn 'l 'rts khn'n
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

verses.original: וְ/ה֨וֹרַשְׁתֶּ֜ם אֶת כָּל יֹשְׁבֵ֤י הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ מִ/פְּנֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/אִ֨בַּדְתֶּ֔ם אֵ֖ת כָּל מַשְׂכִּיֹּתָ֑/ם וְ/אֵ֨ת כָּל צַלְמֵ֤י מַסֵּֽכֹתָ/ם֙ תְּאַבֵּ֔דוּ וְ/אֵ֥ת כָּל בָּמֹתָ֖/ם תַּשְׁמִֽידוּ
verses.translit: vhvrshtm 't khl yshby h'rts mpnykhm v'bdtm 't khl mshkhytm v't khl tslmy mskhtm t'bdv v't khl bmtm tshmydv
verses.translation: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:

verses.original: וְ/הוֹרַשְׁתֶּ֥ם אֶת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וִֽ/ישַׁבְתֶּם בָּ֑/הּ כִּ֥י לָ/כֶ֛ם נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ לָ/רֶ֥שֶׁת אֹתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vhvrshtm 't h'rts vyshbtm bh khy lkhm ntty 't h'rts lrsht 'th
verses.translation: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.

verses.original: וְ/הִתְנַחַלְתֶּם֩ אֶת הָ/אָ֨רֶץ בְּ/גוֹרָ֜ל לְ/מִשְׁפְּחֹֽתֵי/כֶ֗ם לָ/רַ֞ב תַּרְבּ֤וּ אֶת נַחֲלָת/וֹ֙ וְ/לַ/מְעַט֙ תַּמְעִ֣יט אֶת נַחֲלָת֔/וֹ אֶל֩ אֲשֶׁר יֵ֨צֵא ל֥/וֹ שָׁ֛מָּ/ה הַ/גּוֹרָ֖ל ל֣/וֹ יִהְיֶ֑ה לְ/מַטּ֥וֹת אֲבֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם תִּתְנֶחָֽלוּ
verses.translit: vhtnchltm 't h'rts bgvrl lmshpchtykhm lrb trbv 't nchltv vlm't tm'yt 't nchltv 'l 'shr yts' lv shmh hgvrl lv yhyh lmtvt 'btykhm ttnchlv
verses.translation: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man’s inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.

verses.original: וְ/אִם לֹ֨א תוֹרִ֜ישׁוּ אֶת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ/אָרֶץ֮ מִ/פְּנֵי/כֶם֒ וְ/הָיָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תּוֹתִ֣ירוּ מֵ/הֶ֔ם לְ/שִׂכִּים֙ בְּ/עֵ֣ינֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/לִ/צְנִינִ֖ם בְּ/צִדֵּי/כֶ֑ם וְ/צָרֲר֣וּ אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם עַל הָ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם יֹשְׁבִ֥ים בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'm l' tvryshv 't yshby h'rts mpnykhm vhyh 'shr tvtyrv mhm lshkhym b'ynykhm vltsnynm btsdykhm vtsrrv 'tkhm 'l h'rts 'shr 'tm yshbym bh
verses.translation: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּמִּ֛יתִי לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת לָ/הֶ֖ם אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֥ה לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhyh kh'shr dmyty l'shvt lhm ''shh lkhm
verses.translation: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: צַ֞ו אֶת בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵ/הֶ֔ם כִּֽי אַתֶּ֥ם בָּאִ֖ים אֶל הָ/אָ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן זֹ֣את הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּפֹּ֤ל לָ/כֶם֙ בְּֽ/נַחֲלָ֔ה אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנַ֖עַן לִ/גְבֻלֹתֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: tsv 't bny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm khy 'tm b'ym 'l h'rts khn'n z't h'rts 'shr tpl lkhm bnchlh 'rts khn'n lgbltyh
verses.translation: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֨ה לָ/כֶ֧ם פְּאַת נֶ֛גֶב מִ/מִּדְבַּר צִ֖ן עַל יְדֵ֣י אֱד֑וֹם וְ/הָיָ֤ה לָ/כֶם֙ גְּב֣וּל נֶ֔גֶב מִ/קְצֵ֥ה יָם הַ/מֶּ֖לַח קֵֽדְמָ/ה
verses.translit: vhyh lkhm p't ngb mmdbr tsn 'l ydy 'dvm vhyh lkhm gbvl ngb mqtsh ym hmlch qdmh
verses.translation: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:

verses.original: וְ/נָסַ֣ב לָ/כֶם֩ הַ/גְּב֨וּל מִ/נֶּ֜גֶב לְ/מַעֲלֵ֤ה עַקְרַבִּים֙ וְ/עָ֣בַר צִ֔נָ/ה ו/היה וְ/הָיוּ֙ תּֽוֹצְאֹתָ֔י/ו מִ/נֶּ֖גֶב לְ/קָדֵ֣שׁ בַּרְנֵ֑עַ וְ/יָצָ֥א חֲצַר אַדָּ֖ר וְ/עָבַ֥ר עַצְמֹֽנָ/ה
verses.translit: vnsb lkhm hgbvl mngb lm'lh 'qrbym v'br tsnh vhyh vhyv tvts'tyv mngb lqdsh brn' vyts' chtsr 'dr v'br 'tsmnh
verses.translation: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and shall go on to Hazar-addar, and pass on to Azmon:

verses.original: וְ/נָסַ֧ב הַ/גְּב֛וּל מֵ/עַצְמ֖וֹן נַ֣חְלָ/ה מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/הָי֥וּ תוֹצְאֹתָ֖י/ו הַ/יָּֽמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vnsb hgbvl m'tsmvn nchlh mtsrym vhyv tvts'tyv hymh
verses.translation: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.

verses.original: וּ/גְב֣וּל יָ֔ם וְ/הָיָ֥ה לָ/כֶ֛ם הַ/יָּ֥ם הַ/גָּד֖וֹל וּ/גְב֑וּל זֶֽה יִהְיֶ֥ה לָ/כֶ֖ם גְּב֥וּל יָֽם
verses.translit: vgbvl ym vhyh lkhm hym hgdvl vgbvl zh yhyh lkhm gbvl ym
verses.translation: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.

verses.original: וְ/זֶֽה יִהְיֶ֥ה לָ/כֶ֖ם גְּב֣וּל צָפ֑וֹן מִן הַ/יָּם֙ הַ/גָּדֹ֔ל תְּתָא֥וּ לָ/כֶ֖ם הֹ֥ר הָ/הָֽר
verses.translit: vzh yhyh lkhm gbvl tspvn mn hym hgdl tt'v lkhm hr hhr
verses.translation: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:

verses.original: מֵ/הֹ֣ר הָ/הָ֔ר תְּתָא֖וּ לְבֹ֣א חֲמָ֑ת וְ/הָי֛וּ תּוֹצְאֹ֥ת הַ/גְּבֻ֖ל צְדָֽדָ/ה
verses.translit: mhr hhr tt'v lb' chmt vhyv tvts't hgbl tsddh
verses.translation: From mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:

verses.original: וְ/יָצָ֤א הַ/גְּבֻל֙ זִפְרֹ֔נָ/ה וְ/הָי֥וּ תוֹצְאֹתָ֖י/ו חֲצַ֣ר עֵינָ֑ן זֶֽה יִהְיֶ֥ה לָ/כֶ֖ם גְּב֥וּל צָפֽוֹן
verses.translit: vyts' hgbl zprnh vhyv tvts'tyv chtsr 'ynn zh yhyh lkhm gbvl tspvn
verses.translation: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.

verses.original: וְ/הִתְאַוִּיתֶ֥ם לָ/כֶ֖ם לִ/גְב֣וּל קֵ֑דְמָ/ה מֵ/חֲצַ֥ר עֵינָ֖ן שְׁפָֽמָ/ה
verses.translit: vht'vytm lkhm lgbvl qdmh mchtsr 'ynn shpmh
verses.translation: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham:

verses.original: וְ/יָרַ֨ד הַ/גְּבֻ֧ל מִ/שְּׁפָ֛ם הָ/רִבְלָ֖ה מִ/קֶּ֣דֶם לָ/עָ֑יִן וְ/יָרַ֣ד הַ/גְּב֔וּל וּ/מָחָ֛ה עַל כֶּ֥תֶף יָם כִּנֶּ֖רֶת קֵֽדְמָ/ה
verses.translit: vyrd hgbl mshpm hrblh mqdm l'yn vyrd hgbvl vmchh 'l khtf ym khnrt qdmh
verses.translation: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:

verses.original: וְ/יָרַ֤ד הַ/גְּבוּל֙ הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔נָ/ה וְ/הָי֥וּ תוֹצְאֹתָ֖י/ו יָ֣ם הַ/מֶּ֑לַח זֹאת֩ תִּהְיֶ֨ה לָ/כֶ֥ם הָ/אָ֛רֶץ לִ/גְבֻלֹתֶ֖י/הָ סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vyrd hgbvl hyrdnh vhyv tvts'tyv ym hmlch z't thyh lkhm h'rts lgbltyh sbyb
verses.translation: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֣ו מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר זֹ֣את הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּתְנַחֲל֤וּ אֹתָ/הּ֙ בְּ/גוֹרָ֔ל אֲשֶׁר֙ צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה לָ/תֵ֛ת לְ/תִשְׁעַ֥ת הַ/מַּטּ֖וֹת וַ/חֲצִ֥י הַ/מַּטֶּֽה
verses.translit: vytsv mshh 't bny yshr'l l'mr z't h'rts 'shr ttnchlv 'th bgvrl 'shr tsvh yhvh ltt ltsh't hmtvt vchtsy hmth
verses.translation: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:

verses.original: כִּ֣י לָקְח֞וּ מַטֵּ֨ה בְנֵ֤י הָ/ראוּבֵנִי֙ לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֔/ם וּ/מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי הַ/גָּדִ֖י לְ/בֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑/ם וַ/חֲצִי֙ מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לָקְח֖וּ נַחֲלָתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy lqchv mth bny hr'vbny lbyt 'btm vmth bny hgdy lbyt 'btm vchtsy mth mnshh lqchv nchltm
verses.translation: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:

verses.original: שְׁנֵ֥י הַ/מַּטּ֖וֹת וַ/חֲצִ֣י הַ/מַּטֶּ֑ה לָקְח֣וּ נַחֲלָתָ֗/ם מֵ/עֵ֛בֶר לְ/יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵח֖וֹ קֵ֥דְמָ/ה מִזְרָֽחָ/ה
verses.translit: shny hmtvt vchtsy hmth lqchv nchltm m'br lyrdn yrchv qdmh mzrchh
verses.translation: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הָֽ/אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר יִנְחֲל֥וּ לָ/כֶ֖ם אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ אֶלְעָזָר֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן וִ/יהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן נֽוּן
verses.translit: 'lh shmvt h'nshym 'shr ynchlv lkhm 't h'rts 'l'zr hkhhn vyhvsh' bn nvn
verses.translation: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

verses.original: וְ/נָשִׂ֥יא אֶחָ֛ד נָשִׂ֥יא אֶחָ֖ד מִ/מַּטֶּ֑ה תִּקְח֖וּ לִ/נְחֹ֥ל אֶת הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: vnshy' 'chd nshy' 'chd mmth tqchv lnchl 't h'rts
verses.translation: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֖לֶּה שְׁמ֣וֹת הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֑ים לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה יְהוּדָ֔ה כָּלֵ֖ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּֽה
verses.translit: v'lh shmvt h'nshym lmth yhvdh khlb bn ypnh
verses.translation: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/מַטֵּה֙ בְּנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֔וֹן שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל בֶּן עַמִּיהֽוּד
verses.translit: vlmth bny shm'vn shmv'l bn 'myhvd
verses.translation: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

verses.original: לְ/מַטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֔ן אֱלִידָ֖ד בֶּן כִּסְלֽוֹן
verses.translit: lmth bnymn 'lydd bn khslvn
verses.translation: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי דָ֖ן נָשִׂ֑יא בֻּקִּ֖י בֶּן יָגְלִֽי
verses.translit: vlmth bny dn nshy' bqy bn ygly
verses.translation: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף לְ/מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה נָשִׂ֑יא חַנִּיאֵ֖ל בֶּן אֵפֹֽד
verses.translit: lbny yvsf lmth bny mnshh nshy' chny'l bn 'pd
verses.translation: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי אֶפְרַ֖יִם נָשִׂ֑יא קְמוּאֵ֖ל בֶּן שִׁפְטָֽן
verses.translit: vlmth bny 'prym nshy' qmv'l bn shptn
verses.translation: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי זְבוּלֻ֖ן נָשִׂ֑יא אֱלִיצָפָ֖ן בֶּן פַּרְנָֽךְ
verses.translit: vlmth bny zbvln nshy' 'lytspn bn prnkh
verses.translation: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי יִשָׂשכָ֖ר נָשִׂ֑יא פַּלְטִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן עַזָּֽן
verses.translit: vlmth bny yshshkhr nshy' plty'l bn 'zn
verses.translation: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵי אָשֵׁ֖ר נָשִׂ֑יא אֲחִיה֖וּד בֶּן שְׁלֹמִֽי
verses.translit: vlmth bny 'shr nshy' 'chyhvd bn shlmy
verses.translation: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי נַפְתָּלִ֖י נָשִׂ֑יא פְּדַהְאֵ֖ל בֶּן עַמִּיהֽוּד
verses.translit: vlmth bny nptly nshy' pdh'l bn 'myhvd
verses.translation: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.

verses.original: אֵ֕לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה לְ/נַחֵ֥ל אֶת בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ כְּנָֽעַן
verses.translit: 'lh 'shr tsvh yhvh lnchl 't bny yshr'l b'rts khn'n
verses.translation: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּ/עַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֑ב עַל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵח֖וֹ לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh b'rbt mv'b 'l yrdn yrchv l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,

verses.original: צַו֮ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְ/נָתְנ֣וּ לַ/לְוִיִּ֗ם מִֽ/נַּחֲלַ֛ת אֲחֻזָּתָ֖/ם עָרִ֣ים לָ/שָׁ֑בֶת וּ/מִגְרָ֗שׁ לֶֽ/עָרִים֙ סְבִיבֹ֣תֵי/הֶ֔ם תִּתְּנ֖וּ לַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: tsv 't bny yshr'l vntnv llvym mnchlt 'chztm 'rym lshbt vmgrsh l'rym sbybtyhm ttnv llvym
verses.translation: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.

verses.original: וְ/הָי֧וּ הֶֽ/עָרִ֛ים לָ/הֶ֖ם לָ/שָׁ֑בֶת וּ/מִגְרְשֵׁי/הֶ֗ם יִהְי֤וּ לִ/בְהֶמְתָּ/ם֙ וְ/לִ/רְכֻשָׁ֔/ם וּ/לְ/כֹ֖ל חַיָּתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhyv h'rym lhm lshbt vmgrshyhm yhyv lbhmtm vlrkhshm vlkhl chytm
verses.translation: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.

verses.original: וּ/מִגְרְשֵׁי֙ הֶֽ/עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּתְּנ֖וּ לַ/לְוִיִּ֑ם מִ/קִּ֤יר הָ/עִיר֙ וָ/ח֔וּצָ/ה אֶ֥לֶף אַמָּ֖ה סָבִֽיב
verses.translit: vmgrshy h'rym 'shr ttnv llvym mqyr h'yr vchvtsh 'lf 'mh sbyb
verses.translation: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.

verses.original: וּ/מַדֹּתֶ֞ם מִ/ח֣וּץ לָ/עִ֗יר אֶת פְּאַת קֵ֣דְמָ/ה אַלְפַּ֪יִם בָּֽ/אַמָּ֟ה וְ/אֶת פְּאַת נֶגֶב֩ אַלְפַּ֨יִם בָּ/אַמָּ֜ה וְ/אֶת פְּאַת יָ֣ם אַלְפַּ֣יִם בָּֽ/אַמָּ֗ה וְ/אֵ֨ת פְּאַ֥ת צָפ֛וֹן אַלְפַּ֥יִם בָּ/אַמָּ֖ה וְ/הָ/עִ֣יר בַּ/תָּ֑וֶךְ זֶ֚ה יִהְיֶ֣ה לָ/הֶ֔ם מִגְרְשֵׁ֖י הֶ/עָרִֽים
verses.translit: vmdtm mchvts l'yr 't p't qdmh 'lpym b'mh v't p't ngb 'lpym b'mh v't p't ym 'lpym b'mh v't p't tspvn 'lpym b'mh vh'yr btvkh zh yhyh lhm mgrshy h'rym
verses.translation: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֣ת הֶֽ/עָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּתְּנוּ֙ לַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם אֵ֚ת שֵׁשׁ עָרֵ֣י הַ/מִּקְלָ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתְּנ֔וּ לָ/נֻ֥ס שָׁ֖מָּ/ה הָ/רֹצֵ֑חַ וַ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֣ם תִּתְּנ֔וּ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁתַּ֖יִם עִֽיר
verses.translit: v't h'rym 'shr ttnv llvym 't shsh 'ry hmqlt 'shr ttnv lns shmh hrtsch v'lyhm ttnv 'rb'ym vshtym 'yr
verses.translation: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.

verses.original: כָּל הֶ/עָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּתְּנוּ֙ לַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנֶ֖ה עִ֑יר אֶתְ/הֶ֖ן וְ/אֶת מִגְרְשֵׁי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: khl h'rym 'shr ttnv llvym 'rb'ym vshmnh 'yr 'thn v't mgrshyhn
verses.translation: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.

verses.original: וְ/הֶֽ/עָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּתְּנוּ֙ מֵ/אֲחֻזַּ֣ת בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵ/אֵ֤ת הָ/רַב֙ תַּרְבּ֔וּ וּ/מֵ/אֵ֥ת הַ/מְעַ֖ט תַּמְעִ֑יטוּ אִ֗ישׁ כְּ/פִ֤י נַחֲלָת/וֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִנְחָ֔לוּ יִתֵּ֥ן מֵ/עָרָ֖י/ו לַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: vh'rym 'shr ttnv m'chzt bny yshr'l m't hrb trbv vm't hm't tm'ytv 'ysh khpy nchltv 'shr ynchlv ytn m'ryv llvym
verses.translation: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have many ye shall give many; but from them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'l mshh l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.original: דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵ/הֶ֑ם כִּ֥י אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן אַ֥רְצָ/ה כְּנָֽעַן
verses.translit: dbr 'l bny yshr'l v'mrt 'lhm khy 'tm 'brym 't hyrdn 'rtsh khn'n
verses.translation: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;

verses.original: וְ/הִקְרִיתֶ֤ם לָ/כֶם֙ עָרִ֔ים עָרֵ֥י מִקְלָ֖ט תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה לָ/כֶ֑ם וְ/נָ֥ס שָׁ֨מָּ/ה֙ רֹצֵ֔חַ מַכֵּה נֶ֖פֶשׁ בִּ/שְׁגָגָֽה
verses.translit: vhqrytm lkhm 'rym 'ry mqlt thyynh lkhm vns shmh rtsch mkhh npsh bshggh
verses.translation: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.

verses.original: וְ/הָי֨וּ לָ/כֶ֧ם הֶ/עָרִ֛ים לְ/מִקְלָ֖ט מִ/גֹּאֵ֑ל וְ/לֹ֤א יָמוּת֙ הָ/רֹצֵ֔חַ עַד עָמְד֛/וֹ לִ/פְנֵ֥י הָ/עֵדָ֖ה לַ/מִּשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: vhyv lkhm h'rym lmqlt mg'l vl' ymvt hrtsch 'd 'mdv lpny h'dh lmshpt
verses.translation: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.

verses.original: וְ/הֶ/עָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתֵּ֑נוּ שֵׁשׁ עָרֵ֥י מִקְלָ֖ט תִּהְיֶ֥ינָה לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vh'rym 'shr ttnv shsh 'ry mqlt thyynh lkhm
verses.translation: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.

verses.original: אֵ֣ת שְׁלֹ֣שׁ הֶ/עָרִ֗ים תִּתְּנוּ֙ מֵ/עֵ֣בֶר לַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן וְ/אֵת֙ שְׁלֹ֣שׁ הֶֽ/עָרִ֔ים תִּתְּנ֖וּ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן עָרֵ֥י מִקְלָ֖ט תִּהְיֶֽינָה
verses.translit: 't shlsh h'rym ttnv m'br lyrdn v't shlsh h'rym ttnv b'rts khn'n 'ry mqlt thyynh
verses.translation: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.

verses.original: לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְ/לַ/גֵּ֤ר וְ/לַ/תּוֹשָׁב֙ בְּ/תוֹכָ֔/ם תִּהְיֶ֛ינָה שֵׁשׁ הֶ/עָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה לְ/מִקְלָ֑ט לָ/נ֣וּס שָׁ֔מָּ/ה כָּל מַכֵּה נֶ֖פֶשׁ בִּ/שְׁגָגָֽה
verses.translit: lbny yshr'l vlgr vltvshb btvkhm thyynh shsh h'rym h'lh lmqlt lnvs shmh khl mkhh npsh bshggh
verses.translation: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.

verses.original: וְ/אִם בִּ/כְלִ֨י בַרְזֶ֧ל הִכָּ֛ה/וּ וַ/יָּמֹ֖ת רֹצֵ֣חַֽ ה֑וּא מ֥וֹת יוּמַ֖ת הָ/רֹצֵֽחַ
verses.translit: v'm bkhly brzl hkhhv vymt rtsch hv' mvt yvmt hrtsch
verses.translation: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

verses.original: וְ/אִ֡ם בְּ/אֶ֣בֶן יָד֩ אֲשֶׁר יָמ֨וּת בָּ֥/הּ הִכָּ֛ה/וּ וַ/יָּמֹ֖ת רֹצֵ֣חַֽ ה֑וּא מ֥וֹת יוּמַ֖ת הָ/רֹצֵֽחַ
verses.translit: v'm b'bn yd 'shr ymvt bh hkhhv vymt rtsch hv' mvt yvmt hrtsch
verses.translation: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

verses.original: א֡וֹ בִּ/כְלִ֣י עֵֽץ יָד֩ אֲשֶׁר יָמ֨וּת בּ֥/וֹ הִכָּ֛ה/וּ וַ/יָּמֹ֖ת רֹצֵ֣חַֽ ה֑וּא מ֥וֹת יוּמַ֖ת הָ/רֹצֵֽחַ
verses.translit: 'v bkhly 'ts yd 'shr ymvt bv hkhhv vymt rtsch hv' mvt yvmt hrtsch
verses.translation: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.

verses.original: גֹּאֵ֣ל הַ/דָּ֔ם ה֥וּא יָמִ֖ית אֶת הָ/רֹצֵ֑חַ בְּ/פִגְע/וֹ ב֖/וֹ ה֥וּא יְמִיתֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: g'l hdm hv' ymyt 't hrtsch bpg'v bv hv' ymytnv
verses.translation: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.

verses.original: וְ/אִם בְּ/שִׂנְאָ֖ה יֶהְדָּפֶ֑/נּוּ אֽוֹ הִשְׁלִ֥יךְ עָלָ֛י/ו בִּ/צְדִיָּ֖ה וַ/יָּמֹֽת
verses.translit: v'm bshn'h yhdpnv 'v hshlykh 'lyv btsdyh vymt
verses.translation: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;

verses.original: א֣וֹ בְ/אֵיבָ֞ה הִכָּ֤ה/וּ בְ/יָד/וֹ֙ וַ/יָּמֹ֔ת מֽוֹת יוּמַ֥ת הַ/מַּכֶּ֖ה רֹצֵ֣חַֽ ה֑וּא גֹּאֵ֣ל הַ/דָּ֗ם יָמִ֛ית אֶת הָ/רֹצֵ֖חַ בְּ/פִגְע/וֹ בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'v b'ybh hkhhv bydv vymt mvt yvmt hmkhh rtsch hv' g'l hdm ymyt 't hrtsch bpg'v bv
verses.translation: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.

verses.original: וְ/אִם בְּ/פֶ֥תַע בְּ/לֹא אֵיבָ֖ה הֲדָפ֑/וֹ אוֹ הִשְׁלִ֥יךְ עָלָ֛י/ו כָּל כְּלִ֖י בְּ/לֹ֥א צְדִיָּֽה
verses.translit: v'm bpt' bl' 'ybh hdpv 'v hshlykh 'lyv khl khly bl' tsdyh
verses.translation: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,

verses.original: א֣וֹ בְ/כָל אֶ֜בֶן אֲשֶׁר יָמ֥וּת בָּ/הּ֙ בְּ/לֹ֣א רְא֔וֹת וַ/יַּפֵּ֥ל עָלָ֖י/ו וַ/יָּמֹ֑ת וְ/הוּא֙ לֹא אוֹיֵ֣ב ל֔/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א מְבַקֵּ֖שׁ רָעָתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'v bkhl 'bn 'shr ymvt bh bl' r'vt vypl 'lyv vymt vhv' l' 'vyb lv vl' mbqsh r'tv
verses.translation: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:

verses.original: וְ/שָֽׁפְטוּ֙ הָֽ/עֵדָ֔ה בֵּ֚ין הַ/מַּכֶּ֔ה וּ/בֵ֖ין גֹּאֵ֣ל הַ/דָּ֑ם עַ֥ל הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִ֖ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vshptv h'dh byn hmkhh vbyn g'l hdm 'l hmshptym h'lh
verses.translation: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:

verses.original: וְ/הִצִּ֨ילוּ הָ/עֵדָ֜ה אֶת הָ/רֹצֵ֗חַ מִ/יַּד֮ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַ/דָּם֒ וְ/הֵשִׁ֤יבוּ אֹת/וֹ֙ הָֽ/עֵדָ֔ה אֶל עִ֥יר מִקְלָט֖/וֹ אֲשֶׁר נָ֣ס שָׁ֑מָּ/ה וְ/יָ֣שַׁב בָּ֗/הּ עַד מוֹת֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ/גָּדֹ֔ל אֲשֶׁר מָשַׁ֥ח אֹת֖/וֹ בְּ/שֶׁ֥מֶן הַ/קֹּֽדֶשׁ
verses.translit: vhtsylv h'dh 't hrtsch myd g'l hdm vhshybv 'tv h'dh 'l 'yr mqltv 'shr ns shmh vyshb bh 'd mvt hkhhn hgdl 'shr mshch 'tv bshmn hqdsh
verses.translation: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.

verses.original: וְ/אִם יָצֹ֥א יֵצֵ֖א הָ/רֹצֵ֑חַ אֶת גְּבוּל֙ עִ֣יר מִקְלָט֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָנ֖וּס שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: v'm yts' yts' hrtsch 't gbvl 'yr mqltv 'shr ynvs shmh
verses.translation: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;

verses.original: וּ/מָצָ֤א אֹת/וֹ֙ גֹּאֵ֣ל הַ/דָּ֔ם מִ/ח֕וּץ לִ/גְב֖וּל עִ֣יר מִקְלָט֑/וֹ וְ/רָצַ֞ח גֹּאֵ֤ל הַ/דָּם֙ אֶת הָ֣/רֹצֵ֔חַ אֵ֥ין ל֖/וֹ דָּֽם
verses.translit: vmts' 'tv g'l hdm mchvts lgbvl 'yr mqltv vrtsch g'l hdm 't hrtsch 'yn lv dm
verses.translation: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:

verses.original: כִּ֣י בְ/עִ֤יר מִקְלָט/וֹ֙ יֵשֵׁ֔ב עַד מ֖וֹת הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ/גָּדֹ֑ל וְ/אַחֲרֵ֥י מוֹת֙ הַ/כֹּהֵ֣ן הַ/גָּדֹ֔ל יָשׁוּב֙ הָ/רֹצֵ֔חַ אֶל אֶ֖רֶץ אֲחֻזָּתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy b'yr mqltv yshb 'd mvt hkhhn hgdl v'chry mvt hkhhn hgdl yshvb hrtsch 'l 'rts 'chztv
verses.translation: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

verses.original: וְ/הָי֨וּ אֵ֧לֶּה לָ/כֶ֛ם לְ/חֻקַּ֥ת מִשְׁפָּ֖ט לְ/דֹרֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם בְּ/כֹ֖ל מוֹשְׁבֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhyv 'lh lkhm lchqt mshpt ldrtykhm bkhl mvshbtykhm
verses.translation: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

verses.original: כָּל מַ֨כֵּה נֶ֔פֶשׁ לְ/פִ֣י עֵדִ֔ים יִרְצַ֖ח אֶת הָ/רֹצֵ֑חַ וְ/עֵ֣ד אֶחָ֔ד לֹא יַעֲנֶ֥ה בְ/נֶ֖פֶשׁ לָ/מֽוּת
verses.translit: khl mkhh npsh lpy 'dym yrtsch 't hrtsch v'd 'chd l' y'nh bnpsh lmvt
verses.translation: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא תִקְח֥וּ כֹ֨פֶר֙ לְ/נֶ֣פֶשׁ רֹצֵ֔חַ אֲשֶׁר ה֥וּא רָשָׁ֖ע לָ/מ֑וּת כִּי מ֖וֹת יוּמָֽת
verses.translit: vl' tqchv khpr lnpsh rtsch 'shr hv' rsh' lmvt khy mvt yvmt
verses.translation: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא תִקְח֣וּ כֹ֔פֶר לָ/נ֖וּס אֶל עִ֣יר מִקְלָט֑/וֹ לָ/שׁוּב֙ לָ/שֶׁ֣בֶת בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ עַד מ֖וֹת הַ/כֹּהֵֽן
verses.translit: vl' tqchv khpr lnvs 'l 'yr mqltv lshvb lshbt b'rts 'd mvt hkhhn
verses.translation: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא תַחֲנִ֣יפוּ אֶת הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ בָּ֔/הּ כִּ֣י הַ/דָּ֔ם ה֥וּא יַחֲנִ֖יף אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/לָ/אָ֣רֶץ לֹֽא יְכֻפַּ֗ר לַ/דָּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר שֻׁפַּךְ בָּ֔/הּ כִּי אִ֖ם בְּ/דַ֥ם שֹׁפְכֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vl' tchnypv 't h'rts 'shr 'tm bh khy hdm hv' ychnyf 't h'rts vl'rts l' ykhpr ldm 'shr shpkh bh khy 'm bdm shpkhv
verses.translation: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֧א תְטַמֵּ֣א אֶת הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתֶּם֙ יֹשְׁבִ֣ים בָּ֔/הּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י שֹׁכֵ֣ן בְּ/תוֹכָ֑/הּ כִּ֚י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה שֹׁכֵ֕ן בְּ/ת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vl' ttm' 't h'rts 'shr 'tm yshbym bh 'shr 'ny shkhn btvkhh khy 'ny yhvh shkhn btvkh bny yshr'l
verses.translation: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּקְרְב֞וּ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽ/אָב֗וֹת לְ/מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת בְּנֵֽי גִלְעָד֙ בֶּן מָכִ֣יר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה מִֽ/מִּשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֑ף וַֽ/יְדַבְּר֞וּ לִ/פְנֵ֤י מֹשֶׁה֙ וְ/לִ/פְנֵ֣י הַ/נְּשִׂאִ֔ים רָאשֵׁ֥י אָב֖וֹת לִ/בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vyqrbv r'shy h'bvt lmshpcht bny gl'd bn mkhyr bn mnshh mmshpcht bny yvsf vydbrv lpny mshh vlpny hnsh'ym r'shy 'bvt lbny yshr'l
verses.translation: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:

verses.original: וַ/יֹּאמְר֗וּ אֶת אֲדֹנִ/י֙ צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה לָ/תֵ֨ת אֶת הָ/אָ֧רֶץ בְּ/נַחֲלָ֛ה בְּ/גוֹרָ֖ל לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽ/אדֹנִ/י֙ צֻוָּ֣ה בַֽ/יהוָ֔ה לָ/תֵ֗ת אֶֽת נַחֲלַ֛ת צְלָפְחָ֥ד אָחִ֖י/נוּ לִ/בְנֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vy'mrv 't 'dny tsvh yhvh ltt 't h'rts bnchlh bgvrl lbny yshr'l v'dny tsvh byhvh ltt 't nchlt tslpchd 'chynv lbntyv
verses.translation: And they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.

verses.original: וְ֠/הָיוּ לְ/אֶחָ֞ד מִ/בְּנֵ֨י שִׁבְטֵ֥י בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ לְ/נָשִׁים֒ וְ/נִגְרְעָ֤ה נַחֲלָתָ/ן֙ מִ/נַּחֲלַ֣ת אֲבֹתֵ֔י/נוּ וְ/נוֹסַ֕ף עַ֚ל נַחֲלַ֣ת הַ/מַּטֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖ינָה לָ/הֶ֑ם וּ/מִ/גֹּרַ֥ל נַחֲלָתֵ֖/נוּ יִגָּרֵֽעַ
verses.translit: vhyv l'chd mbny shbty bny yshr'l lnshym vngr'h nchltn mnchlt 'btynv vnvsf 'l nchlt hmth 'shr thyynh lhm vmgrl nchltnv ygr'
verses.translation: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.

verses.original: וְ/אִם יִהְיֶ֣ה הַ/יֹּבֵל֮ לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְ/נֽוֹסְפָה֙ נַחֲלָתָ֔/ן עַ֚ל נַחֲלַ֣ת הַ/מַּטֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּהְיֶ֖ינָה לָ/הֶ֑ם וּ/מִֽ/נַּחֲלַת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה אֲבֹתֵ֔י/נוּ יִגָּרַ֖ע נַחֲלָתָֽ/ן
verses.translit: v'm yhyh hybl lbny yshr'l vnvsph nchltn 'l nchlt hmth 'shr thyynh lhm vmnchlt mth 'btynv ygr' nchltn
verses.translation: And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַ֤ו מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַל פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לֵ/אמֹ֑ר כֵּ֛ן מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי יוֹסֵ֖ף דֹּבְרִֽים
verses.translit: vytsv mshh 't bny yshr'l 'l py yhvh l'mr khn mth bny yvsf dbrym
verses.translation: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD , saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.

verses.original: זֶ֣ה הַ/דָּבָ֞ר אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֣ה יְהוָ֗ה לִ/בְנ֤וֹת צְלָפְחָד֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר לַ/טּ֥וֹב בְּ/עֵינֵי/הֶ֖ם תִּהְיֶ֣ינָה לְ/נָשִׁ֑ים אַ֗ךְ לְ/מִשְׁפַּ֛חַת מַטֵּ֥ה אֲבִי/הֶ֖ם תִּהְיֶ֥ינָה לְ/נָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: zh hdbr 'shr tsvh yhvh lbnvt tslpchd l'mr ltvb b'ynyhm thyynh lnshym 'kh lmshpcht mth 'byhm thyynh lnshym
verses.translation: This is the thing which the LORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא תִסֹּ֤ב נַחֲלָה֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִ/מַּטֶּ֖ה אֶל מַטֶּ֑ה כִּ֣י אִ֗ישׁ בְּ/נַחֲלַת֙ מַטֵּ֣ה אֲבֹתָ֔י/ו יִדְבְּק֖וּ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vl' tsb nchlh lbny yshr'l mmth 'l mth khy 'ysh bnchlt mth 'btyv ydbqv bny yshr'l
verses.translation: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

verses.original: וְ/כָל בַּ֞ת יֹרֶ֣שֶׁת נַחֲלָ֗ה מִ/מַּטּוֹת֮ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ לְ/אֶחָ֗ד מִ/מִּשְׁפַּ֛חַת מַטֵּ֥ה אָבִ֖י/הָ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לְ/אִשָּׁ֑ה לְמַ֗עַן יִֽירְשׁוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִ֖ישׁ נַחֲלַ֥ת אֲבֹתָֽי/ו
verses.translit: vkhl bt yrsht nchlh mmtvt bny yshr'l l'chd mmshpcht mth 'byh thyh l'shh lm'n yyrshv bny yshr'l 'ysh nchlt 'btyv
verses.translation: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא תִסֹּ֧ב נַחֲלָ֛ה מִ/מַּטֶּ֖ה לְ/מַטֶּ֣ה אַחֵ֑ר כִּי אִישׁ֙ בְּ/נַ֣חֲלָת֔/וֹ יִדְבְּק֕וּ מַטּ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vl' tsb nchlh mmth lmth 'chr khy 'ysh bnchltv ydbqv mtvt bny yshr'l
verses.translation: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת מֹשֶׁ֑ה כֵּ֥ן עָשׂ֖וּ בְּנ֥וֹת צְלָפְחָֽד
verses.translit: kh'shr tsvh yhvh 't mshh khn 'shv bnvt tslpchd
verses.translation: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:

verses.original: וַ/תִּהְיֶ֜ינָה מַחְלָ֣ה תִרְצָ֗ה וְ/חָגְלָ֧ה וּ/מִלְכָּ֛ה וְ/נֹעָ֖ה בְּנ֣וֹת צְלָפְחָ֑ד לִ/בְנֵ֥י דֹדֵי/הֶ֖ן לְ/נָשִֽׁים
verses.translit: vthyynh mchlh trtsh vchglh vmlkhh vn'h bnvt tslpchd lbny ddyhn lnshym
verses.translation: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father’s brothers’ sons:

verses.original: מִֽ/מִּשְׁפְּחֹ֛ת בְּנֵֽי מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה בֶן יוֹסֵ֖ף הָי֣וּ לְ/נָשִׁ֑ים וַ/תְּהִי֙ נַחֲלָתָ֔/ן עַל מַטֵּ֖ה מִשְׁפַּ֥חַת אֲבִי/הֶֽן
verses.translit: mmshpcht bny mnshh bn yvsf hyv lnshym vthy nchltn 'l mth mshpcht 'byhn
verses.translation: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַ/מִּצְוֺ֞ת וְ/הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בְּ/יַד מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בְּ/עַֽרְבֹ֣ת מוֹאָ֔ב עַ֖ל יַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרֵחֽוֹ
verses.translit: 'lh hmtsvt vhmshptym 'shr tsvh yhvh byd mshh 'l bny yshr'l b'rbt mv'b 'l yrdn yrchv
verses.translation: These are the commandments and the judgments, which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַ/דְּבָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּ/עֵ֖בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֡ר בָּֽ/עֲרָבָה֩ מ֨וֹל ס֜וּף בֵּֽין פָּארָ֧ן וּ/בֵֽין תֹּ֛פֶל וְ/לָבָ֥ן וַ/חֲצֵרֹ֖ת וְ/דִ֥י זָהָֽב
verses.translit: 'lh hdbrym 'shr dbr mshh 'l khl yshr'l b'br hyrdn bmdbr b'rbh mvl svf byn p'rn vbyn tpl vlbn vchtsrt vdy zhb
verses.translation: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea , between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

verses.original: אַחַ֨ד עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ מֵֽ/חֹרֵ֔ב דֶּ֖רֶךְ הַר שֵׂעִ֑יר עַ֖ד קָדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵֽעַ
verses.translit: 'chd 'shr yvm mchrb drkh hr sh'yr 'd qdsh brn'
verses.translation: ( There are eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadesh-barnea.)

verses.original: וַ/יְהִי֙ בְּ/אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּ/עַשְׁתֵּֽי עָשָׂ֥ר חֹ֖דֶשׁ בְּ/אֶחָ֣ד לַ/חֹ֑דֶשׁ דִּבֶּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּ֠/כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֹת֖/וֹ אֲלֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vyhy b'rb'ym shnh b'shty 'shr chdsh b'chd lchdsh dbr mshh 'l bny yshr'l khkhl 'shr tsvh yhvh 'tv 'lhm
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the LORD had given him in commandment unto them;

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֣י הַכֹּת֗/וֹ אֵ֚ת סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽ/אֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּ/חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן וְ/אֵ֗ת ע֚וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/בָּשָׁ֔ן אֲשֶׁר יוֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּ/עַשְׁתָּרֹ֖ת בְּ/אֶדְרֶֽעִי
verses.translit: 'chry hkhtv 't sychn mlkh h'mry 'shr yvshb bchshbvn v't 'vg mlkh hbshn 'shr yvshb b'shtrt b'dr'y
verses.translation: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:

verses.original: בְּ/עֵ֥בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֖ן בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֑ב הוֹאִ֣יל מֹשֶׁ֔ה בֵּאֵ֛ר אֶת הַ/תּוֹרָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: b'br hyrdn b'rts mv'b hv'yl mshh b'r 't htvrh hz't l'mr
verses.translation: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,

verses.original: יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛י/נוּ דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֵ֖י/נוּ בְּ/חֹרֵ֣ב לֵ/אמֹ֑ר רַב לָ/כֶ֥ם שֶׁ֖בֶת בָּ/הָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhynv dbr 'lynv bchrb l'mr rb lkhm shbt bhr hzh
verses.translation: The LORD our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:

verses.original: פְּנ֣וּ וּ/סְע֣וּ לָ/כֶ֗ם וּ/בֹ֨אוּ הַ֥ר הָֽ/אֱמֹרִי֮ וְ/אֶל כָּל שְׁכֵנָי/ו֒ בָּ/עֲרָבָ֥ה בָ/הָ֛ר וּ/בַ/שְּׁפֵלָ֥ה וּ/בַ/נֶּ֖גֶב וּ/בְ/ח֣וֹף הַ/יָּ֑ם אֶ֤רֶץ הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִי֙ וְ/הַ/לְּבָנ֔וֹן עַד הַ/נָּהָ֥ר הַ/גָּדֹ֖ל נְהַר פְּרָֽת
verses.translit: pnv vs'v lkhm vb'v hr h'mry v'l khl shkhnyv b'rbh bhr vbshplh vbngb vbchvf hym 'rts hkhn'ny vhlbnvn 'd hnhr hgdl nhr prt
verses.translation: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.

verses.original: רְאֵ֛ה נָתַ֥תִּי לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֖ם אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ בֹּ֚אוּ וּ/רְשׁ֣וּ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבַּ֣ע יְ֠הוָה לַ/אֲבֹ֨תֵי/כֶ֜ם לְ/אַבְרָהָ֨ם לְ/יִצְחָ֤ק וּֽ/לְ/יַעֲקֹב֙ לָ/תֵ֣ת לָ/הֶ֔ם וּ/לְ/זַרְעָ֖/ם אַחֲרֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: r'h ntty lpnykhm 't h'rts b'v vrshv 't h'rts 'shr nshb' yhvh l'btykhm l'brhm lytschq vly'qb ltt lhm vlzr'm 'chryhm
verses.translation: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֣ר אֲלֵ/כֶ֔ם בָּ/עֵ֥ת הַ/הִ֖וא לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לֹא אוּכַ֥ל לְ/בַדִּ֖/י שְׂאֵ֥ת אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'mr 'lkhm b't hhv' l'mr l' 'vkhl lbdy sh't 'tkhm
verses.translation: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֖ם הִרְבָּ֣ה אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/הִנְּ/כֶ֣ם הַ/יּ֔וֹם כְּ/כוֹכְבֵ֥י הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם לָ/רֹֽב
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhykhm hrbh 'tkhm vhnkhm hyvm khkhvkhby hshmym lrb
verses.translation: The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.

verses.original: יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֽוֹתֵ/כֶ֗ם יֹסֵ֧ף עֲלֵי/כֶ֛ם כָּ/כֶ֖ם אֶ֣לֶף פְּעָמִ֑ים וִ/יבָרֵ֣ךְ אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhy 'bvtkhm ysf 'lykhm khkhm 'lf p'mym vybrkh 'tkhm kh'shr dbr lkhm
verses.translation: (The LORD God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are , and bless you, as he hath promised you!)

verses.original: אֵיכָ֥ה אֶשָּׂ֖א לְ/בַדִּ֑/י טָרְחֲ/כֶ֥ם וּ/מַֽשַּׂאֲ/כֶ֖ם וְ/רִֽיבְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'ykhh 'sh' lbdy trchkhm vmsh'khm vrybkhm
verses.translation: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?

verses.original: הָב֣וּ לָ֠/כֶם אֲנָשִׁ֨ים חֲכָמִ֧ים וּ/נְבֹנִ֛ים וִ/ידֻעִ֖ים לְ/שִׁבְטֵי/כֶ֑ם וַ/אֲשִׂימֵ֖/ם בְּ/רָאשֵׁי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: hbv lkhm 'nshym chkhmym vnbnym vyd'ym lshbtykhm v'shymm br'shykhm
verses.translation: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.

verses.original: וַֽ/תַּעֲנ֖וּ אֹתִ֑/י וַ/תֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ טֽוֹב הַ/דָּבָ֥ר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ לַ/עֲשֽׂוֹת
verses.translit: vt'nv 'ty vt'mrv tvb hdbr 'shr dbrt l'shvt
verses.translation: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do.

verses.original: וָ/אֶקַּ֞ח אֶת רָאשֵׁ֣י שִׁבְטֵי/כֶ֗ם אֲנָשִׁ֤ים חֲכָמִים֙ וִֽ/ידֻעִ֔ים וָ/אֶתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛/ם רָאשִׁ֖ים עֲלֵי/כֶ֑ם שָׂרֵ֨י אֲלָפִ֜ים וְ/שָׂרֵ֣י מֵא֗וֹת וְ/שָׂרֵ֤י חֲמִשִּׁים֙ וְ/שָׂרֵ֣י עֲשָׂרֹ֔ת וְ/שֹׁטְרִ֖ים לְ/שִׁבְטֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'qch 't r'shy shbtykhm 'nshym chkhmym vyd'ym v'tn 'tm r'shym 'lykhm shry 'lpym vshry m'vt vshry chmshym vshry 'shrt vshtrym lshbtykhm
verses.translation: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.

verses.original: וָ/אֲצַוֶּה֙ אֶת שֹׁ֣פְטֵי/כֶ֔ם בָּ/עֵ֥ת הַ/הִ֖וא לֵ/אמֹ֑ר שָׁמֹ֤עַ בֵּין אֲחֵי/כֶם֙ וּ/שְׁפַטְתֶּ֣ם צֶ֔דֶק בֵּֽין אִ֥ישׁ וּ/בֵין אָחִ֖י/ו וּ/בֵ֥ין גֵּרֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'tsvh 't shptykhm b't hhv' l'mr shm' byn 'chykhm vshpttm tsdq byn 'ysh vbyn 'chyv vbyn grv
verses.translation: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.

verses.original: לֹֽא תַכִּ֨ירוּ פָנִ֜ים בַּ/מִּשְׁפָּ֗ט כַּ/קָּטֹ֤ן כַּ/גָּדֹל֙ תִּשְׁמָע֔וּ/ן לֹ֤א תָג֨וּרוּ֙ מִ/פְּנֵי אִ֔ישׁ כִּ֥י הַ/מִּשְׁפָּ֖ט לֵ/אלֹהִ֣ים ה֑וּא וְ/הַ/דָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִקְשֶׁ֣ה מִ/כֶּ֔ם תַּקְרִב֥וּ/ן אֵלַ֖/י וּ/שְׁמַעְתִּֽי/ו
verses.translit: l' tkhyrv pnym bmshpt khqtn khgdl tshm'vn l' tgvrv mpny 'ysh khy hmshpt l'lhym hv' vhdbr 'shr yqshh mkhm tqrbvn 'ly vshm'tyv
verses.translation: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God’s: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.

verses.original: וָ/אֲצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֑וא אֵ֥ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֽׂוּ/ן
verses.translit: v'tsvh 'tkhm b't hhv' 't khl hdbrym 'shr t'shvn
verses.translation: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.

verses.original: וַ/נִּסַּ֣ע מֵ/חֹרֵ֗ב וַ/נֵּ֡לֶךְ אֵ֣ת כָּל הַ/מִּדְבָּ֣ר הַ/גָּדוֹל֩ וְ/הַ/נּוֹרָ֨א הַ/ה֜וּא אֲשֶׁ֣ר רְאִיתֶ֗ם דֶּ֚רֶךְ הַ֣ר הָֽ/אֱמֹרִ֔י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ אֹתָ֑/נוּ וַ/נָּבֹ֕א עַ֖ד קָדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵֽעַ
verses.translit: vns' mchrb vnlkh 't khl hmdbr hgdvl vhnvr' hhv' 'shr r'ytm drkh hr h'mry kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'lhynv 'tnv vnb' 'd qdsh brn'
verses.translation: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֖ר אֲלֵ/כֶ֑ם בָּאתֶם֙ עַד הַ֣ר הָ/אֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: v'mr 'lkhm b'tm 'd hr h'mry 'shr yhvh 'lhynv ntn lnv
verses.translation: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God doth give unto us.

verses.original: רְ֠אֵה נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛י/ךָ לְ/פָנֶ֖י/ךָ אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ עֲלֵ֣ה רֵ֗שׁ כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹתֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לָ֔/ךְ אַל תִּירָ֖א וְ/אַל תֵּחָֽת
verses.translit: r'h ntn yhvh 'lhykh lpnykh 't h'rts 'lh rsh kh'shr dbr yhvh 'lhy 'btykh lkh 'l tyr' v'l tcht
verses.translation: Behold, the LORD thy God hath set the land before thee: go up and possess it , as the LORD God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקְרְב֣וּ/ן אֵלַ/י֮ כֻּלְּ/כֶם֒ וַ/תֹּאמְר֗וּ נִשְׁלְחָ֤ה אֲנָשִׁים֙ לְ/פָנֵ֔י/נוּ וְ/יַחְפְּרוּ לָ֖/נוּ אֶת הָ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/יָשִׁ֤בוּ אֹתָ֨/נוּ֙ דָּבָ֔ר אֶת הַ/דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נַעֲלֶה בָּ֔/הּ וְ/אֵת֙ הֶֽ/עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָבֹ֖א אֲלֵי/הֶֽן
