verses.translit: vtqrbvn 'ly khlkhm vt'mrv nshlchh 'nshym lpnynv vychprv lnv 't h'rts vyshbv 'tnv dbr 't hdrkh 'shr n'lh bh v't h'rym 'shr nb' 'lyhn
verses.translation: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.

verses.original: וַ/יִּיטַ֥ב בְּ/עֵינַ֖/י הַ/דָּבָ֑ר וָ/אֶקַּ֤ח מִ/כֶּם֙ שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֣ר אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אִ֥ישׁ אֶחָ֖ד לַ/שָּֽׁבֶט
verses.translit: vyytb b'yny hdbr v'qch mkhm shnym 'shr 'nshym 'ysh 'chd lshbt
verses.translation: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:

verses.original: וַ/יִּפְנוּ֙ וַ/יַּעֲל֣וּ הָ/הָ֔רָ/ה וַ/יָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד נַ֣חַל אֶשְׁכֹּ֑ל וַֽ/יְרַגְּל֖וּ אֹתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vypnv vy'lv hhrh vyb'v 'd nchl 'shkhl vyrglv 'th
verses.translation: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְח֤וּ בְ/יָדָ/ם֙ מִ/פְּרִ֣י הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וַ/יּוֹרִ֖דוּ אֵלֵ֑י/נוּ וַ/יָּשִׁ֨בוּ אֹתָ֤/נוּ דָבָר֙ וַ/יֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ טוֹבָ֣ה הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vyqchv bydm mpry h'rts vyvrdv 'lynv vyshbv 'tnv dbr vy'mrv tvbh h'rts 'shr yhvh 'lhynv ntn lnv
verses.translation: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which the LORD our God doth give us.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֥א אֲבִיתֶ֖ם לַ/עֲלֹ֑ת וַ/תַּמְר֕וּ אֶת פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vl' 'bytm l'lt vtmrv 't py yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God:

verses.original: וַ/תֵּרָגְנ֤וּ בְ/אָהֳלֵי/כֶם֙ וַ/תֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ בְּ/שִׂנְאַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ אֹתָ֔/נוּ הוֹצִיאָ֖/נוּ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לָ/תֵ֥ת אֹתָ֛/נוּ בְּ/יַ֥ד הָ/אֱמֹרִ֖י לְ/הַשְׁמִידֵֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vtrgnv b'hlykhm vt'mrv bshn't yhvh 'tnv hvtsy'nv m'rts mtsrym ltt 'tnv byd h'mry lhshmydnv
verses.translation: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the LORD hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.

verses.original: אָנָ֣ה אֲנַ֣חְנוּ עֹלִ֗ים אַחֵי/נוּ֩ הֵמַ֨סּוּ אֶת לְבָבֵ֜/נוּ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר עַ֣ם גָּד֤וֹל וָ/רָם֙ מִמֶּ֔/נּוּ עָרִ֛ים גְּדֹלֹ֥ת וּ/בְצוּרֹ֖ת בַּ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ/גַם בְּנֵ֥י עֲנָקִ֖ים רָאִ֥ינוּ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: 'nh 'nchnv 'lym 'chynv hmsv 't lbbnv l'mr 'm gdvl vrm mmnv 'rym gdlt vbtsvrt bshmym vgm bny 'nqym r'ynv shm
verses.translation: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.

verses.original: וָ/אֹמַ֖ר אֲלֵ/כֶ֑ם לֹא תַֽעַרְצ֥וּ/ן וְֽ/לֹא תִֽירְא֖וּ/ן מֵ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'mr 'lkhm l' t'rtsvn vl' tyr'vn mhm
verses.translation: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶם֙ הַ/הֹלֵ֣ךְ לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֔ם ה֖וּא יִלָּחֵ֣ם לָ/כֶ֑ם כְּ֠/כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֧ה אִתְּ/כֶ֛ם בְּ/מִצְרַ֖יִם לְ/עֵינֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhykhm hhlkh lpnykhm hv' ylchm lkhm khkhl 'shr 'shh 'tkhm bmtsrym l'ynykhm
verses.translation: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;

verses.original: וּ/בַ/מִּדְבָּר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאִ֔יתָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נְשָׂאֲ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשָּׂא אִ֖ישׁ אֶת בְּנ֑/וֹ בְּ/כָל הַ/דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲלַכְתֶּ֔ם עַד בֹּאֲ/כֶ֖ם עַד הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vbmdbr 'shr r'yt 'shr nsh'kh yhvh 'lhykh kh'shr ysh' 'ysh 't bnv bkhl hdrkh 'shr hlkhtm 'd b'khm 'd hmqvm hzh
verses.translation: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.

verses.original: וּ/בַ/דָּבָ֖ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה אֵֽינְ/כֶם֙ מַאֲמִינִ֔ם בַּ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vbdbr hzh 'ynkhm m'mynm byhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the LORD your God,

verses.original: הַ/הֹלֵ֨ךְ לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֜ם בַּ/דֶּ֗רֶךְ לָ/ת֥וּר לָ/כֶ֛ם מָק֖וֹם לַֽ/חֲנֹֽתְ/כֶ֑ם בָּ/אֵ֣שׁ לַ֗יְלָה לַ/רְאֹֽתְ/כֶם֙ בַּ/דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּֽלְכוּ בָ֔/הּ וּ/בֶ/עָנָ֖ן יוֹמָֽם
verses.translit: hhlkh lpnykhm bdrkh ltvr lkhm mqvm lchntkhm b'sh lylh lr'tkhm bdrkh 'shr tlkhv bh vb'nn yvmm
verses.translation: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in , in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה אֶת ק֣וֹל דִּבְרֵי/כֶ֑ם וַ/יִּקְצֹ֖ף וַ/יִּשָּׁבַ֥ע לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vyshm' yhvh 't qvl dbrykhm vyqtsf vyshb' l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,

verses.original: אִם יִרְאֶ֥ה אִישׁ֙ בָּ/אֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה הַ/דּ֥וֹר הָ/רָ֖ע הַ/זֶּ֑ה אֵ֚ת הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/טּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבַּ֔עְתִּי לָ/תֵ֖ת לַ/אֲבֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'm yr'h 'ysh b'nshym h'lh hdvr hr' hzh 't h'rts htvbh 'shr nshb'ty ltt l'btykhm
verses.translation: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,

verses.original: זֽוּלָתִ֞י כָּלֵ֤ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּה֙ ה֣וּא יִרְאֶ֔/נָּה וְ/לֽ/וֹ אֶתֵּ֧ן אֶת הָ/אָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דָּֽרַךְ בָּ֖/הּ וּ/לְ/בָנָ֑י/ו יַ֕עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִלֵּ֖א אַחֲרֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: zvlty khlb bn ypnh hv' yr'nh vlv 'tn 't h'rts 'shr drkh bh vlbnyv y'n 'shr ml' 'chry yhvh
verses.translation: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the LORD .

verses.original: גַּם בִּ/י֙ הִתְאַנַּ֣ף יְהוָ֔ה בִּ/גְלַלְ/כֶ֖ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר גַּם אַתָּ֖ה לֹא תָבֹ֥א שָֽׁם
verses.translit: gm by ht'nf yhvh bgllkhm l'mr gm 'th l' tb' shm
verses.translation: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.

verses.original: יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בִּן נוּן֙ הָ/עֹמֵ֣ד לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ ה֖וּא יָ֣בֹא שָׁ֑מָּ/ה אֹת֣/וֹ חַזֵּ֔ק כִּי ה֖וּא יַנְחִלֶ֥/נָּה אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: yhvsh' bn nvn h'md lpnykh hv' yb' shmh 'tv chzq khy hv' ynchlnh 't yshr'l
verses.translation: But Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

verses.original: וְ/טַפְּ/כֶם֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֜ם לָ/בַ֣ז יִהְיֶ֗ה וּ֠/בְנֵי/כֶם אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא יָדְע֤וּ הַ/יּוֹם֙ ט֣וֹב וָ/רָ֔ע הֵ֖מָּה יָבֹ֣אוּ שָׁ֑מָּ/ה וְ/לָ/הֶ֣ם אֶתְּנֶ֔/נָּה וְ/הֵ֖ם יִירָשֽׁוּ/הָּ
verses.translit: vtpkhm 'shr 'mrtm lbz yhyh vbnykhm 'shr l' yd'v hyvm tvb vr' hmh yb'v shmh vlhm 'tnnh vhm yyrshvh
verses.translation: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּ֖ם פְּנ֣וּ לָ/כֶ֑ם וּ/סְע֥וּ הַ/מִּדְבָּ֖רָ/ה דֶּ֥רֶךְ יַם סֽוּף
verses.translit: v'tm pnv lkhm vs'v hmdbrh drkh ym svf
verses.translation: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.

verses.original: וַֽ/תַּעֲנ֣וּ וַ/תֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלַ֗/י חָטָאנוּ֮ לַֽ/יהוָה֒ אֲנַ֤חְנוּ נַעֲלֶה֙ וְ/נִלְחַ֔מְנוּ כְּ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֖/נוּ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ וַֽ/תַּחְגְּר֗וּ אִ֚ישׁ אֶת כְּלֵ֣י מִלְחַמְתּ֔/וֹ וַ/תָּהִ֖ינוּ לַ/עֲלֹ֥ת הָ/הָֽרָ/ה
verses.translit: vt'nv vt'mrv 'ly cht'nv lyhvh 'nchnv n'lh vnlchmnv khkhl 'shr tsvnv yhvh 'lhynv vtchgrv 'ysh 't khly mlchmtv vthynv l'lt hhrh
verses.translation: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the LORD , we will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗/י אֱמֹ֤ר לָ/הֶם֙ לֹ֤א תַֽעֲלוּ֙ וְ/לֹא תִלָּ֣חֲמ֔וּ כִּ֥י אֵינֶ֖/נִּי בְּ/קִרְבְּ/כֶ֑ם וְ/לֹא֙ תִּנָּֽגְפ֔וּ לִ/פְנֵ֖י אֹיְבֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly 'mr lhm l' t'lv vl' tlchmv khy 'ynny bqrbkhm vl' tngpv lpny 'ybykhm
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.

verses.original: וָ/אֲדַבֵּ֥ר אֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם וְ/לֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם וַ/תַּמְרוּ֙ אֶת פִּ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַ/תָּזִ֖דוּ וַ/תַּעֲל֥וּ הָ/הָֽרָ/ה
verses.translit: v'dbr 'lykhm vl' shm'tm vtmrv 't py yhvh vtzdv vt'lv hhrh
verses.translation: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD , and went presumptuously up into the hill.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵ֨א הָ/אֱמֹרִ֜י הַ/יֹּשֵׁ֨ב בָּ/הָ֤ר הַ/הוּא֙ לִ/קְרַאתְ/כֶ֔ם וַ/יִּרְדְּפ֣וּ אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ינָה הַ/דְּבֹרִ֑ים וַֽ/יַּכְּת֥וּ אֶתְ/כֶ֛ם בְּ/שֵׂעִ֖יר עַד חָרְמָֽה
verses.translit: vyts' h'mry hyshb bhr hhv' lqr'tkhm vyrdpv 'tkhm kh'shr t'shynh hdbrym vykhtv 'tkhm bsh'yr 'd chrmh
verses.translation: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.

verses.original: וַ/תָּשֻׁ֥בוּ וַ/תִּבְכּ֖וּ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְ/לֹֽא שָׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ בְּ/קֹ֣לְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/לֹ֥א הֶאֱזִ֖ין אֲלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vtshbv vtbkhv lpny yhvh vl' shm' yhvh bqlkhm vl' h'zyn 'lykhm
verses.translation: And ye returned and wept before the LORD ; but the LORD would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.

verses.original: וַ/תֵּשְׁב֥וּ בְ/קָדֵ֖שׁ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים כַּ/יָּמִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשַׁבְתֶּֽם
verses.translit: vtshbv bqdsh ymym rbym khymym 'shr yshbtm
verses.translation: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode there .

verses.original: וַ/נֵּ֜פֶן וַ/נִּסַּ֤ע הַ/מִּדְבָּ֨רָ/ה֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יַם ס֔וּף כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑/י וַ/נָּ֥סָב אֶת הַר שֵׂעִ֖יר יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים
verses.translit: vnpn vns' hmdbrh drkh ym svf kh'shr dbr yhvh 'ly vnsb 't hr sh'yr ymym rbym
verses.translation: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the LORD spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto me, saying,

verses.original: רַב לָ/כֶ֕ם סֹ֖ב אֶת הָ/הָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֑ה פְּנ֥וּ לָ/כֶ֖ם צָפֹֽנָ/ה
verses.translit: rb lkhm sb 't hhr hzh pnv lkhm tspnh
verses.translation: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הָ/עָם֮ צַ֣ו לֵ/אמֹר֒ אַתֶּ֣ם עֹֽבְרִ֗ים בִּ/גְבוּל֙ אֲחֵי/כֶ֣ם בְּנֵי עֵשָׂ֔ו הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּ/שֵׂעִ֑יר וְ/יִֽירְא֣וּ מִ/כֶּ֔ם וְ/נִשְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: v't h'm tsv l'mr 'tm 'brym bgbvl 'chykhm bny 'shv hyshbym bsh'yr vyyr'v mkhm vnshmrtm m'd
verses.translation: And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:

verses.original: אַל תִּתְגָּר֣וּ בָ֔/ם כִּ֠י לֹֽא אֶתֵּ֤ן לָ/כֶם֙ מֵֽ/אַרְצָ֔/ם עַ֖ד מִדְרַ֣ךְ כַּף רָ֑גֶל כִּֽי יְרֻשָּׁ֣ה לְ/עֵשָׂ֔ו נָתַ֖תִּי אֶת הַ֥ר שֵׂעִֽיר
verses.translit: 'l ttgrv bm khy l' 'tn lkhm m'rtsm 'd mdrkh khf rgl khy yrshh l'shv ntty 't hr sh'yr
verses.translation: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.

verses.original: אֹ֣כֶל תִּשְׁבְּר֧וּ מֵֽ/אִתָּ֛/ם בַּ/כֶּ֖סֶף וַ/אֲכַלְתֶּ֑ם וְ/גַם מַ֜יִם תִּכְר֧וּ מֵ/אִתָּ֛/ם בַּ/כֶּ֖סֶף וּ/שְׁתִיתֶֽם
verses.translit: 'khl tshbrv m'tm bkhsf v'khltm vgm mym tkhrv m'tm bkhsf vshtytm
verses.translation: Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.

verses.original: כִּי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜י/ךָ בֵּֽרַכְ/ךָ֗ בְּ/כֹל֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֔/ךָ יָדַ֣ע לֶכְתְּ/ךָ֔ אֶת הַ/מִּדְבָּ֥ר הַ/גָּדֹ֖ל הַ/זֶּ֑ה זֶ֣ה אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ עִמָּ֔/ךְ לֹ֥א חָסַ֖רְתָּ דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: khy yhvh 'lhykh brkhkh bkhl m'shh ydkh yd' lkhtkh 't hmdbr hgdl hzh zh 'rb'ym shnh yhvh 'lhykh 'mkh l' chsrt dbr
verses.translation: For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the LORD thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.

verses.original: וַֽ/נַּעֲבֹ֞ר מֵ/אֵ֧ת אַחֵ֣י/נוּ בְנֵי עֵשָׂ֗ו הַ/יֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּ/שֵׂעִ֔יר מִ/דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ הָֽ/עֲרָבָ֔ה מֵ/אֵילַ֖ת וּ/מֵ/עֶצְיֹ֣ן גָּ֑בֶר וַ/נֵּ֨פֶן֙ וַֽ/נַּעֲבֹ֔ר דֶּ֖רֶךְ מִדְבַּ֥ר מוֹאָֽב
verses.translit: vn'br m't 'chynv bny 'shv hyshbym bsh'yr mdrkh h'rbh m'ylt vm'tsyn gbr vnpn vn'br drkh mdbr mv'b
verses.translation: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Ezion-gaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗/י אֶל תָּ֨צַר֙ אֶת מוֹאָ֔ב וְ/אַל תִּתְגָּ֥ר בָּ֖/ם מִלְחָמָ֑ה כִּ֠י לֹֽא אֶתֵּ֨ן לְ/ךָ֤ מֵֽ/אַרְצ/וֹ֙ יְרֻשָּׁ֔ה כִּ֣י לִ/בְנֵי ל֔וֹט נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת עָ֖ר יְרֻשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly 'l ttsr 't mv'b v'l ttgr bm mlchmh khy l' 'tn lkh m'rtsv yrshh khy lbny lvt ntty 't 'r yrshh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.

verses.original: הָ/אֵמִ֥ים לְ/פָנִ֖ים יָ֣שְׁבוּ בָ֑/הּ עַ֣ם גָּד֥וֹל וְ/רַ֛ב וָ/רָ֖ם כָּ/עֲנָקִֽים
verses.translit: h'mym lpnym yshbv bh 'm gdvl vrb vrm kh'nqym
verses.translation: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;

verses.original: רְפָאִ֛ים יֵחָשְׁב֥וּ אַף הֵ֖ם כָּ/עֲנָקִ֑ים וְ/הַ/מֹּ֣אָבִ֔ים יִקְרְא֥וּ לָ/הֶ֖ם אֵמִֽים
verses.translit: rp'ym ychshbv 'f hm kh'nqym vhm'bym yqr'v lhm 'mym
verses.translation: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/שֵׂעִ֞יר יָשְׁב֣וּ הַ/חֹרִים֮ לְ/פָנִים֒ וּ/בְנֵ֧י עֵשָׂ֣ו יִֽירָשׁ֗וּ/ם וַ/יַּשְׁמִידוּ/ם֙ מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יֵּשְׁב֖וּ תַּחְתָּ֑/ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֧ר עָשָׂ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל לְ/אֶ֨רֶץ֙ יְרֻשָּׁת֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vbsh'yr yshbv hchrym lpnym vbny 'shv yyrshvm vyshmydvm mpnyhm vyshbv tchtm kh'shr 'shh yshr'l l'rts yrshtv 'shr ntn yhvh lhm
verses.translation: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the LORD gave unto them.

verses.original: עַתָּ֗ה קֻ֛מוּ וְ/עִבְר֥וּ לָ/כֶ֖ם אֶת נַ֣חַל זָ֑רֶד וַֽ/נַּעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת נַ֥חַל זָֽרֶד
verses.translit: 'th qmv v'brv lkhm 't nchl zrd vn'br 't nchl zrd
verses.translation: Now rise up, said I , and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/יָּמִ֞ים אֲשֶׁר הָלַ֣כְנוּ מִ/קָּדֵ֣שׁ בַּרְנֵ֗עַ עַ֤ד אֲשֶׁר עָבַ֨רְנוּ֙ אֶת נַ֣חַל זֶ֔רֶד שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּ/שְׁמֹנֶ֖ה שָׁנָ֑ה עַד תֹּ֨ם כָּל הַ/דּ֜וֹר אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַ/מִּלְחָמָה֙ מִ/קֶּ֣רֶב הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֔ה כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vhymym 'shr hlkhnv mqdsh brn' 'd 'shr 'brnv 't nchl zrd shlshym vshmnh shnh 'd tm khl hdvr 'nshy hmlchmh mqrb hmchnh kh'shr nshb' yhvh lhm
verses.translation: And the space in which we came from Kadesh-barnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the LORD sware unto them.

verses.original: וְ/גַ֤ם יַד יְהוָה֙ הָ֣יְתָה בָּ֔/ם לְ/הֻמָּ֖/ם מִ/קֶּ֣רֶב הַֽ/מַּחֲנֶ֑ה עַ֖ד תֻּמָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vgm yd yhvh hyth bm lhmm mqrb hmchnh 'd tmm
verses.translation: For indeed the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֨י כַ/אֲשֶׁר תַּ֜מּוּ כָּל אַנְשֵׁ֧י הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֛ה לָ/מ֖וּת מִ/קֶּ֥רֶב הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vyhy kh'shr tmv khl 'nshy hmlchmh lmvt mqrb h'm
verses.translation: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥/י לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'ly l'mr
verses.translation: That the LORD spake unto me, saying,

verses.original: אַתָּ֨ה עֹבֵ֥ר הַ/יּ֛וֹם אֶת גְּב֥וּל מוֹאָ֖ב אֶת עָֽר
verses.translit: 'th 'br hyvm 't gbvl mv'b 't 'r
verses.translation: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:

verses.original: וְ/קָרַבְתָּ֗ מ֚וּל בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן אַל תְּצֻרֵ֖/ם וְ/אַל תִּתְגָּ֣ר בָּ֑/ם כִּ֣י לֹֽא אֶ֠תֵּן מֵ/אֶ֨רֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּ֤וֹן לְ/ךָ֙ יְרֻשָּׁ֔ה כִּ֥י לִ/בְנֵי ל֖וֹט נְתַתִּ֥י/הָ יְרֻשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vqrbt mvl bny 'mvn 'l ttsrm v'l ttgr bm khy l' 'tn m'rts bny 'mvn lkh yrshh khy lbny lvt nttyh yrshh
verses.translation: And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.

verses.original: אֶֽרֶץ רְפָאִ֥ים תֵּחָשֵׁ֖ב אַף הִ֑וא רְפָאִ֤ים יָֽשְׁבוּ בָ/הּ֙ לְ/פָנִ֔ים וְ/הָֽ/עַמֹּנִ֔ים יִקְרְא֥וּ לָ/הֶ֖ם זַמְזֻמִּֽים
verses.translit: 'rts rp'ym tchshb 'f hv' rp'ym yshbv bh lpnym vh'mnym yqr'v lhm zmzmym
verses.translation: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;

verses.original: עַ֣ם גָּד֥וֹל וְ/רַ֛ב וָ/רָ֖ם כָּ/עֲנָקִ֑ים וַ/יַּשְׁמִידֵ֤/ם יְהוָה֙ מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יִּירָשֻׁ֖/ם וַ/יֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: 'm gdvl vrb vrm kh'nqym vyshmydm yhvh mpnyhm vyyrshm vyshbv tchtm
verses.translation: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the LORD destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לִ/בְנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֔ו הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּ/שֵׂעִ֑יר אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִשְׁמִ֤יד אֶת הַ/חֹרִי֙ מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֔ם וַ/יִּֽירָשֻׁ/ם֙ וַ/יֵּשְׁב֣וּ תַחְתָּ֔/ם עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: kh'shr 'shh lbny 'shv hyshbym bsh'yr 'shr hshmyd 't hchry mpnyhm vyyrshm vyshbv tchtm 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:

verses.original: וְ/הָֽ/עַוִּ֛ים הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֥ים בַּ/חֲצֵרִ֖ים עַד עַזָּ֑ה כַּפְתֹּרִים֙ הַ/יֹּצְאִ֣ים מִ/כַּפְתּ֔וֹר הִשְׁמִידֻ֖/ם וַ/יֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתָּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vh'vym hyshbym bchtsrym 'd 'zh khptrym hyts'ym mkhptvr hshmydm vyshbv tchtm
verses.translation: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)

verses.original: ק֣וּמוּ סְּע֗וּ וְ/עִבְרוּ֮ אֶת נַ֣חַל אַרְנֹן֒ רְאֵ֣ה נָתַ֣תִּי בְ֠/יָדְ/ךָ אֶת סִיחֹ֨ן מֶֽלֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֧וֹן הָֽ/אֱמֹרִ֛י וְ/אֶת אַרְצ֖/וֹ הָחֵ֣ל רָ֑שׁ וְ/הִתְגָּ֥ר בּ֖/וֹ מִלְחָמָֽה
verses.translit: qvmv s'v v'brv 't nchl 'rnn r'h ntty bydkh 't sychn mlkh chshbvn h'mry v't 'rtsv hchl rsh vhtgr bv mlchmh
verses.translation: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it , and contend with him in battle.

verses.original: הַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֗ה אָחֵל֙ תֵּ֤ת פַּחְדְּ/ךָ֙ וְ/יִרְאָ֣תְ/ךָ֔ עַל פְּנֵי֙ הָֽ/עַמִּ֔ים תַּ֖חַת כָּל הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִשְׁמְעוּ/ן֙ שִׁמְעֲ/ךָ֔ וְ/רָגְז֥וּ וְ/חָל֖וּ מִ/פָּנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: hyvm hzh 'chl tt pchdkh vyr'tkh 'l pny h'mym tcht khl hshmym 'shr yshm'vn shm'kh vrgzv vchlv mpnykh
verses.translation: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.

verses.original: וָ/אֶשְׁלַ֤ח מַלְאָכִים֙ מִ/מִּדְבַּ֣ר קְדֵמ֔וֹת אֶל סִיח֖וֹן מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן דִּבְרֵ֥י שָׁל֖וֹם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: v'shlch ml'khym mmdbr qdmvt 'l sychvn mlkh chshbvn dbry shlvm l'mr
verses.translation: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

verses.original: אֶעְבְּרָ֣ה בְ/אַרְצֶ֔/ךָ בַּ/דֶּ֥רֶךְ בַּ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ אֵלֵ֑ךְ לֹ֥א אָס֖וּר יָמִ֥ין וּ/שְׂמֹֽאול
verses.translit: ''brh b'rtskh bdrkh bdrkh 'lkh l' 'svr ymyn vshm'vl
verses.translation: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.

verses.original: אֹ֣כֶל בַּ/כֶּ֤סֶף תַּשְׁבִּרֵ֨/נִי֙ וְ/אָכַ֔לְתִּי וּ/מַ֛יִם בַּ/כֶּ֥סֶף תִּתֶּן לִ֖/י וְ/שָׁתִ֑יתִי רַ֖ק אֶעְבְּרָ֥ה בְ/רַגְלָֽ/י
verses.translit: 'khl bkhsf tshbrny v'khlty vmym bkhsf ttn ly vshtyty rq ''brh brgly
verses.translation: Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;

verses.original: כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָֽשׂוּ לִ֜/י בְּנֵ֣י עֵשָׂ֗ו הַ/יֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּ/שֵׂעִ֔יר וְ/הַ/מּ֣וֹאָבִ֔ים הַ/יֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּ/עָ֑ר עַ֤ד אֲשֶֽׁר אֶֽעֱבֹר֙ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן אֶל הָ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: kh'shr 'shv ly bny 'shv hyshbym bsh'yr vhmv'bym hyshbym b'r 'd 'shr ''br 't hyrdn 'l h'rts 'shr yhvh 'lhynv ntn lnv
verses.translation: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the LORD our God giveth us.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֣א אָבָ֗ה סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן הַעֲבִרֵ֖/נוּ בּ֑/וֹ כִּֽי הִקְשָׁה֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜י/ךָ אֶת רוּח֗/וֹ וְ/אִמֵּץ֙ אֶת לְבָב֔/וֹ לְמַ֛עַן תִּתּ֥/וֹ בְ/יָדְ/ךָ֖ כַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vl' 'bh sychn mlkh chshbvn h'brnv bv khy hqshh yhvh 'lhykh 't rvchv v'mts 't lbbv lm'n ttv bydkh khyvm hzh
verses.translation: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the LORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as appeareth this day.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔/י רְאֵ֗ה הַֽחִלֹּ֨תִי֙ תֵּ֣ת לְ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ אֶת סִיחֹ֖ן וְ/אֶת אַרְצ֑/וֹ הָחֵ֣ל רָ֔שׁ לָ/רֶ֖שֶׁת אֶת אַרְצֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly r'h hchlty tt lpnykh 't sychn v't 'rtsv hchl rsh lrsht 't 'rtsv
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.

verses.original: וַ/יֵּצֵא֩ סִיחֹ֨ן לִ/קְרָאתֵ֜/נוּ ה֧וּא וְ/כָל עַמּ֛/וֹ לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה יָֽהְצָ/ה
verses.translit: vyts' sychn lqr'tnv hv' vkhl 'mv lmlchmh yhtsh
verses.translation: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.

verses.original: וַֽ/יִּתְּנֵ֛/הוּ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ לְ/פָנֵ֑י/נוּ וַ/נַּ֥ךְ אֹת֛/וֹ וְ/אֶת בנ/ו בָּנָ֖י/ו וְ/אֶת כָּל עַמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vytnhv yhvh 'lhynv lpnynv vnkh 'tv v't bnv bnyv v't khl 'mv
verses.translation: And the LORD our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.

verses.original: וַ/נִּלְכֹּ֤ד אֶת כָּל עָרָי/ו֙ בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֔וא וַֽ/נַּחֲרֵם֙ אֶת כָּל עִ֣יר מְתִ֔ם וְ/הַ/נָּשִׁ֖ים וְ/הַ/טָּ֑ף לֹ֥א הִשְׁאַ֖רְנוּ שָׂרִֽיד
verses.translit: vnlkhd 't khl 'ryv b't hhv' vnchrm 't khl 'yr mtm vhnshym vhtf l' hsh'rnv shryd
verses.translation: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:

verses.original: רַ֥ק הַ/בְּהֵמָ֖ה בָּזַ֣זְנוּ לָ֑/נוּ וּ/שְׁלַ֥ל הֶ/עָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָכָֽדְנוּ
verses.translit: rq hbhmh bzznv lnv vshll h'rym 'shr lkhdnv
verses.translation: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.

verses.original: מֵֽ/עֲרֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל שְׂפַת נַ֨חַל אַרְנֹ֜ן וְ/הָ/עִ֨יר אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּ/נַּ֨חַל֙ וְ/עַד הַ/גִּלְעָ֔ד לֹ֤א הָֽיְתָה֙ קִרְיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂגְבָ֖ה מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ אֶת הַ/כֹּ֕ל נָתַ֛ן יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ לְ/פָנֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: m'r'r 'shr 'l shpt nchl 'rnn vh'yr 'shr bnchl v'd hgl'd l' hyth qryh 'shr shgbh mmnv 't hkhl ntn yhvh 'lhynv lpnynv
verses.translation: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and from the city that is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the LORD our God delivered all unto us:

verses.original: רַ֛ק אֶל אֶ֥רֶץ בְּנֵי עַמּ֖וֹן לֹ֣א קָרָ֑בְתָּ כָּל יַ֞ד נַ֤חַל יַבֹּק֙ וְ/עָרֵ֣י הָ/הָ֔ר וְ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֖ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: rq 'l 'rts bny 'mvn l' qrbt khl yd nchl ybq v'ry hhr vkhl 'shr tsvh yhvh 'lhynv
verses.translation: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, nor unto any place of the river Jabbok, nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever the LORD our God forbad us.

verses.original: וַ/נֵּ֣פֶן וַ/נַּ֔עַל דֶּ֖רֶךְ הַ/בָּשָׁ֑ן וַ/יֵּצֵ֣א עוֹג֩ מֶֽלֶךְ הַ/בָּשָׁ֨ן לִ/קְרָאתֵ֜/נוּ ה֧וּא וְ/כָל עַמּ֛/וֹ לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה אֶדְרֶֽעִי
verses.translit: vnpn vn'l drkh hbshn vyts' 'vg mlkh hbshn lqr'tnv hv' vkhl 'mv lmlchmh 'dr'y
verses.translation: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֵלַ/י֙ אַל תִּירָ֣א אֹת֔/וֹ כִּ֣י בְ/יָדְ/ךָ֞ נָתַ֧תִּי אֹת֛/וֹ וְ/אֶת כָּל עַמּ֖/וֹ וְ/אֶת אַרְצ֑/וֹ וְ/עָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֗יתָ לְ/סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽ/אֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּ/חֶשְׁבּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly 'l tyr' 'tv khy bydkh ntty 'tv v't khl 'mv v't 'rtsv v'shyt lv kh'shr 'shyt lsychn mlkh h'mry 'shr yvshb bchshbvn
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּן֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵ֜י/נוּ בְּ/יָדֵ֗/נוּ גַּ֛ם אֶת ע֥וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ הַ/בָּשָׁ֖ן וְ/אֶת כָּל עַמּ֑/וֹ וַ/נַּכֵּ֕/הוּ עַד בִּלְתִּ֥י הִשְׁאִֽיר ל֖/וֹ שָׂרִֽיד
verses.translit: vytn yhvh 'lhynv bydnv gm 't 'vg mlkh hbshn v't khl 'mv vnkhhv 'd blty hsh'yr lv shryd
verses.translation: So the LORD our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.

verses.original: וַ/נִּלְכֹּ֤ד אֶת כָּל עָרָי/ו֙ בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֔וא לֹ֤א הָֽיְתָה֙ קִרְיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא לָקַ֖חְנוּ מֵֽ/אִתָּ֑/ם שִׁשִּׁ֥ים עִיר֙ כָּל חֶ֣בֶל אַרְגֹּ֔ב מַמְלֶ֥כֶת ע֖וֹג בַּ/בָּשָֽׁן
verses.translit: vnlkhd 't khl 'ryv b't hhv' l' hyth qryh 'shr l' lqchnv m'tm shshym 'yr khl chbl 'rgb mmlkht 'vg bbshn
verses.translation: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

verses.original: כָּל אֵ֜לֶּה עָרִ֧ים בְּצֻר֛וֹת חוֹמָ֥ה גְבֹהָ֖ה דְּלָתַ֣יִם וּ/בְרִ֑יחַ לְ/בַ֛ד מֵ/עָרֵ֥י הַ/פְּרָזִ֖י הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: khl 'lh 'rym btsrvt chvmh gbhh dltym vbrych lbd m'ry hprzy hrbh m'd
verses.translation: All these cities were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.

verses.original: וַ/נַּחֲרֵ֣ם אוֹתָ֔/ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֔ינוּ לְ/סִיחֹ֖ן מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן הַחֲרֵם֙ כָּל עִ֣יר מְתִ֔ם הַ/נָּשִׁ֖ים וְ/הַ/טָּֽף
verses.translit: vnchrm 'vtm kh'shr 'shynv lsychn mlkh chshbvn hchrm khl 'yr mtm hnshym vhtf
verses.translation: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הַ/בְּהֵמָ֛ה וּ/שְׁלַ֥ל הֶ/עָרִ֖ים בַּזּ֥וֹנוּ לָֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vkhl hbhmh vshll h'rym bzvnv lnv
verses.translation: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.

verses.original: וַ/נִּקַּ֞ח בָּ/עֵ֤ת הַ/הִוא֙ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ מִ/יַּ֗ד שְׁנֵי֙ מַלְכֵ֣י הָ/אֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵ֣בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן מִ/נַּ֥חַל אַרְנֹ֖ן עַד הַ֥ר חֶרְמֽוֹן
verses.translit: vnqch b't hhv' 't h'rts myd shny mlkhy h'mry 'shr b'br hyrdn mnchl 'rnn 'd hr chrmvn
verses.translation: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;

verses.original: צִידֹנִ֛ים יִקְרְא֥וּ לְ/חֶרְמ֖וֹן שִׂרְיֹ֑ן וְ/הָ֣/אֱמֹרִ֔י יִקְרְאוּ ל֖/וֹ שְׂנִֽיר
verses.translit: tsydnym yqr'v lchrmvn shryn vh'mry yqr'v lv shnyr
verses.translation: ( Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)

verses.original: כֹּ֣ל עָרֵ֣י הַ/מִּישֹׁ֗ר וְ/כָל הַ/גִּלְעָד֙ וְ/כָל הַ/בָּשָׁ֔ן עַד סַלְכָ֖ה וְ/אֶדְרֶ֑עִי עָרֵ֛י מַמְלֶ֥כֶת ע֖וֹג בַּ/בָּשָֽׁן
verses.translit: khl 'ry hmyshr vkhl hgl'd vkhl hbshn 'd slkhh v'dr'y 'ry mmlkht 'vg bbshn
verses.translation: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

verses.original: כִּ֣י רַק ע֞וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַ/בָּשָׁ֗ן נִשְׁאַר֮ מִ/יֶּ֣תֶר הָ/רְפָאִים֒ הִנֵּ֤ה עַרְשׂ/וֹ֙ עֶ֣רֶשׂ בַּרְזֶ֔ל הֲ/לֹ֣ה הִ֔וא בְּ/רַבַּ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן תֵּ֧שַׁע אַמּ֣וֹת אָרְכָּ֗/הּ וְ/אַרְבַּ֥ע אַמּ֛וֹת רָחְבָּ֖/הּ בְּ/אַמַּת אִֽישׁ
verses.translit: khy rq 'vg mlkh hbshn nsh'r mytr hrp'ym hnh 'rshv 'rsh brzl hlh hv' brbt bny 'mvn tsh' 'mvt 'rkhh v'rb' 'mvt rchbh b'mt 'ysh
verses.translation: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הָ/אָ֧רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֛את יָרַ֖שְׁנוּ בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֑וא מֵ/עֲרֹעֵ֞ר אֲשֶׁר עַל נַ֣חַל אַרְנֹ֗ן וַ/חֲצִ֤י הַֽר הַ/גִּלְעָד֙ וְ/עָרָ֔י/ו נָתַ֕תִּי לָ/רֻֽאוּבֵנִ֖י וְ/לַ/גָּדִֽי
verses.translit: v't h'rts hz't yrshnv b't hhv' m'r'r 'shr 'l nchl 'rnn vchtsy hr hgl'd v'ryv ntty lr'vbny vlgdy
verses.translation: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.

verses.original: וְ/יֶ֨תֶר הַ/גִּלְעָ֤ד וְ/כָל הַ/בָּשָׁן֙ מַמְלֶ֣כֶת ע֔וֹג נָתַ֕תִּי לַ/חֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽ/מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה כֹּ֣ל חֶ֤בֶל הָֽ/אַרְגֹּב֙ לְ/כָל הַ/בָּשָׁ֔ן הַ/ה֥וּא יִקָּרֵ֖א אֶ֥רֶץ רְפָאִֽים
verses.translit: vytr hgl'd vkhl hbshn mmlkht 'vg ntty lchtsy shbt hmnshh khl chbl h'rgb lkhl hbshn hhv' yqr' 'rts rp'ym
verses.translation: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.

verses.original: יָאִ֣יר בֶּן מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה לָקַח֙ אֶת כָּל חֶ֣בֶל אַרְגֹּ֔ב עַד גְּב֥וּל הַ/גְּשׁוּרִ֖י וְ/הַ/מַּֽעֲכָתִ֑י וַ/יִּקְרָא֩ אֹתָ֨/ם עַל שְׁמ֤/וֹ אֶת הַ/בָּשָׁן֙ חַוֺּ֣ת יָאִ֔יר עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: y'yr bn mnshh lqch 't khl chbl 'rgb 'd gbvl hgshvry vhm'khty vyqr' 'tm 'l shmv 't hbshn chvt y'yr 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashan-havoth-jair, unto this day.

verses.original: וּ/לְ/מָכִ֖יר נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת הַ/גִּלְעָֽד
verses.translit: vlmkhyr ntty 't hgl'd
verses.translation: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.

verses.original: וְ/לָ/רֻאוּבֵנִ֨י וְ/לַ/גָּדִ֜י נָתַ֤תִּי מִן הַ/גִּלְעָד֙ וְ/עַד נַ֣חַל אַרְנֹ֔ן תּ֥וֹךְ הַ/נַּ֖חַל וּ/גְבֻ֑ל וְ/עַד֙ יַבֹּ֣ק הַ/נַּ֔חַל גְּב֖וּל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן
verses.translit: vlr'vbny vlgdy ntty mn hgl'd v'd nchl 'rnn tvkh hnchl vgbl v'd ybq hnchl gbvl bny 'mvn
verses.translation: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

verses.original: וְ/הָֽ/עֲרָבָ֖ה וְ/הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֣ן וּ/גְבֻ֑ל מִ/כִּנֶּ֗רֶת וְ/עַ֨ד יָ֤ם הָֽ/עֲרָבָה֙ יָ֣ם הַ/מֶּ֔לַח תַּ֛חַת אַשְׁדֹּ֥ת הַ/פִּסְגָּ֖ה מִזְרָֽחָ/ה
verses.translit: vh'rbh vhyrdn vgbl mkhnrt v'd ym h'rbh ym hmlch tcht 'shdt hpsgh mzrchh
verses.translation: The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast thereof , from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, under Ashdoth-pisgah eastward.

verses.original: וָ/אֲצַ֣ו אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם בָּ/עֵ֥ת הַ/הִ֖וא לֵ/אמֹ֑ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֗ם נָתַ֨ן לָ/כֶ֜ם אֶת הָ/אָ֤רֶץ הַ/זֹּאת֙ לְ/רִשְׁתָּ֔/הּ חֲלוּצִ֣ים תַּֽעַבְר֗וּ לִ/פְנֵ֛י אֲחֵי/כֶ֥ם בְּנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כָּל בְּנֵי חָֽיִל
verses.translit: v'tsv 'tkhm b't hhv' l'mr yhvh 'lhykhm ntn lkhm 't h'rts hz't lrshth chlvtsym t'brv lpny 'chykhm bny yshr'l khl bny chyl
verses.translation: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The LORD your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all that are meet for the war.

verses.original: רַ֠ק נְשֵׁי/כֶ֣ם וְ/טַפְּ/כֶם֮ וּ/מִקְנֵ/כֶם֒ יָדַ֕עְתִּי כִּֽי מִקְנֶ֥ה רַ֖ב לָ/כֶ֑ם יֵֽשְׁבוּ֙ בְּ/עָ֣רֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: rq nshykhm vtpkhm vmqnkhm yd'ty khy mqnh rb lkhm yshbv b'rykhm 'shr ntty lkhm
verses.translation: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, ( for I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;

verses.original: עַ֠ד אֲשֶׁר יָנִ֨יחַ יְהוָ֥ה לַֽ/אֲחֵי/כֶם֮ כָּ/כֶם֒ וְ/יָרְשׁ֣וּ גַם הֵ֔ם אֶת הָ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֛ם נֹתֵ֥ן לָ/הֶ֖ם בְּ/עֵ֣בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְ/שַׁבְתֶּ֗ם אִ֚ישׁ לִֽ/ירֻשָּׁת֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'd 'shr ynych yhvh l'chykhm khkhm vyrshv gm hm 't h'rts 'shr yhvh 'lhykhm ntn lhm b'br hyrdn vshbtm 'ysh lyrshtv 'shr ntty lkhm
verses.translation: Until the LORD have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and until they also possess the land which the LORD your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת יְהוֹשׁ֣וּעַ צִוֵּ֔יתִי בָּ/עֵ֥ת הַ/הִ֖וא לֵ/אמֹ֑ר עֵינֶ֣י/ךָ הָ/רֹאֹ֗ת אֵת֩ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶם֙ לִ/שְׁנֵי֙ הַ/מְּלָכִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה כֵּֽן יַעֲשֶׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְ/כָל הַ/מַּמְלָכ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה עֹבֵ֥ר שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: v't yhvshv' tsvyty b't hhv' l'mr 'ynykh hr't 't khl 'shr 'shh yhvh 'lhykhm lshny hmlkhym h'lh khn y'shh yhvh lkhl hmmlkhvt 'shr 'th 'br shmh
verses.translation: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall the LORD do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest.

verses.original: לֹ֖א תְִּירָא֑וּ/ם כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם ה֖וּא הַ/נִּלְחָ֥ם לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: l' tyr'vm khy yhvh 'lhykhm hv' hnlchm lkhm
verses.translation: Ye shall not fear them: for the LORD your God he shall fight for you.

verses.original: וָ/אֶתְחַנַּ֖ן אֶל יְהוָ֑ה בָּ/עֵ֥ת הַ/הִ֖וא לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: v'tchnn 'l yhvh b't hhv' l'mr
verses.translation: And I besought the LORD at that time, saying,

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה אַתָּ֤ה הַֽחִלּ֨וֹתָ֙ לְ/הַרְא֣וֹת אֶֽת עַבְדְּ/ךָ֔ אֶ֨ת גָּדְלְ/ךָ֔ וְ/אֶת יָדְ/ךָ֖ הַ/חֲזָקָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר מִי אֵל֙ בַּ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם וּ/בָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה כְ/מַעֲשֶׂ֖י/ךָ וְ/כִ/גְבוּרֹתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'dny yhvh 'th hchlvt lhr'vt 't 'bdkh 't gdlkh v't ydkh hchzqh 'shr my 'l bshmym vb'rts 'shr y'shh khm'shykh vkhgbvrtkh
verses.translation: O Lord GOD , thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?

verses.original: אֶעְבְּרָה נָּ֗א וְ/אֶרְאֶה֙ אֶת הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/טּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵ֣בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן הָ/הָ֥ר הַ/טּ֛וֹב הַ/זֶּ֖ה וְ/הַ/לְּבָנֽוֹן
verses.translit: ''brh n' v'r'h 't h'rts htvbh 'shr b'br hyrdn hhr htvb hzh vhlbnvn
verses.translation: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.

verses.original: וַ/יִּתְעַבֵּ֨ר יְהוָ֥ה בִּ/י֙ לְמַ֣עַנְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/לֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֵלָ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֵלַ/י֙ רַב לָ֔/ךְ אַל תּ֗וֹסֶף דַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֛/י ע֖וֹד בַּ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vyt'br yhvh by lm'nkhm vl' shm' 'ly vy'mr yhvh 'ly rb lkh 'l tvsf dbr 'ly 'vd bdbr hzh
verses.translation: But the LORD was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the LORD said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.

verses.original: עֲלֵ֣ה רֹ֣אשׁ הַ/פִּסְגָּ֗ה וְ/שָׂ֥א עֵינֶ֛י/ךָ יָ֧מָּ/ה וְ/צָפֹ֛נָ/ה וְ/תֵימָ֥נָ/ה וּ/מִזְרָ֖חָ/ה וּ/רְאֵ֣ה בְ/עֵינֶ֑י/ךָ כִּי לֹ֥א תַעֲבֹ֖ר אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֥ן הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: 'lh r'sh hpsgh vsh' 'ynykh ymh vtspnh vtymnh vmzrchh vr'h b'ynykh khy l' t'br 't hyrdn hzh
verses.translation: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.

verses.original: וְ/צַ֥ו אֶת יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ וְ/חַזְּקֵ֣/הוּ וְ/אַמְּצֵ֑/הוּ כִּי ה֣וּא יַעֲבֹ֗ר לִ/פְנֵי֙ הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/הוּא֙ יַנְחִ֣יל אוֹתָ֔/ם אֶת הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: vtsv 't yhvsh' vchzqhv v'mtshv khy hv' y'br lpny h'm hzh vhv' ynchyl 'vtm 't h'rts 'shr tr'h
verses.translation: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.

verses.original: וַ/נֵּ֣שֶׁב בַּ/גָּ֔יְא מ֖וּל בֵּ֥ית פְּעֽוֹר
verses.translit: vnshb bgy' mvl byt p'vr
verses.translation: So we abode in the valley over against Beth-peor.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל שְׁמַ֤ע אֶל הַֽ/חֻקִּים֙ וְ/אֶל הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָֽנֹכִ֛י מְלַמֵּ֥ד אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם לַ/עֲשׂ֑וֹת לְמַ֣עַן תִּֽחְי֗וּ וּ/בָאתֶם֙ וִֽ/ירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם נֹתֵ֥ן לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'th yshr'l shm' 'l hchqym v'l hmshptym 'shr 'nkhy mlmd 'tkhm l'shvt lm'n tchyv vb'tm vyrshtm 't h'rts 'shr yhvh 'lhy 'btykhm ntn lkhm
verses.translation: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them , that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.

verses.original: לֹ֣א תֹסִ֗פוּ עַל הַ/דָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָנֹכִי֙ מְצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/לֹ֥א תִגְרְע֖וּ מִמֶּ֑/נּוּ לִ/שְׁמֹ֗ר אֶת מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: l' tspv 'l hdbr 'shr 'nkhy mtsvh 'tkhm vl' tgr'v mmnv lshmr 't mtsvt yhvh 'lhykhm 'shr 'nkhy mtsvh 'tkhm
verses.translation: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.

verses.original: עֵֽינֵי/כֶם֙ הָֽ/רֹאֹ֔ת אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה בְּ/בַ֣עַל פְּע֑וֹר כִּ֣י כָל הָ/אִ֗ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הָלַךְ֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י בַֽעַל פְּע֔וֹר הִשְׁמִיד֛/וֹ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ מִ/קִּרְבֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 'ynykhm hr't 't 'shr 'shh yhvh bb'l p'vr khy khl h'ysh 'shr hlkh 'chry b'l p'vr hshmydv yhvh 'lhykh mqrbkh
verses.translation: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal-peor: for all the men that followed Baal-peor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.

verses.original: וְ/אַתֶּם֙ הַ/דְּבֵקִ֔ים בַּ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֑ם חַיִּ֥ים כֻּלְּ/כֶ֖ם הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: v'tm hdbqym byhvh 'lhykhm chyym khlkhm hyvm
verses.translation: But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God are alive every one of you this day.

verses.original: רְאֵ֣ה לִמַּ֣דְתִּי אֶתְ/כֶ֗ם חֻקִּים֙ וּ/מִשְׁפָּטִ֔ים כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוַּ֖/נִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑/י לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת כֵּ֔ן בְּ/קֶ֣רֶב הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם בָּאִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּ/ה לְ/רִשְׁתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: r'h lmdty 'tkhm chqym vmshptym kh'shr tsvny yhvh 'lhy l'shvt khn bqrb h'rts 'shr 'tm b'ym shmh lrshth
verses.translation: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּם֮ וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶם֒ כִּ֣י הִ֤וא חָכְמַתְ/כֶם֙ וּ/בִ֣ינַתְ/כֶ֔ם לְ/עֵינֵ֖י הָ/עַמִּ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁמְע֗וּ/ן אֵ֚ת כָּל הַ/חֻקִּ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה וְ/אָמְר֗וּ רַ֚ק עַם חָכָ֣ם וְ/נָב֔וֹן הַ/גּ֥וֹי הַ/גָּד֖וֹל הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vshmrtm v'shytm khy hv' chkhmtkhm vbyntkhm l'yny h'mym 'shr yshm'vn 't khl hchqym h'lh v'mrv rq 'm chkhm vnbvn hgvy hgdvl hzh
verses.translation: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.

verses.original: כִּ֚י מִי ג֣וֹי גָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר ל֥/וֹ אֱלֹהִ֖ים קְרֹבִ֣ים אֵלָ֑י/ו כַּ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔י/נוּ בְּ/כָּל קָרְאֵ֖/נוּ אֵלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: khy my gvy gdvl 'shr lv 'lhym qrbym 'lyv khyhvh 'lhynv bkhl qr'nv 'lyv
verses.translation: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God is in all things that we call upon him for ?

verses.original: וּ/מִי֙ גּ֣וֹי גָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁר ל֛/וֹ חֻקִּ֥ים וּ/מִשְׁפָּטִ֖ים צַדִּיקִ֑ם כְּ/כֹל֙ הַ/תּוֹרָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֖ם הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vmy gvy gdvl 'shr lv chqym vmshptym tsdyqm khkhl htvrh hz't 'shr 'nkhy ntn lpnykhm hyvm
verses.translation: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?

verses.original: רַ֡ק הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְ/ךָ֩ וּ/שְׁמֹ֨ר נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֜ מְאֹ֗ד פֶּן תִּשְׁכַּ֨ח אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר רָא֣וּ עֵינֶ֗י/ךָ וּ/פֶן יָס֨וּרוּ֙ מִ/לְּבָ֣בְ/ךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּ֑י/ךָ וְ/הוֹדַעְתָּ֥/ם לְ/בָנֶ֖י/ךָ וְ/לִ/בְנֵ֥י בָנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: rq hshmr lkh vshmr npshkh m'd pn tshkhch 't hdbrym 'shr r'v 'ynykh vpn ysvrv mlbbkh khl ymy chyykh vhvd'tm lbnykh vlbny bnykh
verses.translation: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons’ sons;

verses.original: י֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָמַ֜דְתָּ לִ/פְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶי/ךָ֮ בְּ/חֹרֵב֒ בֶּ/אֱמֹ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗/י הַקְהֶל לִ/י֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֔ם וְ/אַשְׁמִעֵ֖/ם אֶת דְּבָרָ֑/י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִלְמְד֜וּ/ן לְ/יִרְאָ֣ה אֹתִ֗/י כָּל הַ/יָּמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵ֤ם חַיִּים֙ עַל הָ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה וְ/אֶת בְּנֵי/הֶ֖ם יְלַמֵּדֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: yvm 'shr 'mdt lpny yhvh 'lhykh bchrb b'mr yhvh 'ly hqhl ly 't h'm v'shm'm 't dbry 'shr ylmdvn lyr'h 'ty khl hymym 'shr hm chyym 'l h'dmh v't bnyhm ylmdvn
verses.translation: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.

verses.original: וַ/תִּקְרְב֥וּ/ן וַ/תַּֽעַמְד֖וּ/ן תַּ֣חַת הָ/הָ֑ר וְ/הָ/הָ֞ר בֹּעֵ֤ר בָּ/אֵשׁ֙ עַד לֵ֣ב הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם חֹ֖שֶׁךְ עָנָ֥ן וַ/עֲרָפֶֽל
verses.translit: vtqrbvn vt'mdvn tcht hhr vhhr b'r b'sh 'd lb hshmym chshkh 'nn v'rpl
verses.translation: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.

verses.original: וַ/יְדַבֵּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ הָ/אֵ֑שׁ ק֤וֹל דְּבָרִים֙ אַתֶּ֣ם שֹׁמְעִ֔ים וּ/תְמוּנָ֛ה אֵינְ/כֶ֥ם רֹאִ֖ים זוּלָתִ֥י קֽוֹל
verses.translit: vydbr yhvh 'lykhm mtvkh h'sh qvl dbrym 'tm shm'ym vtmvnh 'ynkhm r'ym zvlty qvl
verses.translation: And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.

verses.original: וַ/יַּגֵּ֨ד לָ/כֶ֜ם אֶת בְּרִית֗/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה אֶתְ/כֶם֙ לַ/עֲשׂ֔וֹת עֲשֶׂ֖רֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֑ים וַֽ/יִּכְתְּבֵ֔/ם עַל שְׁנֵ֖י לֻח֥וֹת אֲבָנִֽים
verses.translit: vygd lkhm 't brytv 'shr tsvh 'tkhm l'shvt 'shrt hdbrym vykhtbm 'l shny lchvt 'bnym
verses.translation: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.

verses.original: וְ/אֹתִ֞/י צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֔וא לְ/לַמֵּ֣ד אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם חֻקִּ֖ים וּ/מִשְׁפָּטִ֑ים לַ/עֲשֹׂתְ/כֶ֣ם אֹתָ֔/ם בָּ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּ/ה לְ/רִשְׁתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'ty tsvh yhvh b't hhv' llmd 'tkhm chqym vmshptym l'shtkhm 'tm b'rts 'shr 'tm 'brym shmh lrshth
verses.translation: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.

verses.original: וְ/נִשְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם מְאֹ֖ד לְ/נַפְשֹׁתֵי/כֶ֑ם כִּ֣י לֹ֤א רְאִיתֶם֙ כָּל תְּמוּנָ֔ה בְּ/י֗וֹם דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֲלֵי/כֶ֛ם בְּ/חֹרֵ֖ב מִ/תּ֥וֹךְ הָ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: vnshmrtm m'd lnpshtykhm khy l' r'ytm khl tmvnh byvm dbr yhvh 'lykhm bchrb mtvkh h'sh
verses.translation: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:

verses.original: פֶּ֨ן תַּשְׁחִת֔וּ/ן וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֥ם לָ/כֶ֛ם פֶּ֖סֶל תְּמוּנַ֣ת כָּל סָ֑מֶל תַּבְנִ֥ית זָכָ֖ר א֥וֹ נְקֵבָֽה
verses.translit: pn tshchtvn v'shytm lkhm psl tmvnt khl sml tbnyt zkhr 'v nqbh
verses.translation: Lest ye corrupt yourselves , and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

verses.original: תַּבְנִ֕ית כָּל בְּהֵמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ תַּבְנִית֙ כָּל צִפּ֣וֹר כָּנָ֔ף אֲשֶׁ֥ר תָּע֖וּף בַּ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: tbnyt khl bhmh 'shr b'rts tbnyt khl tspvr khnf 'shr t'vf bshmym
verses.translation: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,

verses.original: תַּבְנִ֕ית כָּל רֹמֵ֖שׂ בָּ/אֲדָמָ֑ה תַּבְנִ֛ית כָּל דָּגָ֥ה אֲשֶׁר בַּ/מַּ֖יִם מִ/תַּ֥חַת לָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: tbnyt khl rmsh b'dmh tbnyt khl dgh 'shr bmym mtcht l'rts
verses.translation: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:

verses.original: וּ/פֶן תִּשָּׂ֨א עֵינֶ֜י/ךָ הַ/שָּׁמַ֗יְמָ/ה וְֽ֠/רָאִיתָ אֶת הַ/שֶּׁ֨מֶשׁ וְ/אֶת הַ/יָּרֵ֜חַ וְ/אֶת הַ/כּֽוֹכָבִ֗ים כֹּ֚ל צְבָ֣א הַ/שָּׁמַ֔יִם וְ/נִדַּחְתָּ֛ וְ/הִשְׁתַּחֲוִ֥יתָ לָ/הֶ֖ם וַ/עֲבַדְתָּ֑/ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָלַ֜ק יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֹתָ֔/ם לְ/כֹל֙ הָֽ/עַמִּ֔ים תַּ֖חַת כָּל הַ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: vpn tsh' 'ynykh hshmymh vr'yt 't hshmsh v't hyrch v't hkhvkhbym khl tsb' hshmym vndcht vhshtchvyt lhm v'bdtm 'shr chlq yhvh 'lhykh 'tm lkhl h'mym tcht khl hshmym
verses.translation: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.

verses.original: וְ/אֶתְ/כֶם֙ לָקַ֣ח יְהוָ֔ה וַ/יּוֹצִ֥א אֶתְ/כֶ֛ם מִ/כּ֥וּר הַ/בַּרְזֶ֖ל מִ/מִּצְרָ֑יִם לִ/הְי֥וֹת ל֛/וֹ לְ/עַ֥ם נַחֲלָ֖ה כַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: v'tkhm lqch yhvh vyvts' 'tkhm mkhvr hbrzl mmtsrym lhyvt lv l'm nchlh khyvm hzh
verses.translation: But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.

verses.original: וַֽ/יהוָ֥ה הִתְאַנֶּף בִּ֖/י עַל דִּבְרֵי/כֶ֑ם וַ/יִּשָּׁבַ֗ע לְ/בִלְתִּ֤י עָבְרִ/י֙ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן וּ/לְ/בִלְתִּי בֹא֙ אֶל הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/טּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְ/ךָ֖ נַחֲלָֽה
verses.translit: vyhvh ht'nf by 'l dbrykhm vyshb' lblty 'bry 't hyrdn vlblty b' 'l h'rts htvbh 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh nchlh
verses.translation: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:

verses.original: כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֥י מֵת֙ בָּ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֔את אֵינֶ֥/נִּי עֹבֵ֖ר אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְ/אַתֶּם֙ עֹֽבְרִ֔ים וִֽ/ירִשְׁתֶּ֕ם אֶת הָ/אָ֥רֶץ הַ/טּוֹבָ֖ה הַ/זֹּֽאת
verses.translit: khy 'nkhy mt b'rts hz't 'ynny 'br 't hyrdn v'tm 'brym vyrshtm 't h'rts htvbh hz't
verses.translation: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.

verses.original: הִשָּׁמְר֣וּ לָ/כֶ֗ם פֶּֽן תִּשְׁכְּחוּ֙ אֶת בְּרִ֤ית יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר כָּרַ֖ת עִמָּ/כֶ֑ם וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֨ם לָ/כֶ֥ם פֶּ֨סֶל֙ תְּמ֣וּנַת כֹּ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּ/ךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: hshmrv lkhm pn tshkhchv 't bryt yhvh 'lhykhm 'shr khrt 'mkhm v'shytm lkhm psl tmvnt khl 'shr tsvkh yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing , which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.

verses.original: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ אֵ֥שׁ אֹכְלָ֖ה ה֑וּא אֵ֖ל קַנָּֽא
verses.translit: khy yhvh 'lhykh 'sh 'khlh hv' 'l qn'
verses.translation: For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.

verses.original: כִּֽי תוֹלִ֤יד בָּנִים֙ וּ/בְנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים וְ/נוֹשַׁנְתֶּ֖ם בָּ/אָ֑רֶץ וְ/הִשְׁחַתֶּ֗ם וַ/עֲשִׂ֤יתֶם פֶּ֨סֶל֙ תְּמ֣וּנַת כֹּ֔ל וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֥ם הָ/רַ֛ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ לְ/הַכְעִיסֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy tvlyd bnym vbny bnym vnvshntm b'rts vhshchtm v'shytm psl tmvnt khl v'shytm hr' b'yny yhvh 'lhykh lhkh'ysv
verses.translation: When thou shalt beget children, and children’s children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves , and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing , and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke him to anger:

verses.original: הַעִידֹתִי֩ בָ/כֶ֨ם הַ/יּ֜וֹם אֶת הַ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם וְ/אֶת הָ/אָ֗רֶץ כִּֽי אָבֹ֣ד תֹּאבֵדוּ/ן֮ מַהֵר֒ מֵ/עַ֣ל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֧ים אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֛ן שָׁ֖מָּ/ה לְ/רִשְׁתָּ֑/הּ לֹֽא תַאֲרִיכֻ֤/ן יָמִים֙ עָלֶ֔י/הָ כִּ֥י הִשָּׁמֵ֖ד תִּשָּׁמֵדֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: h'ydty bkhm hyvm 't hshmym v't h'rts khy 'bd t'bdvn mhr m'l h'rts 'shr 'tm 'brym 't hyrdn shmh lrshth l' t'rykhn ymym 'lyh khy hshmd tshmdvn
verses.translation: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.

verses.original: וְ/הֵפִ֧יץ יְהוָ֛ה אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם בָּ/עַמִּ֑ים וְ/נִשְׁאַרְתֶּם֙ מְתֵ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר בַּ/גּוֹיִ֕ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְנַהֵ֧ג יְהוָ֛ה אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: vhpyts yhvh 'tkhm b'mym vnsh'rtm mty mspr bgvym 'shr ynhg yhvh 'tkhm shmh
verses.translation: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.

verses.original: וַ/עֲבַדְתֶּם שָׁ֣ם אֱלֹהִ֔ים מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָ֑ם עֵ֣ץ וָ/אֶ֔בֶן אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא יִרְאוּ/ן֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יִשְׁמְע֔וּ/ן וְ/לֹ֥א יֹֽאכְל֖וּ/ן וְ/לֹ֥א יְרִיחֻֽ/ן
verses.translit: v'bdtm shm 'lhym m'shh ydy 'dm 'ts v'bn 'shr l' yr'vn vl' yshm'vn vl' y'khlvn vl' yrychn
verses.translation: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

verses.original: וּ/בִקַּשְׁתֶּ֥ם מִ/שָּׁ֛ם אֶת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ וּ/מָצָ֑אתָ כִּ֣י תִדְרְשֶׁ֔/נּוּ בְּ/כָל לְבָבְ/ךָ֖ וּ/בְ/כָל נַפְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: vbqshtm mshm 't yhvh 'lhykh vmts't khy tdrshnv bkhl lbbkh vbkhl npshkh
verses.translation: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him , if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.

verses.original: בַּ/צַּ֣ר לְ/ךָ֔ וּ/מְצָא֕וּ/ךָ כֹּ֖ל הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֑לֶּה בְּ/אַחֲרִית֙ הַ/יָּמִ֔ים וְ/שַׁבְתָּ֙ עַד יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/שָׁמַעְתָּ֖ בְּ/קֹלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: btsr lkh vmts'vkh khl hdbrym h'lh b'chryt hymym vshbt 'd yhvh 'lhykh vshm't bqlv
verses.translation: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֵ֤ל רַחוּם֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ לֹ֥א יַרְפְּ/ךָ֖ וְ/לֹ֣א יַשְׁחִיתֶ֑/ךָ וְ/לֹ֤א יִשְׁכַּח֙ אֶת בְּרִ֣ית אֲבֹתֶ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khy 'l rchvm yhvh 'lhykh l' yrpkh vl' yshchytkh vl' yshkhch 't bryt 'btykh 'shr nshb' lhm
verses.translation: (For the LORD thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.

verses.original: כִּ֣י שְׁאַל נָא֩ לְ/יָמִ֨ים רִֽאשֹׁנִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר הָי֣וּ לְ/פָנֶ֗י/ךָ לְ/מִן הַ/יּוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁר֩ בָּרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים אָדָם֙ עַל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ וּ/לְ/מִ/קְצֵ֥ה הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וְ/עַד קְצֵ֣ה הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם הֲ/נִֽהְיָ֗ה כַּ/דָּבָ֤ר הַ/גָּדוֹל֙ הַ/זֶּ֔ה א֖וֹ הֲ/נִשְׁמַ֥ע כָּמֹֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: khy sh'l n' lymym r'shnym 'shr hyv lpnykh lmn hyvm 'shr br' 'lhym 'dm 'l h'rts vlmqtsh hshmym v'd qtsh hshmym hnhyh khdbr hgdvl hzh 'v hnshm' khmhv
verses.translation: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is , or hath been heard like it?

verses.original: הֲ/שָׁ֣מַֽע עָם֩ ק֨וֹל אֱלֹהִ֜ים מְדַבֵּ֧ר מִ/תּוֹךְ הָ/אֵ֛שׁ כַּ/אֲשֶׁר שָׁמַ֥עְתָּ אַתָּ֖ה וַ/יֶּֽחִי
verses.translit: hshm' 'm qvl 'lhym mdbr mtvkh h'sh kh'shr shm't 'th vychy
verses.translation: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?

verses.original: א֣וֹ הֲ/נִסָּ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֗ים לָ֠/בוֹא לָ/קַ֨חַת ל֣/וֹ גוֹי֮ מִ/קֶּ֣רֶב גּוֹי֒ בְּ/מַסֹּת֩ בְּ/אֹתֹ֨ת וּ/בְ/מוֹפְתִ֜ים וּ/בְ/מִלְחָמָ֗ה וּ/בְ/יָ֤ד חֲזָקָה֙ וּ/בִ/זְר֣וֹעַ נְטוּיָ֔ה וּ/בְ/מוֹרָאִ֖ים גְּדֹלִ֑ים כְּ֠/כֹל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֨ה לָ/כֶ֜ם יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֛ם בְּ/מִצְרַ֖יִם לְ/עֵינֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'v hnsh 'lhym lbv' lqcht lv gvy mqrb gvy bmst b'tt vbmvptym vbmlchmh vbyd chzqh vbzrv' ntvyh vbmvr'ym gdlym khkhl 'shr 'shh lkhm yhvh 'lhykhm bmtsrym l'ynykh
verses.translation: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

verses.original: אַתָּה֙ הָרְאֵ֣תָ לָ/דַ֔עַת כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה ה֣וּא הָ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֥ין ע֖וֹד מִ/לְ/בַדּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'th hr't ld't khy yhvh hv' h'lhym 'yn 'vd mlbdv
verses.translation: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the LORD he is God; there is none else beside him.

verses.original: מִן הַ/שָּׁמַ֛יִם הִשְׁמִֽיעֲ/ךָ֥ אֶת קֹל֖/וֹ לְ/יַסְּרֶ֑/ךָּ וְ/עַל הָ/אָ֗רֶץ הֶרְאֲ/ךָ֙ אֶת אִשּׁ֣/וֹ הַ/גְּדוֹלָ֔ה וּ/דְבָרָ֥י/ו שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ מִ/תּ֥וֹךְ הָ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: mn hshmym hshmy'kh 't qlv lysrkh v'l h'rts hr'kh 't 'shv hgdvlh vdbryv shm't mtvkh h'sh
verses.translation: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.

verses.original: וְ/תַ֗חַת כִּ֤י אָהַב֙ אֶת אֲבֹתֶ֔י/ךָ וַ/יִּבְחַ֥ר בְּ/זַרְע֖/וֹ אַחֲרָ֑י/ו וַ/יּוֹצִֽאֲ/ךָ֧ בְּ/פָנָ֛י/ו בְּ/כֹח֥/וֹ הַ/גָּדֹ֖ל מִ/מִּצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: vtcht khy 'hb 't 'btykh vybchr bzr'v 'chryv vyvts'kh bpnyv bkhchv hgdl mmtsrym
verses.translation: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;

verses.original: לְ/הוֹרִ֗ישׁ גּוֹיִ֛ם גְּדֹלִ֧ים וַ/עֲצֻמִ֛ים מִמְּ/ךָ֖ מִ/פָּנֶ֑י/ךָ לַ/הֲבִֽיאֲ/ךָ֗ לָֽ/תֶת לְ/ךָ֧ אֶת אַרְצָ֛/ם נַחֲלָ֖ה כַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: lhvrysh gvym gdlym v'tsmym mmkh mpnykh lhby'kh ltt lkh 't 'rtsm nchlh khyvm hzh
verses.translation: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art , to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.

verses.original: וְ/יָדַעְתָּ֣ הַ/יּ֗וֹם וַ/הֲשֵׁבֹתָ֮ אֶל לְבָבֶ/ךָ֒ כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים בַּ/שָּׁמַ֣יִם מִ/מַּ֔עַל וְ/עַל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ מִ/תָּ֑חַת אֵ֖ין עֽוֹד
verses.translit: vyd't hyvm vhshbt 'l lbbkh khy yhvh hv' h'lhym bshmym mm'l v'l h'rts mtcht 'yn 'vd
verses.translation: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that the LORD he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמַרְתָּ֞ אֶת חֻקָּ֣י/ו וְ/אֶת מִצְוֺתָ֗י/ו אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֤י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם אֲשֶׁר֙ יִיטַ֣ב לְ/ךָ֔ וּ/לְ/בָנֶ֖י/ךָ אַחֲרֶ֑י/ךָ וּ/לְמַ֨עַן תַּאֲרִ֤יךְ יָמִים֙ עַל הַ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛י/ךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְ/ךָ֖ כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vshmrt 't chqyv v't mtsvtyv 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm 'shr yytb lkh vlbnykh 'chrykh vlm'n t'rykh ymym 'l h'dmh 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh khl hymym
verses.translation: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.

verses.original: אָ֣ז יַבְדִּ֤יל מֹשֶׁה֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ עָרִ֔ים בְּ/עֵ֖בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן מִזְרְחָ֖/ה שָֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: 'z ybdyl mshh shlsh 'rym b'br hyrdn mzrchh shmsh
verses.translation: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;

verses.original: לָ/נֻ֨ס שָׁ֜מָּ/ה רוֹצֵ֗חַ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִרְצַ֤ח אֶת רֵעֵ֨/הוּ֙ בִּ/בְלִי דַ֔עַת וְ/ה֛וּא לֹא שֹׂנֵ֥א ל֖/וֹ מִ/תְּמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשׁ֑וֹם וְ/נָ֗ס אֶל אַחַ֛ת מִן הֶ/עָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖ל וָ/חָֽי
verses.translit: lns shmh rvtsch 'shr yrtsch 't r'hv bbly d't vhv' l' shn' lv mtmvl shlshvm vns 'l 'cht mn h'rym h'l vchy
verses.translation: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:

verses.original: אֶת בֶּ֧צֶר בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֛ר בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ הַ/מִּישֹׁ֖ר לָ/רֻֽאוּבֵנִ֑י וְ/אֶת רָאמֹ֤ת בַּ/גִּלְעָד֙ לַ/גָּדִ֔י וְ/אֶת גּוֹלָ֥ן בַּ/בָּשָׁ֖ן לַֽ/מְנַשִּֽׁי
verses.translit: 't btsr bmdbr b'rts hmyshr lr'vbny v't r'mt bgl'd lgdy v't gvln bbshn lmnshy
verses.translation: Namely , Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.

verses.original: וְ/זֹ֖את הַ/תּוֹרָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר שָׂ֣ם מֹשֶׁ֔ה לִ/פְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vz't htvrh 'shr shm mshh lpny bny yshr'l
verses.translation: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:

verses.original: אֵ֚לֶּה הָֽ/עֵדֹ֔ת וְ/הַֽ/חֻקִּ֖ים וְ/הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּ/צֵאתָ֖/ם מִ/מִּצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: 'lh h'dt vhchqym vhmshptym 'shr dbr mshh 'l bny yshr'l bts'tm mmtsrym
verses.translation: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt,

verses.original: בְּ/עֵ֨בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֜ן בַּ/גַּ֗יְא מ֚וּל בֵּ֣ית פְּע֔וֹר בְּ/אֶ֗רֶץ סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽ/אֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּ/חֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכָּ֤ה מֹשֶׁה֙ וּ/בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּ/צֵאתָ֖/ם מִ/מִּצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: b'br hyrdn bgy' mvl byt p'vr b'rts sychn mlkh h'mry 'shr yvshb bchshbvn 'shr hkhh mshh vbny yshr'l bts'tm mmtsrym
verses.translation: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:

verses.original: וַ/יִּֽירְשׁ֨וּ אֶת אַרְצ֜/וֹ וְ/אֶת אֶ֣רֶץ ע֣וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ הַ/בָּשָׁ֗ן שְׁנֵי֙ מַלְכֵ֣י הָֽ/אֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵ֣בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן מִזְרַ֖ח שָֽׁמֶשׁ
verses.translit: vyyrshv 't 'rtsv v't 'rts 'vg mlkh hbshn shny mlkhy h'mry 'shr b'br hyrdn mzrch shmsh
verses.translation: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;

verses.original: מֵ/עֲרֹעֵ֞ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל שְׂפַת נַ֧חַל אַרְנֹ֛ן וְ/עַד הַ֥ר שִׂיאֹ֖ן ה֥וּא חֶרְמֽוֹן
verses.translit: m'r'r 'shr 'l shpt nchl 'rnn v'd hr shy'n hv' chrmvn
verses.translation: From Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,

verses.original: וְ/כָל הָ֨/עֲרָבָ֜ה עֵ֤בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרָ֔חָ/ה וְ/עַ֖ד יָ֣ם הָ/עֲרָבָ֑ה תַּ֖חַת אַשְׁדֹּ֥ת הַ/פִּסְגָּֽה
verses.translit: vkhl h'rbh 'br hyrdn mzrchh v'd ym h'rbh tcht 'shdt hpsgh
verses.translation: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.

verses.original: וַ/יִּקְרָ֣א מֹשֶׁה֮ אֶל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַ/יֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵ/הֶ֗ם שְׁמַ֤ע יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת הַ/חֻקִּ֣ים וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י דֹּבֵ֥ר בְּ/אָזְנֵי/כֶ֖ם הַ/יּ֑וֹם וּ/לְמַדְתֶּ֣ם אֹתָ֔/ם וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם לַ/עֲשֹׂתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vyqr' mshh 'l khl yshr'l vy'mr 'lhm shm' yshr'l 't hchqym v't hmshptym 'shr 'nkhy dbr b'znykhm hyvm vlmdtm 'tm vshmrtm l'shtm
verses.translation: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֗י/נוּ כָּרַ֥ת עִמָּ֛/נוּ בְּרִ֖ית בְּ/חֹרֵֽב
verses.translit: yhvh 'lhynv khrt 'mnv bryt bchrb
verses.translation: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

verses.original: לֹ֣א אֶת אֲבֹתֵ֔י/נוּ כָּרַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה אֶת הַ/בְּרִ֣ית הַ/זֹּ֑את כִּ֣י אִתָּ֗/נוּ אֲנַ֨חְנוּ אֵ֥לֶּה פֹ֛ה הַ/יּ֖וֹם כֻּלָּ֥/נוּ חַיִּֽים
verses.translit: l' 't 'btynv khrt yhvh 't hbryt hz't khy 'tnv 'nchnv 'lh ph hyvm khlnv chyym
verses.translation: The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.

verses.original: פָּנִ֣ים בְּ/פָנִ֗ים דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה עִמָּ/כֶ֛ם בָּ/הָ֖ר מִ/תּ֥וֹךְ הָ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: pnym bpnym dbr yhvh 'mkhm bhr mtvkh h'sh
verses.translation: The LORD talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,

verses.original: אָ֠נֹכִי עֹמֵ֨ד בֵּין יְהוָ֤ה וּ/בֵֽינֵי/כֶם֙ בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֔וא לְ/הַגִּ֥יד לָ/כֶ֖ם אֶת דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י יְרֵאתֶם֙ מִ/פְּנֵ֣י הָ/אֵ֔שׁ וְ/לֹֽא עֲלִיתֶ֥ם בָּ/הָ֖ר לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: 'nkhy 'md byn yhvh vbynykhm b't hhv' lhgyd lkhm 't dbr yhvh khy yr'tm mpny h'sh vl' 'lytm bhr l'mr
verses.translation: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to shew you the word of the LORD : for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,

verses.original: אָֽנֹכִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֧ר הוֹצֵאתִ֛י/ךָ מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִ/בֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים
verses.translit: 'nkhy yhvh 'lhykh 'shr hvts'tykh m'rts mtsrym mbyt 'bdym
verses.translation: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

verses.original: לֹא יִהְיֶ֥ה לְ/ךָ֛ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים עַל פָּנָֽ/יַ
verses.translit: l' yhyh lkh 'lhym 'chrym 'l pny
verses.translation: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.

verses.original: לֹֽ֣א תַעֲשֶׂ֥ה לְ/ךָ֥ פֶ֨סֶל֙ כָּל תְּמוּנָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר בַּ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ מִ/מַּ֔עַל וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר בָּ/אָ֖רֶץ מִ/תָּ֑חַת וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּ/מַּ֖יִם מִ/תַּ֥חַת לָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: l' t'shh lkh psl khl tmvnh 'shr bshmym mm'l v'shr b'rts mtcht v'shr bmym mtcht l'rts
verses.translation: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:

verses.original: לֹא תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה לָ/הֶ֖ם וְ/לֹ֣א תָעָבְדֵ֑/ם כִּ֣י אָנֹכִ֞י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֵ֣ל קַנָּ֔א פֹּ֠קֵד עֲוֺ֨ן אָב֧וֹת עַל בָּנִ֛ים וְ/עַל שִׁלֵּשִׁ֥ים וְ/עַל רִבֵּעִ֖ים לְ/שֹׂנְאָֽ/י
verses.translit: l' tshtchvh lhm vl' t'bdm khy 'nkhy yhvh 'lhykh 'l qn' pqd 'vn 'bvt 'l bnym v'l shlshym v'l rb'ym lshn'y
verses.translation: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,

verses.original: וְ/עֹ֥שֶׂה חֶ֖סֶד לַֽ/אֲלָפִ֑ים לְ/אֹהֲבַ֖/י וּ/לְ/שֹׁמְרֵ֥י מצות/ו מִצְוֺתָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'shh chsd l'lpym l'hby vlshmry mtsvtv mtsvty
verses.translation: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.

verses.original: לֹ֥א תִשָּׂ֛א אֶת שֵֽׁם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ לַ/שָּׁ֑וְא כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יְנַקֶּה֙ יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר יִשָּׂ֥א אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ לַ/שָּֽׁוְא
verses.translit: l' tsh' 't shm yhvh 'lhykh lshv' khy l' ynqh yhvh 't 'shr ysh' 't shmv lshv'
verses.translation: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain: for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

verses.original: שָׁמ֛וֹר אֶת י֥וֹם הַ/שַׁבָּ֖ת לְ/קַדְּשׁ֑/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּ/ךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: shmvr 't yvm hshbt lqdshv kh'shr tsvkh yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.

verses.original: שֵׁ֤שֶׁת יָמִים֙ תַּֽעֲבֹ֔ד וְ/עָשִׂ֖יתָ כָּל מְלַאכְתֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: shsht ymym t'bd v'shyt khl ml'khtkh
verses.translation: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:

verses.original: וְ/י֨וֹם֙ הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֔י שַׁבָּ֖ת לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ לֹ֣א תַעֲשֶׂ֣ה כָל מְלָאכָ֡ה אַתָּ֣ה וּ/בִנְ/ךָֽ וּ/בִתֶּ֣/ךָ וְ/עַבְדְּ/ךָֽ וַ֠/אֲמָתֶ/ךָ וְ/שׁוֹרְ/ךָ֨ וַ/חֲמֹֽרְ/ךָ֜ וְ/כָל בְּהֶמְתֶּ֗/ךָ וְ/גֵֽרְ/ךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּ/שְׁעָרֶ֔י/ךָ לְמַ֗עַן יָנ֛וּחַ עַבְדְּ/ךָ֥ וַ/אֲמָתְ/ךָ֖ כָּמֽוֹ/ךָ
verses.translit: vyvm hshby'y shbt lyhvh 'lhykh l' t'shh khl ml'khh 'th vbnkh vbtkh v'bdkh v'mtkh vshvrkh vchmrkh vkhl bhmtkh vgrkh 'shr bsh'rykh lm'n ynvch 'bdkh v'mtkh khmvkh
verses.translation: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.

verses.original: וְ/זָכַרְתָּ֗ כִּ֣י עֶ֤בֶד הָיִ֨יתָ֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַ/יֹּצִ֨אֲ/ךָ֜ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ מִ/שָּׁ֔ם בְּ/יָ֥ד חֲזָקָ֖ה וּ/בִ/זְרֹ֣עַ נְטוּיָ֑ה עַל כֵּ֗ן צִוְּ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ לַ/עֲשׂ֖וֹת אֶת י֥וֹם הַ/שַׁבָּֽת
verses.translit: vzkhrt khy 'bd hyyt b'rts mtsrym vyts'kh yhvh 'lhykh mshm byd chzqh vbzr' ntvyh 'l khn tsvkh yhvh 'lhykh l'shvt 't yvm hshbt
verses.translation: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the LORD thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.

verses.original: כַּבֵּ֤ד אֶת אָבִ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/אֶת אִמֶּ֔/ךָ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּ/ךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ לְמַ֣עַן יַאֲרִיכֻ֣/ן יָמֶ֗י/ךָ וּ/לְמַ֨עַן֙ יִ֣יטַב לָ֔/ךְ עַ֚ל הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khbd 't 'bykh v't 'mkh kh'shr tsvkh yhvh 'lhykh lm'n y'rykhn ymykh vlm'n yytb lkh 'l h'dmh 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh
verses.translation: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

verses.original: לֹ֖א תִּרְצָֽח
verses.translit: l' trtsch
verses.translation: Thou shalt not kill.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֖א תִּנְאָֽף
verses.translit: vl' tn'f
verses.translation: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֖א תִּגְנֹֽב
verses.translit: vl' tgnb
verses.translation: Neither shalt thou steal.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא תַעֲנֶ֥ה בְ/רֵֽעֲ/ךָ֖ עֵ֥ד שָֽׁוְא
verses.translit: vl' t'nh br'kh 'd shv'
verses.translation: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֥א תַחְמֹ֖ד אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֶ֑/ךָ וְ/לֹ֨א תִתְאַוֶּ֜ה בֵּ֣ית רֵעֶ֗/ךָ שָׂדֵ֜/הוּ וְ/עַבְדּ֤/וֹ וַ/אֲמָת/וֹ֙ שׁוֹר֣/וֹ וַ/חֲמֹר֔/וֹ וְ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְ/רֵעֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vl' tchmd 'sht r'kh vl' tt'vh byt r'kh shdhv v'bdv v'mtv shvrv vchmrv vkhl 'shr lr'kh
verses.translation: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour’s wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour’s house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour’s.

verses.original: אֶֽת הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֡לֶּה דִּבֶּר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶל כָּל קְהַלְ/כֶ֜ם בָּ/הָ֗ר מִ/תּ֤וֹךְ הָ/אֵשׁ֙ הֶֽ/עָנָ֣ן וְ/הָֽ/עֲרָפֶ֔ל ק֥וֹל גָּד֖וֹל וְ/לֹ֣א יָסָ֑ף וַֽ/יִּכְתְּבֵ֗/ם עַל שְׁנֵי֙ לֻחֹ֣ת אֲבָנִ֔ים וַֽ/יִּתְּנֵ֖/ם אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: 't hdbrym h'lh dbr yhvh 'l khl qhlkhm bhr mtvkh h'sh h'nn vh'rpl qvl gdvl vl' ysf vykhtbm 'l shny lcht 'bnym vytnm 'ly
verses.translation: These words the LORD spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י כְּ/שָׁמְעֲ/כֶ֤ם אֶת הַ/קּוֹל֙ מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ הַ/חֹ֔שֶׁךְ וְ/הָ/הָ֖ר בֹּעֵ֣ר בָּ/אֵ֑שׁ וַ/תִּקְרְב֣וּ/ן אֵלַ֔/י כָּל רָאשֵׁ֥י שִׁבְטֵי/כֶ֖ם וְ/זִקְנֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vyhy khshm'khm 't hqvl mtvkh hchshkh vhhr b'r b'sh vtqrbvn 'ly khl r'shy shbtykhm vzqnykhm
verses.translation: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

verses.original: וַ/תֹּאמְר֗וּ הֵ֣ן הֶרְאָ֜/נוּ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֨י/נוּ֙ אֶת כְּבֹד֣/וֹ וְ/אֶת גָּדְל֔/וֹ וְ/אֶת קֹל֥/וֹ שָׁמַ֖עְנוּ מִ/תּ֣וֹךְ הָ/אֵ֑שׁ הַ/יּ֤וֹם הַ/זֶּה֙ רָאִ֔ינוּ כִּֽי יְדַבֵּ֧ר אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת הָֽ/אָדָ֖ם וָ/חָֽי
verses.translit: vt'mrv hn hr'nv yhvh 'lhynv 't khbdv v't gdlv v't qlv shm'nv mtvkh h'sh hyvm hzh r'ynv khy ydbr 'lhym 't h'dm vchy
verses.translation: And ye said, Behold, the LORD our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ לָ֣/מָּה נָמ֔וּת כִּ֣י תֹֽאכְלֵ֔/נוּ הָ/אֵ֥שׁ הַ/גְּדֹלָ֖ה הַ/זֹּ֑את אִם יֹסְפִ֣ים אֲנַ֗חְנוּ לִ֠/שְׁמֹעַ אֶת ק֨וֹל יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛י/נוּ ע֖וֹד וָ/מָֽתְנוּ
verses.translit: v'th lmh nmvt khy t'khlnv h'sh hgdlh hz't 'm yspym 'nchnv lshm' 't qvl yhvh 'lhynv 'vd vmtnv
verses.translation: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.

verses.original: כִּ֣י מִ֣י כָל בָּשָׂ֡ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׁמַ֣ע קוֹל֩ אֱלֹהִ֨ים חַיִּ֜ים מְדַבֵּ֧ר מִ/תּוֹךְ הָ/אֵ֛שׁ כָּמֹ֖/נוּ וַ/יֶּֽחִי
verses.translit: khy my khl bshr 'shr shm' qvl 'lhym chyym mdbr mtvkh h'sh khmnv vychy
verses.translation: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have , and lived?

verses.original: קְרַ֤ב אַתָּה֙ וּֽ/שֲׁמָ֔ע אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֹאמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ וְ/אַ֣תְּ תְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֵ֗י/נוּ אֵת֩ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְדַבֵּ֜ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛י/נוּ אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ וְ/שָׁמַ֥עְנוּ וְ/עָשִֽׂינוּ
verses.translit: qrb 'th vshm' 't khl 'shr y'mr yhvh 'lhynv v't tdbr 'lynv 't khl 'shr ydbr yhvh 'lhynv 'lykh vshm'nv v'shynv
verses.translation: Go thou near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the LORD our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it , and do it .

verses.original: וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ אֶת ק֣וֹל דִּבְרֵי/כֶ֔ם בְּ/דַבֶּרְ/כֶ֖ם אֵלָ֑/י וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗/י שָׁ֠מַעְתִּי אֶת ק֨וֹל דִּבְרֵ֜י הָ/עָ֤ם הַ/זֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבְּר֣וּ אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ הֵיטִ֖יבוּ כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽרוּ
verses.translit: vyshm' yhvh 't qvl dbrykhm bdbrkhm 'ly vy'mr yhvh 'ly shm'ty 't qvl dbry h'm hzh 'shr dbrv 'lykh hytybv khl 'shr dbrv
verses.translation: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the LORD said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.

verses.original: מִֽי יִתֵּ֡ן וְ/הָיָה֩ לְבָבָ֨/ם זֶ֜ה לָ/הֶ֗ם לְ/יִרְאָ֥ה אֹתִ֛/י וְ/לִ/שְׁמֹ֥ר אֶת כָּל מִצְוֺתַ֖/י כָּל הַ/יָּמִ֑ים לְמַ֨עַן יִיטַ֥ב לָ/הֶ֛ם וְ/לִ/בְנֵי/הֶ֖ם לְ/עֹלָֽם
verses.translit: my ytn vhyh lbbm zh lhm lyr'h 'ty vlshmr 't khl mtsvty khl hymym lm'n yytb lhm vlbnyhm l'lm
verses.translation: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!

verses.original: לֵ֖ךְ אֱמֹ֣ר לָ/הֶ֑ם שׁ֥וּבוּ לָ/כֶ֖ם לְ/אָהֳלֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: lkh 'mr lhm shvbv lkhm l'hlykhm
verses.translation: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֗ה פֹּה֮ עֲמֹ֣ד עִמָּדִ/י֒ וַ/אֲדַבְּרָ֣ה אֵלֶ֗י/ךָ אֵ֧ת כָּל הַ/מִּצְוָ֛ה וְ/הַ/חֻקִּ֥ים וְ/הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר תְּלַמְּדֵ֑/ם וְ/עָשׂ֣וּ בָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לָ/הֶ֖ם לְ/רִשְׁתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: v'th ph 'md 'mdy v'dbrh 'lykh 't khl hmtsvh vhchqym vhmshptym 'shr tlmdm v'shv b'rts 'shr 'nkhy ntn lhm lrshth
verses.translation: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם לַ/עֲשׂ֔וֹת כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֖ם אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם לֹ֥א תָסֻ֖רוּ יָמִ֥ין וּ/שְׂמֹֽאל
verses.translit: vshmrtm l'shvt kh'shr tsvh yhvh 'lhykhm 'tkhm l' tsrv ymyn vshm'l
verses.translation: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.

verses.original: בְּ/כָל הַ/דֶּ֗רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֜ה יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֛ם אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם תֵּלֵ֑כוּ לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽחְיוּ/ן֙ וְ/ט֣וֹב לָ/כֶ֔ם וְ/הַאֲרַכְתֶּ֣ם יָמִ֔ים בָּ/אָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּֽירָשֽׁוּ/ן
verses.translit: bkhl hdrkh 'shr tsvh yhvh 'lhykhm 'tkhm tlkhv lm'n tchyvn vtvb lkhm vh'rkhtm ymym b'rts 'shr tyrshvn
verses.translation: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the LORD your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.

verses.original: וְ/זֹ֣את הַ/מִּצְוָ֗ה הַֽ/חֻקִּים֙ וְ/הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֖ם לְ/לַמֵּ֣ד אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּ/ה לְ/רִשְׁתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vz't hmtsvh hchqym vhmshptym 'shr tsvh yhvh 'lhykhm llmd 'tkhm l'shvt b'rts 'shr 'tm 'brym shmh lrshth
verses.translation: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it:

verses.original: לְמַ֨עַן תִּירָ֜א אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י/ךָ לִ֠/שְׁמֹר אֶת כָּל חֻקֹּתָ֣י/ו וּ/מִצְוֺתָי/ו֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י מְצַוֶּ/ךָ֒ אַתָּה֙ וּ/בִנְ/ךָ֣ וּ/בֶן בִּנְ/ךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּ֑י/ךָ וּ/לְמַ֖עַן יַאֲרִכֻ֥/ן יָמֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: lm'n tyr' 't yhvh 'lhykh lshmr 't khl chqtyv vmtsvtyv 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh 'th vbnkh vbn bnkh khl ymy chyykh vlm'n y'rkhn ymykh
verses.translation: That thou mightest fear the LORD thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמַעְתָּ֤ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ/שָׁמַרְתָּ֣ לַ/עֲשׂ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר֙ יִיטַ֣ב לְ/ךָ֔ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְבּ֖וּ/ן מְאֹ֑ד כַּ/אֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹתֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לָ֔/ךְ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּ/דְבָֽשׁ
verses.translit: vshm't yshr'l vshmrt l'shvt 'shr yytb lkh v'shr trbvn m'd kh'shr dbr yhvh 'lhy 'btykh lkh 'rts zbt chlb vdbsh
verses.translation: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.

verses.original: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ יְהוָ֥ה אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: shm' yshr'l yhvh 'lhynv yhvh 'chd
verses.translation: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD :

verses.original: וְ/אָ֣הַבְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ בְּ/כָל לְבָבְ/ךָ֥ וּ/בְ/כָל נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֖ וּ/בְ/כָל מְאֹדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'hbt 't yhvh 'lhykh bkhl lbbkh vbkhl npshkh vbkhl m'dkh
verses.translation: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.

verses.original: וְ/הָי֞וּ הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֛ הַ/יּ֖וֹם עַל לְבָבֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vhyv hdbrym h'lh 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm 'l lbbkh
verses.translation: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:

verses.translit: vshnntm lbnykh vdbrt bm bshbtkh bbytkh vblkhtkh bdrkh vbshkhbkh vbqvmkh
verses.translation: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

verses.original: וּ/קְשַׁרְתָּ֥/ם לְ/א֖וֹת עַל יָדֶ֑/ךָ וְ/הָי֥וּ לְ/טֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vqshrtm l'vt 'l ydkh vhyv lttpt byn 'ynykh
verses.translation: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.

verses.original: וּ/כְתַבְתָּ֛/ם עַל מְזוּזֹ֥ת בֵּיתֶ֖/ךָ וּ/בִ/שְׁעָרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vkhtbtm 'l mzvzt bytkh vbsh'rykh
verses.translation: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֞ה כִּ֥י יְבִיאֲ/ךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י/ךָ אֶל הָ/אָ֜רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע לַ/אֲבֹתֶ֛י/ךָ לְ/אַבְרָהָ֛ם לְ/יִצְחָ֥ק וּֽ/לְ/יַעֲקֹ֖ב לָ֣/תֶת לָ֑/ךְ עָרִ֛ים גְּדֹלֹ֥ת וְ/טֹבֹ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא בָנִֽיתָ
verses.translit: vhyh khy yby'kh yhvh 'lhykh 'l h'rts 'shr nshb' l'btykh l'brhm lytschq vly'qb ltt lkh 'rym gdlt vtbt 'shr l' bnyt
verses.translation: And it shall be, when the LORD thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,

verses.original: וּ/בָ֨תִּ֜ים מְלֵאִ֣ים כָּל טוּב֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא מִלֵּאתָ֒ וּ/בֹרֹ֤ת חֲצוּבִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא חָצַ֔בְתָּ כְּרָמִ֥ים וְ/זֵיתִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא נָטָ֑עְתָּ וְ/אָכַלְתָּ֖ וְ/שָׂבָֽעְתָּ
verses.translit: vbtym ml'ym khl tvb 'shr l' ml't vbrt chtsvbym 'shr l' chtsbt khrmym vzytym 'shr l' nt't v'khlt vshb't
verses.translation: And houses full of all good things , which thou filledst not, and wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;

verses.original: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְ/ךָ֔ פֶּן תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח אֶת יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הוֹצִֽיאֲ/ךָ֛ מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִ/בֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים
verses.translit: hshmr lkh pn tshkhch 't yhvh 'shr hvtsy'kh m'rts mtsrym mbyt 'bdym
verses.translation: Then beware lest thou forget the LORD , which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

verses.original: אֶת יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛י/ךָ תִּירָ֖א וְ/אֹת֣/וֹ תַעֲבֹ֑ד וּ/בִ/שְׁמ֖/וֹ תִּשָּׁבֵֽעַ
verses.translit: 't yhvh 'lhykh tyr' v'tv t'bd vbshmv tshb'
verses.translation: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.

verses.original: לֹ֣א תֵֽלְכ֔וּ/ן אַחֲרֵ֖י אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים מֵ/אֱלֹהֵי֙ הָֽ/עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר סְבִיבוֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: l' tlkhvn 'chry 'lhym 'chrym m'lhy h'mym 'shr sbybvtykhm
verses.translation: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you;

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֵ֥ל קַנָּ֛א יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ בְּ/קִרְבֶּ֑/ךָ פֶּן יֶ֠חֱרֶה אַף יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ בָּ֔/ךְ וְ/הִשְׁמִ֣ידְ/ךָ֔ מֵ/עַ֖ל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: khy 'l qn' yhvh 'lhykh bqrbkh pn ychrh 'f yhvh 'lhykh bkh vhshmydkh m'l pny h'dmh
verses.translation: (For the LORD thy God is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the LORD thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.

verses.original: לֹ֣א תְנַסּ֔וּ אֶת יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֑ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִסִּיתֶ֖ם בַּ/מַּסָּֽה
verses.translit: l' tnsv 't yhvh 'lhykhm kh'shr nsytm bmsh
verses.translation: Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.
