verses.original: שָׁמ֣וֹר תִּשְׁמְר֔וּ/ן אֶת מִצְוֺ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/עֵדֹתָ֥י/ו וְ/חֻקָּ֖י/ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: shmvr tshmrvn 't mtsvt yhvh 'lhykhm v'dtyv vchqyv 'shr tsvkh
verses.translation: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֛יתָ הַ/יָּשָׁ֥ר וְ/הַ/טּ֖וֹב בְּ/עֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לְמַ֨עַן֙ יִ֣יטַב לָ֔/ךְ וּ/בָ֗אתָ וְ/יָֽרַשְׁתָּ֙ אֶת הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/טֹּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לַ/אֲבֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: v'shyt hyshr vhtvb b'yny yhvh lm'n yytb lkh vb't vyrsht 't h'rts htbh 'shr nshb' yhvh l'btykh
verses.translation: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the LORD : that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers,

verses.original: לַ/הֲדֹ֥ף אֶת כָּל אֹיְבֶ֖י/ךָ מִ/פָּנֶ֑י/ךָ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: lhdf 't khl 'ybykh mpnykh kh'shr dbr yhvh
verses.translation: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the LORD hath spoken.

verses.original: כִּֽי יִשְׁאָלְ/ךָ֥ בִנְ/ךָ֛ מָחָ֖ר לֵ/אמֹ֑ר מָ֣ה הָ/עֵדֹ֗ת וְ/הַֽ/חֻקִּים֙ וְ/הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khy ysh'lkh bnkh mchr l'mr mh h'dt vhchqym vhmshptym 'shr tsvh yhvh 'lhynv 'tkhm
verses.translation: And when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD our God hath commanded you?

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֣ לְ/בִנְ/ךָ֔ עֲבָדִ֛ים הָיִ֥ינוּ לְ/פַרְעֹ֖ה בְּ/מִצְרָ֑יִם וַ/יּוֹצִיאֵ֧/נוּ יְהוָ֛ה מִ/מִּצְרַ֖יִם בְּ/יָ֥ד חֲזָקָֽה
verses.translit: v'mrt lbnkh 'bdym hyynv lpr'h bmtsrym vyvtsy'nv yhvh mmtsrym byd chzqh
verses.translation: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh’s bondmen in Egypt; and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֣ן יְהוָ֡ה אוֹתֹ֣ת וּ֠/מֹפְתִים גְּדֹלִ֨ים וְ/רָעִ֧ים בְּ/מִצְרַ֛יִם בְּ/פַרְעֹ֥ה וּ/בְ/כָל בֵּית֖/וֹ לְ/עֵינֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: vytn yhvh 'vtt vmptym gdlym vr'ym bmtsrym bpr'h vbkhl bytv l'ynynv
verses.translation: And the LORD shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:

verses.original: וְ/אוֹתָ֖/נוּ הוֹצִ֣יא מִ/שָּׁ֑ם לְמַ֨עַן֙ הָבִ֣יא אֹתָ֔/נוּ לָ֤/תֶת לָ֨/נוּ֙ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַ/אֲבֹתֵֽי/נוּ
verses.translit: v'vtnv hvtsy' mshm lm'n hby' 'tnv ltt lnv 't h'rts 'shr nshb' l'btynv
verses.translation: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.

verses.original: וַ/יְצַוֵּ֣/נוּ יְהוָ֗ה לַ/עֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת כָּל הַ/חֻקִּ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה לְ/יִרְאָ֖ה אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑י/נוּ לְ/ט֥וֹב לָ֨/נוּ֙ כָּל הַ/יָּמִ֔ים לְ/חַיֹּתֵ֖/נוּ כְּ/הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vytsvnv yhvh l'shvt 't khl hchqym h'lh lyr'h 't yhvh 'lhynv ltvb lnv khl hymym lchytnv khhyvm hzh
verses.translation: And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.

verses.original: וּ/צְדָקָ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶה לָּ֑/נוּ כִּֽי נִשְׁמֹ֨ר לַ/עֲשׂ֜וֹת אֶת כָּל הַ/מִּצְוָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֗את לִ/פְנֵ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖י/נוּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽ/נוּ
verses.translit: vtsdqh thyh lnv khy nshmr l'shvt 't khl hmtsvh hz't lpny yhvh 'lhynv kh'shr tsvnv
verses.translation: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he hath commanded us.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יְבִֽיאֲ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ אֶל הָ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה בָא שָׁ֖מָּ/ה לְ/רִשְׁתָּ֑/הּ וְ/נָשַׁ֣ל גּֽוֹיִם רַבִּ֣ים מִ/פָּנֶ֡י/ךָ הַֽ/חִתִּי֩ וְ/הַ/גִּרְגָּשִׁ֨י וְ/הָ/אֱמֹרִ֜י וְ/הַ/כְּנַעֲנִ֣י וְ/הַ/פְּרִזִּ֗י וְ/הַֽ/חִוִּי֙ וְ/הַ/יְבוּסִ֔י שִׁבְעָ֣ה גוֹיִ֔ם רַבִּ֥ים וַ/עֲצוּמִ֖ים מִמֶּֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: khy yby'kh yhvh 'lhykh 'l h'rts 'shr 'th b' shmh lrshth vnshl gvym rbym mpnykh hchty vhgrgshy vh'mry vhkhn'ny vhprzy vhchvy vhybvsy shb'h gvym rbym v'tsvmym mmkh
verses.translation: When the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;

verses.original: וּ/נְתָנָ֞/ם יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛י/ךָ לְ/פָנֶ֖י/ךָ וְ/הִכִּיתָ֑/ם הַחֲרֵ֤ם תַּחֲרִים֙ אֹתָ֔/ם לֹא תִכְרֹ֥ת לָ/הֶ֛ם בְּרִ֖ית וְ/לֹ֥א תְחָנֵּֽ/ם
verses.translit: vntnm yhvh 'lhykh lpnykh vhkhytm hchrm tchrym 'tm l' tkhrt lhm bryt vl' tchnm
verses.translation: And when the LORD thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֥א תִתְחַתֵּ֖ן בָּ֑/ם בִּתְּ/ךָ֙ לֹא תִתֵּ֣ן לִ/בְנ֔/וֹ וּ/בִתּ֖/וֹ לֹא תִקַּ֥ח לִ/בְנֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vl' ttchtn bm btkh l' ttn lbnv vbtv l' tqch lbnkh
verses.translation: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.

verses.original: כִּֽי יָסִ֤יר אֶת בִּנְ/ךָ֙ מֵֽ/אַחֲרַ֔/י וְ/עָבְד֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וְ/חָרָ֤ה אַף יְהוָה֙ בָּ/כֶ֔ם וְ/הִשְׁמִידְ/ךָ֖ מַהֵֽר
verses.translit: khy ysyr 't bnkh m'chry v'bdv 'lhym 'chrym vchrh 'f yhvh bkhm vhshmydkh mhr
verses.translation: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.

verses.original: כִּֽי אִם כֹּ֤ה תַעֲשׂוּ֙ לָ/הֶ֔ם מִזְבְּחֹתֵי/הֶ֣ם תִּתֹּ֔צוּ וּ/מַצֵּבֹתָ֖/ם תְּשַׁבֵּ֑רוּ וַ/אֲשֵֽׁירֵ/הֶם֙ תְּגַדֵּע֔וּ/ן וּ/פְסִילֵי/הֶ֖ם תִּשְׂרְפ֥וּ/ן בָּ/אֵֽשׁ
verses.translit: khy 'm khh t'shv lhm mzbchtyhm tttsv vmtsbtm tshbrv v'shyrhm tgd'vn vpsylyhm tshrpvn b'sh
verses.translation: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.

verses.original: כִּ֣י עַ֤ם קָדוֹשׁ֙ אַתָּ֔ה לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ בְּ/ךָ֞ בָּחַ֣ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י/ךָ לִ/הְי֥וֹת ל/וֹ֙ לְ/עַ֣ם סְגֻלָּ֔ה מִ/כֹּל֙ הָֽ/עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: khy 'm qdvsh 'th lyhvh 'lhykh bkh bchr yhvh 'lhykh lhyvt lv l'm sglh mkhl h'mym 'shr 'l pny h'dmh
verses.translation: For thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God: the LORD thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.

verses.original: לֹ֣א מֵֽ/רֻבְּ/כֶ֞ם מִ/כָּל הָֽ/עַמִּ֗ים חָשַׁ֧ק יְהוָ֛ה בָּ/כֶ֖ם וַ/יִּבְחַ֣ר בָּ/כֶ֑ם כִּֽי אַתֶּ֥ם הַ/מְעַ֖ט מִ/כָּל הָ/עַמִּֽים
verses.translit: l' mrbkhm mkhl h'mym chshq yhvh bkhm vybchr bkhm khy 'tm hm't mkhl h'mym
verses.translation: The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:

verses.original: כִּי֩ מֵֽ/אַהֲבַ֨ת יְהוָ֜ה אֶתְ/כֶ֗ם וּ/מִ/שָּׁמְר֤/וּ אֶת הַ/שְּׁבֻעָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִשְׁבַּע֙ לַ/אֲבֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם הוֹצִ֧יא יְהוָ֛ה אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם בְּ/יָ֣ד חֲזָקָ֑ה וַֽ/יִּפְדְּ/ךָ֙ מִ/בֵּ֣ית עֲבָדִ֔ים מִ/יַּ֖ד פַּרְעֹ֥ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: khy m'hbt yhvh 'tkhm vmshmrv 't hshb'h 'shr nshb' l'btykhm hvtsy' yhvh 'tkhm byd chzqh vypdkh mbyt 'bdym myd pr'h mlkh mtsrym
verses.translation: But because the LORD loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

verses.original: וְ/יָ֣דַעְתָּ֔ כִּֽי יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ ה֣וּא הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֑ים הָ/אֵל֙ הַֽ/נֶּאֱמָ֔ן שֹׁמֵ֧ר הַ/בְּרִ֣ית וְ/הַ/חֶ֗סֶד לְ/אֹהֲבָ֛י/ו וּ/לְ/שֹׁמְרֵ֥י מצות/ו מִצְוֺתָ֖י/ו לְ/אֶ֥לֶף דּֽוֹר
verses.translit: vyd't khy yhvh 'lhykh hv' h'lhym h'l hn'mn shmr hbryt vhchsd l'hbyv vlshmry mtsvtv mtsvtyv l'lf dvr
verses.translation: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;

verses.original: וּ/מְשַׁלֵּ֧ם לְ/שֹׂנְאָ֛י/ו אֶל פָּנָ֖י/ו לְ/הַאֲבִיד֑/וֹ לֹ֤א יְאַחֵר֙ לְ/שֹׂ֣נְא֔/וֹ אֶל פָּנָ֖י/ו יְשַׁלֶּם לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vmshlm lshn'yv 'l pnyv lh'bydv l' y'chr lshn'v 'l pnyv yshlm lv
verses.translation: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁמַרְתָּ֨ אֶת הַ/מִּצְוָ֜ה וְ/אֶת הַֽ/חֻקִּ֣ים וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֛ הַ/יּ֖וֹם לַ/עֲשׂוֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vshmrt 't hmtsvh v't hchqym v't hmshptym 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm l'shvtm
verses.translation: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה עֵ֣קֶב תִּשְׁמְע֗וּ/ן אֵ֤ת הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִים֙ הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּ֥ם וַ/עֲשִׂיתֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑/ם וְ/שָׁמַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜י/ךָ לְ/ךָ֗ אֶֽת הַ/בְּרִית֙ וְ/אֶת הַ/חֶ֔סֶד אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַ/אֲבֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vhyh 'qb tshm'vn 't hmshptym h'lh vshmrtm v'shytm 'tm vshmr yhvh 'lhykh lkh 't hbryt v't hchsd 'shr nshb' l'btykh
verses.translation: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the LORD thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:

verses.original: וַ/אֲהֵ֣בְ/ךָ֔ וּ/בֵרַכְ/ךָ֖ וְ/הִרְבֶּ֑/ךָ וּ/בֵרַ֣ךְ פְּרִֽי בִטְנְ/ךָ֣ וּ/פְרִֽי אַ֠דְמָתֶ/ךָ דְּגָ֨נְ/ךָ֜ וְ/תִֽירֹשְׁ/ךָ֣ וְ/יִצְהָרֶ֗/ךָ שְׁגַר אֲלָפֶ֨י/ךָ֙ וְ/עַשְׁתְּרֹ֣ת צֹאנֶ֔/ךָ עַ֚ל הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לַ/אֲבֹתֶ֖י/ךָ לָ֥/תֶת לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: v'hbkh vbrkhkh vhrbkh vbrkh pry btnkh vpry 'dmtkh dgnkh vtyrshkh vytshrkh shgr 'lpykh v'shtrt ts'nkh 'l h'dmh 'shr nshb' l'btykh ltt lkh
verses.translation: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.

verses.original: בָּר֥וּךְ תִּֽהְיֶ֖ה מִ/כָּל הָ/עַמִּ֑ים לֹא יִהְיֶ֥ה בְ/ךָ֛ עָקָ֥ר וַֽ/עֲקָרָ֖ה וּ/בִ/בְהֶמְתֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: brvkh thyh mkhl h'mym l' yhyh bkh 'qr v'qrh vbbhmtkh
verses.translation: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.

verses.original: וְ/הֵסִ֧יר יְהוָ֛ה מִמְּ/ךָ֖ כָּל חֹ֑לִי וְ/כָל מַדְוֵי֩ מִצְרַ֨יִם הָ/רָעִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָדַ֗עְתָּ לֹ֤א יְשִׂימָ/ם֙ בָּ֔/ךְ וּ/נְתָנָ֖/ם בְּ/כָל שֹׂנְאֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vhsyr yhvh mmkh khl chly vkhl mdvy mtsrym hr'ym 'shr yd't l' yshymm bkh vntnm bkhl shn'ykh
verses.translation: And the LORD will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.

verses.original: וְ/אָכַלְתָּ֣ אֶת כָּל הָֽ/עַמִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֔/ךְ לֹא תָחֹ֥ס עֵֽינְ/ךָ֖ עֲלֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/לֹ֤א תַעֲבֹד֙ אֶת אֱלֹ֣הֵי/הֶ֔ם כִּֽי מוֹקֵ֥שׁ ה֖וּא לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: v'khlt 't khl h'mym 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh l' tchs 'ynkh 'lyhm vl' t'bd 't 'lhyhm khy mvqsh hv' lkh
verses.translation: And thou shalt consume all the people which the LORD thy God shall deliver thee; thine eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto thee.

verses.original: כִּ֤י תֹאמַר֙ בִּ/לְבָ֣בְ/ךָ֔ רַבִּ֛ים הַ/גּוֹיִ֥ם הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה מִמֶּ֑/נִּי אֵיכָ֥ה אוּכַ֖ל לְ/הוֹרִישָֽׁ/ם
verses.translit: khy t'mr blbbkh rbym hgvym h'lh mmny 'ykhh 'vkhl lhvryshm
verses.translation: If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?

verses.original: לֹ֥א תִירָ֖א מֵ/הֶ֑ם זָכֹ֣ר תִּזְכֹּ֗ר אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ לְ/פַרְעֹ֖ה וּ/לְ/כָל מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: l' tyr' mhm zkhr tzkhr 't 'shr 'shh yhvh 'lhykh lpr'h vlkhl mtsrym
verses.translation: Thou shalt not be afraid of them: but shalt well remember what the LORD thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;

verses.original: הַ/מַּסֹּ֨ת הַ/גְּדֹלֹ֜ת אֲשֶׁר רָא֣וּ עֵינֶ֗י/ךָ וְ/הָ/אֹתֹ֤ת וְ/הַ/מֹּֽפְתִים֙ וְ/הַ/יָּ֤ד הַ/חֲזָקָה֙ וְ/הַ/זְּרֹ֣עַ הַ/נְּטוּיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹצִֽאֲ/ךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ כֵּֽן יַעֲשֶׂ֞ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לְ/כָל הָ֣/עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה יָרֵ֖א מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: hmst hgdlt 'shr r'v 'ynykh vh'tt vhmptym vhyd hchzqh vhzr' hntvyh 'shr hvts'kh yhvh 'lhykh khn y'shh yhvh 'lhykh lkhl h'mym 'shr 'th yr' mpnyhm
verses.translation: The great temptations which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the LORD thy God brought thee out: so shall the LORD thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.

verses.original: וְ/גַם֙ אֶת הַ/צִּרְעָ֔ה יְשַׁלַּ֛ח יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ בָּ֑/ם עַד אֲבֹ֗ד הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֛ים וְ/הַ/נִּסְתָּרִ֖ים מִ/פָּנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vgm 't htsr'h yshlch yhvh 'lhykh bm 'd 'bd hnsh'rym vhnstrym mpnykh
verses.translation: Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.

verses.original: לֹ֥א תַעֲרֹ֖ץ מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶ֑ם כִּֽי יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ בְּ/קִרְבֶּ֔/ךָ אֵ֥ל גָּד֖וֹל וְ/נוֹרָֽא
verses.translit: l' t'rts mpnyhm khy yhvh 'lhykh bqrbkh 'l gdvl vnvr'
verses.translation: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the LORD thy God is among you, a mighty God and terrible.

verses.original: וְ/נָשַׁל֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜י/ךָ אֶת הַ/גּוֹיִ֥ם הָ/אֵ֛ל מִ/פָּנֶ֖י/ךָ מְעַ֣ט מְעָ֑ט לֹ֤א תוּכַל֙ כַּלֹּתָ֣/ם מַהֵ֔ר פֶּן תִּרְבֶּ֥ה עָלֶ֖י/ךָ חַיַּ֥ת הַ/שָּׂדֶֽה
verses.translit: vnshl yhvh 'lhykh 't hgvym h'l mpnykh m't m't l' tvkhl khltm mhr pn trbh 'lykh chyt hshdh
verses.translation: And the LORD thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.

verses.original: וּ/נְתָנָ֛/ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/הָמָ/ם֙ מְהוּמָ֣ה גְדֹלָ֔ה עַ֖ד הִשָּׁמְדָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vntnm yhvh 'lhykh lpnykh vhmm mhvmh gdlh 'd hshmdm
verses.translation: But the LORD thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.

verses.original: וְ/נָתַ֤ן מַלְכֵי/הֶם֙ בְּ/יָדֶ֔/ךָ וְ/הַאֲבַדְתָּ֣ אֶת שְׁמָ֔/ם מִ/תַּ֖חַת הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם לֹֽא יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב אִישׁ֙ בְּ/פָנֶ֔י/ךָ עַ֥ד הִשְׁמִֽדְ/ךָ֖ אֹתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vntn mlkhyhm bydkh vh'bdt 't shmm mtcht hshmym l' ytytsb 'ysh bpnykh 'd hshmdkh 'tm
verses.translation: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.

verses.original: פְּסִילֵ֥י אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֖ם תִּשְׂרְפ֣וּ/ן בָּ/אֵ֑שׁ לֹֽא תַחְמֹד֩ כֶּ֨סֶף וְ/זָהָ֤ב עֲלֵי/הֶם֙ וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֣ לָ֔/ךְ פֶּ֚ן תִּוָּקֵ֣שׁ בּ֔/וֹ כִּ֧י תוֹעֲבַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ הֽוּא
verses.translit: psyly 'lhyhm tshrpvn b'sh l' tchmd khsf vzhb 'lyhm vlqcht lkh pn tvqsh bv khy tv'bt yhvh 'lhykh hv'
verses.translation: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therein: for it is an abomination to the LORD thy God.

verses.original: וְ/לֹא תָבִ֤יא תֽוֹעֵבָה֙ אֶל בֵּיתֶ֔/ךָ וְ/הָיִ֥יתָ חֵ֖רֶם כָּמֹ֑/הוּ שַׁקֵּ֧ץ תְּשַׁקְּצֶ֛/נּוּ וְ/תַעֵ֥ב תְּֽתַעֲבֶ֖/נּוּ כִּי חֵ֥רֶם הֽוּא
verses.translit: vl' tby' tv'bh 'l bytkh vhyyt chrm khmhv shqts tshqtsnv vt'b tt'bnv khy chrm hv'
verses.translation: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.

verses.original: כָּל הַ/מִּצְוָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֛ הַ/יּ֖וֹם תִּשְׁמְר֣וּ/ן לַ/עֲשׂ֑וֹת לְמַ֨עַן תִּֽחְי֜וּ/ן וּ/רְבִיתֶ֗ם וּ/בָאתֶם֙ וִֽ/ירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לַ/אֲבֹתֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khl hmtsvh 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm tshmrvn l'shvt lm'n tchyvn vrbytm vb'tm vyrshtm 't h'rts 'shr nshb' yhvh l'btykhm
verses.translation: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers.

verses.original: וְ/זָכַרְתָּ֣ אֶת כָּל הַ/דֶּ֗רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֹלִֽיכֲ/ךָ֜ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛י/ךָ זֶ֛ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר לְמַ֨עַן עַנֹּֽתְ/ךָ֜ לְ/נַסֹּֽתְ/ךָ֗ לָ/דַ֜עַת אֶת אֲשֶׁ֧ר בִּֽ/לְבָבְ/ךָ֛ הֲ/תִשְׁמֹ֥ר מצות/ו מִצְוֺתָ֖י/ו אִם לֹֽא
verses.translit: vzkhrt 't khl hdrkh 'shr hlykhkh yhvh 'lhykh zh 'rb'ym shnh bmdbr lm'n 'ntkh lnstkh ld't 't 'shr blbbkh htshmr mtsvtv mtsvtyv 'm l'
verses.translation: And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.

verses.original: וַֽ/יְעַנְּ/ךָ֮ וַ/יַּרְעִבֶ/ךָ֒ וַ/יַּֽאֲכִֽלְ/ךָ֤ אֶת הַ/מָּן֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא יָדַ֔עְתָּ וְ/לֹ֥א יָדְע֖וּ/ן אֲבֹתֶ֑י/ךָ לְמַ֣עַן הוֹדִֽעֲ/ךָ֗ כִּ֠י לֹ֣א עַל הַ/לֶּ֤חֶם לְ/בַדּ/וֹ֙ יִחְיֶ֣ה הָֽ/אָדָ֔ם כִּ֛י עַל כָּל מוֹצָ֥א פִֽי יְהוָ֖ה יִחְיֶ֥ה הָ/אָדָֽם
verses.translit: vy'nkh vyr'bkh vy'khlkh 't hmn 'shr l' yd't vl' yd'vn 'btykh lm'n hvd'kh khy l' 'l hlchm lbdv ychyh h'dm khy 'l khl mvts' py yhvh ychyh h'dm
verses.translation: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.

verses.original: שִׂמְלָ֨תְ/ךָ֜ לֹ֤א בָֽלְתָה֙ מֵֽ/עָלֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/רַגְלְ/ךָ֖ לֹ֣א בָצֵ֑קָה זֶ֖ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: shmltkh l' blth m'lykh vrglkh l' btsqh zh 'rb'ym shnh
verses.translation: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.

verses.original: וְ/יָדַעְתָּ֖ עִם לְבָבֶ֑/ךָ כִּ֗י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְיַסֵּ֥ר אִישׁ֙ אֶת בְּנ֔/וֹ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ מְיַסְּרֶֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: vyd't 'm lbbkh khy kh'shr yysr 'ysh 't bnv yhvh 'lhykh mysrkh
verses.translation: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.

verses.original: וְ/שָׁ֣מַרְתָּ֔ אֶת מִצְוֺ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ לָ/לֶ֥כֶת בִּ/דְרָכָ֖י/ו וּ/לְ/יִרְאָ֥ה אֹתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vshmrt 't mtsvt yhvh 'lhykh llkht bdrkhyv vlyr'h 'tv
verses.translation: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.

verses.original: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ מְבִֽיאֲ/ךָ֖ אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ טוֹבָ֑ה אֶ֚רֶץ נַ֣חֲלֵי מָ֔יִם עֲיָנֹת֙ וּ/תְהֹמֹ֔ת יֹצְאִ֥ים בַּ/בִּקְעָ֖ה וּ/בָ/הָֽר
verses.translit: khy yhvh 'lhykh mby'kh 'l 'rts tvbh 'rts nchly mym 'ynt vthmt yts'ym bbq'h vbhr
verses.translation: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;

verses.original: אֶ֤רֶץ חִטָּה֙ וּ/שְׂעֹרָ֔ה וְ/גֶ֥פֶן וּ/תְאֵנָ֖ה וְ/רִמּ֑וֹן אֶֽרֶץ זֵ֥ית שֶׁ֖מֶן וּ/דְבָֽשׁ
verses.translit: 'rts chth vsh'rh vgpn vt'nh vrmvn 'rts zyt shmn vdbsh
verses.translation: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;

verses.original: אֶ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹ֤א בְ/מִסְכֵּנֻת֙ תֹּֽאכַל בָּ֣/הּ לֶ֔חֶם לֹֽא תֶחְסַ֥ר כֹּ֖ל בָּ֑/הּ אֶ֚רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲבָנֶ֣י/הָ בַרְזֶ֔ל וּ/מֵ/הֲרָרֶ֖י/הָ תַּחְצֹ֥ב נְחֹֽשֶׁת
verses.translit: 'rts 'shr l' bmskhnt t'khl bh lchm l' tchsr khl bh 'rts 'shr 'bnyh brzl vmhrryh tchtsb nchsht
verses.translation: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.

verses.original: וְ/אָכַלְתָּ֖ וְ/שָׂבָ֑עְתָּ וּ/בֵֽרַכְתָּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ עַל הָ/אָ֥רֶץ הַ/טֹּבָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: v'khlt vshb't vbrkht 't yhvh 'lhykh 'l h'rts htbh 'shr ntn lkh
verses.translation: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.

verses.original: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְ/ךָ֔ פֶּן תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ לְ/בִלְתִּ֨י שְׁמֹ֤ר מִצְוֺתָי/ו֙ וּ/מִשְׁפָּטָ֣י/ו וְ/חֻקֹּתָ֔י/ו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֖ הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: hshmr lkh pn tshkhch 't yhvh 'lhykh lblty shmr mtsvtyv vmshptyv vchqtyv 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm
verses.translation: Beware that thou forget not the LORD thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:

verses.original: פֶּן תֹּאכַ֖ל וְ/שָׂבָ֑עְתָּ וּ/בָתִּ֥ים טוֹבִ֛ים תִּבְנֶ֖ה וְ/יָשָֽׁבְתָּ
verses.translit: pn t'khl vshb't vbtym tvbym tbnh vyshbt
verses.translation: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;

verses.original: וּ/בְקָֽרְ/ךָ֤ וְ/צֹֽאנְ/ךָ֙ יִרְבְּיֻ֔/ן וְ/כֶ֥סֶף וְ/זָהָ֖ב יִרְבֶּה לָּ֑/ךְ וְ/כֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר לְ/ךָ֖ יִרְבֶּֽה
verses.translit: vbqrkh vts'nkh yrbyn vkhsf vzhb yrbh lkh vkhl 'shr lkh yrbh
verses.translation: And when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;

verses.original: וְ/רָ֖ם לְבָבֶ֑/ךָ וְ/שָֽׁכַחְתָּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ הַ/מּוֹצִיאֲ/ךָ֛ מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִ/בֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים
verses.translit: vrm lbbkh vshkhcht 't yhvh 'lhykh hmvtsy'kh m'rts mtsrym mbyt 'bdym
verses.translation: Then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the LORD thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;

verses.original: הַ/מּוֹלִ֨יכֲ/ךָ֜ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֣ר הַ/גָּדֹ֣ל וְ/הַ/נּוֹרָ֗א נָחָ֤שׁ שָׂרָף֙ וְ/עַקְרָ֔ב וְ/צִמָּא֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֵֽין מָ֑יִם הַ/מּוֹצִ֤יא לְ/ךָ֙ מַ֔יִם מִ/צּ֖וּר הַֽ/חַלָּמִֽישׁ
verses.translit: hmvlykhkh bmdbr hgdl vhnvr' nchsh shrf v'qrb vtsm'vn 'shr 'yn mym hmvtsy' lkh mym mtsvr hchlmysh
verses.translation: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;

verses.original: הַ/מַּֽאֲכִ֨לְ/ךָ֥ מָן֙ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא יָדְע֖וּ/ן אֲבֹתֶ֑י/ךָ לְמַ֣עַן עַנֹּֽתְ/ךָ֗ וּ/לְמַ֨עַן֙ נַסֹּתֶ֔/ךָ לְ/הֵיטִֽבְ/ךָ֖ בְּ/אַחֲרִיתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: hm'khlkh mn bmdbr 'shr l' yd'vn 'btykh lm'n 'ntkh vlm'n nstkh lhytbkh b'chrytkh
verses.translation: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;

verses.original: וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֖ בִּ/לְבָבֶ֑/ךָ כֹּחִ/י֙ וְ/עֹ֣צֶם יָדִ֔/י עָ֥שָׂה לִ֖/י אֶת הַ/חַ֥יִל הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: v'mrt blbbkh khchy v'tsm ydy 'shh ly 't hchyl hzh
verses.translation: And thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth.

verses.original: וְ/זָֽכַרְתָּ֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ כִּ֣י ה֗וּא הַ/נֹּתֵ֥ן לְ/ךָ֛ כֹּ֖חַ לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת חָ֑יִל לְמַ֨עַן הָקִ֧ים אֶת בְּרִית֛/וֹ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע לַ/אֲבֹתֶ֖י/ךָ כַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: vzkhrt 't yhvh 'lhykh khy hv' hntn lkh khch l'shvt chyl lm'n hqym 't brytv 'shr nshb' l'btykh khyvm hzh
verses.translation: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה אִם שָׁכֹ֤חַ תִּשְׁכַּח֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/הָֽלַכְתָּ֗ אַחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַ/עֲבַדְתָּ֖/ם וְ/הִשְׁתַּחֲוִ֣יתָ לָ/הֶ֑ם הַעִדֹ֤תִי בָ/כֶם֙ הַ/יּ֔וֹם כִּ֥י אָבֹ֖ד תֹּאבֵדֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: vhyh 'm shkhch tshkhch 't yhvh 'lhykh vhlkht 'chry 'lhym 'chrym v'bdtm vhshtchvyt lhm h'dty bkhm hyvm khy 'bd t'bdvn
verses.translation: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the LORD thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.

verses.original: כַּ/גּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יְהוָה֙ מַאֲבִ֣יד מִ/פְּנֵי/כֶ֔ם כֵּ֖ן תֹאבֵד֑וּ/ן עֵ֚קֶב לֹ֣א תִשְׁמְע֔וּ/ן בְּ/ק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khgvym 'shr yhvh m'byd mpnykhm khn t'bdvn 'qb l' tshm'vn bqvl yhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: As the nations which the LORD destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the LORD your God.

verses.original: שְׁמַ֣ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל אַתָּ֨ה עֹבֵ֤ר הַ/יּוֹם֙ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן לָ/בֹא֙ לָ/רֶ֣שֶׁת גּוֹיִ֔ם גְּדֹלִ֥ים וַ/עֲצֻמִ֖ים מִמֶּ֑/ךָּ עָרִ֛ים גְּדֹלֹ֥ת וּ/בְצֻרֹ֖ת בַּ/שָּׁמָֽיִם
verses.translit: shm' yshr'l 'th 'br hyvm 't hyrdn lb' lrsht gvym gdlym v'tsmym mmkh 'rym gdlt vbtsrt bshmym
verses.translation: Hear, O Israel: Thou art to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven,

verses.original: עַֽם גָּד֥וֹל וָ/רָ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י עֲנָקִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֨עְתָּ֙ וְ/אַתָּ֣ה שָׁמַ֔עְתָּ מִ֣י יִתְיַצֵּ֔ב לִ/פְנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י עֲנָֽק
verses.translit: 'm gdvl vrm bny 'nqym 'shr 'th yd't v'th shm't my ytytsb lpny bny 'nq
verses.translation: A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom thou knowest, and of whom thou hast heard say , Who can stand before the children of Anak!

verses.original: וְ/יָדַעְתָּ֣ הַ/יּ֗וֹם כִּי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜י/ךָ הֽוּא הָ/עֹבֵ֤ר לְ/פָנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֵ֣שׁ אֹֽכְלָ֔ה ה֧וּא יַשְׁמִידֵ֛/ם וְ/ה֥וּא יַכְנִיעֵ֖/ם לְ/פָנֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/הֽוֹרַשְׁתָּ֤/ם וְ/הַֽאַבַדְתָּ/ם֙ מַהֵ֔ר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֛ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vyd't hyvm khy yhvh 'lhykh hv' h'br lpnykh 'sh 'khlh hv' yshmydm vhv' ykhny'm lpnykh vhvrshtm vh'bdtm mhr kh'shr dbr yhvh lkh
verses.translation: Understand therefore this day, that the LORD thy God is he which goeth over before thee; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before thy face: so shalt thou drive them out, and destroy them quickly, as the LORD hath said unto thee.

verses.original: אַל תֹּאמַ֣ר בִּ/לְבָבְ/ךָ֗ בַּ/הֲדֹ֣ף יְהוָה֩ אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ אֹתָ֥/ם מִ/לְּ/פָנֶי/ךָ֮ לֵ/אמֹר֒ בְּ/צִדְקָתִ/י֙ הֱבִיאַ֣/נִי יְהוָ֔ה לָ/רֶ֖שֶׁת אֶת הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/זֹּ֑את וּ/בְ/רִשְׁעַת֙ הַ/גּוֹיִ֣ם הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה יְהוָ֖ה מוֹרִישָׁ֥/ם מִ/פָּנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: 'l t'mr blbbkh bhdf yhvh 'lhykh 'tm mlpnykh l'mr btsdqty hby'ny yhvh lrsht 't h'rts hz't vbrsh't hgvym h'lh yhvh mvryshm mpnykh
verses.translation: Speak not thou in thine heart, after that the LORD thy God hath cast them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness the LORD hath brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD doth drive them out from before thee.

verses.original: לֹ֣א בְ/צִדְקָתְ/ךָ֗ וּ/בְ/יֹ֨שֶׁר֙ לְבָ֣בְ/ךָ֔ אַתָּ֥ה בָ֖א לָ/רֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת אַרְצָ֑/ם כִּ֞י בְּ/רִשְׁעַ֣ת הַ/גּוֹיִ֣ם הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ מוֹרִישָׁ֣/ם מִ/פָּנֶ֔י/ךָ וּ/לְמַ֜עַן הָקִ֣ים אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהוָה֙ לַ/אֲבֹתֶ֔י/ךָ לְ/אַבְרָהָ֥ם לְ/יִצְחָ֖ק וּֽ/לְ/יַעֲקֹֽב
verses.translit: l' btsdqtkh vbyshr lbbkh 'th b' lrsht 't 'rtsm khy brsh't hgvym h'lh yhvh 'lhykh mvryshm mpnykh vlm'n hqym 't hdbr 'shr nshb' yhvh l'btykh l'brhm lytschq vly'qb
verses.translation: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thine heart, dost thou go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may perform the word which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

verses.original: וְ/יָדַעְתָּ֗ כִּ֠י לֹ֤א בְ/צִדְקָֽתְ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֠לֹהֶי/ךָ נֹתֵ֨ן לְ/ךָ֜ אֶת הָ/אָ֧רֶץ הַ/טּוֹבָ֛ה הַ/זֹּ֖את לְ/רִשְׁתָּ֑/הּ כִּ֥י עַם קְשֵׁה עֹ֖רֶף אָֽתָּה
verses.translit: vyd't khy l' btsdqtkh yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh 't h'rts htvbh hz't lrshth khy 'm qshh 'rf 'th
verses.translation: Understand therefore, that the LORD thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou art a stiffnecked people.

verses.original: זְכֹר֙ אַל תִּשְׁכַּ֔ח אֵ֧ת אֲשֶׁר הִקְצַ֛פְתָּ אֶת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר לְ/מִן הַ/יּ֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר יָצָ֣אתָ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם עַד בֹּֽאֲ/כֶם֙ עַד הַ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/זֶּ֔ה מַמְרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם עִם יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: zkhr 'l tshkhch 't 'shr hqtspt 't yhvh 'lhykh bmdbr lmn hyvm 'shr yts't m'rts mtsrym 'd b'khm 'd hmqvm hzh mmrym hyytm 'm yhvh
verses.translation: Remember, and forget not, how thou provokedst the LORD thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against the LORD .

verses.original: וּ/בְ/חֹרֵ֥ב הִקְצַפְתֶּ֖ם אֶת יְהוָ֑ה וַ/יִּתְאַנַּ֧ף יְהוָ֛ה בָּ/כֶ֖ם לְ/הַשְׁמִ֥יד אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vbchrb hqtsptm 't yhvh vyt'nf yhvh bkhm lhshmyd 'tkhm
verses.translation: Also in Horeb ye provoked the LORD to wrath, so that the LORD was angry with you to have destroyed you.

verses.original: בַּ/עֲלֹתִ֣/י הָ/הָ֗רָ/ה לָ/קַ֜חַת לוּחֹ֤ת הָֽ/אֲבָנִים֙ לוּחֹ֣ת הַ/בְּרִ֔ית אֲשֶׁר כָּרַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּ/כֶ֑ם וָ/אֵשֵׁ֣ב בָּ/הָ֗ר אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֣ים לַ֔יְלָה לֶ֚חֶם לֹ֣א אָכַ֔לְתִּי וּ/מַ֖יִם לֹ֥א שָׁתִֽיתִי
verses.translit: b'lty hhrh lqcht lvcht h'bnym lvcht hbryt 'shr khrt yhvh 'mkhm v'shb bhr 'rb'ym yvm v'rb'ym lylh lchm l' 'khlty vmym l' shtyty
verses.translation: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:

verses.original: וַ/יִּתֵּ֨ן יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗/י אֶת שְׁנֵי֙ לוּחֹ֣ת הָֽ/אֲבָנִ֔ים כְּתֻבִ֖ים בְּ/אֶצְבַּ֣ע אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַ/עֲלֵי/הֶ֗ם כְּֽ/כָל הַ/דְּבָרִ֡ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּר֩ יְהוָ֨ה עִמָּ/כֶ֥ם בָּ/הָ֛ר מִ/תּ֥וֹךְ הָ/אֵ֖שׁ בְּ/י֥וֹם הַ/קָּהָֽל
verses.translit: vytn yhvh 'ly 't shny lvcht h'bnym khtbym b'tsb' 'lhym v'lyhm khkhl hdbrym 'shr dbr yhvh 'mkhm bhr mtvkh h'sh byvm hqhl
verses.translation: And the LORD delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them was written according to all the words, which the LORD spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.

verses.original: וַ/יְהִ֗י מִ/קֵּץ֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָ֑יְלָה נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗/י אֶת שְׁנֵ֛י לֻחֹ֥ת הָ/אֲבָנִ֖ים לֻח֥וֹת הַ/בְּרִֽית
verses.translit: vyhy mqts 'rb'ym yvm v'rb'ym lylh ntn yhvh 'ly 't shny lcht h'bnym lchvt hbryt
verses.translation: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that the LORD gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗/י ק֣וּם רֵ֤ד מַהֵר֙ מִ/זֶּ֔ה כִּ֚י שִׁחֵ֣ת עַמְּ/ךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוֹצֵ֖אתָ מִ/מִּצְרָ֑יִם סָ֣רוּ מַהֵ֗ר מִן הַ/דֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֔/ם עָשׂ֥וּ לָ/הֶ֖ם מַסֵּכָֽה
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly qvm rd mhr mzh khy shcht 'mkh 'shr hvts't mmtsrym srv mhr mn hdrkh 'shr tsvytm 'shv lhm mskhh
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֣/י לֵ/אמֹ֑ר רָאִ֨יתִי֙ אֶת הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה עַם קְשֵׁה עֹ֖רֶף הֽוּא
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly l'mr r'yty 't h'm hzh vhnh 'm qshh 'rf hv'
verses.translation: Furthermore the LORD spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:

verses.original: הֶ֤רֶף מִמֶּ֨/נִּי֙ וְ/אַשְׁמִידֵ֔/ם וְ/אֶמְחֶ֣ה אֶת שְׁמָ֔/ם מִ/תַּ֖חַת הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ/אֶֽעֱשֶׂה֙ אֽוֹתְ/ךָ֔ לְ/גוֹי עָצ֥וּם וָ/רָ֖ב מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: hrf mmny v'shmydm v'mchh 't shmm mtcht hshmym v''shh 'vtkh lgvy 'tsvm vrb mmnv
verses.translation: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.

verses.original: וָ/אֵ֗פֶן וָֽ/אֵרֵד֙ מִן הָ/הָ֔ר וְ/הָ/הָ֖ר בֹּעֵ֣ר בָּ/אֵ֑שׁ וּ/שְׁנֵי֙ לֻחֹ֣ת הַ/בְּרִ֔ית עַ֖ל שְׁתֵּ֥י יָדָֽ/י
verses.translit: v'pn v'rd mn hhr vhhr b'r b'sh vshny lcht hbryt 'l shty ydy
verses.translation: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.

verses.original: וָ/אֵ֗רֶא וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה חֲטָאתֶם֙ לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם עֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם לָ/כֶ֔ם עֵ֖גֶל מַסֵּכָ֑ה סַרְתֶּ֣ם מַהֵ֔ר מִן הַ/דֶּ֕רֶךְ אֲשֶׁר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'r' vhnh cht'tm lyhvh 'lhykhm 'shytm lkhm 'gl mskhh srtm mhr mn hdrkh 'shr tsvh yhvh 'tkhm
verses.translation: And I looked, and, behold, ye had sinned against the LORD your God, and had made you a molten calf: ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the LORD had commanded you.

verses.original: וָ/אֶתְפֹּשׂ֙ בִּ/שְׁנֵ֣י הַ/לֻּחֹ֔ת וָֽ/אַשְׁלִכֵ֔/ם מֵ/עַ֖ל שְׁתֵּ֣י יָדָ֑/י וָ/אֲשַׁבְּרֵ֖/ם לְ/עֵינֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'tpsh bshny hlcht v'shlkhm m'l shty ydy v'shbrm l'ynykhm
verses.translation: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.

verses.original: וָֽ/אֶתְנַפַּל֩ לִ/פְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֜ה כָּ/רִאשֹׁנָ֗ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים יוֹם֙ וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֣ים לַ֔יְלָה לֶ֚חֶם לֹ֣א אָכַ֔לְתִּי וּ/מַ֖יִם לֹ֣א שָׁתִ֑יתִי עַ֤ל כָּל חַטַּאתְ/כֶם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חֲטָאתֶ֔ם לַ/עֲשׂ֥וֹת הָ/רַ֛ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְ/הַכְעִיסֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v'tnpl lpny yhvh khr'shnh 'rb'ym yvm v'rb'ym lylh lchm l' 'khlty vmym l' shtyty 'l khl cht'tkhm 'shr cht'tm l'shvt hr' b'yny yhvh lhkh'ysv
verses.translation: And I fell down before the LORD , as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which ye sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of the LORD , to provoke him to anger.

verses.original: כִּ֣י יָגֹ֗רְתִּי מִ/פְּנֵ֤י הָ/אַף֙ וְ/הַ֣/חֵמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָצַ֧ף יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵי/כֶ֖ם לְ/הַשְׁמִ֣יד אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔/י גַּ֖ם בַּ/פַּ֥עַם הַ/הִֽוא
verses.translit: khy ygrty mpny h'f vhchmh 'shr qtsf yhvh 'lykhm lhshmyd 'tkhm vyshm' yhvh 'ly gm bp'm hhv'
verses.translation: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the LORD was wroth against you to destroy you. But the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also.

verses.original: וּֽ/בְ/אַהֲרֹ֗ן הִתְאַנַּ֧ף יְהוָ֛ה מְאֹ֖ד לְ/הַשְׁמִיד֑/וֹ וָֽ/אֶתְפַּלֵּ֛ל גַּם בְּעַ֥ד אַהֲרֹ֖ן בָּ/עֵ֥ת הַ/הִֽוא
verses.translit: vb'hrn ht'nf yhvh m'd lhshmydv v'tpll gm b'd 'hrn b't hhv'
verses.translation: And the LORD was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.

verses.original: וְֽ/אֶת חַטַּאתְ/כֶ֞ם אֲשֶׁר עֲשִׂיתֶ֣ם אֶת הָ/עֵ֗גֶל לָקַחְתִּי֮ וָ/אֶשְׂרֹ֣ף אֹת֣/וֹ בָּ/אֵשׁ֒ וָ/אֶכֹּ֨ת אֹת֤/וֹ טָחוֹן֙ הֵיטֵ֔ב עַ֥ד אֲשֶׁר דַּ֖ק לְ/עָפָ֑ר וָֽ/אַשְׁלִךְ֙ אֶת עֲפָר֔/וֹ אֶל הַ/נַּ֖חַל הַ/יֹּרֵ֥ד מִן הָ/הָֽר
verses.translit: v't cht'tkhm 'shr 'shytm 't h'gl lqchty v'shrf 'tv b'sh v'kht 'tv tchvn hytb 'd 'shr dq l'pr v'shlkh 't 'prv 'l hnchl hyrd mn hhr
verses.translation: And I took your sin, the calf which ye had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it, and ground it very small, even until it was as small as dust: and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.

verses.original: וּ/בְ/תַבְעֵרָה֙ וּ/בְ/מַסָּ֔ה וּ/בְ/קִבְרֹ֖ת הַֽתַּאֲוָ֑ה מַקְצִפִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם אֶת יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vbtb'rh vbmsh vbqbrt ht'vh mqtspym hyytm 't yhvh
verses.translation: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibroth-hattaavah, ye provoked the LORD to wrath.

verses.original: וּ/בִ/שְׁלֹ֨חַ יְהוָ֜ה אֶתְ/כֶ֗ם מִ/קָּדֵ֤שׁ בַּרְנֵ֨עַ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר עֲלוּ֙ וּ/רְשׁ֣וּ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לָ/כֶ֑ם וַ/תַּמְר֗וּ אֶת פִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/לֹ֤א הֶֽאֱמַנְתֶּם֙ ל֔/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם בְּ/קֹלֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vbshlch yhvh 'tkhm mqdsh brn' l'mr 'lv vrshv 't h'rts 'shr ntty lkhm vtmrv 't py yhvh 'lhykhm vl' h'mntm lv vl' shm'tm bqlv
verses.translation: Likewise when the LORD sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.

verses.original: מַמְרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם עִם יְהוָ֑ה מִ/יּ֖וֹם דַּעְתִּ֥/י אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: mmrym hyytm 'm yhvh myvm d'ty 'tkhm
verses.translation: Ye have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.

verses.original: וָֽ/אֶתְנַפַּ֞ל לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֣ת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים הַ/יּ֛וֹם וְ/אֶת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים הַ/לַּ֖יְלָה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִתְנַפָּ֑לְתִּי כִּֽי אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה לְ/הַשְׁמִ֥יד אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: v'tnpl lpny yhvh 't 'rb'ym hyvm v't 'rb'ym hlylh 'shr htnplty khy 'mr yhvh lhshmyd 'tkhm
verses.translation: Thus I fell down before the LORD forty days and forty nights, as I fell down at the first; because the LORD had said he would destroy you.

verses.original: וָ/אֶתְפַּלֵּ֣ל אֶל יְהוָה֮ וָ/אֹמַר֒ אֲדֹנָ֣/י יְהוִ֗ה אַל תַּשְׁחֵ֤ת עַמְּ/ךָ֙ וְ/נַחֲלָ֣תְ/ךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּדִ֖יתָ בְּ/גָדְלֶ֑/ךָ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵ֥אתָ מִ/מִּצְרַ֖יִם בְּ/יָ֥ד חֲזָקָֽה
verses.translit: v'tpll 'l yhvh v'mr 'dny yhvh 'l tshcht 'mkh vnchltkh 'shr pdyt bgdlkh 'shr hvts't mmtsrym byd chzqh
verses.translation: I prayed therefore unto the LORD , and said, O Lord GOD , destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

verses.original: זְכֹר֙ לַ/עֲבָדֶ֔י/ךָ לְ/אַבְרָהָ֥ם לְ/יִצְחָ֖ק וּֽ/לְ/יַעֲקֹ֑ב אַל תֵּ֗פֶן אֶל קְשִׁי֙ הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/אֶל רִשְׁע֖/וֹ וְ/אֶל חַטָּאתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: zkhr l'bdykh l'brhm lytschq vly'qb 'l tpn 'l qshy h'm hzh v'l rsh'v v'l cht'tv
verses.translation: Remember thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:

verses.original: פֶּן יֹאמְר֗וּ הָ/אָרֶץ֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הוֹצֵאתָ֣/נוּ מִ/שָּׁם֒ מִ/בְּלִי֙ יְכֹ֣לֶת יְהוָ֔ה לַ/הֲבִיאָ֕/ם אֶל הָ/אָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֣ר לָ/הֶ֑ם וּ/מִ/שִּׂנְאָת֣/וֹ אוֹתָ֔/ם הוֹצִיאָ֖/ם לַ/הֲמִתָ֥/ם בַּ/מִּדְבָּֽר
verses.translit: pn y'mrv h'rts 'shr hvts'tnv mshm mbly ykhlt yhvh lhby'm 'l h'rts 'shr dbr lhm vmshn'tv 'vtm hvtsy'm lhmtm bmdbr
verses.translation: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say, Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.

verses.original: וְ/הֵ֥ם עַמְּ/ךָ֖ וְ/נַחֲלָתֶ֑/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הוֹצֵ֨אתָ֙ בְּ/כֹחֲ/ךָ֣ הַ/גָּדֹ֔ל וּ/בִֽ/זְרֹעֲ/ךָ֖ הַ/נְּטוּיָֽה
verses.translit: vhm 'mkh vnchltkh 'shr hvts't bkhchkh hgdl vbzr'kh hntvyh
verses.translation: Yet they are thy people and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest out by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm.

verses.original: בָּ/עֵ֨ת הַ/הִ֜וא אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֣ה אֵלַ֗/י פְּסָל לְ/ךָ֞ שְׁנֵֽי לֻוחֹ֤ת אֲבָנִים֙ כָּ/רִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים וַ/עֲלֵ֥ה אֵלַ֖/י הָ/הָ֑רָ/ה וְ/עָשִׂ֥יתָ לְּ/ךָ֖ אֲר֥וֹן עֵֽץ
verses.translit: b't hhv' 'mr yhvh 'ly psl lkh shny lvcht 'bnym khr'shnym v'lh 'ly hhrh v'shyt lkh 'rvn 'ts
verses.translation: At that time the LORD said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.

verses.original: וְ/אֶכְתֹּב֙ עַל הַ/לֻּחֹ֔ת אֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֛וּ עַל הַ/לֻּחֹ֥ת הָ/רִאשֹׁנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר שִׁבַּ֑רְתָּ וְ/שַׂמְתָּ֖/ם בָּ/אָרֽוֹן
verses.translit: v'khtb 'l hlcht 't hdbrym 'shr hyv 'l hlcht hr'shnym 'shr shbrt vshmtm b'rvn
verses.translation: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.

verses.original: וָ/אַ֤עַשׂ אֲרוֹן֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וָ/אֶפְסֹ֛ל שְׁנֵי לֻחֹ֥ת אֲבָנִ֖ים כָּ/רִאשֹׁנִ֑ים וָ/אַ֣עַל הָ/הָ֔רָ/ה וּ/שְׁנֵ֥י הַ/לֻּחֹ֖ת בְּ/יָדִֽ/י
verses.translit: v''sh 'rvn 'tsy shtym v'psl shny lcht 'bnym khr'shnym v''l hhrh vshny hlcht bydy
verses.translation: And I made an ark of shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in mine hand.

verses.original: וַ/יִּכְתֹּ֨ב עַֽל הַ/לֻּחֹ֜ת כַּ/מִּכְתָּ֣ב הָ/רִאשׁ֗וֹן אֵ֚ת עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת הַ/דְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֲלֵי/כֶ֥ם בָּ/הָ֛ר מִ/תּ֥וֹךְ הָ/אֵ֖שׁ בְּ/י֣וֹם הַ/קָּהָ֑ל וַ/יִּתְּנֵ֥/ם יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָֽ/י
verses.translit: vykhtb 'l hlcht khmkhtb hr'shvn 't 'shrt hdbrym 'shr dbr yhvh 'lykhm bhr mtvkh h'sh byvm hqhl vytnm yhvh 'ly
verses.translation: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and the LORD gave them unto me.

verses.original: וָ/אֵ֗פֶן וָֽ/אֵרֵד֙ מִן הָ/הָ֔ר וָֽ/אָשִׂם֙ אֶת הַ/לֻּחֹ֔ת בָּ/אָר֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑יתִי וַ/יִּ֣הְיוּ שָׁ֔ם כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוַּ֖/נִי יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'pn v'rd mn hhr v'shm 't hlcht b'rvn 'shr 'shyty vyhyv shm kh'shr tsvny yhvh
verses.translation: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as the LORD commanded me.

verses.original: וּ/בְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נָֽסְע֛וּ מִ/בְּאֵרֹ֥ת בְּנֵי יַעֲקָ֖ן מוֹסֵרָ֑ה שָׁ֣ם מֵ֤ת אַהֲרֹן֙ וַ/יִּקָּבֵ֣ר שָׁ֔ם וַ/יְכַהֵ֛ן אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בְּנ֖/וֹ תַּחְתָּֽי/ו
verses.translit: vbny yshr'l ns'v mb'rt bny y'qn mvsrh shm mt 'hrn vyqbr shm vykhhn 'l'zr bnv tchtyv
verses.translation: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his stead.

verses.original: מִ/שָּׁ֥ם נָסְע֖וּ הַ/גֻּדְגֹּ֑דָ/ה וּ/מִן הַ/גֻּדְגֹּ֣דָ/ה יָטְבָ֔תָה אֶ֖רֶץ נַ֥חֲלֵי מָֽיִם
verses.translit: mshm ns'v hgdgdh vmn hgdgdh ytbth 'rts nchly mym
verses.translation: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters.

verses.original: בָּ/עֵ֣ת הַ/הִ֗וא הִבְדִּ֤יל יְהוָה֙ אֶת שֵׁ֣בֶט הַ/לֵּוִ֔י לָ/שֵׂ֖את אֶת אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית יְהוָ֑ה לַ/עֲמֹד֩ לִ/פְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֤ה לְ/שָֽׁרְת/וֹ֙ וּ/לְ/בָרֵ֣ךְ בִּ/שְׁמ֔/וֹ עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: b't hhv' hbdyl yhvh 't shbt hlvy lsh't 't 'rvn bryt yhvh l'md lpny yhvh lshrtv vlbrkh bshmv 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD , to stand before the LORD to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֞ן לֹֽא הָיָ֧ה לְ/לֵוִ֛י חֵ֥לֶק וְ/נַחֲלָ֖ה עִם אֶחָ֑י/ו יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָת֔/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: 'l khn l' hyh llvy chlq vnchlh 'm 'chyv yhvh hv' nchltv kh'shr dbr yhvh 'lhykh lv
verses.translation: Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren; the LORD is his inheritance, according as the LORD thy God promised him.

verses.original: וְ/אָנֹכִ֞י עָמַ֣דְתִּי בָ/הָ֗ר כַּ/יָּמִים֙ הָ/רִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְ/אַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָ֑יְלָה וַ/יִּשְׁמַ֨ע יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗/י גַּ֚ם בַּ/פַּ֣עַם הַ/הִ֔וא לֹא אָבָ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה הַשְׁחִיתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'nkhy 'mdty bhr khymym hr'shnym 'rb'ym yvm v'rb'ym lylh vyshm' yhvh 'ly gm bp'm hhv' l' 'bh yhvh hshchytkh
verses.translation: And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also, and the LORD would not destroy thee.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔/י ק֛וּם לֵ֥ךְ לְ/מַסַּ֖ע לִ/פְנֵ֣י הָ/עָ֑ם וְ/יָבֹ֨אוּ֙ וְ/יִֽרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי לַ/אֲבֹתָ֖/ם לָ/תֵ֥ת לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly qvm lkh lms' lpny h'm vyb'v vyrshv 't h'rts 'shr nshb'ty l'btm ltt lhm
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, take thy journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.

verses.original: וְ/עַתָּה֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מָ֚ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ שֹׁאֵ֖ל מֵ/עִמָּ֑/ךְ כִּ֣י אִם לְ֠/יִרְאָה אֶת יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜י/ךָ לָ/לֶ֤כֶת בְּ/כָל דְּרָכָי/ו֙ וּ/לְ/אַהֲבָ֣ה אֹת֔/וֹ וְ/לַֽ/עֲבֹד֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/כָל לְבָבְ/ךָ֖ וּ/בְ/כָל נַפְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'th yshr'l mh yhvh 'lhykh sh'l m'mkh khy 'm lyr'h 't yhvh 'lhykh llkht bkhl drkhyv vl'hbh 'tv vl'bd 't yhvh 'lhykh bkhl lbbkh vbkhl npshkh
verses.translation: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God require of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,

verses.original: לִ/שְׁמֹ֞ר אֶת מִצְוֺ֤ת יְהוָה֙ וְ/אֶת חֻקֹּתָ֔י/ו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֖ הַ/יּ֑וֹם לְ/ט֖וֹב לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: lshmr 't mtsvt yhvh v't chqtyv 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm ltvb lkh
verses.translation: To keep the commandments of the LORD , and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?

verses.original: הֵ֚ן לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם וּ/שְׁמֵ֣י הַ/שָּׁמָ֑יִם הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וְ/כָל אֲשֶׁר בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: hn lyhvh 'lhykh hshmym vshmy hshmym h'rts vkhl 'shr bh
verses.translation: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens is the LORD’s thy God, the earth also , with all that therein is .

verses.original: רַ֧ק בַּ/אֲבֹתֶ֛י/ךָ חָשַׁ֥ק יְהוָ֖ה לְ/אַהֲבָ֣ה אוֹתָ֑/ם וַ/יִּבְחַ֞ר בְּ/זַרְעָ֣/ם אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֗ם בָּ/כֶ֛ם מִ/כָּל הָ/עַמִּ֖ים כַּ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּה
verses.translit: rq b'btykh chshq yhvh l'hbh 'vtm vybchr bzr'm 'chryhm bkhm mkhl h'mym khyvm hzh
verses.translation: Only the LORD had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, even you above all people, as it is this day.

verses.original: וּ/מַלְתֶּ֕ם אֵ֖ת עָרְלַ֣ת לְבַבְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/עָ֨רְפְּ/כֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תַקְשׁ֖וּ עֽוֹד
verses.translit: vmltm 't 'rlt lbbkhm v'rpkhm l' tqshv 'vd
verses.translation: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.

verses.original: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם ה֚וּא אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָֽ/אֱלֹהִ֔ים וַ/אֲדֹנֵ֖י הָ/אֲדֹנִ֑ים הָ/אֵ֨ל הַ/גָּדֹ֤ל הַ/גִּבֹּר֙ וְ/הַ/נּוֹרָ֔א אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹא יִשָּׂ֣א פָנִ֔ים וְ/לֹ֥א יִקַּ֖ח שֹֽׁחַד
verses.translit: khy yhvh 'lhykhm hv' 'lhy h'lhym v'dny h'dnym h'l hgdl hgbr vhnvr' 'shr l' ysh' pnym vl' yqch shchd
verses.translation: For the LORD your God is God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward:

verses.original: עֹשֶׂ֛ה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט יָת֖וֹם וְ/אַלְמָנָ֑ה וְ/אֹהֵ֣ב גֵּ֔ר לָ֥/תֶת ל֖/וֹ לֶ֥חֶם וְ/שִׂמְלָֽה
verses.translit: 'shh mshpt ytvm v'lmnh v'hb gr ltt lv lchm vshmlh
verses.translation: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.

verses.original: וַ/אֲהַבְתֶּ֖ם אֶת הַ/גֵּ֑ר כִּֽי גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: v'hbtm 't hgr khy grym hyytm b'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: Love ye therefore the stranger: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.

verses.original: אֶת יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛י/ךָ תִּירָ֖א אֹת֣/וֹ תַעֲבֹ֑ד וּ/ב֣/וֹ תִדְבָּ֔ק וּ/בִ/שְׁמ֖/וֹ תִּשָּׁבֵֽעַ
verses.translit: 't yhvh 'lhykh tyr' 'tv t'bd vbv tdbq vbshmv tshb'
verses.translation: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God; him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.

verses.original: ה֥וּא תְהִלָּתְ/ךָ֖ וְ/ה֣וּא אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂ֣ה אִתְּ/ךָ֗ אֶת הַ/גְּדֹלֹ֤ת וְ/אֶת הַ/נּֽוֹרָאֹת֙ הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָא֖וּ עֵינֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: hv' thltkh vhv' 'lhykh 'shr 'shh 'tkh 't hgdlt v't hnvr't h'lh 'shr r'v 'ynykh
verses.translation: He is thy praise, and he is thy God, that hath done for thee these great and terrible things, which thine eyes have seen.

verses.original: בְּ/שִׁבְעִ֣ים נֶ֔פֶשׁ יָרְד֥וּ אֲבֹתֶ֖י/ךָ מִצְרָ֑יְמָ/הּ וְ/עַתָּ֗ה שָֽׂמְ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ כְּ/כוֹכְבֵ֥י הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם לָ/רֹֽב
verses.translit: bshb'ym npsh yrdv 'btykh mtsrymh v'th shmkh yhvh 'lhykh khkhvkhby hshmym lrb
verses.translation: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now the LORD thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.

verses.original: וְ/אָ֣הַבְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/שָׁמַרְתָּ֣ מִשְׁמַרְתּ֗/וֹ וְ/חֻקֹּתָ֧י/ו וּ/מִשְׁפָּטָ֛י/ו וּ/מִצְוֺתָ֖י/ו כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: v'hbt 't yhvh 'lhykh vshmrt mshmrtv vchqtyv vmshptyv vmtsvtyv khl hymym
verses.translation: Therefore thou shalt love the LORD thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his judgments, and his commandments, alway.

verses.original: וִֽ/ידַעְתֶּם֮ הַ/יּוֹם֒ כִּ֣י לֹ֣א אֶת בְּנֵי/כֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא יָדְעוּ֙ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא רָא֔וּ אֶת מוּסַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֑ם אֶת גָּדְל֕/וֹ אֶת יָד/וֹ֙ הַ/חֲזָקָ֔ה וּ/זְרֹע֖/וֹ הַ/נְּטוּיָֽה
verses.translit: vyd'tm hyvm khy l' 't bnykhm 'shr l' yd'v v'shr l' r'v 't mvsr yhvh 'lhykhm 't gdlv 't ydv hchzqh vzr'v hntvyh
verses.translation: And know ye this day: for I speak not with your children which have not known, and which have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, and his stretched out arm,

verses.original: וְ/אֶת אֹֽתֹתָי/ו֙ וְ/אֶֽת מַעֲשָׂ֔י/ו אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם לְ/פַרְעֹ֥ה מֶֽלֶךְ מִצְרַ֖יִם וּ/לְ/כָל אַרְצֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v't 'ttyv v't m'shyv 'shr 'shh btvkh mtsrym lpr'h mlkh mtsrym vlkhl 'rtsv
verses.translation: And his miracles, and his acts, which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and unto all his land;

verses.original: וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂה֩ לְ/חֵ֨יל מִצְרַ֜יִם לְ/סוּסָ֣י/ו וּ/לְ/רִכְבּ֗/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֵצִ֜יף אֶת מֵ֤י יַם סוּף֙ עַל פְּנֵי/הֶ֔ם בְּ/רָדְפָ֖/ם אַחֲרֵי/כֶ֑ם וַ/יְאַבְּדֵ֣/ם יְהוָ֔ה עַ֖ד הַ/יּ֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: v'shr 'shh lchyl mtsrym lsvsyv vlrkhbv 'shr htsyf 't my ym svf 'l pnyhm brdpm 'chrykhm vy'bdm yhvh 'd hyvm hzh
verses.translation: And what he did unto the army of Egypt, unto their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and how the LORD hath destroyed them unto this day;

verses.original: וַ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֛ה לָ/כֶ֖ם בַּ/מִּדְבָּ֑ר עַד בֹּאֲ/כֶ֖ם עַד הַ/מָּק֥וֹם הַ/זֶּֽה
verses.translit: v'shr 'shh lkhm bmdbr 'd b'khm 'd hmqvm hzh
verses.translation: And what he did unto you in the wilderness, until ye came into this place;

verses.original: וַ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה לְ/דָתָ֣ן וְ/לַ/אֲבִירָ֗ם בְּנֵ֣י אֱלִיאָב֮ בֶּן רְאוּבֵן֒ אֲשֶׁ֨ר פָּצְתָ֤ה הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ אֶת פִּ֔י/הָ וַ/תִּבְלָעֵ֥/ם וְ/אֶת בָּתֵּי/הֶ֖ם וְ/אֶת אָהֳלֵי/הֶ֑ם וְ/אֵ֤ת כָּל הַ/יְקוּם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/רַגְלֵי/הֶ֔ם בְּ/קֶ֖רֶב כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: v'shr 'shh ldtn vl'byrm bny 'ly'b bn r'vbn 'shr ptsth h'rts 't pyh vtbl'm v't btyhm v't 'hlyhm v't khl hyqvm 'shr brglyhm bqrb khl yshr'l
verses.translation: And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the substance that was in their possession, in the midst of all Israel:

verses.original: כִּ֤י עֵֽינֵי/כֶם֙ הָֽ/רֹאֹ֔ת אֶת כָּל מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה הַ/גָּדֹ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֖ר עָשָֽׂה
verses.translit: khy 'ynykhm hr't 't khl m'shh yhvh hgdl 'shr 'shh
verses.translation: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the LORD which he did.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת כָּל הַ/מִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֖ הַ/יּ֑וֹם לְמַ֣עַן תֶּחֶזְק֗וּ וּ/בָאתֶם֙ וִֽ/ירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּ/ה לְ/רִשְׁתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vshmrtm 't khl hmtsvh 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm lm'n tchzqv vb'tm vyrshtm 't h'rts 'shr 'tm 'brym shmh lrshth
verses.translation: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day, that ye may be strong, and go in and possess the land, whither ye go to possess it;

verses.original: וּ/לְמַ֨עַן תַּאֲרִ֤יכוּ יָמִים֙ עַל הָ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁבַּ֨ע יְהוָ֧ה לַ/אֲבֹתֵי/כֶ֛ם לָ/תֵ֥ת לָ/הֶ֖ם וּ/לְ/זַרְעָ֑/ם אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּ/דְבָֽשׁ
verses.translit: vlm'n t'rykhv ymym 'l h'dmh 'shr nshb' yhvh l'btykhm ltt lhm vlzr'm 'rts zbt chlb vdbsh
verses.translation: And that ye may prolong your days in the land, which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed, a land that floweth with milk and honey.

verses.original: כִּ֣י הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֤ה בָא שָׁ֨מָּ/ה֙ לְ/רִשְׁתָּ֔/הּ לֹ֣א כְ/אֶ֤רֶץ מִצְרַ֨יִם֙ הִ֔וא אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְצָאתֶ֖ם מִ/שָּׁ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר תִּזְרַע֙ אֶֽת זַרְעֲ/ךָ֔ וְ/הִשְׁקִ֥יתָ בְ/רַגְלְ/ךָ֖ כְּ/גַ֥ן הַ/יָּרָֽק
verses.translit: khy h'rts 'shr 'th b' shmh lrshth l' kh'rts mtsrym hv' 'shr yts'tm mshm 'shr tzr' 't zr'kh vhshqyt brglkh khgn hyrq
verses.translation: For the land, whither thou goest in to possess it, is not as the land of Egypt, from whence ye came out, where thou sowedst thy seed, and wateredst it with thy foot, as a garden of herbs:

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתֶּ֜ם עֹבְרִ֥ים שָׁ֨מָּ/ה֙ לְ/רִשְׁתָּ֔/הּ אֶ֥רֶץ הָרִ֖ים וּ/בְקָעֹ֑ת לִ/מְטַ֥ר הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם תִּשְׁתֶּה מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: vh'rts 'shr 'tm 'brym shmh lrshth 'rts hrym vbq't lmtr hshmym tshth mym
verses.translation: But the land, whither ye go to possess it, is a land of hills and valleys, and drinketh water of the rain of heaven:

verses.original: אֶ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ דֹּרֵ֣שׁ אֹתָ֑/הּ תָּמִ֗יד עֵינֵ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ בָּ֔/הּ מֵֽ/רֵשִׁית֙ הַ/שָּׁנָ֔ה וְ/עַ֖ד אַחֲרִ֥ית שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: 'rts 'shr yhvh 'lhykh drsh 'th tmyd 'yny yhvh 'lhykh bh mrshyt hshnh v'd 'chryt shnh
verses.translation: A land which the LORD thy God careth for: the eyes of the LORD thy God are always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה אִם שָׁמֹ֤עַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל מִצְוֺתַ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם הַ/יּ֑וֹם לְ/אַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶם֙ וּ/לְ/עָבְד֔/וֹ בְּ/כָל לְבַבְ/כֶ֖ם וּ/בְ/כָל נַפְשְׁ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhyh 'm shm' tshm'v 'l mtsvty 'shr 'nkhy mtsvh 'tkhm hyvm l'hbh 't yhvh 'lhykhm vl'bdv bkhl lbbkhm vbkhl npshkhm
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, if ye shall hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day, to love the LORD your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתִּ֧י מְטַֽר אַרְצְ/כֶ֛ם בְּ/עִתּ֖/וֹ יוֹרֶ֣ה וּ/מַלְק֑וֹשׁ וְ/אָסַפְתָּ֣ דְגָנֶ֔/ךָ וְ/תִֽירֹשְׁ/ךָ֖ וְ/יִצְהָרֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vntty mtr 'rtskhm b'tv yvrh vmlqvsh v'spt dgnkh vtyrshkh vytshrkh
verses.translation: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil.

verses.translit: vntty 'shb bshdkh lbhmtkh v'khlt vshb't
verses.translation: And I will send grass in thy fields for thy cattle, that thou mayest eat and be full.

verses.original: הִשָּֽׁמְר֣וּ לָ/כֶ֔ם פֶּ֥ן יִפְתֶּ֖ה לְבַבְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/סַרְתֶּ֗ם וַ/עֲבַדְתֶּם֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְ/הִשְׁתַּחֲוִיתֶ֖ם לָ/הֶֽם
verses.translit: hshmrv lkhm pn ypth lbbkhm vsrtm v'bdtm 'lhym 'chrym vhshtchvytm lhm
verses.translation: Take heed to yourselves, that your heart be not deceived, and ye turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship them;

verses.original: וְ/חָרָ֨ה אַף יְהוָ֜ה בָּ/כֶ֗ם וְ/עָצַ֤ר אֶת הַ/שָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ וְ/לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֣ה מָטָ֔ר וְ/הָ֣/אֲדָמָ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתֵּ֖ן אֶת יְבוּלָ֑/הּ וַ/אֲבַדְתֶּ֣ם מְהֵרָ֗ה מֵ/עַל֙ הָ/אָ֣רֶץ הַ/טֹּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה נֹתֵ֥ן לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vchrh 'f yhvh bkhm v'tsr 't hshmym vl' yhyh mtr vh'dmh l' ttn 't ybvlh v'bdtm mhrh m'l h'rts htbh 'shr yhvh ntn lkhm
verses.translation: And then the LORD’s wrath be kindled against you, and he shut up the heaven, that there be no rain, and that the land yield not her fruit; and lest ye perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD giveth you.

verses.original: וְ/שַׂמְתֶּם֙ אֶת דְּבָרַ֣/י אֵ֔לֶּה עַל לְבַבְ/כֶ֖ם וְ/עַֽל נַפְשְׁ/כֶ֑ם וּ/קְשַׁרְתֶּ֨ם אֹתָ֤/ם לְ/אוֹת֙ עַל יֶדְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/הָי֥וּ לְ/טוֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vshmtm 't dbry 'lh 'l lbbkhm v'l npshkhm vqshrtm 'tm l'vt 'l ydkhm vhyv ltvtpt byn 'ynykhm
verses.translation: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.

verses.translit: vlmdtm 'tm 't bnykhm ldbr bm bshbtkh bbytkh vblkhtkh bdrkh vbshkhbkh vbqvmkh
verses.translation: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.

verses.original: וּ/כְתַבְתָּ֛/ם עַל מְזוּז֥וֹת בֵּיתֶ֖/ךָ וּ/בִ/שְׁעָרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vkhtbtm 'l mzvzvt bytkh vbsh'rykh
verses.translation: And thou shalt write them upon the door posts of thine house, and upon thy gates:

verses.original: לְמַ֨עַן יִרְבּ֤וּ יְמֵי/כֶם֙ וִ/ימֵ֣י בְנֵי/כֶ֔ם עַ֚ל הָֽ/אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע יְהוָ֛ה לַ/אֲבֹתֵי/כֶ֖ם לָ/תֵ֣ת לָ/הֶ֑ם כִּ/ימֵ֥י הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם עַל הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: lm'n yrbv ymykhm vymy bnykhm 'l h'dmh 'shr nshb' yhvh l'btykhm ltt lhm khymy hshmym 'l h'rts
verses.translation: That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.

verses.original: כִּי֩ אִם שָׁמֹ֨ר תִּשְׁמְר֜וּ/ן אֶת כָּל הַ/מִּצְוָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֗את אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם לַ/עֲשֹׂתָ֑/הּ לְ/אַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֛ם לָ/לֶ֥כֶת בְּ/כָל דְּרָכָ֖י/ו וּ/לְ/דָבְקָה בֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy 'm shmr tshmrvn 't khl hmtsvh hz't 'shr 'nkhy mtsvh 'tkhm l'shth l'hbh 't yhvh 'lhykhm llkht bkhl drkhyv vldbqh bv
verses.translation: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you, to do them, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cleave unto him;

verses.original: וְ/הוֹרִ֧ישׁ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת כָּל הַ/גּוֹיִ֥ם הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה מִ/לִּ/פְנֵי/כֶ֑ם וִֽ/ירִשְׁתֶּ֣ם גּוֹיִ֔ם גְּדֹלִ֥ים וַ/עֲצֻמִ֖ים מִ/כֶּֽם
verses.translit: vhvrysh yhvh 't khl hgvym h'lh mlpnykhm vyrshtm gvym gdlym v'tsmym mkhm
verses.translation: Then will the LORD drive out all these nations from before you, and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves.

verses.original: כָּל הַ/מָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּדְרֹ֧ךְ כַּֽף רַגְלְ/כֶ֛ם בּ֖/וֹ לָ/כֶ֣ם יִהְיֶ֑ה מִן הַ/מִּדְבָּ֨ר וְ/הַ/לְּבָנ֜וֹן מִן הַ/נָּהָ֣ר נְהַר פְּרָ֗ת וְ/עַד֙ הַ/יָּ֣ם הָֽ/אַחֲר֔וֹן יִהְיֶ֖ה גְּבֻלְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khl hmqvm 'shr tdrkh khf rglkhm bv lkhm yhyh mn hmdbr vhlbnvn mn hnhr nhr prt v'd hym h'chrvn yhyh gblkhm
verses.translation: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be.

verses.original: לֹא יִתְיַצֵּ֥ב אִ֖ישׁ בִּ/פְנֵי/כֶ֑ם פַּחְדְּ/כֶ֨ם וּ/מֽוֹרַאֲ/כֶ֜ם יִתֵּ֣ן יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֗ם עַל פְּנֵ֤י כָל הָ/אָ֨רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּדְרְכוּ בָ֔/הּ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: l' ytytsb 'ysh bpnykhm pchdkhm vmvr'khm ytn yhvh 'lhykhm 'l pny khl h'rts 'shr tdrkhv bh kh'shr dbr lkhm
verses.translation: There shall no man be able to stand before you: for the LORD your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon, as he hath said unto you.

verses.original: רְאֵ֗ה אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֖ם הַ/יּ֑וֹם בְּרָכָ֖ה וּ/קְלָלָֽה
verses.translit: r'h 'nkhy ntn lpnykhm hyvm brkhh vqllh
verses.translation: Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse;

verses.original: אֶֽת הַ/בְּרָכָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁמְע֗וּ אֶל מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: 't hbrkhh 'shr tshm'v 'l mtsvt yhvh 'lhykhm 'shr 'nkhy mtsvh 'tkhm hyvm
verses.translation: A blessing, if ye obey the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you this day:

verses.original: וְ/הַ/קְּלָלָ֗ה אִם לֹ֤א תִשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶל מִצְוֺת֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/סַרְתֶּ֣ם מִן הַ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְ/כֶ֖ם הַ/יּ֑וֹם לָ/לֶ֗כֶת אַחֲרֵ֛י אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא יְדַעְתֶּֽם
verses.translit: vhqllh 'm l' tshm'v 'l mtsvt yhvh 'lhykhm vsrtm mn hdrkh 'shr 'nkhy mtsvh 'tkhm hyvm llkht 'chry 'lhym 'chrym 'shr l' yd'tm
verses.translation: And a curse, if ye will not obey the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which ye have not known.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה כִּ֤י יְבִֽיאֲ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ אֶל הָ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה בָא שָׁ֖מָּ/ה לְ/רִשְׁתָּ֑/הּ וְ/נָתַתָּ֤ה אֶת הַ/בְּרָכָה֙ עַל הַ֣ר גְּרִזִ֔ים וְ/אֶת הַ/קְּלָלָ֖ה עַל הַ֥ר עֵיבָֽל
verses.translit: vhyh khy yby'kh yhvh 'lhykh 'l h'rts 'shr 'th b' shmh lrshth vntth 't hbrkhh 'l hr grzym v't hqllh 'l hr 'ybl
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it, that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.

verses.original: הֲ/לֹא הֵ֜מָּה בְּ/עֵ֣בֶר הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֗ן אַֽחֲרֵי֙ דֶּ֚רֶךְ מְב֣וֹא הַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ בְּ/אֶ֨רֶץ֙ הַֽ/כְּנַעֲנִ֔י הַ/יֹּשֵׁ֖ב בָּ/עֲרָבָ֑ה מ֚וּל הַ/גִּלְגָּ֔ל אֵ֖צֶל אֵלוֹנֵ֥י מֹרֶֽה
verses.translit: hl' hmh b'br hyrdn 'chry drkh mbv' hshmsh b'rts hkhn'ny hyshb b'rbh mvl hglgl 'tsl 'lvny mrh
verses.translation: Are they not on the other side Jordan, by the way where the sun goeth down, in the land of the Canaanites, which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh?

verses.original: כִּ֤י אַתֶּם֙ עֹבְרִ֣ים אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֔ן לָ/בֹא֙ לָ/רֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֖ם נֹתֵ֣ן לָ/כֶ֑ם וִֽ/ירִשְׁתֶּ֥ם אֹתָ֖/הּ וִֽ/ישַׁבְתֶּם בָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: khy 'tm 'brym 't hyrdn lb' lrsht 't h'rts 'shr yhvh 'lhykhm ntn lkhm vyrshtm 'th vyshbtm bh
verses.translation: For ye shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God giveth you, and ye shall possess it, and dwell therein.

verses.original: וּ/שְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם לַ/עֲשׂ֔וֹת אֵ֥ת כָּל הַֽ/חֻקִּ֖ים וְ/אֶת הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י נֹתֵ֥ן לִ/פְנֵי/כֶ֖ם הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vshmrtm l'shvt 't khl hchqym v't hmshptym 'shr 'nkhy ntn lpnykhm hyvm
verses.translation: And ye shall observe to do all the statutes and judgments which I set before you this day.

verses.original: אֵ֠לֶּה הַֽ/חֻקִּ֣ים וְ/הַ/מִּשְׁפָּטִים֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּשְׁמְר֣וּ/ן לַ/עֲשׂוֹת֒ בָּ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֧י אֲבֹתֶ֛י/ךָ לְ/ךָ֖ לְ/רִשְׁתָּ֑/הּ כָּל הַ/יָּמִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר אַתֶּ֥ם חַיִּ֖ים עַל הָ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: 'lh hchqym vhmshptym 'shr tshmrvn l'shvt b'rts 'shr ntn yhvh 'lhy 'btykh lkh lrshth khl hymym 'shr 'tm chyym 'l h'dmh
verses.translation: These are the statutes and judgments, which ye shall observe to do in the land, which the LORD God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth.

verses.original: אַבֵּ֣ד תְּ֠אַבְּדוּ/ן אֶֽת כָּל הַ/מְּקֹמ֞וֹת אֲשֶׁ֧ר עָֽבְדוּ שָׁ֣ם הַ/גּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם יֹרְשִׁ֥ים אֹתָ֖/ם אֶת אֱלֹהֵי/הֶ֑ם עַל הֶ/הָרִ֤ים הָֽ/רָמִים֙ וְ/עַל הַ/גְּבָע֔וֹת וְ/תַ֖חַת כָּל עֵ֥ץ רַעֲנָן
verses.translit: 'bd t'bdvn 't khl hmqmvt 'shr 'bdv shm hgvym 'shr 'tm yrshym 'tm 't 'lhyhm 'l hhrym hrmym v'l hgb'vt vtcht khl 'ts r'nn
verses.translation: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree:

verses.original: וְ/נִתַּצְתֶּ֣ם אֶת מִזְבּחֹתָ֗/ם וְ/שִׁבַּרְתֶּם֙ אֶת מַצֵּ֣בֹתָ֔/ם וַ/אֲשֵֽׁרֵי/הֶם֙ תִּשְׂרְפ֣וּ/ן בָּ/אֵ֔שׁ וּ/פְסִילֵ֥י אֱלֹֽהֵי/הֶ֖ם תְּגַדֵּע֑וּ/ן וְ/אִבַּדְתֶּ֣ם אֶת שְׁמָ֔/ם מִן הַ/מָּק֖וֹם הַ/הֽוּא
verses.translit: vnttstm 't mzbchtm vshbrtm 't mtsbtm v'shryhm tshrpvn b'sh vpsyly 'lhyhm tgd'vn v'bdtm 't shmm mn hmqvm hhv'
verses.translation: And ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods, and destroy the names of them out of that place.

verses.original: לֹֽא תַעֲשׂ֣וּ/ן כֵּ֔ן לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: l' t'shvn khn lyhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: Ye shall not do so unto the LORD your God.

verses.original: כִּ֠י אִֽם אֶל הַ/מָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶם֙ מִ/כָּל שִׁבְטֵי/כֶ֔ם לָ/שׂ֥וּם אֶת שְׁמ֖/וֹ שָׁ֑ם לְ/שִׁכְנ֥/וֹ תִדְרְשׁ֖וּ וּ/בָ֥אתָ שָֽׁמָּ/ה
verses.translit: khy 'm 'l hmqvm 'shr ybchr yhvh 'lhykhm mkhl shbtykhm lshvm 't shmv shm lshkhnv tdrshv vb't shmh
verses.translation: But unto the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there, even unto his habitation shall ye seek, and thither thou shalt come:

verses.original: וַ/הֲבֵאתֶ֣ם שָׁ֗מָּ/ה עֹלֹֽתֵי/כֶם֙ וְ/זִבְחֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/אֵת֙ מַעְשְׂרֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/אֵ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת יֶדְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/נִדְרֵי/כֶם֙ וְ/נִדְבֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם וּ/בְכֹרֹ֥ת בְּקַרְ/כֶ֖ם וְ/צֹאנְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vhb'tm shmh 'ltykhm vzbchykhm v't m'shrtykhm v't trvmt ydkhm vndrykhm vndbtykhm vbkhrt bqrkhm vts'nkhm
verses.translation: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offerings of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks:

verses.original: וַ/אֲכַלְתֶּם שָׁ֗ם לִ/פְנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם וּ/שְׂמַחְתֶּ֗ם בְּ/כֹל֙ מִשְׁלַ֣ח יֶדְ/כֶ֔ם אַתֶּ֖ם וּ/בָתֵּי/כֶ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בֵּֽרַכְ/ךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: v'khltm shm lpny yhvh 'lhykhm vshmchtm bkhl mshlch ydkhm 'tm vbtykhm 'shr brkhkh yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: And there ye shall eat before the LORD your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto, ye and your households, wherein the LORD thy God hath blessed thee.

verses.original: לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ/ן כְּ֠/כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲנַ֧חְנוּ עֹשִׂ֛ים פֹּ֖ה הַ/יּ֑וֹם אִ֖ישׁ כָּל הַ/יָּשָׁ֥ר בְּ/עֵינָֽי/ו
verses.translit: l' t'shvn khkhl 'shr 'nchnv 'shym ph hyvm 'ysh khl hyshr b'ynyv
verses.translation: Ye shall not do after all the things that we do here this day, every man whatsoever is right in his own eyes.

verses.original: כִּ֥י לֹא בָּאתֶ֖ם עַד עָ֑תָּה אֶל הַ/מְּנוּחָה֙ וְ/אֶל הַֽ/נַּחֲלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: khy l' b'tm 'd 'th 'l hmnvchh v'l hnchlh 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh
verses.translation: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which the LORD your God giveth you.

verses.original: וַ/עֲבַרְתֶּם֮ אֶת הַ/יַּרְדֵּן֒ וִֽ/ישַׁבְתֶּ֣ם בָּ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֖ם מַנְחִ֣יל אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם וְ/הֵנִ֨יחַ לָ/כֶ֧ם מִ/כָּל אֹיְבֵי/כֶ֛ם מִ/סָּבִ֖יב וִֽ/ישַׁבְתֶּם בֶּֽטַח
verses.translit: v'brtm 't hyrdn vyshbtm b'rts 'shr yhvh 'lhykhm mnchyl 'tkhm vhnych lkhm mkhl 'ybykhm msbyb vyshbtm btch
verses.translation: But when ye go over Jordan, and dwell in the land which the LORD your God giveth you to inherit, and when he giveth you rest from all your enemies round about, so that ye dwell in safety;

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה הַ/מָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֥ם בּ/וֹ֙ לְ/שַׁכֵּ֤ן שְׁמ/וֹ֙ שָׁ֔ם שָׁ֣מָּ/ה תָבִ֔יאוּ אֵ֛ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְ/כֶ֑ם עוֹלֹתֵי/כֶ֣ם וְ/זִבְחֵי/כֶ֗ם מַעְשְׂרֹֽתֵי/כֶם֙ וּ/תְרֻמַ֣ת יֶדְ/כֶ֔ם וְ/כֹל֙ מִבְחַ֣ר נִדְרֵי/כֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּדְּר֖וּ לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vhyh hmqvm 'shr ybchr yhvh 'lhykhm bv lshkhn shmv shm shmh tby'v 't khl 'shr 'nkhy mtsvh 'tkhm 'vltykhm vzbchykhm m'shrtykhm vtrmt ydkhm vkhl mbchr ndrykhm 'shr tdrv lyhvh
verses.translation: Then there shall be a place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there; thither shall ye bring all that I command you; your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which ye vow unto the LORD :

verses.original: וּ/שְׂמַחְתֶּ֗ם לִ/פְנֵי֮ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶם֒ אַתֶּ֗ם וּ/בְנֵי/כֶם֙ וּ/בְנֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם וְ/עַבְדֵי/כֶ֖ם וְ/אַמְהֹתֵי/כֶ֑ם וְ/הַ/לֵּוִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/שַֽׁעֲרֵי/כֶ֔ם כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין ל֛/וֹ חֵ֥לֶק וְ/נַחֲלָ֖ה אִתְּ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vshmchtm lpny yhvh 'lhykhm 'tm vbnykhm vbntykhm v'bdykhm v'mhtykhm vhlvy 'shr bsh'rykhm khy 'yn lv chlq vnchlh 'tkhm
verses.translation: And ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, and your menservants, and your maidservants, and the Levite that is within your gates; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you.

verses.original: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְ/ךָ֔ פֶּֽן תַּעֲלֶ֖ה עֹלֹתֶ֑י/ךָ בְּ/כָל מָק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְאֶֽה
verses.translit: hshmr lkh pn t'lh 'ltykh bkhl mqvm 'shr tr'h
verses.translation: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt offerings in every place that thou seest:

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם בַּ/מָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ בְּ/אַחַ֣ד שְׁבָטֶ֔י/ךָ שָׁ֖ם תַּעֲלֶ֣ה עֹלֹתֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/שָׁ֣ם תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּֽ/ךָּ
verses.translit: khy 'm bmqvm 'shr ybchr yhvh b'chd shbtykh shm t'lh 'ltykh vshm t'shh khl 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh
verses.translation: But in the place which the LORD shall choose in one of thy tribes, there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, and there thou shalt do all that I command thee.

verses.original: רַק֩ בְּ/כָל אַוַּ֨ת נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֜ תִּזְבַּ֣ח וְ/אָכַלְתָּ֣ בָשָׂ֗ר כְּ/בִרְכַּ֨ת יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן לְ/ךָ֖ בְּ/כָל שְׁעָרֶ֑י/ךָ הַ/טָּמֵ֤א וְ/הַ/טָּהוֹר֙ יֹאכְלֶ֔/נּוּ כַּ/צְּבִ֖י וְ/כָ/אַיָּֽל
verses.translit: rq bkhl 'vt npshkh tzbch v'khlt bshr khbrkht yhvh 'lhykh 'shr ntn lkh bkhl sh'rykh htm' vhthvr y'khlnv khtsby vkh'yl
verses.translation: Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof, as of the roebuck, and as of the hart.

verses.original: רַ֥ק הַ/דָּ֖ם לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֑לוּ עַל הָ/אָ֥רֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶ֖/נּוּ כַּ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: rq hdm l' t'khlv 'l h'rts tshpkhnv khmym
verses.translation: Only ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water.

verses.original: לֹֽא תוּכַ֞ל לֶ/אֱכֹ֣ל בִּ/שְׁעָרֶ֗י/ךָ מַעְשַׂ֤ר דְּגָֽנְ/ךָ֙ וְ/תִֽירֹשְׁ/ךָ֣ וְ/יִצְהָרֶ֔/ךָ וּ/בְכֹרֹ֥ת בְּקָרְ/ךָ֖ וְ/צֹאנֶ֑/ךָ וְ/כָל נְדָרֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּדֹּ֔ר וְ/נִדְבֹתֶ֖י/ךָ וּ/תְרוּמַ֥ת יָדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: l' tvkhl l'khl bsh'rykh m'shr dgnkh vtyrshkh vytshrkh vbkhrt bqrkh vts'nkh vkhl ndrykh 'shr tdr vndbtykh vtrvmt ydkh
verses.translation: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:

verses.original: כִּ֡י אִם לִ/פְנֵי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜י/ךָ תֹּאכְלֶ֗/נּוּ בַּ/מָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִבְחַ֜ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶי/ךָ֮ בּ/וֹ֒ אַתָּ֨ה וּ/בִנְ/ךָ֤ וּ/בִתֶּ֨/ךָ֙ וְ/עַבְדְּ/ךָ֣ וַ/אֲמָתֶ֔/ךָ וְ/הַ/לֵּוִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּ/שְׁעָרֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/שָׂמַחְתָּ֗ לִ/פְנֵי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/כֹ֖ל מִשְׁלַ֥ח יָדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khy 'm lpny yhvh 'lhykh t'khlnv bmqvm 'shr ybchr yhvh 'lhykh bv 'th vbnkh vbtkh v'bdkh v'mtkh vhlvy 'shr bsh'rykh vshmcht lpny yhvh 'lhykh bkhl mshlch ydkh
verses.translation: But thou must eat them before the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that is within thy gates: and thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God in all that thou puttest thine hands unto.

verses.original: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְ/ךָ֔ פֶּֽן תַּעֲזֹ֖ב אֶת הַ/לֵּוִ֑י כָּל יָמֶ֖י/ךָ עַל אַדְמָתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: hshmr lkh pn t'zb 't hlvy khl ymykh 'l 'dmtkh
verses.translation: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth.

verses.original: כִּֽי יַרְחִיב֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֥י/ךָ אֶֽת גְּבֽוּלְ/ךָ֮ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּר לָ/ךְ֒ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֙ אֹכְלָ֣ה בָשָׂ֔ר כִּֽי תְאַוֶּ֥ה נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֖ לֶ/אֱכֹ֣ל בָּשָׂ֑ר בְּ/כָל אַוַּ֥ת נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֖ תֹּאכַ֥ל בָּשָֽׂר
verses.translit: khy yrchyb yhvh 'lhykh 't gbvlkh kh'shr dbr lkh v'mrt 'khlh bshr khy t'vh npshkh l'khl bshr bkhl 'vt npshkh t'khl bshr
verses.translation: When the LORD thy God shall enlarge thy border, as he hath promised thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh, because thy soul longeth to eat flesh; thou mayest eat flesh, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.

verses.original: כִּֽי יִרְחַ֨ק מִמְּ/ךָ֜ הַ/מָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִבְחַ֜ר יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶי/ךָ֮ לָ/שׂ֣וּם שְׁמ֣/וֹ שָׁם֒ וְ/זָבַחְתָּ֞ מִ/בְּקָרְ/ךָ֣ וּ/מִ/צֹּֽאנְ/ךָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן יְהוָה֙ לְ/ךָ֔ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוִּיתִ֑/ךָ וְ/אָֽכַלְתָּ֙ בִּ/שְׁעָרֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/כֹ֖ל אַוַּ֥ת נַפְשֶֽׁ/ךָ
verses.translit: khy yrchq mmkh hmqvm 'shr ybchr yhvh 'lhykh lshvm shmv shm vzbcht mbqrkh vmts'nkh 'shr ntn yhvh lkh kh'shr tsvytkh v'khlt bsh'rykh bkhl 'vt npshkh
verses.translation: If the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock, which the LORD hath given thee, as I have commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.

verses.original: אַ֗ךְ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֵאָכֵ֤ל אֶֽת הַ/צְּבִי֙ וְ/אֶת הָ֣/אַיָּ֔ל כֵּ֖ן תֹּאכְלֶ֑/נּוּ הַ/טָּמֵא֙ וְ/הַ/טָּה֔וֹר יַחְדָּ֖ו יֹאכְלֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 'kh kh'shr y'khl 't htsby v't h'yl khn t'khlnv htm' vhthvr ychdv y'khlnv
verses.translation: Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat them: the unclean and the clean shall eat of them alike.

verses.original: רַ֣ק חֲזַ֗ק לְ/בִלְתִּי֙ אֲכֹ֣ל הַ/דָּ֔ם כִּ֥י הַ/דָּ֖ם ה֣וּא הַ/נָּ֑פֶשׁ וְ/לֹא תֹאכַ֥ל הַ/נֶּ֖פֶשׁ עִם הַ/בָּשָֽׂר
verses.translit: rq chzq lblty 'khl hdm khy hdm hv' hnpsh vl' t'khl hnpsh 'm hbshr
verses.translation: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood: for the blood is the life; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh.

verses.original: לֹ֖א תֹּאכְלֶ֑/נּוּ עַל הָ/אָ֥רֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶ֖/נּוּ כַּ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: l' t'khlnv 'l h'rts tshpkhnv khmym
verses.translation: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water.

verses.original: לֹ֖א תֹּאכְלֶ֑/נּוּ לְמַ֨עַן יִיטַ֤ב לְ/ךָ֙ וּ/לְ/בָנֶ֣י/ךָ אַחֲרֶ֔י/ךָ כִּֽי תַעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַ/יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: l' t'khlnv lm'n yytb lkh vlbnykh 'chrykh khy t'shh hyshr b'yny yhvh
verses.translation: Thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the LORD .

verses.original: רַ֧ק קָֽדָשֶׁ֛י/ךָ אֲשֶׁר יִהְי֥וּ לְ/ךָ֖ וּ/נְדָרֶ֑י/ךָ תִּשָּׂ֣א וּ/בָ֔אתָ אֶל הַ/מָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: rq qdshykh 'shr yhyv lkh vndrykh tsh' vb't 'l hmqvm 'shr ybchr yhvh
verses.translation: Only thy holy things which thou hast, and thy vows, thou shalt take, and go unto the place which the LORD shall choose:

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֤יתָ עֹלֹתֶ֨י/ךָ֙ הַ/בָּשָׂ֣ר וְ/הַ/דָּ֔ם עַל מִזְבַּ֖ח יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/דַם זְבָחֶ֗י/ךָ יִשָּׁפֵךְ֙ עַל מִזְבַּח֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/הַ/בָּשָׂ֖ר תֹּאכֵֽל
verses.translit: v'shyt 'ltykh hbshr vhdm 'l mzbch yhvh 'lhykh vdm zbchykh yshpkh 'l mzbch yhvh 'lhykh vhbshr t'khl
verses.translation: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of the LORD thy God: and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the LORD thy God, and thou shalt eat the flesh.

verses.original: שְׁמֹ֣ר וְ/שָׁמַעְתָּ֗ אֵ֚ת כָּל הַ/דְּבָרִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י מְצַוֶּ֑/ךָּ לְמַעַן֩ יִיטַ֨ב לְ/ךָ֜ וּ/לְ/בָנֶ֤י/ךָ אַחֲרֶ֨י/ךָ֙ עַד עוֹלָ֔ם כִּ֤י תַעֲשֶׂה֙ הַ/טּ֣וֹב וְ/הַ/יָּשָׁ֔ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: shmr vshm't 't khl hdbrym h'lh 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh lm'n yytb lkh vlbnykh 'chrykh 'd 'vlm khy t'shh htvb vhyshr b'yny yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: Observe and hear all these words which I command thee, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee for ever, when thou doest that which is good and right in the sight of the LORD thy God.

verses.original: כִּֽי יַכְרִית֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜י/ךָ אֶת הַ/גּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֨ר אַתָּ֥ה בָא שָׁ֛מָּ/ה לָ/רֶ֥שֶׁת אוֹתָ֖/ם מִ/פָּנֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/יָרַשְׁתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔/ם וְ/יָשַׁבְתָּ֖ בְּ/אַרְצָֽ/ם
verses.translit: khy ykhryt yhvh 'lhykh 't hgvym 'shr 'th b' shmh lrsht 'vtm mpnykh vyrsht 'tm vyshbt b'rtsm
verses.translation: When the LORD thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee, whither thou goest to possess them, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their land;

verses.original: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְ/ךָ֗ פֶּן תִּנָּקֵשׁ֙ אַחֲרֵי/הֶ֔ם אַחֲרֵ֖י הִשָּׁמְדָ֣/ם מִ/פָּנֶ֑י/ךָ וּ/פֶן תִּדְרֹ֨שׁ לֵֽ/אלֹהֵי/הֶ֜ם לֵ/אמֹ֨ר אֵיכָ֨ה יַעַבְד֜וּ הַ/גּוֹיִ֤ם הָ/אֵ֨לֶּה֙ אֶת אֱלֹ֣הֵי/הֶ֔ם וְ/אֶעֱשֶׂה כֵּ֖ן גַּם אָֽנִי
verses.translit: hshmr lkh pn tnqsh 'chryhm 'chry hshmdm mpnykh vpn tdrsh l'lhyhm l'mr 'ykhh y'bdv hgvym h'lh 't 'lhyhm v''shh khn gm 'ny
verses.translation: Take heed to thyself that thou be not snared by following them, after that they be destroyed from before thee; and that thou enquire not after their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.

verses.original: לֹא תַעֲשֶׂ֣ה כֵ֔ן לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ כִּי֩ כָּל תּוֹעֲבַ֨ת יְהוָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂנֵ֗א עָשׂוּ֙ לֵ/אלֹ֣הֵי/הֶ֔ם כִּ֣י גַ֤ם אֶת בְּנֵי/הֶם֙ וְ/אֶת בְּנֹ֣תֵי/הֶ֔ם יִשְׂרְפ֥וּ בָ/אֵ֖שׁ לֵֽ/אלֹהֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: l' t'shh khn lyhvh 'lhykh khy khl tv'bt yhvh 'shr shn' 'shv l'lhyhm khy gm 't bnyhm v't bntyhm yshrpv b'sh l'lhyhm
verses.translation: Thou shalt not do so unto the LORD thy God: for every abomination to the LORD , which he hateth, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods.
What thing soever I command you, observe to do it: thou shalt not add thereto, nor diminish from it.

verses.original: אֵ֣ת כָּל הַ/דָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָנֹכִי֙ מְצַוֶּ֣ה אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם אֹת֥/וֹ תִשְׁמְר֖וּ לַ/עֲשׂ֑וֹת לֹא תֹסֵ֣ף עָלָ֔י/ו וְ/לֹ֥א תִגְרַ֖ע מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 't khl hdbr 'shr 'nkhy mtsvh 'tkhm 'tv tshmrv l'shvt l' tsf 'lyv vl' tgr' mmnv
verses.translation: If there arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and giveth thee a sign or a wonder,

verses.original: כִּֽי יָק֤וּם בְּ/קִרְבְּ/ךָ֙ נָבִ֔יא א֖וֹ חֹלֵ֣ם חֲל֑וֹם וְ/נָתַ֥ן אֵלֶ֛י/ךָ א֖וֹת א֥וֹ מוֹפֵֽת
verses.translit: khy yqvm bqrbkh nby' 'v chlm chlvm vntn 'lykh 'vt 'v mvpt
verses.translation: And the sign or the wonder come to pass, whereof he spake unto thee, saying, Let us go after other gods, which thou hast not known, and let us serve them;

verses.original: וּ/בָ֤א הָ/אוֹת֙ וְ/הַ/מּוֹפֵ֔ת אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֶ֖י/ךָ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר נֵֽלְכָ֞ה אַחֲרֵ֨י אֱלֹהִ֧ים אֲחֵרִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא יְדַעְתָּ֖/ם וְ/נָֽעָבְדֵֽ/ם
verses.translit: vb' h'vt vhmvpt 'shr dbr 'lykh l'mr nlkhh 'chry 'lhym 'chrym 'shr l' yd'tm vn'bdm
verses.translation: Thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams: for the LORD your God proveth you, to know whether ye love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.original: לֹ֣א תִשְׁמַ֗ע אֶל דִּבְרֵי֙ הַ/נָּבִ֣יא הַ/ה֔וּא א֛וֹ אֶל חוֹלֵ֥ם הַ/חֲל֖וֹם הַ/ה֑וּא כִּ֣י מְנַסֶּ֞ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶם֙ אֶתְ/כֶ֔ם לָ/דַ֗עַת הֲ/יִשְׁ/כֶ֤ם אֹֽהֲבִים֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֔ם בְּ/כָל לְבַבְ/כֶ֖ם וּ/בְ/כָל נַפְשְׁ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: l' tshm' 'l dbry hnby' hhv' 'v 'l chvlm hchlvm hhv' khy mnsh yhvh 'lhykhm 'tkhm ld't hyshkhm 'hbym 't yhvh 'lhykhm bkhl lbbkhm vbkhl npshkhm
verses.translation: Ye shall walk after the LORD your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֨י יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֛ם תֵּלֵ֖כוּ וְ/אֹת֣/וֹ תִירָ֑אוּ וְ/אֶת מִצְוֺתָ֤י/ו תִּשְׁמֹ֨רוּ֙ וּ/בְ/קֹל֣/וֹ תִשְׁמָ֔עוּ וְ/אֹת֥/וֹ תַעֲבֹ֖דוּ וּ/ב֥/וֹ תִדְבָּקֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: 'chry yhvh 'lhykhm tlkhv v'tv tyr'v v't mtsvtyv tshmrv vbqlv tshm'v v'tv t'bdv vbv tdbqvn
verses.translation: And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death; because he hath spoken to turn you away from the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to thrust thee out of the way which the LORD thy God commanded thee to walk in. So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee.
