verses.original: וְ/הַ/נָּבִ֣יא הַ/ה֡וּא א֣וֹ חֹלֵם֩ הַ/חֲל֨וֹם הַ/ה֜וּא יוּמָ֗ת כִּ֣י דִבֶּר סָ֠רָה עַל יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֜ם הַ/מּוֹצִ֥יא אֶתְ/כֶ֣ם מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם וְ/הַ/פֹּֽדְ/ךָ֙ מִ/בֵּ֣ית עֲבָדִ֔ים לְ/הַדִּֽיחֲ/ךָ֙ מִן הַ/דֶּ֔רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֧ר צִוְּ/ךָ֛ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ לָ/לֶ֣כֶת בָּ֑/הּ וּ/בִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָ/רָ֖ע מִ/קִּרְבֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vhnby' hhv' 'v chlm hchlvm hhv' yvmt khy dbr srh 'l yhvh 'lhykhm hmvtsy' 'tkhm m'rts mtsrym vhpdkh mbyt 'bdym lhdychkh mn hdrkh 'shr tsvkh yhvh 'lhykh llkht bh vb'rt hr' mqrbkh
verses.translation: If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which is as thine own soul, entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers;

verses.original: כִּ֣י יְסִֽיתְ/ךָ֡ אָחִ֣י/ךָ בֶן אִ֠מֶּ/ךָ אֽוֹ בִנְ/ךָ֨ אֽוֹ בִתְּ/ךָ֜ א֣וֹ אֵ֣שֶׁת חֵיקֶ֗/ךָ א֧וֹ רֵֽעֲ/ךָ֛ אֲשֶׁ֥ר כְּ/נַפְשְׁ/ךָ֖ בַּ/סֵּ֣תֶר לֵ/אמֹ֑ר נֵֽלְכָ֗ה וְ/נַֽעַבְדָה֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹ֣א יָדַ֔עְתָּ אַתָּ֖ה וַ/אֲבֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khy ysytkh 'chykh bn 'mkh 'v bnkh 'v btkh 'v 'sht chyqkh 'v r'kh 'shr khnpshkh bstr l'mr nlkhh vn'bdh 'lhym 'chrym 'shr l' yd't 'th v'btykh
verses.translation: Namely , of the gods of the people which are round about you, nigh unto thee, or far off from thee, from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth;

verses.original: מֵ/אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָֽ/עַמִּ֗ים אֲשֶׁר֙ סְבִיבֹ֣תֵי/כֶ֔ם הַ/קְּרֹבִ֣ים אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ א֖וֹ הָ/רְחֹקִ֣ים מִמֶּ֑/ךָּ מִ/קְצֵ֥ה הָ/אָ֖רֶץ וְ/עַד קְצֵ֥ה הָ/אָֽרֶץ
verses.translit: m'lhy h'mym 'shr sbybtykhm hqrbym 'lykh 'v hrchqym mmkh mqtsh h'rts v'd qtsh h'rts
verses.translation: Thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him:

verses.original: לֹא תֹאבֶ֣ה ל֔/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א תִשְׁמַ֖ע אֵלָ֑י/ו וְ/לֹא תָח֤וֹס עֵֽינְ/ךָ֙ עָלָ֔י/ו וְ/לֹֽא תַחְמֹ֥ל וְ/לֹֽא תְכַסֶּ֖ה עָלָֽי/ו
verses.translit: l' t'bh lv vl' tshm' 'lyv vl' tchvs 'ynkh 'lyv vl' tchml vl' tkhsh 'lyv
verses.translation: But thou shalt surely kill him; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.

verses.original: כִּ֤י הָרֹג֙ תַּֽהַרְגֶ֔/נּוּ יָֽדְ/ךָ֛ תִּֽהְיֶה בּ֥/וֹ בָ/רִֽאשׁוֹנָ֖ה לַ/הֲמִית֑/וֹ וְ/יַ֥ד כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם בָּ/אַחֲרֹנָֽה
verses.translit: khy hrg thrgnv ydkh thyh bv br'shvnh lhmytv vyd khl h'm b'chrnh
verses.translation: And thou shalt stone him with stones, that he die; because he hath sought to thrust thee away from the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.

verses.original: וּ/סְקַלְתּ֥/וֹ בָ/אֲבָנִ֖ים וָ/מֵ֑ת כִּ֣י בִקֵּ֗שׁ לְ/הַדִּֽיחֲ/ךָ֙ מֵ/עַל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ הַ/מּוֹצִיאֲ/ךָ֛ מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִ/בֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים
verses.translit: vsqltv b'bnym vmt khy bqsh lhdychkh m'l yhvh 'lhykh hmvtsy'kh m'rts mtsrym mbyt 'bdym
verses.translation: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you.

verses.original: וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יִשְׁמְע֖וּ וְ/יִֽרָא֑וּ/ן וְ/לֹֽא יוֹסִ֣פוּ לַ/עֲשׂ֗וֹת כַּ/דָּבָ֥ר הָ/רָ֛ע הַ/זֶּ֖ה בְּ/קִרְבֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vkhl yshr'l yshm'v vyr'vn vl' yvspv l'shvt khdbr hr' hzh bqrbkh
verses.translation: If thou shalt hear say in one of thy cities, which the LORD thy God hath given thee to dwell there, saying,

verses.original: כִּֽי תִשְׁמַ֞ע בְּ/אַחַ֣ת עָרֶ֗י/ךָ אֲשֶׁר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜י/ךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְ/ךָ֛ לָ/שֶׁ֥בֶת שָׁ֖ם לֵ/אמֹֽר
verses.translit: khy tshm' b'cht 'rykh 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh lshbt shm l'mr
verses.translation: Certain men, the children of Belial, are gone out from among you, and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which ye have not known;

verses.original: יָצְא֞וּ אֲנָשִׁ֤ים בְּנֵֽי בְלִיַּ֨עַל֙ מִ/קִּרְבֶּ֔/ךָ וַ/יַּדִּ֛יחוּ אֶת יֹשְׁבֵ֥י עִירָ֖/ם לֵ/אמֹ֑ר נֵלְכָ֗ה וְ/נַעַבְדָ֛ה אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא יְדַעְתֶּֽם
verses.translit: yts'v 'nshym bny bly'l mqrbkh vydychv 't yshby 'yrm l'mr nlkhh vn'bdh 'lhym 'chrym 'shr l' yd'tm
verses.translation: Then shalt thou enquire, and make search, and ask diligently; and, behold, if it be truth, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought among you;

verses.original: וְ/דָרַשְׁתָּ֧ וְ/חָקַרְתָּ֧ וְ/שָׁאַלְתָּ֖ הֵיטֵ֑ב וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה אֱמֶת֙ נָכ֣וֹן הַ/דָּבָ֔ר נֶעֶשְׂתָ֛ה הַ/תּוֹעֵבָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את בְּ/קִרְבֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vdrsht vchqrt vsh'lt hytb vhnh 'mt nkhvn hdbr n'shth htv'bh hz't bqrbkh
verses.translation: Thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, and all that is therein, and the cattle thereof, with the edge of the sword.

verses.original: הַכֵּ֣ה תַכֶּ֗ה אֶת יֹֽשְׁבֵ֛י הָ/עִ֥יר ה/הוא הַ/הִ֖יא לְ/פִי חָ֑רֶב הַחֲרֵ֨ם אֹתָ֧/הּ וְ/אֶת כָּל אֲשֶׁר בָּ֛/הּ וְ/אֶת בְּהֶמְתָּ֖/הּ לְ/פִי חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: hkhh tkhh 't yshby h'yr hhv' hhy' lpy chrb hchrm 'th v't khl 'shr bh v't bhmth lpy chrb
verses.translation: And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof, and shalt burn with fire the city, and all the spoil thereof every whit, for the LORD thy God: and it shall be an heap for ever; it shall not be built again.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת כָּל שְׁלָלָ֗/הּ תִּקְבֹּץ֮ אֶל תּ֣וֹךְ רְחֹבָ/הּ֒ וְ/שָׂרַפְתָּ֨ בָ/אֵ֜שׁ אֶת הָ/עִ֤יר וְ/אֶת כָּל שְׁלָלָ/הּ֙ כָּלִ֔יל לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/הָיְתָה֙ תֵּ֣ל עוֹלָ֔ם לֹ֥א תִבָּנֶ֖ה עֽוֹד
verses.translit: v't khl shllh tqbts 'l tvkh rchbh vshrpt b'sh 't h'yr v't khl shllh khlyl lyhvh 'lhykh vhyth tl 'vlm l' tbnh 'vd
verses.translation: And there shall cleave nought of the cursed thing to thine hand: that the LORD may turn from the fierceness of his anger, and shew thee mercy, and have compassion upon thee, and multiply thee, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers;

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא יִדְבַּ֧ק בְּ/יָדְ/ךָ֛ מְא֖וּמָה מִן הַ/חֵ֑רֶם לְמַעַן֩ יָשׁ֨וּב יְהוָ֜ה מֵ/חֲר֣וֹן אַפּ֗/וֹ וְ/נָֽתַן לְ/ךָ֤ רַחֲמִים֙ וְ/רִֽחַמְ/ךָ֣ וְ/הִרְבֶּ֔/ךָ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַ/אֲבֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vl' ydbq bydkh m'vmh mn hchrm lm'n yshvb yhvh mchrvn 'pv vntn lkh rchmym vrchmkh vhrbkh kh'shr nshb' l'btykh
verses.translation: When thou shalt hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep all his commandments which I command thee this day, to do that which is right in the eyes of the LORD thy God.

verses.original: בָּנִ֣ים אַתֶּ֔ם לַֽ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶ֑ם לֹ֣א תִתְגֹּֽדְד֗וּ וְ/לֹֽא תָשִׂ֧ימוּ קָרְחָ֛ה בֵּ֥ין עֵינֵי/כֶ֖ם לָ/מֵֽת
verses.translit: bnym 'tm lyhvh 'lhykhm l' ttgddv vl' tshymv qrchh byn 'ynykhm lmt
verses.translation: Ye are the children of the LORD your God: ye shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.

verses.original: כִּ֣י עַ֤ם קָדוֹשׁ֙ אַתָּ֔ה לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ וּ/בְ/ךָ֞ בָּחַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה לִֽ/הְי֥וֹת ל/וֹ֙ לְ/עַ֣ם סְגֻלָּ֔ה מִ/כֹּל֙ הָֽ/עַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל פְּנֵ֥י הָ/אֲדָמָֽה
verses.translit: khy 'm qdvsh 'th lyhvh 'lhykh vbkh bchr yhvh lhyvt lv l'm sglh mkhl h'mym 'shr 'l pny h'dmh
verses.translation: For thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God, and the LORD hath chosen thee to be a peculiar people unto himself, above all the nations that are upon the earth.

verses.original: לֹ֥א תֹאכַ֖ל כָּל תּוֹעֵבָֽה
verses.translit: l' t'khl khl tv'bh
verses.translation: Thou shalt not eat any abominable thing.

verses.original: זֹ֥את הַ/בְּהֵמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֹּאכֵ֑לוּ שׁ֕וֹר שֵׂ֥ה כְשָׂבִ֖ים וְ/שֵׂ֥ה עִזִּֽים
verses.translit: z't hbhmh 'shr t'khlv shvr shh khshbym vshh 'zym
verses.translation: These are the beasts which ye shall eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,

verses.original: אַיָּ֥ל וּ/צְבִ֖י וְ/יַחְמ֑וּר וְ/אַקּ֥וֹ וְ/דִישֹׁ֖ן וּ/תְא֥וֹ וָ/זָֽמֶר
verses.translit: 'yl vtsby vychmvr v'qv vdyshn vt'v vzmr
verses.translation: The hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.

verses.original: וְ/כָל בְּהֵמָ֞ה מַפְרֶ֣סֶת פַּרְסָ֗ה וְ/שֹׁסַ֤עַת שֶׁ֨סַע֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י פְרָס֔וֹת מַעֲלַ֥ת גֵּרָ֖ה בַּ/בְּהֵמָ֑ה אֹתָ֖/הּ תֹּאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: vkhl bhmh mprst prsh vshs't shs' shty prsvt m'lt grh bbhmh 'th t'khlv
verses.translation: And every beast that parteth the hoof, and cleaveth the cleft into two claws, and cheweth the cud among the beasts, that ye shall eat.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ אֶת זֶ֞ה לֹ֤א תֹֽאכְלוּ֙ מִ/מַּֽעֲלֵ֣י הַ/גֵּרָ֔ה וּ/מִ/מַּפְרִיסֵ֥י הַ/פַּרְסָ֖ה הַ/שְּׁסוּעָ֑ה אֶֽת הַ֠/גָּמָל וְ/אֶת הָ/אַרְנֶ֨בֶת וְ/אֶת הַ/שָּׁפָ֜ן כִּֽי מַעֲלֵ֧ה גֵרָ֣ה הֵ֗מָּה וּ/פַרְסָה֙ לֹ֣א הִפְרִ֔יסוּ טְמֵאִ֥ים הֵ֖ם לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: 'kh 't zh l' t'khlv mm'ly hgrh vmmprysy hprsh hshsv'h 't hgml v't h'rnbt v't hshpn khy m'lh grh hmh vprsh l' hprysv tm'ym hm lkhm
verses.translation: Nevertheless these ye shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the cloven hoof; as the camel, and the hare, and the coney: for they chew the cud, but divide not the hoof; therefore they are unclean unto you.

verses.original: וְ/אֶת הַ֠/חֲזִיר כִּֽי מַפְרִ֨יס פַּרְסָ֥ה הוּא֙ וְ/לֹ֣א גֵרָ֔ה טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָ/כֶ֑ם מִ/בְּשָׂרָ/ם֙ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֔לוּ וּ/בְ/נִבְלָתָ֖/ם לֹ֥א תִגָּֽעוּ
verses.translit: v't hchzyr khy mprys prsh hv' vl' grh tm' hv' lkhm mbshrm l' t'khlv vbnbltm l' tg'v
verses.translation: And the swine, because it divideth the hoof, yet cheweth not the cud, it is unclean unto you: ye shall not eat of their flesh, nor touch their dead carcase.

verses.original: אֶת זֶה֙ תֹּֽאכְל֔וּ מִ/כֹּ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּ/מָּ֑יִם כֹּ֧ל אֲשֶׁר ל֛/וֹ סְנַפִּ֥יר וְ/קַשְׂקֶ֖שֶׂת תֹּאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: 't zh t'khlv mkhl 'shr bmym khl 'shr lv snpyr vqshqsht t'khlv
verses.translation: These ye shall eat of all that are in the waters: all that have fins and scales shall ye eat:

verses.original: וְ/כֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֵֽין ל֛/וֹ סְנַפִּ֥יר וְ/קַשְׂקֶ֖שֶׂת לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֑לוּ טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: vkhl 'shr 'yn lv snpyr vqshqsht l' t'khlv tm' hv' lkhm
verses.translation: And whatsoever hath not fins and scales ye may not eat; it is unclean unto you.

verses.original: כָּל צִפּ֥וֹר טְהֹרָ֖ה תֹּאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: khl tspvr thrh t'khlv
verses.translation: Of all clean birds ye shall eat.

verses.original: וְ/זֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא תֹאכְל֖וּ מֵ/הֶ֑ם הַ/נֶּ֥שֶׁר וְ/הַ/פֶּ֖רֶס וְ/הָֽ/עָזְנִיָּֽה
verses.translit: vzh 'shr l' t'khlv mhm hnshr vhprs vh'znyh
verses.translation: But these are they of which ye shall not eat: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,

verses.original: וְ/הָ/רָאָה֙ וְ/אֶת הָ֣/אַיָּ֔ה וְ/הַ/דַּיָּ֖ה לְ/מִינָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vhr'h v't h'yh vhdyh lmynh
verses.translation: And the glede, and the kite, and the vulture after his kind,

verses.original: וְ/אֵ֥ת כָּל עֹרֵ֖ב לְ/מִינֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: v't khl 'rb lmynv
verses.translation: And every raven after his kind,

verses.original: וְ/אֵת֙ בַּ֣ת הַֽ/יַּעֲנָ֔ה וְ/אֶת הַ/תַּחְמָ֖ס וְ/אֶת הַ/שָּׁ֑חַף וְ/אֶת הַ/נֵּ֖ץ לְ/מִינֵֽ/הוּ
verses.translit: v't bt hy'nh v't htchms v't hshchf v't hnts lmynhv
verses.translation: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,

verses.original: אֶת הַ/כּ֥וֹס וְ/אֶת הַ/יַּנְשׁ֖וּף וְ/הַ/תִּנְשָֽׁמֶת
verses.translit: 't hkhvs v't hynshvf vhtnshmt
verses.translation: The little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,

verses.original: וְ/הַ/קָּאָ֥ת וְ/אֶֽת הָ/רָחָ֖מָ/ה וְ/אֶת הַ/שָּׁלָֽךְ
verses.translit: vhq't v't hrchmh v't hshlkh
verses.translation: And the pelican, and the gier eagle, and the cormorant,

verses.original: וְ/הַ֣/חֲסִידָ֔ה וְ/הָ/אֲנָפָ֖ה לְ/מִינָ֑/הּ וְ/הַ/דּוּכִיפַ֖ת וְ/הָ/עֲטַלֵּֽף
verses.translit: vhchsydh vh'nph lmynh vhdvkhypt vh'tlf
verses.translation: And the stork, and the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

verses.original: וְ/כֹל֙ שֶׁ֣רֶץ הָ/ע֔וֹף טָמֵ֥א ה֖וּא לָ/כֶ֑ם לֹ֖א יֵאָכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: vkhl shrts h'vf tm' hv' lkhm l' y'khlv
verses.translation: And every creeping thing that flieth is unclean unto you: they shall not be eaten.

verses.original: כָּל ע֥וֹף טָה֖וֹר תֹּאכֵֽלוּ
verses.translit: khl 'vf thvr t'khlv
verses.translation: But of all clean fowls ye may eat.

verses.original: לֹ֣א תֹאכְל֣וּ כָל נְ֠בֵלָה לַ/גֵּ֨ר אֲשֶׁר בִּ/שְׁעָרֶ֜י/ךָ תִּתְּנֶ֣נָּ/ה וַ/אֲכָלָ֗/הּ א֤וֹ מָכֹר֙ לְ/נָכְרִ֔י כִּ֣י עַ֤ם קָדוֹשׁ֙ אַתָּ֔ה לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ לֹֽא תְבַשֵּׁ֥ל גְּדִ֖י בַּ/חֲלֵ֥ב אִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: l' t'khlv khl nblh lgr 'shr bsh'rykh ttnnh v'khlh 'v mkhr lnkhry khy 'm qdvsh 'th lyhvh 'lhykh l' tbshl gdy bchlb 'mv
verses.translation: Ye shall not eat of any thing that dieth of itself: thou shalt give it unto the stranger that is in thy gates, that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it unto an alien: for thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.

verses.original: עַשֵּׂ֣ר תְּעַשֵּׂ֔ר אֵ֖ת כָּל תְּבוּאַ֣ת זַרְעֶ֑/ךָ הַ/יֹּצֵ֥א הַ/שָּׂדֶ֖ה שָׁנָ֥ה שָׁנָֽה
verses.translit: 'shr t'shr 't khl tbv't zr'kh hyts' hshdh shnh shnh
verses.translation: Thou shalt truly tithe all the increase of thy seed, that the field bringeth forth year by year.

verses.original: וְ/אָכַלְתָּ֞ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י/ךָ בַּ/מָּק֣וֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַר֮ לְ/שַׁכֵּ֣ן שְׁמ֣/וֹ שָׁם֒ מַעְשַׂ֤ר דְּגָֽנְ/ךָ֙ תִּֽירֹשְׁ/ךָ֣ וְ/יִצְהָרֶ֔/ךָ וּ/בְכֹרֹ֥ת בְּקָרְ/ךָ֖ וְ/צֹאנֶ֑/ךָ לְמַ֣עַן תִּלְמַ֗ד לְ/יִרְאָ֛ה אֶת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: v'khlt lpny yhvh 'lhykh bmqvm 'shr ybchr lshkhn shmv shm m'shr dgnkh tyrshkh vytshrkh vbkhrt bqrkh vts'nkh lm'n tlmd lyr'h 't yhvh 'lhykh khl hymym
verses.translation: And thou shalt eat before the LORD thy God, in the place which he shall choose to place his name there, the tithe of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the firstlings of thy herds and of thy flocks; that thou mayest learn to fear the LORD thy God always.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יִרְבֶּ֨ה מִמְּ/ךָ֜ הַ/דֶּ֗רֶךְ כִּ֣י לֹ֣א תוּכַ֘ל שְׂאֵת/וֹ֒ כִּֽי יִרְחַ֤ק מִמְּ/ךָ֙ הַ/מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִבְחַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ לָ/שׂ֥וּם שְׁמ֖/וֹ שָׁ֑ם כִּ֥י יְבָרֶכְ/ךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vkhy yrbh mmkh hdrkh khy l' tvkhl sh'tv khy yrchq mmkh hmqvm 'shr ybchr yhvh 'lhykh lshvm shmv shm khy ybrkhkh yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: And if the way be too long for thee, so that thou art not able to carry it; or if the place be too far from thee, which the LORD thy God shall choose to set his name there, when the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:

verses.original: וְ/נָתַתָּ֖ה בַּ/כָּ֑סֶף וְ/צַרְתָּ֤ הַ/כֶּ֨סֶף֙ בְּ/יָ֣דְ/ךָ֔ וְ/הָֽלַכְתָּ֙ אֶל הַ/מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְחַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vntth bkhsf vtsrt hkhsf bydkh vhlkht 'l hmqvm 'shr ybchr yhvh 'lhykh bv
verses.translation: Then shalt thou turn it into money, and bind up the money in thine hand, and shalt go unto the place which the LORD thy God shall choose:

verses.translit: vntth hkhsf bkhl 'shr t'vh npshkh bbqr vbts'n vbyyn vbshkhr vbkhl 'shr tsh'lkh npshkh v'khlt shm lpny yhvh 'lhykh vshmcht 'th vbytkh
verses.translation: And thou shalt bestow that money for whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatsoever thy soul desireth: and thou shalt eat there before the LORD thy God, and thou shalt rejoice, thou, and thine household,

verses.original: וְ/הַ/לֵּוִ֥י אֲשֶׁר בִּ/שְׁעָרֶ֖י/ךָ לֹ֣א תַֽעַזְבֶ֑/נּוּ כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין ל֛/וֹ חֵ֥לֶק וְ/נַחֲלָ֖ה עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vhlvy 'shr bsh'rykh l' t'zbnv khy 'yn lv chlq vnchlh 'mkh
verses.translation: And the Levite that is within thy gates; thou shalt not forsake him; for he hath no part nor inheritance with thee.

verses.original: מִ/קְצֵ֣ה שָׁלֹ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֗ים תּוֹצִיא֙ אֶת כָּל מַעְשַׂר֙ תְּבוּאָ֣תְ/ךָ֔ בַּ/שָּׁנָ֖ה הַ/הִ֑וא וְ/הִנַּחְתָּ֖ בִּ/שְׁעָרֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: mqtsh shlsh shnym tvtsy' 't khl m'shr tbv'tkh bshnh hhv' vhncht bsh'rykh
verses.translation: At the end of three years thou shalt bring forth all the tithe of thine increase the same year, and shalt lay it up within thy gates:

verses.original: וּ/בָ֣א הַ/לֵּוִ֡י כִּ֣י אֵֽין ל/וֹ֩ חֵ֨לֶק וְ/נַחֲלָ֜ה עִמָּ֗/ךְ וְ֠/הַ/גֵּר וְ/הַ/יָּת֤וֹם וְ/הָֽ/אַלְמָנָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּ/שְׁעָרֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/אָכְל֖וּ וְ/שָׂבֵ֑עוּ לְמַ֤עַן יְבָרֶכְ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/כָל מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדְ/ךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: vb' hlvy khy 'yn lv chlq vnchlh 'mkh vhgr vhytvm vh'lmnh 'shr bsh'rykh v'khlv vshb'v lm'n ybrkhkh yhvh 'lhykh bkhl m'shh ydkh 'shr t'shh
verses.translation: And the Levite, (because he hath no part nor inheritance with thee,) and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, which are within thy gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hand which thou doest.

verses.original: מִ/קֵּ֥ץ שֶֽׁבַע שָׁנִ֖ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה שְׁמִטָּֽה
verses.translit: mqts shb' shnym t'shh shmth
verses.translation: At the end of every seven years thou shalt make a release.

verses.original: וְ/זֶה֮ דְּבַ֣ר הַ/שְּׁמִטָּה֒ שָׁמ֗וֹט כָּל בַּ֨עַל֙ מַשֵּׁ֣ה יָד֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַשֶּׁ֖ה בְּ/רֵעֵ֑/הוּ לֹֽא יִגֹּ֤שׂ אֶת רֵעֵ֨/הוּ֙ וְ/אֶת אָחִ֔י/ו כִּֽי קָרָ֥א שְׁמִטָּ֖ה לַֽ/יהוָֽה
verses.translit: vzh dbr hshmth shmvt khl b'l mshh ydv 'shr yshh br'hv l' ygsh 't r'hv v't 'chyv khy qr' shmth lyhvh
verses.translation: And this is the manner of the release: Every creditor that lendeth ought unto his neighbour shall release it; he shall not exact it of his neighbour, or of his brother; because it is called the LORD’s release.

verses.original: אֶת הַ/נָּכְרִ֖י תִּגֹּ֑שׂ וַ/אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה לְ/ךָ֛ אֶת אָחִ֖י/ךָ תַּשְׁמֵ֥ט יָדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: 't hnkhry tgsh v'shr yhyh lkh 't 'chykh tshmt ydkh
verses.translation: Of a foreigner thou mayest exact it again: but that which is thine with thy brother thine hand shall release;

verses.original: אֶ֕פֶס כִּ֛י לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה בְּ/ךָ֖ אֶבְי֑וֹן כִּֽי בָרֵ֤ךְ יְבָֽרֶכְ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה בָּ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ נֹֽתֵן לְ/ךָ֥ נַחֲלָ֖ה לְ/רִשְׁתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: 'ps khy l' yhyh bkh 'byvn khy brkh ybrkhkh yhvh b'rts 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh nchlh lrshth
verses.translation: Save when there shall be no poor among you; for the LORD shall greatly bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it:

verses.original: רַ֚ק אִם שָׁמ֣וֹעַ תִּשְׁמַ֔ע בְּ/ק֖וֹל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ לִ/שְׁמֹ֤ר לַ/עֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת כָּל הַ/מִּצְוָ֣ה הַ/זֹּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֖ הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: rq 'm shmv' tshm' bqvl yhvh 'lhykh lshmr l'shvt 't khl hmtsvh hz't 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm
verses.translation: Only if thou carefully hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all these commandments which I command thee this day.

verses.original: כִּֽי יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ בֵּֽרַכְ/ךָ֔ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר לָ֑/ךְ וְ/הַֽעֲבַטְתָּ֞ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֗ים וְ/אַתָּה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲבֹ֔ט וּ/מָֽשַׁלְתָּ֙ בְּ/גוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים וּ/בְ/ךָ֖ לֹ֥א יִמְשֹֽׁלוּ
verses.translit: khy yhvh 'lhykh brkhkh kh'shr dbr lkh vh'btt gvym rbym v'th l' t'bt vmshlt bgvym rbym vbkh l' ymshlv
verses.translation: For the LORD thy God blesseth thee, as he promised thee: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, but thou shalt not borrow; and thou shalt reign over many nations, but they shall not reign over thee.

verses.original: כִּֽי יִהְיֶה֩ בְ/ךָ֨ אֶבְי֜וֹן מֵ/אַחַ֤ד אַחֶ֨י/ךָ֙ בְּ/אַחַ֣ד שְׁעָרֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/אַ֨רְצְ/ךָ֔ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֑/ךְ לֹ֧א תְאַמֵּ֣ץ אֶת לְבָבְ/ךָ֗ וְ/לֹ֤א תִקְפֹּץ֙ אֶת יָ֣דְ/ךָ֔ מֵ/אָחִ֖י/ךָ הָ/אֶבְיֽוֹן
verses.translit: khy yhyh bkh 'byvn m'chd 'chykh b'chd sh'rykh b'rtskh 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh l' t'mts 't lbbkh vl' tqpts 't ydkh m'chykh h'byvn
verses.translation: If there be among you a poor man of one of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not harden thine heart, nor shut thine hand from thy poor brother:

verses.original: כִּֽי פָתֹ֧חַ תִּפְתַּ֛ח אֶת יָדְ/ךָ֖ ל֑/וֹ וְ/הַעֲבֵט֙ תַּעֲבִיטֶ֔/נּוּ דֵּ֚י מַחְסֹר֔/וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֶחְסַ֖ר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy ptch tptch 't ydkh lv vh'bt t'bytnv dy mchsrv 'shr ychsr lv
verses.translation: But thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him, and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need, in that which he wanteth.

verses.original: הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְ/ךָ֡ פֶּן יִהְיֶ֣ה דָבָר֩ עִם לְבָבְ/ךָ֨ בְלִיַּ֜עַל לֵ/אמֹ֗ר קָֽרְבָ֣ה שְׁנַֽת הַ/שֶּׁבַע֮ שְׁנַ֣ת הַ/שְּׁמִטָּה֒ וְ/רָעָ֣ה עֵֽינְ/ךָ֗ בְּ/אָחִ֨י/ךָ֙ הָֽ/אֶבְי֔וֹן וְ/לֹ֥א תִתֵּ֖ן ל֑/וֹ וְ/קָרָ֤א עָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֶל יְהוָ֔ה וְ/הָיָ֥ה בְ/ךָ֖ חֵֽטְא
verses.translit: hshmr lkh pn yhyh dbr 'm lbbkh bly'l l'mr qrbh shnt hshb' shnt hshmth vr'h 'ynkh b'chykh h'byvn vl' ttn lv vqr' 'lykh 'l yhvh vhyh bkh cht'
verses.translation: Beware that there be not a thought in thy wicked heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand; and thine eye be evil against thy poor brother, and thou givest him nought; and he cry unto the LORD against thee, and it be sin unto thee.

verses.original: נָת֤וֹן תִּתֵּן֙ ל֔/וֹ וְ/לֹא יֵרַ֥ע לְבָבְ/ךָ֖ בְּ/תִתְּ/ךָ֣ ל֑/וֹ כִּ֞י בִּ/גְלַ֣ל הַ/דָּבָ֣ר הַ/זֶּ֗ה יְבָרֶכְ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/כָֽל מַעֲשֶׂ֔/ךָ וּ/בְ/כֹ֖ל מִשְׁלַ֥ח יָדֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: ntvn ttn lv vl' yr' lbbkh bttkh lv khy bgll hdbr hzh ybrkhkh yhvh 'lhykh bkhl m'shkh vbkhl mshlch ydkh
verses.translation: Thou shalt surely give him, and thine heart shall not be grieved when thou givest unto him: because that for this thing the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thy works, and in all that thou puttest thine hand unto.

verses.original: כִּ֛י לֹא יֶחְדַּ֥ל אֶבְי֖וֹן מִ/קֶּ֣רֶב הָ/אָ֑רֶץ עַל כֵּ֞ן אָנֹכִ֤י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֙ לֵ/אמֹ֔ר פָּ֠תֹחַ תִּפְתַּ֨ח אֶת יָדְ/ךָ֜ לְ/אָחִ֧י/ךָ לַ/עֲנִיֶּ֛/ךָ וּ/לְ/אֶבְיֹנְ/ךָ֖ בְּ/אַרְצֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khy l' ychdl 'byvn mqrb h'rts 'l khn 'nkhy mtsvkh l'mr ptch tptch 't ydkh l'chykh l'nykh vl'bynkh b'rtskh
verses.translation: For the poor shall never cease out of the land: therefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy, in thy land.

verses.translit: khy ymkhr lkh 'chykh h'bry 'v h'bryh v'bdkh shsh shnym vbshnh hshby't tshlchnv chpshy m'mkh
verses.translation: And if thy brother, an Hebrew man, or an Hebrew woman, be sold unto thee, and serve thee six years; then in the seventh year thou shalt let him go free from thee.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי תְשַׁלְּחֶ֥/נּוּ חָפְשִׁ֖י מֵֽ/עִמָּ֑/ךְ לֹ֥א תְשַׁלְּחֶ֖/נּוּ רֵיקָֽם
verses.translit: vkhy tshlchnv chpshy m'mkh l' tshlchnv ryqm
verses.translation: And when thou sendest him out free from thee, thou shalt not let him go away empty:

verses.original: הַעֲנֵ֤יק תַּעֲנִיק֙ ל֔/וֹ מִ/צֹּ֣אנְ/ךָ֔ וּ/מִֽ/גָּרְנְ/ךָ֖ וּ/מִ/יִּקְבֶ֑/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֧ר בֵּרַכְ/ךָ֛ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ תִּתֶּן לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: h'nyq t'nyq lv mts'nkh vmgrnkh vmyqbkh 'shr brkhkh yhvh 'lhykh ttn lv
verses.translation: Thou shalt furnish him liberally out of thy flock, and out of thy floor, and out of thy winepress: of that wherewith the LORD thy God hath blessed thee thou shalt give unto him.

verses.original: וְ/זָכַרְתָּ֗ כִּ֣י עֶ֤בֶד הָיִ֨יתָ֙ בְּ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וַֽ/יִּפְדְּ/ךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ עַל כֵּ֞ן אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֛ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֥ר הַ/זֶּ֖ה הַ/יּֽוֹם
verses.translit: vzkhrt khy 'bd hyyt b'rts mtsrym vypdkh yhvh 'lhykh 'l khn 'nkhy mtsvkh 't hdbr hzh hyvm
verses.translation: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt, and the LORD thy God redeemed thee: therefore I command thee this thing to day.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ כִּֽי יֹאמַ֣ר אֵלֶ֔י/ךָ לֹ֥א אֵצֵ֖א מֵ/עִמָּ֑/ךְ כִּ֤י אֲהֵֽבְ/ךָ֙ וְ/אֶת בֵּיתֶ֔/ךָ כִּי ט֥וֹב ל֖/וֹ עִמָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: vhyh khy y'mr 'lykh l' 'ts' m'mkh khy 'hbkh v't bytkh khy tvb lv 'mkh
verses.translation: And it shall be, if he say unto thee, I will not go away from thee; because he loveth thee and thine house, because he is well with thee;

verses.original: וְ/לָקַחְתָּ֣ אֶת הַ/מַּרְצֵ֗עַ וְ/נָתַתָּ֤ה בְ/אָזְנ/וֹ֙ וּ/בַ/דֶּ֔לֶת וְ/הָיָ֥ה לְ/ךָ֖ עֶ֣בֶד עוֹלָ֑ם וְ/אַ֥ף לַ/אֲמָתְ/ךָ֖ תַּעֲשֶׂה כֵּֽן
verses.translit: vlqcht 't hmrts' vntth b'znv vbdlt vhyh lkh 'bd 'vlm v'f l'mtkh t'shh khn
verses.translation: Then thou shalt take an aul, and thrust it through his ear unto the door, and he shall be thy servant for ever. And also unto thy maidservant thou shalt do likewise.

verses.original: לֹא יִקְשֶׁ֣ה בְ/עֵינֶ֗/ךָ בְּ/שַׁלֵּֽחֲ/ךָ֙ אֹת֤/וֹ חָפְשִׁי֙ מֵֽ/עִמָּ֔/ךְ כִּ֗י מִשְׁנֶה֙ שְׂכַ֣ר שָׂכִ֔יר עֲבָֽדְ/ךָ֖ שֵׁ֣שׁ שָׁנִ֑ים וּ/בֵֽרַכְ/ךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ בְּ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶֽׂה
verses.translit: l' yqshh b'ynkh bshlchkh 'tv chpshy m'mkh khy mshnh shkhr shkhyr 'bdkh shsh shnym vbrkhkh yhvh 'lhykh bkhl 'shr t'shh
verses.translation: It shall not seem hard unto thee, when thou sendest him away free from thee; for he hath been worth a double hired servant to thee , in serving thee six years: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all that thou doest.

verses.original: כָּֽל הַ/בְּכ֡וֹר אֲשֶׁר֩ יִוָּלֵ֨ד בִּ/בְקָרְ/ךָ֤ וּ/בְ/צֹֽאנְ/ךָ֙ הַ/זָּכָ֔ר תַּקְדִּ֖ישׁ לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ לֹ֤א תַעֲבֹד֙ בִּ/בְכֹ֣ר שׁוֹרֶ֔/ךָ וְ/לֹ֥א תָגֹ֖ז בְּכ֥וֹר צֹאנֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: khl hbkhvr 'shr yvld bbqrkh vbts'nkh hzkhr tqdysh lyhvh 'lhykh l' t'bd bbkhr shvrkh vl' tgz bkhvr ts'nkh
verses.translation: All the firstling males that come of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify unto the LORD thy God: thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy bullock, nor shear the firstling of thy sheep.

verses.original: לִ/פְנֵי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֤י/ךָ תֹאכֲלֶ֨/נּוּ֙ שָׁנָ֣ה בְ/שָׁנָ֔ה בַּ/מָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה אַתָּ֖ה וּ/בֵיתֶֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: lpny yhvh 'lhykh t'khlnv shnh bshnh bmqvm 'shr ybchr yhvh 'th vbytkh
verses.translation: Thou shalt eat it before the LORD thy God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose, thou and thy household.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יִהְיֶ֨ה ב֜/וֹ מ֗וּם פִּסֵּ֨חַ֙ א֣וֹ עִוֵּ֔ר כֹּ֖ל מ֣וּם רָ֑ע לֹ֣א תִזְבָּחֶ֔/נּוּ לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vkhy yhyh bv mvm psch 'v 'vr khl mvm r' l' tzbchnv lyhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: And if there be any blemish therein, as if it be lame, or blind, or have any ill blemish, thou shalt not sacrifice it unto the LORD thy God.

verses.original: בִּ/שְׁעָרֶ֖י/ךָ תֹּאכֲלֶ֑/נּוּ הַ/טָּמֵ֤א וְ/הַ/טָּהוֹר֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו כַּ/צְּבִ֖י וְ/כָ/אַיָּֽל
verses.translit: bsh'rykh t'khlnv htm' vhthvr ychdv khtsby vkh'yl
verses.translation: Thou shalt eat it within thy gates: the unclean and the clean person shall eat it alike, as the roebuck, and as the hart.

verses.original: רַ֥ק אֶת דָּמ֖/וֹ לֹ֣א תֹאכֵ֑ל עַל הָ/אָ֥רֶץ תִּשְׁפְּכֶ֖/נּוּ כַּ/מָּֽיִם
verses.translit: rq 't dmv l' t'khl 'l h'rts tshpkhnv khmym
verses.translation: Only thou shalt not eat the blood thereof; thou shalt pour it upon the ground as water.

verses.original: שָׁמוֹר֙ אֶת חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָ/אָבִ֔יב וְ/עָשִׂ֣יתָ פֶּ֔סַח לַ/יהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ כִּ֞י בְּ/חֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽ/אָבִ֗יב הוֹצִ֨יאֲ/ךָ֜ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛י/ךָ מִ/מִּצְרַ֖יִם לָֽיְלָה
verses.translit: shmvr 't chdsh h'byb v'shyt psch lyhvh 'lhykh khy bchdsh h'byb hvtsy'kh yhvh 'lhykh mmtsrym lylh
verses.translation: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the passover unto the LORD thy God: for in the month of Abib the LORD thy God brought thee forth out of Egypt by night.

verses.original: וְ/זָבַ֥חְתָּ פֶּ֛סַח לַ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ צֹ֣אן וּ/בָקָ֑ר בַּ/מָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה לְ/שַׁכֵּ֥ן שְׁמ֖/וֹ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vzbcht psch lyhvh 'lhykh ts'n vbqr bmqvm 'shr ybchr yhvh lshkhn shmv shm
verses.translation: Thou shalt therefore sacrifice the passover unto the LORD thy God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which the LORD shall choose to place his name there.

verses.original: לֹא תֹאכַ֤ל עָלָי/ו֙ חָמֵ֔ץ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֛ים תֹּֽאכַל עָלָ֥י/ו מַצּ֖וֹת לֶ֣חֶם עֹ֑נִי כִּ֣י בְ/חִפָּז֗וֹן יָצָ֨אתָ֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם לְמַ֣עַן תִּזְכֹּר֔ אֶת י֤וֹם צֵֽאתְ/ךָ֙ מֵ/אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י חַיֶּֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: l' t'khl 'lyv chmts shb't ymym t'khl 'lyv mtsvt lchm 'ny khy bchpzvn yts't m'rts mtsrym lm'n tzkhr 't yvm ts'tkh m'rts mtsrym khl ymy chyykh
verses.translation: Thou shalt eat no leavened bread with it; seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread therewith, even the bread of affliction; for thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt in haste: that thou mayest remember the day when thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of thy life.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא יֵרָאֶ֨ה לְ/ךָ֥ שְׂאֹ֛ר בְּ/כָל גְּבֻלְ/ךָ֖ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וְ/לֹא יָלִ֣ין מִן הַ/בָּשָׂ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר תִּזְבַּ֥ח בָּ/עֶ֛רֶב בַּ/יּ֥וֹם הָ/רִאשׁ֖וֹן לַ/בֹּֽקֶר
verses.translit: vl' yr'h lkh sh'r bkhl gblkh shb't ymym vl' ylyn mn hbshr 'shr tzbch b'rb byvm hr'shvn lbqr
verses.translation: And there shall be no leavened bread seen with thee in all thy coast seven days; neither shall there any thing of the flesh, which thou sacrificedst the first day at even, remain all night until the morning.

verses.original: לֹ֥א תוּכַ֖ל לִ/זְבֹּ֣חַ אֶת הַ/פָּ֑סַח בְּ/אַחַ֣ד שְׁעָרֶ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: l' tvkhl lzbch 't hpsch b'chd sh'rykh 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh
verses.translation: Thou mayest not sacrifice the passover within any of thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee:

verses.original: כִּ֠י אִֽם אֶל הַ/מָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לְ/שַׁכֵּ֣ן שְׁמ֔/וֹ שָׁ֛ם תִּזְבַּ֥ח אֶת הַ/פֶּ֖סַח בָּ/עָ֑רֶב כְּ/ב֣וֹא הַ/שֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ מוֹעֵ֖ד צֵֽאתְ/ךָ֥ מִ/מִּצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: khy 'm 'l hmqvm 'shr ybchr yhvh 'lhykh lshkhn shmv shm tzbch 't hpsch b'rb khbv' hshmsh mv'd ts'tkh mmtsrym
verses.translation: But at the place which the LORD thy God shall choose to place his name in, there thou shalt sacrifice the passover at even, at the going down of the sun, at the season that thou camest forth out of Egypt.

verses.original: וּ/בִשַּׁלְתָּ֙ וְ/אָ֣כַלְתָּ֔ בַּ/מָּק֕וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְחַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ בּ֑/וֹ וּ/פָנִ֣יתָ בַ/בֹּ֔קֶר וְ/הָלַכְתָּ֖ לְ/אֹהָלֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vbshlt v'khlt bmqvm 'shr ybchr yhvh 'lhykh bv vpnyt bbqr vhlkht l'hlykh
verses.translation: And thou shalt roast and eat it in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose: and thou shalt turn in the morning, and go unto thy tents.

verses.original: שֵׁ֥שֶׁת יָמִ֖ים תֹּאכַ֣ל מַצּ֑וֹת וּ/בַ/יּ֣וֹם הַ/שְּׁבִיעִ֗י עֲצֶ֨רֶת֙ לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ לֹ֥א תַעֲשֶׂ֖ה מְלָאכָֽה
verses.translit: shsht ymym t'khl mtsvt vbyvm hshby'y 'tsrt lyhvh 'lhykh l' t'shh ml'khh
verses.translation: Six days thou shalt eat unleavened bread: and on the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to the LORD thy God: thou shalt do no work therein .

verses.original: שִׁבְעָ֥ה שָׁבֻעֹ֖ת תִּסְפָּר לָ֑/ךְ מֵ/הָחֵ֤ל חֶרְמֵשׁ֙ בַּ/קָּמָ֔ה תָּחֵ֣ל לִ/סְפֹּ֔ר שִׁבְעָ֖ה שָׁבֻעֽוֹת
verses.translit: shb'h shb't tspr lkh mhchl chrmsh bqmh tchl lspr shb'h shb'vt
verses.translation: Seven weeks shalt thou number unto thee: begin to number the seven weeks from such time as thou beginnest to put the sickle to the corn.

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֜יתָ חַ֤ג שָׁבֻעוֹת֙ לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ מִסַּ֛ת נִדְבַ֥ת יָדְ/ךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתֵּ֑ן כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְבָרֶכְ/ךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: v'shyt chg shb'vt lyhvh 'lhykh mst ndbt ydkh 'shr ttn kh'shr ybrkhkh yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: And thou shalt keep the feast of weeks unto the LORD thy God with a tribute of a freewill offering of thine hand, which thou shalt give unto the Lord thy God , according as the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:

verses.original: וְ/שָׂמַחְתָּ֞ לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י/ךָ אַתָּ֨ה וּ/בִנְ/ךָ֣ וּ/בִתֶּ/ךָ֮ וְ/עַבְדְּ/ךָ֣ וַ/אֲמָתֶ/ךָ֒ וְ/הַ/לֵּוִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בִּ/שְׁעָרֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/הַ/גֵּ֛ר וְ/הַ/יָּת֥וֹם וְ/הָ/אַלְמָנָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ/קִרְבֶּ֑/ךָ בַּ/מָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֤ר יִבְחַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ לְ/שַׁכֵּ֥ן שְׁמ֖/וֹ שָֽׁם
verses.translit: vshmcht lpny yhvh 'lhykh 'th vbnkh vbtkh v'bdkh v'mtkh vhlvy 'shr bsh'rykh vhgr vhytvm vh'lmnh 'shr bqrbkh bmqvm 'shr ybchr yhvh 'lhykh lshkhn shmv shm
verses.translation: And thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that is within thy gates, and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are among you, in the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to place his name there.

verses.original: וְ/זָ֣כַרְתָּ֔ כִּי עֶ֥בֶד הָיִ֖יתָ בְּ/מִצְרָ֑יִם וְ/שָׁמַרְתָּ֣ וְ/עָשִׂ֔יתָ אֶת הַֽ/חֻקִּ֖ים הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: vzkhrt khy 'bd hyyt bmtsrym vshmrt v'shyt 't hchqym h'lh
verses.translation: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt: and thou shalt observe and do these statutes.

verses.translit: chg hskht t'shh lkh shb't ymym b'spkh mgrnkh vmyqbkh
verses.translation: Thou shalt observe the feast of tabernacles seven days, after that thou hast gathered in thy corn and thy wine:

verses.translit: vshmcht bchgkh 'th vbnkh vbtkh v'bdkh v'mtkh vhlvy vhgr vhytvm vh'lmnh 'shr bsh'rykh
verses.translation: And thou shalt rejoice in thy feast, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite, the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are within thy gates.

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֗ים תָּחֹג֙ לַ/יהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ בַּ/מָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֣י יְבָרֶכְ/ךָ֞ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י/ךָ בְּ/כֹ֤ל תְּבוּאָֽתְ/ךָ֙ וּ/בְ/כֹל֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יָדֶ֔י/ךָ וְ/הָיִ֖יתָ אַ֥ךְ שָׂמֵֽחַ
verses.translit: shb't ymym tchg lyhvh 'lhykh bmqvm 'shr ybchr yhvh khy ybrkhkh yhvh 'lhykh bkhl tbv'tkh vbkhl m'shh ydykh vhyyt 'kh shmch
verses.translation: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD shall choose: because the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase, and in all the works of thine hands, therefore thou shalt surely rejoice.

verses.original: שָׁל֣וֹשׁ פְּעָמִ֣ים בַּ/שָּׁנָ֡ה יֵרָאֶ֨ה כָל זְכוּרְ/ךָ֜ אֶת פְּנֵ֣י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗י/ךָ בַּ/מָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִבְחָ֔ר בְּ/חַ֧ג הַ/מַּצּ֛וֹת וּ/בְ/חַ֥ג הַ/שָּׁבֻע֖וֹת וּ/בְ/חַ֣ג הַ/סֻּכּ֑וֹת וְ/לֹ֧א יֵרָאֶ֛ה אֶת פְּנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה רֵיקָֽם
verses.translit: shlvsh p'mym bshnh yr'h khl zkhvrkh 't pny yhvh 'lhykh bmqvm 'shr ybchr bchg hmtsvt vbchg hshb'vt vbchg hskhvt vl' yr'h 't pny yhvh ryqm
verses.translation: Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose; in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles: and they shall not appear before the LORD empty:

verses.original: אִ֖ישׁ כְּ/מַתְּנַ֣ת יָד֑/וֹ כְּ/בִרְכַּ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'ysh khmtnt ydv khbrkht yhvh 'lhykh 'shr ntn lkh
verses.translation: Every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee.

verses.original: שֹׁפְטִ֣ים וְ/שֹֽׁטְרִ֗ים תִּֽתֶּן לְ/ךָ֙ בְּ/כָל שְׁעָרֶ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛י/ךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְ/ךָ֖ לִ/שְׁבָטֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/שָׁפְט֥וּ אֶת הָ/עָ֖ם מִשְׁפַּט צֶֽדֶק
verses.translit: shptym vshtrym ttn lkh bkhl sh'rykh 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh lshbtykh vshptv 't h'm mshpt tsdq
verses.translation: Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, throughout thy tribes: and they shall judge the people with just judgment.

verses.original: לֹא תַטֶּ֣ה מִשְׁפָּ֔ט לֹ֥א תַכִּ֖יר פָּנִ֑ים וְ/לֹא תִקַּ֣ח שֹׁ֔חַד כִּ֣י הַ/שֹּׁ֗חַד יְעַוֵּר֙ עֵינֵ֣י חֲכָמִ֔ים וִֽ/יסַלֵּ֖ף דִּבְרֵ֥י צַדִּיקִֽם
verses.translit: l' tth mshpt l' tkhyr pnym vl' tqch shchd khy hshchd y'vr 'yny chkhmym vyslf dbry tsdyqm
verses.translation: Thou shalt not wrest judgment; thou shalt not respect persons, neither take a gift: for a gift doth blind the eyes of the wise, and pervert the words of the righteous.

verses.original: צֶ֥דֶק צֶ֖דֶק תִּרְדֹּ֑ף לְמַ֤עַן תִּֽחְיֶה֙ וְ/יָרַשְׁתָּ֣ אֶת הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: tsdq tsdq trdf lm'n tchyh vyrsht 't h'rts 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh
verses.translation: That which is altogether just shalt thou follow, that thou mayest live, and inherit the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.

verses.original: לֹֽא תִטַּ֥ע לְ/ךָ֛ אֲשֵׁרָ֖ה כָּל עֵ֑ץ אֵ֗צֶל מִזְבַּ֛ח יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶׂה לָּֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: l' tt' lkh 'shrh khl 'ts 'tsl mzbch yhvh 'lhykh 'shr t'shh lkh
verses.translation: Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the LORD thy God, which thou shalt make thee.

verses.original: וְ/לֹֽא תָקִ֥ים לְ/ךָ֖ מַצֵּבָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׂנֵ֖א יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: vl' tqym lkh mtsbh 'shr shn' yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: Neither shalt thou set thee up any image; which the LORD thy God hateth.

verses.original: לֹא תִזְבַּח֩ לַ/יהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜י/ךָ שׁ֣וֹר וָ/שֶׂ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה ב/וֹ֙ מ֔וּם כֹּ֖ל דָּבָ֣ר רָ֑ע כִּ֧י תוֹעֲבַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ הֽוּא
verses.translit: l' tzbch lyhvh 'lhykh shvr vshh 'shr yhyh bv mvm khl dbr r' khy tv'bt yhvh 'lhykh hv'
verses.translation: Thou shalt not sacrifice unto the LORD thy God any bullock, or sheep, wherein is blemish, or any evilfavouredness: for that is an abomination unto the LORD thy God.

verses.original: כִּֽי יִמָּצֵ֤א בְ/קִרְבְּ/ךָ֙ בְּ/אַחַ֣ד שְׁעָרֶ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֑/ךְ אִ֣ישׁ אוֹ אִשָּׁ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲשֶׂ֧ה אֶת הָ/רַ֛ע בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ לַ/עֲבֹ֥ר בְּרִיתֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy ymts' bqrbkh b'chd sh'rykh 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh 'ysh 'v 'shh 'shr y'shh 't hr' b'yny yhvh 'lhykh l'br brytv
verses.translation: If there be found among you, within any of thy gates which the LORD thy God giveth thee, man or woman, that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the LORD thy God, in transgressing his covenant,

verses.original: וַ/יֵּ֗לֶךְ וַֽ/יַּעֲבֹד֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַ/יִּשְׁתַּ֖חוּ לָ/הֶ֑ם וְ/לַ/שֶּׁ֣מֶשׁ א֣וֹ לַ/יָּרֵ֗חַ א֛וֹ לְ/כָל צְבָ֥א הַ/שָּׁמַ֖יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא צִוִּֽיתִי
verses.translit: vylkh vy'bd 'lhym 'chrym vyshtchv lhm vlshmsh 'v lyrch 'v lkhl tsb' hshmym 'shr l' tsvyty
verses.translation: And hath gone and served other gods, and worshipped them, either the sun, or moon, or any of the host of heaven, which I have not commanded;

verses.original: וְ/הֻֽגַּד לְ/ךָ֖ וְ/שָׁמָ֑עְתָּ וְ/דָרַשְׁתָּ֣ הֵיטֵ֔ב וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה אֱמֶת֙ נָכ֣וֹן הַ/דָּבָ֔ר נֶעֶשְׂתָ֛ה הַ/תּוֹעֵבָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֖את בְּ/יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vhgd lkh vshm't vdrsht hytb vhnh 'mt nkhvn hdbr n'shth htv'bh hz't byshr'l
verses.translation: And it be told thee, and thou hast heard of it , and enquired diligently, and, behold, it be true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought in Israel:

verses.original: וְ/הֽוֹצֵאתָ֣ אֶת הָ/אִ֣ישׁ הַ/ה֡וּא אוֹ֩ אֶת הָ/אִשָּׁ֨ה הַ/הִ֜וא אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָ֠שׂוּ אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֨ר הָ/רָ֤ע הַ/זֶּה֙ אֶל שְׁעָרֶ֔י/ךָ אֶת הָ/אִ֕ישׁ א֖וֹ אֶת הָ/אִשָּׁ֑ה וּ/סְקַלְתָּ֥/ם בָּ/אֲבָנִ֖ים וָ/מֵֽתוּ
verses.translit: vhvts't 't h'ysh hhv' 'v 't h'shh hhv' 'shr 'shv 't hdbr hr' hzh 'l sh'rykh 't h'ysh 'v 't h'shh vsqltm b'bnym vmtv
verses.translation: Then shalt thou bring forth that man or that woman, which have committed that wicked thing, unto thy gates, even that man or that woman, and shalt stone them with stones, till they die.

verses.original: עַל פִּ֣י שְׁנַ֣יִם עֵדִ֗ים א֛וֹ שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה עֵדִ֖ים יוּמַ֣ת הַ/מֵּ֑ת לֹ֣א יוּמַ֔ת עַל פִּ֖י עֵ֥ד אֶחָֽד
verses.translit: 'l py shnym 'dym 'v shlshh 'dym yvmt hmt l' yvmt 'l py 'd 'chd
verses.translation: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, shall he that is worthy of death be put to death; but at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.

verses.original: יַ֣ד הָ/עֵדִ֞ים תִּֽהְיֶה בּ֤/וֹ בָ/רִאשֹׁנָה֙ לַ/הֲמִית֔/וֹ וְ/יַ֥ד כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם בָּ/אַחֲרֹנָ֑ה וּ/בִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָ/רָ֖ע מִ/קִּרְבֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: yd h'dym thyh bv br'shnh lhmytv vyd khl h'm b'chrnh vb'rt hr' mqrbkh
verses.translation: The hands of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So thou shalt put the evil away from among you.

verses.original: כִּ֣י יִפָּלֵא֩ מִמְּ/ךָ֨ דָבָ֜ר לַ/מִּשְׁפָּ֗ט בֵּֽין דָּ֨ם לְ/דָ֜ם בֵּֽין דִּ֣ין לְ/דִ֗ין וּ/בֵ֥ין נֶ֨גַע֙ לָ/נֶ֔גַע דִּבְרֵ֥י רִיבֹ֖ת בִּ/שְׁעָרֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/קַמְתָּ֣ וְ/עָלִ֔יתָ אֶל הַ/מָּק֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְחַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ בּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy ypl' mmkh dbr lmshpt byn dm ldm byn dyn ldyn vbyn ng' lng' dbry rybt bsh'rykh vqmt v'lyt 'l hmqvm 'shr ybchr yhvh 'lhykh bv
verses.translation: If there arise a matter too hard for thee in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within thy gates: then shalt thou arise, and get thee up into the place which the LORD thy God shall choose;

verses.original: וּ/בָאתָ֗ אֶל הַ/כֹּהֲנִים֙ הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם וְ/אֶל הַ/שֹּׁפֵ֔ט אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְיֶ֖ה בַּ/יָּמִ֣ים הָ/הֵ֑ם וְ/דָרַשְׁתָּ֙ וְ/הִגִּ֣ידוּ לְ/ךָ֔ אֵ֖ת דְּבַ֥ר הַ/מִּשְׁפָּֽט
verses.translit: vb't 'l hkhhnym hlvym v'l hshpt 'shr yhyh bymym hhm vdrsht vhgydv lkh 't dbr hmshpt
verses.translation: And thou shalt come unto the priests the Levites, and unto the judge that shall be in those days, and enquire; and they shall shew thee the sentence of judgment:

verses.original: וְ/עָשִׂ֗יתָ עַל פִּ֤י הַ/דָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַגִּ֣ידֽוּ לְ/ךָ֔ מִן הַ/מָּק֣וֹם הַ/ה֔וּא אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִבְחַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וְ/שָׁמַרְתָּ֣ לַ/עֲשׂ֔וֹת כְּ/כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹרֽוּ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'shyt 'l py hdbr 'shr ygydv lkh mn hmqvm hhv' 'shr ybchr yhvh vshmrt l'shvt khkhl 'shr yvrvkh
verses.translation: And thou shalt do according to the sentence, which they of that place which the LORD shall choose shall shew thee; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform thee:

verses.original: עַל פִּ֨י הַ/תּוֹרָ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר יוֹר֗וּ/ךָ וְ/עַל הַ/מִּשְׁפָּ֛ט אֲשֶׁר יֹאמְר֥וּ לְ/ךָ֖ תַּעֲשֶׂ֑ה לֹ֣א תָס֗וּר מִן הַ/דָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר יַגִּ֥ידֽוּ לְ/ךָ֖ יָמִ֥ין וּ/שְׂמֹֽאל
verses.translit: 'l py htvrh 'shr yvrvkh v'l hmshpt 'shr y'mrv lkh t'shh l' tsvr mn hdbr 'shr ygydv lkh ymyn vshm'l
verses.translation: According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach thee, and according to the judgment which they shall tell thee, thou shalt do: thou shalt not decline from the sentence which they shall shew thee, to the right hand, nor to the left.

verses.original: וְ/הָ/אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה בְ/זָד֗וֹן לְ/בִלְתִּ֨י שְׁמֹ֤עַ אֶל הַ/כֹּהֵן֙ הָ/עֹמֵ֞ד לְ/שָׁ֤רֶת שָׁם֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ א֖וֹ אֶל הַ/שֹּׁפֵ֑ט וּ/מֵת֙ הָ/אִ֣ישׁ הַ/ה֔וּא וּ/בִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָ/רָ֖ע מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: vh'ysh 'shr y'shh bzdvn lblty shm' 'l hkhhn h'md lshrt shm 't yhvh 'lhykh 'v 'l hshpt vmt h'ysh hhv' vb'rt hr' myshr'l
verses.translation: And the man that will do presumptuously, and will not hearken unto the priest that standeth to minister there before the LORD thy God, or unto the judge, even that man shall die: and thou shalt put away the evil from Israel.

verses.original: וְ/כָל הָ/עָ֖ם יִשְׁמְע֣וּ וְ/יִרָ֑אוּ וְ/לֹ֥א יְזִיד֖וּ/ן עֽוֹד
verses.translit: vkhl h'm yshm'v vyr'v vl' yzydvn 'vd
verses.translation: And all the people shall hear, and fear, and do no more presumptuously.

verses.original: כִּֽי תָבֹ֣א אֶל הָ/אָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֔/ךְ וִֽ/ירִשְׁתָּ֖/הּ וְ/יָשַׁ֣בְתָּה בָּ֑/הּ וְ/אָמַרְתָּ֗ אָשִׂ֤ימָה עָלַ/י֙ מֶ֔לֶךְ כְּ/כָל הַ/גּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר סְבִיבֹתָֽ/י
verses.translit: khy tb' 'l h'rts 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh vyrshth vyshbth bh v'mrt 'shymh 'ly mlkh khkhl hgvym 'shr sbybty
verses.translation: When thou art come unto the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, and shalt possess it, and shalt dwell therein, and shalt say, I will set a king over me, like as all the nations that are about me;

verses.original: שׂ֣וֹם תָּשִׂ֤ים עָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ מֶ֔לֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְחַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ בּ֑/וֹ מִ/קֶּ֣רֶב אַחֶ֗י/ךָ תָּשִׂ֤ים עָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ מֶ֔לֶךְ לֹ֣א תוּכַ֗ל לָ/תֵ֤ת עָלֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אִ֣ישׁ נָכְרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא אָחִ֖י/ךָ הֽוּא
verses.translit: shvm tshym 'lykh mlkh 'shr ybchr yhvh 'lhykh bv mqrb 'chykh tshym 'lykh mlkh l' tvkhl ltt 'lykh 'ysh nkhry 'shr l' 'chykh hv'
verses.translation: Thou shalt in any wise set him king over thee, whom the LORD thy God shall choose: one from among thy brethren shalt thou set king over thee: thou mayest not set a stranger over thee, which is not thy brother.

verses.original: רַק֮ לֹא יַרְבֶּה לּ֣/וֹ סוּסִים֒ וְ/לֹֽא יָשִׁ֤יב אֶת הָ/עָם֙ מִצְרַ֔יְמָ/ה לְמַ֖עַן הַרְבּ֣וֹת ס֑וּס וַֽ/יהוָה֙ אָמַ֣ר לָ/כֶ֔ם לֹ֣א תֹסִפ֗וּ/ן לָ/שׁ֛וּב בַּ/דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַ/זֶּ֖ה עֽוֹד
verses.translit: rq l' yrbh lv svsym vl' yshyb 't h'm mtsrymh lm'n hrbvt svs vyhvh 'mr lkhm l' tspvn lshvb bdrkh hzh 'vd
verses.translation: But he shall not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he should multiply horses: forasmuch as the LORD hath said unto you, Ye shall henceforth return no more that way.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֤א יַרְבֶּה לּ/וֹ֙ נָשִׁ֔ים וְ/לֹ֥א יָס֖וּר לְבָב֑/וֹ וְ/כֶ֣סֶף וְ/זָהָ֔ב לֹ֥א יַרְבֶּה לּ֖/וֹ מְאֹֽד
verses.translit: vl' yrbh lv nshym vl' ysvr lbbv vkhsf vzhb l' yrbh lv m'd
verses.translation: Neither shall he multiply wives to himself, that his heart turn not away: neither shall he greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה כְ/שִׁבְתּ֔/וֹ עַ֖ל כִּסֵּ֣א מַמְלַכְתּ֑/וֹ וְ/כָ֨תַב ל֜/וֹ אֶת מִשְׁנֵ֨ה הַ/תּוֹרָ֤ה הַ/זֹּאת֙ עַל סֵ֔פֶר מִ/לִּ/פְנֵ֥י הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֖ים הַ/לְוִיִּֽם
verses.translit: vhyh khshbtv 'l khs' mmlkhtv vkhtb lv 't mshnh htvrh hz't 'l spr mlpny hkhhnym hlvym
verses.translation: And it shall be, when he sitteth upon the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write him a copy of this law in a book out of that which is before the priests the Levites:

verses.original: וְ/הָיְתָ֣ה עִמּ֔/וֹ וְ/קָ֥רָא ב֖/וֹ כָּל יְמֵ֣י חַיָּ֑י/ו לְמַ֣עַן יִלְמַ֗ד לְ/יִרְאָה֙ אֶת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י/ו לִ֠/שְׁמֹר אֶֽת כָּל דִּבְרֵ֞י הַ/תּוֹרָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֛את וְ/אֶת הַ/חֻקִּ֥ים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה לַ/עֲשֹׂתָֽ/ם
verses.translit: vhyth 'mv vqr' bv khl ymy chyyv lm'n ylmd lyr'h 't yhvh 'lhyv lshmr 't khl dbry htvrh hz't v't hchqym h'lh l'shtm
verses.translation: And it shall be with him, and he shall read therein all the days of his life: that he may learn to fear the LORD his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them:

verses.original: לְ/בִלְתִּ֤י רוּם לְבָב/וֹ֙ מֵֽ/אֶחָ֔י/ו וּ/לְ/בִלְתִּ֛י ס֥וּר מִן הַ/מִּצְוָ֖ה יָמִ֣ין וּ/שְׂמֹ֑אול לְמַעַן֩ יַאֲרִ֨יךְ יָמִ֧ים עַל מַמְלַכְתּ֛/וֹ ה֥וּא וּ/בָנָ֖י/ו בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
verses.translit: lblty rvm lbbv m'chyv vlblty svr mn hmtsvh ymyn vshm'vl lm'n y'rykh ymym 'l mmlkhtv hv' vbnyv bqrb yshr'l
verses.translation: That his heart be not lifted up above his brethren, and that he turn not aside from the commandment, to the right hand, or to the left: to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he, and his children, in the midst of Israel.

verses.original: לֹֽא יִ֠הְיֶה לַ/כֹּהֲנִ֨ים הַ/לְוִיִּ֜ם כָּל שֵׁ֧בֶט לֵוִ֛י חֵ֥לֶק וְ/נַחֲלָ֖ה עִם יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִשֵּׁ֧י יְהוָ֛ה וְ/נַחֲלָת֖/וֹ יֹאכֵלֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: l' yhyh lkhhnym hlvym khl shbt lvy chlq vnchlh 'm yshr'l 'shy yhvh vnchltv y'khlvn
verses.translation: The priests the Levites, and all the tribe of Levi, shall have no part nor inheritance with Israel: they shall eat the offerings of the LORD made by fire, and his inheritance.

verses.original: וְ/נַחֲלָ֥ה לֹא יִֽהְיֶה לּ֖/וֹ בְּ/קֶ֣רֶב אֶחָ֑י/ו יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָת֔/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר לֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vnchlh l' yhyh lv bqrb 'chyv yhvh hv' nchltv kh'shr dbr lv
verses.translation: Therefore shall they have no inheritance among their brethren: the LORD is their inheritance, as he hath said unto them.

verses.original: וְ/זֶ֡ה יִהְיֶה֩ מִשְׁפַּ֨ט הַ/כֹּהֲנִ֜ים מֵ/אֵ֣ת הָ/עָ֗ם מֵ/אֵ֛ת זֹבְחֵ֥י הַ/זֶּ֖בַח אִם שׁ֣וֹר אִם שֶׂ֑ה וְ/נָתַן֙ לַ/כֹּהֵ֔ן הַ/זְּרֹ֥עַ וְ/הַ/לְּחָיַ֖יִם וְ/הַ/קֵּבָֽה
verses.translit: vzh yhyh mshpt hkhhnym m't h'm m't zbchy hzbch 'm shvr 'm shh vntn lkhhn hzr' vhlchyym vhqbh
verses.translation: And this shall be the priest’s due from the people, from them that offer a sacrifice, whether it be ox or sheep; and they shall give unto the priest the shoulder, and the two cheeks, and the maw.

verses.original: רֵאשִׁ֨ית דְּגָֽנְ/ךָ֜ תִּֽירֹשְׁ/ךָ֣ וְ/יִצְהָרֶ֗/ךָ וְ/רֵאשִׁ֛ית גֵּ֥ז צֹאנְ/ךָ֖ תִּתֶּן לּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: r'shyt dgnkh tyrshkh vytshrkh vr'shyt gz ts'nkh ttn lv
verses.translation: The firstfruit also of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the first of the fleece of thy sheep, shalt thou give him.

verses.original: כִּ֣י ב֗/וֹ בָּחַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ מִ/כָּל שְׁבָטֶ֑י/ךָ לַ/עֲמֹ֨ד לְ/שָׁרֵ֧ת בְּ/שֵׁם יְהוָ֛ה ה֥וּא וּ/בָנָ֖י/ו כָּל הַ/יָּמִֽים
verses.translit: khy bv bchr yhvh 'lhykh mkhl shbtykh l'md lshrt bshm yhvh hv' vbnyv khl hymym
verses.translation: For the LORD thy God hath chosen him out of all thy tribes, to stand to minister in the name of the LORD , him and his sons for ever.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יָבֹ֨א הַ/לֵּוִ֜י מֵ/אַחַ֤ד שְׁעָרֶ֨י/ךָ֙ מִ/כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁר ה֖וּא גָּ֣ר שָׁ֑ם וּ/בָא֙ בְּ/כָל אַוַּ֣ת נַפְשׁ֔/וֹ אֶל הַ/מָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַ֥ר יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vkhy yb' hlvy m'chd sh'rykh mkhl yshr'l 'shr hv' gr shm vb' bkhl 'vt npshv 'l hmqvm 'shr ybchr yhvh
verses.translation: And if a Levite come from any of thy gates out of all Israel, where he sojourned, and come with all the desire of his mind unto the place which the LORD shall choose;

verses.original: וְ/שֵׁרֵ֕ת בְּ/שֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י/ו כְּ/כָל אֶחָי/ו֙ הַ/לְוִיִּ֔ם הָ/עֹמְדִ֥ים שָׁ֖ם לִ/פְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vshrt bshm yhvh 'lhyv khkhl 'chyv hlvym h'mdym shm lpny yhvh
verses.translation: Then he shall minister in the name of the LORD his God, as all his brethren the Levites do , which stand there before the LORD .

verses.original: חֵ֥לֶק כְּ/חֵ֖לֶק יֹאכֵ֑לוּ לְ/בַ֥ד מִמְכָּרָ֖י/ו עַל הָ/אָבֽוֹת
verses.translit: chlq khchlq y'khlv lbd mmkhryv 'l h'bvt
verses.translation: They shall have like portions to eat, beside that which cometh of the sale of his patrimony.

verses.original: כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ בָּ֣א אֶל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֑/ךְ לֹֽא תִלְמַ֣ד לַ/עֲשׂ֔וֹת כְּ/תוֹעֲבֹ֖ת הַ/גּוֹיִ֥ם הָ/הֵֽם
verses.translit: khy 'th b' 'l h'rts 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh l' tlmd l'shvt khtv'bt hgvym hhm
verses.translation: When thou art come into the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not learn to do after the abominations of those nations.

verses.original: לֹֽא יִמָּצֵ֣א בְ/ךָ֔ מַעֲבִ֥יר בְּנֽ/וֹ וּ/בִתּ֖/וֹ בָּ/אֵ֑שׁ קֹסֵ֣ם קְסָמִ֔ים מְעוֹנֵ֥ן וּ/מְנַחֵ֖שׁ וּ/מְכַשֵּֽׁף
verses.translit: l' ymts' bkh m'byr bnv vbtv b'sh qsm qsmym m'vnn vmnchsh vmkhshf
verses.translation: There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, or that useth divination, or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch,

verses.original: וְ/חֹבֵ֖ר חָ֑בֶר וְ/שֹׁאֵ֥ל אוֹב֙ וְ/יִדְּעֹנִ֔י וְ/דֹרֵ֖שׁ אֶל הַ/מֵּתִֽים
verses.translit: vchbr chbr vsh'l 'vb vyd'ny vdrsh 'l hmtym
verses.translation: Or a charmer, or a consulter with familiar spirits, or a wizard, or a necromancer.

verses.original: כִּֽי תוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה כָּל עֹ֣שֵׂה אֵ֑לֶּה וּ/בִ/גְלַל֙ הַ/תּוֹעֵבֹ֣ת הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ מוֹרִ֥ישׁ אוֹתָ֖/ם מִ/פָּנֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khy tv'bt yhvh khl 'shh 'lh vbgll htv'bt h'lh yhvh 'lhykh mvrysh 'vtm mpnykh
verses.translation: For all that do these things are an abomination unto the LORD : and because of these abominations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee.

verses.original: תָּמִ֣ים תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה עִ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: tmym thyh 'm yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: Thou shalt be perfect with the LORD thy God.

verses.original: כִּ֣י הַ/גּוֹיִ֣ם הָ/אֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ יוֹרֵ֣שׁ אוֹתָ֔/ם אֶל מְעֹנְנִ֥ים וְ/אֶל קֹסְמִ֖ים יִשְׁמָ֑עוּ וְ/אַתָּ֕ה לֹ֣א כֵ֔ן נָ֛תַן לְ/ךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khy hgvym h'lh 'shr 'th yvrsh 'vtm 'l m'nnym v'l qsmym yshm'v v'th l' khn ntn lkh yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: For these nations, which thou shalt possess, hearkened unto observers of times, and unto diviners: but as for thee, the LORD thy God hath not suffered thee so to do .

verses.original: נָבִ֨יא מִ/קִּרְבְּ/ךָ֤ מֵ/אַחֶ֨י/ךָ֙ כָּמֹ֔/נִי יָקִ֥ים לְ/ךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ אֵלָ֖י/ו תִּשְׁמָעֽוּ/ן
verses.translit: nby' mqrbkh m'chykh khmny yqym lkh yhvh 'lhykh 'lyv tshm'vn
verses.translation: The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken;

verses.original: כְּ/כֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁר שָׁאַ֜לְתָּ מֵ/עִ֨ם יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ בְּ/חֹרֵ֔ב בְּ/י֥וֹם הַ/קָּהָ֖ל לֵ/אמֹ֑ר לֹ֣א אֹסֵ֗ף לִ/שְׁמֹ֨עַ֙ אֶת קוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔/י וְ/אֶת הָ/אֵ֨שׁ הַ/גְּדֹלָ֥ה הַ/זֹּ֛את לֹֽא אֶרְאֶ֥ה ע֖וֹד וְ/לֹ֥א אָמֽוּת
verses.translit: khkhl 'shr sh'lt m'm yhvh 'lhykh bchrb byvm hqhl l'mr l' 'sf lshm' 't qvl yhvh 'lhy v't h'sh hgdlh hz't l' 'r'h 'vd vl' 'mvt
verses.translation: According to all that thou desiredst of the LORD thy God in Horeb in the day of the assembly, saying, Let me not hear again the voice of the LORD my God, neither let me see this great fire any more, that I die not.

verses.original: וַ/יֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָ֑/י הֵיטִ֖יבוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽרוּ
verses.translit: vy'mr yhvh 'ly hytybv 'shr dbrv
verses.translation: And the LORD said unto me, They have well spoken that which they have spoken.

verses.original: נָבִ֨יא אָקִ֥ים לָ/הֶ֛ם מִ/קֶּ֥רֶב אֲחֵי/הֶ֖ם כָּמ֑וֹ/ךָ וְ/נָתַתִּ֤י דְבָרַ/י֙ בְּ/פִ֔י/ו וְ/דִבֶּ֣ר אֲלֵי/הֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת כָּל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲצַוֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: nby' 'qym lhm mqrb 'chyhm khmvkh vntty dbry bpyv vdbr 'lyhm 't khl 'shr 'tsvnv
verses.translation: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren, like unto thee, and will put my words in his mouth; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה הָ/אִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא יִשְׁמַע֙ אֶל דְּבָרַ֔/י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְדַבֵּ֖ר בִּ/שְׁמִ֑/י אָנֹכִ֖י אֶדְרֹ֥שׁ מֵ/עִמּֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vhyh h'ysh 'shr l' yshm' 'l dbry 'shr ydbr bshmy 'nkhy 'drsh m'mv
verses.translation: And it shall come to pass, that whosoever will not hearken unto my words which he shall speak in my name, I will require it of him.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ הַ/נָּבִ֡יא אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָזִיד֩ לְ/דַבֵּ֨ר דָּבָ֜ר בִּ/שְׁמִ֗/י אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא צִוִּיתִי/ו֙ לְ/דַבֵּ֔ר וַ/אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְדַבֵּ֔ר בְּ/שֵׁ֖ם אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים וּ/מֵ֖ת הַ/נָּבִ֥יא הַ/הֽוּא
verses.translit: 'kh hnby' 'shr yzyd ldbr dbr bshmy 't 'shr l' tsvytyv ldbr v'shr ydbr bshm 'lhym 'chrym vmt hnby' hhv'
verses.translation: But the prophet, which shall presume to speak a word in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or that shall speak in the name of other gods, even that prophet shall die.

verses.original: וְ/כִ֥י תֹאמַ֖ר בִּ/לְבָבֶ֑/ךָ אֵיכָה֙ נֵדַ֣ע אֶת הַ/דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא דִבְּר֖/וֹ יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: vkhy t'mr blbbkh 'ykhh nd' 't hdbr 'shr l' dbrv yhvh
verses.translation: And if thou say in thine heart, How shall we know the word which the LORD hath not spoken?

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר֩ יְדַבֵּ֨ר הַ/נָּבִ֜יא בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֗ה וְ/לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֤ה הַ/דָּבָר֙ וְ/לֹ֣א יָב֔וֹא ה֣וּא הַ/דָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא דִבְּר֖/וֹ יְהוָ֑ה בְּ/זָדוֹן֙ דִּבְּר֣/וֹ הַ/נָּבִ֔יא לֹ֥א תָג֖וּר מִמֶּֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: 'shr ydbr hnby' bshm yhvh vl' yhyh hdbr vl' ybv' hv' hdbr 'shr l' dbrv yhvh bzdvn dbrv hnby' l' tgvr mmnv
verses.translation: When a prophet speaketh in the name of the LORD , if the thing follow not, nor come to pass, that is the thing which the LORD hath not spoken, but the prophet hath spoken it presumptuously: thou shalt not be afraid of him.

verses.original: כִּֽי יַכְרִ֞ית יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֶת הַ/גּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְ/ךָ֖ אֶת אַרְצָ֑/ם וִֽ/ירִשְׁתָּ֕/ם וְ/יָשַׁבְתָּ֥ בְ/עָרֵי/הֶ֖ם וּ/בְ/בָתֵּי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: khy ykhryt yhvh 'lhykh 't hgvym 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh 't 'rtsm vyrshtm vyshbt b'ryhm vbbtyhm
verses.translation: When the LORD thy God hath cut off the nations, whose land the LORD thy God giveth thee, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their cities, and in their houses;

verses.original: שָׁל֥וֹשׁ עָרִ֖ים תַּבְדִּ֣יל לָ֑/ךְ בְּ/ת֣וֹךְ אַרְצְ/ךָ֔ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְ/ךָ֖ לְ/רִשְׁתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: shlvsh 'rym tbdyl lkh btvkh 'rtskh 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh lrshth
verses.translation: Thou shalt separate three cities for thee in the midst of thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it.

verses.original: תָּכִ֣ין לְ/ךָ֮ הַ/דֶּרֶךְ֒ וְ/שִׁלַּשְׁתָּ֙ אֶת גְּב֣וּל אַרְצְ/ךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַנְחִֽילְ/ךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/הָיָ֕ה לָ/נ֥וּס שָׁ֖מָּ/ה כָּל רֹצֵֽחַ
verses.translit: tkhyn lkh hdrkh vshlsht 't gbvl 'rtskh 'shr ynchylkh yhvh 'lhykh vhyh lnvs shmh khl rtsch
verses.translation: Thou shalt prepare thee a way, and divide the coasts of thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee to inherit, into three parts, that every slayer may flee thither.

verses.original: וְ/זֶה֙ דְּבַ֣ר הָ/רֹצֵ֔חַ אֲשֶׁר יָנ֥וּס שָׁ֖מָּ/ה וָ/חָ֑י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַכֶּ֤ה אֶת רֵעֵ֨/הוּ֙ בִּ/בְלִי דַ֔עַת וְ/ה֛וּא לֹא שֹׂנֵ֥א ל֖/וֹ מִ/תְּמֹ֥ל שִׁלְשֹֽׁם
verses.translit: vzh dbr hrtsch 'shr ynvs shmh vchy 'shr ykhh 't r'hv bbly d't vhv' l' shn' lv mtml shlshm
verses.translation: And this is the case of the slayer, which shall flee thither, that he may live: Whoso killeth his neighbour ignorantly, whom he hated not in time past;

verses.original: וַ/אֲשֶׁר֩ יָבֹ֨א אֶת רֵעֵ֥/הוּ בַ/יַּעַר֮ לַ/חְטֹ֣ב עֵצִים֒ וְ/נִדְּחָ֨ה יָד֤/וֹ בַ/גַּרְזֶן֙ לִ/כְרֹ֣ת הָ/עֵ֔ץ וְ/נָשַׁ֤ל הַ/בַּרְזֶל֙ מִן הָ/עֵ֔ץ וּ/מָצָ֥א אֶת רֵעֵ֖/הוּ וָ/מֵ֑ת ה֗וּא יָנ֛וּס אֶל אַחַ֥ת הֶ/עָרִים הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה וָ/חָֽי
verses.translit: v'shr yb' 't r'hv by'r lchtb 'tsym vndchh ydv bgrzn lkhrt h'ts vnshl hbrzl mn h'ts vmts' 't r'hv vmt hv' ynvs 'l 'cht h'rym h'lh vchy
verses.translation: As when a man goeth into the wood with his neighbour to hew wood, and his hand fetcheth a stroke with the axe to cut down the tree, and the head slippeth from the helve, and lighteth upon his neighbour, that he die; he shall flee unto one of those cities, and live:

verses.original: פֶּן יִרְדֹּף֩ גֹּאֵ֨ל הַ/דָּ֜ם אַחֲרֵ֣י הָ/רֹצֵ֗חַ כִּי יֵחַם֮ לְבָב/וֹ֒ וְ/הִשִּׂיג֛/וֹ כִּֽי יִרְבֶּ֥ה הַ/דֶּ֖רֶךְ וְ/הִכָּ֣ה/וּ נָ֑פֶשׁ וְ/ל/וֹ֙ אֵ֣ין מִשְׁפַּט מָ֔וֶת כִּ֠י לֹ֣א שֹׂנֵ֥א ה֛וּא ל֖/וֹ מִ/תְּמ֥וֹל שִׁלְשֽׁוֹם
verses.translit: pn yrdf g'l hdm 'chry hrtsch khy ychm lbbv vhshygv khy yrbh hdrkh vhkhhv npsh vlv 'yn mshpt mvt khy l' shn' hv' lv mtmvl shlshvm
verses.translation: Lest the avenger of the blood pursue the slayer, while his heart is hot, and overtake him, because the way is long, and slay him; whereas he was not worthy of death, inasmuch as he hated him not in time past.

verses.original: עַל כֵּ֛ן אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֖ לֵ/אמֹ֑ר שָׁלֹ֥שׁ עָרִ֖ים תַּבְדִּ֥יל לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: 'l khn 'nkhy mtsvkh l'mr shlsh 'rym tbdyl lkh
verses.translation: Wherefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt separate three cities for thee.

verses.original: וְ/אִם יַרְחִ֞יב יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ אֶת גְּבֻ֣לְ/ךָ֔ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַ/אֲבֹתֶ֑י/ךָ וְ/נָ֤תַן לְ/ךָ֙ אֶת כָּל הָ/אָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר לָ/תֵ֥ת לַ/אֲבֹתֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: v'm yrchyb yhvh 'lhykh 't gblkh kh'shr nshb' l'btykh vntn lkh 't khl h'rts 'shr dbr ltt l'btykh
verses.translation: And if the LORD thy God enlarge thy coast, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, and give thee all the land which he promised to give unto thy fathers;

verses.original: כִּֽי תִשְׁמֹר֩ אֶת כָּל הַ/מִּצְוָ֨ה הַ/זֹּ֜את לַ/עֲשֹׂתָ֗/הּ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֣י מְצַוְּ/ךָ֮ הַ/יּוֹם֒ לְ/אַהֲבָ֞ה אֶת יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛י/ךָ וְ/לָ/לֶ֥כֶת בִּ/דְרָכָ֖י/ו כָּל הַ/יָּמִ֑ים וְ/יָסַפְתָּ֨ לְ/ךָ֥ עוֹד֙ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ עָרִ֔ים עַ֖ל הַ/שָּׁלֹ֥שׁ הָ/אֵֽלֶּה
verses.translit: khy tshmr 't khl hmtsvh hz't l'shth 'shr 'nkhy mtsvkh hyvm l'hbh 't yhvh 'lhykh vllkht bdrkhyv khl hymym vyspt lkh 'vd shlsh 'rym 'l hshlsh h'lh
verses.translation: If thou shalt keep all these commandments to do them, which I command thee this day, to love the LORD thy God, and to walk ever in his ways; then shalt thou add three cities more for thee, beside these three:

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֤א יִשָּׁפֵךְ֙ דָּ֣ם נָקִ֔י בְּ/קֶ֣רֶב אַרְצְ/ךָ֔ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְ/ךָ֖ נַחֲלָ֑ה וְ/הָיָ֥ה עָלֶ֖י/ךָ דָּמִֽים
verses.translit: vl' yshpkh dm nqy bqrb 'rtskh 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh nchlh vhyh 'lykh dmym
verses.translation: That innocent blood be not shed in thy land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance, and so blood be upon thee.

verses.original: וְ/כִֽי יִהְיֶ֥ה אִישׁ֙ שֹׂנֵ֣א לְ/רֵעֵ֔/הוּ וְ/אָ֤רַב ל/וֹ֙ וְ/קָ֣ם עָלָ֔י/ו וְ/הִכָּ֥ה/וּ נֶ֖פֶשׁ וָ/מֵ֑ת וְ/נָ֕ס אֶל אַחַ֖ת הֶ/עָרִ֥ים הָ/אֵֽל
verses.translit: vkhy yhyh 'ysh shn' lr'hv v'rb lv vqm 'lyv vhkhhv npsh vmt vns 'l 'cht h'rym h'l
verses.translation: But if any man hate his neighbour, and lie in wait for him, and rise up against him, and smite him mortally that he die, and fleeth into one of these cities:

verses.original: וְ/שָֽׁלְחוּ֙ זִקְנֵ֣י עִיר֔/וֹ וְ/לָקְח֥וּ אֹת֖/וֹ מִ/שָּׁ֑ם וְ/נָתְנ֣וּ אֹת֗/וֹ בְּ/יַ֛ד גֹּאֵ֥ל הַ/דָּ֖ם וָ/מֵֽת
verses.translit: vshlchv zqny 'yrv vlqchv 'tv mshm vntnv 'tv byd g'l hdm vmt
verses.translation: Then the elders of his city shall send and fetch him thence, and deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, that he may die.

verses.original: לֹא תָח֥וֹס עֵֽינְ/ךָ֖ עָלָ֑י/ו וּ/בִֽעַרְתָּ֧ דַֽם הַ/נָּקִ֛י מִ/יִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וְ/ט֥וֹב לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: l' tchvs 'ynkh 'lyv vb'rt dm hnqy myshr'l vtvb lkh
verses.translation: Thine eye shall not pity him, but thou shalt put away the guilt of innocent blood from Israel, that it may go well with thee.

verses.original: לֹ֤א תַסִּיג֙ גְּב֣וּל רֵֽעֲ/ךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֥ר גָּבְל֖וּ רִאשֹׁנִ֑ים בְּ/נַחֲלָֽתְ/ךָ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּנְחַ֔ל בָּ/אָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְ/ךָ֖ לְ/רִשְׁתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: l' tsyg gbvl r'kh 'shr gblv r'shnym bnchltkh 'shr tnchl b'rts 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh lrshth
verses.translation: Thou shalt not remove thy neighbour’s landmark, which they of old time have set in thine inheritance, which thou shalt inherit in the land that the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it.

verses.original: לֹֽא יָקוּם֩ עֵ֨ד אֶחָ֜ד בְּ/אִ֗ישׁ לְ/כָל עָוֺן֙ וּ/לְ/כָל חַטָּ֔את בְּ/כָל חֵ֖טְא אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֶֽחֱטָ֑א עַל פִּ֣י שְׁנֵ֣י עֵדִ֗ים א֛וֹ עַל פִּ֥י שְׁלֹשָֽׁה עֵדִ֖ים יָק֥וּם דָּבָֽר
verses.translit: l' yqvm 'd 'chd b'ysh lkhl 'vn vlkhl cht't bkhl cht' 'shr ycht' 'l py shny 'dym 'v 'l py shlshh 'dym yqvm dbr
verses.translation: One witness shall not rise up against a man for any iniquity, or for any sin, in any sin that he sinneth: at the mouth of two witnesses, or at the mouth of three witnesses, shall the matter be established.

verses.original: כִּֽי יָק֥וּם עֵד חָמָ֖ס בְּ/אִ֑ישׁ לַ/עֲנ֥וֹת בּ֖/וֹ סָרָֽה
verses.translit: khy yqvm 'd chms b'ysh l'nvt bv srh
verses.translation: If a false witness rise up against any man to testify against him that which is wrong;

verses.original: וְ/עָמְד֧וּ שְׁנֵֽי הָ/אֲנָשִׁ֛ים אֲשֶׁר לָ/הֶ֥ם הָ/רִ֖יב לִ/פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לִ/פְנֵ֤י הַ/כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ וְ/הַ/שֹּׁ֣פְטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִהְי֖וּ בַּ/יָּמִ֥ים הָ/הֵֽם
verses.translit: v'mdv shny h'nshym 'shr lhm hryb lpny yhvh lpny hkhhnym vhshptym 'shr yhyv bymym hhm
verses.translation: Then both the men, between whom the controversy is , shall stand before the LORD , before the priests and the judges, which shall be in those days;

verses.original: וְ/דָרְשׁ֥וּ הַ/שֹּׁפְטִ֖ים הֵיטֵ֑ב וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה עֵֽד שֶׁ֨קֶר֙ הָ/עֵ֔ד שֶׁ֖קֶר עָנָ֥ה בְ/אָחִֽי/ו
verses.translit: vdrshv hshptym hytb vhnh 'd shqr h'd shqr 'nh b'chyv
verses.translation: And the judges shall make diligent inquisition: and, behold, if the witness be a false witness, and hath testified falsely against his brother;

verses.original: וַ/עֲשִׂ֣יתֶם ל֔/וֹ כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר זָמַ֖ם לַ/עֲשׂ֣וֹת לְ/אָחִ֑י/ו וּ/בִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָ/רָ֖ע מִ/קִּרְבֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: v'shytm lv kh'shr zmm l'shvt l'chyv vb'rt hr' mqrbkh
verses.translation: Then shall ye do unto him, as he had thought to have done unto his brother: so shalt thou put the evil away from among you.

verses.original: וְ/הַ/נִּשְׁאָרִ֖ים יִשְׁמְע֣וּ וְ/יִרָ֑אוּ וְ/לֹֽא יֹסִ֨פוּ לַ/עֲשׂ֜וֹת ע֗וֹד כַּ/דָּבָ֥ר הָ/רָ֛ע הַ/זֶּ֖ה בְּ/קִרְבֶּֽ/ךָ
verses.translit: vhnsh'rym yshm'v vyr'v vl' yspv l'shvt 'vd khdbr hr' hzh bqrbkh
verses.translation: And those which remain shall hear, and fear, and shall henceforth commit no more any such evil among you.

verses.original: וְ/לֹ֥א תָח֖וֹס עֵינֶ֑/ךָ נֶ֣פֶשׁ בְּ/נֶ֗פֶשׁ עַ֤יִן בְּ/עַ֨יִן֙ שֵׁ֣ן בְּ/שֵׁ֔ן יָ֥ד בְּ/יָ֖ד רֶ֥גֶל בְּ/רָֽגֶל
verses.translit: vl' tchvs 'ynkh npsh bnpsh 'yn b'yn shn bshn yd byd rgl brgl
verses.translation: And thine eye shall not pity; but life shall go for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

verses.original: כִּֽי תֵצֵ֨א לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֜ה עַל אֹיְבֶ֗י/ךָ וְֽ/רָאִ֜יתָ ס֤וּס וָ/רֶ֨כֶב֙ עַ֚ם רַ֣ב מִמְּ/ךָ֔ לֹ֥א תִירָ֖א מֵ/הֶ֑ם כִּֽי יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ עִמָּ֔/ךְ הַ/מַּֽעַלְ/ךָ֖ מֵ/אֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם
verses.translit: khy tts' lmlchmh 'l 'ybykh vr'yt svs vrkhb 'm rb mmkh l' tyr' mhm khy yhvh 'lhykh 'mkh hm'lkh m'rts mtsrym
verses.translation: When thou goest out to battle against thine enemies, and seest horses, and chariots, and a people more than thou, be not afraid of them: for the LORD thy God is with thee, which brought thee up out of the land of Egypt.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֕ה כְּ/קָֽרָבְ/כֶ֖ם אֶל הַ/מִּלְחָמָ֑ה וְ/נִגַּ֥שׁ הַ/כֹּהֵ֖ן וְ/דִבֶּ֥ר אֶל הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vhyh khqrbkhm 'l hmlchmh vngsh hkhhn vdbr 'l h'm
verses.translation: And it shall be, when ye are come nigh unto the battle, that the priest shall approach and speak unto the people,

verses.original: וְ/אָמַ֤ר אֲלֵ/הֶם֙ שְׁמַ֣ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַתֶּ֨ם קְרֵבִ֥ים הַ/יּ֛וֹם לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה עַל אֹיְבֵי/כֶ֑ם אַל יֵרַ֣ךְ לְבַבְ/כֶ֗ם אַל תִּֽירְא֧וּ וְ/אַֽל תַּחְפְּז֛וּ וְ/אַל תַּֽעַרְצ֖וּ מִ/פְּנֵי/הֶֽם
verses.translit: v'mr 'lhm shm' yshr'l 'tm qrbym hyvm lmlchmh 'l 'ybykhm 'l yrkh lbbkhm 'l tyr'v v'l tchpzv v'l t'rtsv mpnyhm
verses.translation: And shall say unto them, Hear, O Israel, ye approach this day unto battle against your enemies: let not your hearts faint, fear not, and do not tremble, neither be ye terrified because of them;

verses.original: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֔ם הַ/הֹלֵ֖ךְ עִמָּ/כֶ֑ם לְ/הִלָּחֵ֥ם לָ/כֶ֛ם עִם אֹיְבֵי/כֶ֖ם לְ/הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ אֶתְ/כֶֽם
verses.translit: khy yhvh 'lhykhm hhlkh 'mkhm lhlchm lkhm 'm 'ybykhm lhvshy' 'tkhm
verses.translation: For the LORD your God is he that goeth with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.

verses.original: וְ/דִבְּר֣וּ הַ/שֹּֽׁטְרִים֮ אֶל הָ/עָ֣ם לֵ/אמֹר֒ מִֽי הָ/אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנָ֤ה בַֽיִת חָדָשׁ֙ וְ/לֹ֣א חֲנָכ֔/וֹ יֵלֵ֖ךְ וְ/יָשֹׁ֣ב לְ/בֵית֑/וֹ פֶּן יָמוּת֙ בַּ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְ/אִ֥ישׁ אַחֵ֖ר יַחְנְכֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: vdbrv hshtrym 'l h'm l'mr my h'ysh 'shr bnh byt chdsh vl' chnkhv ylkh vyshb lbytv pn ymvt bmlchmh v'ysh 'chr ychnkhnv
verses.translation: And the officers shall speak unto the people, saying, What man is there that hath built a new house, and hath not dedicated it? let him go and return to his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man dedicate it.

verses.original: וּ/מִֽי הָ/אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר נָטַ֥ע כֶּ֨רֶם֙ וְ/לֹ֣א חִלְּל֔/וֹ יֵלֵ֖ךְ וְ/יָשֹׁ֣ב לְ/בֵית֑/וֹ פֶּן יָמוּת֙ בַּ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְ/אִ֥ישׁ אַחֵ֖ר יְחַלְּלֶֽ/נּוּ
verses.translit: vmy h'ysh 'shr nt' khrm vl' chllv ylkh vyshb lbytv pn ymvt bmlchmh v'ysh 'chr ychllnv
verses.translation: And what man is he that hath planted a vineyard, and hath not yet eaten of it? let him also go and return unto his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man eat of it.

verses.original: וּ/מִֽי הָ/אִ֞ישׁ אֲשֶׁר אֵרַ֤שׂ אִשָּׁה֙ וְ/לֹ֣א לְקָחָ֔/הּ יֵלֵ֖ךְ וְ/יָשֹׁ֣ב לְ/בֵית֑/וֹ פֶּן יָמוּת֙ בַּ/מִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְ/אִ֥ישׁ אַחֵ֖ר יִקָּחֶֽ/נָּה
verses.translit: vmy h'ysh 'shr 'rsh 'shh vl' lqchh ylkh vyshb lbytv pn ymvt bmlchmh v'ysh 'chr yqchnh
verses.translation: And what man is there that hath betrothed a wife, and hath not taken her? let him go and return unto his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man take her.

verses.original: וְ/יָסְפ֣וּ הַ/שֹּׁטְרִים֮ לְ/דַבֵּ֣ר אֶל הָ/עָם֒ וְ/אָמְר֗וּ מִי הָ/אִ֤ישׁ הַ/יָּרֵא֙ וְ/רַ֣ךְ הַ/לֵּבָ֔ב יֵלֵ֖ךְ וְ/יָשֹׁ֣ב לְ/בֵית֑/וֹ וְ/לֹ֥א יִמַּ֛ס אֶת לְבַ֥ב אֶחָ֖י/ו כִּ/לְבָבֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: vyspv hshtrym ldbr 'l h'm v'mrv my h'ysh hyr' vrkh hlbb ylkh vyshb lbytv vl' yms 't lbb 'chyv khlbbv
verses.translation: And the officers shall speak further unto the people, and they shall say, What man is there that is fearful and fainthearted? let him go and return unto his house, lest his brethren’s heart faint as well as his heart.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֛ה כְּ/כַלֹּ֥ת הַ/שֹּׁטְרִ֖ים לְ/דַבֵּ֣ר אֶל הָ/עָ֑ם וּ/פָֽקְד֛וּ שָׂרֵ֥י צְבָא֖וֹת בְּ/רֹ֥אשׁ הָ/עָֽם
verses.translit: vhyh khkhlt hshtrym ldbr 'l h'm vpqdv shry tsb'vt br'sh h'm
verses.translation: And it shall be, when the officers have made an end of speaking unto the people, that they shall make captains of the armies to lead the people.

verses.original: כִּֽי תִקְרַ֣ב אֶל עִ֔יר לְ/הִלָּחֵ֖ם עָלֶ֑י/הָ וְ/קָרָ֥אתָ אֵלֶ֖י/הָ לְ/שָׁלֽוֹם
verses.translit: khy tqrb 'l 'yr lhlchm 'lyh vqr't 'lyh lshlvm
verses.translation: When thou comest nigh unto a city to fight against it, then proclaim peace unto it.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָה֙ אִם שָׁל֣וֹם תַּֽעַנְ/ךָ֔ וּ/פָתְחָ֖ה לָ֑/ךְ וְ/הָיָ֞ה כָּל הָ/עָ֣ם הַ/נִּמְצָא בָ֗/הּ יִהְי֥וּ לְ/ךָ֛ לָ/מַ֖ס וַ/עֲבָדֽוּ/ךָ
verses.translit: vhyh 'm shlvm t'nkh vptchh lkh vhyh khl h'm hnmts' bh yhyv lkh lms v'bdvkh
verses.translation: And it shall be, if it make thee answer of peace, and open unto thee, then it shall be, that all the people that is found therein shall be tributaries unto thee, and they shall serve thee.

verses.original: וְ/אִם לֹ֤א תַשְׁלִים֙ עִמָּ֔/ךְ וְ/עָשְׂתָ֥ה עִמְּ/ךָ֖ מִלְחָמָ֑ה וְ/צַרְתָּ֖ עָלֶֽי/הָּ
verses.translit: v'm l' tshlym 'mkh v'shth 'mkh mlchmh vtsrt 'lyh
verses.translation: And if it will make no peace with thee, but will make war against thee, then thou shalt besiege it:

verses.original: וּ/נְתָנָ֛/הּ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ בְּ/יָדֶ֑/ךָ וְ/הִכִּיתָ֥ אֶת כָּל זְכוּרָ֖/הּ לְ/פִי חָֽרֶב
verses.translit: vntnh yhvh 'lhykh bydkh vhkhyt 't khl zkhvrh lpy chrb
verses.translation: And when the LORD thy God hath delivered it into thine hands, thou shalt smite every male thereof with the edge of the sword:

verses.original: רַ֣ק הַ֠/נָּשִׁים וְ/הַ/טַּ֨ף וְ/הַ/בְּהֵמָ֜ה וְ/כֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יִהְיֶ֥ה בָ/עִ֛יר כָּל שְׁלָלָ֖/הּ תָּבֹ֣ז לָ֑/ךְ וְ/אָֽכַלְתָּ֙ אֶת שְׁלַ֣ל אֹיְבֶ֔י/ךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֛ן יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖י/ךָ לָֽ/ךְ
verses.translit: rq hnshym vhtf vhbhmh vkhl 'shr yhyh b'yr khl shllh tbz lkh v'khlt 't shll 'ybykh 'shr ntn yhvh 'lhykh lkh
verses.translation: But the women, and the little ones, and the cattle, and all that is in the city, even all the spoil thereof, shalt thou take unto thyself; and thou shalt eat the spoil of thine enemies, which the LORD thy God hath given thee.

verses.original: כֵּ֤ן תַּעֲשֶׂה֙ לְ/כָל הֶ֣/עָרִ֔ים הָ/רְחֹקֹ֥ת מִמְּ/ךָ֖ מְאֹ֑ד אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא מֵ/עָרֵ֥י הַ/גּֽוֹיִם הָ/אֵ֖לֶּה הֵֽנָּה
verses.translit: khn t'shh lkhl h'rym hrchqt mmkh m'd 'shr l' m'ry hgvym h'lh hnh
verses.translation: Thus shalt thou do unto all the cities which are very far off from thee, which are not of the cities of these nations.

verses.original: רַ֗ק מֵ/עָרֵ֤י הָֽ/עַמִּים֙ הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔י/ךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְ/ךָ֖ נַחֲלָ֑ה לֹ֥א תְחַיֶּ֖ה כָּל נְשָׁמָֽה
verses.translit: rq m'ry h'mym h'lh 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh nchlh l' tchyh khl nshmh
verses.translation: But of the cities of these people, which the LORD thy God doth give thee for an inheritance, thou shalt save alive nothing that breatheth:

verses.original: כִּֽי הַחֲרֵ֣ם תַּחֲרִימֵ֗/ם הַ/חִתִּ֤י וְ/הָ/אֱמֹרִי֙ הַ/כְּנַעֲנִ֣י וְ/הַ/פְּרִזִּ֔י הַ/חִוִּ֖י וְ/הַ/יְבוּסִ֑י כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוְּ/ךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽי/ךָ
verses.translit: khy hchrm tchrymm hchty vh'mry hkhn'ny vhprzy hchvy vhybvsy kh'shr tsvkh yhvh 'lhykh
verses.translation: But thou shalt utterly destroy them; namely , the Hittites, and the Amorites, the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites; as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee:

verses.original: לְמַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹֽא יְלַמְּד֤וּ אֶתְ/כֶם֙ לַ/עֲשׂ֔וֹת כְּ/כֹל֙ תּֽוֹעֲבֹתָ֔/ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשׂ֖וּ לֵֽ/אלֹהֵי/הֶ֑ם וַ/חֲטָאתֶ֖ם לַ/יהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי/כֶֽם
verses.translit: lm'n 'shr l' ylmdv 'tkhm l'shvt khkhl tv'btm 'shr 'shv l'lhyhm vcht'tm lyhvh 'lhykhm
verses.translation: That they teach you not to do after all their abominations, which they have done unto their gods; so should ye sin against the LORD your God.

verses.original: כִּֽי תָצ֣וּר אֶל עִיר֩ יָמִ֨ים רַבִּ֜ים לְֽ/הִלָּחֵ֧ם עָלֶ֣י/הָ לְ/תָפְשָׂ֗/הּ לֹֽא תַשְׁחִ֤ית אֶת עֵצָ/הּ֙ לִ/נְדֹּ֤חַ עָלָי/ו֙ גַּרְזֶ֔ן כִּ֚י מִמֶּ֣/נּוּ תֹאכֵ֔ל וְ/אֹת֖/וֹ לֹ֣א תִכְרֹ֑ת כִּ֤י הָֽ/אָדָם֙ עֵ֣ץ הַ/שָּׂדֶ֔ה לָ/בֹ֥א מִ/פָּנֶ֖י/ךָ בַּ/מָּצֽוֹר
verses.translit: khy ttsvr 'l 'yr ymym rbym lhlchm 'lyh ltpshh l' tshchyt 't 'tsh lndch 'lyv grzn khy mmnv t'khl v'tv l' tkhrt khy h'dm 'ts hshdh lb' mpnykh bmtsvr
verses.translation: When thou shalt besiege a city a long time, in making war against it to take it, thou shalt not destroy the trees thereof by forcing an axe against them: for thou mayest eat of them, and thou shalt not cut them down (for the tree of the field is man’s life ) to employ them in the siege:

verses.original: רַ֞ק עֵ֣ץ אֲשֶׁר תֵּדַ֗ע כִּֽי לֹא עֵ֤ץ מַאֲכָל֙ ה֔וּא אֹת֥/וֹ תַשְׁחִ֖ית וְ/כָרָ֑תָּ וּ/בָנִ֣יתָ מָצ֗וֹר עַל הָ/עִיר֙ אֲשֶׁר הִ֨וא עֹשָׂ֧ה עִמְּ/ךָ֛ מִלְחָמָ֖ה עַ֥ד רִדְתָּֽ/הּ
verses.translit: rq 'ts 'shr td' khy l' 'ts m'khl hv' 'tv tshchyt vkhrt vbnyt mtsvr 'l h'yr 'shr hv' 'shh 'mkh mlchmh 'd rdth
verses.translation: Only the trees which thou knowest that they be not trees for meat, thou shalt destroy and cut them down; and thou shalt build bulwarks against the city that maketh war with thee, until it be subdued.

verses.original: כִּי יִמָּצֵ֣א חָלָ֗ל בָּ/אֲדָמָה֙ אֲשֶׁר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜י/ךָ נֹתֵ֤ן לְ/ךָ֙ לְ/רִשְׁתָּ֔/הּ נֹפֵ֖ל בַּ/שָּׂדֶ֑ה לֹ֥א נוֹדַ֖ע מִ֥י הִכָּֽה/וּ
verses.translit: khy ymts' chll b'dmh 'shr yhvh 'lhykh ntn lkh lrshth npl bshdh l' nvd' my hkhhv
verses.translation: If one be found slain in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee to possess it, lying in the field, and it be not known who hath slain him:

verses.original: וְ/יָצְא֥וּ זְקֵנֶ֖י/ךָ וְ/שֹׁפְטֶ֑י/ךָ וּ/מָדְדוּ֙ אֶל הֶ֣/עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר סְבִיבֹ֥ת הֶ/חָלָֽל
verses.translit: vyts'v zqnykh vshptykh vmddv 'l h'rym 'shr sbybt hchll
verses.translation: Then thy elders and thy judges shall come forth, and they shall measure unto the cities which are round about him that is slain:

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֣ה הָ/עִ֔יר הַ/קְּרֹבָ֖ה אֶל הֶ/חָלָ֑ל וְ/לָֽקְח֡וּ זִקְנֵי֩ הָ/עִ֨יר הַ/הִ֜וא עֶגְלַ֣ת בָּקָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא עֻבַּד֙ בָּ֔/הּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא מָשְׁכָ֖ה בְּ/עֹֽל
verses.translit: vhyh h'yr hqrbh 'l hchll vlqchv zqny h'yr hhv' 'glt bqr 'shr l' 'bd bh 'shr l' mshkhh b'l
verses.translation: And it shall be, that the city which is next unto the slain man, even the elders of that city shall take an heifer, which hath not been wrought with, and which hath not drawn in the yoke;

verses.original: וְ/הוֹרִ֡דוּ זִקְנֵי֩ הָ/עִ֨יר הַ/הִ֤וא אֶת הָֽ/עֶגְלָה֙ אֶל נַ֣חַל אֵיתָ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא יֵעָבֵ֥ד בּ֖/וֹ וְ/לֹ֣א יִזָּרֵ֑עַ וְ/עָֽרְפוּ שָׁ֥ם אֶת הָ/עֶגְלָ֖ה בַּ/נָּֽחַל
verses.translit: vhvrdv zqny h'yr hhv' 't h'glh 'l nchl 'ytn 'shr l' y'bd bv vl' yzr' v'rpv shm 't h'glh bnchl
verses.translation: And the elders of that city shall bring down the heifer unto a rough valley, which is neither eared nor sown, and shall strike off the heifer’s neck there in the valley:

verses.original: וְ/נִגְּשׁ֣וּ הַ/כֹּהֲנִים֮ בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִי֒ כִּ֣י בָ֗/ם בָּחַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨י/ךָ֙ לְ/שָׁ֣רְת֔/וֹ וּ/לְ/בָרֵ֖ךְ בְּ/שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וְ/עַל פִּי/הֶ֥ם יִהְיֶ֖ה כָּל רִ֥יב וְ/כָל נָֽגַע
verses.translit: vngshv hkhhnym bny lvy khy bm bchr yhvh 'lhykh lshrtv vlbrkh bshm yhvh v'l pyhm yhyh khl ryb vkhl ng'
verses.translation: And the priests the sons of Levi shall come near; for them the LORD thy God hath chosen to minister unto him, and to bless in the name of the LORD ; and by their word shall every controversy and every stroke be tried:

verses.original: וְ/כֹ֗ל זִקְנֵי֙ הָ/עִ֣יר הַ/הִ֔וא הַ/קְּרֹבִ֖ים אֶל הֶ/חָלָ֑ל יִרְחֲצוּ֙ אֶת יְדֵי/הֶ֔ם עַל הָ/עֶגְלָ֖ה הָ/עֲרוּפָ֥ה בַ/נָּֽחַל
verses.translit: vkhl zqny h'yr hhv' hqrbym 'l hchll yrchtsv 't ydyhm 'l h'glh h'rvph bnchl
verses.translation: And all the elders of that city, that are next unto the slain man , shall wash their hands over the heifer that is beheaded in the valley:

verses.original: וְ/עָנ֖וּ וְ/אָמְר֑וּ יָדֵ֗י/נוּ לֹ֤א שפכה שָֽׁפְכוּ֙ אֶת הַ/דָּ֣ם הַ/זֶּ֔ה וְ/עֵינֵ֖י/נוּ לֹ֥א רָאֽוּ
verses.translit: v'nv v'mrv ydynv l' shpkhh shpkhv 't hdm hzh v'ynynv l' r'v
verses.translation: And they shall answer and say, Our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen it .

verses.original: כַּפֵּר֩ לְ/עַמְּ/ךָ֨ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֲשֶׁר פָּדִ֨יתָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה וְ/אַל תִּתֵּן֙ דָּ֣ם נָקִ֔י בְּ/קֶ֖רֶב עַמְּ/ךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְ/נִכַּפֵּ֥ר לָ/הֶ֖ם הַ/דָּֽם
verses.translit: khpr l'mkh yshr'l 'shr pdyt yhvh v'l ttn dm nqy bqrb 'mkh yshr'l vnkhpr lhm hdm
verses.translation: Be merciful, O LORD , unto thy people Israel, whom thou hast redeemed, and lay not innocent blood unto thy people of Israel’s charge. And the blood shall be forgiven them.

verses.original: וְ/אַתָּ֗ה תְּבַעֵ֛ר הַ/דָּ֥ם הַ/נָּקִ֖י מִ/קִּרְבֶּ֑/ךָ כִּֽי תַעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַ/יָּשָׁ֖ר בְּ/עֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה
verses.translit: v'th tb'r hdm hnqy mqrbkh khy t'shh hyshr b'yny yhvh
verses.translation: So shalt thou put away the guilt of innocent blood from among you, when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the LORD .

verses.original: כִּֽי תֵצֵ֥א לַ/מִּלְחָמָ֖ה עַל אֹיְבֶ֑י/ךָ וּ/נְתָנ֞/וֹ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛י/ךָ בְּ/יָדֶ֖/ךָ וְ/שָׁבִ֥יתָ שִׁבְיֽ/וֹ
verses.translit: khy tts' lmlchmh 'l 'ybykh vntnv yhvh 'lhykh bydkh vshbyt shbyv
verses.translation: When thou goest forth to war against thine enemies, and the LORD thy God hath delivered them into thine hands, and thou hast taken them captive,

verses.translit: vr'yt bshbyh 'sht ypt t'r vchshqt bh vlqcht lkh l'shh
verses.translation: And seest among the captives a beautiful woman, and hast a desire unto her, that thou wouldest have her to thy wife;

verses.original: וַ/הֲבֵאתָ֖/הּ אֶל תּ֣וֹךְ בֵּיתֶ֑/ךָ וְ/גִלְּחָה֙ אֶת רֹאשָׁ֔/הּ וְ/עָשְׂתָ֖ה אֶת צִפָּרְנֶֽי/הָ
verses.translit: vhb'th 'l tvkh bytkh vglchh 't r'shh v'shth 't tsprnyh
verses.translation: Then thou shalt bring her home to thine house; and she shall shave her head, and pare her nails;

verses.original: וְ/הֵסִ֩ירָה֩ אֶת שִׂמְלַ֨ת שִׁבְיָ֜/הּ מֵ/עָלֶ֗י/הָ וְ/יָֽשְׁבָה֙ בְּ/בֵיתֶ֔/ךָ וּ/בָֽכְתָ֛ה אֶת אָבִ֥י/הָ וְ/אֶת אִמָּ֖/הּ יֶ֣רַח יָמִ֑ים וְ/אַ֨חַר כֵּ֜ן תָּב֤וֹא אֵלֶ֨י/הָ֙ וּ/בְעַלְתָּ֔/הּ וְ/הָיְתָ֥ה לְ/ךָ֖ לְ/אִשָּֽׁה
verses.translit: vhsyrh 't shmlt shbyh m'lyh vyshbh bbytkh vbkhth 't 'byh v't 'mh yrch ymym v'chr khn tbv' 'lyh vb'lth vhyth lkh l'shh
verses.translation: And she shall put the raiment of her captivity from off her, and shall remain in thine house, and bewail her father and her mother a full month: and after that thou shalt go in unto her, and be her husband, and she shall be thy wife.

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֞ה אִם לֹ֧א חָפַ֣צְתָּ בָּ֗/הּ וְ/שִׁלַּחְתָּ/הּ֙ לְ/נַפְשָׁ֔/הּ וּ/מָכֹ֥ר לֹא תִמְכְּרֶ֖/נָּה בַּ/כָּ֑סֶף לֹא תִתְעַמֵּ֣ר בָּ֔/הּ תַּ֖חַת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִנִּיתָֽ/הּ
verses.translit: vhyh 'm l' chptst bh vshlchth lnpshh vmkhr l' tmkhrnh bkhsf l' tt'mr bh tcht 'shr 'nyth
verses.translation: And it shall be, if thou have no delight in her, then thou shalt let her go whither she will; but thou shalt not sell her at all for money, thou shalt not make merchandise of her, because thou hast humbled her.

verses.original: כִּֽי תִהְיֶ֨יןָ לְ/אִ֜ישׁ שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשִׁ֗ים הָ/אַחַ֤ת אֲהוּבָה֙ וְ/הָ/אַחַ֣ת שְׂנוּאָ֔ה וְ/יָֽלְדוּ ל֣/וֹ בָנִ֔ים הָ/אֲהוּבָ֖ה וְ/הַ/שְּׂנוּאָ֑ה וְ/הָיָ֛ה הַ/בֵּ֥ן הַ/בְּכ֖וֹר לַ/שְּׂנִיאָֽה
verses.translit: khy thyyn l'ysh shty nshym h'cht 'hvbh vh'cht shnv'h vyldv lv bnym h'hvbh vhshnv'h vhyh hbn hbkhvr lshny'h
verses.translation: If a man have two wives, one beloved, and another hated, and they have born him children, both the beloved and the hated; and if the firstborn son be hers that was hated:

verses.original: וְ/הָיָ֗ה בְּ/יוֹם֙ הַנְחִיל֣/וֹ אֶת בָּנָ֔י/ו אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר יִהְיֶ֖ה ל֑/וֹ לֹ֣א יוּכַ֗ל לְ/בַכֵּר֙ אֶת בֶּן הָ֣/אֲהוּבָ֔ה עַל פְּנֵ֥י בֶן הַ/שְּׂנוּאָ֖ה הַ/בְּכֹֽר
